title: Terrain-Aware Thompson Sampling for Multi-Drone Search and Rescue
comment: Accepted to the 18th International Symposium on Distributed Autonomous Robotic Systems (DARS 2026)
summary: In this work, we propose a decentralized terrain-aware multi-drone Thompson Sampling algorithm tailored for search and rescue (SAR) applications. A probability distribution of locating a lost person is informed by terrain data, using established SAR models (displacement ring, elevation, watershed, dispersion angle, and track offset) derived from historical SAR case data on lost person behavior. Exploration is conducted by a team of drones using Thompson Sampling, where candidate actions are selected by drawing samples from this probability distribution, represented by a per-cell Gaussian posterior whose mean and variance are updated through Bayesian inference. This approach balances exploration of uncertain regions with exploitation of high-probability areas to locate a lost person. Observation uncertainty is incorporated through fractional forest coverage, which measures the percentage of an observation occluded by tree coverage and accounts for reduced detection performance in densely vegetated areas. Simulations using real SAR case data (YOSAR) evaluate the proposed method against a coverage planner and a probabilistic active search method in search regions of 1.5 and 3.8 square kilometers, with 5, 10, 15, and 20 agents flying at 50 km/hr. We demonstrate that our method achieves a success rate of approximately 87% within 60 to 247 seconds in the 1.5 square kilometer region, and success rates of approximately 75% to 91% within 161 to 466 seconds in the 3.8 square kilometer region, across different agent configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种去中心化的地形感知多无人机Thompson Sampling算法用于搜救，利用地形数据与SAR历史模型构建失踪者位置分布，通过贝叶斯高斯后验更新实现探索与利用的平衡，并引入森林覆盖遮挡的观测不确定性，在真实YOSAR数据仿真中优于覆盖率规划器与概率主动搜索方法。
AI.motivation: 搜救中失踪者位置高度不确定，且地形（高程、流域、植被遮挡）显著影响其行为与探测概率，现有覆盖率规划器与概率主动搜索方法未充分融合地形先验与观测不确定性，且多无人机协同多为集中式，难以扩展。
AI.method: 构建由地形数据驱动的位置概率分布，采用位移环、高程、流域、扩散角、轨迹偏移等基于历史失踪者行为数据的经典SAR模型；各无人机以去中心化Thompson Sampling选择候选动作，即从逐栅格高斯后验中采样，均值与方差经贝叶斯推断在线更新；以分数森林覆盖率量化观测遮挡导致的探测性能下降。
AI.result: 基于真实YOSAR案例仿真，在1.5 km²与3.8 km²区域、5/10/15/20架无人机、50 km/hr条件下，与覆盖率规划器和概率主动搜索对比；1.5 km²区域成功率约87%，耗时60–247 s；3.8 km²区域成功率约75%–91%，耗时161–466 s。
AI.conclusion: 地形先验与去中心化Thompson Sampling相结合可有效平衡探索与利用，在多种机队配置与区域尺度下实现高成功率与较短找到时间，验证了方法的有效性与可扩展性。

title: SunLightBots: Turning sunlight into self-sustained, high-power motion in soft robots
summary: Soft robots built from active materials can directly convert environmental stimuli into motion, offering a route to energy autonomy and embodied control. However, environmental energy is generally harvested at low power, whereas rapid, mechanically demanding actions require high mechanical output power. Reconciling this mismatch while sustaining self-regulated cyclic actuation is challenging, particularly at the subgram scale, where limited payload capacity constrains the integration of conventional power and control hardware. Here, we present SunLightBots, a class of subgram, sunlight-powered, untethered soft robots that achieve autonomous locomotion under continuous illumination near 1 Sun (100 mW/cm2). Their operation is enabled by a self-resetting snapping (SRS) mechanism that integrates liquid crystal elastomers (LCEs) with snap-through instability to accumulate solar energy supplied at low power, release it as rapid, high-power motion, and reset through photothermal-mechanical feedback. Through coordinated optimization of the LCE actuation temperature, photothermal conversion, actuation stress, and structural energy barrier, the system operates near 1 Sun and achieves a peak mass-specific mechanical power of 89 W/kg. At this irradiance, the optimized LCE generates an actuation stress of 0.1 MPa at approximately 60 deg C. SunLightBots demonstrate sustained swimming, crawling, and repeated impulsive jumping. Under 1.5 Suns, the swimmer advances more than three body lengths per cycle. This work provides a materials-mechanics route toward autonomous soft robots powered entirely by the environment.

AI.tldr: 提出亚克级、阳光驱动的无缆软体机器人SunLightBots，通过"自复位突弹跳变"（SRS）机制将低功率太阳能积累并以高功率爆发释放，在近1个太阳光强下实现自主游动、爬行与跳跃。
AI.motivation: 软体机器人可直接将环境刺激转化为运动，但环境能量采集功率低，而快速、机械负载大的动作需高机械输出功率，二者存在功率失配；在亚克级尺度下，载荷能力限制传统电源与控制硬件的集成，难以维持自调节循环驱动。
AI.method: 设计自复位突弹跳变（SRS）机制，将液晶弹性体（LCE）与突弹跳变不稳定性耦合：以低功率积累太阳能，经突弹跳变瞬间释放为高速、高功率运动，并借助光热-机械反馈实现自复位。协同优化LCE驱动温度、光热转换、驱动应力与结构能垒，使系统在近1 Sun（100 mW/cm²）下工作。
AI.result: 优化后LCE在约60 °C时产生0.1 MPa驱动应力；系统峰值质量比机械功率达89 W/kg；在1 Sun附近实现持续游动、爬行和重复脉冲跳跃；在1.5 Suns下，游动机器人每周期前进超过三个体长。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一条材料-力学协同路径，实现完全由环境能量驱动的自主软体机器人，缓解了低功率采集与高功率输出之间的固有矛盾。

title: Open-Source Transtibial Prosthetic Bypass Preserving Joint Alignment: Gait Learning and Kinematic Evaluation
summary: Prosthetic bypasses allow able-bodied individuals to walk with a prosthesis, enabling safe early-stage testing of new prosthetic devices before clinical trials. However, existing transtibial bypasses impose constraints, such as a contralateral shoe lift or a lateral offset of the prosthesis, and their effects on gait remain poorly documented. We present an open-source transtibial prosthetic bypass that preserves part of the sagittal knee mobility without these constraints. Six able-bodied participants familiarized themselves with the bypass for approximately 10~min, then walked on a treadmill with and without it, and joint kinematics were recorded with motion capture and then extracted with OpenSim. All participants were able to walk without handrail support, although single stance remained shorter on the bypass side (27% vs. 45% of the gait cycle). Bypass-side ankle kinematics were consistent with those reported for transtibial prosthesis users, whereas peak knee flexion during swing decreased from 61° to 36° (p<0.001) and hip range of the sound leg increased from 35° to 51° (p<0.01). Although gait with the bypass does not fully replicate that of prosthesis users, it yielded consistent gait patterns after only 10~min of learning. This bypass therefore provides a useful tool for the lower-limb prosthetics research community, facilitating preliminary experiments with able-bodied participants.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无约束条件的开源小腿假肢旁路装置，保留部分矢状面膝关节活动度，使健全受试者经约10分钟熟悉后即可在无扶手支持下行走，步态模式稳定一致，可用于假肢器械的早期初步测试。
AI.motivation: 假肢旁路（bypass）可让健全人佩戴假肢行走，从而在临床试验前实现新假肢器械的安全早期测试。但现有小腿假肢旁路存在约束条件，如需对侧鞋垫抬高或假肢侧向偏移，且其对步态的影响缺乏系统记录。
AI.method: 设计并公开一种开源小腿假肢旁路，取消上述约束并保留部分矢状面膝关节活动度。6名健全受试者熟悉装置约10分钟后，在跑步机上分别佩戴与不佩戴装置行走；采用运动捕捉记录关节运动学，并用OpenSim提取数据。
AI.result: 所有受试者均能在无扶手支持下行走，但旁路侧单支撑期较短（占步态周期27% vs. 45%）。旁路侧踝关节运动学与文献报道的经胫假肢使用者一致；摆动期峰值膝屈曲由61°降至36°（p<0.001），健侧髋关节活动范围由35°增至51°（p<0.01）。
AI.conclusion: 旁路行走虽不能完全复现假肢使用者的步态，但仅经10分钟学习即产生一致稳定的步态模式。该旁路为下肢假肢研究社区提供了实用工具，便于以健全受试者开展初步实验。

title: Learning Low-Latency Action Verification for Frozen Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have made significant progress in general-purpose robotic manipulation. However, sampled action sequences can be ineffective, while evaluating alternatives with computationally expensive verifiers adds latency at each policy query. In this work, we propose HDH, a lightweight framework that uses hindsight from a frozen VLA's own deployments to improve action verification. The framework has three stages. First, we deploy the policy and collect its autonomous rollouts. We then train a compact action verifier to assign each action chunk a predicted task-success score. Finally, the frozen VLA generates action candidates, and the verifier selects the candidate with the highest score for execution. Across four LIBERO-10 tasks, HDH achieves an average success rate of 82.3\% and on three real-world manipulation tasks, HDH improves average success over the baseline policy by 22.6\%.

AI.tldr: HDH：利用冻结VLA自身部署的后见数据训练轻量动作验证器，在推理时从候选动作中择优执行，无需昂贵外部验证器即可提升操作成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在通用机器人操作上进展显著，但采样得到的动作序列可能无效；而用计算昂贵的验证器评估候选动作会在每次策略查询时增加延迟。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：(1) 部署策略并收集其自主rollout；(2) 利用这些后见部署数据训练紧凑的动作验证器，为每个动作chunk预测任务成功分数；(3) 推理时由冻结VLA生成多个候选动作，验证器选出得分最高者执行。
AI.result: 在四个LIBERO-10任务上平均成功率达82.3%；在三个真实世界操作任务上，平均成功率相对基线策略提升22.6%。
AI.conclusion: 轻量、可复用冻结VLA的自监督部署数据即可实现有效动作验证与候选择优，兼顾性能与推理效率。

title: Learning of LPV Models With Linear Fractional Representations: Initialization, Optimization, and Conditioning
comment: Preprint submitted to the IFAC Journal of Systems and Control
summary: Linear Parameter-Varying (LPV) models with Linear Fractional Representation (LFR) can describe a wide class of nonlinear systems with a control-friendly structure. However, identifying these models together with their scheduling map from input-output data requires solving a non-convex optimization problem that is highly sensitive to initialization. Consequently, existing methods often rely on many random initializations. Instead, our work proposes an initialization strategy based on the Best Linear Approximator (BLA). Furthermore, motivated by an analysis of the impact of rational-dependency LPV-LFR models on the conditioning of the non-convex cost, two multiple shooting methods that improve the conditioning, unconstrained multiple shooting (UMS) and encoder-based multiple shooting (EBMS), are compared. The initialization and multiple shooting methods are evaluated on a nonlinear mass-spring-damper example, showing that BLA initialization consistently yields accurate results, whereas random initialization has a large spread. The results also show that both UMS and EBMS reduce the spread for randomly initialized models. UMS is simple to tune and well suited to few sub-records, whereas EBMS can exploit many short sub-records to further improve conditioning, at the cost of training an encoder and tuning additional hyperparameters.

AI.tldr: 提出基于最佳线性逼近(BLA)的初始化策略，并比较无约束多步法(UMS)与编码器多步法(EBMS)以改善LPV-LFR模型非凸辨识的条件数，在非线性质量-弹簧-阻尼系统上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: LPV-LFR模型能以控制友好的结构描述广泛非线性系统，但从输入输出数据联合辨识模型及其调度映射需解非凸优化问题，对初始化高度敏感，现有方法常依赖大量随机初始化，计算代价高且结果分散。
AI.method: 1) 利用最佳线性逼近(BLA)构造初始化，替代随机初始化；2) 分析有理依赖LPV-LFR模型对非凸代价函数条件数的影响；3) 提出并比较两种改善条件数的多步法：无约束多步法(UMS)与基于编码器的多步法(EBMS)。
AI.result: 在非线性质量-弹簧-阻尼算例上，BLA初始化稳定获得准确结果，而随机初始化结果离散度大；UMS与EBMS均能降低随机初始化模型的离散度。
AI.conclusion: BLA初始化可靠且无需大量随机重启；UMS调参简单、适合子记录较少的场景，EBMS可利用大量短子记录进一步改善条件数，但需训练编码器并调节额外超参数。

title: FreeDeshadow: Shadow Removal for User-Specified Objects With Multimodal Prompts
summary: Existing shadow removal methods either perform global shadow removal or rely on precise shadow masks to guide restoration. Such paradigms limit their ability to selectively remove the shadow cast by a user-specified object in practical applications. To this end, we introduce an object-aware controllable shadow removal task, which allows users to specify a target object through a simple prompt and removes only its cast shadow while preserving other content. However, object-shadow asymmetry makes it challenging to establish accurate correspondence between the specified object and its spatially separated cast shadow and to confine restoration to the target shadow region. To address these challenges, we propose FreeDeshadow, a unified controllable shadow removal framework that supports both visual and textual prompts. It consists of an object-aware generator and a shadow-aware local refiner. The former interprets the user prompt and produces a high-quality shadow-free proposal, while the latter establishes the correspondence between the object and its cast shadow and constrains the generated changes to the target shadow region. To support training and evaluation, we further construct PCSRD+, a large-scale dataset containing 154,571 quadruples at 1024$\times$1024 resolution and covering six types of user prompts. The visual prompts include a dot, a line, and an object mask, while the textual prompts describe the target object using attributes, spatial relations, or states. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FreeDeshadow accurately removes the shadow of the target object under both visual and textual prompts while effectively preserving non-target regions. It also outperforms existing methods in shadow removal performance and controllability. Project Page: https://wzlwlm13.github.io/FreeDeshadow

AI.tldr: 本文提出“物体感知可控阴影去除”新任务，允许用户通过视觉或文本提示指定目标物体，仅移除其投射阴影并保留其他内容；为此构建FreeDeshadow框架（物体感知生成器+阴影感知局部精化器）及大规模数据集PCSRD+（154,571组四元组，1024×1024，六类提示），实验证明其在阴影去除效果与可控性上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有阴影去除方法要么做全局阴影去除，要么依赖精确阴影掩码引导修复，无法在实际应用中只选择性移除用户指定物体所投射的阴影。为此需要定义并解决“物体感知可控阴影去除”任务：用户用简单提示指定目标物体，仅移除其投影阴影而保持其他内容不变。
AI.method: 提出FreeDeshadow统一可控阴影去除框架，支持视觉与文本提示：（1）物体感知生成器解析用户提示并生成高质量无阴影候选结果；（2）阴影感知局部精化器建立物体与其空间分离投影阴影之间的对应关系，并将生成变化约束在目标阴影区域内。同时构建PCSRD+数据集，包含154,571组1024×1024四元组，覆盖六类提示：视觉（点、线、物体掩码）与文本（属性、空间关系、状态描述）。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，FreeDeshadow在视觉提示与文本提示下均能准确移除目标物体的投影阴影，同时有效保留非目标区域；在阴影去除性能与可控性两方面均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作开辟了物体感知可控阴影去除方向，说明通过“生成+局部精化”的解耦设计可缓解物体-阴影非对称性带来的对应与区域约束难题；PCSRD+数据集为该任务提供训练与评测基准。

title: Zugwise: Domain-Aware Game Reconstruction for Digitizing Handwritten Chess Scoresheets
comment: 54 pages, 3 figures. Code and models: https://github.com/GerhardTrippen/Zugwise
summary: Digitizing handwritten chess scoresheets has been studied as a handwriting-recognition problem: read the move in each box and check that it is legal. This framing misses the errors that matter most. A misread that yields an illegal move is loud. One that yields a legal-but-wrong move is silent, because a legality-only pipeline accepts it and reads every later move against a wrong position. We therefore treat the task as game reconstruction and present Zugwise, which repurposes computer-chess machinery (quiescence search, static exchange evaluation, pin detection) to ask not "what should be played?" but "could a human plausibly have written this?" An absurdity detector makes silent errors loud at or near where they occur, and a backward search traces late symptoms to their cause. Candidate ranking excludes chess-quality signals. A Needleman-Wunsch merge adds the second player's sheet as evidence, and review stops send every disagreement between the sheets' legal readings to a human. In oracle replay of two tournament sections, a release adding them cuts silent errors from 16 to 1 and from 50 to 13. Two learned signals, CTC re-scoring against the recognizer's raw output and a Maia-style human-move prior, raise the correct fix's top-rank rate from 58.8% to 78.0% of the replacement decisions where it is a candidate, and hold without refitting on a later section. On the first section, the human-verified output matches an independent expert transcription move for move on 34 of 45 games, and adjudication against the sheets found errors in both records, on different plies. We do not establish that either workflow is faster or more accurate. The system runs entirely in the browser and is free, private, and offline-capable; alongside it we offer a three-way adjudication protocol for a domain where no single record is ground truth.

AI.tldr: 将手写棋谱数字化从"合法移动识别"重新定义为"对局重建"问题，提出浏览器端系统Zugwise，用荒谬性检测与反向搜索把"合法但错误"的静默错误显式化，并用双份棋谱交叉校验证。
AI.motivation: 既有工作将手写棋谱框定为手写识别问题（读取每格移动并检验合法性），但会遗漏最关键的错误：产生"合法但错误"棋步的静默误读会被合法性管线接受，并使后续所有棋步都在错误局面下被解读。此类错误无声且会引发级联污染，因此需要新的问题框架。
AI.method: 提出Zugwise，复用国际象棋引擎机制（静态搜索quiescence search、静态交换评估SEE、牵制检测）来判定"人类是否可能写下这一手"，而非评估"应该走什么"；构建荒谬性检测器在错误发生处或附近暴露静默错误，配合反向搜索把后期症状回溯到病因；候选排序刻意排除棋力质量类信号；用Needleman-Wunsch对齐合并双方棋谱作为额外证据，对两份棋谱合法解读间的分歧提交人工复核。另引入两个学习信号：针对识别器原始输出的CTC重打分，以及Maia式人类走子先验。
AI.result: 在两个赛事组别的oracle回放中，加入双谱合并的版本将静默错误从16降至1（第一组）、从50降至13（第二组）。两个学习信号将替换决策中正确修正的Top-1命中率从58.8%提升至78.0%（仅计正确修正为候选的情形），且在后续组别上无需重新拟合即保持表现。第一组中，人工核验输出与独立专家转录在45局中的34局逐手一致；对裁定发现两份记录都存在错误，且错在不同半回合（ply）。
AI.conclusion: 系统完全运行于浏览器，免费、隐私友好且可离线使用；同时提出面向"无单一真值记录"领域的三方裁定（three-way adjudication）协议。作者声明尚未证明任一工作流更快或更准确。

title: CAFIN: CUDA-accelerated Adaptive Fisher Information Matrix Network Optimization via GPU-Native Kernel Fusion
summary: Second-order optimizers improve deep neural network training using curvature information, but their practical efficiency is limited by GPU execution overhead. AdaFisher reduces Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) approximation costs through diagonal Kronecker structures and exponential moving averages, yet its PyTorch implementation requires sequential CUDA kernel launches, intermediate tensor allocations, and repeated memory accesses. We introduce CAFIN, a GPU-native CUDA kernel fusion framework that improves AdaFisher execution efficiency without changing its optimization formulation. The proposed approach progressively integrates FIM preconditioner construction, exponential moving average updates, gradient preconditioning, momentum accumulation, weight decay, and parameter updates into fused CUDA kernels. Shared-memory reuse, register-resident computation, and in-place operations further reduce memory traffic and intermediate allocations. Experiments using ResNet-18 on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny ImageNet across NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti and RTX 3060 Laptop GPUs demonstrate up to 78.4% lower isolated FIM construction latency and 2.1-26.9% lower optimizer-step latency. The implementation also eliminates approximately 18.91 MB of intermediate GPU memory allocations per optimizer step. Numerical validation confirms consistency within the predefined FP32 tolerance, while convergence accuracy remains comparable across evaluated datasets and random seeds. These findings demonstrate that CUDA kernel fusion can substantially accelerate second-order optimization while preserving AdaFisher's underlying mathematical formulation and learning behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出CAFIN，一个GPU原生CUDA核函数融合框架，在不改变AdaFisher二阶优化器数学形式的前提下，将FIM预条件子构建、EMA更新、梯度预条件、动量累积、权重衰减和参数更新逐步融合为统一CUDA核，显著降低延迟与显存分配。
AI.motivation: 二阶优化器利用曲率信息提升DNN训练效果，但实际效率受GPU执行开销限制。AdaFisher虽通过对角Kronecker结构与指数移动平均降低FIM近似成本，其PyTorch实现仍存在串行CUDA核启动、中间张量分配与重复访存等问题。
AI.method: 设计CAFIN核融合框架，逐步将FIM预条件子构建、EMA更新、梯度预条件、动量累积、权重衰减与参数更新整合进融合CUDA核；结合共享内存复用、寄存器驻留计算与原地操作以减少访存与中间分配。实验采用ResNet-18在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Tiny ImageNet上，于GTX 1660 Ti与RTX 3060 Laptop两种GPU评估。
AI.result: 孤立FIM构建延迟最高降低78.4%，优化器单步延迟降低2.1–26.9%；每步消除约18.91 MB中间GPU显存分配；数值验证在预设FP32容差内保持一致，各数据集与随机种子下收敛精度相当。
AI.conclusion: CUDA核函数融合可在保持AdaFisher数学形式与学习行为不变的同时显著加速二阶优化，说明执行层优化是提升二阶优化器实用性的有效途径。

title: Can I join you? Extended Social Force Based Model with Predictive Control and Barrier Functions for Humanoid Group Repositioning Amidst Obstacles
summary: As social and service robots increasingly share interaction spaces in public, they may form groups while coordinating tasks or interacting with humans. Initial group formation alone is insufficient in dynamic settings, because it can be disrupted when a person or another agent joins, leaves, or passes through the group. Although group dynamics and repositioning have been widely studied in swarm robotics and virtual-agent settings, little attention has been given to socially appropriate repositioning behaviors in groups of humanoid robots. Existing social-force-based approaches provide a useful foundation for group behavior, but they have limited obstacle handling, and can produce unsafe behavior as environmental complexity increases. We propose a novel framework that modulates traditional Social Force, guided by Model Predictive Control (MPC) to plan ahead, bounded by Control Barrier Functions (CBF) to increase safety for robot groups repositioning behaviors. This approach aims to produce safer and socially aware group repositioning behaviors under various group formation disturbance. We evaluate the method in simulation through an ablation study and an online user study. The results show that our proposed method can produce smoother and safer repositioning behaviors in complex environments while preserving social appropriateness.

AI.tldr: 提出一种由MPC引导、CBF约束的社会力模型框架，实现人形机器人群体在动态干扰下的安全、社交得体的重新编队行为。
AI.motivation: 社交与服务机器人日益在公共空间成群协作，但动态环境中成员加入、离开或穿行会破坏初始群组结构；群体动力学与重定位在集群机器人和虚拟智能体中已有研究，人形机器人群体的社交适宜重定位却少有关注。传统社会力方法虽提供基础，但障碍物处理能力有限，环境复杂时会产生不安全行为。
AI.method: 提出新框架：以传统社会力模型为底层调制机制，由模型预测控制（MPC）提供前瞻规划引导，并由控制屏障函数（CBF）加以约束以提升机器人群体重定位的安全性。通过仿真消融实验与在线用户研究进行评估。
AI.result: 在复杂环境中产生更平滑、更安全的重定位行为，同时保持社交适宜性；消融实验验证各模块贡献，在线用户研究支持所提方法的社交可接受性。
AI.conclusion: MPC引导与CBF约束的社会力调制框架可有效提升人形机器人群体在各类编队干扰下的安全性与社交适宜性，为动态公共空间中的群体协调提供可行方案。

title: A Three-Stage Unsupervised Online Physics-Informed Neural Network for Microgrid Optimal Power Flow
summary: Optimal allocation of generators is a key challenge in power systems to achieve economical dispatch while satisfying operational constraints. Conventional optimization techniques can be computationally expensive, limiting their applicability in real-time environments, and neural networks often require offline retraining under new operating conditions. This paper proposes a three-stage unsupervised online physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework for optimal power flow (OPF). Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework satisfies load demand and system constraints while achieving a $43,665 lower operating cost than fmincon-based optimization under the same operating conditions. The training process analysis further demonstrate the framework's ability to adapt its parameters online to variations in load demand and renewable generation in real time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种三阶段无监督在线物理信息神经网络（PINN）框架，用于求解最优潮流（OPF）中发电机的最优分配问题，可在满足负荷需求与系统约束的同时实现在线自适应。
AI.motivation: 传统优化方法计算开销大，难以用于实时场景；神经网络在新工况下通常需要离线重新训练，缺乏在线适应性。因此需要一种既能满足运行约束、又能在线实时调整的OPF求解方法。
AI.method: 提出三阶段无监督在线PINN框架：将物理约束（潮流方程与运行约束）嵌入损失函数，无需标签数据进行无监督训练，并采用三阶段流程实现在线参数更新以适应负荷与可再生出力的变化。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，该框架在满足负荷需求与系统约束的前提下，在相同运行条件下运行成本比基于fmincon的优化低43,665；训练过程分析显示其参数可在线实时适应负荷需求与可再生发电的变化。
AI.conclusion: 该三阶段无监督在线PINN框架为实时OPF提供了一种经济性与约束可行性兼具的解决方案，并具备在线自适应能力。

title: Fast Slice-Wise Deep Learning Motion Correction for Spinal Cord Functional MRI
summary: Respiratory and bulk motion displace the spinal cord between the volumes of a functional MRI time series. Current methods such as the Spinal Cord Toolbox (SCT) take several minutes per time series, and general-purpose brain tools register whole volumes, whereas the cord moves mainly slice by slice. We propose a lightweight convolutional neural network that regresses the in-plane translation aligning each axial slice to a reference. Two models, trained without motion labels, correct large and then residual motion. On a 3T (120 scans) and a 7T (59 scans) dataset, the proposed method improves on SCT on every metric (tSNR +10 to +25%, DVARS -20 to -38%), leaves almost no slice displaced by more than one voxel (<0.1%), performs on par with a slice-wise AFNI variant and better than slice-wise FSL FLIRT, and runs in about 10 s per scan, about 30 times faster than SCT. The code is available at https://github.com/ivadomed/moco-dl and the method is available in SCT v7.4.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级CNN回归每个轴位切片在平面内的平移量，对齐到参考切片，用于脊髓fMRI运动校正。
AI.motivation: 呼吸与整体运动使脊髓在fMRI时间序列的各个volume之间发生位移；SCT等现有方法每个时间序列需数分钟，而通用脑部工具对整卷配准，但脊髓运动主要逐切片发生。
AI.method: 构建轻量级卷积神经网络，回归将每个轴位切片对齐到参考切片的平面内平移；两个模型无运动标签训练，先校正大幅运动再校正残余运动。
AI.result: 在3T（120次扫描）与7T（59次扫描）数据集上，所有指标均优于SCT（tSNR提升10–25%，DVARS降低20–38%）；位移超过1体素的切片<0.1%；与逐切片AFNI变体相当，优于逐切片FSL FLIRT；每扫描约10秒，约比SCT快30倍。
AI.conclusion: 逐切片深度学习配准可在保证或提升图像质量的同时显著加速脊髓fMRI运动校正；代码开源（ivadomed/moco-dl），方法已集成于SCT v7.4。

title: Cleaning an Agent's History Hurts When the World Still Holds the Error
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures; code and data in ancillary files
summary: Tool-using language-model agents accumulate histories of their own mistakes, and a system that compacts, repairs or hands off such a history decides what it says about those mistakes while their effects stay in the world. Prior work cleans the history at a fixed world, where showing a corrected step and saying it is done move together. We ask whether the same correct content helps or hurts depending on how the history states it and what the world holds. We freeze an agent mid-task with its exact world state, edit the history or the world, and let a receiver model continue. On AgentCE-Bench, after the agent commits a wrong value, we hold the world fixed and add the correct value by two natural edits: a truthful note beside the preserved error or the agent's own completed action. The note raises recovery, the share of remaining targets the receiver gets right, from 51% under a matched neutral note to 66%. The completed action lowers it below the unedited history, from 50% to 44%, so the value's presence alone does not predict the effect. On AppWorld, after a database write, we vary whether its receipt reports success or failure and whether its effect is present. A success receipt lowers whole-task success from 45% to 28% while the effect is absent and raises it from 38% to 49% once present. The two effects differ by 27 points pooled over two receivers, a difference positive in six of eight receivers at 97.5% and seven at 95%. A history edit's effect thus depends on the world it describes, and a history made to look clean while the world still holds the error can leave an agent worse off than no edit at all.

AI.tldr: 历史编辑的正确性与否不足以预测其对接收方模型的影响：编辑效果取决于"历史如何陈述"与"世界实际状态"的耦合。在AgentCE-Bench中，中性对照下"真实注释"提升恢复率（51%→66%），而"已完成动作"反而降低（50%→44%）；在AppWorld中，"成功回执"在效果缺失时降低整任务成功率（45%→28%），在效果存在时提升（38%→49%），两者相差27个百分点，且跨接收方具稳健性。
AI.motivation: 现有工作在一个"固定世界"的设定下清理历史，即"展示已修正步骤"与"宣称任务已完成"是同步发生的，无法分离二者的独立作用。作者因此提出研究问题：同样的正确内容，是否会因历史的陈述方式以及世界实际状态的不同而产生帮助或损害的效果。核心动机在于解耦"历史内容正确性"与"世界状态一致性"，并揭示一种风险——当历史被修饰得干净、而错误仍留在世界中时，智能体可能比不做编辑更糟。
AI.method: 采用"冻结—干预—续接"的受控实验范式：将智能体在任务中途连同其精确世界状态一并冻结，然后仅编辑历史或仅编辑世界状态，再让接收方模型（receiver）继续执行任务。AgentCE-Bench实验：智能体提交错误值后固定世界，用两种自然编辑加入正确值——(a) 在保留错误旁附加真实注释，(b) 将正确值写为智能体自身的"已完成动作"，并设匹配的中性注释为对照。AppWorld实验：在数据库写入之后，正交操控"回执报告成功/失败"与"世界效果是否实际保留"，测量整任务成功率，并在多个接收方模型上做重复验证。
AI.result: AgentCE-Bench：真实注释使恢复率（接收方答对剩余目标的占比）由中性对照的51%升至66%；"已完成动作"则由未编辑基线的50%降至44%，说明正确值"存在"本身并不能预测效果。AppWorld：成功回执在效果缺失时将整任务成功率从45%降至28%，在效果存在时则从38%升至49%；两种情形差异合并两个接收方为27个百分点，在8个接收方中6个于97.5%水平显著、7个于95%水平显著。
AI.conclusion: 历史编辑的效用并非内容属性，而是"历史陈述方式×世界状态"的联合函数。仅凭正确信息是否出现来评估历史修复是错误的；当历史被修饰成"看起来干净"而世界仍保留错误时，接收方可能被误导而表现恶于未编辑情形。因此，面向工具智能体的历史压缩、修复与交接机制必须以世界状态为条件进行设计，并需对"叙述—现实"不一致做显式校验。

title: An Asynchronous Federated Learning Platform for Lung Adenocarcinoma Grading via Foundation Models and Structural Pruning
summary: Classification of lung adenocarcinoma into poorly differentiated (PD) and well-to-moderately differentiated (WMD) subtypes plays an important role in patient survival; however, consistent classification is difficult due to inter-observer variability among pathologists. Collecting data from multiple hospitals is also challenging due to patient privacy concerns. This study proposes a web-based federated learning system that shares only locally trained model weights without sharing patient data between institutions. The UNI2 foundation model and CLAM-SB were used to classify pathological whole slide images. A four-client federated learning system was constructed, and the NLST cohort was reserved exclusively for external validation. In centralized evaluation, joint training with CPTAC and TCGA outperformed single-institution training on external validation, confirming the necessity of multi-institutional data integration. FedAvg, FedProx, FedBN, and FedNova were compared as federated learning algorithms under identical experimental conditions. Test AUC ranked as FedBN, FedProx, FedNova, and FedAvg. FedNova showed the most balanced classification performance between PD and WMD. L1-norm structural pruning at 20%, 30%, and 40% sparsity was applied to reduce model transmission size. FedAvg, FedProx, and FedBN showed a tendency of decreasing Test AUC under pruning, while FedNova achieved improved Test AUC across all sparsity levels. A web-based application was developed supporting slide upload, local training, AI classification, and attention heatmap-based visualization. The combination of FedNova and 40% pruning was confirmed as a practical approach that improves communication efficiency and classification performance while protecting patient privacy.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建联邦学习系统，用UNI2+CLAM-SB分类肺腺癌PD/WMD亚型，比较四种聚合算法与结构化剪枝，发现FedNova配合40%剪枝在隐私保护下兼顾通信效率与性能。
AI.motivation: 肺腺癌PD与WMD亚型分级对患者生存预后重要，但病理学家间观察者间变异导致分类不一致；多中心数据整合受患者隐私限制难以集中收集，单一机构数据训练泛化性不足。
AI.method: 提出基于Web的联邦学习系统，仅共享本地模型权重而非患者数据；采用UNI2基础模型与CLAM-SB进行全切片图像分类；构建四客户端联邦系统，NLST队列仅用于外部验证；在相同条件下比较FedAvg、FedProx、FedBN、FedNova；对模型施加20%、30%、40%稀疏度的L1范数结构化剪枝以降低传输体积；开发支持切片上传、本地训练、AI分类与注意力热图可视化的Web应用。
AI.result: 集中式评估中，CPTAC与TCGA联合训练的外部验证性能优于单机构训练，证实多机构数据整合的必要性。联邦算法测试AUC排序为FedBN > FedProx > FedNova > FedAvg；FedNova在PD与WMD间分类性能最均衡。剪枝下FedAvg、FedProx、FedBN的AUC呈下降趋势，而FedNova在各稀疏度下AUC均有提升。
AI.conclusion: FedNova与40%剪枝组合是兼顾通信效率与分类性能、同时保护患者隐私的实用方案，并已落地为可用的Web可视化应用。

title: DIVAL: Diffeomorphic Vector-Field Alignment for Nonholonomic Motion Planning
summary: Conventional vector-field-based motion planners for nonholonomic robots consist of two steps: first designing a nominal vector field and then controlling the robot to follow it to approach the target. However, a nonholonomic robot cannot follow the vector field instantaneously and may collide with obstacles, due to the inevitable mismatch between the robot's initial heading and the vector field's direction. This paper proposes a diffeomorphic vector-field alignment (DIVAL) method, which aligns the vector field's direction with the robot's initial heading so the robot can follow the vector field from the start. Specifically, the nominal vector field is locally reshaped by applying a diffeomorphic deformation to the workspace, such that the reshaped vector field has the same direction as the robot's heading at the initial position and coincides with the nominal vector field outside the deformed region. Since DIVAL eliminates the initial heading mismatch, the nonholonomic robot can maintain heading alignment with the reshaped vector field throughout the motion. This heading alignment further ensures that the robot preserves the nominal vector field's properties, including obstacle avoidance, convergence to the target, and smooth control signals. Numerical simulations provide vector-field-tracking baselines where the nominal vector fields are reshaped with DIVAL. Compared to the original baselines, the proposed method achieves collision-free convergence in all trials and avoids control discontinuities. Hardware experiments on a ground vehicle further demonstrate collision-free convergence across different targets and initial conditions under real-world disturbances.

AI.tldr: 提出微分同胚向量场对齐（DIVAL）方法：通过对工作空间施加局部微分同胚变形重塑标称向量场，使其在初始位置与机器人初始航向一致、在变形区域外与标称场重合，从而消除初始航向失配，保证非完整机器人全程航向对齐并保持避障、收敛与平滑控制特性。
AI.motivation: 传统基于向量场的非完整机器人运动规划分两步：先设计标称向量场，再控制机器人跟踪。但机器人无法瞬时跟随向量场，且初始航向与向量场方向不可避免存在失配，易导致与障碍物碰撞及控制信号不连续。
AI.method: DIVAL：对工作空间施加局部微分同胚变形以重塑标称向量场，使重塑后向量场在初始位置方向与机器人初始航向相同，同时在变形区域之外严格与原标称向量场重合；由此消除初始航向失配，使非完整机器人在运动全程维持航向对齐。
AI.result: 数值仿真中以经DIVAL重塑标称向量场的向量场跟踪方法为基线；相比原始基线，所提方法在所有试验中实现无碰撞收敛并避免控制不连续。地面车辆硬件实验在不同目标与初始条件、真实扰动下亦验证了无碰撞收敛。
AI.conclusion: DIVAL通过微分同胚变形实现初始航向对齐，进而保留标称向量场的避障、目标收敛与平滑控制等性质，仿真与硬件实验均表明其在非完整机器人向量场运动规划中的有效性与鲁棒性。

title: U.S. Data Center Growth Through 2030: A Critical Review of Grid Adequacy and Transmission Expansion Planning
summary: The growth of large data centers raises questions about both supply adequacy and the suitability of load representations used in connection studies. This paper critically reviews the U.S. demand, generation, and transmission outlook through 2030 and examines the implications for transmission expansion planning (TEP). Comparison of public forecasts highlights distinctions among annual average demand, peak demand, and grid connection capacity. National generating-capacity totals cannot establish a dependable surplus because resource availability, regional adequacy, transmission constraints, and project timing determine supply capability. Recent grid events and published dynamic studies demonstrate that faults can trigger substantial data-center transfers to backup supply, followed by delayed or coordinated demand recovery. These behaviors require appropriate representation within the conventional planning framework, alongside assessment of the requested maximum grid import. The selected literature reveals limited integration of validated data-center dynamic models into the technical screening and economic comparison of expansion alternatives. The review identifies the need to establish whether fault response and recovery change feasible connection capacity, required reinforcement, or the preferred transmission investment.

AI.tldr: 本文对2030年前美国需求、发电与输电展望进行批判性综述，指出国家层面装机总量无法证明供应充裕，并强调数据中心故障响应与负荷恢复特性需纳入输电扩展规划（TEP）的建模与技术筛选。
AI.motivation: 大型数据中心快速增长，引发对供电充裕性以及接入研究中负荷表示方法适用性的质疑；同时现有文献缺乏将经验证的数据中心动态模型纳入扩展方案技术筛选与经济比较的整合。
AI.method: 文献综述与公开预测对比分析：区分年平均需求、峰值需求与并网容量三类口径；结合近期电网事件与已发表动态研究，考察故障引发数据中心负荷向备用电源转移及延迟/协调恢复的行为，并对照常规规划框架与最大并网需求评估。
AI.result: 国家层面发电装机总量不能作为可靠盈余依据，因资源可用性、区域充裕性、输电约束与项目投运时序共同决定供电能力；故障可触发数据中心大幅负荷转移并伴随滞后或协调的负荷恢复，常规规划框架难以刻画该行为。
AI.conclusion: 需明确故障响应与恢复过程是否改变可行并网容量、所需加固措施或最优输电投资方案，并把经过校验的数据中心动态模型嵌入TEP的技术筛选与经济比较。

title: What Entropy-Based View Selection Cannot See: An Audit of Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshops on VLM4RWD
summary: Vision-language models such as CLIP can classify images into categories they were never explicitly trained to recognize, but accuracy degrades when test images differ in style or source from their training data. A common remedy generates randomly cropped and flipped copies of each test image, called views, and combines their predictions. Since some views miss the object, methods must identify which views to trust. The dominant approach uses prediction entropy to measure confidence and retains the most certain views. Other methods use signals such as embedding typicality. Despite repeated refinements of these scoring functions, the information they rely on, the model's own response to each view, remains largely unexamined. We investigate this choice while holding other pipeline stages fixed. First, we show that view selection, rather than the gradient update, accounts for almost all accuracy gains. We then examine whether entropy identifies useful views when predictions are wrong, despite at least one view predicting the correct class. In these cases, entropy ranks correct views above incorrect ones no better than chance, recovering only about one-twentieth of the accuracy recovered by an oracle over the same views. This finding holds across two image encoders and under a control ruling out an obvious statistical artifact. An exact analysis explains this limitation: entropy measures confidence but not which class a view favors. We identify an unused signal already available in the augmentation pipeline: the fraction of the original image retained by each crop. Ranking views by this quantity improves accuracy on 14 of 15 benchmark datasets over entropy and on 11 of 15 over the strongest scoring function tested. A pre-method measurement also predicts which datasets benefit.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉语言模型（如CLIP）测试时增强中的"视图选择"问题：指出现有基于预测熵的置信度打分在预测错误时几乎无效，并提出利用裁剪保留比例这一未被使用的信号来排序视图，在多数基准上优于熵及最强打分函数。
AI.motivation: CLIP等视觉语言模型在测试图像风格或来源偏移时精度下降，常用做法是生成随机裁剪/翻转的多个"视图"并融合预测。由于部分视图会丢失目标物体，必须判断哪些视图可信。主流方法用预测熵衡量置信度并保留最确定视图，也有用嵌入典型性等信号。然而，这些打分函数所依赖的信息——模型对每个视图自身的响应——始终缺乏检验，作者因此要填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在固定其他流程阶段的前提下，单独考察视图选择这一环节：(1) 消融比较视图选择与梯度更新对精度增益的贡献；(2) 在"至少有一个视图预测正确但最终预测错误"的样本上，检验熵能否把正确视图排在错误视图之前，并与oracle上界对比；(3) 通过理论/精确分析解释熵的局限，并用对照实验排除统计伪影；(4) 提出以增强管线中天然存在、此前未被使用的信号——每个裁剪保留原图的比例——作为视图打分依据。
AI.result: 精度增益几乎全部来自视图选择而非梯度更新。在预测错误且存在正确视图的样本上，熵对正确视图的排序能力不优于随机（仅恢复约oracle的1/20精度），该结论在两种图像编码器下成立且通过对照实验验证。精确分析表明熵只度量置信度、不反映视图偏向哪一类别。以裁剪保留比例排序视图，在15个基准中的14个上优于熵，在11个上优于所测最强打分函数；预先进行的测量还能预测哪些数据集会受益。
AI.conclusion: 现有基于熵的视图选择存在原理性缺陷：它度量置信但不度量类别倾向，在错误情形下排序近乎随机。裁剪保留比例是一个简单、无需额外计算、已被现成管线提供的有效替代信号，且可预判适用数据集。研究提示应重新审视视图选择打分函数所依赖的信息本身，而非仅反复精调打分形式。

title: Together Compiler: Continual Compilation for AI Inference
summary: Today's AI workloads are rapidly changing: new models are released more often, model architectures are increasingly diverse, and traffic distributions change frequently. The challenge we face at Together AI is continual optimization for these changing workloads. Compiling a deployment into an optimized forward pass is a challenge that is well-suited for agent hill-climbing. Existing systems struggle with continual compilation due to a tradeoff between measurement throughput and fidelity. Many systems use agents to optimize individual kernels from the inference forward pass using offline benchmarks, but timings are low-fidelity because of data-dependent behavior in primitives like mixture-of-experts (MoE). On the other hand, systems use agents to directly optimize end-to-end engines but suffer from slow engine launch times. To address these challenges, we build Together Compiler (TKCC), the first truly continual agent loop designed for AI inference optimization. To address the throughput-fidelity tradeoff, we propose: (1) a Tiered Persistent Engine that decouples engine launch overheads from forward pass computation; (2) a cost model to select the parallelism configurations that seed the optimization process. We also conduct extensive ablations on agent context management and present our insights on deploying TKCC in production. TKCC outperforms highly-optimized hand-written Megakernels on the Llama 1B workhorse workload by up to 1.7x and the best open source engines on the latest frontier models (Kimi K3, GLM 5.3, MiniMax M3.1 Flash, DeepSeek v4.1 Flash) across hardware platforms by up to 2.6x higher TPS on the InferenceX benchmark. TKCC also sets the state-of-the-art performance at batch size 1, with 1111 TPS on M3.1 Flash and 1205 TPS on DeepSeek v4.1 Flash. Finally, TKCC generalizes beyond frontier language model inference. TKCC serves trillions of tokens across our production fleet.

AI.tldr: Together AI 提出首个真正持续的智能体编译循环 TKCC，通过分层常驻引擎与成本模型解决"测量吞吐 vs. 保真度"的权衡，在 Llama 1B 上超越手写 Megakernel 最高 1.7 倍，在 InferenceX 上超越最佳开源引擎最高 2.6 倍，并在生产集群服务数万亿 token。
AI.motivation: AI 工作负载快速变化（模型发布频繁、架构多样化、流量分布漂移），需要持续的部署优化。现有系统难以持续编译：一方面，用智能体对单个 kernel 做离线基准优化，因 MoE 等原语的数据相关行为导致计时保真度低；另一方面，直接用智能体优化端到端引擎，则受引擎启动时间过慢拖累。二者构成测量吞吐与保真度的取舍。
AI.method: (1) 分层常驻引擎（Tiered Persistent Engine），将引擎启动开销与前向计算解耦；(2) 成本模型，用于选择为优化过程提供初始种子的并行配置；(3) 对智能体上下文管理进行大量消融实验，并给出生产部署经验。
AI.result: 在 Llama 1B 主力负载上较高度优化手写 Megakernel 最高提升 1.7 倍；在 InferenceX 基准上，跨多种硬件平台对最新前沿模型（Kimi K3、GLM 5.3、MiniMax M3.1 Flash、DeepSeek v4.1 Flash）较最佳开源引擎最高提升 2.6 倍 TPS；在 batch size 1 下取得 SOTA，M3.1 Flash 达 1111 TPS、DeepSeek v4.1 Flash 达 1205 TPS。
AI.conclusion: TKCC 可推广至前沿语言模型推理之外，已在生产集群服务数万亿 token，验证了持续智能体编译在真实部署中的可行性与收益。

title: Adversarial Risk in the Generative AI Era Necessitates Dropping the Small Epsilon Ball
comment: neurips 2026, 10 pages, position paper on adversarial risk, certified robustness
summary: Adversarial Machine Learning research is currently centered on the search for the epsilon-ball: minimal perturbations designed to fool models while remaining imperceptible to humans. We argue that this fixation on $\ell_p$ norms is a metrological trap that communicates a distorted perception of risk to defenders, one that is unaligned with real-world system vulnerabilities. This paradigm misleads defenders into optimizing for narrow, mathematical robustness at the expense of systemic security, while simultaneously incentivizing attackers to exploit non-overlapping alternative adversarial pathways. Ultimately, we argue that the dominance of the $\ell_p$ ball does not just fail to reduce harm---it may actively facilitate it by communicating a false sense of security against the wrong threats.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场性（position）论文，指出对抗机器学习研究对 ℓ_p 范数下"最小扰动 ε-ball"的执念是一种"计量学陷阱"（metrological trap），会向防御方传达失真的风险认知，因而该范式不仅未必减少危害，反而可能因制造"虚假安全感"而助长危害。
AI.motivation: 当前对抗机器学习研究以寻找 ε-ball（对人类不可察觉、却能欺骗模型的最小扰动）为核心目标。作者认为这种对 ℓ_p 范数的痴迷与真实系统脆弱性错位：它引导防御方优化狭隘的数学鲁棒性而牺牲系统性安全，同时激励攻击者转向与之不重叠的替代对抗路径。
AI.method: 论证式/批判性分析（立场论文），采用计量学（metrology）视角审视鲁棒性评估的度量选择问题：分析 ℓ_p 范数作为风险度量为何与真实威胁模型脱节，及其对攻防双方行为激励的影响。摘要未给出实验或形式化模型。
AI.result: 提出三项论断：(1) ε-ball 基准传达的风险感知是失真的；(2) 该范式导致防御资源错配于窄义的数学鲁棒性；(3) 该范式激励攻击者利用不重叠的替代对抗通道，因此主导地位下的 ℓ_p 度量不仅未能降低危害，还可能主动促成危害。
AI.conclusion: 研究者与防御方应摆脱以 ℓ_p 球为中心的评估惯性，转向与真实世界系统脆弱性对齐的风险度量与威胁模型，避免"以错误威胁为对象的虚假安全感"。该文属观点性呼吁，尚需可操作的替代度量与实证支撑。

title: The Posterior-Prior Epistemic Gap: When World Model Imagination Fails to Carry Task-Relevant Signals
summary: Model-based planners that roll out imagined futures assume the transition model faithfully propagates task-relevant signals---a property rarely measured directly. In a single-seed case study of a Recurrent State Space Model world model with active-inference planning in the CARLA driving simulator, we identify a \textbf{posterior-prior gap}---posterior (observation-filtered) states retain obstacle information that imagined rollout states progressively lose: a supervised obstacle probe achieves AUC 0.85 on posterior states, but the same probe applied to imagined prior states shows monotonic decay (AUC 0.85$\rightarrow$0.71 over 15 steps; logit separation drops 57\%). Because the probe is identical, the decay isolates the transition model---not the representation---as the information bottleneck. Obstacle avoidance drops to 0\% without privileged runtime coordinates, and the planner's own ensemble-based epistemic term does not flag the loss---ensemble disagreement yields AUC 0.52 as an obstacle classifier (chance level), making the failure an unflagged imagination failure---an unknown unknown at planning time. As a secondary contribution, we show that \textbf{task-conditioned weighting of Effective Free Energy components} over the same world model yields lane keeping ($81.2 \pm 1.8$\% route completion) and obstacle avoidance (28/28 avoided, \emph{using privileged coordinates}) in the CARLA simulator, with runtime weight modulation enabling post-evasion centering.

AI.tldr: 该文通过单种子案例研究，发现带主动推理规划的 RSSM 世界模型存在"后验-先验差距"：后验状态保留障碍物信息，而想象 rollout 的滚动预测状态逐步丢失该信息；且集成不确定性无法察觉此损失。作者提出任务条件化的有效自由能加权，在 CARLA 中实现车道保持与避障。
AI.motivation: 基于模型的规划器假设转移模型能忠实传播任务相关信号，但这一性质很少被直接测量。作者希望直接检验"想象 rollout 是否保留任务相关信息"，并验证规划器自身的不确定性估计能否察觉此类信息流失。
AI.method: (1) 在 CARLA 中对 RSSM 世界模型 + 主动推理规划器做单种子案例研究；(2) 训练同一个监督式障碍物探针，分别作用于后验（观测滤波）状态与想象先验状态，并以 AUC 与 logit 分离度随滚动步数的变化量化信息衰减；(3) 检验集成不一致性（ensemble disagreement）作为障碍物分类器的 AUC；(4) 次级贡献：对有效自由能各分量做任务条件化加权，并在运行时调制权重以支持规避后回中。
AI.result: 探针在后验状态上 AUC 0.85，在想象先验状态上单调衰减至 0.71（15 步内），logit 分离度下降 57%；由于探针相同，衰减可归因于转移模型而非表征。若无特权运行时坐标，避障成功率降至 0%；集成不确定性作为障碍物分类器 AUC 仅 0.52（随机水平），说明该失败未被标记。任务条件化加权在 CARLA 中取得 81.2±1.8% 路线完成率，障碍物 28/28 全部规避（使用特权坐标）。
AI.conclusion: 转移模型是任务相关信息的信息瓶颈，规划时可出现"未被标记的想象失败"（规划期的未知未知），且规划器自带的认知不确定性项对此不敏感。任务条件化的有效自由能加权可在同一世界模型上同时改善车道保持与避障，运行时可调权重支持行为恢复。结论基于单种子案例研究，推广性需更多种子与任务验证。

title: An Inductively Assisted N :1 Switched-Capacitor Ladder Converter
summary: This paper proposes an inductively assisted N:1 switched-capacitor ladder buck (D-SCLB) converter that replaces the output-side switch in the bottom half-bridge of an N:1 SCLB with a small inductor placed in parallel with the ladder capacitors during the demagnetization phase. The flying capacitors share the load current delivery, lowering the average inductor current to (1-M)Iout and enabling continuous regulation with M=D/(N-1+D). A closed-form output-impedance model, valid for arbitrary N under both optimal and uniform switch sizing, is derived and compared against SC, SCLB, FCMC, and DPSC topologies. For a 4:1 48V-to-PoL design, the D-SCLB reduces the average inductor current by up to 20% and improves the equivalent output impedance by up to 30% relative to the SCLB. Two hardware prototypes on a low-cost two-layer PCB achieve a peak efficiency of 96.2%, with the D-SCLB using 49% smaller inductor volume than the SCLB at comparable efficiency. Model predictions agree with measurements to within 1.5% under heavy load.

AI.tldr: 提出电感辅助型N:1开关电容阶梯降压（D-SCLB）变换器，通过将下桥臂输出侧开关替换为与阶梯电容并联的小电感，实现降低电感电流并改善输出阻抗。
AI.motivation: N:1开关电容阶梯降压（SCLB）变换器中电感电流较高、等效输出阻抗偏大，不利于高频高密度点到负载（PoL）供电。
AI.method: 在去磁阶段用并联于阶梯电容的小电感替代SCLB下桥臂的输出侧开关；飞跨电容参与负载电流传输，使平均电感电流降至(1-M)Iout，并给出M=D/(N-1+D)的连续调节关系；推导对任意N且在最优与均匀开关尺寸下均适用的闭环输出阻抗模型，并与SC、SCLB、FCMC、DPSC对比；基于4:1 48V-to-PoL设计并在低成本双层PCB上制作两个原型验证。
AI.result: 4:1 48V-to-PoL设计中，D-SCLB相较SCLB平均电感电流最多降低20%，等效输出阻抗最多改善30%；两原型峰值效率达96.2%，在相当效率下D-SCLB电感体积缩小49%；重载下模型预测与实测偏差在1.5%以内。
AI.conclusion: D-SCLB以小型并联电感实现电流分担与阻抗优化，兼顾连续调节、高效率和更高功率密度，模型精度满足工程设计需求。

title: SyntheIce: A Synthetic Radargram Annotation Benchmark for Englacial Layer Reconstruction
comment: 10 pages, 10 figures, 3 Tables, accepted in IEEE International Conference on Big Data (BigData) 2026
summary: Englacial layers in radio-echo-sounding radargrams (subsurface ice images) encode the climate and flow history of ice sheets and glaciers. However, large-scale extraction is hindered by time-consuming manual annotation and semi-automated detectors that produce fragmented rather than continuous horizons. We address two challenges: reconstructing complete layers from partial detections across radargram profiles and validating layer continuity across adjacent tile boundaries. We introduce a slope-aware greedy fragment-linking algorithm that reconstructs full-width layers using row-similarity gating and an exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) slope predictor. Each reconstruction receives a content-based hash ID for stable cross-radargram identification. For quantitative evaluation, we generate SyntheIce, a synthetic dataset of 600 radargrams spanning multiple complexity levels and realistic noise conditions, including 150 wide radargrams divided into four adjacent tiles. All samples include exact ground-truth annotations. We evaluate the dataset using XCheck, a consistency-based validation framework, extending its original two-image setting to four consecutive tiles and enforcing continuity at every boundary. This demonstrates the dataset's utility for developing and evaluating real-world annotation algorithms. Our findings extend beyond ice science: when spatial features are fragmented but retain consistent local geometry, trajectory-based linking is more reliable than appearance-based matching. Evaluation against expert-labeled real radargrams demonstrates high precision, recall, F1-score, and mean IoU, supporting the method's transfer to real-world data.

AI.tldr: 提出斜率感知的贪心碎片链接算法，从局部检测重建完整冰内层位，并用SyntheIce合成数据集与XCheck四瓦片一致性验证框架进行定量评估。
AI.motivation: 冰内层位记录冰盖气候与流动历史，但大规模提取受制于耗时的人工标注与半自动检测器产生的碎片化（非连续）层位；同时需要解决跨雷达剖面、跨瓦片边界的层位连续性与验证问题。
AI.method: 1) 斜率感知贪心碎片链接算法：利用行相似度门控（row-similarity gating）与指数加权移动平均（EWMA）斜率预测器重建全宽层位；2) 为每个重建结果赋予基于内容的哈希ID，实现跨雷达剖面的稳定识别；3) 构建SyntheIce合成数据集：600幅雷达图，覆盖多复杂度等级与真实噪声，含150幅切分为四个相邻瓦片的宽幅图像，全部带精确真值；4) 扩展XCheck一致性验证框架至四瓦片连续设置，在每个边界强制连续性检验。
AI.result: 在SyntheIce上完成定量评估；与专家标注的真实雷达图对比，取得高精确率、召回率、F1与平均IoU，表明方法可迁移至真实数据。
AI.conclusion: 当空间特征碎片化但保留一致的局部几何结构时，基于轨迹的链接优于基于外观的匹配，该结论可推广至冰科学以外的领域；合成数据集与一致性验证框架为开发与评估真实标注算法提供了工具。

title: When Should Semantic Priors Enter Partially-Identified Causal Discovery?
summary: Observational causal discovery often leaves causal di- rections unresolved or unstable. Large language mod- els (LLMs) can provide semantic information to resolve these directions, but incorrect proposals can exclude the true causal graph and invalidate downstream inference. We study three separate decisions: where to allocate semantic queries, which proposals to admit, and which causal graphs to retain. Our framework distinguishes population non-identifiability from finite-sample insta- bility, evaluates semantic orientation against statistical and random controls, and examines calibrated admis- sion and error-tolerant DAG retention. Experiments across benchmark networks show that semantic infor- mation improves recovery over coin-flip orientations, but targeting unstable edges has no established ad- vantage over matched-random allocation. The tested admission certificate cannot support nontrivial admis- sion with the available calibration tasks. Moreover, downstream retention depends on reference adequacy: learned references contain the true DAG in only three of 80 planned tasks. These findings separate the value of semantic information from the reliability of its alloca- tion, admission, and retention, and identify calibration size and reference adequacy as key limitations.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM语义信息用于观测因果发现中定向的三个决策（查询分配、提案准入、图保留），发现语义信息确有价值，但分配、准入与保留环节的可靠性不足，校准规模与参考充分性是关键瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 观测因果发现常留下未定向或不稳定的因果方向；LLM可提供语义信息定向，但错误提案会排除真实因果图并使下游推断失效。作者希望把"语义信息本身的价值"与"其使用机制（分配/准入/保留）的可靠性"区分开来评估。
AI.method: 将问题拆为三个独立决策：(1)语义查询分配——区分总体不可识别性与有限样本不稳定性；(2)提案准入——将语义定向与统计对照及随机对照比较，并检验带校准的准入证书；(3)图保留——采用容错DAG保留与校准准入。在多个基准网络上进行实验，并设置匹配随机分配与抛硬币定向作为对照。
AI.result: 语义信息相比抛硬币定向提升了因果图的恢复效果；但针对不稳定边的定向分配相较匹配随机分配无确立优势；在现有校准任务下，所测试的准入证书无法支持非平凡准入；下游保留依赖参考充分性——学习到的参考仅在80个计划任务中的3个包含真实DAG。
AI.conclusion: 研究将语义信息的价值与其分配、准入、保留机制的可靠性分离开来，指出校准规模不足与参考不充分是当前方法的关键限制。

title: StructRL: Model-Free Reinforcement Learning with Replay Graphs
summary: StructRL turns the experience collected during reinforcement learning into an explicit replay graph. Once the graph contains a path to the task goal, dynamic programming selects actions on the observed part of the state space; these actions form a graph policy that is defined only where the required transitions have been observed. StructRL transfers these actions to model-free learners: as action preferences for a DQN Q-model and as target directions along shortest observed paths for a SAC actor. For DQN on three sparse-reward MiniGrid tasks, final success rises from 0.10 to 0.90 (DoorKey), 0.10 to 0.80 (KeyCorridor) and 0 to 0.50 (ObstructedMaze); plain DQN does not catch up with three times the budget. For SAC on continuous PointMaze, graph-derived direction labels raise final success from 0.17 to 1.0 on seven matched runs that reached the goal. Distilling the graph policy into a fresh Q-model gives a DoorKey 6x6 controller that reaches the goal from 91% of reachable states, against 38% for plain DQN. Scaling experiments identify three bottlenecks: incomplete graph support, structural aliasing, and loss of graph information in high-dimensional inputs.

AI.tldr: StructRL将强化学习过程中的经验组织为显式回放图，在图中存在通往目标路径时用动态规划在已观测状态空间上选动作，形成局部定义的图策略，再以动作偏好（DQN）和最短观测路径方向（SAC）的形式蒸馏给无模型学习器，显著提升稀疏奖励任务的成功率。
AI.motivation: 稀疏奖励任务中无模型强化学习样本效率低、探索困难，单纯增加预算也难以收敛到目标（plain DQN在三倍预算下仍无法追平）。作者希望把经验中蕴含的显式结构信息利用起来，为无模型学习器提供有根据的探索与动作引导。
AI.method: 构建经验回放图（replay graph）；当图中存在到达目标的路径时，用动态规划在已观测状态空间上求解，得到仅在观测转移处有定义的图策略；将该策略迁移至无模型学习器：对DQN的Q模型提供动作偏好，对SAC的actor提供沿最短观测路径的目标方向标签；并进一步将图策略蒸馏进新的Q模型，另做缩放实验分析瓶颈。
AI.result: DQN在三个稀疏奖励MiniGrid任务上最终成功率由0.10提升至0.90（DoorKey）、0.10提升至0.80（KeyCorridor）、0提升至0.50（ObstructedMaze）；SAC在连续PointMaze上用图导出方向标签将最终成功率由0.17提升至1.0（7次匹配运行均到达目标）；蒸馏得到的DoorKey 6x6控制器可从91%的可达状态到达目标，而plain DQN为38%。缩放实验识别出三个瓶颈：图支撑不完整、结构混叠、以及高维输入中图信息丢失。
AI.conclusion: 显式回放图与动态规划可有效提取经验中的结构信息，并作为引导信号显著改善无模型强化学习在稀疏奖励场景下的成功率与泛化到状态空间的能力；其效果受图覆盖度、状态表征混叠与高维输入信息保留程度的制约。

title: Adapting Monocular Depth Estimation in Novel Scenes through Disparity Refinement and Robot Ego-Motion
summary: The geometric understanding of a scene is a crucial component for safe and efficient robotic operations in novel and unstructured environments. The recent emergence of foundation models for Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) has provided an opportunity to enrich robotic perception capabilities with dense long-range depth predictions, replacing expensive onboard hardware (e.g., LiDARs and stereo cameras). However, these offline models are primarily trained on affine-invariant depth representations, and their generalization to novel scenes remains unclear. In this work we present EM-ViT, a monocular depth estimation model that learns to adapt online relative depth inputs from a foundation model prior to the metric scale with observations collected during robotic operations. Motivated by the stereo camera parameterization, our method decomposes depth prediction via dense disparity refinement to recover the scene's relative structure and an effective baseline scalar prediction to determine the missing metric scale. The learning process leverages sparse LiDAR points and, optionally, the robot's Ego-Motion (EM) to rapidly train a lightweight Vision Transformer (ViT), while an internal gradient matching loss preserves the fine-grained semantic structure of the input disparity in real-time. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method on publicly available sequences, such as KITTI, and show that our online learning pipeline can adapt to novel scenes faster and with higher accuracy than existing MDE foundation models. The code and supplementary materials will be publicly available at https://emvit-mde.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出EM-ViT：以基础模型的仿射不变（相对）深度为输入，利用机器人运行中采集的稀疏LiDAR点与自运动（EM）在线快速微调轻量ViT，将相对深度分解为稠密视差细化与有效基线标量预测，从而恢复度量尺度。
AI.motivation: 机器人在新颖非结构化环境中安全作业依赖对场景几何的理解。单目深度估计（MDE）基础模型可在无LiDAR/双目等昂贵硬件条件下提供稠密长距深度，但这些离线模型多以仿射不变深度训练，面向新场景的泛化性不明，且缺失度量尺度。
AI.method: 受双目相机参数化启发，将深度预测分解为两部分：稠密视差细化以恢复场景相对结构，以及有效基线（effective baseline）标量预测以确定缺失的度量尺度。以基础模型输出的相对深度为先验输入，借助稀疏LiDAR点、可选的自运动（Ego-Motion）信息在线训练轻量ViT；并引入内部梯度匹配损失，实时保持输入视差的细粒度语义结构。
AI.result: 在KITTI等公开序列上验证有效；在线学习流程相比现有MDE基础模型能更快适应新场景，且精度更高。
AI.conclusion: 以基础模型相对深度为在线自适应起点、结合稀疏LiDAR与自运动的度量尺度恢复方案，可在机器人运行中快速获得高精度度量深度，是替代昂贵深度传感硬件的可行途径。

title: AgentiGrid: Agentic AI for Steady State and Transient Studies
summary: As power systems worldwide struggle to meet in- creasing loads or higher penetration of inverter based resources, dynamic studies become of increasing importance. The rise of artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities allows to automate some of these resource intensive studies. Coupled with parallel computing, AI is a promising technology to conduct transient and stability studies on an unprecedented scale. This study provides a proof of concept agentic AI capable of parallel or sequential execution of phasor domain studies for a 10,000 bus system. The agent first executes a standalone simulation of a three phase symmetric fault and then executes a series of actions, by first adding a large load to a bus and then applying the fault to the same bus to stress the system. The results of the agentic simulation are consistent with human counterfactual across four vendor backends.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种概念验证型的智能体式AI（agentic AI），可在1万节点电力系统上并行或串行执行相量域动态研究，其结果在四个厂商后端上与人工反事实结果一致。
AI.motivation: 全球电力系统面临负荷增长与逆变器型资源（IBR）高渗透率的双重压力，动态研究愈发重要；此类研究计算密集，人工开展成本高，而AI与并行计算结合有望在大规模尺度上自动化暂态与稳定性研究。
AI.method: 构建一个可执行相量域（phasor domain）研究的agentic AI，支持并行与串行执行，应用于10,000节点系统。流程分两阶段：先对三相对称故障进行独立仿真；再执行一系列动作——向某母线增加大负荷，随后在同一母线施加故障以对系统施压，并与人工反事实（counterfactual）基线对比。
AI.result: 智能体仿真结果与人工反事实结果一致，且在四个不同厂商的仿真后端上均得到验证（结果一致性）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为AI驱动的电力系统动态研究提供了可行性概念验证，表明agentic AI结合并行计算可在万节点级系统上自动化开展暂态与稳定性研究，具备规模化应用潜力。

authors: Mario Alberto Tapia de la Cruz
title: RECALL: Real-Time Recalibration of Multi-Camera Rigs via Learned OEM-Anchored Residuals
summary: Multi-camera rigs ship pre-calibrated from the manufacturer, but their calibration goes stale each time the rig is repositioned, and drifts continuously through wear, thermal cycling, and vibration. Recovering it on-the-fly is hard: classical bundle adjustment needs a fresh multi-view capture and a global optimization whose cost grows with the rig, ruling out real-time use. In this paper we present RECALL, a feed-forward method that recalibrates a movable multi-camera rig in a single pass. From the nominal OEM calibration as an anchor and a brief observation of a known object, it predicts each camera's current intrinsics and extrinsics, written as a shared global rotation of the rig composed with a small per-camera drift. Instead of regressing the calibration in one shot, RECALL refines its estimate with a learned, rig-coupled recurrent operator that reprojects through a differentiable projection and applies attention across the cameras at each step, and solves for the shared rotational gauge in-network with a learned Gauss-Newton step rather than regressing it. Because the ground truth is synthesizable, we train entirely on data generated on-the-fly and need no captured dataset. On a synthetic 10-camera benchmark, RECALL is more accurate than per-camera and rig-coupled joint bundle adjustment ($0.26^\circ$ vs $0.47^\circ$ rotation, $5.4$ vs $8.9$ px focal) and runs about $10^5\times$ faster at about $0.12$ ms per rig. On real data (TotalCapture, CMU Panoptic) it matches or beats offline rig-coupled bundle adjustment on absolute and relative rotation while running four-to-five orders of magnitude faster, and on the Panoptic surround rig it also matches the strongest image-only foundation models (VGGT, VGGT-$Ω$, $π^3$) on relative pose while staying metric and about $15\times$ more accurate in focal length. Code: https://github.com/theICTlab/RECALL-multicam

AI.tldr: RECALL 是一种前馈式多相机rig重标定方法：以OEM标定为锚，借助已知物体的短暂观测，单次前向预测各相机的内参与外参，并用学习的、rig耦合的循环算子（含可微重投影、跨相机注意力与学习的Gauss-Newton全局旋转规范求解）迭代精化；完全在线合成训练，无需实采数据集。
AI.motivation: 多相机rig出厂已标定，但重定位、磨损、热循环与振动会使其持续漂移、标定失效。传统bundle adjustment需重新采集多视图并做全局优化，代价随rig规模增长，无法实时恢复标定。
AI.method: 提出RECALL：输入为厂商名义标定（作为锚）与对已知物体的短观测，输出各相机当前内外参，参数化为"共享的rig全局旋转 ∘ 小的逐相机漂移"。不一次性回归，而是用学习的rig耦合循环算子逐步精化：每步通过可微投影做重投影、跨相机做注意力；共享旋转规范（gauge）不直接回归，而在网络内用学习的Gauss-Newton步求解。因真值可合成，训练数据全部在线生成。
AI.result: 合成10相机基准：旋转误差0.26° vs 逐相机/rig耦合联合BA的0.47°，焦距误差5.4 px vs 8.9 px，速度约快10^5倍，约0.12 ms/rig。真实数据（TotalCapture、CMU Panoptic）：绝对与相对旋转上与离线rig耦合BA相当或更优，速度快四到五个数量级；Panoptic环绕rig上相对位姿与最强纯图像基础模型（VGGT、VGGT-Ω、π^3）相当，同时保持度量尺度且焦距精度约高15倍。
AI.conclusion: RECALL 将多相机rig的在线重标定转化为单次前馈推理问题，在精度上超越甚至替代离线联合BA，速度提升数个数量级，并可在无实采数据条件下训练，适用于需要持续自标定的可移动多相机系统。

title: SynthCorp: A Platform for Creating Benchmarks for Data Agents
comment: SynthCorp v1.0. We will release the benchmarks soon
summary: Current benchmarks for LLM-driven data agents saturate quickly and cannot target specific capabilities. We present SynthCorp, a platform that creates customizable data estates and benchmarks by simulating how business events produce and modify corporate data over time. Each data estate combines relational databases, a document store, and a data catalog, paired with evaluation tasks and executable gold programs. First, given a scenario and target complexity dimensions, SynthCorp synthesizes reusable event types and compiles each into a program over predefined simulation primitives. Second, SynthCorp schedules event instances on a virtual calendar, interleaving routine and disruption events so that tables, documents, and catalog entries remain consistent. Third, SynthCorp executes the calendar to materialize the data estate and records every operation in a simulation log. Fourth, SynthCorp generates analytical tasks and derives verified gold programs from the log. We use SynthCorp to generate initial evaluation benchmarks comprising seven data estates (up to 1K operational tables) and 256 tasks across five domains. The data estates pass deterministic pipeline checks (such as foreign-key violations, undeclared writes, recurrence violations, and database execution failures) with a near-zero error rate, introduce cross-asset complexities, and cover all requested dimensions. Evaluating three models across four data-context settings shows that the benchmarks separate data contexts and model tiers. Auditing candidate queries against causal provenance in the simulation log verifies gold programs without manual annotation, including on multi-event composite tasks that expose reasoning failures in state-of-the-art agents. We hope the community uses SynthCorp to generate more challenging and useful data estates and benchmarks that foster the development of enterprise data agents.

AI.tldr: SynthCorp 是一个通过模拟企业事件在时间上生成和修改数据来构建可定制数据资产与基准的平台，可生成跨关系库、文档库与数据目录的高复杂度基准，并自动产出经仿日志验证的金标准程序。
AI.motivation: 现有面向 LLM 数据智能体的基准很快饱和，且无法针对特定能力维度进行定向评测，亟需可定制、可控复杂度的基准生成手段。
AI.method: 四阶段流水线：①给定场景与目标复杂度维度，合成可复用的事件类型并编译为基于预定义仿真原语的程序；②在虚拟日历上调度事件实例，交织常规事件与扰动事件，保持表、文档与目录条目一致；③执行日历以物化数据资产，并将所有操作记入仿真日志；④生成分析任务并由日志推导出经校验的金标准程序。每个数据资产由关系数据库、文档存储与数据目录组成。另通过对比仿真日志中的因果溯源来审计候选查询，实现无人工标注的金标准验证。
AI.result: 生成初始评测基准：7 个数据资产（最多含 1K 张操作表）、5 个领域共 256 个任务。数据资产通过外键违规、未声明写入、时序复现违规、数据库执行失败等确定性流水线检查，错误率接近零，并引入跨资产复杂度、覆盖全部请求维度。在三模型 × 四数据上下文设置下评测，基准可区分数据上下文与模型层级；对多事件组合任务的审计揭示当前先进智能体存在推理失败。
AI.conclusion: SynthCorp 提供了可扩展、可控复杂度的企业数据智能体基准生成方法，兼具自动金标准验证能力；作者期望社区借此构建更具挑战性的数据资产与基准，推动企业数据智能体发展。

title: KernelMosaic: An Open Dataset and Agentic Framework for CUDA Kernel Generation
summary: Training large language models to generate efficient CUDA kernels requires supervision spanning diverse computational requirements and iterative code optimization. Constructing this supervision is challenging because of heterogeneous specifications, and useful implementations emerge through iterative complicated testing and refinement. We introduce KernelMosaic, an open dataset pairing diverse CUDA tasks with verified solutions and trajectories. Human-guided review and diversity-aware selection curate tasks expressed as natural-language descriptions, reference programs, mathematical specifications, and their intersections. To build the solutions and trajectories, our agentic framework guides a strong LLM through implementation, correctness repair, and performance optimization with reusable CUDA guidance and execution feedback. Supervised fine-tuning of a small open-source model on KernelMosaic raises correctness from 4%, 0%, and 0% to 88%, 82%, and 16% on KernelBench L1, L2, and L3, respectively, while increasing the fraction of tasks with kernels faster than PyTorch eager at every level. Further training experiments show that supervision from the curated trajectories substantially outperforms direct responses and promotes sustained testing and revision. These results demonstrate that KernelMosaic enables a general-purpose model to achieve substantial gains in CUDA kernel generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KernelMosaic——一个开源数据集，将多样化CUDA任务与经过验证的解决方案及求解轨迹配对，用于训练大语言模型生成高效CUDA内核；在小开源模型上微调后，KernelBench L1/L2/L3正确率由4%/0%/0%提升至88%/82%/16%。
AI.motivation: 训练LLM生成高效CUDA内核需要覆盖多样计算需求与迭代式代码优化的监督信号，但此类监督构建困难：任务规格异构，有效实现需经复杂的迭代测试与精炼才能涌现。
AI.method: 构建KernelMosaic数据集：采用人工引导审核与多样性感知筛选，将任务表示为自然语言描述、参考程序、数学规格及其交集；用智能体框架引导强LLM完成实现、正确性修复与性能优化，并借助可复用CUDA指导与执行反馈生成解决方案和轨迹。随后在小开源模型上进行监督微调，并比较轨迹监督与直接回答监督的效果。
AI.result: 微调后KernelBench L1/L2/L3正确率分别从4%、0%、0%提升至88%、82%、16%，且各级别中内核快于PyTorch eager的任务比例均上升；消融显示精选轨迹监督显著优于直接回答监督，并能促进持续的测试与修订行为。
AI.conclusion: KernelMosaic使通用模型在CUDA内核生成上取得实质性提升，验证了高质量、多规格、带轨迹的监督数据对内核生成任务的关键作用。

title: Scaling VLA Serving Under Robotic Execution Constraints
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose robotic manipulation. In our production setting, hundreds of VLA-powered robots are already operating in real-world environments, creating an immediate need for efficient fleet serving. We present XInfer, a production-deployed VLA serving system designed to reduce the inference infrastructure cost of large-scale robotic deployments. XInfer jointly coordinates heterogeneous VLA computation with the evolving response requirements of robotic execution. By exploiting computational parallelism while managing interference, XInfer improves GPU efficiency while protecting time-critical robotic feedback. We evaluate XInfer across three VLA models using production-derived workloads, achieving 1.26-3.75 times the effective robot capacity (ERC) of state-of-the-art systems under physical-execution constraints. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/X-Square-Robot/xinfer.

AI.tldr: XInfer：面向大规模机器人集群的生产级VLA推理服务系统，通过协同调度异构VLA计算与机器人执行时变的响应需求，在管理干扰的同时利用计算并行性，提升GPU效率并保障时敏反馈，使有效机器人容量提升1.26–3.75倍。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中已有数百台VLA驱动机器人实际运行，亟需高效的集群级serving能力；而大规模部署的推理基础设施成本高，且机器人执行的响应时延需求随时间演化，需要在提升GPU利用率与保护时敏控制反馈之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出生产部署的VLA服务系统XInfer，核心是联合协调异构VLA计算与机器人执行侧不断变化的响应需求；通过显式挖掘计算并行性并同时管理由此产生的相互干扰，兼顾GPU效率提升与时敏机器人反馈的时延保障。在三种VLA模型上使用源自生产的工作负载进行评估，以有效机器人容量（ERC）在物理执行约束下为指标。
AI.result: 在三种VLA模型、生产来源工作负载下，在物理执行约束下相比SOTA系统取得1.26–3.75倍的有效机器人容量（ERC）。
AI.conclusion: XInfer表明，将VLA推理的异构计算调度与机器人实时执行需求耦合设计，可显著降低大规模机器人部署的推理基础设施成本；系统已实际生产部署并开源（github.com/X-Square-Robot/xinfer）。

title: Beyond Yes or No: Grading Observability of Power System Dynamic States with Symbolic Coefficients
summary: Graph-based observability analysis runs in seconds where Lie-derivative tests take hours, but it answers only one question: is the system observable or not. It cannot say how well a given set of measurements supports state reconstruction. This paper extends the graph-based approach with symbolic observability coefficients computed from a symbolic Jacobian of the state-space equations, in which every dependency is classified as constant, nonlinear polynomial, or rational. We show that the coefficient tracks the analytical observability determinant of the Lie-derivative approach: it is zero when the determinant vanishes, lies strictly between zero and one when the determinant depends on the state, and equals one when the determinant is a nonzero constant. We apply the method to a seven-state synchronous machine and to the 21-state Western System Coordinating Council nine-bus system under several synchrophasor measurement configurations. On the nine-bus system, the coefficient grows from 0.0952 with one PMU to 0.1905 with two and 0.2857 with three, and the whole analysis runs in under five seconds. Configurations with the same number of PMUs receive the same coefficient, yet an unscented Kalman filter estimates the states with different accuracy for each. The symbolic coefficient therefore grades measurement sets beyond identifying root strongly connected components, while telling PMU locations apart still requires the numerical parameters of the system.

AI.tldr: 提出基于符号雅可比的图论可观测性系数，在秒级时间内对量测配置给出可观测性"程度"分级，并在同步电机与九母线系统上验证。
AI.motivation: 图论可观测性分析速度极快（秒级），但只能回答"是否可观测"的二值问题，无法刻画给定量测集对状态重构的支持程度。
AI.method: 在状态空间方程的符号雅可比基础上，将每个依赖关系分类为常数、非线性多项式或有理式，据此计算符号可观测性系数，扩展原有图论方法。
AI.result: 系数与Lie导数法的解析可观测行列式一致：行列式为零时系数为零，行列式依赖状态时系数严格介于0与1之间，行列式为非零常数时系数为1。九母线系统上系数随PMU数量由0.0952（1个）增至0.1905（2个）、0.2857（3个），全程分析不足5秒；但PMU数目相同的配置得到相同系数，而UKF估计精度各异。
AI.conclusion: 符号系数能在根强连通分量识别之外进一步对量测集分级；然而区分具体PMU安装位置仍需系统的数值参数。

title: BirdDreams: Joint Perspective and BEV Video Generation for a Plausible, Reactive Driving World Model
summary: Driving world models aim to simulate how a scene unfolds under different ego actions. This requires plausible motion of surrounding vehicles as well as precise ego-trajectory control. Learning vehicle motion from perspective video alone is challenging because motion is entangled with appearance and vehicles can be occluded. Prior work therefore conditions video generation on layouts that specify vehicle motion, providing control over surrounding vehicles but requiring their future trajectories as inputs. We introduce BirdDreams, an autoregressive driving world model that jointly generates perspective video and a schematic bird's-eye-view (BEV) video, making scene layout part of the predicted future. The BEV, rendered from scene annotations for training, depicts roads and vehicles as simple shapes at a fixed metric scale, providing a top-down view of their positions and motion with reduced occlusion between vehicles. Perspective video, by contrast, retains scene details that the BEV omits, such as traffic signals and object appearance. Joint attention between two video diffusion transformers, one per stream, lets each stream inform the other during generation. The predicted BEV also provides a geometric interface for ego control: we translate and rotate its latest frame along an input ego trajectory and use the resulting frames as a soft condition that shows how the scene would appear to move if only the ego vehicle moved. At inference, BirdDreams generates both videos from a single camera image without requiring an HD map or vehicle-state inputs. On PhysicalAI-AV and nuScenes, BirdDreams follows input ego trajectories more faithfully than prior driving world models and generates more plausible ego motion without ego-action conditioning. Human evaluation shows that BirdDreams outperforms a perspective-only baseline in generating realistic surrounding-vehicle behavior.

AI.tldr: BirdDreams：一种自回归驾驶世界模型，联合生成透视视频与鸟瞰（BEV）示意图视频，将场景布局纳入预测未来，实现对自车轨迹的精确控制并提升周围车辆运动的合理性。
AI.motivation: 驾驶世界模型需同时满足两点：周围车辆运动合理、自车轨迹可控。仅从透视视频学习车辆运动困难，因为运动与外观耦合且车辆易被遮挡；既有工作依赖给定布局（含周围车辆未来轨迹）作为条件，缺乏自主预测布局的能力。
AI.method: 联合建模双流视频：透视视频流与由场景标注渲染的BEV视频流（固定米制尺度、简化道路与车辆形状、遮挡更少）。采用两个视频扩散Transformer，通过跨流联合注意力相互提供信息。BEV同时充当几何控制接口：将最新BEV帧按输入自车轨迹平移旋转，作为软条件表示"仅自车运动"下的场景变化。推理时仅需单张相机图像，无需HD地图或车辆状态输入。
AI.result: 在PhysicalAI-AV与nuScenes上，自车轨迹跟随精度优于先前的驾驶世界模型；在无自车动作条件下也能生成更合理的自车运动；人工评估显示，在生成真实周围车辆行为方面优于仅透视基线。
AI.conclusion: 将BEV示意图作为预测未来的一部分并与透视视频联合自回归生成，可同时缓解遮挡与外观-运动耦合问题，并为自车控制提供几何接口，实现无需HD地图与车辆状态输入的可控驾驶世界模型。

title: Rational Use of Time for Social Coordination in Humans and AI
summary: All social interactions are situated in time. Previous studies have shown that humans are able to use implicit temporal cues, such as the duration of a pause, to infer others' mental states. But how do humans use temporal cues for dynamic, fine-grained social coordination? And can AI systems do the same, without ``experiencing'' continuous real-time as humans do? We study these questions using a cooperative card game task called The Mind, which requires players to achieve a shared goal across repeated interactions but forbids explicit communication: the only available signal is the passage of time. We evaluate 150 humans, and two classes of AI models which reflect different ways of operationalizing time in artificial systems: computer-use agents (CUAs), and standard text-prompted LLMs. We find that human behavior is best captured by a Bayesian strategy that infers a partner's belief from their timing---and similarly for frontier models. However, unlike humans, none of the tested models seem to efficiently adapt their behaviors to their partners' over the course of the game. From a cognitive perspective, our findings suggest that humans perform implicit probabilistic reasoning about continuous-time signals in dynamic social settings, and that such reasoning mechanisms may emerge without real-time experience. Practically, our study highlights new challenges for AI systems to coordinate efficiently with other agents by learning to interpret and adapt to their implicit signals in dynamic settings.

AI.tldr: 研究用合作卡牌游戏《The Mind》（仅靠时间信号沟通）考察人类与AI如何利用时间线索进行动态社会协调：人类行为可用"从对手时机推断其信念的贝叶斯策略"刻画，前沿模型亦如此，但模型无法在对局中有效适应伙伴。
AI.motivation: 既有研究表明人类能利用停顿时长等内隐时间线索推断他人心理状态，但尚不清楚人类如何在动态、细粒度的社会协调中运用时间线索，以及不"经历"连续实时过程的AI系统能否同样做到。
AI.method: 采用禁止显式沟通、唯一信号为时间流逝的合作卡牌任务《The Mind》；评测150名人类被试与两类AI模型（计算机使用智能体CUAs、标准文本提示LLM），并用行为建模比较不同策略对参与者行为的解释力。
AI.result: 人类行为最佳由"依据伙伴出牌时机推断其信念"的贝叶斯策略解释，前沿模型也呈现类似模式；但与人类不同，所有被测模型在游戏过程中都未能有效根据伙伴调整自身行为。
AI.conclusion: 认知层面，人类能在动态社会情境中对连续时间信号进行内隐概率推理，且此类机制可能无需实时体验即可涌现；应用层面，研究揭示了AI需学会解读并适应他者的内隐信号以实现高效协调的新挑战。

title: Thompson Sampling using Prior-fitted Diffusion Transformers
summary: Thompson sampling is natural randomized strategy for optimizing unknown functions in a black-box manner. In continuous global optimization, Thompson sampling has largely been restricted to Gaussian process priors, as these are essentially the only class for which computing the posterior distribution has been tractable in practice. In this work, we introduce \emph{prior-fitted diffusion transformers}, which are diffusion models that perform Thompson sampling in-context at inference time, after being pre-trained using the prior-fitted network paradigm. To apply these models, we develop a set of practical non-Gaussian priors for general black-box functions---including those that have characteristics that cannot be achieved under Gaussianity, such as priors over unimodal functions. We also quantify the tradeoff between model size and the number of pre-training iterations, and show that these models follow scaling laws akin to those observed in transformers defined over other modalities. Across a set of global optimization benchmarks, we show that prior-fitted diffusion transformers with non-Gaussian priors can achieve improved performance compared to traditional pipelines built on Gaussian processes.

AI.tldr: 提出prior-fitted diffusion transformers（PFDT），用扩散Transformer在推理时以in-context方式执行Thompson sampling，并配套设计一系列非高斯先验，突破连续全局优化中Thompson sampling长期局限于高斯过程先验的限制，在多个全局优化基准上优于基于高斯过程的传统流程。
AI.motivation: 在连续全局优化中，Thompson sampling 受限于高斯过程（GP）先验：因为实际上只有 GP 类先验的后验分布在实践中易于计算。这导致无法表达高斯性之外无法实现的函数性质（如单峰性先验），也限制了方法在大规模/复杂任务上的可用性。
AI.method: 1）引入 prior-fitted diffusion transformers：基于 prior-fitted network 范式预训练的扩散模型，在推理阶段以 in-context 方式完成 Thompson sampling，从而绕过显式后验计算；2）构建一组实用的非高斯先验以覆盖一般黑箱函数，包括单峰函数等高斯先验难以刻画的性质；3）量化模型规模与预训练迭代次数之间的权衡，检验是否呈现类似其他模态 Transformer 的 scaling law。
AI.result: 模型规模与预训练迭代数之间存在可量化的权衡，并表现出与其他模态 Transformer 类似的 scaling law；在一系列全局优化基准上，带非高斯先验的 prior-fitted diffusion transformers 相比基于高斯过程的传统流程取得更优性能。
AI.conclusion: 以扩散 Transformer 实现 in-context Thompson sampling 是可行且有效的，非高斯先验能带来实质性收益，表明该范式可替代以 GP 为核心的传统贝叶斯优化流程；同时其可扩展性（scaling law）为后续按算力/模型规模进行系统化扩展提供了依据。

title: From a Single RGB Image to Robot Execution: Metric Scene Alignment and Contact-Guided Retargeting
summary:
Extending humanoid interaction generation to new environments remains limited by the need for prebuilt 3D scene assets. Reconstructing scenes directly from single RGB images offers a way to overcome this limitation, but introduces a key challenge in maintaining geometric consistency throughout motion generation and transfer. Visually plausible human motions may be misaligned with the reconstructed scene, while retargeting can introduce additional support errors due to differences between human and robot embodiments.
  We present a unified pipeline that transforms a single RGB image into a humanoid motion reference. It reconstructs scene geometry from the input image, generates a human interaction conditioned on the reconstructed scene, and retargets the motion to a humanoid robot. To maintain geometric consistency throughout this process, we incorporate two complementary refinement stages before and after embodiment transfer. Before retargeting, Joint Metric Interaction Refinement (JMIR) refines human motion alignment with the registered metric scene while preserving the generated interaction structure. Following retargeting, Contact Guided Residual Retargeting (CGRR) corrects robot specific support errors to restore the intended support relationships. Together, these stages produce motion references that are consistent with the reconstructed scene and can be followed by multiple pretrained humanoid trackers without scene specific policy fine tuning. Compared with GRAIL, our method reduces refinement time from 480 s to 87 s, yielding a speedup of 5.5 times. The complete pipeline achieves a success rate of 89% in simulation and 70% across 50 physical trials on the Unitree G1, demonstrating its effectiveness in generating executable humanoid motion references from single RGB images.

AI.tldr: 提出统一流水线：从单张RGB图像重建场景几何→生成以场景为条件的人-场景交互运动→重定向到人形机器人，并通过JMIR与CGRR两级精修保证全流程几何一致性，在Unitree G1上实现仿真89%、真机50次试验70%的成功率，精修时间由480 s降至87 s（5.5倍加速）。
AI.motivation: 将人形交互运动生成扩展到新环境受限于需预建3D场景资产；单张RGB图像重建可绕开该限制，但带来全流程几何一致性难题：视觉上合理的人体运动可能与重建场景错位，且人到机器人的重定向会因具身差异引入额外支撑/接触误差。
AI.method: 端到端统一pipeline：单图重建场景几何→以重建场景为条件生成人体交互运动→重定向至人形机器人。为保证几何一致性，在具身迁移前后各设一个精修阶段：(1) 重定向前，Joint Metric Interaction Refinement (JMIR) 在保持生成交互结构的前提下将人体运动对齐到已配准的米制场景；(2) 重定向后，Contact Guided Residual Retargeting (CGRR) 以接触为引导做残差修正，消除机器人特有的支撑误差，恢复预期支撑关系。
AI.result: 相比GRAIL，精修时间从480 s降至87 s，加速5.5倍；完整流水线在仿真中成功率89%，在Unitree G1真机上50次物理试验成功率70%；生成的参考运动可被多个预训练人形跟踪器直接跟随，无需针对场景进行策略微调。
AI.conclusion: 通过"单图场景重建+场景条件交互生成+迁移前后双阶段几何一致性精修"，可在无预建3D资产条件下产出与重建场景一致、且可被现成跟踪器执行的人形运动参考，兼具效率与Sim2Real可行性。

title: Inverse-Optimal Fixed-Time Integral Reinforcement Learning for Unknown Nonlinear Leader-Follower Multi-Agent Systems
summary: This paper develops a distributed inverse-optimal fixed-time integral reinforcement learning framework for unknown nonlinear leader-follower multi-agent systems. The proposed method first reconstructs the unknown agent dynamics from finite integral data. Based on the identified dynamics, a distributed inverse-optimal formulation is constructed by prescribing a desired fixed-time value function and recovering a compatible running cost. A critic-only integral reinforcement learning architecture is then developed using current integral data and finitely informative experience-replay data, thereby avoiding the persistent-excitation requirement. Practical fixed-time convergence of the critic-weight errors is established in the presence of identification and function-approximation residuals. Finally, a network-level composite Lyapunov analysis proves practical fixed-time leader-following consensus of the true unknown nonlinear multi-agent system. Numerical simulations are provided to validate the developed theory.

AI.tldr: 提出面向未知非线性leader-follower多智能体系统的分布式逆最优固定时间积分强化学习框架：先用有限积分数据重构智能体动力学，再构造逆最优问题并以critic-only积分RL实现无需持续激励的固定时间收敛与一致性。
AI.motivation: 未知非线性多智能体系统难以直接设计最优一致性控制器；传统RL依赖持续激励（PE）条件且收敛时间不受控，需要在不满足PE、仅具有限数据与残差情形下获得可保证的固定时间性能。
AI.method: 三步：(1) 基于有限积分数据辨识未知智能体动力学；(2) 在辨识模型上构造分布式逆最优问题——预设期望的固定时间值函数并反解相容的running cost；(3) 设计仅含critic的积分强化学习结构，利用当前积分数据与有限信息量的经验回放数据更新权重，避免PE要求；在存在辨识残差与函数逼近残差情况下证明critic权误差的实际固定时间收敛；最后用网络级复合Lyapunov分析证明真实未知系统实现实际固定时间leader-following一致性。
AI.result: 理论上给出critic权重误差的实际固定时间收敛性，以及真实未知非线性多智能体系统的实际固定时间leader-following一致性；数值仿真验证所提理论。
AI.conclusion: 将数据驱动辨识、逆最优设计与固定时间积分RL相结合，可在免除持续激励的条件下为未知非线性多智能体系统提供具有固定时间收敛保证的分布式一致性方案；收敛为"实际"意义（受残差影响）。

title: From Classification to Generation: Vision-Language Models for Roman Imperial Coin Description
summary: Cataloguing a Roman Imperial coin involves reading its legends and identifying its imagery in order to match it to an entry in the standard reference catalogue. Previous work has automated individual parts of this process, such as identifying the issuer or recognizing reverse motifs, by formulating each part as a classification task over a predefined set of labels. We instead formulate coin description as image-to-text generation and adapt an open-weight vision-language model (VLM), Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, to four tasks: transcribing the obverse and reverse legends, and describing the obverse and reverse imagery. To obtain training data, we convert approximately 30,000 auction records into structured image-text pairs. We separate the two sides of each coin, extract and normalize legends and descriptions, and standardize obverse descriptions against a bust-type taxonomy. We then train a separate low-rank adapter for each task on a single 20GB GPU, and evaluate each task with metrics that we define to capture the key components of numismatic descriptions. The adapted models outperform both the unadapted base model and GPT-4.1 on all four tasks, reducing the normalized edit distance of legend transcriptions by over 40% relative to GPT-4.1. The improvement is smaller, but still present, on legends absent from the training data.

AI.tldr: 该文将罗马帝国钱币的编目描述任务重构为图像到文本生成问题，基于约3万条拍卖记录构建结构化图文数据，用四个独立LoRA适配器微调Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct，在铭文转录与图像描述四项任务上均超越基座模型和GPT-4.1。
AI.motivation: 传统钱币编目需人工辨读铭文与图像并匹配标准目录。已有工作仅将各子环节（如发行者识别、背面图案识别）处理为固定标签集的分类任务，缺乏统一、可扩展的描述生成能力，也无法处理开放词汇的铭文与图像内容。
AI.method: 将钱币描述建模为image-to-text生成，任务分为四项：正面铭文转录、背面铭文转录、正面图像描述、背面图像描述。数据方面，将约3万条拍卖记录转换为结构化图文对：切分钱币正反面、抽取并规范化铭文与描述、按bust-type分类体系标准化正面描述。模型方面，对开放权重VLM Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct为每个任务各训练一个低秩适配器（LoRA），单卡20GB GPU完成训练；并自定义评测指标以覆盖钱币描述的关键构成要素。
AI.result: 四个微调模型在全部四项任务上均优于未适配基座模型与GPT-4.1；铭文转录的归一化编辑距离相对GPT-4.1降低逾40%。对训练数据中未出现的铭文，提升幅度较小但仍存在，显示一定泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 以生成式VLM替代固定标签分类范式，可在数据与算力成本可控的条件下显著提升钱币编目描述质量；分任务LoRA适配与领域定制指标是有效方案，且模型对未见铭文具备部分泛化性。

title: Leaderboard Hacking: Preference-Based Model Evaluations are Vulnerable to Manipulation
summary: Arena-style rankings of language models are a widely used evaluation framework in online leaderboards, research papers, and model evaluation in production. These rankings aim to realistically assess model performance using pairwise comparisons of anonymous models on user prompts, aggregating votes via the Bradley-Terry model to produce the final ranking.
