However, we find that these leaderboards are highly vulnerable to several manipulation strategies that unscrupulous providers could use to boost a model's rank: strategic voting (individual votes that boost a model's rank, including votes on irrelevant models), strategic prompting (choosing prompts that favor a model), and strategic nomination (boosting the rank of a model by inserting irrelevant models). We demonstrate these effects on public leaderboard data, analyze the circumstances that cause these vulnerabilities, and describe approaches to safeguard against each attack. Notably, these issues hold for any preference-based evaluation using the Bradley-Terry model that allows open prompting, voting, or model submission. These manipulations boost the rank of nearly every tested model; each attack can boost a model by up to 15-20 places in a ranking and, combined, they can boost a model by up to 45 places.

AI.tldr: 竞技场式排行榜所依赖的Bradley-Terry偏好聚合对策略性投票、策略性提示与策略性提名高度脆弱，攻击可使模型排名提升15-20名，组合攻击最高提升45名。
AI.motivation: 在线排行榜、论文与生产环境广泛使用竞技场式排名来"真实"评估模型能力，但其开放投票、开放提示与开放提名的机制假设参与者诚实，缺乏对该假设失效时鲁棒性的系统检验。
AI.method: 在公开排行榜数据上构造并演示三类操纵策略：(1) 策略性投票，包括针对无关模型的投票以间接抬升目标模型；(2) 策略性提示，选择有利于目标模型的提示；(3) 策略性提名，插入无关模型以抬高目标模型名次。随后分析脆弱性成因（如对无关模型投票的信息泄漏、提示分布可被选择、模型集合可扩充），并给出针对每种攻击的防护方案。
AI.result: 三类攻击几乎对所有被测模型均有效；单一攻击可使排名提升至多15-20位，三者叠加可使排名提升至多45位。该脆弱性并非特定榜单实现缺陷，而是任何采用Bradley-Terry模型且允许开放提示、投票或模型提交的偏好评估框架的共性问题。
AI.conclusion: 竞技场式排名的可信度依赖于对参与者行为的强假设，需在投票聚合、提示采样与模型准入层面引入防护机制；相关结论可推广至所有基于Bradley-Terry的开放式偏好评估基准。

title: Closing the Loop: Co-Evolving EM for Irregular Time Series Generation in Lifted Representations
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026; The first two authors contributed equally and are co-leading authors
summary: Regular time-series generation from irregular time series is typically reduced to one-shot imputation: complete each partial sequence once, freeze the completions, and train a generator on the resulting surrogate dataset. We show that this open-loop strategy is structurally flawed. Point imputers collapse ambiguous missing regions to conditional averages, while stochastic imputers become stale as the generator evolves; the binding constraint is therefore iteration, not imputer design. We introduce a co-evolving Monte Carlo EM framework that closes the imputer-generator loop. Each E-step samples missing values from the posterior of the current generator, and each M-step retrains the generator on these completions, preserving unconditional generator training. Since our diffusion prior operates in a lifted 2D representation while observations live in time-series space, we further introduce Posterior Sampling for Lifted Representations (PSLR), which enforces operator-consistent conditioning, uncertainty preservation, and manifold consistency during the E-step. Across ten datasets and four corruption regimes, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving over the strongest baselines by 59% in discriminative score, 15% in predictive score, 73% in Context-FID, and 71% in feature-correlation error. Ablations show that our approach reduces average discriminative score by 73% over single-step baselines, closing most of the remaining gap to the clean-data oracle. Code is available at https://github.com/azencot-group/PSLR.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出从-irregular时间序列生成规则时间序列的"一次性插补+冻结生成"开环范式存在结构性缺陷，提出协同演化的Monte Carlo EM框架闭环耦合插补器与生成器，并设计适用于提升2D表示的后验采样方法PSLR，在十个数据集、四种损坏设置下取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有做法将任务简化为一次性插补：对每条残缺序列只补全一次并冻结补全结果，再在替代数据上训练生成器。这种开环策略有两点结构性问题：(1) 点插补器把歧义缺失区域坍缩为条件均值，抹平多模态不确定性；(2) 随机插补器随生成器演化而过时。作者认为关键瓶颈在于"迭代"而非插补器设计本身。
AI.method: 提出协同演化的Monte Carlo EM框架，闭合插补器—生成器回路：E步从当前生成器的后验中采样缺失值，M步用这些补全结果重训生成器，从而保持生成器的无条件训练目标。由于扩散先验工作在提升的2D表示空间、而观测位于时间序列空间，进一步提出Posterior Sampling for Lifted Representations (PSLR)，在E步中同时保证算子一致的条件下、不确定性保留与流形一致性。
AI.result: 在十个数据集、四种损坏机制上达到SOTA：判别分数提升59%、预测分数提升15%、Context-FID提升73%、特征相关性误差降低71%（相对最强基线）。消融显示相较单步基线将平均判别分数降低73%，大幅缩小与干净数据oracle的剩余差距。
AI.conclusion: "冻结插补"的开环范式是问题的根源，将插补与生成置于EM式闭环中协同演化可显著提升不规则时间序列到规则序列的生成质量；配合在提升表示空间上做后验采样（PSLR），可兼顾算子一致性、不确定性与流形约束。

title: ILA: A Transferable Interface-Level Adapter for Compliant Humanoid Motion Tracking
summary: Humanoid motion tracking is fundamental to reproducing human motions on humanoid robots and serves as an important tool for teleoperation and motion data collection. However, directly tracking reference motions can be unsafe in constrained environments or during physical human--robot interaction, motivating the need for compliant motion tracking. We present ILA, an Interface-Level Adapter for compliant humanoid motion tracking without dedicated interaction sensors. ILA adapts motion references from the robot's observation history, allowing the robot to respond to physical guidance while preserving the capabilities of a pretrained motion tracker. As an interface-level module, ILA can be directly plugged into different pretrained motion trackers without retraining either the adapter or the tracking policies. ILA is trained entirely in simulation to predict reference corrections induced by physical interaction. We evaluate ILA with three humanoid motion trackers and achieve a 63.6--75.4% reduction in guidance-target error compared with their original policies. Matched simulation studies and hardware experiments further show that ILA improves responsiveness to human guidance while preserving nominal motion-tracking performance. These results demonstrate compliant guidance as a reusable, sensor-free extension to pretrained humanoid motion trackers.

AI.tldr: 提出接口级适配器 ILA，无需专用交互传感器即可实现人形机器人柔顺运动跟踪，可直接插入预训练跟踪器，引导目标误差降低 63.6–75.4%。
AI.motivation: 直接在受限环境或人机物理交互中跟踪参考运动存在安全风险，需要柔顺的运动跟踪；而现有预训练运动跟踪器缺乏交互感知能力，重新训练成本高，因此需要一种可复用的、无需额外传感器的扩展模块。
AI.method: ILA 作为接口层适配器，从机器人观测历史中推断并修正运动参考，使机器人能响应物理引导，同时保留预训练跟踪器的原有能力。它是即插即用模块，可接入不同预训练跟踪器，且适配器与跟踪策略均无需重训练；适配器完全在仿真中训练，学习物理交互引起的参考修正量。
AI.result: 在三种人形运动跟踪器上评估，引导目标误差相较原策略降低 63.6–75.4%；匹配的仿真研究与硬件实验表明其在提升人体引导响应性的同时保持了标称运动跟踪性能。
AI.conclusion: 柔顺引导可作为预训练人形运动跟踪器的可复用、无传感器扩展，验证了接口级适配范式的有效性与通用性。

title: LLM-Enhanced Deep Reinforcement Learning with Human-in-the-Loop Calibration for Real-Time Optimal Power Flow
summary: Real-time optimal power flow (RT-OPF) requires fast and reliable decision-making under time-varying operating conditions. However, many practical operating preferences and safety related requirements are difficult to encode using conventional numerical rewards alone, which limits the effectiveness and controllability of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) for RT-OPF. To address this issue, this paper proposes an LLM-enhanced DRL framework with human-in-the-loop (HITL) for RT-OPF. The proposed method augments the physics-based reward with sparse language evaluative feedback during offline training, so that semantic operational requirements can be incorporated into policy learning. To improve reliability in RT-OPF, a selective HITL calibration mechanism is further introduced to inspect and correct questionable LLM judgments before they continuously shape the learning process. Case studies on the IEEE 30-bus and IEEE 118-bus systems show that LLM feedback improves policy safety over vanilla TD3, while further HITL calibration achieves the best overall performance and more stable training behavior. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining language guidance and expert calibration for RT-OPF.

AI.tldr: 提出一种融合大语言模型（LLM）与人在回路（HITL）的深度强化学习框架用于实时最优潮流（RT-OPF），以稀疏语言评价反馈补充物理奖励，并通过选择性HITL校准机制修正可疑的LLM判断，提升策略安全性与训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: RT-OPF需在时变工况下快速可靠决策，但许多实际运行偏好与安全要求难以用传统数值奖励完整刻画，导致DRL的有效性与可控性受限。
AI.method: 在离线训练中，将物理基奖励与稀疏语言评价反馈相结合，把语义化运行要求注入策略学习；并引入选择性HITL校准机制，在可疑LLM判断持续塑造学习过程之前对其进行审查与修正。
AI.result: 在IEEE 30节点与IEEE 118节点系统上的算例表明：LLM反馈相比原始TD3提升了策略安全性；加入HITL校准后取得最佳综合性能与更稳定的训练行为。
AI.conclusion: 语言引导与专家校准相结合可有效支撑RT-OPF决策，兼顾语义可控性与可靠性。

title: Neural Compression for Scientific Particle Data: Perspectives on How Learning Can Help
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Extended version of paper accepted at 2026 Conference on Physics and AI (PAI26)
summary: As particle-based simulations grow in scale, efficient compression of scientific data becomes critical. Neural point cloud compression (PCC) methods excel on computer vision (CV) benchmarks, but do they transfer to scientific particle data? We highlight that scientific particles differ from CV point clouds in fractal dimension: CV point clouds are locally planar, but particles are not. This key difference limits the effectiveness of the octree data structure that underpins most PCC methods. Neural codecs achieve only marginal bitrate reductions over the traditional G-PCC baseline on scientific data, revealing a significant performance gap. Supported by an evaluation spanning domains of cosmology, molecular dynamics, and plasma physics, we outline where the structure of scientific data limits current neural approaches and where learning can help in the future.

AI.tldr: 该文指出科学粒子数据的分形维数与CV点云（局部平面）不同，使得主流基于八叉树的神经点云压缩方法失效，在宇宙学、分子动力学、等离子体物理数据上神经编解码器相对G-PCC基线仅获得边际码率收益。
AI.motivation: 粒子模拟规模持续增长，亟需高效的科学数据压缩；神经点云压缩在CV基准上表现优异，但其能否迁移到科学粒子数据尚不清楚，需要系统评估这一迁移性差距。
AI.method: 以分形维数作为关键区分性指标，对比CV点云与科学粒子的局部几何结构；揭示八叉树结构（多数PCC方法的基础）在科学数据上失效的原因；在宇宙学、分子动力学、等离子体物理三个领域开展跨域评测。
AI.result: 神经编解码器相对传统G-PCC基线在科学粒子数据上仅取得边际码率降低，暴露出显著性能差距；并刻画了科学数据结构限制现有神经方法的环节。
AI.conclusion: 科学粒子的非平面分形特性使八叉树先验失配，现有神经PCC难以直接迁移；论文定位了失效边界并指出未来学习中可发挥作用的方向。

title: Robust Task-Aware State Estimation from Pre-trained Perception
comment: The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS), 2026
summary: Agents that perform state estimation using pretrained perception models, e.g., Vision-Language Models (VLMs), face the fundamental challenge that predictions are uncertain. Still, most approaches determinize these predictions into a single best-guess state and make decisions as if it were ground truth. This is brittle because when the guess is wrong, the agent's decisions may be unsafe or infeasible. At the other extreme, maintaining a full probability distribution over symbolic states is often intractable. We propose a middle path, drawing on the underlying probabilities the perception model already produces (e.g., a VLM's output-layer token distributions) to construct a $θ$-confidence Minimal Belief Set (MBS$_θ$), a minimal subset of states whose cumulative probability meets a user-specified belief-mass threshold. The minimality of an MBS$_θ$ ensures that the agent considers only the most likely states, enhancing robustness in downstream decision-making while maintaining computational tractability. Using a novel three-layered belief system, we efficiently approximate individual state probabilities from per-feature predictions and task-level constraints. On this belief construction, we base our MBS$_θ$ construction, while maintaining only a lean factored representation of the belief. Our algorithm, Probability-Ranked Valid State Search (PRaVaSS), takes advantage of the unique structure of this belief system to construct an MBS$_θ$ with correctness guarantees and polynomial complexity in the unconstrained case. Using a VLM as the backbone of our state estimator, we validate our method's theoretical properties, scalability with problem size, and improvement of downstream decision-making when used in a task-planning pipeline.

AI.tldr: 提出以感知模型（如VLM）输出层概率构造 θ-置信最小信念集（MBS$_θ$），并用三层信念系统与PRaVaSS算法在多项式复杂度内高效构造，兼顾鲁棒性与可计算性。
AI.motivation: 基于预训练感知模型（如VLM）做状态估计的智能体面临预测不确定性。现有方法多将预测确定化为单一最优猜测并当作真值使用，一旦猜错会导致决策不安全或不可行；而维护完整符号状态概率分布又往往不可解。因此需要一条介于两者之间的中间路径。
AI.method: 利用感知模型本身已有的概率（如VLM输出层token分布），构造 θ-置信最小信念集 MBS$_θ$——累积概率达到用户指定信念质量阈值的最小状态子集。设计新颖的三层信念系统，从逐特征预测与任务级约束高效近似单个状态概率；仅维护精简的因子化信念表示。在此基础上提出概率排序有效状态搜索算法PRaVaSS，利用该信念系统结构构造带正确性保证的MBS$_θ$，在无约束情形下具多项式复杂度。
AI.result: 以VLM为状态估计骨干进行实验，验证了方法的理论性质、随问题规模的可扩展性，以及在任务规划流水线中对下游决策的改进。
AI.conclusion: 以最小信念集替代单点确定化或全分布推断，是一种兼顾鲁棒性与可计算性的有效折中；PRaVaSS在三层因子化信念结构下可实现有保证且高效的最小信念集构造，并提升下游规划决策质量。

title: Trait Hitchhiking in LLM Post-Training
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is now a standard stage of language model post-training, and the compute devoted to it is growing rapidly. While it has been shown to improve capabilities, particularly for tasks with verifiable rewards, it can also change behaviours and internal properties that the reward does not explicitly target. We present a formalism to describe the evolution of "traits" during RL post-training and, in doing so, recover the Price equation from evolutionary biology. We use this to develop a mathematical model for what we call "trait hitchhiking": the amplification or suppression of non-targeted traits as training redistributes probability across completions. We evaluate this Price update expression on language models trained with GRPO and show that the Price estimates closely track the sampled trait dynamics. These results identify trait hitchhiking as a mechanism by which RL post-training can silently amplify undesirable traits.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用进化生物学的Price方程刻画语言模型RL后训练中"特质"（trait）的演化，揭示非目标特质会随概率重分配被"搭便车"式放大或抑制，并在GRPO训练的模型上验证了Price估计与采样得到的特质动态高度吻合。
AI.motivation: RL已成为语言模型后训练的标准阶段且算力投入快速增长。它虽能提升可验证奖励任务的能力，但也会改变奖励未显式针对的行为与内部属性。现有工作缺乏描述这类"非目标特质"在RL过程中如何演化的形式化框架，因此需要一种数学工具来解释其机制。
AI.method: 作者构建了描述RL后训练中特质演化的形式化框架，并由此推导出进化生物学中的Price方程，进而提出"特质搭便车"（trait hitchhiking）的数学模型——即训练在completion上重新分配概率时，非目标特质被放大或抑制。随后在用GRPO训练的语言模型上评估该Price更新表达式。
AI.result: Price估计值与实际采样得到的特质动态紧密吻合，表明该表达式能有效刻画非目标特质的变化。
AI.conclusion: 特质搭便车是RL后训练悄然放大不良特质的一种机制。该框架为理解和监测RL后训练中的非预期行为变化提供了数学视角。

title: Fast Inference-Time Policy Refinement via Action-Affine World Models
summary: Imitation policies can perform complex manipulation, yet small execution errors can accumulate and cause failure. Refinement can correct these errors, but existing approaches often require additional on-policy learning or costly online planning. Our key insight is that a pretrained policy already supplies a useful nominal behavior: refinement can focus on predicting how small action corrections change its outcome. We therefore learn this local response in a form that is cheap to optimize. Our \textit{action-affine world model} (A\textsuperscript{2}WM) learns local action sensitivities offline from action-perturbed policy rollouts. Given interaction history and a policy proposal, it predicts task-relevant geometry as a nominal trajectory plus a linear response to corrections. It predicts the full planning horizon directly, avoiding the propagation of intermediate errors through recursive model evaluations. Quadratic penalties on predicted task errors and linear correction constraints then yield a cheap convex quadratic program (QP). Online refinement requires one model evaluation and one QP solve, while both policy and model weights remain frozen. Across four simulated manipulation tasks, our framework achieves the highest success rate among evaluated baselines, adding only 3.8 ms of mean refinement overhead per control step, excluding base-policy sampling.

AI.tldr: 提出动作仿射世界模型(A²WM)：以预训练策略的输出为名义行为，离线学习"小动作修正→局部结果变化"的线性响应，预测整段规划视野内的任务相关几何；在线仅需一次模型评估+一次凸QP求解即可修正执行误差，策略与模型权重均冻结。四类仿真操作任务中成功率最高，平均每控制步精修开销仅3.8 ms。
AI.motivation: 模仿策略能完成复杂操作，但微小执行误差会累积导致失败。现有精修方法或需额外的on-policy在线学习，或依赖高成本在线规划，代价过高。
AI.method: 核心洞察：预训练策略已提供有用名义行为，修正只需刻画小的动作扰动如何改变结果。离线从"动作受扰的策略 rollout"中学习局部动作敏感度，得到动作仿射世界模型：输入交互历史与策略提议动作，输出任务相关几何的"名义轨迹+对修正量的线性响应"，并直接预测完整规划视野以规避递归模型评估带来的中间误差传播。在线以预测任务误差的二次惩罚与线性修正约束构成凸QP，一次前向+一次QP求解完成精修，策略与模型参数冻结。
AI.result: 在四个仿真操作任务上，成功率高于所评估的全部基线；除基础策略采样外，每控制步平均精修开销仅3.8 ms。
AI.conclusion: 通过将精修问题化简为对局部线性响应的凸优化，A²WM在免在线学习、免在线规划的冻结设定下实现了高效且有效的策略精修，说明围绕名义行为的局部建模是低开销纠错的一条可行路径。

title: TDMOpt: LLM-Driven Cross-layer Dispatch for Transmission-Distribution-Microgrid Systems
summary: Coordinating transmission networks, distribution networks, and microgrids enables distributed flexibility to support renewable energy integration and low-carbon operation. However, heterogeneous resources, cross-layer coupling, and varying operating requirements complicate the selection of models and coordination schemes that are both physically adequate and computationally tractable. This paper proposes TDMOpt, a LLM-driven multi-agent framework that replaces fixed modeling configurations with adaptive model composition. A layered component library provides executable network, resource, objective, constraint, and coordination models. Guided by retrieved physics and component knowledge, the agents infer specific modeling requirements and jointly select compatible components across layers according to operating conditions and computational budgets. The model compositions undergo independent AC power flow validation, since feasibility in a simplified formulation does not ensure compliance with physical network limits. A refinement mechanism interprets numerical feedback to identify modeling requirements for reconsideration and revise relevant component selections. Case studies on different scale systems illustrate the framework's ability to adapt model combinations and obtain validated dispatch solutions through targeted refinement under varying operating conditions.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 TDMOpt——一个由大语言模型驱动的多智能体框架，用"自适应模型组合"替代固定建模配置，实现输电网、配电网与微电网协同调度模型的可执行组装、独立潮流校验与迭代式修正。
AI.motivation: 输—配—微协同可释放分布式灵活性以支撑新能源消纳与低碳运行，但异质资源、跨层耦合与差异化运行要求使"物理上充分且计算上可解"的模型与协调方案难以选择；传统固定建模配置泛化性差。
AI.method: 构建分层组件库，提供可执行的网络、资源、目标、约束与协调模型；在检索到的物理与组件知识引导下，多智能体推理具体建模需求，并按运行条件与计算预算跨层联合选择兼容组件；对模型组合进行独立 AC 潮流校验；通过精化机制解析数值反馈，识别需重新考虑的建模需求并修订组件选择。
AI.result: 不同规模系统的算例表明，框架能随运行条件自适应调整模型组合，并经定向精化获得通过校验的调度解。
AI.conclusion: 以"模型组合+校验+反馈精化"的闭环替代一次性固定建模，可在保证物理可行性的同时兼顾计算可解性，为跨层协同调度提供可适配的建模范式。

title: Sophon: A Procedural Diagnostic for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
comment: NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). 10 page main text, 44 pages total. Code and data: https://github.com/zgazak/sophon
summary: Open-weight Vision-Language Models (VLMs) score 85-94% on spatial benchmarks (BLINK Spatial, What's Up CLEVR) yet collapse to chance on simple geometric questions when object, scene, and texture priors are stripped away. We introduce and open-source Sophon, a procedurally generated diagnostic of paired colored point-cloud stimuli across three coordinate systems (1D linear, 2D Cartesian, 2D polar) and four question types (binary, categorical, comparative, quantitative). Across four open architectures (LLaVA-NeXT, LLaVA-OneVision, Qwen2.5-VL, Idefics3), accuracy clusters at 47-52% while frontier models (Opus 4.6, Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT-5.4) clear 77-83% and humans reach 84-94%. We use linear probes and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) to trace the open-weight failures. Probes of the vision encoder (ViT) and language decoder (LLM) recover Sophon spatial information at 83-85% and 80-86% accuracy, respectively, and the language tower's reasoning circuit answers text-only controls (point clouds as sets of coordinates) at +40 pp over visual stimuli. Language tower per-layer attention attribution localizes visual integration to mid-stack layers. At readout, models elevate the correct answer-set tokens but select among them randomly. We localize the mechanism by tuning individual and grouped components across every architecture's stack, including the vision tower (ViT workspace and reader), the projector, and the language tower (LLM workspace and reader). These experiments demonstrate that this mid-stack workspace holds circuitry capable of organizing the spatial signal so that the frozen reader can decode it. LoRA fine-tuning adjusts that circuitry such that 7B-class VLMs answer Sophon spatial reasoning questions at frontier aggregate accuracy. This work suggests that these models do not have a capability gap for spatial reasoning but suffer from a routing bottleneck that targeted fine-tuning repairs.

AI.tldr: 开放权重VLM在几何空间推理上的失败并非能力缺失，而是中层"路由瓶颈"：视觉信号在语言塔中层已被整合，但读出时被随机化选择；针对性LoRA微调可修复该瓶颈，使7B级模型达到前沿模型的聚合准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有开放权重VLM在BLINK Spatial、What's Up CLEVR等基准上得分85-94%，但一旦剥离物体、场景与纹理先验，面对简单几何问题时准确率跌至随机水平。作者希望区分这种失败究竟是"能力缺口"还是"信号路由/读出问题"，并给出可诊断、可修复的机制性解释。
AI.method: 1) 构建并开源Sophon：程序化生成成对彩色点云刺激，覆盖三种坐标系（1D线性、2D笛卡尔、2D极坐标）与四类问题（二分类、类别、比较、定量）。2) 评测四个开放架构（LLaVA-NeXT、LLaVA-OneVision、Qwen2.5-VL、Idefics3）与前沿模型、人类。3) 线性探针检测ViT与LLM中空间信息的可解码性；用纯文本对照（点云坐标集合）检验语言塔推理回路。4) 逐层注意力归因定位视觉整合层。5) 对视觉塔（ViT workspace与reader）、投影器、语言塔（LLM workspace与reader）进行单组件与分组LoRA微调，定位机制。
AI.result: 四个开放架构准确率集中在47-52%，前沿模型（Opus 4.6、Gemini 2.5 Pro、GPT-5.4）达77-83%，人类84-94%。ViT与LLM线性探针分别以83-85%和80-86%恢复Sophon空间信息；语言塔在纯文本对照上比视觉刺激高出+40个百分点；逐层注意力归因显示视觉整合位于中stack层；读出阶段模型会抬高正确答案集token的概率，但在集合内部随机选择。分组与单组件微调表明，该中层workspace具备组织空间信号、使冻结reader可解码的回路；基于此的LoRA微调使7B级VLM在Sophon上达到前沿模型的聚合准确率。
AI.conclusion: 开放权重VLM在剥离先验的几何空间推理上存在系统性"路由瓶颈"而非能力缺口：空间信息在视觉编码器与语言塔中层均可被解码，语言塔推理回路本身可用，但视觉整合发生在中stack层且读出选择失效。针对中层workspace的定向LoRA微调即可修复该瓶颈，提示评测分数与内在能力之间的差距可由机制定位与针对性适配弥合。

title: When Is Proof-Step Verification Worth Its Cost? Operating Requirements of Certify-or-Decline Verification for Open-Weight Mathematical Reasoning
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 13 tables. Accepted at the 6th Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (MATH-AI) at NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/yashica-patodia/certify-or-decline
summary: Proof-step verification rewrites a solver's answer into typed steps and uses LLM judges to certify or decline. We evaluate this pipeline on open-weight models across GPQA, AIME-2025, and a MATH-500 subset. Certification raises answer-key-match precision by 31 percentage points on the strong GPQA configuration and 46 on AIME, while answering only 35% and 21% of attempts. On near-ceiling MATH-500, gains are at most 5 points at a loss of 13-27 points of coverage. An output-token-matched self-consistency selector obtains 82.9% precision at 35% coverage, compared with the verifier's pooled 87.6% (paired difference: +4.8 points, 95% interval [-8.2, 18.5]). A diagnostic sample reveals a distinct failure mode: 52 of 88 completed problems end in invalid proof construction without ever reaching a judge. Finally, external-LLM acceptance of rendered certified chains is 61.0-67.6%, compared with 87.6% answer-key match. These audits lack human or formal-kernel ground truth. Open-weight auditor pairs show near-zero chance-corrected agreement, which measures consistency rather than accuracy against proof truth. These results motivate separate reporting of execution failures, selected-answer precision, and independently assessed proof validity. We provide per-configuration results and evaluation details in the supplement.

AI.tldr: 提出"证明步骤验证"流水线：将求解器答案改写为类型化步骤，由LLM评审判定认证或拒绝；在开源权重模型上跨GPQA、AIME-2025与MATH-500子集评测，量化认证带来的精确率提升与覆盖率损失，并揭示构造失败等失效模式，主张分别报告执行失败、选中答案精确率与独立评估的证明有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM求解器的答案校验多依赖答案键匹配或自一致性选择，缺乏对推理过程有效性的可解释验证；作者希望考察"步骤级证明验证"能否在提升精确率的同时，明确其覆盖率代价与失效来源。
AI.method: 构建三段式流水线：把求解器输出重写为带类型的证明步骤，再由LLM评审给出认证/拒绝；在开源权重模型上于GPQA、AIME-2025及MATH-500子集评测。设置输出token匹配的自一致性选择器作为对照，并进行诊断抽样与外部LLM对渲染后认证链的接受度审计，报告配对差值及95%区间。
AI.result: 认证使答案键匹配精确率在GPQA强配置上提升31个百分点、AIME提升46个百分点，但仅回答35%与21%的尝试；接近饱和的MATH-500上增益至多5点，覆盖率损失13–27点。token匹配的自一致性选择器在35%覆盖率下获82.9%精确率，验证器汇总为87.6%（配对差+4.8点，95%区间[−8.2, 18.5]）。诊断样本中88题有52题因证明构造无效而未到达评审。外部LLM对认证链接受度仅61.0–67.6%，低于87.6%的答案键匹配率；开源审计模型对之间机会校正一致度近零，仅反映一致性而非相对证明真值的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 步骤级证明验证主要起"高精度低覆盖"的筛选作用，其增益在难题上显著、在近饱和基准上不足以抵消覆盖率损失，且与自一致性选择器的差异在统计上不显著。由于缺乏人工或形式化内核真值，LLM审计不能作为证明有效性的证据。建议将执行失败率、选中答案精确率与独立评估的证明有效性分列报告。

title: Beyond Row-Level Prediction: Evaluating and Learning Composition for Reusable Table Representations
summary: Tables are compositional, with content spread across a schema, cell values, rows, and columns. Large-scale operations such as retrieval, overlap estimation, deduplication, and data curation need these local signals composed into one reusable embedding vector per table. Table representation methods, however, are mostly evaluated through row-level prediction or supervised downstream tasks, which do not measure table-level embedding quality directly. We introduce a benchmark that evaluates table-level embeddings through four desiderata: consistency under partial views, discriminability across label granularities, robustness to benign perturbations, and efficiency. Across twelve methods on synthetic and real corpora, lightweight schema- and text-based fingerprints are among the strongest. The sharpest contrast comes from two tabular foundation models, TabPFN and ConTextTab: although both are strong row-level predictors, their states, composed by mean, max, or three further parameter-free pooling rules, trail the strongest fingerprints. We therefore ask whether the gap lies in the encoder or in the compositional rule. Keeping ConTextTab frozen, we learn only the compositional rule over its cell states, using support-conditioned distribution matching (SCDM), a self-supervised loss we propose that matches the distribution of embedding similarities to the distribution of partition overlaps within and across tables. Across all fifteen head configurations, the learned rule raises the Spearman correlation between embedding similarity and partial-view overlap from 0.04 to 0.43-0.50 on synthetic data and improves triplet ranking, clustering, and retrieval, with smaller but systematic gains on real data. A downstream parent-table retrieval task confirms these findings. How local states are composed, and with what objective, substantially affects the quality of table-level embeddings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个面向表级嵌入质量的基准，用一致性、判别性、鲁棒性和效率四项指标评测12种表表示方法，发现轻量模式/文本指纹优于TabPFN、ConTextTab等表格基础模型的池化状态；进而提出自监督的支撑集条件分布匹配（SCDM）学习组合规则，在冻结编码器下将嵌入相似度与部分视图重叠的Spearman相关从0.04提升至0.43–0.50。
AI.motivation: 表格内容分布在模式、单元格、行、列上，检索、重叠估计、去重、数据整理等大规模操作需要把局部信号组合为每表一个可复用的嵌入向量；但现有表表示方法多以行级预测或监督下游任务评估，无法直接衡量表级嵌入质量，且"编码器与组合规则孰为瓶颈"尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建表级嵌入基准，以四项要求（部分视图下的一致性、跨标签粒度的判别性、对良性扰动的鲁棒性、效率）评测12种方法（合成与真实语料）；观察TabPFN与ConTextTab在均值、最大及另三种无参池化规则下的表现；保持ConTextTab冻结，仅学习其单元格状态上的组合规则，采用提出的自监督损失SCDM，使嵌入相似度分布匹配表内与跨表分区重叠的分布。
AI.result: 轻量模式与文本指纹整体最强；两种表格基础模型的行级预测虽强，其池化状态仍落后于最强指纹；在全部15种头部配置下，SCDM学习到的规则将嵌入相似度与部分视图重叠的Spearman相关从0.04提升到合成数据上的0.43–0.50，并改善三元组排序、聚类与检索，真实数据上增益较小但系统性存在；下游父表检索任务进一步验证。
AI.conclusion: 局部状态如何被组合、以及采用何种目标函数，会实质性影响表级嵌入质量；表级嵌入评测需与行级预测解耦，组合规则的学习是缩小差距的关键。

title: Genie Sim Benchmark: Real-to-Sim Fidelity and Evaluation
summary: We evaluate Genie Sim Benchmark through paired real-simulation tasks and complementary system-identification studies. Across 22 robot-task pairs spanning 16 task names, task-specific pi0.5 policies fine-tuned on real-robot data achieve a descriptive Score correlation of 0.9686, MAE 0.0405, RMSE 0.0520, with simulation-real differences from -0.110 to +0.080. G2 crsB experiments assess long-horizon closed-loop position and joint-side torque agreement, while five representative object cases examine identification and cross-engine contact transfer. A separate 32.6503 s teleoperation trajectory, excluded from mechanical identification and servo-gain search, evaluates external position targets through simulated motion-controller command shaping and a calibrated position servo. Across both arms, per-joint position RMSE spans 0.00614-0.03522 rad and current-derived torque RMSE spans 0.73545-4.00099 N m. Native PhysX adaptations recover three recorded interaction tasks, with case-dependent alignment gains. These results support task-specific simulation evaluation through joint assessment of task outcomes and physical-response consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估 Genie Sim Benchmark，通过“配对真实-仿真任务”与系统辨识研究，验证其可用于任务特定的仿真评测：在 22 个机器人-任务对（16 类任务名称）上，真实数据微调的 pi0.5 策略获得 Score 相关 0.9686、MAE 0.0405、RMSE 0.0520，仿真与真值差异范围为 -0.110~+0.080；运动学与力矩一致性、接触迁移及长时程闭环表现均得到定量验证。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人仿真基准多只考察任务成功率，缺乏任务结果与物理响应一致性相结合的系统性验证。本文旨在构建并评估一个可在任务层面同时检验“任务成效”与“物理真实度”的仿真基准（Genie Sim Benchmark），为策略评估的可信度提供依据。
AI.method: 采用三类互补实验：(1) 配对真实-仿真任务评测，覆盖 22 个机器人-任务对、16 类任务名称，用真实机器人数据微调的 task-specific pi0.5 策略对比 Score；(2) G2 crsB 实验评估长时程闭环位置与关节侧力矩一致性，并以五个代表性物体案例考察系统辨识与跨引擎接触迁移；(3) 使用一条 32.6503 s 遥操作轨迹（排除于机械辨识与伺服增益搜索之外），通过仿真运动控制器指令整形与标定位置伺服评估外部位置目标跟踪，并测试原生 PhysX 适配对三个记录交互任务的重现能力。
AI.result: Score 相关系数 0.9686（描述性）、MAE 0.0405、RMSE 0.0520，仿真-真实差异 -0.110~+0.080；双臂逐关节位置 RMSE 为 0.00614-0.03522 rad，由电流推算的力矩 RMSE 为 0.73545-4.00099 N·m；原生 PhysX 适配可复现三个记录交互任务，对齐增益随案例而异。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 Genie Sim Benchmark 能够支持任务特定的仿真评测，其有效性来源于任务结果与物理响应一致性两者的联合评估；同时仿真-真实差距虽小但非零且具案例依赖性，提示后续需在接触与执行器建模上持续校准。

title: Metropolis Random Walks Escape Deep Basins Faster in Higher Dimensions
summary: Simulated Annealing (SA) is a widely used stochastic optimization algorithm. It is of great interest to understand how its ability to escape local minima at a fixed temperature depends on geometry and dimension. In prior work, we derived closed-form expressions for the expected basin escape time of a constant-temperature SA process on a one-dimensional piecewise-linear landscape. In this paper, we extend the analysis to $D$-dimensional cubic basins defined by the infinity-norm energy $V(x)=\|x\|_\infty$. The walk proposes nearest-neighbor moves uniformly and escapes upon first reaching the outer shell, that is, any site with $\|x\|_\infty=N$. We construct a one-dimensional birth-death shell-quotient chain by collapsing each concentric shell in the Metropolis electrical network to a single node while retaining its total stationary mass. We derive a closed-form expression for the mean escape time $Q_D(N)$ of this shell-quotient chain as a function of the acceptance probability $p$, the basin depth $N$, and the dimension $D$. For fixed $D$ and fixed $0<p<1$, the quotient escape time scales as $Θ(α^N/N^{D-1})$ as $N\to\infty$, where $α=1/p$. Relative to $D=1$, this gives an asymptotic speedup of order $N^{D-1}$ within this family of cubic basins. We prove that the true Metropolis mean escape time $H_D(N)$, without shell averaging, has the same $Θ(α^N/N^{D-1})$ scaling, establishing a lower bound via Rayleigh monotonicity and a matching upper bound through an explicit low-energy flow construction using Thomson's principle. Numerical solutions that exploit the walk's symmetries quantify the discrepancy between the quotient and true-chain means for $D=1,2,3$.

AI.tldr: 本文把恒定温度模拟退火（SA）在无穷范数能量 $V(x)=\|x\|_\infty$ 定义的 $D$ 维立方势阱上的逃逸时间问题，通过壳层商链（shell-quotient chain）化简为一维生灭链，得到闭式的平均逃逸时间 $Q_D(N)$，并证明其与真实 Metropolis 链的平均逃逸时间 $H_D(N)$ 同为 $\Theta(\alpha^N/N^{D-1})$ 标度。
AI.motivation: 理解恒定温度下 SA 逃离局部极小值的能力如何依赖势阱的几何形状与维度，是 SA 理论分析的核心问题；先前工作仅给出了一维分段线性景观的闭式逃逸时间，缺乏高维结果。
AI.method: 将 $D$ 维立方壳层在 Metropolis 电网络中坍缩为单节点（保留各壳层总平稳质量），构造一维生灭壳层商链，推导其平均逃逸时间闭式表达；进一步用 Rayleigh 单调性给出真实链逃逸时间的下界，用 Thomson 原理通过显式低能量流构造给出匹配上界；并结合对称性做数值求解量化偏差。
AI.result: 对固定 $D$ 和固定接受概率 $0<p<1$，商链逃逸时间满足 $Q_D(N)=\Theta(\alpha^N/N^{D-1})$（$N\to\infty$，$\alpha=1/p$），相对 $D=1$ 有 $N^{D-1}$ 量级的渐近加速；真实链 $H_D(N)$ 具有相同标度；数值结果给出 $D=1,2,3$ 时商链与真实链均值的差异。
AI.conclusion: 壳层商近似在标度层面是紧的：由坍缩得到的一维链与原始高维 Metropolis 链逃逸时间具有相同的指数基底与 $N^{-(D-1)}$ 多项式修正，说明在立方无穷范数势阱族中，维度提升带来 $N^{D-1}$ 的逃逸加速。

title: Paired Geometric Supervision for Generalizable Deepfake Detection
comment: Accepted at BMVC 2026 (poster). 37 pages including supplementary material; 8 figures, 22 tables
summary: We present OrthoPairGTL, a geometric training framework for cross-domain deepfake detection, built on a partially frozen DINOv3 backbone ($\sim$300M parameters), and make three contributions: (1) We re-evaluate six recent transfer-learning detectors (Forensics Adapter, Effort, three GenD variants and FakeSTormer) using the authors' released checkpoints under a single preprocessing pipeline across 17 cross-domain datasets (2018-2025), so that the reported gaps reflect method rather than per-method pipeline tuning. (2) We model the transformation between paired real and fake samples, training Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) adapters with an orthogonal pair decomposition, hyperspherical regularisation, and (in the GSD-LoRA variant) a set-level coherence objective. (3) Under LoRA, this regularisation gives a more stable optimisation profile: GSD-LoRA's post-peak validation degradation is $4.2\times$ shallower than plain LoRA at the same parameter footprint, and the time-averaged validation AUC across training is 1.82 pp higher. On the 17 datasets, GSD-LoRA matches or exceeds every re-evaluated baseline (92.82% vs. 91.58% for the strongest; paired Wilcoxon signed-rank $p=0.015$, 13/17 per-dataset wins), with the largest gains on modern reenactment-heavy benchmarks (DSv1.1, DSv2). Under strict parameter budgets, LayerNorm-only tuning ($\approx$0.03% of the backbone) is the most stable configuration and matches the strongest baseline with a mean of 91.97%.

AI.tldr: 提出几何训练框架OrthoPairGTL，基于部分冻结的DINOv3主干，通过正交配对分解、超球正则化与集合级一致性目标微调PEFT适配器，在17个跨域数据集上以92.82%平均准确率超越所有复现基线，并显著提升训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有跨域深度伪造检测器之间的比较受各自预处理与调参流程干扰，报告差距未必反映方法本身优劣；同时PEFT微调在跨域迁移中优化不稳定、峰值后验证性能退化明显。
AI.method: 1）在统一预处理流水线下，用作者发布的权重在17个跨域数据集（2018–2025）上重评六个迁移学习检测器（Forensics Adapter、Effort、三个GenD变体、FakeSTormer）；2）以约300M参数的DINOv3为部分冻结主干，对成对真伪样本的变换建模，训练PEFT适配器，引入正交配对分解、超球正则化，GSD-LoRA变体额外加入集合级一致性目标。
AI.result: GSD-LoRA平均92.82%，最强基线91.58%，配对Wilcoxon符号秩检验p=0.015，17个数据集中13个单数据集获胜，在现代重演类基准（DSv1.1、DSv2）增益最大；相同参数量下峰后验证退化比普通LoRA浅4.2倍，训练期时间平均验证AUC高1.82个百分点；严格参数预算下仅调LayerNorm（约0.03%主干参数）最稳定，均值91.97%，与最强基线持平。
AI.conclusion: 统一评测揭示方法层面的真实差距；所提配对几何正则显著改善PEFT微调的稳定性与跨域泛化，且极低参数预算下的LayerNorm调优可作为稳健的轻量方案。

title: GenPFN: An In-Context Tabular Foundation Model Approach for Augmenting Small Datasets in Engineering
summary:
Costly simulations and experiments limit the data available for engineering design. This paper proposes GenPFN, a training-free candidate generator guided by a pretrained tabular Prior-Data Fitted Network (TabPFN) classifier with fixed weights. The context contains evaluated designs labeled desired (Class 1) or undesired (Class 0). GenPFN interpolates between desired designs and refines candidates using gated classifier gradients and Gaussian noise. Each candidate is evaluated using the problem's constraints and objective functions. Evaluated desired designs and their objective values augment the context for regression training.
  Evaluation spans fourteen selected problems, including a two-parameter benchmark and a 44-parameter hull problem. In paired comparisons, GenPFN with TabPFN v1 achieves higher class satisfaction and lower realism distance than the tested adversarial, variational-autoencoder and diffusion generators. The variational-autoencoder generator provides greater coverage and diversity. Relative to the synthetic minority over-sampling technique (SMOTE), GenPFN provides lower coverage distance and greater diversity. Among observed paired regression fits, augmentation reduces estimated AutoGluon validation mean squared error by 62.1% relative to context-only training. A hull-stern case study yields 99.3% propeller-compatible candidates versus 1.4% among randomly sampled context designs. Generation followed by evaluation produces sample sets that augment limited datasets and support training more accurate predictive models.

AI.tldr: GenPFN 是一种免训练、由固定权重 TabPFN 分类器引导的候选设计生成器，在14个工程问题上相比对抗、VAE 与扩散生成器取得更高类别满足率与更低的真实性距离，并可用于数据增强以提升回归模型精度。
AI.motivation: 工程设计中仿真与实验成本高昂，可用数据有限，需要一种能在少量已评估设计上生成高质量候选、并增强数据集以训练更准确预测模型的方法。
AI.method: GenPFN 以预训练的表格 Prior-Data Fitted Network（TabPFN）分类器为核心，权重固定、无需额外训练。上下文由已评估设计组成，标注为期望（Class 1）或非期望（Class 0）。生成时在期望设计之间插值，并通过门控分类器梯度与高斯噪声细化候选；每个候选由问题的约束与目标函数评估。被评估为期望的设计及其目标值随后加入上下文，用于回归训练（数据增强）。评估覆盖14个选定问题，包括一个双参数基准与一个44参数船体问题。
AI.result: 配对比较中，GenPFN（TabPFN v1）在类别满足率上更高、真实性距离更低，优于所测试的对抗、VAE 与扩散生成器；VAE 生成器在覆盖度与多样性上更优。相较 SMOTE，GenPFN 覆盖距离更低、多样性更高。在观察到的配对回归拟合中，增强使 AutoGluon 验证均方误差相对仅用上下文训练降低 62.1%。船尾案例研究显示，99.3% 的候选与螺旋桨兼容，而随机采样的上下文设计中仅为 1.4%。
AI.conclusion: "生成—评估"流程可产出高质量样本集，用于扩充有限数据集并支撑更准确的预测模型训练；GenPFN 在可行性与真实性上优于对比生成方法，但在覆盖度与多样性上弱于 VAE，体现了质量与多样性之间的权衡。

title: Code as Explanations: Executable and Verifiable LLM Explanations
comment: 30 pages, 11 figures, 3 tables, The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly make consequential decisions and solve problems alongside humans, we must understand how models arrive at their conclusions. Understanding how an LLM behaves requires observing it across multiple inputs, yet free-text explanations such as chain-of-thought (CoT) are generated per instance and cannot be easily verified on new inputs. We propose {code explanations to address the mismatch in how LLM explanations are generated versus how they are evaluated: a program explains LLM behavior across a dataset of inputs, and its execution enables automatic verification. We define Consistency metric that measures the fraction of inputs on which the program reproduces the LLM's outputs, and use it to evaluate and select candidate programs. Across three open-source code-capable LLMs and eight tasks, we find that LLMs can produce highly consistent code explanations in several settings. Code explanations are also 6$\times$ to 100$\times$ shorter than CoT, and better align with model behavior in 9 out of 24 settings. However, consistency is significantly lower on tasks with more complex linguistic components, where generated programs reproduce model outputs no more frequently than an uninformative explanation baseline, and these programs often rely on longer hard-coded patterns. In experiments with Claude Opus 5.5, providing the model with consistency feedback and code execution improves explanation consistency across tasks, but consistency remains significantly lower on more complex tasks. Our findings establish executable code as a novel, verifiable, and compact approach to explaining LLM behavior and highlight verification feedback as a promising direction for improving explanation consistency. The code for this paper is at https://github.com/rajesh-lab/code-as-explanations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"代码解释"（code explanations）：用一段程序跨数据集解释LLM行为，并通过程序执行实现自动验证；定义一致性（Consistency）指标衡量程序复现模型输出的输入比例，发现多个具备代码能力的开源LLM在多任务上可生成高一致性的代码解释，且比CoT更短，但在语言成分复杂的任务上一致性显著下降。
AI.motivation: LLM日益参与具有后果的决策与问题求解，需理解其得出答案的过程。理解模型行为须在多个输入上观察，而CoT等自由文本解释按单实例生成、难以在新输入上验证，导致"解释的生成方式"与"解释的评估方式"不匹配。
AI.method: 提出以代码作为解释：一段程序覆盖整个输入数据集地刻画LLM行为，执行程序即可自动验证。定义Consistency指标——程序复现LLM输出一致的输入所占比例，并据此评估与筛选候选程序。实验覆盖3个开源代码能力LLM、8个任务；另在Claude Opus 5.5上加入一致性反馈与代码执行进行改进实验。
AI.result: LLM在若干设置下能产出高度一致的代码解释；代码解释长度仅为CoT的1/6至1/100；在24个设置中有9个比CoT更贴合模型行为。但在语言成分更复杂的任务上一致性显著偏低，生成程序复现模型输出的频率不高于无信息基线，且常依赖较长的硬编码模式。提供一致性反馈与代码执行可跨任务提升解释一致性，但复杂任务上的一致性依然显著较低。
AI.conclusion: 可执行代码是一种新颖、可验证且紧凑的LLM行为解释方式；验证反馈是提升解释一致性的有前景方向。

title: Does Your World Model Know Actions Have Consequences?
comment: Presented at "Do Robots Need World Models?" Workshop at Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026
summary: Embodied world models (WMs) are implicit learning systems that predict the next future latent state directly from observations and actions. Unique from other end-to-end learning systems, the dynamics predictor of WMs can simulate the environment's response to alternative actions without physical deployment nor pre-specifying states of the dynamical system. Current metrics focus on the quality of model outputs, e.g., clarity of reconstructions or task success, but fail to assess the fidelity of modeling consequences of counterfactual actions. Inspecting the forced response to action perturbations through sensitivity analysis is one way to audit how well WMs can predict the consequences of counterfactual actions. Deploying WMs on hardware will require new evaluation frameworks to analyze the tradeoffs between state error and accurate sensitivity prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文指出具身世界模型（WM）的核心能力在于预测反事实动作的后果，而现有指标只评估输出质量（重建清晰度、任务成功率），无法衡量这一能力；作者提出以灵敏度分析审计WM对动作扰动的强制响应，并呼吁建立兼顾状态误差与灵敏度预测精度权衡的新评测框架。
AI.motivation: 具身世界模型的动力学预测器可在不物理部署、不预先指定系统状态的前提下模拟环境对替代动作的响应，这是其相较其他端到端学习系统的独特优势。但现有评测指标偏重输出质量，如重建清晰度与任务成功率，无法评估模型对反事实动作后果建模的保真度，因而无法回答"WM是否真正学到了动作—后果映射"这一关键问题。
AI.method: 作者提出以灵敏度分析为审计手段：对WM施加动作扰动，检视其强制响应（forced response），从而量化模型对反事实动作后果的预测能力。并主张在此基础上面向硬件部署需求，构建新的评测框架，显式刻画状态误差与灵敏度预测精度之间的权衡关系。
AI.result: 摘要为立场/观点型文稿，未报告具体实验数据；其"结果"在于论证了现有指标体系的盲区，并确立了以动作扰动响应为核心的审计思路及需要权衡的两类评价维度。
AI.conclusion: 评估具身世界模型不能止步于输出质量，须引入针对反事实动作后果的灵敏度评测；未来WM落地硬件时，需要新的评测框架来联合分析状态误差与灵敏度预测精度的权衡。

title: Backstepping-Forwarding Design for Hyperbolic PIDE-ODE Systems with Distributed Interconnection and an Arbitrarily Large Input Delay
comment: Originally submitted to IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control in May 2026. The revised manuscript is currently under review
summary: This paper studies first-order hyperbolic partial integro-differential equation (PIDE) and ordinary differential equation (ODE) cascades with distributed interconnection and an arbitrarily large known constant input delay. Within the backstepping--forwarding framework, a forwarding-type transformation is designed to reduce the distributed interconnection to an equivalent boundary-coupled Dirichlet cascade without requiring the PIDE to be open-loop stable. A subsequent backstepping design stabilizes the PIDE and the ODE while compensating for the input delay. Incompatible boundary conditions in the delay-compensation kernel equations may produce discontinuities along characteristic lines. We determine their jump locations and amplitudes and prove that the interface terms cancel when deriving the target equations, so the kernel discontinuities do not change the target system. Closed-loop exponential stability is established without additional plant restrictions to ensure kernel continuity. A numerical example illustrates the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 针对含分布互联与任意大已知输入时滞的一阶双曲PIDE–ODE级联系统，提出backstepping–forwarding设计：先用forwarding变换将分布互联化为等价边界耦合Dirichlet级联（无需开环稳定），再用backstepping补偿时滞并镇定，并证明核函数不连续处界面项在目标方程推导中相互抵消，从而获得指数稳定性。
AI.motivation: 一阶双曲PIDE与ODE通过分布（而非点或边界）方式互联，且存在任意大但已知的输入时滞；现有方法常要求PIDE开环稳定，或需额外限制以保证核函数连续，从而制约了设计的适用范围。
AI.method: 在backstepping–forwarding框架下，先设计forwarding型变换，把分布互联约化为等价的边界耦合Dirichlet级联；随后进行backstepping设计，镇定PIDE与ODE并补偿输入时滞。针对时滞补偿核方程中边界条件不相容导致沿特征线出现的核不连续性，确定跳跃位置与幅值，并证明在推导目标方程时界面项相互抵消。
AI.result: 给出核函数跳跃点位置与跳跃幅值的解析刻画；证明界面项在目标方程推导中抵消，故核不连续性不改变目标系统；在无需额外被控对象限制（即不要求核连续）的条件下建立闭环指数稳定性；数值算例验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将forwarding与backstepping结合可统一处理分布互联PIDE–ODE级联的大输入时滞镇定问题，并放宽对开环稳定性与核连续性的要求；核不连续性是可由界面项抵消吸收的形式现象，不影响稳定性结论。

title: Honest Fusion Evaluation for Cross-Domain Deepfake Detection: Leakage Audits and Tail Robustness
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. 19 pages including supplementary material; 6 figures, 10 tables. Code: https://github.com/lukegcollins/WACV27-HFEFCDD
summary: Cross-domain video deepfake detection increasingly uses frozen foundation-model experts, combined by calibrated score averaging, a per-video router picking one expert, or a learned head over concatenated features. Expressive routing and feature fusion are often reported to beat plain averaging. Across a 22-dataset frozen-expert testbed, we find those gains are largely evaluation artifacts. A corner theorem locates the gap routing aims to close: because AUC depends only on score ordering, the best any score-space router can do is an oracle reading the test label to pick each video's expert, a ceiling no realisable, label-blind router reaches. The theorem does not order real routers against a calibrated global average; the case against routing is empirical, and no router we test beats that average. Feature fusion reads raw features, falls outside the theorem, and is audited empirically. Reported gains trace to leakage: holding out one dataset leaks siblings sharing identities and reals (over-crediting routing), while holding out one manipulation keeps that dataset's reals in training (over-crediting feature fusion). A $2\times 2$ over fold and evaluation granularity pins the $+2.6$pp feature-fusion "win" to the fold alone: 12/12 significant under leaky folds vs. 0/12 under honest family-held-out folds, where both gains vanish. Fusion still pays off in the tail of hard videos and families: as experts are added, videos every expert misclassifies drop from 15.2% to 2.3%, and global calibrated fusion (InvB) beats the best single expert on worst-family AUC, selective risk (AURC), and low-false-positive recall, stably across protocols. Practitioners should calibrate and combine globally, hold out whole dataset families, and measure tail performance. For score-space routing under ranking metrics, honest evaluation and expert diversity matter more than combiner complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文在22个数据集的冻结专家测试台上审查跨域视频深度伪造检测的组合策略，发现路由与特征融合被报道的优势主要是评估泄漏造成的假象；诚实评估下二者增益消失，但特征融合在困难样本尾部仍稳定有效。
AI.motivation: 现有工作普遍报告“学习式路由”或“特征拼接融合”优于简单的分数校准平均，但作者怀疑这些增益源于评估协议泄漏而非真实方法优势，需要系统性审计并明确路由的理论上限与经验界限。
AI.method: 构建含22个数据集的冻结专家测试台，对比校准全局平均、逐视频路由、拼接特征学习头三类组合器；提出“角点定理”刻画分数空间路由在AUC下的最优上界（读测试标签的oracle）；设计2×2折（按数据集折/按家族折）与评估粒度对照实验，区分泄漏来源；并对特征融合在困难视频/家族的尾部表现（InvB、最差家族AUC、AURC、低误报召回）做跨协议审计。
AI.result: 特征融合“+2.6pp”增益完全由折方式解释：泄漏折下12/12显著，诚实家族留出折下0/12显著，两类增益均消失；没有测试的路由器能超越校准全局平均。尾部方面，随着专家增加，全体专家均误判的视频比例由15.2%降至2.3%；全局校准融合（InvB）在最差家族AUC、选择性风险AURC与低误报召回上稳定优于最佳单专家。
AI.conclusion: 在排序指标下，分数空间路由的收益受oracle天花板与专家多样性限制，诚实评估与专家多样性比组合器复杂度更重要；实践中应全局校准并组合专家、以完整数据集家族作为留出单元，并额外度量尾部性能。

title: AutoAssumption: Searching over Assumptions Discovers ML-Systems Algorithms
comment: 52 pages (9 main + references and appendix), 14 figures, 13 tables
summary: Many advances in ML systems came from breaking an assumption that earlier methods took for granted: speculative decoding dropped the assumption that a model needs one forward pass per token. Yet algorithms rarely state their assumptions, so experts and discovery harnesses search over programs, where one edit changes several design choices and gains are difficult to attribute. Searching over the assumptions themselves remains largely unexplored. Writing algorithms as proofs makes their assumptions explicit and turns algorithm design into a search over a small, structured space that an LLM can explore and a proof checker can audit. We formalize 89 algorithms from KV-cache eviction, weight pruning and speculative decoding as proof graphs with explicit assumptions, checked in Lean. Our harness, AutoAssumption, relaxes one assumption of a published method, re-derives and re-proves it, and generates its code. In KV-cache eviction and weight pruning, this search improved on every published algorithm we ran and produced state-of-the-art algorithms. The eviction algorithm has the highest RULER-4K score of the published methods we ran, and the pruning algorithm the lowest perplexity of thirteen on four LLaMA models. At equal budget, the harness scores within a point of OpenEvolve, an open-source implementation of AlphaEvolve, with a lower standard deviation across repeats. Future work will formalize more fields and combine them through the principal assumptions they share.

AI.tldr: 将算法改写为Lean中带显式假设的证明图，把算法设计转化为"松弛单个假设—重新推导并证明—生成代码"的结构化搜索，AutoAssumption在KV-cache驱逐与权重剪枝上超越所有对照的已发表算法并达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: ML系统进展常源于打破旧方法默认的假设（如推测解码放弃"每token一次前向"），但算法极少显式声明假设；现有专家与自动化搜索（harness）在程序空间上搜索，单次编辑会同时改变多个设计选择，收益难以归因。直接在"假设空间"上搜索仍基本空白。
AI.method: 把算法写成证明：将KV-cache驱逐、权重剪枝、推测解码共89个算法形式化为带显式假设的证明图，并在Lean中检验；构建harness AutoAssumption，对已发表方法松弛其中一条假设，重新推导、重新证明并生成对应代码，从而在小型结构化空间中由LLM探索、由证明检查器审计。
AI.result: 在KV-cache驱逐与权重剪枝上，该搜索对每个实际运行的已发表算法均有改进并产出SOTA：驱逐算法在所运行已发表方法中取得最高RULER-4K分数；剪枝算法在四个LLaMA模型上取得13个方法中最低困惑度。同等预算下，该harness得分与AlphaEvolve开源实现OpenEvolve相差不到1分，且重复运行标准差更低。
AI.conclusion: 以证明形式显式化假设，可将算法设计变成可探索、可审计的结构化搜索，并在多个领域稳定超越人工设计与程序级进化搜索。后续将形式化更多领域，并通过它们共享的主假设进行跨领域组合。

title: UniPipe: Unified Inference Serving and Fine-Tuning for Deadline-Constrained DNN Surrogate Workflows
summary: DNN surrogates are increasingly used to accelerate scientific workflows that must process high-rate sensor streams in near real time, exemplified by Ptychographic imaging at next-generation X-ray light sources. Such surrogates deliver 100-1000x higher throughput than iterative solvers, enabling faster steering of experiments. To preserve surrogate accuracy during an experiment, as the input distribution evolves, state-of-the-art deployments freeze the pretrained surrogate or run a separate CUDA context that fine-tunes concurrently with serving. However, multi-context concurrency causes significant contention on the GPU, inflating both the mean and the variance of inference latency, triggering deadline misses in workflows where sensor data has to be processed within a hard per-unit deadline. To address this challenge, we propose UniPipe, a single-context system that unifies inference serving and fine-tuning of a DNN surrogate on a single edge GPU. UniPipe is driven by three key insights: both serving and fine-tuning require a forward pass and can be fused into one; the per-sample latency of modern GPUs is non-linear in batch size; and the workload is repetitive across intervals, enabling offline scheduling. Specifically, UniPipe fuses training and inference data in a single forward pass with a selective backward pass on the training subset, and uses a polynomial-time scheduler that exploits the latency curve to compute the batch composition. We evaluate UniPipe on a real-world Ptychographic reconstruction workflow with sensor rates up to 5000 patterns/sec.; UniPipe lowers reconstruction MSE by up to 30% and inference MSE by up to 50% over a pretrained baseline, and reduces the deadline-miss rate by 13%-22% over a multi-context baseline. UniPipe's unified deployment reduces the latency spread from 106% to 57% of the mean, and increases total throughput compared to multi-context baseline.

AI.tldr: UniPipe 是一个单上下文的边缘GPU系统，将DNN代理模型（surrogate）的推理服务与在线微调统一在一次前向传播中完成，并通过多项式时间调度器优化批次组成，从而在满足硬实时截止约束的同时保持重建精度。
AI.motivation: 科学工作流（如新一代光源的叠层成像Ptychography）需在实时条件下处理高速传感器数据流，DNN代理比迭代求解器快100-1000倍。但实验中输入分布会漂移，现有部署要么冻结预训练模型、要么用独立CUDA上下文并发微调与推理；多上下文并发造成严重GPU争用，抬高推理延迟的均值与方差，导致硬性逐单元截止时间被错过。
AI.method: 提出UniPipe单上下文统一系统，基于三点洞察：推理与微调都需要前向传播，可融合为一次；现代GPU的每样本延迟与批次大小呈非线性关系；负载在区间间具有重复性，可离线调度。具体做法为：将训练与推理数据融合进单次前向传播，仅对训练子集执行选择性反向传播；并使用多项式时间调度器，利用延迟曲线计算批次组成。
AI.result: 在真实叠层成像重建工作流上评估，传感器速率高达5000 patterns/sec：相较预训练基线，重建MSE最多降低30%，推理MSE最多降低50%；相较多上下文基线，截止时间错过率降低13%-22%；延迟离散度从均值的106%降至57%，且总吞吐量高于多上下文基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过将推理与微调统一为单上下文、单次前向传播并配合延迟感知的离线调度，UniPipe可在边缘GPU上同时获得更高精度、更低且更稳定的延迟以及更高吞吐，适用于硬实时科学数据流场景。

title: MiniPose: Miniature-Based Real Data Collection for 6D Pose Estimation of Large Industrial Pipe Segments
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: 6-DOF pose estimation of large and heavy industrial objects, such as large piping systems in shipyards and structural components in petrochemical plants, remains relatively underexplored in robotic perception. Repeatedly repositioning large objects is physically and spatially demanding, making it difficult to acquire real training data with sufficient pose diversity. Synthetic data offer a scalable alternative, but faithfully reproducing real RGB-D observations, particularly the structured measurement errors of real depth sensors, remains difficult. We propose MiniPose, a practical pipeline for miniature-based real RGB-D data collection that addresses both the data-acquisition burden and the sim-to-real gap. We fabricate a scaled-down replica and capture RGB-D data of it in diverse poses using a real RGB-D camera. RGB images are used directly, while depth maps are converted to a geometrically consistent representation of the full-scale object via a simple inverse scaling transformation. This allows training to incorporate real appearance and sensor measurement characteristics that are difficult to reproduce using synthetic data alone. To examine whether the benefit depends on a particular network, we evaluate two RGB-D pose estimators with different formulations, PVN3D and RDPN6D. Mixing at most 1,000 miniature images per pipe type, less than 10\% of the training data, with 10,000 synthetic images improves the mean ADD-S AUC across pipe types over synthetic-only training for both estimators. A comparison with training on full-scale real data further suggests that miniature data can serve as a proxy where full-scale collection is difficult, reducing the data-collection burden for large industrial objects.

AI.tldr: 提出MiniPose流程：用真实RGB-D相机采集缩放模型(miniature)的RGB-D数据，深度图经逆缩放变换转为全尺寸物体的几何一致表示，与合成数据混合训练6-DOF位姿估计器，缓解大件工业物体真实数据采集难与sim-to-real差距问题。
AI.motivation: 大型重型工业物体（船厂大管道系统、石化装置结构件）的6-DOF位姿估计研究不足；反复重摆大型物体在物理与空间上都困难，难以获得位姿多样性充足的实采训练数据；合成数据虽可扩展，但难以忠实复现真实RGB-D观测，特别是真实深度传感器的结构性测量误差。
AI.method: 制作按比例缩小的物体复制件，用真实RGB-D相机在多姿态下采集RGB-D数据；RGB图像直接使用，深度图通过简单的逆缩放变换转换为全尺寸物体的几何一致表示；以此保留真实外观与传感器测量特性。为检验收益是否依赖特定网络，选用两种不同建模范式的RGB-D位姿估计器PVN3D与RDPN6D进行评测；每类管道最多混入1,000张模型图像（不足训练数据10%），与10,000张合成图像联合训练，并与纯合成训练及全尺寸真实数据训练对比。
AI.result: 对两类管道，在两款估计器上，混合少量模型数据均使平均ADD-S AUC相比纯合成训练提升；与全尺寸真实数据训练的比较进一步表明，模型数据可作为全尺寸采集困难场景下的替代代理。
AI.conclusion: MiniPose是一种实用且模型无关的数据采集流程，同时缓解数据采集负担与sim-to-real差距，可降低大型工业物体位姿估计的数据采集成本。

title: Sim-to-Real Powertrain Vibration Control via Model-Based Assisted Domain-Randomized Reinforcement Learning
summary: Controllers designed from nominal models often degrade on mechanical systems with nonlinearities and parametric variations, such as automotive powertrains with backlash. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) with domain randomization can acquire robustness to such model discrepancies, but wide randomization destabilizes training and yields conservative policies, and experimental transfer of such policies has rarely been demonstrated in vibration control. This paper presents model-based controller assisted domain randomization (MBCADR), a framework that integrates model-based control into domain-randomized DRL. An $H_{2}$ controller designed from the nominal model supplies a baseline action, while a residual policy trained with twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient under randomized dynamics compensates for nonlinearities and uncertainties. This model-based assistance relieves the agent of synthesizing the entire control input, thereby stabilizing training under extensive randomization. For each realization of the uncertain parameters, the augmented plant--controller state is shown to be a Markov state of the closed loop, so that domain-randomized training is rigorously formulated as policy optimization over a parameterized family of Markov decision processes. A Lyapunov-based stability analysis further derives a forward-invariant set and an explicit ultimate bound, in which the learned action enters only through its saturation level. Monte Carlo simulations with multiple training seeds show that MBCADR reduces performance variability compared with either component alone. Experiments on a powertrain test bench with backlash, using the simulation-trained policy on an embedded processor without further tuning, confirm successful sim-to-real transfer.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于模型控制器辅助的域随机化框架（MBCADR），将H2基线控制器与TD3残差策略结合，稳定了宽域随机化下的训练，并从理论上证明了状态马尔可夫性、给出了带显式极限界的Lyapunov稳定性分析，最终在含齿隙的动力总成台架上实现了零微调sim-to-real迁移。
AI.motivation: 名义模型设计的控制器在含非线性与参数摄动的机械系统（如含齿隙的汽车动力总成）上性能退化；DRL配合域随机化虽可提升鲁棒性，但宽域随机化会导致训练不稳定且策略过于保守，且此类策略在振动控制中的实验迁移鲜有验证。
AI.method: 框架以名义模型的H2控制器提供基线动作，TD3训练的残差策略在随机化动力学下补偿非线性与不确定性；理论上证明对每个不确定参数实现，增广被控对象—控制器状态构成闭环的马尔可夫状态，从而将域随机化训练形式化为参数化MDP族上的策略优化；并用Lyapunov分析导出前向不变集与显式最终界，学习动作仅通过其饱和水平进入界中。
AI.result: 多训练种子的蒙特卡洛仿真表明，MBCADR相比单独使用H2控制器或单独使用DRL均降低了性能波动；在含齿隙的动力总成试验台上，将以仿真训练的策略直接部署于嵌入式处理器、无需再调参，验证了sim-to-real迁移成功。
AI.conclusion: 将模型控制作为基线嵌入域随机化DRL，可兼顾训练稳定性与鲁棒性，并提供可证稳定性边界，适用于非线性机械系统的振动控制及实际迁移。

title: In-orbit demonstration of object-based change detection applied to the maritime domain
summary: This article presents the successful in-orbit validation of an object-based change detection pipeline for low latency maritime monitoring onboard the CogniSAT-6 mission. We propose and validate a lightweight, three-phase operational sequence: optimized ground-based dual-acquisition scheduling, real-time onboard AI-based vessel segmentation, and multi-temporal matching. Upon acquiring consecutive images over a targeted Area of Interest (AoI), the onboard system correlates vessel detections using a hybrid matching approach that integrates the Hungarian algorithm for optimal assignment with RANSAC-driven spatial and size filters for outlier rejection. A series of in-orbit validations demonstrated robust performance across 11 diverse maritime scenarios, achieving valid recall and precision values (considering only vessel size and location) exceeding 0.8. The validation demonstrated the ability of the system to track both cooperative targets and uncooperative "dark" vessels strictly through geometric consistency. This capacity to autonomously generate and act upon real-time intelligence establishes a foundation for next-generation Insight-as-a-Service (IaaS) and tipping-and-cueing architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文在CogniSAT-6任务上完成了面向低时延海事监测的在轨目标级变化检测流程验证：提出"地面双次成像调度—星上AI舰船分割—多时相匹配"三阶段轻量化流程，在11个海上场景中召回率与精确率均超过0.8，可仅凭几何一致性跟踪合作与非合作"暗"船舶。
AI.motivation: 海事监测要求低时延、近实时情报，传统"下传—地面处理—回传"链路延迟高；需验证星上AI目标级变化检测在真实在轨环境中的可行性，并支撑IaaS与tipping-and-cueing架构。
AI.method: 三阶段流程：(1) 优化的地面双次采集调度（针对AoI连续成像）；(2) 实时星上AI舰船分割；(3) 多时相匹配——混合匹配策略，匈牙利算法实现最优分配，RANSAC驱动的空间与尺寸滤波器剔除离群点。
AI.result: 在轨验证覆盖11个多样化海上场景，性能稳健；仅考虑船体尺寸与位置时，有效召回率与精确率均>0.8；系统可仅通过几何一致性同时跟踪合作目标与非合作"暗"船舶。
AI.conclusion: 星上自主生成并响应实时情报的能力得到在轨证实，为下一代Insight-as-a-Service与tipping-and-cueing体系奠定基础。

title: Open Challenges and Opportunities in Human-Agent Systems
comment: Part of The AAMAS Community Agentic AI Report
summary: Agentic AI systems increasingly undertake extended tasks and act on people's behalf, making human-agent interaction central to their effectiveness. Successful interaction requires understanding human perspectives, coordinating complementary capabilities, and maintaining productive relationships within socio-technical environments. This paper examines how foundations developed by the Autonomous Agents and Multi-Agent Systems (AAMAS) community inform these demands. We consider interactions ranging from individual human-agent partnerships to teams and larger groups, where participants differ in their roles, decision authority, capabilities, and objectives. We organize computational approaches around the connected challenges of understanding others and deciding how to interact with them. Theory of Mind, belief-desire-intention architectures, goal and plan recognition, inverse planning, and recursive reasoning provide mechanisms for representing and inferring partially observable mental states. Observer-aware planning, model reconciliation, and decision-theoretic communication connect these inferences to action, explanation, and information exchange. Together with shared autonomy, argumentation, and cooperative inverse reinforcement learning, these approaches offer foundations for agentic systems that account for evolving human knowledge, intentions, and expectations. We argue that progress requires treating human interaction as an ongoing decision problem shaped by uncertainty, interdependence, and potentially conflicting objectives.

AI.tldr: 该文综述AAMAS社区关于人-智能体交互的基础理论,主张把人类交互视为持续的不确定性决策问题。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI日益承担长期任务并代表人类行动,人-智能体交互成为系统有效性的核心;需要理解人类视角、协调互补能力并在社会技术环境中维持有效关系。
AI.method: 文献综述/立场论文:围绕"理解他人"与"决定如何交互"两类相互关联的挑战组织计算路径,包括ToM、BDI架构、目标与规划识别、逆向规划、递归推理,以及观察者感知规划、模型调和、决策论通信,并结合共享自主、论辩与合作式逆强化学习。
AI.result: 系统梳理了表征与推断部分可观测心理状态的机制,并将其与行动、解释、信息交换相衔接,形成面向演化中的人类知识、意图与期望的智能体系统基础框架。
AI.conclusion: 研究进展要求将人类交互视为由不确定性、相互依赖与潜在冲突目标塑造的持续决策问题。

title: From Nodes to Pixels: Topological and Structural Two-View Graph Imaging
summary: Graph learning still lacks a broadly reusable input interface comparable to patches in vision or tokens in language. Unlike images or text, graphs are irregular, vary in size and density, and are invariant under many equivalent node labelings, making it difficult to standardize inputs across tasks and architectures. We introduce G2Image, a fixed-budget graph imaging framework that converts each graph into two complementary image-like views. TopoGrid provides a stable topological view by encoding an intrinsic bifiltration as a compact multipersistence surface grid, while GraphGrid provides a higher-bandwidth structural view by aggregating edge densities between groups defined by intrinsic node scores. Both views are permutation-invariant and come with resolution-controlled stability guarantees. Because the resulting representations are fixed-size tensors, they can be processed by lightweight 2D encoders and aligned through a supervised cross-view contrastive objective. Across graph classification and molecular prediction benchmarks, G2Image achieves strong average performance among the compared methods, improves over single-view and standard fusion variants, and extends to attribute-rich molecular graphs without changing the overall architecture. These results suggest that fixed-budget graph images offer a practical and reusable interface for graph representation learning.

AI.tldr: 提出G2Image框架，将图转换为两路互补的固定尺寸"图像"视图（TopoGrid多持续同调曲面网格 + GraphGrid边密度聚合网格），并用轻量2D编码器与跨视图对比学习处理，为图学习提供类似vision中patch、语言中token的通用输入接口。
AI.motivation: 图学习缺乏像视觉中patch、语言中token那样可广泛复用的输入接口。图是非规则的、尺寸与密度差异大，且对节点标签置换不变，难以跨任务与跨架构标准化输入。
AI.method: G2Image将每个图转为两个互补的类图像视图：TopoGrid通过编码内在双滤流（intrinsic bifiltration）为紧凑的多持续同调曲面网格，提供稳定的拓扑视图；GraphGrid通过聚合由内在节点分数所定义分组间的边密度，提供更高带宽的结构视图。两视图均具置换不变性，并具分辨率控制下的稳定性保证；输出为固定尺寸张量，可由轻量2D编码器处理，并通过监督式跨视图对比目标进行对齐。
AI.result: 在图分类与分子预测基准上，G2Image在对比方法中取得较强的平均性能，优于单视图与标准融合变体，且无需改变整体架构即可扩展到含属性的分子图。
AI.conclusion: 固定预算的图"图像"可为图表示学习提供实用且可复用的输入接口。

title: CrowdMAPS: Crowdsourcing Multiple Actions per State for Real-World Imitation Learning
summary: Real-world robot imitation learning is often limited by the cost of collecting physical demonstrations, which typically yield only one action label per visited state. We present CrowdMAPS, a web-based crowdsourcing paradigm for augmenting real-robot datasets with Multiple Actions per State (MAPS). After or during standard robot data collection, CrowdMAPS distributes visited robot states to remote annotators through a web-based 3D interface, where they specify alternative valid actions without requiring access to physical robot hardware. This expands robot datasets along a complementary "width" dimension--by increasing the number of actions per visited state--rather than only by collecting more trajectories. We evaluate CrowdMAPS using keyframe-centric goal-pose annotations supplied by non-expert annotators and train imitation policies on the resulting MAPS data. Across five real-world manipulation tasks, increasing MAPS width from one to ten actions per state improves sample efficiency and increases average success rates by 35.6 percentage points for keypose policies and 33.0 percentage points for trajectory policies. These results show that software-mediated human annotations can augment physical robot data to afford denser supervision, establishing CrowdMAPS as a scalable digital layer for real-robot data collection.

AI.tldr: CrowdMAPS 是一种基于网页的众包范式，通过为非专家标注者在3D界面中为机器人访问过的状态指定多个替代有效动作，将真实机器人数据沿"宽度"维度扩充（每状态多动作，MAPS），在五个真实操作任务上将每个状态的动作数从1增至10，使关键位姿策略和轨迹策略的平均成功率分别提升35.6和33.0个百分点。
AI.motivation: 真实机器人模仿学习受限于物理示教采集成本高，且常规采集每个访问状态仅有一个动作标签，监督信号稀疏；已有扩充多在"长度"维度（增加轨迹数量）上做文章，缺乏对同一状态下多可行动作的密集标注。
AI.method: 提出 CrowdMAPS 网页众包框架：在标准数据采集过程中或之后，将机器人访问过的状态分发给远程标注者，标注者通过基于 Web 的 3D 交互界面，在无需接触真实机器人硬件的情况下指定替代的有效动作。实验采用以关键帧为中心的目标位姿（goal-pose）标注，由非专家完成，并在所得 MAPS 数据上训练模仿策略（关键位姿策略与轨迹策略）。
AI.result: 在五个真实机器人操作任务上，将 MAPS 宽度从每状态1个动作提升至10个动作，改善了样本效率，并使平均成功率在关键位姿策略上提升35.6个百分点、在轨迹策略上提升33.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 由软件中介的人类标注能够增强物理机器人数据、提供更密集的监督；CrowdMAPS 可作为真实机器人数据采集的可扩展"数字层"，沿每状态多动作的宽度维度补充物理采集。

title: Low-Data OOD Prediction of SAW Resonators with Simulation-Compensated Transfer Learning
summary: Surface acoustic wave (SAW) resonators are foundational to modern radio-frequency (RF) front-end architectures. However, models trained on limited fabricated devices generalize poorly to unmeasured design regions because of process-induced variations, while finite-element method (FEM) simulations, although inexpensive, exhibit systematic offsets from measurements. To predict device performance before physical prototyping, this work presents a simulation-compensated transfer-learning framework that uses computationally efficient 2.5-D FEM simulations as physics-based anchors and learns their calibration to the measurement domain. Using 4,236 measured lithium tantalate (LiTaO3) SAW resonators and 816 unique simulated configurations, five transfer strategies are systematically benchmarked under seven out-of-distribution (OOD) protocols spanning frequency, geometry, and material shifts. The proposed framework reduces OOD prediction error by 83.54% on average (up to 97.57%) relative to the Measurement-only baseline, with the best strategy selected per case, and raises the pooled R2 of frequency prediction to 1.000, offering an economically scalable route toward physics-guided, fabrication-aware machine learning for microelectromechanical-system (MEMS) acoustic-device design.

AI.tldr: 提出仿真补偿的迁移学习框架：以2.5-D FEM仿真作物理锚点并学习其到实测域的校准，用4,236个实测LiTaO3 SAW谐振器与816个仿真配置在7种OOD协议下系统评测5种迁移策略。
AI.motivation: SAW谐振器是RF前端的基础器件，但仅有少量已制器件上训练的模型因工艺波动难以泛化到未测量设计区，而FEM仿真虽廉价却与实测存在系统性偏差，二者都无法可靠地在流片前预测器件性能。
AI.method: 构建仿真补偿的迁移学习框架，将计算高效的2.5-D FEM仿真作为物理先验锚点，学习其向测量域的校准；基于4,236个实测LiTaO3 SAW谐振器与816个独特仿真配置，在覆盖频率、几何与材料偏移的7种OOD协议下对5种迁移策略进行系统基准测试，并按情境择优。
AI.result: 相对仅用实测数据的基线，OOD预测误差平均降低83.54%（最高达97.57%），频率预测的合并R²提升至1.000。
AI.conclusion: 仿真-测量迁移学习可显著改善OOD泛化能力，为MEMS声学器件设计提供经济可扩展的物理引导、考虑工艺偏差的机器学习路径。

title: HeadIO: Body-Frame Heading Decomposition for Neural Inertial Odometry on Head-Mounted Devices
summary: Inertial odometry (IO) using only Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) enables camera-free head tracking in head-mounted devices such as VR headsets, AR glasses, and earbuds. Prior IO methods operate in a gravity-aligned world frame, which is not yaw-equivariant. Yaw augmentation improves robustness but does not guarantee equivariance; learned equivariant layers achieve it, but EqNIO's full pipeline costs nearly 3$\times$ the FLOPs of ours. While raw body-frame IMU inputs are inherently yaw-invariant, head tilt redistributes both gravity and motion signals across device axes, making the representation tilt-variant. We propose HeadIO, which combines a body-frame heading decomposition with a bidirectional Mamba backbone for head-mounted inertial odometry. Our decomposition achieves tilt invariance by separating gravity-aligned and horizontal components using only the tilt component of device orientation. We evaluate on four head-mounted datasets and find that HeadIO improves RTE-5s by 8.1% (0.260 m $\to$ 0.239 m) over world-frame methods with learned equivariant layers on Nymeria, the largest benchmark dataset, at nearly 3$\times$ lower FLOPs and 8$\times$ fewer parameters. HeadIO achieves state-of-the-art performance on our primary metric, RTE-5s, on all Aria-glasses datasets, which natively provide body-frame semantics for our decomposition method. We further evaluate the IMU-only deployment scenario on Nymeria, where HeadIO remains state-of-the-art. We show that our method relies mainly on tilt accuracy, which can be obtained from the gravity signal; for yaw, a single-coefficient gyroscope correction removes 11.6% of the yaw error and improves RTE-5s by 2.5%, and sparse external yaw corrections (for example, one every 30 s) can improve RTE-5s by 12.0%. Our decomposition is lightweight, composes with any backbone, and is suitable for real-time deployment on head-mounted devices.

AI.tldr: HeadIO：用"身体坐标系航向分解 + 双向Mamba主干"实现头部惯性里程计。仅用设备姿态的倾斜分量把IMU信号分解为重力对齐分量与水平分量，从而获得倾斜不变性并保持对偏航的等变性，在四个头戴数据集上以约1/3 FLOPs、1/8参数达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 仅靠IMU的惯性里程计（IO）可在VR头显、AR眼镜、耳机等头戴设备上实现无摄像头头部追踪。现有方法在世界坐标系（重力对齐）中运算，不具备偏航等变性；偏航数据增强不能保证等变性，学习等变层（如EqNIO）虽能实现但计算代价近3倍FLOPs。同时，原始身体坐标系IMU虽天然偏航不变，但头部倾斜会把重力与运动信号重新分配到各设备轴上，导致表示具有倾斜变异性。
AI.method: 提出HeadIO：1）身体坐标系下的航向分解（heading decomposition），仅使用设备姿态中的倾斜分量，将IMU信号分离为重力对齐分量与水平分量，从而同时获得倾斜不变性与偏航等变性；2）采用双向Mamba作为主干网络；3）分解模块轻量、可与任意主干组合。
AI.result: 在四个头戴数据集上评估：在最大基准Nymeria上，RTE-5s较使用学习等变层的世界坐标系方法提升8.1%（0.260 m→0.239 m），FLOPs约为其1/3、参数约为其1/8；在所有原生提供身体坐标系语义的Aria眼镜数据集上，主指标RTE-5s均达SOTA；在Nymeria的纯IMU部署场景下同样保持SOTA。消融显示方法主要依赖倾斜精度（可由重力信号获得）；偏航方面，单系数陀螺仪校正消除11.6%偏航误差、RTE-5s提升2.5%，稀疏外部偏航校正（如每30 s一次）可使RTE-5s提升12.0%。
AI.conclusion: 基于倾斜分量的身体坐标系航向分解是一种轻量、可插拔且具倾斜不变性的表示，配合双向Mamba主干可在头戴惯性里程计中实现低算力、低参数量的SOTA性能，并适合在头戴设备上实时部署；系统对倾斜精度依赖强，偏航误差可通过简单陀螺仪校正或稀疏外部校正有效缓解。

title: Effective Teacher Support for Reasoning Distillation
summary: Forward-KL language-model distillation normally computes dense teacher and student scores over the full vocabulary at every supervised position, making training and stored teacher targets expensive. We instead distill from the teacher's highest-probability vocabulary fraction, renormalizing the retained mass as we sweep support from 100% to 0.01%. Our main study distills Qwen3 4B -> 1.7B. We confirm the broader support-reduction finding on larger Qwen3 8B -> 4B and Nemotron Nano 12B -> 9B pairs and under answer-only supervision. We evaluate generation primarily on MMLU-Pro and secondarily on GPQA-Diamond. Across the Qwen3 settings, retaining 0.01% of the vocabulary causes no observed MMLU-Pro degradation relative to full-vocabulary distillation, although disagreement with the complete teacher distribution increases. Nemotron Nano matches full-vocabulary MMLU-Pro at 0.1%, but smaller fractions fail to emit the closing reasoning tag, showing that the reliable cutoff depends on the model family. At 0.01% support, caching the retained next-token scores from the teacher forward pass cuts training step time by 38%, while restricting student output computation to those tokens cuts peak memory by 24%; neither causes observed MMLU-Pro degradation.

AI.tldr: 前向KL语言模型蒸馏只需在教师最高概率的极小词表子集上进行：将支撑集从100%扫到0.01%，Qwen3（4B→1.7B、8B→4B）在0.01%时MMLU-Pro无可见退化，且缓存保留token分数使训练步时降低38%、峰值显存降低24%。
AI.motivation: 标准前向KL蒸馏在每个监督位置都要对全词表计算密集的教师与学生分数，导致训练开销大、存储教师目标昂贵。
AI.method: 仅从教师最高概率的词表比例中蒸馏，并对保留的分布质量重新归一化；支撑集由100%逐步缩减至0.01%。主实验为Qwen3 4B→1.7B，并在Qwen3 8B→4B、Nemotron Nano 12B→9B及仅答案监督设置下验证；以MMLU-Pro为主要评测、GPQA-Diamond为次要评测。此外，在0.01%支撑集下缓存教师前向中保留的下一token分数，并仅在这些token上计算学生输出。
AI.result: Qwen3各设置下，保留0.01%词表相对全词表蒸馏在MMLU-Pro上无可见退化，尽管与完整教师分布的不一致度上升；Nemotron Nano在0.1%时与全词表持平，但更小比例下模型无法输出推理结束标记，说明可靠截断阈值依赖模型族。0.01%支撑集下，缓存使训练步时降低38%，限制学生输出计算使峰值显存降低24%，二者均未观察到MMLU-Pro退化。
AI.conclusion: 按教师最高概率词表子集进行稀疏化前向KL蒸馏，可在几乎不损失生成性能的前提下显著降低训练时间与显存；但最优截断比例需按模型族调节，且需关注推理结束标记等结构性行为的失效风险。

title: Graph Label Alignment: A Diagnostic Atlas for Graph Classification
summary: Graph classification benchmarks vary widely in difficulty: some are solved by simple pooled baselines, while others remain challenging for GNNs and graph transformers. We take a data-centric view and ask whether benchmark success is driven by genuine structure--feature reasoning or by label signal already accessible from restricted marginal views. We introduce graph label alignment, a lightweight diagnostic that measures label accessibility through two supervised probes computed without training a graph encoder: structural label alignment (SLA), based on permutation-invariant topological and spectral summaries, and feature label alignment (FLA), based on pooled node features with edges removed. Across real graph classification benchmarks and multiple pooled backbones, the resulting SLA--FLA plane strongly organizes test accuracy, with low-alignment datasets forming a consistent regime where standard pooled pipelines struggle. To probe what lies beyond marginal accessibility, we introduce controlled interaction-dominated stress tests, including heterophilic ego-graphs and synthetic Twins tasks whose structural and feature marginals are matched across classes but whose role--feature couplings differ. These results show that high alignment explains much of easy benchmark performance, while low alignment reveals regimes where success requires preserving structure--feature correspondence beyond standard pooled representations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“图标签对齐”（graph label alignment）诊断方法，用不训练图编码器的两个监督探针——结构标签对齐（SLA）与特征标签对齐（FLA）——衡量标签信号可从受限边际视图获得的难易程度，并用SLA–FLA平面解释图分类基准难度差异。
AI.motivation: 图分类基准难度差异巨大：部分任务被简单池化基线即可解决，另一些则对GNN与图Transformer仍然困难。作者由此从数据中心视角追问：基准上的成功究竟源于真实的“结构—特征”联合推理，还是源于受限边际视图（拓扑/谱摘要或去除边的节点特征）中已可获取的标签信号。
AI.method: 提出轻量诊断指标label alignment：SLA基于置换不变的拓扑与谱摘要构建监督探针，FLA基于去除边后的池化节点特征构建监督探针，二者均无需训练图编码器。在多个真实图分类基准与多种池化骨干上绘制SLA–FLA平面并与测试精度关联；进一步设计交互主导的受控压力测试，包括异配ego-graph与结构、特征边际跨类匹配但角色—特征耦合不同的合成Twins任务。
AI.result: SLA–FLA平面能强有力地组织测试精度：高对齐数据集精度高，低对齐数据集构成标准池化流程一致失效的稳定区域。在边际匹配但耦合不同的受控压力测试中，仅靠边际信息无法区分类别，需保留结构—特征对应关系。
AI.conclusion: 高对齐可解释大部分“简单”基准上的性能，说明这些成功主要来自边际可及的标签信号而非结构—特征推理；低对齐揭示了必须超越标准池化表示、保留结构—特征对应性的任务区间。该诊断为基准选择与模型评估提供了数据中心的判据。

title: Decide Before You Move: Diffusion-Generated Search Reference for Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Object Navigation in Semi-Static Environments
summary: Open-world navigation requires a robot to locate a user-specified target in an indoor scene under open-vocabulary queries. Realistic indoor environments are semi-static: walls and furniture largely persist while smaller objects move, relocate, or vanish between visits. Prior-map systems answer queries from object poses recorded at reconstruction time, which expire as soon as objects move, whereas online methods re-derive where to look from current observations every few steps, often through expensive calls to a vision--language model. Assuming that walls and large furniture do not move, we keep their map to plan paths, but use a target--furniture co-occurrence prior to decide where to search. We present PreNav, an ObjectNav framework on semi-static environments. Rather than invoking a vision-language model at each step, PreNav generates a single global search reference before the robot moves: an LLM converts target--furniture co-occurrence into a spatial prior, a conditional diffusion model turns that prior and the persistent structure into an ordered centerline with a band around it, and the robot approaches the target once it is detected online. Experiments on a Gibson ObjectNav benchmark show that PreNav outperforms a strong online baseline under matched structural priors, using a generator trained only on room-level ScanNet++ scenes and applied to floor-level Gibson without fine-tuning. Real-world experiments under object relocation and open-vocabulary queries further validate the approach.

AI.tldr: PreNav：面向半静态室内环境的ObjectNav框架。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇目标导航需在室内场景定位用户指定目标。真实室内环境为半静态：墙体与大家具持久，小物体常移动或消失。基于先验地图的方法依赖重建时记录的物体位姿，物体一移动即失效；在线方法每几步就从当前观测重新推导搜索位置，需频繁调用昂贵的视觉语言模型。
AI.method: 假设墙体与大家具不动，用其地图规划路径；利用目标—家具共现先验决定搜索位置。PreNav在机器人移动前只生成一次全局搜索参考：由LLM将目标—家具共现转化为空间先验；条件扩散模型结合该先验与持久结构，输出带带状区域的中心线路径；在线检测到目标后再趋近。
AI.result: 在Gibson ObjectNav基准上，在结构先验匹配条件下优于强在线基线；生成器仅在房间级ScanNet++场景上训练，未微调即迁移到楼层级Gibson。真实世界物体搬移与开放词汇查询实验进一步验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: 先验与在线方法可按静态性分层结合：持久结构用于建图规划，可移动物体以语义共现先验引导搜索，并以单次全局规划替代逐步VLM调用，兼顾效率与开放词汇泛化。

title: When Does Learned Constraint Selection Pay in Security-Constrained Optimisation? A Boundary Map from SCOPF to Unit Commitment
summary: Learning-to-optimise methods for security-constrained optimal power flow (SCOPF) predict the security constraints that bind on each instance and solve only the reduced problem, with reported speed-ups of two to four orders of magnitude over the full problem. We ask whether learned selection beats the strongest learning-free alternative: a fixed umbrella set enforcing every constraint observed to bind in training. Our criterion, the price of a spare, answers this in advance: an enforced but inactive constraint is free, so the umbrella is exactly optimal wherever feasible, and learning can pay only where a spare decision carries a price. We test it systematically, including every PGLib-OPF network up to 10,000 buses. For SCOPF on a fixed network the umbrella is never beaten: its median size is five constraints across 43 networks, with no size trend, and our selector, while reproducing speed-ups of published magnitude (about x80,000 at case500), gains at most 0.25 ms over the umbrella and violates constraints on 4-5% of instances. Configuration diversity can break the umbrella's coverage on a small, densely meshed network but not at 2,000 buses, and we certify coverage with conformal risk control. In unit commitment, where a spare has a price, a static commitment loses 4-12% out of sample, and a predict-repair-reduce pipeline recovers it (cost gap 0.2-2.9%, fully feasible, 16-161x faster than the MILP). In our experiments, whether learning pays depends not on problem size but on whether a spare carries a price.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"备用代价"(price of a spare)判据，用以预先判断约束选择的学习方法是否优于固定"伞集"。实验表明：固定网络上SCOPF伞集从未被击败；仅在UC中因备用有代价，学习才带来收益。
AI.motivation: 学习型优化方法在SCOPF中通过预测绑定约束并求解缩减问题，报告了2–4个数量级的加速。但作者质疑其相对最强无学习基线——由训练中所有曾绑定约束构成的固定"伞集"——是否真正占优，并希望给出一个可先验判定的准则。
AI.method: 提出"price of a spare"判据：被强制但未激活的约束代价为零，故只要伞集可行即精确最优，学习仅在"备用决策有代价"处才有价值。系统测试覆盖PGLib-OPF全部至10,000母线网络，并对比自研选择器与伞集；用保形风险控制(conformal risk control)认证覆盖率；并在机组组合(UC)中评估"预测-修复-缩减"流水线。
AI.result: 固定网络SCOPF中伞集从未被击败：43个网络中中位规模仅5条约束且无规模趋势；选择器虽复现约x80,000（case500）的加速，但相对伞集至多仅省0.25 ms，且在4–5%实例上违反约束。配置多样性可在小型稠密网状网络上破坏伞集覆盖，但在2,000母线规模不成立。UC中静态承诺样本外损失4–12%，预测-修复-缩减流水线可挽回：成本差距0.2–2.9%，完全可行，比MILP快16–161倍。
AI.conclusion: 学习是否有价值并不取决于问题规模，而取决于"备用是否带有代价"。这一准则可先验判断学习方法相对固定伞集的必要性，并为约束选择研究提供更严格、无学习的对照基线。

title: From Pixels to Prompts: Physics-Guided Language Enhancement for AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: AI-generated content (AIGC) has substantially narrowed the visual gap between natural and synthetic images, while existing detectors often rely on generator-specific artifacts and exhibit limited generalization to unseen models. This motivates a fundamental question: which intrinsic physical image characteristics provide stable, discriminative cues for distinguishing natural from AI-generated images? We investigate this by systematically identifying robust physical features and incorporating them into a vision-language representation without external textual prompts at inference. We first analyze 15 handcrafted physical descriptors across images from over 20 generative models. Based on cross-generator stability and real-fake discriminability, we propose a Feature Stability-Discriminability Validation Assessment (FSDVA) to select a compact set of reliable features. Five core features, including Laplacian variance, Sobel statistics, and residual-noise variance, are then used to construct structured textual descriptions encoding physical evidence for CLIP-based learning. We integrate these physics-enriched descriptions with image representations via a native physics-guided multimodal framework, adapting CLIP ViT-L 14 with LoRA. At inference, the model requires only the input image, with no external captions or manual prompts. On GenImage, our method achieves 99.0 percent accuracy on SDv1.4 and 96.7 percent on Wukong, with a mean of 97.23 percent across eight generative models versus 95.8 percent for C2pCLIP under the same setting. On UniversalFakeDetect, it maintains strong, stable generalization across diverse and unseen generation settings. These results show that carefully selected physical image statistics provide complementary forensic evidence to pretrained vision-language representations, enabling interpretable, more generator-agnostic AIGC detection.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究哪些本质物理图像特征能为区分自然图像与AI生成图像提供稳定、可判别的线索，提出FSDVA筛选出5个核心特征（含Laplacian方差、Sobel统计量、残差噪声方差），构建结构化文本描述并经LoRA微调CLIP ViT-L/14，实现无需推理时外部提示的可解释、跨生成器AIGC检测，GenImage均值97.23%。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGC检测器多依赖特定生成器的伪造痕迹（generator-specific artifacts），对未见模型的泛化能力有限；因此需要探究哪些内在物理图像特性可提供稳定且具判别性的线索，以提升跨生成器泛化性。
AI.method: 1) 在20余个生成模型的图像上分析15种手工物理描述子；2) 提出特征稳定性-判别性验证评估（FSDVA），依据跨生成器稳定性与真伪判别性筛选出5个核心特征（Laplacian方差、Sobel统计、残差噪声方差等）；3) 将核心特征构建为结构化文本描述以编码物理证据，结合图像表示，采用物理引导的多模态框架，通过LoRA适配CLIP ViT-L/14；4) 推理仅需输入图像，无需外部caption或人工提示。
AI.result: GenImage上SDv1.4达99.0%准确率，Wukong达96.7%，8个生成模型平均97.23%，同设置下C2pCLIP为95.8%；在UniversalFakeDetect上于多样及未见生成设置中保持强且稳定的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 精心筛选的物理图像统计量可为预训练视觉-语言表示提供互补的取证证据，从而实现可解释且更生成器无关的AIGC检测。

title: Can an AI Agent Be Epistemically Akratic? Higher-Order Evidence & the Limits of Self-Correction
summary: When we judge that our reasoning was defective, it seems plausible that we should abandon the conclusion it produced. This thought has special force for AI agents built to assess and correct their own work. Yet obeying such judgments can make an agent worse at distinguishing sound reasoning from defective reasoning.
