An AI agent may rely on information about its reasoning when deciding which conclusions to keep, while the part that judges whether those conclusions are justified cannot use that information. The agent can then exercise an epistemic competence by retaining conclusions it judges unjustified, even when its self-assessments are generally reliable. Nor is the difficulty resolved by training the agent to make its conclusions and assessments agree: agreement can be achieved by degrading either one. Crucially, I argue that a negative assessment can remain valuable by identifying conclusions requiring further scrutiny, without having authority to eliminate them. The result challenges a central assumption about AI self-correction: that bringing an agent's beliefs into agreement with its own self-assessment about their justification makes it better at correcting its mistakes.

AI.tldr: 论文论证：AI代理的"负面自评"不应对结论拥有否决权；保留被判为"未获辩护"的结论反而可能体现认知胜任力，自评的价值在于标记需进一步审查的结论而非直接消除它们。
AI.motivation: 针对AI自我纠错研究中的一个核心假设——"让代理的信念与其对自身辩护状态的评估保持一致，就能更好地纠错"——提出质疑，并解释为何"依据自评放弃结论"这一看似合理的做法会损害推理辨别力。
AI.method: 概念/规范性分析（认识论论证）：构造"分裂式"代理结构——决定保留哪些结论的部分可使用关于自身推理过程的信息，而判断结论是否获辩护的部分不能使用该信息；据此说明代理可行使认知胜任力去保留其判定为未获辩护的结论，即便自评总体可靠。并进一步论证该困难不能通过训练使二者一致来解决。
AI.result: （1）服从自评判断会使代理在区分可靠推理与缺陷推理上变差；（2）"结论—自评一致"可由任一侧退化达成，故一致性本身不是纠错能力的指标；（3）负面评估可以保持价值，其功能是识别需进一步审查的结论，而不具备消除结论的权威。
AI.conclusion: AI自我纠错不应以"信念与自评趋于一致"为目标；自评应被定位为审查触发器（scrutiny-triggering）而非结论淘汰机制，这对自纠正代理的设计原则构成实质挑战。

title: SPIRE: Task-agnostic embodied continual learning through autonomous situation inference and causal motor-primitive reuse
summary: Embodied continual learning requires controllers to infer changing situations, retain prior behavior and reuse motor skills without task labels or known boundaries. The challenge is deciding when to recover earlier behavior and which skills can support new learning. We introduce Situation-guided Primitive Integration for Recurrent Embodiment (SPIRE), a recurrent-spiking system that infers latent contexts from action-outcome evidence and learns context-specific motor actors online. Mature actors become protected sources that combine with a target-context residual to drive recurrent-spiking motor populations. Across coordinate, three-joint and hidden-force control, SPIRE maintained control, autonomously inferred situations, retained prior behavior and accelerated acquisition of an unseen source composition, reducing mean interactions to criterion by approximately 40% relative to matched fresh controllers. Rewinding compatible source actors impaired early acquisition in every matched intervention, demonstrating causal reuse. Against seven recurrent continual-learning and modular-control comparators, SPIRE achieved 2.4 times the mean prior-learning advantage of the strongest eligible task-free alternative selected for each paired stream. These results demonstrate autonomous recovery and causal reuse of motor skills for new learning in continuous embodied control.

AI.tldr: SPIRE是一种循环脉冲神经网络系统，可从动作-结果证据中在线推断潜在情境并学习情境专属运动执行器，成熟执行器成为可保护复用源，实现无标签、无边界条件下的自主情境恢复与运动技能因果复用。
AI.motivation: 具身持续学习要求控制器在无任务标签、无已知任务边界的情况下推断变化的情境、保持既有行为并复用运动技能；核心难点在于判断何时应恢复早期行为，以及哪些技能能支撑新学习。
AI.method: 提出SPIRE（Situation-guided Primitive Integration for Recurrent Embodiment）：循环脉冲网络系统，从动作-结果证据推断潜在情境，在线学习情境专属运动执行器；成熟执行器被设为受保护的"源"，与目标情境的残差信号组合，共同驱动循环脉冲运动群体。
AI.result: 在坐标控制、三关节控制与隐力控制任务中，SPIRE均维持控制、自主推断情境、保持既往行为，并将未见源组合的习得加速，达到准则所需平均交互次数较匹配的全新控制器降低约40%；在每个匹配干预中，回退兼容源执行器均损害早期习得，证明存在因果复用。与7种循环持续学习及模块化控制基线相比，SPIRE的既往学习优势均值为各配对流中最优无任务基线方法的2.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明在连续具身控制中可实现运动技能的自主恢复与因果复用以支撑新学习。

title: Elastra: A Simulation Framework for Elastic Bodies
summary: When robots interact with elastic surfaces such as mattresses and trampolines, changes in loading cause the surfaces to deform and rebound, altering subsequent contact locations and forces. We present Elastra, a simulation framework for modeling this interaction and supporting the training and evaluation of robot control policies. Elastra represents each surface using elements that move only vertically, with elastic connections and damping to model deformation and recovery. Contact forces drive surface motion, and the updated surface geometry is used to compute subsequent contact forces. We systematically validate our simulations against an independent implementation and a real mattress load curve. We further use Elastra to train the Unitree G1 humanoid to stand up on mattresses and trampolines. Using the pretrained HoST policy and ProtoMotions motion tracker as original controllers, we train residual policies through reinforcement learning to add corrections to their joint targets. Adding these residual policies increases the success rate with HoST from 44.1\% to 72.5\%, and from 55\% to 89\% on the trampoline. With ProtoMotions, the success rate increases from 19.0\% to 45.0\% for initial poses not encountered during training. The code and video are available on https://github.com/yichg/elastra.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Elastra 仿真框架，用仅做垂直运动、带弹性连接与阻尼的表面元建模弹性表面（床垫、蹦床）的形变与回弹，并基于该框架为 Unitree G1 人形机器人训练残差强化学习策略，显著提升了站立任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人（如人形机器人）在床垫、蹦床等弹性表面上交互时，载荷变化会使表面形变并回弹，进而改变后续接触位置与接触力，这类交互难以在现有刚体仿真中建模，也缺乏支持控制策略训练与评估的仿真平台。
AI.method: 提出 Elastra 仿真框架：将表面离散为只沿竖直方向运动的单元，单元间以弹性连接和阻尼刻画形变与恢复；接触力驱动表面运动，更新后的表面几何再用于计算后续接触力。验证方面，与独立实现及真实床垫载荷曲线进行系统对比。应用方面，以预训练的 HoST 策略和 ProtoMotions 运动跟踪器作为原始控制器，通过强化学习训练残差策略，对关节目标添加修正量，用于 G1 在床垫和蹦床上站起。
AI.result: 仿真结果与独立实现和真实床垫载荷曲线一致。加入残差策略后，HoST 在床垫上的成功率由 44.1% 提升至 72.5%，在蹦床上由 55% 提升至 89%；ProtoMotions 在训练中未见的初始位姿下成功率由 19.0% 提升至 45.0%。
AI.conclusion: 垂直运动单元 + 弹性连接/阻尼的简化可变形表面模型足以支撑策略训练与评估，且以其为环境训练的残差策略能有效提升现有控制器在弹性表面上的鲁棒性与泛化性；代码与视频已公开。

title: Quantum Computing in Power Systems:Current Landscape and Future Roadmap with AI
summary: Modern power systems are characterized by greater penetration of renewable energy resources, extensive use of power electronics, and more diverse loads. This leads to a dramatic increase in computational complexity, which, in turn, compromises solution efficiency and fails to satisfy the real time demands of system analysis. Recently, quantum computing techniques, attributed to their unique physical properties, such as superposition and entanglement, hold the potential to offer new solutions for power systems. To this end, this paper not only provides a comprehensive landscape of quantum computing in power systems, but also investigates its roadmap with AI enabled evolution. This paper begins with an introduction to the fundamental concepts of quantum computing, followed by a review of several approaches to power system simulation and optimization. Subsequently, we further investigate the potential quantum AI-enabled evolution in power systems. In addition, the current development of quantum software and hardware platforms is elaborated. Finally, this paper synthesizes the prevailing challenges and prospects for future research directions.

AI.tldr: 该文综述量子计算在电力系统中的应用全景，并探讨"AI使能的量子演进路线图"，涵盖量子计算基础概念、电力系统仿真与优化方法回顾、量子AI演进潜力、量子软硬件平台进展，以及挑战与未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 现代电力系统可再生能源渗透率高、电力电子设备广泛使用、负荷多样化，导致计算复杂度剧增，求解效率下降，难以满足系统分析的实时性需求；量子计算的叠加与纠缠等物理特性有望提供新的求解途径，但缺乏系统性的应用全景与演进路线梳理。
AI.method: 综述性/路线图研究：先介绍量子计算基本概念，再回顾电力系统仿真与优化的若干方法，进而分析量子AI使能的潜在演进路径，并阐述当前量子软件与硬件平台的发展状况。
AI.result: 形成量子计算在电力系统中的研究全景与AI使能演进路线图，梳理量子软硬件平台现状，并归纳当前主要挑战与未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 量子计算凭借叠加、纠缠等特性具备应对电力系统计算复杂度与实时性挑战的潜力，其与AI融合的演进路径值得深入研究；后续需围绕量子软硬件成熟度、算法适配性等问题推进研究。

title: Lines Are Ideas: Visual Creativity Assessment in Hyperbolic Space
summary: Assessing human creativity from drawings provides a scalable way to evaluate human creative ability. However, existing approaches either rely on costly expert annotation or treat creativity as a single regression target, overlooking its underlying structure. Psychological theories have long emphasized that creativity emerges from balancing novelty and appropriateness. Motivated by this principle, we recast creativity as structured semantic deviation between paired drawings, where novelty measures the extent of departure from the original base sketch, and appropriateness determines whether such departures remain meaningful. This formulation naturally leads to a hyperbolic representation, in which novelty is quantified by geodesic distance and appropriateness is evaluated conditionally via a learned decision boundary, further regulated by an abstraction-conditioned adaptive constraint. Experiments on AuDrA-Drawings demonstrate state-of-the-art alignment with expert judgments and strong robustness under rater and task shifts. Beyond performance gains, our framework reveals an interpretable radial organization of creative variation, offering a principled geometric foundation for automatic creativity assessment.

AI.tldr: 该论文将绘画创造力评估重构为配对绘画间的结构化语义偏离，用双曲表示中的测地距离度量新颖性、学习决策边界判定恰当性，在AuDrA-Drawings上达到与专家评判最先进的一致性并具可解释的径向结构。
AI.motivation: 现有绘画创造力评估依赖昂贵专家标注，或将创造力当作单一回归目标，忽略其内在结构；心理学理论强调创造力源于新颖性与恰当性的平衡，故需按此结构建模。
AI.method: 提出结构化语义偏离框架：新颖性=相对原始基础草图（base sketch）的偏离程度，恰当性=偏离是否有意义；采用双曲表示，测地距离量化新颖性，学习决策边界条件化评估恰当性，并引入抽象度条件化的自适应约束（abstraction-conditioned adaptive constraint）。
AI.result: 在AuDrA-Drawings上取得与专家判断最先进的一致性，并在评分者与任务偏移下表现强鲁棒性；揭示创造力变化的可解释径向组织。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为自动创造力评估提供了有原则的几何基础，兼顾性能、鲁棒性与可解释性。

title: MuEdit: An efficient multi-task editing method towards inter-domain knowledge conflicts
summary: Large language models (LLMs) require frequent knowledge updates across heterogeneous domains, but existing editing methods fail when applied sequentially to multi-task settings. We trace this collapse to inter-domain null-space misalignment: heterogeneous tasks induce distinct Jacobian geometries, causing their common null space to shrink dramatically and leaving insufficient admissible directions for conflict-free updates. We propose the Conflict Index to quantify this geometric interference, and introduce Mu-Edit, which mitigates multi-task conflicts via (1) conflict-aware ordering to minimize cumulative interference, and (2) dynamic low-rank approximation to expand the null space when ordering alone is insufficient. Experiments across five functional domains and three backbones show that Mu-Edit significantly outperforms existing baselines in multi-task editing performance while preserving general capabilities, and remains effective under incremental task arrival.

AI.tldr: 提出域间零空间错位解释多任务序贯知识编辑的性能崩塌，并用Mu-Edit（冲突感知排序+动态低秩近似）缓解多任务冲突。
AI.motivation: LLM需在异构领域频繁更新知识，但现有编辑方法序贯应用于多任务时性能崩塌，其机制尚缺乏几何层面的解释。
AI.method: 以域间零空间错位刻画问题：异构任务诱导不同Jacobian几何，使公共零空间急剧收缩、可容许方向不足。提出Conflict Index量化几何干扰；Mu-Edit包含(1)冲突感知排序以最小化累积干扰、(2)排序不足时用动态低秩近似扩张零空间。
AI.result: 在五个功能领域、三种骨干网络上，多任务编辑性能显著优于现有基线，同时保持通用能力；在增量任务到达场景下仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 多任务序贯编辑的失效可通过域间零空间错位分析定位，排序与零空间扩张的组合可有效实现无冲突多任务知识编辑。

title: Generalize Then Personalize: Wearable-Based Heart Rate Forecasting Under Scarce Ruck-March Data
summary: Heart rate (HR) forecasting may provide advance information about near-future cardiovascular response, potentially supporting physiological monitoring and workload-management decisions during ruck marching. However, robust model development is constrained by the difficulty of collecting large-scale ruck-march datasets, creating a scarce-data problem in which models must generalize across participants while adapting to individuals from limited personal data. To address this problem, we benchmark population-only training (POT), personalized-from-scratch training (PFST), and population-pretrained fine-tuning (PPFT) for HR forecasting during loaded ruck marching using data from eight active-duty U.S. Army medics across thirteen sessions. LSTM, Attention-LSTM, and CNN-LSTM backbones were evaluated against a persistence baseline at 30 s and 60 s horizons. Across all neural architectures and horizons, PPFT yielded lower mean MAE, RMSE, and endpoint MAE than both POT and PFST. Participant-level paired analysis after averaging across three training seeds showed that, relative to PFST, PPFT reduced trajectory MAE by 2.22-4.30 bpm and endpoint MAE by 1.24-2.88 bpm. All six trajectory-MAE comparisons remained significant after Holm adjustment ($p_{adj}$ = 0.0469), while four of six endpoint-MAE comparisons remained significant after adjustment. At 30 s, persistence achieved the lowest MAE (3.555 $\pm$ 1.274 bpm), while CNN-LSTM PPFT achieved the lowest RMSE (4.669 $\pm$ 1.916 bpm); LSTM PPFT achieved the lowest endpoint MAE (5.093 $\pm$ 2.365 bpm). At 60 s, Attention-LSTM PPFT achieved the lowest MAE (5.573 $\pm$ 1.939 bpm) and RMSE (7.134 $\pm$ 2.260 bpm), while CNN-LSTM PPFT achieved the lowest endpoint MAE (7.553 $\pm$ 2.357 bpm). These results suggest that population pretraining followed by participant-specific fine-tuning may provide a practical strategy for scarce-data wearable HR forecasting.

AI.tldr: 在负重行军心率（HR）预测的稀缺数据场景下，对比仅群体训练（POT）、从头个性化训练（PFST）与群体预训练+微调（PPFT）三种策略；结果表明PPFT在所有骨干网络与两个预测时域上均优于POT与PFST。
AI.motivation: HR预测可为负重行军中的近未来心血管响应提供前瞻信息，支撑生理监测与负荷管理决策；但大规模行军数据集难以采集，形成"稀缺数据"问题——模型需跨受试者泛化，同时利用有限个人数据实现个体适配。
AI.method: 使用8名美国陆军现役卫生兵、共13次行军会话的数据，在30 s与60 s两个预测时域上，以持久性基线为对照，评测LSTM、Attention-LSTM、CNN-LSTM三种骨干下的POT、PFST、PPFT三种训练范式；采用MAE、RMSE、终点MAE指标，并进行受试者级配对分析与Holm多重比较校正（三种随机种子取平均）。
AI.result: PPFT在所有架构与时域上均获得更低的平均MAE、RMSE与终点MAE。相对PFST，PPFT使轨迹MAE降低2.22–4.30 bpm、终点MAE降低1.24–2.88 bpm；6项轨迹MAE比较经Holm校正后全部显著（p_adj=0.0469），6项终点MAE比较中4项显著。30 s时持久性基线MAE最低（3.555±1.274 bpm），CNN-LSTM PPFT的RMSE最低（4.669±1.916 bpm），LSTM PPFT的终点MAE最低（5.093±2.365 bpm）；60 s时Attention-LSTM PPFT的MAE与RMSE最低（5.573±1.939、7.134±2.260 bpm），CNN-LSTM PPFT的终点MAE最低（7.553±2.357 bpm）。
AI.conclusion: 群体预训练后进行受试者特异性微调，可为稀缺数据条件下的可穿戴HR预测提供一种实用策略；短期（30 s）轨迹误差仍难以超越持久性基线，提示短时域预测的改进空间与基线选择的必要性。

title: PolyMorphWBC: Whole-Body Control from End-Effector Trajectories for Quadrupedal Mobile Manipulation across Arm Morphologies with Extended Reach
summary: Quadrupedal mobile manipulators can extend their manipulation workspace by coordinating the mounted arm with the mobile base. At the task level, short-horizon end-effector (EE) trajectories provide an interface for specifying the desired manipulation motion without prescribing how it should be realized by the arm and base. However, executing such trajectories remains challenging because the controller must determine when and how the base should move, and this decision depends on the mounted-arm morphology. We therefore present PolyMorphWBC, a hierarchical controller that takes an EE trajectory as the sole task-level motion command and generates coordinated arm--base motions across four families of 6-DoF mounted arms, with extended-reach trajectories beyond the initial fixed-base reach. Within PolyMorphWBC, a trajectory-conditioned coordinator determines the base motion from previewed EE targets, while arm-specific Inverse Kinematics (IK) tracks the current target, and a frozen locomotion backend executes the resulting motion. Cross-arm reuse is enabled by a Unified Robot Description Format (URDF)-derived morphology conditioning, together with online residual-wrench feedback. We train PolyMorphWBC on procedurally generated arms and structured trajectories within and beyond fixed-base reach. In IsaacLab, it achieves 93.95% completion with 2.30cm position error and 4.81° orientation error on held-out trajectories and arm morphologies. In MuJoCo evaluation against UMI-on-Legs, PolyMorphWBC reduces EE position error by 69--72% and orientation error by 91--97% across four within- and extended-reach trajectories. On a physical Go2--ARX5 system, we demonstrate language-conditioned extended-reach pick-and-place using EE trajectories from pi_0 without vision-language-action (VLA)-generated base commands.

AI.tldr: 提出PolyMorphWBC分层控制器，仅以末端轨迹为任务级指令，实现跨四类6-DoF机械臂形态的四足移动操作臂协同运动。
AI.motivation: 四足移动操作臂需协调机械臂与移动基座以扩展作业空间。短时域末端轨迹可作为任务级接口，但控制器必须自行判定基座何时、如何移动，且该决策依赖所搭载机械臂的形态，现有方法难以泛化到不同臂形态。
AI.method: 分层控制架构：轨迹条件协调器基于预览的末端目标决定基座运动；臂特定的逆运动学（IK）跟踪当前目标；冻结的运动后端执行生成的运动。通过URDF导出的形态条件化与在线残余力矩（residual-wrench）反馈实现跨臂复用。基于程序化生成的机械臂与结构化轨迹（含固定基座可达范围之内与之外）进行训练。
AI.result: IsaacLab中在留出轨迹与臂形态上达到93.95%完成率，位置误差2.30cm、姿态误差4.81°；MuJoCo中对比UMI-on-Legs，在四条臂内与扩展可达轨迹上位置误差降低69–72%、姿态误差降低91–97%；在Go2–ARX5实机上实现由pi_0生成末端轨迹、无需VLA生成基座指令的语言条件扩展可达抓放。
AI.conclusion: 以末端轨迹为唯一任务级运动指令的分层全身控制可跨多种机械臂形态复用，并在仿真与实机上实现高精度、扩展可达范围的协同操作，为移动操作的任务级接口提供了可行方案。

title: Towards Efficient Edge AI for Power Flow in Renewable-Rich Grids with Volt/VAR Control
summary: AI models of the power grid must capture how wind and solar plants support the voltage, adjusting their reactive power to the local voltage along a grid-code Q(V) characteristic. This research examines whether grid foundation models, fast neural network models for power-flow analysis, can represent this behaviour. We introduce the Q(V) bus, a new bus type for the open-source GridFM GraphKit, whose physics decoder evaluates the reactive injection from the plant characteristic at the predicted voltage in every correction step. Training data comprise 7882 hourly operating points of a modified IEEE 118-bus system, matched to Energinet DK1/DK2 measurements and solved with pandapower. Compared with a physics-informed baseline that represents the parks as negative load, the Q(V) bus lowers the voltage-magnitude RMSE 2.3-fold, reduces the power-balance mismatch at the parks from 25 to 0.66 MVA, and raises the F1 score for voltage-band violations from 0.40 to 0.76. An ablation over five configurations shows that the Q(V) bus type provides the accuracy and the physics loss provides the power balance. For edge monitoring, we distil the trained $2.0\times10^{7}$-parameter model into students of $6\times10^{5}$ and $1.3\times10^{6}$ parameters; a flat-start initialisation prevents their collapse into an incorrect low-voltage state in which the characteristic saturates. With output distillation, the 12-step student reaches 1.4 times the teacher's error and, for edge inference on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano (15 W), solves an hourly scenario in 12.2 ms, within the 20 ms synchrophasor interval.

AI.tldr: 提出GridFM GraphKit中的"Q(V)母线"新母线类型，使电网基础模型能表征风/光电站按电网规范Q(V)特性调节无功的行为；配合物理损失，电压幅值RMSE降至基线的1/2.3，并蒸馏出可在Jetson Orin Nano上12.2 ms完成推理的轻量学生模型。
AI.motivation: 电网AI模型需准确刻画风、光电站按电网规范Q(V)特性调节无功以支撑电压的行为；而现有时将新能源场站简化为"负负荷"的物理信息基线无法反映这一特性，导致电压精度与功率平衡误差偏大。
AI.method: 在开源GridFM GraphKit中引入Q(V)母线这一新母线类型：其物理解码器在每个校正步中依据预测电压和电站Q(V)特性计算无功注入。训练数据为改造IEEE 118节点系统的7882个小时运行点，与Energinet DK1/DK2实测数据匹配并用pandapower求解。与"负负荷"基线对比，并进行五组配置消融；随后将2.0×10^7参数教师模型蒸馏为6×10^5与1.3×10^6参数的学生模型，采用平坦启动初始化防止特性饱和导致的错误低电压态坍缩，并结合输出蒸馏。
AI.result: 相较负负荷基线，Q(V)母线使电压幅值RMSE降低2.3倍，场站处功率平衡失配由25 MVA降至0.66 MVA，电压越限F1由0.40提升至0.76。消融表明Q(V)母线类型贡献精度、物理损失贡献功率平衡。12步学生模型误差为教师的1.4倍，在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano（15 W）上以12.2 ms求解单小时场景，满足20 ms同步相量间隔。
AI.conclusion: Q(V)母线类型可让电网基础模型有效表征新能源场站的无功—电压耦合行为，显著提升电压预测与越限识别精度并保持功率平衡；经蒸馏的小模型配合平坦启动初始化可避免饱和坍缩，满足边缘端同步相量级实时监测需求。

title: Hint-Informed Self-Distillation for Reasoning Segmentation
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. The first two authors contributed equally
summary: Reasoning segmentation requires identifying the target referred to by a query among visually similar objects, yet trajectory-level rewards cannot directly indicate which tokens provide relevant visual evidence. We propose Hint-Informed Self-Distillation (HISD), which uses target-disambiguation evidence for token-level credit assignment. An external model generates Segment Hints offline from training images, queries, and ground-truth target annotations, organizing target identity, discriminative attributes, confusable objects, and anchoring paths. A hint-conditioned exponential moving average teacher scores the student's own trajectories, and HISD computes the teacher-to-student evidence ratio over a token support set to adjust only the magnitudes of positive group-relative advantages, leaving nonpositive advantages unchanged. This design encourages concise reasoning while retaining the information needed for target disambiguation, and the student requires neither hints nor a teacher at inference. Under a unified training protocol, HISD improves ReasonSeg test gIoU and cIoU over our reproduction of DPAD by 3.00 and 3.55 percentage points, respectively. Across the five evaluated splits of ReasonSeg and the RefCOCO family, HISD achieves higher segmentation metrics than this baseline and reduces the average token count of valid reasoning spans by 80.17 to 91.83 percent.

AI.tldr: 提出Hint-Informed Self-Distillation (HISD)，利用目标消歧证据进行token级信用分配，仅调整正优势幅度，在ReasonSeg与RefCOCO上超越DPAD复现并大幅压缩推理token。
AI.motivation: 推理分割需在视觉相似物体中定位查询所指目标，但轨迹级奖励无法直接指示哪些token提供了相关视觉证据，导致信用分配粗粒度、推理冗长。
AI.method: 离线由外部模型基于训练图像、查询与GT标注生成Segment Hints（组织目标身份、判别性属性、易混淆物体、锚定路径）；用提示条件化的EMA教师对学生自身轨迹打分；在token支持集上计算教师-学生证据比，仅按比例调整正的分组相对优势幅度，非正优势保持不变；推理时学生无需提示与教师。
AI.result: 统一训练协议下，ReasonSeg测试gIoU与cIoU较DPAD复现分别提升3.00和3.55个百分点；在ReasonSeg五个划分及RefCOCO系列上分割指标均优于该基线，有效推理span平均token数减少80.17%–91.83%。
AI.conclusion: 以目标消歧证据实现token级信用分配，可在保持目标区分信息的同时鼓励简洁推理，并实现无提示、无教师的推理部署。

title: Edge-Native Multimodal RAG: Hardware-Aware Quantization and Architectural Optimization for Consumer GPUs
comment: Accepted to the 14th International Japan-Africa Conference on Electronics, Communications and Computations (JAC-ECC 2026).6 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables
summary: Deployment of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for Edge-AI is constrained by memory and bandwidth limitations. A standard 7B parameter model consumes 14 GB Video Random Access Memory (VRAM) in half-precision (FP16), precluding co-location of vector indices and Key-Value (KV) caches. This paper presents an engineering integration and empirical evaluation of a multimodal RAG framework optimized for consumer-grade Turing hardware (e.g., NVIDIA Tesla T4). Our system-level analysis identifies a critical trade-off: while generative pre-trained transformer quantization (GPTQ) offers superior throughput (51.6 tok/s), it exhibits significant context instability at 2048+ tokens on Turing architectures. Conversely, NormalFloat 4-bit (NF4) maintains robust long-context performance with viable latency (81 ms/tok). By coupling NF4 with a decoupled Florence-2 vision integration, we achieve visual reasoning with only 430 MB VRAM overhead. Furthermore, empirical observations of prompt-induced search space pruning show that structured prompting reduces latency by 47% without altering computational intensity (1.88 GFLOPs/token). The integrated architecture maintains an 8.37 GB footprint, establishing a viable RAG pipeline for 12-16 GB GPUs. Finally, structured few-shot prompting effectively compensates for quantization-induced reasoning loss, restoring mathematical accuracy from 35.0% to 92.0% across 200 trials.

AI.tldr: 论文面向消费级Turing架构GPU（如Tesla T4）设计并实测了一套多模态RAG边缘部署框架，通过NF4量化+解耦Florence-2视觉模块+结构化提示，将整体显存占用控制在8.37 GB，并兼顾长上下文稳定性与推理精度。
AI.motivation: 边缘AI部署RAG受显存与带宽限制：标准7B模型在FP16下即占用14 GB VRAM，无法同时容纳向量索引与KV缓存，导致检索与生成难以共置；同时量化方案在Turing架构上的长上下文行为缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 工程集成与实证评估：对比GPTQ与NF4两种4-bit量化在吞吐、延迟及长上下文（2048+ token）稳定性上的表现；采用解耦式Florence-2视觉编码器实现多模态；引入结构化提示/结构化few-shot提示，并测量延迟与计算强度（GFLOPs/token）变化。
AI.result: GPTQ吞吐更高（51.6 tok/s）但在2048+ token出现明显上下文不稳定；NF4长上下文更稳健，延迟81 ms/tok。视觉模块仅增加430 MB显存开销；结构化提示在不改变计算强度（1.88 GFLOPs/token）的前提下降低47%延迟；整体显存8.37 GB，适配12–16 GB GPU；结构化few-shot将数学准确率由35.0%提升至92.0%（200次试验）。
AI.conclusion: 在Turing消费级硬件上，NF4配合解耦视觉集成与结构化提示是实现稳定长上下文多模态RAG的可行配置；提示工程可缓解量化带来的推理能力损失，为12–16 GB显存设备提供了可落地的RAG流水线。

title: FOE-Dreamer: Deployment-Efficient Learning of Cyber Defense Policies in Operational Networks
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures. To appear in the proceedings of the Annual Computer Security Applications Conference (ACSAC)
summary: Autonomous cyber defense is widely studied with deep reinforcement learning, but most work trains policies inside simulators because learning requires many trial-and-error interactions. Simulator-based training carries a fidelity gap: trained policies face authentication delays, partial action failures, service dependencies, and user traffic patterns that the simulator did not represent, and degrade on transfer. Training directly in the network being defended removes the gap but makes every interaction slow and costly, so sample efficiency becomes the binding constraint. Model-based reinforcement learning has reduced sample requirements on games and physical robots by orders of magnitude by planning inside a learned world model, but it has not been applied to defenders trained in operational networks. We present FOE-Dreamer (Factored Opponent-Enhanced Dreamer), a model-based reinforcement learning framework that trains a defender online and directly in a network on cloud infrastructure, without a simulator stage. FOE-Dreamer separates three sources of variation in the latent state: a controllable component driven by defender actions, an exogenous component driven by benign user activity, and an opponent embedding inferred from defender-observable signals alone. Separating the components reduces the variance in policy gradients during planning in imagination. Against two scripted attacker profiles with user activity emulated by the GHOSTS framework on an 8-host OpenStack testbed, FOE-Dreamer trains within a 3-day budget on a single GPU and achieves about 2$\times$ better episode loss than Rainbow and IQN baselines under matched compute. Both the factoring and the opponent model contribute to the gain, and the learned latents are consistent with the intended separation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FOE-Dreamer，一种基于模型的强化学习框架，可在真实云网络环境中直接在线训练自主防御智能体，无需模拟器阶段；其将潜在状态分解为可控、外生与对手三个分量以降低策略梯度方差，在 8 主机 OpenStack 测试床上 3 天、单 GPU 训练即取得约 2 倍于 Rainbow 与 IQN 的回合损失表现。
AI.motivation: 自主网络防御多依赖深度强化学习，但在模拟器中训练存在保真度差距：真实网络中的认证延迟、部分动作失败、服务依赖与用户流量模式未被建模，导致策略迁移后性能下降；而直接在真实网络中训练虽消除差距，却交互缓慢昂贵，样本效率成为瓶颈。基于模型的强化学习已在游戏与机器人任务中将样本需求降低数量级，但尚未用于在真实运行网络中训练的防御者。
AI.method: 提出 FOE-Dreamer（Factored Opponent-Enhanced Dreamer）框架：在潜在状态中显式分离三类变异来源——由防御者动作驱动的可控分量、由良性用户活动驱动外生分量，以及仅依据防御者可观测信号推断的对手嵌入；通过在想象中规划时分离这些分量来降低策略梯度方差。实验在 8 主机 OpenStack 测试床上进行，以 GHOSTS 框架模拟用户活动，针对两种脚本化攻击者画像，单 GPU、3 天预算内在线训练。
AI.result: 在匹配算力下，FOE-Dreamer 的回合损失约为 Rainbow 与 IQN 基线的 2 倍优势；消融表明因子分解与对手模型均对增益有贡献，且学到的潜在表示与预期的分量分离结构一致。
AI.conclusion: 基于模型的强化学习可切实用于在真实运行网络中在线训练自主防御策略，避开模拟器保真度差距的同时满足样本效率约束；结构化的潜在状态分解（可控/外生/对手）是提升样本效率与表示可解释性的有效手段。

title: ARTS: An Open-Source, Reproducible Three-Arm Platform for Autonomy Research in Minimally Invasive Surgery
comment: Submitted to the 2027 International Symposium on Medical Robotics (ISMR). † Equal contribution
summary: Research on surgical autonomy needs open platforms that any laboratory can build, yet the most widely shared platform depends on donated clinical hardware, and open alternatives on industrial arms each lack part of the surgical chain. We present the Autonomous Robotic Translational System (ARTS), an open-source three-arm platform for autonomy research in minimally invasive surgery, built entirely from purchasable parts for about USD 137,000. Two UR5e arms hold wristed da Vinci X/Xi instruments, a UR5 arm holds a stereo endoscope with two FLIR cameras, the surgeon console provides haptic handles, footswitches and a stereo viewer, and a hardware stop independent of the software lets a supervisor freeze all three arms in place. The ROS 2 software pins every dependency, installs from the same scripts on bare metal or in containers, and records stereo images with hardware-measured timing. On the real arms, ARTS commands each arm at its controller's full rate (e.g., 500 Hz on the UR5e), the two cameras expose within 12 microseconds of each other, hand motion reaches the arm in 58 ms, and the endoscope image reaches the monitor in 68 ms. The ISO 9283 pose repeatability is 0.14-0.25 mm, comparable to a da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK) Classic arm on the same protocol, and an optical tracker measured a mean remote-center-of-motion error of 0.34-0.37 mm. Three expert and three novice operators performed the Fundamentals of Laparoscopic Surgery (FLS) peg transfer through a laparoscopic trainer box, and one of the experts sutured on a suture pad. The hardware designs, firmware and software are available at https://github.com/MRE-Lab-UMD/arts.

AI.tldr: ARTS 是一套全开源、约13.7万美元、可用可购件搭建的三臂微创手术自主性研究平台，性能对标 dVRK 并附完整软硬件开源。
AI.motivation: 手术自主性研究需要各实验室可自行搭建的开放平台，但最普及的 dVRK 依赖捐赠的临床硬件，而基于工业机械臂的开放方案又各自缺失手术链条中的某些环节，因此缺乏完整、可复制、低门槛的三臂平台。
AI.method: 用两台 UR5e 搭载带腕的 da Vinci X/Xi 器械，一台 UR5 搭载双 FLIR 相机的立体内窥镜；医生控制台含力反馈手柄、脚踏与立体显示器；另设独立于软件的硬件急停可冻结三臂。ROS 2 软件锁定全部依赖，同一脚本支持裸机与容器部署，并以硬件实测时间戳记录立体图像。
AI.result: 各臂以控制器全速指令（UR5e 500 Hz）；双相机曝光同步误差小于12 µs；手部动作到机械臂延迟58 ms，内窥镜图像到显示器68 ms；ISO 9283 位姿重复性0.14–0.25 mm，与同协议 dVRK Classic 臂相当；光学跟踪测得 RCM 平均误差0.34–0.37 mm。
AI.conclusion: 三名专家与三名新手在腹腔镜训练箱内完成 FLS 钉传递任务，一名专家在缝合垫上完成缝合，验证了平台可用性；硬件设计、固件与软件均已在 GitHub 开源，为手术自主性研究提供可复现的开放三臂基础。

title: Algorithms for Robust Dedicated Actuator Placement
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure. Source code and verification scripts available on GitHub
summary: We study dedicated actuators installed at distinct states of a structured linear system. Failures remove actuators but preserve states and state arcs. For unit costs and one failure, an exact source-quota relaxation followed by maximum matching in a \emph{common-repair graph} yields a $3/2$-approximation on arbitrary directed state graphs using $O(n^3)$ elementary graph operations. The analysis combines fundamental cocircuit unions with the Tutte--Berge formula. For multiple failures, we give an exact algorithm fixed-parameter tractable in the maximum-matching deficiency and failure budget, independently of the number of source strongly connected components. The underlying result solves resilient matroid spanning with an arbitrary number of disjoint unit-cost quota constraints. We also establish an exact weighted spanning algorithm for safe and vulnerable elements in the independence-oracle model, with an application to strongly connected state graphs.

AI.tldr: 该文研究结构化线性系统中位于不同状态的专用执行器的鲁棒配置问题：故障会移除执行器但保留状态与状态弧。对单位成本、单故障情形，通过精确源配额松弛加"公共修复图"上的最大匹配，得到任意有向状态图上的3/2近似，代价为O(n^3)次基本图运算。多故障情形给出以最大匹配亏量和故障预算为参数的精确FPT算法；底层结果解决带任意数量互不相交单位成本配额约束的韧性拟阵生成问题，并给出独立性预言模型下区分安全/脆弱元素的精确加权生成算法。
AI.motivation: 已有工作多关注单个执行器/单点失效或要求状态图结构良好（如源强连通分量数量受限），缺乏同时处理任意有向状态图、单故障近似保证与多故障精确可解性的统一框架；同时，韧性拟阵生成在带多个互不相交配额约束时缺乏算法结果。作者因此希望在有向状态图与一般拟阵两个层面同时推进。
AI.method: 1) 建模：执行器置于状态上，故障删除执行器而保留状态与状态弧，目标是在最坏故障下维持可达性/可生成性——形式化为带单位成本配额约束的韧性拟阵生成。2) 单故障、单位成本：先求精确的源配额LP/组合松弛，再构造公共修复图（common-repair graph）并求最大匹配以保持近似比。3) 分析工具：基本余回路（cocircuit）并集与Tutte–Berge公式结合进行近似比论证。4) 多故障：基于最大匹配亏量与故障预算的FPT精确算法，避免依赖源强连通分量数量。5) 加权推广：在独立性预言（independence oracle）模型下给出安全元素/脆弱元素的精确加权生成算法。
AI.result: 单故障单位成本：任意有向状态图上3/2近似，O(n^3)基本图运算。多故障：以最大匹配亏量与故障预算为参数的精确FPT算法，与源强连通分量数目无关。理论层面：解决韧性拟阵生成中带任意多个互不相交单位成本配额约束的问题；并给出独立性预言模型下安全/脆弱元素的可精确加权生成算法，可应用于强连通状态图。
AI.conclusion: 该文将有向状态图上的容错执行器配置统一到"带配额约束的韧性拟阵生成"框架，用源配额松弛+公共修复图最大匹配获得单故障3/2近似，用参数化方法获得多故障精确算法，并给出可推广的加权拟阵生成算法，适用于强连通状态图等场景。

title: Reality Perception Gap: Are AI-Manipulated Video Detectors Ready for the Real World?
summary: AI-manipulated video detectors are typically evaluated on clean, curated datasets. In deployment, however, videos have usually passed through repost compression on social-media platforms and sometimes were captured by imperfect hardware. To measure detection under these conditions, we introduce Reality Perception Gap (RPG), a benchmark of 10,000 videos from frontier generators and partially synthetic edits, processed with cross-platform repost compression and paired with real footage that carries camera-side optical artifacts. RPG also includes socially fragile content, such as crime and wartime footage, where fabricated videos can cause severe social harm. Across 18 detectors, none catches more than 15% of fakes at a 1% false-positive rate. A positive control and a re-encoding sweep separate two sources of failure: generator and content shift degrades detectors before any compression, and repost compression erases the low-level traces that the artifact-based detectors relies on. Existing detectors therefore struggle when deployment conditions strip away the generation artifacts they rely on. These complementary failures suggest that robust detection requires training under deployment conditions and combining low-level, temporal, and semantic evidence, where passive detection may have reached its limits.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RPG基准（1万条视频，含前沿生成器与部分合成编辑、跨平台转发压缩、真实拍摄光学伪影），在1%假阳性率下18个检测器最高仅检出不到15%的伪造视频，并揭示了"生成器/内容漂移"与"转发压缩抹除低层伪影"两类互补失效来源。
AI.motivation: 现有AI视频检测器多在干净、人工筛选的数据集上评估，而实际部署中视频常经历社交媒体跨平台转发压缩，且有时由非理想硬件拍摄。亟需在真实部署条件下衡量检测性能，尤其是犯罪、战时等社会脆弱内容场景中伪造视频危害严重。
AI.method: 构建Reality Perception Gap (RPG) 基准：10,000条来自前沿生成器及部分合成编辑的视频，施加跨平台转发压缩，并与携带相机端光学伪影的真实素材配对；纳入社会脆弱内容。评估18个检测器，并设置阳性对照与重编码扫描实验，以分离两类失效来源。
AI.result: 在1%假阳性率下，无一检测器对伪造视频的检出率超过15%。阳性对照与重编码扫描表明：生成器与内容漂移在任何压缩之前就已使检测器性能下降；转发压缩则抹除了基于伪影的检测器所依赖的低层痕迹。
AI.conclusion: 现有检测器在部署条件剥离其依赖的生成伪影后难以奏效。稳健检测需在部署条件下训练，并融合低层、时序与语义证据；被动检测可能已接近其能力上限。

title: Provably Optimal HBT Legalization in Seconds: Certified Optima Reveal Where the Headroom Really Lies
summary: Hybrid bonding terminal (HBT) legalization assigns every terminal of a face-to-face 3D IC to its own pitch-grid site with minimum total Manhattan displacement. Open3DBench reports that a reinforcement-learning (RL) legalizer reduces displacement by 19-22% relative to a sliding-window (SW) heuristic, but none of its legalizers is publicly released. We ask how much displacement any legalizer can still recover. We build an open benchmark of 21 design/pitch instances from Open3DBench placement data, with reconstructed greedy, SW (ViaLegal-style) and BTAssign-style baselines, and GEO-Exact, an exact solver that runs successive shortest augmenting paths over lazily generated spatial candidate edges. An independent dual certificate proves its assignment optimal on all 21 instances (relative primal-dual gap at most $8.2 \times 10^{-16}$). Against these optima, our SW reconstruction with ViaLegal's default configuration is on average 0.011% above optimal (worst 0.119%), while on the 16 contended instances BTAssign-style, a density-guided heuristic (DGHL) and greedy are 3.0%, 6.9% and 64.5% above. Headroom does appear outside this regime: with 2x2 windows SW reaches 34.1%, and above about 58% utilization, on three of six swept designs, it reaches 21.1% on bp, 27.5% on swerv and 8.9% on jpeg (217 further certified instances, and ten bp points checked against an independent exact solver). If the published 19-22% gain were measured on instances like ours, SW would have to be at least 24-28% above optimal on average, far more than any SW variant we tested at nominal pitch; the RL paper's own comparison with the Hungarian optimum puts its SW 3.05% above optimal on average. GEO-Exact is also about an order of magnitude faster than DGHL and SW in our harness (geometric means 8.1x and 40x; a compiled core against Python baselines on a shared server). Code, optimal values and certificates are released.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了21个HBT合法化基准算例，提出精确求解器GEO-Exact（基于惰性生成空间候选边的连续最短增广路），并用独立对偶证书证明其在全部21个算例上最优（相对原始-对偶间隙≤8.2e-16）。
AI.motivation: Open3DBench报告RL合法化器相较滑动窗口（SW）启发式减少19-22%位移，但其合法化器均未公开，因此需回答任何合法化器还能挽回多少位移，并建立可复现的公开基准与最优性参照。
AI.method: 从Open3DBench布局数据构建21个设计/间距算例，复现greedy、SW（ViaLegal风格）与BTAssign风格基线，以及密度引导启发式DGHL；提出精确求解器GEO-Exact，在惰性生成的空间候选边上运行连续最短增广路。
AI.result: 独立对偶证书证明GEO-Exact在全部21个算例上最优（相对间隙≤8.2e-16）。以最优值为参照，默认配置的SW重建平均仅高出0.011%（最差0.119%）；16个竞争算例上BTAssign风格、DGHL和greedy分别高出3.0%、6.9%、64.5%。2x2窗口下SW达34.1%；利用率约58%以上时，六个扫描设计中的三个上SW分别达bp 21.1%、swerv 27.5%、jpeg 8.9%（另有217个认证算例及10个bp点对独立精确求解器校验）。若19-22%增益在本类算例上测得，SW平均须高出最优24-28%，远超名义间距下所有SW变体；RL原文与匈牙利最优比较时其SW平均仅高3.05%。GEO-Exact亦更快，几何平均分别为DGHL的8.1倍、SW的40倍。
AI.conclusion: 名义间距、低利用率下HBT合法化几乎已达最优，可恢复余量极小；显著余量仅出现在大窗口或高利用率区域。已发表RL增益与本文测得的SW最优性差距不相容，提示其基线设置或比较条件不同。代码、最优值与证书均已公开。

title: Machine Learning Moment Closure for the Boltzmann Transport Equation: Enforcing Hyperbolicity
summary: The Boltzmann transport equation describes particle transport across collisional regimes, but resolving its velocity dependence is expensive. Moment methods reduce this cost by evolving finitely many velocity moments, requiring a closure for unresolved higher-order moments. Data-driven closures can represent these moments accurately, yet without structural constraints they may produce complex characteristic speeds and unstable simulations. Learned Boltzmann closures with guaranteed hyperbolicity have so far been formulated in one spatial dimension; in multiple dimensions, hyperbolicity must hold in every direction simultaneously. We develop, to the best of our knowledge, the first data-driven closure for multidimensional Hermite moment systems of the linear Boltzmann equation that is hyperbolic by construction. The network learns a symmetric positive-definite symmetrizer shared by all spatial directions and restricted to a subspace that preserves the known lower-order transport equations; the unresolved rows follow from a symmetric completion. Every directional Jacobian thus has real eigenvalues and a complete set of eigenvectors for every network output and at any truncation order. The closure is trained only on spatial derivatives of unresolved moments from kinetic reference solutions, with no solver in the training loop, and evolved by a partially conservative discontinuous Galerkin method. In two-dimensional experiments in the transition and scattering-dominated regimes, a single learned third-order system with ten moments remains stable in all cases. Averaged over time, it is more accurate than the classical P7 and P15 truncations with 36 and 136 moments in every experiment, and its density error is about two orders of magnitude smaller than that of the P3 truncation with the same moments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个按构造保证双曲性的、面向多维线性Boltzmann方程Hermite矩系统的数据驱动闭合，仅用10个矩的三阶系统即可稳定且高精度地模拟输运。
AI.motivation: Boltzmann输运方程直接求解速度依赖代价高昂，矩方法通过演化有限个速度矩降低成本，但需对未闭合的高阶矩给出闭合关系。数据驱动闭合虽精度高，却缺乏结构约束，易产生复特征速度导致不稳定；而已有保证双曲性的学习型闭合仅限一维，多维情形要求双曲性在所有方向上同时成立。
AI.method: 网络学习一个在所有空间方向共享的对称正定对称化子（symmetrizer），并将其限制在保持已知低阶输运方程不变的子空间内；未解析行由对称补全得到，从而任一方向的Jacobian对任意网络输出、任意截断阶数均具实特征值与完备特征向量。闭合仅用动理解参考解中未解析矩的空间导数训练，训练回路不含求解器；时间演化采用部分守恒的间断Galerkin方法。
AI.result: 二维过渡区与散射主导区实验中，单一学习的三阶十矩系统在所有算例中保持稳定；时间平均精度在每项实验中都优于经典P7（36矩）与P15（136矩）截断，其密度误差比同为矩数的P3截断低约两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 通过将对称化子学习与对称补全结合，可在多维情形下构造性地保证矩系统双曲性，使低阶数据驱动闭合以极少矩数实现稳定、高效且高精度的输运模拟。

title: Are We Ready for Snow-tonomous Driving? Challenges Toward Robust Automated Driving in Extreme Weather
summary:
Automated driving has gained remarkable momentum over the past decade, with both industry and academia investing substantial resources in developing perception and control solutions to advance vehicle autonomy. However, these efforts have largely focused on clear-weather scenarios, leaving harsh conditions, such as snow, rain, and fog, comparatively understudied. As a result, inclement weather remains one of the most significant hurdles for autonomous vehicles, often leading to substantial performance degradation in downstream perception and control tasks.
  In this paper, we present insights from the EU-funded Horizon Europe project ROADVIEW, which aims to develop robust, weather-aware perception and control modules for connected and automated vehicles operating under severe conditions, including snow, rain, and fog. Drawing on four years of large-scale development and real-world demonstrations across multiple vehicle platforms in different locations, we identify ten key challenges that hinder the development of weather-resilient autonomy, including data scarcity, domain shifts, limitations in multimodal perception, control robustness, and validation gaps, among others. We summarize these challenges and lessons learned toward enabling reliable snow-autonomous driving, highlighting critical directions for future research and standardization.

AI.tldr: 基于欧盟Horizon Europe项目ROADVIEW四年的大规模开发与多平台实车验证，总结恶劣天气（雪、雨、雾）自动驾驶感知与控制面临的十大关键挑战与经验教训，并提出未来研究方向与标准化建议。
AI.motivation: 过去十年自动驾驶研究主要集中于晴朗天气场景，雪、雨、雾等恶劣条件下的感知与控制研究相对不足，导致下游感知与控制任务性能显著下降，恶劣天气成为自动驾驶落地的最大障碍之一。
AI.method: 以ROADVIEW项目为依托，面向网联自动驾驶车辆开发鲁棒的、具备天气感知能力的感知与控制模块；基于四年跨多个车辆平台、多地点的大规模开发与真实环境演示，归纳分析实践中的问题与经验。
AI.result: 识别出阻碍天气鲁棒自动驾驶发展的十大关键挑战，涵盖数据稀缺、域偏移、多模态感知局限、控制鲁棒性不足以及验证体系缺口等方面。
AI.conclusion: 系统总结上述挑战与经验教训，为实现可靠的雪天自动驾驶提供指引，并指出未来研究与标准化建设的关键方向。

title: Unifying Heterogeneous Dissipativity for Distributed Power-System Stability Analysis
summary: Compositional dissipativity is attractive for large-scale interconnected systems, but its application to modern heterogeneous power systems is limited by conservative descriptions of nodal dissipativity and inefficient distributed implementation. This paper introduces a common first-order dynamic lifting of the physical voltage-current port, providing an enriched dissipativity representation that captures complementary frequency-dependent energy behavior while preserving network composability. The resulting representation accommodates heterogeneous power system buses within a unified dissipativity description and enables less conservative compositional stability analysis. A centralized stability-certification problem is then formulated and solved through a dual-guided column-generation scheme. Its matrix dual reveals the network-critical dissipation direction, which guides parallel local certificate generation toward the current system bottleneck. This leads to a distributed Network-Critical Margin Exchange (NCME) method with early stability certification. Case studies demonstrate substantially reduced conservatism of the dynamic-port formulation and improved computational and communication scalability of NCME for heterogeneous power systems.

AI.tldr: 提出电压-电流端口的公共一阶动态提升，得到更少保守的耗散性描述，并用双引导列生成与分布式NCME实现异构电力系统的可扩展稳定性认证。
AI.motivation: 组合耗散性适合大规模互联系统，但节点耗散性描述保守、分布式实现效率低，限制了其在现代异构电力系统中的应用。
AI.method: 对物理电压-电流端口引入公共一阶动态提升，构造兼顾互补频率相关能量行为且保持网络可组合性的增广耗散性表示；建立集中式稳定认证问题，采用对偶引导的列生成求解，由矩阵对偶揭示网络关键耗散方向，指导并行的局部证书生成，进而形成带早期稳定认证的分布式网络关键裕度交换（NCME）方法。
AI.result: 案例研究表明，动态端口表述显著降低了保守性；NCME在异构电力系统上改善了计算与通信的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 动态端口耗散性表述可在统一框架内容纳异构母线并给出更紧的稳定性判据，配合对偶引导的分布式认证可实现高效、可扩展的稳定性验证。

title: RSLiveBench-UAV: A Continually Evolving Vision-Language Benchmark for Aerial Spatial Intelligence
summary: Aerial spatial intelligence (ASI) requires models to understand objects and spatial relationships across changing viewpoints and scales. Evaluating these abilities as models evolve calls for fresh physical observations, yet producing new aerial spatial questions requires repeatedly establishing entity identities, geometric references, and cross-view correspondences. We introduce \textbf{RSLiveBench-UAV}, a continually evolving vision-language benchmark driven by recurring acquisition of real UAV imagery. Its update protocol admits images captured after the preceding release and delays answer disclosure. An entity-centered production workflow uses geometry-assisted association to link repeated observations of physical vehicles, reuse human-verified attributes, and combine them with view-specific annotations and spatial references for traceable question generation. All tasks use deterministic scoring without model judges. We evaluate 30 general-purpose, remote-sensing, and embodied models on 35,491 question records from ten scenes, covering 17 tasks across 2D perception, 3D perception, cross-view perception, and reasoning. All 18 tested embodied models outperform the three selected remote-sensing comparators in Overall, although the strongest embodied model scores 43.29 versus 59.88 for GPT-6-Astra. Fine-grained vehicle recognition remains challenging, and performance varies across heights and camera pitches. Retrospective scene-group comparisons and rolling-window replay characterize score-pattern consistency under scene renewal. RSLiveBench-UAV connects fresh physical observations, entity-centered answer production, and systematic model evaluation to support continual assessment of ASI. Benchmark will release at https://rslivebench.space

AI.tldr: 提出持续演进的无人机视觉语言基准RSLiveBench-UAV：以实体为中心、几何辅助关联的题目生产流程保证可溯源与确定性评分，并在35,491条记录、10场景、17任务上评测30个模型。
AI.motivation: 空中空间智能（ASI）要求模型在变化的视角与尺度下理解物体与空间关系；模型迭代需要"新鲜的物理观测"来评测，但生成新的空中空间问答需反复重建实体身份、几何参考与跨视角对应关系，成本高且困难。
AI.method: 构建由真实UAV影像持续采集驱动的基准：更新协议只接收上一版本发布后拍摄的影像，并延迟答案公开以防污染。题目生产以实体为中心：用几何辅助关联把同一物理车辆（实体身份）的重复观测链接起来，复用人工核验的属性，再结合视角特定标注与空间参考，生成可溯源的问答；全部任务采用确定性评分，不使用模型裁判（无LLM-as-judge）。
AI.result: 在10个场景、35,491条题目记录、覆盖2D/3D/跨视角感知与推理共17项任务上评测30个通用、遥感与具身模型。18个受测具身模型在Overall上均优于3个选定遥感对照模型，但最强具身模型为43.29，低于GPT-6-Astra的59.88；细粒度车辆识别仍具挑战，性能随飞行高度与相机俯仰角变化。通过回溯性场景组比较与滚动窗口重放，刻画场景更新下的分数模式一致性。
AI.conclusion: RSLiveBench-UAV把新鲜物理观测、以实体为中心的答案生产与系统性模型评测贯通，支撑ASI的持续评估；基准将于 https://rslivebench.space 发布。

title: Emergent Vision-Shaped Thinking in Text-Only Reasoning through Multimodal Training
summary: Does multimodal training shape how a language model thinks, even when the input is text only? We test this with targeted causal ablations across 10 multimodal configurations from 6 model families, with matched text-only backbones and cross-family transfer controls. We contrast spatial-imagery tasks that invite mental scene construction with symbol-manipulation tasks solvable by symbolic rules alone. We identify a vision-language axis in hidden-state space and ablate its projection at inference. In Chameleon-7B, this ablation drops accuracy on BIG-Bench Hard (BBH) navigate by 27.6 pp while leaving boolean expressions intact (+5.6 pp), a 33.2 pp double dissociation. The effect is direction-specific and layer-localized, extends to mental-simulation tasks such as mental rotation, paper folding, and perspective taking, and is not explained by task difficulty, reasoning depth, or sequential update load. Together, these results reveal emergent vision-shaped thinking (EVT): text-only reasoning that causally recruits representations introduced or strengthened by vision-language training, without assuming an image-like internal format. The measured effect is spatially concentrated at 7-8B and broadens to non-spatial visual attribute binding in the tested 32B configuration. In dual-path unified models (BAGEL, Janus-Pro), the causal handle localizes to the generation pathway as a compact one-dimensional carrier. The understanding pathway also encodes spatial information in a higher-rank, probe-decodable form, but is not the causal handle. To separate decodability from causal use, we analyze concentration, alignment, and semantic location. These diagnostics explain why behavior, probing, and intervention can diverge. Multimodal training thus reshapes the geometry of text-only reasoning, not just how visual input is processed.

AI.tldr: 通过跨6个模型家族、10种多模态配置的因果消融，作者发现纯文本推理中会因果性地调用由视觉-语言训练引入或强化的表征，提出“涌现式视觉化思维（EVT）”。在Chameleon-7B上，消融隐状态空间中的视觉-语言轴使BBH navigate掉27.6pp而布尔表达式不受损（+5.6pp），构成33.2pp的双重解离，且效应具方向特异性与层级局部性。
AI.motivation: 已有研究多关注多模态训练如何改变视觉输入的处理方式，但一个关键问题未被回答：多模态训练是否也重塑了模型在纯文本输入下的推理机制。若成立，则说明多模态训练改变的是推理的表征几何，而非仅增加一个视觉感知模块。
AI.method: 构建匹配的纯文本骨干与跨家族迁移对照，覆盖6个模型家族的10种多模态配置；对比需“心理场景构建”的空间意象任务（如心理旋转、折纸、视角采择、BBH navigate）与仅靠符号规则可解的任务（如布尔表达式）；在隐状态空间中识别“视觉-语言轴”，于推理时消融该轴的投影；结合难度、推理深度、序列更新负载等混淆因素做对照，并通过集中度、对齐性与语义定位三项诊断区分“可解码性”与“因果使用”。
AI.result: Chameleon-7B中消融导致BBH navigate准确率下降27.6pp，布尔表达式反而提升5.6pp，形成33.2pp双重解离；效应具方向特异性与层级局部性，且无法用任务难度、推理深度或序列更新负载解释。效应在7–8B规模集中于空间任务，在32B配置扩展至非空间视觉属性绑定。在双路径统一模型（BAGEL、Janus-Pro）中，因果手柄定位于生成通路，表现为紧凑的一维载体；理解通路虽以更高秩、可探针解码的形式编码空间信息，但不构成因果手柄。
AI.conclusion: 多模态训练重塑的是纯文本推理的表征几何，而不仅是视觉输入的加工方式；行为表现、探针可解码性与干预效应可能相互背离，需以因果干预而非可解码性判定机制的实质参与。

title: Social Engineering Attack Detection in Corporate Communications
summary: Social Engineering attacks continue to pose a significant risk to the corporate world with a growing level of sophistication. It is difficult to distinguish between authentic and phishing communication via email, chat, and phone. They pose a risk of exposing trade secrets and confidential communications and can create a chain of attack from lower-level employees up to executives. Therefore, we study this growing threat using real-world datasets to build baseline machine-learning models. Our TF-IDF models classify emails as phishing or safe, achieving accuracy above 90%. We build on this by exploring whether psychological manipulation and persuasion indicators can be measured to play a significant role in detecting phishing. Instead of relying solely on surface-level lexical features, we derive interpretable lexicon-based indicators of urgency, trust, greed, and other persuasion cues from the combined email dataset. By evaluating these manipulation-oriented features on their own, we measure how much signal they carry (ROC-AUC of 0.74 on a held-out test split) and test whether they transfer to held-out email sources.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于真实邮件数据集构建钓鱼邮件检测的基线机器学习模型，TF-IDF分类准确率超90%，并进一步用可解释的词表指标量化紧迫感、信任、贪婪等心理操纵线索，单独使用这些特征在留出测试集上取得ROC-AUC 0.74，并检验其跨邮件来源的迁移性。
AI.motivation: 社会工程攻击手法日益复杂，邮件、聊天与电话中的真实通信与钓鱼通信难以区分，可能泄露商业秘密并形成从基层员工到高管的攻击链，因此需要可解释、可迁移的检测手段，而非仅依赖表层词汇特征。
AI.method: 使用真实世界数据集构建基线机器学习模型，先以TF-IDF特征进行钓鱼/安全二分类；随后从合并邮件数据集中基于词表提取紧迫性、信任、贪婪及其他说服线索的可解释操纵指标，单独评估其判别能力，并在留出测试划分上测量信号强度，进一步测试其向其他留出邮件来源的迁移效果。
AI.result: TF-IDF模型分类准确率超过90%；仅使用心理操纵与说服指标的模型在留出测试集上达到ROC-AUC 0.74，表明这些可解释特征本身携带显著判别信号；论文同时报告了跨来源迁移的检验结果。
AI.conclusion: 心理操纵与说服线索可作为独立且可解释的钓鱼检测信号，补充甚至部分替代表层词汇特征；未来可将其与TF-IDF等模型融合以提升鲁棒性与跨来源泛化能力。

title: DroneDiffusion: Uncertainty-Guided Diffusion Path Planner for UAV Navigation
summary: We present DroneDiffusion, a perception-aware diffusion planner for local 3-D UAV trajectory generation that explicitly models and avoids failure zones caused by lens flare, overexposure, and reflective surfaces. A vision-language perceptual safety estimator produces a pixel-aligned reliability map that highlights regions of degraded sensing. A denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) is conditioned on this map together with the onboard RGB image, goal point, and initial velocity to generate egocentric 3-D trajectories. To enforce obstacle avoidance at inference time without retraining, we apply training-free CHOMP guidance over a 3-D Euclidean signed distance field. The model is trained entirely in simulation and deployed zero-shot on a real drone. Reliability conditioning raises the mean perceptual reliability along generated trajectories to 0.71, compared with 0.63 for a geometric baseline, while guidance halves the collision rate of the learned prior from 14.7% to 7.8%. Perceptual safety conditioning and geometric guidance are therefore complementary: treating sensor reliability as a first-class signal reduces incursions into unreliable regions while maintaining competitive navigation performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 DroneDiffusion：一种感知感知的扩散规划器，用于局部三维无人机轨迹生成，显式建模并规避由镜头光晕、过曝和反光表面造成的失效区域，并结合免训练 CHOMP 引导实现推理期避障。
AI.motivation: 镜头光晕、过曝、反光表面会使机载视觉传感退化，导致感知不可靠区域成为隐性失效区；传统几何规划器忽略传感器可靠性，容易生成穿越这些区域的轨迹。
AI.method: (1) 视觉-语言感知安全估计器输出像素对齐的可靠性图，标出感知退化区域；(2) 以该可靠性图、机载 RGB 图像、目标点与初始速度共同条件化 DDPM，生成第一视角三维轨迹；(3) 推理阶段在三维欧氏符号距离场上施加免训练 CHOMP 引导以强化避障，无需重训练；(4) 全仿真训练，零样本部署于真实无人机。
AI.result: 可靠性条件化将生成轨迹的平均感知可靠性从几何基线的 0.63 提升至 0.71；引导将学习先验的碰撞率从 14.7% 降至 7.8%（减半）。
AI.conclusion: 感知安全条件化与几何引导互补：将传感器可靠性作为一等信息源可减少进入不可靠区域的轨迹段，同时保持有竞争力的导航性能，并支持仿真到真机的零样本迁移。

title: Fundamental Limits of Data-Driven Predictive Control
summary: Data-driven predictive control (DDPC) has attracted substantial interest, and many variants have been proposed; however, comparatively less is known about the statistical closed-loop performance of these methods and the fundamental limits they are subject to. In this contribution, we apply the statistical decision framework developed in our earlier work to study fundamental limits of DDPC. The performance of a data-driven controller is measured by its risk, the expected deterioration in control performance relative to an oracle model-based controller at a given system, and by its total risk that measures the overall performance across all systems of interest. Lower bounds on these risks are derived using the bias-variance decomposition and the Cramer-Rao inequality. In particular, a lower bound on the total risk is obtained by a calculus-of-variations method. This bound applies to any DDPC design, thereby quantifying unavoidable performance limitations and providing a benchmark for assessing existing DDPC methods. In an illustrative example, we compare the risks of certainty-equivalence model predictive control, subspace predictive control, and data-enabled predictive control with the derived lower bounds, providing a quantitative performance assessment of these methods and some guidance on tuning regularization parameters in DDPC.

AI.tldr: 本文在已建立的统计决策框架下研究数据驱动预测控制（DDPC）的基本性能极限：以“风险”（相对 oracle 模型控制器的期望性能损失）与“总风险”（跨所有目标系统的总体性能）为度量，基于偏差-方差分解与 Cramér-Rao 不等式推导下界，并用变分法得到适用于任意 DDPC 设计的总风险下界。
AI.motivation: DDPC 变体众多，但其统计闭环性能及所受基本极限缺乏认识；缺少可量化不可避免性能限制并可为现有方法提供基准的理论工具。
AI.method: 采用作者前期发展的统计决策框架：以风险与总风险为性能度量；通过偏差-方差分解和 Cramér-Rao 不等式推导风险下界；用变分法（calculus of variations）导出总风险下界，该下界对任意 DDPC 设计成立。
AI.result: 得到适用于任意 DDPC 设计的总风险下界，量化了不可回避的性能局限；在示例中将确定性等价 MPC、子空间预测控制（SPC）与 data-enabled predictive control（DeePC）的风险与理论下界对比，给出定量性能评估，并就 DDPC 正则化参数调节给出指导。
AI.conclusion: 所推导下界构成评估现有 DDPC 方法的基准，并可指导正则化参数整定；该框架将统计决策理论引入 DDPC 的性能极限分析。

title: Validation of a Facial-Video Digital Hydration Biomarker Score for Tracking Hydration State Transitions in a Real-World Fasting Model
summary: Hydration influences physiology and daily function, yet repeated practical measurement in everyday settings remains limited. We present initial real-world evidence that a facial-video lifestyle digital biomarker score can track the direction of hydration state transitions. Using Ramadan fasting as a model of prolonged fluid abstinence, we assessed whether the score tracks the transition between the fasting (pre-drink) state and the rehydrated (post-drink) state across three validation layers. In the primary cohort (104 participants, 208 videos), the score increased from a mean of 36.6 in the fasting (pre-drink) state to 70.6 in the rehydrated (post-drink) state (change = +33.9, 95% CI [+30.7, +37.1], p < 0.001, Cohen's d = 2.03), with 102 of 104 participants (98.1%) showing an upward shift. In a nested body-weight subgroup (20 participants), body weight increased by +0.74 kg after fluid intake (p < 0.001), confirming fluid uptake and providing supportive physical anchoring. In a nested serum osmolality subgroup (10 participants), osmolality decreased by -5.1 mOsm/kg (p < 0.001), with all post-drink values within the normal clinical range, providing exploratory biological support. An exploratory secondary comparison of water versus electrolyte rehydration showed no statistically significant difference in short-term score change (p = 0.247). This study does not establish a clinical diagnostic test for dehydration. Rather, these findings support the score as a lifestyle digital biomarker for tracking the direction of hydration state change in real-world settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究提供初步真实世界证据，表明基于面部视频的生活方式数字生物标志物评分能够追踪水合状态转变的方向：斋戒期（饮水前）均值36.6升至补水后70.6（+33.9，95% CI [+30.7,+37.1]，p<0.001，Cohen's d=2.03），98.1%参与者评分上升；嵌套体重亚组（+0.74 kg）与血清渗透压亚组（-5.1 mOsm/kg）分别提供物理与生物学佐证。该评分定位为生活方式数字生物标志物，而非脱水临床诊断工具。
AI.motivation: 水合状态影响生理功能与日常表现，但日常场景中反复、实用的测量手段仍然有限，缺乏可在真实世界中对水合状态变化进行无创、便捷追踪的方案。
AI.method: 以斋戒（Ramadan fasting）作为长时间液体戒断的模型，构建三层验证框架考察面部视频衍生评分在斋戒期（饮水前）与补水后状态间的变化方向：主队列104人、208段视频；嵌套体重亚组20人用于确认液体摄入；嵌套血清渗透压亚组10人用于探索性生物学验证；另设探索性二次比较，考察水与电解质补水方案的短期评分变化差异。
AI.result: 主队列评分由36.6升至70.6（变化+33.9，95% CI [+30.7,+37.1]，p<0.001，Cohen's d=2.03），102/104（98.1%）参与者呈上升变化；体重亚组饮水后体重增加+0.74 kg（p<0.001）；血清渗透压亚组下降-5.1 mOsm/kg（p<0.001），且饮水后数值均处于正常临床范围；水与电解质补水的短期评分变化差异无统计学意义（p=0.247）。
AI.conclusion: 本研究不构成脱水的临床诊断检验，但支持该面部视频评分作为生活方式数字生物标志物，用于在真实世界场景中追踪水合状态变化的方向；其效应量大、个体一致性强，并具备初步的物理与生物学锚定，后续需在更广人群与场景中进一步验证。

title: RSI-PDEbench: A Benchmark for Self-Improving Agents in PDE Solving
summary: Identifying and solving partial differential equations (PDEs) from sampled solution data often requires substantial expert effort in equation discovery, coefficient estimation, and numerical solver configuration, especially under noise and distribution shifts. Can large language model (LLM) agents automate this workflow accurately and efficiently? To investigate this question, we introduce \bench{}, a benchmark of 1,001 cases spanning 42 equation templates, including both classical and fractional PDEs. It provides three evaluation settings: Full evaluates performance on noise-free solution data; Noisy tests robustness to Gaussian noise with an RMS equal to 50\% of the clean-signal RMS; and Hard-OOD tests challenging out-of-distribution generalization to unseen equation templates and shifted coefficient ranges. We further introduce RSI-PDE, a recursively self-improving agent harness that shortlists candidate equations by residual loss, uses relative $L^2$ feedback to refine coefficients and numerical solvers, and applies a validation gate to policy and memory updates. We compare RSI-PDE with single-run baselines and native agent harnesses (Claude Code or Codex) across four frontier models. Across the three settings, RSI-PDE improves the pass rate averaged across the four models by 106.5--181.9\% relative to single-run baselines and by 3.0--19.6\% relative to native harnesses, while reducing total recorded model calls by 46.9\% across the 12 model--setting pairs. These results highlight the potential of validated recursive self-improvement in LLM agents to advance scientific computing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PDE基准测试bench（1,001个案例、42个方程模板，含经典与分数阶PDE）及递归自改进型LLM智能体框架RSI-PDE，在Full、Noisy（50% RMS高斯噪声）和Hard-OOD三种设置下评测四个前沿模型，RSI-PDE相较单次运行基线通过率提升106.5–181.9%，相较原生智能体框架提升3.0–19.6%，同时模型调用次数减少46.9%。
AI.motivation: 从采样解数据中识别并求解偏微分方程（方程发现、系数估计、数值求解器配置）通常依赖大量专家工作，且在噪声与分布偏移下尤为困难。作者希望验证LLM智能体能否准确、高效地自动化这一流程，而现有工作缺乏统一、含噪声与分布外泛化的系统性基准。
AI.method: 1) 构建基准bench：1,001个案例、42个方程模板，覆盖经典与分数阶PDE，设三种评估设置——Full（无噪声数据）、Noisy（高斯噪声RMS为干净信号RMS的50%）、Hard-OOD（未见方程模板与偏移系数范围的分布外泛化）；2) 提出RSI-PDE智能体框架：按残差损失筛选候选方程，利用相对L²反馈迭代精炼系数与数值求解器，并通过验证门控约束策略与记忆更新；3) 在四个前沿模型上，与单次运行基线及原生智能体框架（Claude Code、Codex）对比，共12个模型–设置组合。
AI.result: 在三种设置下，RSI-PDE相对单次运行基线将四模型平均通过率提升106.5–181.9%，相对原生智能体框架提升3.0–19.6%；同时，12个模型–设置组合记录的模型调用总次数减少46.9%。
AI.conclusion: 经验证的递归自改进机制可显著提升LLM智能体在PDE发现与求解任务上的准确性与调用效率，并具备对噪声和分布偏移的鲁棒性，展示了其在科学计算自动化中的潜力。

title: Epigraph Form Reinforcement Learning-based Safe Trajectory Tracking Control for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Safe trajectory tracking (STT) aims to enable autonomous vehicles to follow a reference trajectory accurately while avoiding collisions. This problem is particularly challenging for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) in highly dynamic environments. Existing non-learning-based STT methods often use simplified vehicle and interaction models to meet real-time requirements, which may result in suboptimal tracking accuracy. Although Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) can help address this limitation, widely used Lagrangian DRL methods often suffer from unstable training because increasing Lagrange multipliers amplify policy-gradient magnitudes. To address these issues, we propose a novel reinforcement learning framework for STT, called STT Control Epigraph Form RL (STTC-EFRL). In this framework, the STT problem is formulated as an epigraph-form min-max optimization problem. Based on this formulation, we develop a learning mechanism that uses a decreasing scalar related to the epigraph to adjust the policy gradient descent direction without increasing the gradient magnitude, thereby improving training stability. We also develop a computationally efficient ray-casting method to compute a polyhedron scaling factor for safety quantification. Experimental results, including Vehicle-in-the-Loop tests, show that STTC-EFRL achieves higher tracking accuracy than the considered non-learning-based baseline and more stable training than widely used Lagrangian DRL methods, while satisfying safety requirements in connected environments.

AI.tldr: 提出STTC-EFRL框架，将安全轨迹跟踪问题建模为上图形式（epigraph-form）min-max优化，用递减标量调整策略梯度方向而非增大梯度幅值，提升训练稳定性，并用射线投射法量化安全。
AI.motivation: CAV在高动态环境中的安全轨迹跟踪（STT）难度大：非学习方法依赖简化车辆与交互模型以满足实时性，跟踪精度次优；而主流拉格朗日DRL方法因拉格朗日乘子增大导致策略梯度幅值放大，训练不稳定。
AI.method: 将STT问题表述为epigraph形式的min-max优化问题；据此设计学习机制，利用与epigraph相关的递减标量调整策略梯度下降方向而不增加梯度幅值；并提出计算高效的射线投射（ray-casting）方法求多面体缩放因子以量化安全性。
AI.result: 实验（含Vehicle-in-the-Loop测试）表明：跟踪精度高于所比较的非学习基线；训练稳定性优于常用拉格朗日DRL方法；在联网环境下满足安全约束。
AI.conclusion: STTC-EFRL通过epigraph形式重述与梯度方向调控，兼顾了跟踪精度、训练稳定性与安全性，为CAV安全轨迹跟踪提供了一种可行的强化学习方案。

title: Autonomous Trail Racing with a Bicycle Robot
comment: 35 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables (incl. appendix with supplementary figures and tables). Submitted to The International Journal of Robotics Research. Project page: https://pages.rai-inst.com/autonomous-trail-racing/. Code: https://github.com/rai-opensource/sem_map
summary: Navigating off-road trails on a mountain bike requires diverse locomotion skills, including aerial maneuvers, cornering, and slip recovery, paired with sophisticated perception for scene understanding. Translating these capabilities to autonomous, two-wheeled robots remains a formidable challenge. We show that autonomous, high-speed trail navigation can be achieved through a single idea: encoding the trail as a semantic layer of the terrain. In simulation, this layer embeds the navigation task into the training environment; during deployment, it is reconstructed onboard from camera and LiDAR data. First, we introduce a unified learning framework that treats local navigation and locomotion as a joint optimization problem, bypassing the twist or pose command interface of classical control hierarchies. With fixed reward weights, the same framework produces both trail racing and agile parkour, shaped only through terrain semantics and episode length. Second, our perception pipeline combines a frozen vision foundation model with a lightweight dual-head decoder that predicts per-pixel terrain semantics and confidence scores, which are fused with LiDAR range measurements into an egocentric semantic elevation map at 30 Hz onboard an NVIDIA AGX Orin. We validate our framework on the Ultra Mobility Vehicle (UMV), a bicycle robot that autonomously raced across all sections of a kilometer-long, unstructured mountain bike trail at speeds exceeding 5 m/s and averaging 3.26 m/s. In simulation, our policy fails up to an order of magnitude less often than hierarchical baselines while driving faster.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"将赛道编码为地形语义层"这一核心思路，实现自主两轮机器人在非结构化山地自行车道上的高速越野导航：训练时将语义层嵌入仿真环境构建联合运动与导航任务，部署时由机载相机与LiDAR重建该层，UMV自行车机器人在1公里赛道上均速3.26 m/s、峰值超5 m/s完成全程自主骑行。
AI.motivation: 两轮机器人高速越野需同时具备空中机动、过弯、打滑恢复等多样运动技能与精细场景感知，将其迁移到自主两轮机器人上仍是难题；传统分层控制中"twist/pose指令接口"割裂了导航与运动，且奖励设计难以复用。
AI.method: 1）统一学习框架：将局部导航与运动控制作为联合优化问题，绕开经典分层控制的指令接口，固定奖励权重下仅通过地形语义与episode长度即可分别产生越野竞速与敏捷跑酷行为；2）感知管线：冻结的视觉基础模型 + 轻量双头解码器，输出逐像素地形语义与置信度，与LiDAR测距融合为自中心语义高程图，在NVIDIA AGX Orin上以30 Hz机载运行。
AI.result: UMV自行车机器人在1公里非结构化山地自行车道上全程自主竞速，速度超5 m/s，均速3.26 m/s；仿真中相比分层基线失败率降低最多一个数量级，且行驶速度更快。
AI.conclusion: 把赛道作为地形语义层统一训练与部署，可有效弥合仿真训练与真实部署的鸿沟，并以单一框架覆盖导航与运动的联合优化，为高速两轮自主越野提供可行范式。

title: Agreement Is Not Assurance: Evidence-Independent Safety Gates for Agentic AI in DER-Rich Distribution Grids
summary: Physics-based safety gates for large language model (LLM) agents can approve unsafe actions when the agent and gate rely on the same corrupted measurements or network records. We formulate this shared-evidence failure for voltage-constrained distributed energy resource (DER) export decisions and analyze how nearly critical DER telemetry can bias state estimation while evading residual-based bad-data detection. We propose evidence-independent verification (EIV), which combines advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) voltage readings, measurement selection based on predicted voltage rise, and bounded physical probes. An IEEE 123-bus hidden-truth testbed evaluates 1,654 near-limit requests under telemetry attacks and record errors. For telemetry attacks targeting the nominal gate, an AC-twin gate with bad-data detection approved 95% of unsafe requests, compared with 3.1% for EIV; EIV rejected 22% of safe clean requests. At matched false-rejection settings, direct AMI checks outperformed incorporating the same readings into state estimation. Gate-targeted attacks exposed a vulnerability in telemetry-based response prediction. Command-based prediction removed that route, but targeted attacks on fresh validation cases still produced a 20% unsafe-approval rate under the tested attack pool. LLM agents frequently sought independent evidence voluntarily, but injected instructions and phase-label errors caused unsafe decisions. When offered the EIV checker as a tool, they used it in 93-100% of episodes; mandatory use did not reduce observed violations, which primarily reflected checker errors. These results distinguish enforcement of verification from reliability of the verifier itself.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并分析LLM智能体安全门控中的“共享证据失效”问题：当智能体与门控依赖同一被污染的量测/网络记录时，物理安全门控会误批不安全动作。作者提出证据独立验证(EIV)——融合AMI电压读数、基于预测电压升的测量选择与有界物理探针，在IEEE 123节点隐藏真值测试床上验证其显著优于AC孪生门控。
AI.motivation: 基于物理的安全门控与LLM智能体若共用同一套（可能被污染或记录错误的）量测，则残余类不良数据检测难以发现“准临界”DER遥测偏置，从而在电压约束的DER出力决策中放行不安全请求，形成共享证据失效。
AI.method: 将共享证据失效能形式化于电压约束的分布式能源(DER)外送决策；提出EIV，独立使用AMI电压读数、按预测电压升进行测量选择，并引入有界物理探针；在IEEE 123节点隐藏真值测试台上，对遥测攻击与记录错误下的1,654个近限请求进行评估，并对比AC孪生门控与不良数据检测、基于遥测的响应预测、指令式预测、以及LLM智能体主动/被动使用EIV检查器的行为。
AI.result: 针对标称门控的遥测攻击下，带不良数据检测的AC孪生门控批准了95%的不安全请求，EIV仅3.1%；EIV对干净安全请求的误拒为22%。在同等误拒设置下，直接AMI校验优于将同样读数纳入状态估计。门控定向攻击暴露了基于遥测的响应预测漏洞；改为指令式预测可消除该路径，但对全新验证样本的定向攻击仍产生20%的不安全批准率。LLM智能体常自愿寻求独立证据，但注入指令与相别标签错误会导致不安全决策；提供EIV检查器工具后使用率达93–100%，强制使用并未降低观测违规，违规主要源于检查器自身误差。
AI.conclusion: 共享证据是物理安全门控的根本性失效模式，证据独立性比检测器灵敏度更关键；同时须区分“验证的强制执行”与“验证器本身的可靠性”——工具使用率高不等于安全性提升，还需提升验证器精度并防范指令注入与标签错误。

title: Federated Class Incremental Learning: A Pseudo Feature Based Approach Without Exemplars
summary: Federated learning often assumes that data is fixed in advance, which is unrealistic in many real-world scenarios where new data continuously arrives, causing catastrophic forgetting. To address this challenge, we propose FCLPF (Federated Class Incremental Learning with Pseudo Features), a method that uses pseudo features generated from prototypes to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. Our approach reduces communication costs and improves efficiency by eliminating the need for past data and avoiding computationally heavy models like GANs. Experimental results on CIFAR-100 show that FCLPF achieves an average accuracy of 51.87% and an average forgetting of 9.62%, significantly outperforming existing baselines with an average accuracy of 47.72% and forgetting of 20.46%. On TinyImageNet, FCLPF achieves 37.56% accuracy and 3.14% forgetting, compared to the baselines' 27.69% accuracy and 24.46% forgetting, demonstrating the superior performance of FCLPF.

AI.tldr: 提出FCLPF方法，利用从原型生成的伪特征来缓解联邦类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘，无需保存历史数据或使用GAN，在CIFAR-100和TinyImageNet上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习通常假设数据预先固定，但现实中数据持续到达，导致模型出现灾难性遗忘；同时保存历史数据与使用GAN类重型生成模型会带来隐私、通信成本与计算开销问题。
AI.method: FCLPF（Federated Class Incremental Learning with Pseudo Features）：基于类原型生成伪特征以回放/正则化旧类知识，从而在不存储过去数据、不依赖GAN的前提下抑制灾难性遗忘，并降低通信成本、提升效率。
AI.conclusion: 原型驱动的伪特征是一种轻量、低成本且有效的联邦类增量学习抗遗忘方案，在两个基准上同时取得更高的准确率与更低的遗忘率，验证了其优越性。

title: Termination Lag: Coding Agents Solve Early but Stop Late
summary: Coding agents can solve a task well before they stop working on it. We characterize \emph{termination lag}--the number of steps between an agent's first correct patch and the end of its run--across five models, two agent frameworks, and three SWE-bench datasets by recording and testing every distinct repository patch generated during execution. Our analysis reveals that 38--82% of successful runs achieve a correct solution on their initial source-code edit. However, agents continue to expend substantial effort after correct patches, with post-solution steps accounting for a median of 35--37% for Qwen3-Coder and 54--60% for Laguna-XS.2 in successful runs on SWE-bench Verified and Multilingual. Agents spend most of these additional steps verifying their work and exploring the repository. In a small fraction of cases (1--8%), this continued activity leads agents to undo their earlier correct patch, leaving the final solution incorrect.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并刻画"终止滞后"（termination lag）现象：编码智能体往往在首次给出正确补丁后仍继续运行大量步数，其中位占比在成功运行中达35%–60%，且1%–8%的案例会因此把已正确的补丁改坏。
AI.motivation: 现有评测只看最终补丁是否正确，忽略了智能体在求解过程中的终止行为。作者希望揭示"智能体早就能解出任务却不停手"这一效率与可靠性问题，量化正确解出现之后的多余开销及其风险。
AI.method: 定义termination lag为"首次出现正确补丁"到"本次运行结束"之间的步数；对执行过程中产生的每一个不同的仓库补丁进行记录与测试，从而定位首次正确补丁；在5个模型、2个智能体框架、3个SWE-bench数据集上进行系统测量，并统计成功运行中的后解步数占比及其行为构成。
AI.result: 38%–82%的成功运行在首次源代码编辑时即得到正确解；但智能体在正确补丁后仍消耗大量步数，后解步数中位数占成功运行总步数的35%–37%（Qwen3-Coder）与54%–60%（Laguna-XS.2，SWE-bench Verified与Multilingual）；这些额外步数主要用于验证工作与仓库探索；有1%–8%的案例因此撤销了先前正确补丁，最终解变为错误。
AI.conclusion: 编码智能体的终止决策本身是独立于求解能力的瓶颈：多数任务在极早期即被解决，但智能体缺乏有效停止机制，既造成算力与步数浪费，也带来把正确解改坏的风险。这提示需引入基于补丁置信度或验证信号的提前终止策略。

title: Rethinking "RL Generalizes, SFT Memorizes": The Role of SFT Data
summary: Large language models trained with Reinforcement Learning (RL) with verifiable rewards exhibit strong reasoning ability and broad generalization, whereas models trained with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) are often viewed as more prone to memorization and limited transfer. This paper rethinks this distinction through the lens of SFT training data on widely used Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 series models. First, we study the role of data source and show that it is critical: a carefully mixed SFT dataset substantially outperforms data generated solely by a larger model. Second, we study the role of data scale and show that matching the number of correct rollouts between SFT and RL greatly improves SFT generalization, while matching the total rollout budget enables SFT to generalize as well as RL. Combining these two factors further enables SFT to generalize even better than RL. Third, by using LLM annotations to characterize the solution methods in training rollouts, we show that larger datasets cover more tail methods and that these tail methods provide generalizable reasoning signals. Finally, we support these empirical findings theoretically by analyzing the training dynamics of shallow transformers under both RL and SFT.

AI.tldr: 本文从SFT训练数据（来源与规模）视角重新审视"RL泛化强、SFT易记忆"的流行观点，发现在Qwen2.5/Qwen3系列上，合理混合的数据来源与匹配rollout预算可使SFT的泛化能力达到甚至超过RL，并从数据覆盖"尾部解法"及浅层Transformer训练动力学的理论分析给出解释。
AI.motivation: 已有认知认为基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）训练的LLM具备强推理与广泛化能力，而监督微调（SFT）易记忆、迁移差。作者质疑这一区分是否源于训练数据本身（数据来源与规模）的差异，而非训练范式本身，因此从SFT数据角度重新检验该二分法。
AI.method: 以Qwen2.5与Qwen3系列模型为对象开展受控实证：(1) 考察数据来源，比较精心混合的SFT数据集与仅由更大模型生成的数据；(2) 考察数据规模，分别匹配SFT与RL的正确rollout数量、以及总rollout预算；(3) 用LLM标注刻画训练rollout中的解题方法分布，检验尾部方法的覆盖与泛化信号；(4) 在浅层Transformer上分析RL与SFT的训练动力学，为实证结论提供理论支撑。
AI.result: 数据来源关键：精心混合的SFT数据集显著优于单一由更大模型生成的数据。数据规模关键：匹配正确rollout数量可大幅提升SFT泛化；匹配总rollout预算可令SFT泛化与RL持平；两者结合后SFT泛化甚至优于RL。机制上，更大数据集覆盖更多"尾部解法"，且这些尾部方法提供可泛化的推理信号。理论分析在浅层Transformer上印证了上述经验发现。
AI.conclusion: SFT与RL的泛化差距在很大程度上可由训练数据的来源与rollout预算差异解释，而非范式固有属性；当数据混合得当且预算匹配时，SFT可达到乃至超越RL的泛化表现。尾部解法的覆盖是泛化的关键机制，提示应以数据为中心重新设计SFT与RL的训练策略。

title: APG-Planner: Learning Vision-Based High-Speed Trajectory Planning via Analytic Policy Gradient
summary: Vision-based high-speed navigation requires a trajectory planner that can reactively generate smooth, collision-free trajectories from onboard visual observations. Deep reinforcement learning offers a promising approach to vision-based trajectory planning, as it enables the optimization of sequential decision-making policies in complex environments. However, model-free policy gradient methods rely on sample-based policy gradient estimation, which yields noisy gradient estimates and inefficient training. To this end, we propose a framework for learning trajectory planning policies using the analytic policy gradient (APG) method and use it to train APG-Planner, a vision-based high-speed trajectory planner. The proposed framework leverages differential flatness to analytically reconstruct vehicle states from planned trajectories, thereby enabling differentiable trajectory-level state transitions without requiring an explicit low-level dynamics model. By iteratively performing trajectory planning and differentiable state transitions, we construct a differentiable episode rollout and analytically compute policy gradients from episode-level losses, improving both training efficiency and policy performance. After approximately 30 minutes of training on a single GPU, APG-Planner demonstrates comparable or superior performance to existing baseline methods in simulation and achieves speeds of up to 11\,m/s in real-world flight experiments. We further validate the proposed framework on a skid-steer ground robot, demonstrating its applicability to differentially flat robotic systems beyond quadrotors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于解析策略梯度(APG)的视觉高速轨迹规划框架，训练出 APG-Planner；利用微分平坦性构造可微的回合展开，避免显式低层动力学模型，单GPU约30分钟训练即在仿真中达到与基线相当或更优的性能，并在真机实现最高11 m/s飞行，还验证于滑移转向地面机器人。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的高速导航需要能依据机载视觉观测实时生成平滑、无碰撞轨迹的规划器。深度强化学习适合此类序贯决策优化，但无模型策略梯度方法依赖基于采样的梯度估计，梯度噪声大、训练效率低。
AI.method: 提出用解析策略梯度(APG)学习轨迹规划策略的框架。该框架借助微分平坦性从规划轨迹解析重构飞行器状态，从而在无需显式低层动力学模型的情况下实现轨迹级可微状态转移；通过迭代执行轨迹规划与可微状态转移，构建可微的回合(episode)展开，并由回合级损失解析计算策略梯度。据此训练出视觉轨迹规划器 APG-Planner。
AI.result: 单块 GPU 上约30分钟训练后，APG-Planner 在仿真中性能与现有基线方法相当或更优，真机飞行实验速度最高达11 m/s；并在滑移转向地面机器人上验证了框架对四旋翼之外其他微分平坦机器人系统的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 解析策略梯度结合微分平坦性可有效缓解无模型策略梯度的噪声与低效问题，兼顾训练效率与策略性能；该框架具有跨平台（空中与地面微分平坦系统）的通用性，为视觉高速自主导航提供了一种高效可微的规划学习范式。

title: Planning-Stage Assessment of Battery-Supported Regional Islanding: A South Australian Case Study
summary: Power systems with high shares of renewable generation may face increased operational vulnerability under regional islanding caused by the loss of major inter-area transmission interfaces. This paper presents a planning-stage transmission-level assessment of regional islanding with battery storage, using a South Australian case study based on a synthetic representation of the Australian National Electricity Market (NEM). An interconnected planning baseline is compared with a stress test scenario involving complete regional-islanding over a 24-hour chronological horizon. The framework quantifies peak unserved power, total unserved energy, and the duration of unserved demand, while characterising battery redispatch and the synchronous inertia accessible to the subsystem.

AI.tldr: 在高比例可再生能源电力系统中，本文以基于澳大利亚国家电力市场（NEM）合成表示的南澳为案例，开展规划阶段的输电网级区域孤岛评估，比较互联基线场景与24小时时序全域孤岛压力测试场景，量化峰值失供功率、总失供电量及失供持续时间，并刻画储能电池再调度与子系统可获取的同步惯量。
AI.motivation: 高比例可再生能源系统在失去主要跨区输电断面后可能形成区域孤岛，运行脆弱性上升；需要在规划阶段评估储能电池支撑孤岛运行的能力与失供风险。
AI.method: 采用基于NEM合成表示的南澳案例，构建规划阶段输电网级评估框架：设置互联规划基线场景与完整区域孤岛压力测试场景，在24小时时序尺度上进行仿真，量化失供指标并分析电池再调度与同步惯量。
AI.result: 框架给出峰值失供功率、总失供电量与失供需求持续时间三类指标，并刻画孤岛子系统中电池再调度行为及可获取的同步惯量水平，实现基线场景与孤岛压力场景的对比。
AI.conclusion: 规划阶段应显式考虑跨区断面失效引发的区域孤岛风险，并将储能电池与同步惯量可得性纳入评估，以支撑高可再生能源系统的韧性规划。

title: Back to the Question: Tracing Visual Distraction Through Text Tokens
summary: The visual world is cluttered: robust vision-language reasoning requires ignoring irrelevant information. Yet vision-language models (VLMs) can suffer substantial accuracy losses when answering questions about a target image with distractors present. Existing mitigations focus on selecting relevant images or limiting information exchange between images. Through a systematic analysis of three open 7-8B VLMs on five perception benchmarks adapted to include distractor images, we show that distractors reduce accuracy even when models correctly identify the relevant image, suggesting that selection alone is not enough. To understand the mechanism behind this interference, we combine attention analysis with targeted knockouts in Qwen2.5-VL and identify middle-layer distractor-to-text connections as a pathway through which irrelevant visual information affects reasoning. We introduce answer consistency regularization, which encourages consistent answer distributions with and without distractors. Without directly constraining attention, this objective reduces middle-layer attention from question tokens to distractor images, consistent with the pathway our analysis implicates. With five distractors, our approach improves circular accuracy by an average of 16 percentage points over the Qwen2.5-VL baseline across the five benchmarks while preserving single-image performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统分析了视觉干扰对7-8B视觉语言模型（VLM）的影响，发现即使模型正确选中相关图像，干扰图仍会造成精度下降；作者定位到中间层的"干扰图→文本"连接通路，并提出答案一致性正则化，在无干扰与有干扰条件下对齐答案分布。五个基准、五个干扰图设置下，循环精度平均提升16个百分点，且不损害单图性能。
AI.motivation: 现实视觉场景高度杂乱，鲁棒的视觉语言推理需忽略无关信息。现有VLM在多图输入含干扰图时精度显著下降；已有缓解方法集中于"选取相关图像"或"限制图像间信息交换"，但作者怀疑这类方法不足，需要验证干扰是否在选中正确图像后依然存在，并揭示其内部机制。
AI.method: (1) 在五个改写为含干扰图的感知基准上，系统评测三个开源7-8B VLM，检验"正确选中相关图像时干扰效应是否仍存在"；(2) 结合注意力分析与Qwen2.5-VL中的定向敲除（targeted knockouts），定位干扰信息影响推理的通路；(3) 提出答案一致性正则化（answer consistency regularization），约束有/无干扰条件下答案分布一致，不直接约束注意力。
AI.result: 干扰图在模型已正确识别相关图像的情况下仍降低准确率，说明仅靠图像选择不够。分析确定中间层的distractor-to-text连接是无关视觉信息影响推理的通路。答案一致性正则化在不显式约束注意力的情况下，降低了中间层从问题token到干扰图的注意力，与分析所揭示的通路一致。在五个基准、五个干扰图设置下，循环精度较Qwen2.5-VL基线平均提升16个百分点，同时保持单图性能。
AI.conclusion: 干扰并非主要源于图像选择失败，而是通过中间层干扰图到文本的深层连接渗入推理；通过输出层面对齐（答案一致性）即可间接抑制该通路，是一种无需注意力干预、简单有效的鲁棒性增强方案。

title: Early Signals, Strong Decisions: Prefix-Guided Sampling for Parallel Test-Time Scaling
summary: Parallel test-time scaling (TTS) has been shown to enhance reasoning in large language models by generating and aggregating multiple independent reasoning paths. Internal confidence scores can further improve this process by identifying paths of varying quality. However, existing methods remain computationally inefficient, as low-quality paths are fully expanded before being evaluated. In this work, we aim to improve the use of internal confidence signals for better model performance and computational efficiency. We begin by offering a new perspective on the role of confidence in aggregation, showing that it is most impactful for questions near the decision boundary. Notably, when amplified by multi-sample aggregation, even small confidence signals derived from short prefixes can meaningfully influence outcomes in these boundary cases. Building on this insight, we introduce Prefix-Guided Sampling (PreG), a method that reallocates computation by first generating short prefixes, ranking them using internal confidence scores, and then completing only the most promising candidates. This strategy reduces token usage while maintaining gains in path quality. We provide theoretical analysis demonstrating that, under a fixed compute budget, PreG strengthens the effective signal by widening the decision boundary margin. Empirically, our method consistently outperforms standard parallel TTS approaches across benchmarks, while significantly improving token efficiency and reducing overall computation.

AI.tldr: 提出Prefix-Guided Sampling（PreG）：先生成短前缀并用内部置信度排序，仅完整展开最有希望的候选，从而在并行测试时扩展中提升路径质量与token效率。
AI.motivation: 并行测试时扩展（TTS）通过生成并聚合多条独立推理路径提升大模型推理能力，内部置信度可用于区分路径质量。但现有方法计算低效：低质量路径在被评估前已被完整展开，浪费大量token。
AI.method: 首先给出关于置信度在聚合中作用的新视角：置信度对接近决策边界的题目影响最大，且在多样本聚合放大下，来自短前缀的微弱置信信号也能显著影响边界样本的结果。据此提出PreG：先并行生成短前缀，用内部置信度对其排序，仅对最有前景的候选进行补全，从而重新分配计算预算。并给出理论分析。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，在固定计算预算下PreG通过扩大决策边界间隔增强有效信号；实验上在多个基准上一致优于标准并行TTS方法，同时显著提升token效率、降低总体计算量。
AI.conclusion: 内部置信度信号可用于早期筛选而非事后聚合，前缀级排序+选择性补全是兼顾性能与效率的有效并行TTS策略。

title: A Transferable Pretrained 3D Model for Impedance Inversion with Sparse-Well Prior Conditioning
summary: Deep-learning-based seismic impedance inversion commonly requires retraining for each target survey, which may generalize poorly beyond the conditioning locations when well control is extremely sparse. We propose a transferable three-dimensional inversion framework that separates offline learning from target-survey deployment. A masked autoencoder first learns seismic structural representations from unlabeled multi-survey data, after which the frozen encoder is incorporated into an inversion network trained on synthetic geological models with sparse-well-derived low-frequency priors. During deployment, the complete inversion network remains fixed; the available conditioning well is used only to construct the low-frequency prior and align the global impedance range. Experiments on the Overthrust model show that the proposed method achieves the lowest full-volume NRMSE and reduces the P95 trace-wise NRMSE from 0.1310 to 0.1074 relative to the best target-trained baseline, indicating fewer localized large errors under different well locations.
