In a field survey with one conditioning well and three blind wells, it reduces the mean blind-well NRMSE by 20.95% relative to the target-trained U-Net while maintaining the highest correlation. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework transfers useful impedance information beyond the conditioning location with low deployment cost and without retraining the inversion network.

AI.tldr: 提出可迁移三维地震波阻抗反演框架：掩码自编码器在多工区无标签数据上预训练结构表征并冻结，仅用目标工区一口井构造低频先验与振幅对齐，无需重训练即可泛化到井旁以外区域。
AI.motivation: 深度学习波阻抗反演通常需针对每个目标工区重新训练，且在井控极稀疏时难以泛化到条件井以外的位置。目标是降低部署成本并提升稀疏井条件下的空间泛化能力。
AI.method: 分为离线学习与目标工区部署两阶段：1) 掩码自编码器（MAE）在无标签多工区地震数据上自监督学习地震结构表征；2) 将冻结的编码器嵌入反演网络，并用合成地质模型及稀疏井导出的低频先验进行训练；3) 部署时整个反演网络保持固定，仅利用可用条件井构建低频先验并做全局阻抗范围对齐。
AI.result: Overthrust模型实验中，方法取得最低的全数据体NRMSE，并将逐道NRMSE的P95由基线最优的0.1310降至0.1074，说明不同井位下局部大误差更少；实际工区（1口条件井、3口盲井）中，盲井平均NRMSE较目标工区训练的U-Net降低20.95%，同时保持最高相关系数。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够在低部署成本、不重训练反演网络的条件下，将有效阻抗信息迁移至条件井以外位置，验证了跨工区迁移三维波阻抗反演的可行性。

title: BiPOP: Partial-Order Planning for Long-Horizon Bimanual Robotic Manipulation
summary: Bimanual robotic manipulation is versatile, yet its central challenge lies not only in executing dexterous motion with each hand, but also in coordinating the two arms for long-horizon manipulation under coupled spatial and temporal constraints. Prior work has largely focused on endowing robots with human-level manipulation skills, paying less attention to the structure of bimanual behaviour itself: many practical tasks are a coordinated composition of reusable unimanual skills and a small set of synchronous bimanual skills. This makes high-level spatio-temporal coordination, rather than skill acquisition alone, a key bottleneck for efficient bimanual execution. We propose BiPOP, a framework that couples Large Language Models (LLMs) with Temporal Partial-Order Planning for long-horizon bimanual manipulation. At its core is an explicit spatio-temporal model that partitions the workspace by arm reachability and captures inter-arm dependencies, arm assignment, synchronization requirements, and opportunities for safe concurrent execution. Building on this model, an LLM translates natural-language instructions into a formal PDDL specification, while a temporal planner enforces the constraints and schedules actions, yielding plans that are logically consistent at the symbolic level and efficient through parallel execution. On simulated long-horizon tasks of varying complexity, BiPOP outperforms open-loop planning with strong reasoning models and closed-loop ReAct-style planning in success rate, planning time, and plan efficiency, and the full pipeline runs end to end on the real bimanual robot NICOL. A failure analysis further shows that LLM-only planners mainly violate spatial and temporal coordination constraints, which motivates delegating these constraints to a symbolic planner. Code: https://github.com/Kchu/BiPOP

AI.tldr: BiPOP结合LLM与时间偏序规划（TPOP），通过显式时空模型（按臂可达性划分工作空间、刻画臂间依赖、臂分配与同步约束）将自然语言指令转为PDDL并由时间规划器调度，在仿真长程任务中成功率、规划时间与规划效率均优于强推理模型开环规划及ReAct闭环规划，并在真实双臂机器人NICOL上端到端运行。
AI.motivation: 双臂操作的核心难点不仅是单手灵巧运动，更是双臂在耦合的时空约束下完成长程协调。已有工作多聚焦于赋予机器人人类级操作技能，而忽视了双臂行为本身的结构：许多实际任务只是可复用单手技能与少量同步双臂技能的组合。因此高层时空协调（而非单纯技能获取）成为高效双臂执行的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出BiPOP框架：核心是显式时空模型，按手臂可达性划分工作空间，并刻画臂间依赖、手臂分配、同步需求与安全并发执行机会；在此基础上，LLM将自然语言指令翻译为形式化PDDL规范，再由时间规划器施加约束并调度动作，产生符号层逻辑一致且可并行执行的高效方案。
AI.result: 在不同复杂度的仿真长程任务上，BiPOP在成功率、规划时间和规划效率方面均优于强推理模型的开环规划与ReAct式闭环规划；完整流程在真实双臂机器人NICOL上端到端运行。失败分析表明，仅用LLM的规划器主要违反空间与时间协调约束，这印证了将此类约束交由符号规划器处理的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 双臂长程操作的关键瓶颈在于高层时空协调；将LLM的语义理解能力与符号时间规划器的约束推理能力解耦并耦合，可显著提升规划的可靠性、效率与可并行性，且方法具备真机可部署性。

title: SLyM: LLM-Driven Symbolic Lyapunov Function Discovery via Structure Proposal and Coefficient Optimization
summary: Lyapunov functions are the cornerstone of stability analysis for dynamical systems, yet synthesizing a symbolic form remains difficult as no universal constructive algorithm exists. To address this challenge, we introduce SLyM, a framework that harnesses the knowledge and reasoning of large language models (LLMs) to discover symbolic Lyapunov functions. To avoid charging the LLM with ill-suited numerical generation, SLyM decomposes the construction into structure proposal and coefficient optimization: the LLM draws on its prior knowledge of Lyapunov constructions to propose the function structure, whose coefficients then follow from a convex program. Local-search structures are folded back into supervision, extending coverage to systems missed by the initial proposer. Across all benchmarks, SLyM consistently outperforms the evaluated neural, sum-of-squares, and generative baselines.

AI.tldr: SLyM利用大语言模型的先验知识与推理能力发现符号化Lyapunov函数，将构造分解为"结构提议+系数优化"，并以局部搜索结构回灌监督扩展覆盖面，在全部基准上优于神经、平方和及生成式基线。
AI.motivation: Lyapunov函数是动力系统稳定性分析的基石，但其符号形式的自动合成缺乏通用构造性算法，是长期难题。同时，直接让LLM进行数值生成并不合适，需要一种能扬长避短的框架。
AI.method: 提出SLyM框架：将Lyapunov函数构造分解为两步——由LLM依据其关于Lyapunov构造的先验知识提议函数结构；系数则通过凸优化程序求解，避免LLM承担不擅长的数值生成。此外，将局部搜索得到的结构折回监督信号，以覆盖初始提议器遗漏的系统。
AI.result: 在所有基准测试中，SLyM一致优于所评估的神经方法、平方和（SOS）方法及生成式基线。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM的符号结构提议能力与凸优化的系数求解相结合，是符号Lyapunov函数合成的有效范式；结构回灌监督进一步提升了覆盖范围与整体性能。

title: Estimating Image Creativity
summary: What makes an image creative? Although this may seem like a highly subjective decision, research in psychology suggests that creativity may be based on a set of fundamental creativity dimensions such as novelty, surprise, and arousal. A deeper understanding of image creativity can benefit both research and practical applications. Exploring how human viewers use creativity dimensions to evaluate image creativity may allow us to predict a target image's human-rated creativity automatically. We present a novel framework to estimate the perceived creativity of an image by: (1) predicting the strengths of an image's novelty, surprise, and arousal creativity dimensions, and (2) combining the creativity dimension strengths to estimate an image creativity score. Controlled human-subject experiments were conducted on Amazon Mechanical Turk to collect data to train supervised machine learning models to estimate an image's strengths on the three creativity dimensions. A final machine learning model takes the predicted dimension strengths as input to produce an estimated image creativity score. Results showed that our estimated creativity scores are statistically equivalent to human ratings of creativity for the images we tested. The novel contributions of our research are: (1) identification and validation of three psychological creativity dimensions used to estimate image creativity; (2) supervised machine learning models to automatically estimate novelty, surprise, and arousal strengths for an input image; (3) a supervised machine learning model to predict a creativity score from novelty, surprise, and arousal strengths for an input image, and (4) experimental methods to confirm the accuracy, advantages, and limitations of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出一种两阶段框架：先用监督学习模型预测图像在新颖性、惊异性和唤醒度三个心理学创造力维度上的强度，再将维度强度组合为整体创造力评分，估计值与人工评分在统计上无显著差异。
AI.motivation: 图像创造力评价通常被视为高度主观的判断，但心理学研究表明创造力可由新颖性、惊异性、唤醒度等基本维度构成。深入理解并自动预测人类对图像创造力的评价，对相关研究与实际应用（如创意内容筛选、生成模型评估）均有益处。
AI.method: 构建两阶段框架：(1) 基于Amazon Mechanical Turk的受控人类被试实验采集标注数据，训练监督机器学习模型预测图像在novelty、surprise、arousal三个创造力维度上的强度；(2) 以预测出的维度强度为输入，用另一监督模型输出整体创造力评分。并通过系统实验验证方法的准确性、优势与局限。
AI.result: 所提出的估计创造力得分与人类对测试图像给出的创造力评分在统计上等价，即模型能够复现人类的创造力判断。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别并验证了可用于估计图像创造力的三个心理学维度，提供了三个维度强度及整体创造力得分的自动预测模型，并给出验证方法有效性的实验方案，实现图像创造力的自动化、可解释估计。

title: Same Task, Different Statement: When and How Reformulation Helps LLM Problem Solving
summary: When people face a hard problem, they often restate it in a clearer way before solving it. We study whether the same habit helps large language models by rewriting the statement of a problem. A legal rewrite must keep the meaning, the constraints, and the correct answer unchanged. We test three kinds of rewrites. Decomposition makes hidden subgoals explicit. Typed Reformulation casts the task into a more suitable solving frame. Concept Reduction removes surface detail and exposes the task structure. We evaluate them on eight math, logic, and code benchmarks with eight models, all under the same chain-of-thought solving prompt. The effect is large but depends on the problem type. An oracle that picks the best rewrite after the fact raises accuracy by +27.6% on average. Yet no single rewrite helps every problem, and a mismatched rewrite can hurt. Still, the effect follows clear patterns. Each kind of rewrite fits certain problem types. A simple fixed rule learned from one set of problems transfers part of the gain to new problems. It gains +11.0% on the problems it chooses to rewrite, while blind rewriting loses 5.6% on a similar share of problems. Rewriting is therefore not a universal way to solve problems. The question is when and how to rewrite.

AI.tldr: 受人类"先澄清问题再求解"习惯启发，论文考察用问题重写提升大语言模型推理表现。在8个数学、逻辑、代码基准、8个模型、统一CoT提示下测试分解、类型化重构、概念约简三类重写：事后oracle选取最佳重写平均提升+27.6%，但无单一重写普适，错配重写有害；单一问题集学到的固定规则迁移到新问题，在所选问题上+11.0%，而盲目重写同比例问题损失5.6%。结论：重写的关键不是"是否"而是"何时与如何"。
AI.motivation: 人类面对难题时常先把问题重新表述得更清楚再求解；作者想验证这一习惯能否迁移到大语言模型，即通过重写问题陈述提升推理准确率，并厘清其收益的来源与适用条件。
AI.method: 提出三种受约束的重写类型：Decomposition（显式化隐含子目标）、Typed Reformulation（将任务投射到更合适的求解框架）、Concept Reduction（剥离表层细节以暴露任务结构），要求重写保持语义、约束与正确答案不变。在8个数学、逻辑与代码基准、8个模型上，统一使用相同chain-of-thought求解提示进行评测，并比较oracle事后择优与从单一问题集学得的固定重写规则在新问题上做选择式重写和盲目重写的表现。
AI.result: oracle事后选取最佳重写平均提升+27.6%，效应量显著但依赖问题类型；不存在对所有问题都有效的单一重写，错配重写会带来负收益。各类重写对应特定问题类型，存在清晰规律。由一组问题学到的简单固定规则可部分迁移到新问题：在其选择重写的问题上+11.0%，而盲目重写相似比例的问题则−5.6%。
AI.conclusion: 重写并非普适的解题手段，其收益由问题类型与重写方式的匹配决定；核心研究问题应从"是否重写"转向"何时与如何重写"，即以自适应、有选择的策略替代盲目重写。

title: Binding Mode Matters: Hotspot-Aware Drug Discovery via Explorative Preferences
summary: Discovering hit molecules requires not just high binding affinity, but also the identification of diverse binding modes, which are critical for experimental assays. Existing generative approaches have predominantly relied on optimizing a scalar docking score, obscuring the distinct contributions of key binding determinants. To this end, we introduce a paradigm shift by formulating target-based drug design as a multi-objective exploration task, where each objective explicitly corresponds to enhancing interactions with a specific hotspot. Here, we introduce BindMol, a novel generative framework driven by a customized multi-objective reinforcement learning algorithm. By incorporating explorative preferences during training, our approach efficiently uncovers molecules with diverse and desirable binding profiles. Empirical results demonstrate that BindMol facilitates the discovery of high-affinity compounds characterized by both structural novelty and diverse binding modes. Validated across target-based drug discovery and multi-property optimization tasks, our approach provides a versatile paradigm for goal-oriented drug discovery.

AI.tldr: 将基于靶点的分子设计重构为多目标探索问题，每个目标对应一个热点残基的相互作用，提出多目标强化学习生成框架 BindMol，可生成高亲和力、结构新颖且结合模式多样的分子。
AI.motivation: 现有生成方法多以单一标量对接分数为优化目标，掩盖了各关键结合决定因素（热点相互作用）的独立贡献，难以获得多样的结合模式，而多样性对实验验证至关重要。
AI.method: 把基于靶点的药物设计表述为多目标探索任务，各目标显式对应与特定结合热点的相互作用增强；构建 BindMol 生成框架，由定制化的多目标强化学习算法驱动，并在训练中引入探索性偏好以高效发现具有多样且理想结合谱的分子。
AI.result: 实验表明 BindMol 能够发现兼具高亲和力、结构新颖性与多样结合模式的化合物；在基于靶点的药物发现与多性质优化任务上均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 以多目标视角替代单一标量优化，可为面向目标的药物发现提供通用范式，兼顾亲和力与结合模式多样性。

title: Interactive Perception of Granular Materials via Robotic Scooping and Force-Torque Sensing
summary: Granular materials exhibit complex and highly variable interaction dynamics, making their reliable manipulation challenging without knowledge of their physical properties. We present an interactive perception framework that infers granular material properties directly from force-torque measurements acquired during scooping. The proposed Latent Filter++ combines a bio-inspired frequency-temporal filter-bank representation with a causal latent dynamical model, allowing the representation to evolve as interaction observations become available while avoiding hand-crafted signal preprocessing. The learned latent representation captures physically meaningful variation in granular materials and supports estimation of properties including grain size and bulk density. Evaluated on 26 diverse granular materials, the approach generalizes to materials excluded from training and enables few-shot adaptation of property-specific mappings using a small number of additional interaction samples. Finally, we demonstrate the relevance of the inferred properties to downstream manipulation by examining their correlation with the maximum acceleration the materials can withstand without spilling from the spoon during transport.

AI.tldr: 提出 Latent Filter++ 交互式感知框架，从铲取过程中的力-力矩测量中直接推断颗粒材料属性（粒径、堆积密度），并验证其对下游操作任务的相关性。
AI.motivation: 颗粒材料交互动力学复杂多变，在缺乏其物理属性先验知识的情况下难以实现可靠操作；传统方法依赖手工信号预处理，且属性估计与操作任务脱节。
AI.method: Latent Filter++：将仿生频率-时域滤波器组表征与因果隐动力学模型结合，表征随交互观测逐步演化（在线/因果推断），避免手工信号预处理；学习到的隐表征捕捉颗粒材料的物理有意义变化，并据此估计粒径与堆积密度；支持用少量额外交互样本进行属性专用映射的少样本自适应。
AI.result: 在 26 种多样化颗粒材料上评估：方法可泛化到训练集之外的材料；可用少量交互样本实现少样本属性映射自适应；推断属性与运输过程中材料不从勺中溢出所能承受的最大加速度相关，验证其对下游操作的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 力-力矩信号经因果隐动力学表征可有效推断颗粒材料物理属性，且所推断属性对操作策略（如运输加速度约束）具有直接指导价值，为无先验知识下的颗粒材料操作提供了交互式感知方案。

title: Quantitative Stability Region Estimation of Grid-Forming Inverters with Current Limiting via a State-Dependent Switched Energy Function
summary: With increasing renewable energy integration, grid-forming (GFM) inverters are becoming key components of future power systems. Compared with synchronous generators (SGs), GFM inverters have limited overcurrent capability and require current limiting. This can lead to switching between normal and current-limited operating modes under large disturbances, complicating synchronization dynamics and posing a longstanding challenge to existing transient-stability analysis methods. In this paper, a state-dependent switched (SdS) energy function theory is proposed for transient-stability analysis of GFM inverters with current limiting, whose dynamics can be abstracted as SdS nonlinear systems. Regional energy functions are constructed for individual operating modes and continuously matched at switching interfaces, yielding a continuous piecewise energy function. Hence, the derived conservative estimate of the stability region (region of attraction, ROA) spans different operating regions without prescribing subsequent current limiting activations and releases, a fundamental distinction from conventional methods using signal-mode energy functions. Techniques for incorporating damping energy are extended to the proposed framework to capture damping effects and further reduce the conservatism of the ROA estimates. The methodology applies to GFM inverters with different synchronization control loops and current-limiting strategies. Experiments on a physical GFM inverter under various grid contingencies validate the proposed quantitative transient stability assessment.

AI.tldr: 该文提出状态依赖切换（SdS）能量函数理论，用于含限流环节的构网型（GFM）逆变器暂态稳定分析，构造在切换界面处连续匹配的分段能量函数，从而获得跨越不同运行区域的吸引域（ROA）保守估计。
AI.motivation: GFM逆变器过流能力弱、需限流，大扰动下会在正常运行模式与限流模式间切换，使同步动态复杂化；传统基于单一信号模式能量函数的方法难以刻画切换过程，暂态稳定分析长期存在困难。
AI.method: 将限流GFM逆变器动态抽象为状态依赖切换非线性系统；针对各运行模式分别构造区域能量函数，并在切换界面上连续匹配，得到连续分段能量函数；据此推导跨运行区域的ROA保守估计，且无需预设后续限流的触发与退出时序；并将阻尼能量处理技术推广至该框架以计入阻尼效应、降低保守性。方法适用于不同同步控制环与不同限流策略。
AI.result: 在物理GFM逆变器上针对多种电网故障场景开展实验，验证了所提定量暂态稳定评估的有效性；引入阻尼能量后可减小ROA估计的保守性。
AI.conclusion: SdS能量函数框架可统一处理含限流切换的GFM逆变器暂态稳定问题，给出不依赖切换序列假设的ROA估计，且具有跨同步控制与限流策略的通用性。

title: Saying No by Asking Yes: Affirmative Decomposition and Evidence Reflection for Frozen CLIP
summary: Frozen vision-language models often match concepts mentioned in a caption without respecting their negation: a query "a kitchen with no toaster" favors an image containing a toaster. Yet these models are substantially stronger at matching affirmative descriptions. We exploit this asymmetry with Negation-Aware Evidence Scoring (NAES), which reformulates negated descriptions into affirmative queries and combines their evidence by caption structure. A lightweight text decomposer, NegSplit, identifies this structure by extracting negated spans and the remaining affirmative context. For captions with an affirmative remainder, NAES matches that content and applies a presence-based correction for the denial. When no affirmative content remains, it queries the denied object's presence and reflects the evidence around a reference to score the negated description. With LAION-2B CLIP, NAES achieves 82.4% accuracy on COCO-MCQ and 93.0% on VOC2007-MCQ, surpassing KTN by 2.9 and 0.9 percentage points; with OpenAI CLIP, it exceeds PeakPatch accuracy by 4.4 and 26.0 points, respectively. NAES also improves negated-description retrieval on COCO and MSR-VTT, with gains extending to SigLIP, SigLIP 2, and larger CLIP encoders. The strongest multiple-choice results use competing descriptions to center and align evidence; retrieval improvements persist without this conditioning. These findings show that explicitly separating affirmative matching from denied-object evidence can substantially improve negation-aware ranking.

AI.tldr: 提出 Negation-Aware Evidence Scoring (NAES)：将否定描述改写为肯定查询，并按描述结构组合证据，显著提升视觉语言模型的否定感知排序能力。
AI.motivation: 冻结的视觉语言模型在匹配描述中提到的概念时往往不遵守否定语义（如"没有烤面包机的厨房"更偏向含烤面包机的图像），但在匹配肯定描述时能力明显更强。作者利用这一"肯定—否定"不对称性来解决否定理解问题。
AI.method: 1) 轻量文本分解器 NegSplit 抽取否定片段与剩余肯定上下文，确定描述结构；2) 若存在肯定剩余内容，NAES 匹配该内容并对被否定对象施加基于存在性的校正；3) 若无肯定内容残留，则查询被否定对象的存在性并以参考点为中心反射证据进行打分；4) 多选设置下可用竞争描述对证据进行居中与对齐。
AI.result: LAION-2B CLIP 下 COCO-MCQ 82.4%、VOC2007-MCQ 93.0%，分别超 KTN 2.9 与 0.9 个百分点；OpenAI CLIP 下分别超 PeakPatch 4.4 与 26.0 个百分点。在 COCO、MSR-VTT 的否定描述检索上亦有提升，增益可扩展至 SigLIP、SigLIP 2 及更大 CLIP 编码器。
AI.conclusion: 显式分离"肯定匹配"与"被否定对象证据"能实质提升否定感知的排序性能；最强多选结果依赖竞争描述条件化，而检索增益在无条件化时依然保持。

title: EvoX: Rethinking the Agent Harness as a Runtime Policy
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly interact with tools and environments, yet plausible model decisions do not always translate into successful execution due to tool-call mismatches, interrupted workflows, and unsupported completion claims. We present EvoX, a Rust-based, multi-model agent runtime guided by The Second Policy, which views the harness as an Operational Policy complementing the foundation model's Semantic Policy. EvoX combines model-facing guidance with deterministic runtime control through three complementary mechanisms: Action Realization, Execution Continuity, and Outcome Grounding. To evaluate harnesses without suppressing their native behaviors, we introduce Contrast, a controlled and auditable framework integrating explicit fairness constraints, provider-bound request verification, and evidence-based adjudication. Across five benchmarks, six foundation models, and six agent harnesses, EvoX achieves the highest numerical success rate of 56.2% over 691 common task--model pairs, exceeding the average of the other five harnesses by approximately 3.0 percentage points. Its larger advantages on GLM-5.3 (+10.7 points) and Kimi K3 (+7.9 points) highlight the model-dependent effectiveness of harness design and the potential for cross-provider adaptability. Achieved without memory, evolution, or extensions, these results establish EvoX as a competitive multi-model agent runtime and underscore the importance of harness-level operational control in realizing foundation-model capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出基于 Rust 的多模型 Agent 运行时 EvoX，以"第二策略"视角把 harness 视为补足模型语义策略的操作策略，通过 Action Realization、Execution Continuity、Outcome Grounding 三项机制将可行决策转化为可执行行为；并配套可控评测框架 Contrast，在 5 个基准、6 个基座模型、6 个 harness 的 691 个共同任务-模型对上取得 56.2% 最高成功率，领先其余 5 个 harness 均值约 3.0 个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM Agent 已广泛与工具和环境交互，但模型层面"合理"的决策常因工具调用不匹配、工作流中断、无依据的完成声明而无法落地为成功执行。现有研究多聚焦模型能力本身，忽视 harness（运行时/编排层）对能力兑现的影响；同时缺乏在不压制各 harness 原生行为前提下进行公平、可审计比较的评测方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出"The Second Policy"框架，将 harness 定位为与基座模型 Semantic Policy 互补的 Operational Policy；2) 实现 Rust 版多模型运行时 EvoX，包含三项机制：Action Realization（面向模型的引导 + 确定性运行控制，保证动作可落地）、Execution Continuity（维持多步工作流连续与可恢复）、Outcome Grounding（基于证据约束完成声明）；3) 设计评测框架 Contrast，包含显式公平性约束、provider-bound 请求核验与基于证据的裁决，以受控、可审计方式横向比较大模型- harness 组合，且保留 harness 原生行为；4) 在 5 个基准、6 个基座模型、6 个 harness 上做对照实验，按共同任务-模型对聚合比较。
AI.result: 在 691 个共同任务-模型对上，EvoX 取得最高数值成功率 56.2%，较其余 5 个 harness 的平均水平高约 3.0 个百分点；在 GLM-5.3 上领先 +10.7 个百分点、在 Kimi K3 上领先 +7.9 个百分点，显示 harness 设计效果具有模型依赖性，并具备跨 provider 适配潜力。该结果在未使用记忆、演化或扩展模块的前提下取得。
AI.conclusion: EvoX 是一个具竞争力的多模型 Agent 运行时；结果表明 harness 层面的操作控制对兑现基座模型能力至关重要，且增益随基座模型不同而显著变化，提示后续工作应同时优化模型语义策略与运行时操作策略，并在公平可审计的评测协议下报告跨模型、跨 harness 的对比结果。

title: Poison-then-Hide: Finetuning-Activated Backdoor Attack on Pretrained Vision Encoders
summary: Backdoor attacks threaten the integrity of machine learning models by allowing attackers to control model behavior through triggers. Models can be compromised during finetuning by backdoor attacks through either poisoned data or adversarial training objectives. Because existing finetuning-activated attacks assume limited domain shift or frozen encoder layers, they often fail under full-model finetuning. We target a stealthy finetuning-activated attack where a dormant backdoor is implanted in a pretrained encoder, and later activated by finetuning on clean downstream data. We propose Poison-then-Hide, a novel attack that remains effective when the entire model is finetuned in a domain transfer. Our approach consists of three components: trigger optimization, base encoder poisoning, and targeted unlearning to conceal the backdoor. We evaluate our method on six datasets and three model architectures, and achieve state-of-the-art (up to 97%) attack success rates. We find that jointly learning the benign target task alongside the poisoning is critical to the attack's success. We demonstrate standard detection and mitigation defenses cannot fully remove the backdoor, which can reappear after benign finetuning.

AI.tldr: 提出 Poison-then-Hide，一种在预训练编码器中植入休眠后门、经干净下游数据全模型微调后激活的隐蔽后门攻击，在六个数据集、三种架构上达到最高 97% 的攻击成功率（SOTA），且标准检测与缓解手段无法完全清除后门。
AI.motivation: 现有微调激活型后门攻击假设域偏移有限或编码器层被冻结，在完整模型微调（full-model finetuning）与域迁移场景下常常失效，因此需要一种更鲁棒、更隐蔽的攻击设计。
AI.method: 方法由三部分组成：(1) 触发器优化（trigger optimization）；(2) 基座编码器投毒（base encoder poisoning），将休眠后门植入预训练编码器；(3) 定向遗忘（targeted unlearning）以隐藏后门；并强调在投毒过程中联合学习良性目标任务，这是攻击成功的关键。
AI.result: 在 6 个数据集、3 种模型架构上评测，攻击成功率达到最高 97%，为当前最优；消融显示联合学习良性目标对成功至关重要；标准检测与缓解防御无法完全移除后门，后门在良性微调后还会重新出现。
AI.conclusion: Poison-then-Hide 证明显式考虑域迁移与全参数微调时，微调激活型后门依然可行且高度隐蔽，暴露了现有后门检测/缓解在预训练—微调范式下的不足。

title: Bind-WAM: Binding-Uncertainty-Guided Selective Future Imagination in World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) can improve robot learning by jointly predicting future visual states and actions, but generating a visual future at every replanning step is expensive and sometimes unnecessary. This raises a critical question: when should a robot policy imagine the future? In this paper, we propose Bind-WAM, a binding-uncertainty-guided WAM for selective future imagination. Bind-WAM introduces language-object binding uncertainty, selectively invoking joint future-action generation when the current observation does not support stable task-relevant action generation. An offline labeling pipeline uses complete demonstrations and action context to identify task-relevant objects and detect reference mismatch, invisibility, and identity drift. The resulting pseudo-labels supervise a lightweight router that predicts binding uncertainty from the current observation and language instruction. At inference, a shared WAM policy invokes selective future imagination according to the predicted uncertainty and its change between consecutive replanning steps. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that Bind-WAM can establish binding uncertainty as a strong, interpretable signal for selective future imagination.

AI.tldr: 提出Bind-WAM，用"语言—物体绑定不确定性"作为可解释信号，让世界动作模型（WAM）仅在必要时做未来视觉想象的联合生成。
AI.motivation: WAM通过联合预测未来视觉状态与动作来提升机器人学习，但每个重规划步都生成未来图像代价高昂、且并非总是必要。核心问题是：策略应在何时想象未来？
AI.method: 构建语言—物体绑定不确定性：(1) 离线标注流水线利用完整示范与动作上下文识别任务相关物体，检测引用错配、不可见与身份漂移，生成伪标签；(2) 用伪标签监督一个轻量路由器，从当前观测与语言指令预测绑定不确定性；(3) 推理时共享的WAM策略依据预测不确定性及其在相邻重规划步间的变化，选择性地触发未来想象—动作联合生成。
AI.result: 仿真与真实世界实验表明，绑定不确定性可作为强且可解释的选择性未来想象信号；选择性调用在保持性能的同时减少不必要的视觉生成开销。
AI.conclusion: 将"何时想象"转化为可量化的绑定不确定性路由问题，为WAM的按需生成提供了原则性判据，并具备可解释性。

title: Estimation-Aware Control on Quadrotor State Manifolds via Anisotropic Covariance Filtering
summary: Conventional nonlinear flight controllers operate under the implicit assumption of reliable, high-confidence state feedback. During transient sensing degradation or partial unobservability, state estimation uncertainty is frequently misinterpreted as physical tracking error, triggering aggressive and parasitic corrective inputs. To mitigate this vulnerability, we propose a generalized Estimation-Aware (EA) control framework that directly incorporates real-time estimator confidence into control execution. By mapping the posterior error covariance $\mathbf{P}_{k\mid k}$ into an uncertainty-dependent modulation operator, the EA mechanism dynamically scales feedback authority, performing anisotropic attenuation along weakly observed state directions to prevent false error corrections. Validated across six distinct control paradigms, the proposed approach demonstrates substantial performance gains across all baselines. In particular, when integrated into an Incremental Nonlinear Dynamic Inversion (INDI) architecture, the EA mechanism reduces tracking and estimation errors by 24.34% and 33.24%, respectively, at a high flight speed of 10 m/s.

AI.tldr: 提出估计感知（EA）控制框架，将估计器后验误差协方差映射为不确定性相关调制算子，动态缩放反馈权限以抑制由传感退化/部分不可观引起的虚假误差修正，在六种控制范式中验证有效。
AI.motivation: 传统非线性飞控隐含假设状态反馈可靠且高置信；在瞬态传感退化或部分不可观时，状态估计不确定性被误判为物理跟踪误差，触发激进的寄生修正输入，构成脆弱性。
AI.method: 构建广义EA控制框架：将后验误差协方差 P_{k|k} 映射为不确定性依赖的调制算子，动态缩放反馈权限，并沿弱可观状态方向实施各向异性衰减，防止伪误差修正；以INDI等六种控制范式作为集成基座进行验证。
AI.result: 在全部六个基线中均取得显著性能提升；集成于INDI架构时，在10 m/s高飞行速度下跟踪误差与估计误差分别降低24.34%与33.24%。
AI.conclusion: 将实时估计器置信度显式纳入控制执行可有效缓解状态估计不确定性向控制输入的误传播，EA为一类可插拔、通用性强的增强机制。

title: Test-Time Selective Adaptation for Cross-Modal UAV Object Tracking with Token Shift
summary: Cross-modal unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) object tracking faces modality-induced appearance discrepancies and abrupt target-position shifts that can arise from modality switching, UAV motion, and inter-sensor offsets. Although existing methods model modality and spatial variations, they primarily rely on offline representation learning and offer limited localization-oriented adaptation during testing. To address these challenges, we propose Test-Time Selective Adaptation with Token Shift (TSAT), which derives spatial and temporal adaptation signals from unlabeled test sequences for online optimization. Specifically, we design a controllable token shift auxiliary task, which imposes explicit spatial correspondence between predefined token translations and resultant localization offsets, generating stable annotation-free spatial adaptation signals. Furthermore, we introduce a temporal backward prediction auxiliary task to exploit frame-wise temporal dependencies, effectively mitigating cumulative localization errors in continuous tracking. To suppress interference from unreliable tracking samples, we develop a reliability-aware update gating strategy to screen valid adaptation signals and stabilize online parameter updates. Experiments on CM-UOT demonstrate that TSAT achieves state-of-the-art performance against existing test-time adaptation methods, exhibiting superior robustness under frequent modality switching and severe spatial displacement. Experiments across tracking frameworks and datasets further validate the effectiveness and generalization capability of TSAT.

AI.tldr: 论文提出TSAT（Test-Time Selective Adaptation with Token Shift），通过可控Token移位辅助任务、时间反向预测辅助任务和可靠性感知更新门控，利用无标签测试序列在线产生空间与时间适应信号，解决跨模态UAV目标跟踪中的模态表观差异与目标位置突变问题。
AI.motivation: 跨模态UAV目标跟踪面临两类挑战：一是模态切换、无人机运动与传感器间偏移导致的模态诱导表观差异和目标位置突变；二是现有方法虽建模模态与空间变化，但主要依赖离线表征学习，测试阶段缺乏面向定位的适应能力。
AI.method: 提出TSAT，从无标签测试序列中提取空间与时间适应信号进行在线优化：1）设计可控Token移位辅助任务，在预定义Token平移与由此产生的定位偏移之间建立显式空间对应，生成稳定且无需标注的空间适应信号；2）引入时间反向预测辅助任务，利用逐帧时间依赖缓解连续跟踪中的累积定位误差；3）提出可靠性感知更新门控策略，筛选有效适应信号，抑制不可靠跟踪样本干扰，稳定在线参数更新。
AI.result: 在CM-UOT数据集上，TSAT相较现有测试时适应方法取得SOTA性能，在频繁模态切换与严重空间位移条件下表现出更优鲁棒性；跨跟踪框架与跨数据集的实验进一步验证了其有效性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TSAT表明，将无标注的空间对应约束与时间一致性约束结合，并配合可靠性门控，可有效实现跨模态UAV跟踪的测试时在线适应，且具备良好的框架通用性与泛化性。

title: Science Prediction Universe
comment: 52 pages, 28 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://spu.unipat.ai/
summary:
Humanity has long sought to explain natural phenomena. Reliable prediction of experimental outcomes is a central test of our understanding of the processes that produce them. If artificial general intelligence (AGI) is to surpass human scientific capabilities, it must also predict experimental outcomes more reliably than humans. Such capabilities could accelerate scientific discovery across disciplines, help address humanity's most pressing challenges, and improve human well-being. We introduce Science Prediction Universe (SPU), a benchmark of hidden experimental outcomes with 100 public verified tasks from chemistry, materials science, biology and medicine, and 16 private tasks from unpublished wet-lab experiments. Given an experimental setup and candidate conditions, an agent works with any resources it needs to rank the candidates by a measured outcome.
  We evaluate thirteen agent configurations spanning twelve frontier models across two harnesses (Codex and Claude Code). Current agents remain far from saturating wet-lab outcome prediction, with substantial performance disparities across models: on the public benchmark, configurations separate into two distinct tiers, with task-adjusted Spearman correlations ranging from 0.227 for the lowest-performing configuration to 0.478 for the best. Analysis of 1,155 scored public trajectories (227,103 tool calls) suggests that the bottleneck lies in scientific judgment rather than tool execution: agents rely on shared monotone priors, agreeing far more with one another than with experimental reality (0.52 vs. 0.33), and frequently compute trivial physical or chemical proxies that do not influence the final outcome.

AI.tldr: 提出SPU基准：100个公开验证任务+16个未发表湿实验隐藏任务，评估13种智能体配置在候选条件排序上的表现；最佳配置任务调整Spearman相关仅0.478，瓶颈在科学判断而非工具调用。
AI.motivation: AGI若要超越人类科研能力，必须能比人类更可靠地预测实验结果；现有基准缺乏对"隐藏实验结果"这一核心科学预测能力的直接检验。
AI.method: 构建Science Prediction Universe（SPU）基准，涵盖化学、材料科学、生物与医学的100个公开已验证任务及16个来自未发表湿实验的私有任务；任务形式为给定实验设置与候选条件，智能体可调用任意资源，按测量结果对候选排序；在Codex与Claude Code两种框架下评测12个前沿模型的13种配置。
AI.result: 公开基准上配置分化为两个梯队，任务调整Spearman相关系数从最低0.227到最高0.478；分析1155条计分公开轨迹（227,103次工具调用）显示智能体间一致性（0.52）远高于与实验实际值的一致性（0.33），常计算无关的简单理化代理量。
AI.conclusion: 当前智能体远未饱和湿实验结果的预测任务，且瓶颈在于科学判断而非工具执行，表现为共享的单调先验偏置。

title: EASTAR: Event-Anchored Semantic and Task-Adaptive Region Representation Learning
comment: 13 pages. Accepted to the 43rd IEEE International Conference on Data Engineering (ICDE 2027)
summary: Urban region representation learning supports a wide range of urban analytics tasks by encoding regional functions and interactions, with human mobility serving as a central signal because it directly captures inter-region interactions. However, most mobility-based methods learn from aggregated origin-destination matrices, where trips driven by different activity purposes are mixed into purpose-agnostic interaction patterns. Although static urban attributes such as POIs and land use can enrich region-level semantics, they do not explicitly ground mobility interactions in activity-purpose signals. As a result, downstream adaptation is often performed over entangled embeddings, making it difficult to select task-relevant functional semantics. To address these limitations, we propose EASTAR, an event-anchored and task-adaptive framework for urban region representation learning. EASTAR treats offline activity events as sparse semantic anchors and uses them to factorize aggregated mobility representations into multiple purpose-related semantic channels. It further introduces free channels to capture latent mobility patterns not covered by event data and a global channel to preserve overall spatial structure. To adapt the learned channel space to different downstream objectives, EASTAR designs a task-adaptive prompt router that initializes task-channel relevance from LLM-derived priors and refines the routing weights through downstream supervision. Experiments on two real-world urban datasets across four prediction tasks show that EASTAR consistently outperforms representative baselines, achieving up to 39.15% reduction in MAE. Ablation and interpretability analyses further demonstrate the effectiveness of event anchoring, semantic channel construction, and task-adaptive routing.

AI.tldr: EASTAR是一个以线下活动事件为语义锚点、支持任务自适应的城市区域表示学习框架，将聚合出行表示分解为多目的语义通道，并用LLM先验+下游监督驱动的提示路由器适配不同任务，在四个任务上MAE最多降低39.15%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于出行的方法多从聚合OD矩阵学习，不同活动目的的出行被混合成"目的不可知"的交互模式；POI、土地利用等静态属性虽能补充区域语义，却无法将出行交互显式锚定到活动目的信号上。因而下游适配只能在纠缠的嵌入上进行，难以选取与任务相关的功能语义。
AI.method: 提出EASTAR框架：以离线活动事件作为稀疏语义锚点，将聚合出行表示分解为多个与目的相关的语义通道；引入自由通道（free channels）捕捉事件数据未覆盖的潜在出行模式，并设置全局通道保留整体空间结构；设计任务自适应提示路由器（task-adaptive prompt router），从LLM导出的先验初始化任务-通道相关性，再通过下游监督精化路由权重。
AI.result: 在两个真实城市数据集、四类预测任务上持续优于代表性基线，MAE最高降低39.15%；消融实验与可解释性分析验证了事件锚定、语义通道构建与任务自适应路由的有效性。
AI.conclusion: EASTAR通过事件锚定的目的化语义通道分解与任务自适应路由，缓解了聚合出行表示的语义纠缠问题，实现了可解释、可适配的区域表示学习，为多任务城市分析提供了统一框架。

title: Low-Cost Mobile Bimanual Manipulation for Long-Horizon Toilet Cleaning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising capabilities for robot manipulation, but their performance on accessible mobile bimanual platforms remains underexplored. We present a low-cost and reproducible mobile bimanual platform integrating two LeRobot SO-101 manipulators with a TurtleBot 4 and a LeRobot-ROS 2 software stack. Using long-horizon toilet cleaning as a case study, we collect 250 real-world demonstrations and evaluate $π_0$, $π_{0.5}$, SmolVLA, and GR00T under the same embodiment and task conditions. We further evaluate variants using SARM-derived task-progress signals and short-term MEM observation history. Among the evaluated models, $π_0$ performs best, achieving 60% strict and 70% relaxed autonomous success, increasing to 90% with limited human intervention. In contrast, the evaluated progress- and memory-augmented variants do not improve their corresponding baselines. Our results demonstrate the feasibility of long-horizon mobile bimanual manipulation on accessible hardware while highlighting remaining challenges in reliable VLA deployment. Project website: https://so101-turtlebot4.github.io/mobile-bimanual-cleaning/

AI.tldr: 本文构建低成本可复现的移动双臂平台（两台LeRobot SO-101 + TurtleBot 4 + LeRobot-ROS 2），以长时序马桶清洁为案例采集250条真实演示，在统一本体与任务条件下评测π0、π0.5、SmolVLA与GR00T，π0表现最佳（严格60%、宽松70%自主成功率，有限人工干预下达90%），而基于SARM任务进度信号与短期MEM观测历史的增强变体均未超过各自基线。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在机器人操作上展现出潜力，但在可获得的（低成本）移动双臂平台上的性能尚缺乏系统研究；同时长时序移动双臂任务对VLA的可靠性提出更高要求。
AI.method: 搭建集成两台SO-101机械臂、TurtleBot 4底盘与LeRobot-ROS 2软件栈的低成本可复现移动双臂平台；以马桶清洁为长时序案例，采集250条真实世界演示；在相同本体与任务条件下对比评测π0、π0.5、SmolVLA、GR00T，并测试叠加SARM派生任务进度信号与短期MEM观测历史的增强变体。
AI.result: π0最优：严格成功率60%、宽松成功率70%自主完成，加入有限人工干预后提升至90%；任务进度与记忆增强变体均未带来相对基线的改进。
AI.conclusion: 验证了在易获取硬件上开展长时序移动双臂操作的可行性，同时揭示了VLA可靠部署仍存在的挑战。

title: Adaptive Robust Output Regulation of Uncertain Linear Time-Varying Systems
summary: This paper studies adaptive robust output regulation of linear time-varying systems with unknown constant parameters in both the plant and exosystem. The design is based on nonmonic differential relations for the ideal input. For general time-varying and periodic systems, we derive sufficient conditions for the existence of nonmonic differential relations and construct them from the original system coefficients. Based on these relations, an adaptive controller is constructed using stable filters and a parameterized readout. Under suitable conditions on the filter and readout, the controller achieves exact regulation for finitely separable relation coefficients, including the affine parametric uncertainty treated in Byrnes--Isidori form. For coefficient families satisfying the approximation conditions, refining the approximation achieves any prescribed ultimate regulation accuracy with a fixed stabilization design, yielding practical regulation. Neither persistent excitation nor parameter convergence is required. Two numerical examples illustrate the regulation performance of the proposed controller. Overall, the framework includes earlier constructions based on finite separation of the ideal input or monic linear differential relations with finitely separable coefficients, and achieves exact robust regulation for a broader class of uncertain systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究被控对象与外系统均含未知常参数线性时变系统的自适应鲁棒输出调节，提出基于非首一微分关系的控制器设计框架。
AI.motivation: 经典输出调节多依赖首一线性微分关系与有限可分性假设，难以覆盖参数不确定性存在于时变对象和外系统中的一般情形，需推广到更广泛的系统类。
AI.method: 针对理想输入构造非首一微分关系，对一般时变与周期系统给出存在性充分条件并由原系统系数显式构造；再基于该关系，用稳定滤波器与参数化读出构造自适应控制器，利用有限可分的关系系数实现精确调节，并推广至单纯型参数不确定。
AI.result: 对满足有限可分的关系系数可实现精确调节；对满足逼近条件的系数族，可在固定镇定设计下通过细化逼近达到任意给定的最终调节精度，实现实用调节；无需持续激励与参数收敛；两个数值算例验证了性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架涵盖基于理想输入有限可分或首一线性微分关系的既有构造，并对更广一类不确定系统实现精确鲁棒调节。

title: DiFiT: Distribution-Fidelity-guided Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Visual token pruning reduces the inference cost of multimodal large language models, but answer accuracy only partly reflects its effect. Pruning can change the probabilities of alternative response tokens even when greedy answers remain correct and unchanged. We compare full and pruned response distributions under shared reference prefixes. Average predictive drift grows with compression on fixed correctly answered samples. Separate analyses associate larger drift with more confidence-decision disagreements and sampling failures. We propose DiFiT (Distribution-Fidelity-guided Token pruning) to learn discrete selection from reference answers and full-token response distributions. Dual-View Distillation matches probabilities across the vocabulary, while answer supervision supports task quality. A learned scorer and differentiable Top-$K$ learn which visual evidence to retain. A multi-budget mask objective supports different retention ratios through one shared ranking over a frozen model. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, DiFiT reduces sampling-induced negative flips by 30.3% relative to FastV at 10% retention on four-task greedy-correct controls. It preserves 98.74% of baseline performance on MME at 30% retention.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出视觉token剪枝仅用答案准确率评估不足，剪枝会改变候选response token的概率分布；为此提出DiFiT（分布保真度引导的token剪枝），通过双视角蒸馏匹配全词表概率分布并学习可微Top-K选择，在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上显著减少采样负翻转并保持基线性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉token剪枝可降低多模态大模型推理成本，但答案准确率仅部分反映剪枝效果：即便贪心答案保持不变且正确，剪枝仍会改变备选response token的概率。作者通过比较共享参考前缀下full与pruned的response分布，发现平均预测漂移随压缩率上升而增大，且更大漂移关联更多置信度-决策不一致与采样失败，因此需要以分布保真度而非仅答案正确性来指导剪枝。
AI.method: 提出DiFiT（Distribution-Fidelity-guided Token pruning），从参考答案与full-token response分布中学习离散选择。采用Dual-View Distillation在整个词表上匹配概率，同时以answer supervision保证任务质量；使用可学习scorer与可微Top-K学习保留哪些视觉证据；并设计multi-budget mask objective，在冻结模型上通过单一共享排序支持不同保留率。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上，于四任务贪心正确对照样本中，DiFiT在10%保留率下相较FastV将采样导致的negative flips减少30.3%；在MME上30%保留率下保持基线性能的98.74%。
AI.conclusion: 评估视觉token剪枝需关注response分布保真度而非仅答案准确率；DiFiT通过分布蒸馏与可微离散选择，在多个保留率下有效抑制预测漂移与采样失败，同时保持任务性能，为剪枝质量提供了更细粒度的优化目标。

title: Advancing Weighted Partial MaxSAT Solving via Differentiable GPU Guidance
summary: We present a GPU-CPU hybrid framework for Weighted Partial MaxSAT (WPMAX-SAT) that complements state-of-the-art CPU solvers with differentiable GPU optimization. The GPU stage directly optimizes instance-specific categorical decision parameters without a training dataset or a pretrained predictive model. The central challenge in extending differentiable optimization to WPMAX-SAT is the hard/soft clause asymmetry: hard clauses represent inviolable feasibility constraints while soft clauses carry weights. We introduce a hierarchical differentiable loss that prioritizes hard clause satisfaction before optimizing the weighted soft objective, ensuring that GPU gradient descent leans towards the constraint structure of WPMAX-SAT. Our framework transforms the GPU-optimized variable logits to high-confidence assignments and transfers them to CPU solvers via two complementary modes: partial guidance, which injects the most confident perturbed partial variable assignments as soft clauses into $N$ parallel solver instances, and phase initialization, which guides the CDCL solver's internal branching polarity with the full GPU assignment as a warm start to preserve the problem's originality. We evaluate on all 229 instances of the MSE 2024 (most recent due to cancellation in 2025) anytime weighted benchmark with the top 2 winners as baselines; our hybrid framework improves the average solution score by up to 4.9% over tt-open-wbo-inc-Glucose and 4.8% over SPB-MaxSAT-c-FPS at a 300-second time limit, with the potential to obtain better solutions surpassing the best known solution recorded in the competition evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出 GPU-CPU 混合框架求解加权部分 MaxSAT（WPMAX-SAT）：用可微分 GPU 优化生成变量赋值，再以“部分引导”与“相位初始化”两种方式注入 SOTA CPU 求解器，在 MSE 2024 anytime weighted 基准 229 个实例上平均解质量最高提升 4.9%/4.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有最先进（SOTA）WPMAX-SAT 求解器主要基于 CPU 的 CDCL/分支定界，其启发式难以在 anytime 场景下快速获得高质量可行解；而可微分优化虽在组合优化（如 SAT/MaxSAT 的无监督神经求解）中展现潜力，却难以直接扩展到 WPMAX-SAT，核心障碍在于硬约束/软约束的非对称性——硬子句是不可违反的可行性约束，软子句带有权重，简单加权求和的可微损失会让梯度被软目标主导，产生不可行或低质量解。
AI.method: 1) 无需训练数据或预训练预测模型，直接在 GPU 上对实例特定的类别型决策参数（变量 logits）做可微分优化；2) 设计分层可微分损失：先优先满足硬子句（可行性），再优化加权软目标，使梯度下降朝向 WPMAX-SAT 的约束结构；3) 将 GPU 优化后的 logits 转为高置信度赋值并迁移至 CPU 求解器，采用两种互补模式：(a) 部分引导——将最置信的被扰动部分变量赋值作为软子句注入 N 个并行求解器实例；(b) 相位初始化——用完整 GPU 赋值引导 CDCL 求解器的分支极性作为热启动，同时保留原问题完整性；4) 在 MSE 2024 anytime weighted 全部 229 个实例上，以竞赛前 2 名（tt-open-wbo-inc-Glucose、SPB-MaxSAT-c-FPS）为基线评估。
AI.result: 在 300 秒时限下，混合框架相对 tt-open-wbo-inc-Glucose 平均解得分最高提升 4.9%，相对 SPB-MaxSAT-c-FPS 提升 4.8%；并具备获得优于竞赛评测记录中最佳已知解的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 可微分 GPU 优化与 CPU 完备求解器的互补结合能有效提升 anytime WPMAX-SAT 求解质量，分层损失对处理硬/软不对称性至关重要；两种信息迁移模式（部分引导、相位初始化）为神经/梯度方法与经典求解器的融合提供了通用范式，未来可进一步探索引导强度调度与更细粒度的置信度筛选。

title: AI4Plasma I: Data-Efficient Surrogate Modeling of Capacitively Coupled Plasma Fields
summary: Reference capacitively coupled plasma (CCP) simulations provide spatially resolved plasma fields but are costly to generate across operating conditions. We compare the data efficiency of five surrogate architectures--Coordinate MLP, PCA-Net, U-Net, Fourier neural operator (FNO), and Transolver--for predicting RF-cycle-averaged electron density, ion density, electric potential, and electron temperature in 1D planar and 2D axisymmetric GEC CCP benchmarks. We assess the number of reference simulations needed to achieve 1% and 2% mean relative L2 error for parameter-interior and parameter-boundary test cases, and examine architecture-specific mechanisms. FNO achieves the lowest or joint-lowest reference-case requirement in seven of eight comparisons. In 1D, FNO reaches 1% interior error with 50 training cases, compared with 100 for Transolver and 200 for U-Net. In 2D, FNO and U-Net each reach 1% interior error with 100 cases; FNO and Transolver each reach 2% parameter-boundary error with 200 cases, compared with 400 for U-Net. At the stricter 1% 2D parameter-boundary target, Transolver requires 400 cases versus 800 for FNO. Additional analyses investigate FNO spectral modes and padding, U-Net skip connections, Transolver adaptive slicing, and PCA-Net projection versus prediction error. The results support FNO as a data-efficient baseline for the tested CCP settings, while showing that the preferred architecture depends on the accuracy target and operating-parameter region.

AI.tldr: 本文在1D平面与2D轴对称GEC-CCP基准上系统比较五种代理模型（Coordinate MLP、PCA-Net、U-Net、FNO、Transolver）的数据效率，以达到1%/2%平均相对L2误差所需参考仿真数为指标，发现FNO在八项比较中七项取得最低或并列最低需求，但最优架构取决于精度目标与参数区域。
AI.motivation: 参考CCP仿真能提供空间分辨的等离子体场，但跨工况生成成本高昂。需要明确不同代理架构在有限参考数据下的数据效率，以指导CCP多物理场代理建模的架构选择与采样预算分配。
AI.method: 以RF周期平均的电子密度、离子密度、电势与电子温度为目标量，在1D平面与2D轴对称GEC-CCP基准上训练五类代理模型；统计达到1%和2%平均相对L2误差所需的参考仿真数量，区分参数内部与参数边界测试情形，并开展架构机理分析：FNO的谱模态数与padding、U-Net跳跃连接、Transolver自适应切片、PCA-Net投影误差与预测误差的关系。
AI.result: FNO在8项比较中7项取得最低或并列最低参考样本需求。1D：FNO以50例达1%内部误差，Transolver需100例、U-Net需200例。2D：FNO与U-Net均以100例达1%内部误差；2%参数边界误差下FNO与Transolver均需200例，U-Net需400例；更严格的1%参数边界目标下Transolver需400例，FNO需800例。
AI.conclusion: 对本文测试的CCP设定，FNO是数据效率较高的基线架构，但不存在普适最优架构：架构偏好随精度目标与运行参数区域（内部/边界）而变化，实际选型应结合误差容限与工况覆盖范围确定。

title: Actuation and Control of Passive Tendon-Driven Soft Extensions Through Rigid Manipulator Motion
comment: 16 pages, 12 figures. Soon to be submitted to the IEEE Transactions on Robotics. Code: https://github.com/nachocz/passive_soft_extension_control. Interactive pages and video: https://ignaciocuiral.com/passive_soft_extension_control/
summary: Industrial manipulators offer reach and precision but can damage nearby structures in confined spaces. Soft robots provide compliant contact but typically have limited reach. Rigid-soft systems combine their advantages, although they often require dedicated actuation and control hardware. We propose actuating a passive tendon-driven soft extension through manipulator joint motion. As the robot moves, the exterior spans of tendons anchored to upstream links change, altering tendon tension and deforming the extension. Inspection through narrow apertures, for example, constrains the motion of the end effector (EE). We develop a controller that regulates the soft tip while preserving such EE constraints. A differential model separates rigid transport from soft deformation, combining analytic arm and tendon kinematics with a locally identified span-to-deformation map. We also derive a local upper bound on the number of independent deformation directions transmitted by the tendons under the EE constraint, and conditions for the exponential convergence of the tip error. A quadratic program with control barrier functions imposes obstacle clearance, fulcrum limits, and model-validity conditions. Simulations and real experiments show tip and shape regulation under free, position-constrained, and fulcrum-constrained EE motion.

AI.tldr: 通过机械臂关节运动驱动被动腱驱动软体延伸段，结合微分模型与含控制障碍函数的二次规划，在末端受约束条件下实现软体末端与形状调控。
AI.motivation: 工业机械臂可达性与精度高但在狭小空间易碰撞损伤结构；软体机器人接触柔顺但可达范围有限；刚软结合系统虽兼具优点，却常需专用驱动与控制硬件。本文旨在无需额外硬件，利用机械臂自身关节运动驱动软体延伸。
AI.method: 将腱锚定于上游连杆，通过关节运动改变外部腱跨距长度，进而改变张力使软体延伸段变形。建立微分模型，将刚体输运与软体变形解耦：结合解析的臂与腱运动学与局部辨识的跨距—变形映射。推导末端约束下腱可传递独立变形方向数的局部上界及末端误差指数收敛条件。采用控制障碍函数约束的二次规划，施加速度级障碍物间隙、支点限制与模型有效性条件。
AI.result: 仿真与实物实验验证了在无约束、位置约束及支点约束的末端运动下，均能实现软体末端位置与整体形状的调节。
AI.conclusion: 以机械臂关节运动被动驱动软体延伸段是可行的，所提建模与控制框架可在保留末端约束的前提下实现软尖控制与形状调控，为受限空间作业提供低成本刚软协同方案。

title: Decentralised model predictive control of recurrent neural network models
summary: This work proposes a decentralised nonlinear model predictive control algorithm for systems described by input-coupled recurrent neural network models. The proposed approach exploits closed-loop incremental input-to-state stability to design the local controllers and provide robustness to subsystem couplings. The resulting control scheme guarantees asymptotic convergence to a desired equilibrium while satisfying input and output constraints. Simulation results illustrate the performance of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向输入耦合递归神经网络（RNN）模型的去中心化非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）算法，基于闭环增量输入-状态稳定性（δISS）设计局部控制器以抑制子系统间耦合，在满足输入/输出约束的同时保证渐近收敛到期望平衡点。
AI.motivation: 由输入耦合RNN描述的互联系统具有强非线性和子系统间耦合，集中式NMPC计算负担重、可扩展性差；去中心化方案虽可降低计算量，但耦合项相当于对每个局部子系统的未知扰动，缺乏稳定性与约束满足的理论保证。
AI.method: 将整体系统分解为以输入耦合RNN建模的子系统，各局部控制器独立求解NMPC问题；以闭环增量输入-状态稳定性（δISS）作为核心分析工具，利用其Lyapunov型/增益型性质刻画耦合输入的鲁棒性，据此构造局部终端约束与优化问题，从而保证去中心化闭环的稳定性与约束可行性。
AI.result: 所提出的去中心化控制方案能够保证闭环轨迹渐近收敛至期望平衡点，并满足输入与输出约束；仿真结果验证了算法在耦合RNN系统上的性能与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: δISS为去中心化NMPC处理输入耦合RNN系统提供了可操作的理论框架，兼具计算可扩展性与稳定性、约束保证；未来可进一步研究通信依赖更强的分布式（迭代/协同）NMPC及输出耦合、时延等更一般情形。

title: SAVE: Less is More in Agentic Video Reasoning
summary: Agentic video-reasoning frameworks iteratively explore a video, choosing what to observe based on the query and evidence gathered so far. Existing methods are typically evaluated with different backbones, preprocessing pipelines, and computational budgets, making it difficult to determine which components actually drive performance, how much they cost, and whether agentic inference is preferable to native video reasoning in the first place. We conduct a controlled evaluation of a diverse set of recent agentic video-reasoning systems across two strong contemporary backbones, with explicit token and monetary-cost accounting. Across Gemini 3 Flash and Gemma 4, most existing agentic frameworks fail to consistently improve over native video inference and often increase computational cost. We investigate two primary questions: (1) How much agentic framework complexity is necessary for effective video reasoning? (2) When, if at all, is agentic video reasoning preferable to just using the backbone directly? To answer the first question, we introduce a deliberately minimal Active Exploration Baseline and show that it remains competitive with substantially more elaborate agents. We then propose targeted extensions to this baseline, yielding SAVE (Simple Agentic Video Explorer). SAVE outperforms all evaluated prior agentic methods in five of six backbone-benchmark settings. Turning to the second question, our results indicate that the advantage of agentic exploration grows when dense processing would otherwise represent answer-relevant events too sparsely, particularly for long videos and temporally concentrated evidence. Overall, our results suggest that agentic video reasoning should favor simple frameworks over increasingly elaborate pipelines and focus primarily on long-form video, where selective evidence acquisition offers the clearest advantage over native inference.

AI.tldr: 本文对近期多种"智能体式视频推理"框架做了受控评测（统一骨干、预处理与算力预算，计入token与金钱成本），发现多数现有框架难以稳定超越原生视频推理。作者据此提出极简的主动探索基线，并扩展为SAVE，在六个骨干-基准设置中的五个取得最佳表现。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体式视频推理方法在骨干模型、预处理流程与计算预算上各不相同，导致无法判断究竟是哪些组件在真正驱动性能提升、代价几何，以及智能体式推理是否真的优于直接使用骨干模型的原生视频推理。因此需要一次控制变量的公平对比，并回答"框架复杂度是否必要"与"何时才该用智能体"两个问题。
AI.method: 在Gemini 3 Flash与Gemma 4两个强骨干上，对多种近期智能体式视频推理系统进行受控评测，并显式记录token消耗与金钱成本。为回答问题(1)，作者构建了一个刻意极简的Active Exploration Baseline（主动探索基线），验证其与复杂智能体相当；再在其上做针对性扩展，形成SAVE（Simple Agentic Video Explorer）。
AI.result: 在Gemini 3 Flash与Gemma 4上，大多数现有智能体框架无法稳定优于原生视频推理，且常带来更高的计算开销。极简基线即可与复杂得多的智能体保持竞争力；SAVE在六组骨干-基准设置中的五组优于所有被评测的既有智能体方法。消融显示：当稠密处理会使答案相关事件被过度稀疏采样时（长视频、时间上集中的证据），智能体式探索的相对优势更明显。
AI.conclusion: 智能体式视频推理应偏向简单框架而非日益复杂的流水线，并主要聚焦长视频场景——在此类场景中，选择性证据获取相对原生推理的优势最为清晰。

title: A frontier machine intelligence for human neuroimaging
comment: 41 pages, 4 main figures, 9 extended data figures
summary: Medical imaging is essential for diagnosing disease, guiding treatment and monitoring patients over time. Although artificial intelligence has advanced image interpretation, existing medical models often address restricted tasks, while general-purpose proprietary models lack access to private clinical imaging required to achieve medical expertise. Developing models that can interpret complex examinations and communicate their findings in the context of clinical decisions remains a major challenge. Here, we show that Neuro-VL, a vision-language model trained on nearly one million neuroimaging studies from routine clinical care, can interpret complete imaging examinations and engage in natural language conversations about their findings. Across internal and international datasets, Neuro-VL outperformed frontier general-purpose and specialized medical models in diagnosing, localizing, and describing abnormalities, as well as generating comprehensive radiology reports. The model also compared serial examinations to assess disease progression and more reliably resisted misleading clinical assumptions than leading frontier models from OpenAI and Google. These results extend health system learning beyond individual predictions to interactive image interpretation and longitudinal disease monitoring. They demonstrate how the collective clinical experience of health systems can be used to develop medical AI with specialized expertise and broad clinical capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出Neuro-VL——在近百万例常规临床神经影像检查上训练的视觉-语言模型，可解读完整影像检查并以自然语言对话交流发现，在诊断、定位、描述异常及生成报告上超越前沿通用与专用医学模型，并能对比序列检查评估疾病进展、更可靠抵抗误导性临床假设。
AI.motivation: 医学影像对疾病诊断、治疗指导与随访监测至关重要。现有医学AI模型多局限于受限任务，而通用专有模型无法获取私有临床影像数据，难以形成医学专业能力；如何让模型解读复杂检查并结合临床决策交流结论仍是重大挑战。
AI.method: 构建Neuro-VL视觉-语言模型，训练数据为来自常规临床诊疗的近一百万例神经影像检查；模型支持完整影像检查解读与围绕影像发现的自然语言多轮对话，并具备序列检查对比与纵向分析能力；在内部及国际数据集上与前沿通用模型和专用医学模型进行对照评测。
AI.result: 在诊断、异常定位与描述、以及生成完整放射学报告方面，Neuro-VL优于前沿通用模型和专用医学模型；可对比序列检查以评估疾病进展；在抵抗误导性临床假设方面比OpenAI与Google的领先前沿模型更可靠。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将卫生系统的学习从单一预测扩展到交互式影像解读与纵向疾病监测，表明可利用医疗系统的集体临床经验开发兼具专业专长与广泛临床能力的医学AI。

title: A Cardiorespiratory Foundation Model Pretrained on Ten Physiological Signals for Perioperative and Critical Care
summary: Arterial, venous, pulmonary artery and intracranial pressures and ventilator waveforms guide decisions in operating rooms and intensive care units, yet foundation models for physiological waveforms have been built almost entirely on the electrocardiogram and photoplethysmogram. We present CARMEN, a single encoder pretrained without labels on ten cardiorespiratory waveforms (2.27 million modality-hours). CARMEN accepts any combination of co-recorded signals from 10 s to 5 min, and a conditioning mechanism, LSCNorm, restores the absolute signal level that normalization removes; without it, the AUROC for intraoperative hypotension fell from 0.894 to 0.780. Across 19 tasks from Korean and US cohorts, the frozen encoder outperformed supervised models on 12 of 15 and three foundation models, one general-purpose and two for biosignals, on 14 to 17 of 19, with none exceeding it on any task. Given the electrocardiogram or photoplethysmogram alone, it matched or exceeded signal-specific foundation models in most comparisons, and it retained its performance when channels were missing.

AI.tldr: 提出CARMEN：在10种心肺波形（227万模态小时）上无标签预训练的单编码器生理波形基础模型，可接受10秒至5分钟任意共同记录信号组合；配套LSCNorm条件机制恢复归一化丢失的绝对信号水平。冻结编码器在19项任务中多数超越监督模型与三个基础模型。
AI.motivation: 手术室与ICU中的动脉压、静脉压、肺动脉压、颅内压及呼吸机波形对临床决策至关重要，但现有生理波形基础模型几乎完全建立在ECG与PPG之上，其他波形模态被忽视。
AI.method: 构建单一编码器CARMEN，在10种心肺波形、共2.27 million modality-hours数据上无标签预训练；支持任意共同记录信号组合、时长10 s–5 min；引入LSCNorm条件机制恢复归一化所移除的绝对信号水平。
AI.result: LSCNorm关键性：去除后术中低血压AUROC由0.894降至0.780。在韩国与美国队列的19项任务上，冻结编码器在15项中有12项优于监督模型，在19项中有14–17项优于三个基础模型（一个通用模型、两个生物信号模型），无任何任务被超越；仅给ECG或PPG时多数比较中达到或超过信号专用基础模型；通道缺失时性能保持。
AI.conclusion: 单一多模态波形编码器可泛化至跨人群、跨任务场景，且对缺失通道鲁棒，扩展了生理波形基础模型的应用边界。

title: SPARC: RoboCup Standard Platform for Autonomous Rescue Competition with Initial Datasets, Software, and Simulation Environments
summary: The RoboCup Standard Platform for Autonomous Rescue Competition (SPARC) is a new competition under development of the RoboCup Rescue Robot League that uses the Unitree A2-W as a common robot platform. SPARC aims to make research on artificial intelligence for autonomous rescue robots accessible to a broader research community, including groups without expertise in developing and maintaining custom robot hardware. By providing a capable standard platform and established benchmark environments, researchers can focus on autonomous navigation, perception, manipulation, and embodied AI for challenging disaster-response scenarios. This paper introduces the SPARC competition, its benchmark environment, and the Unitree A2-W standard platform. Furthermore, we present the first open SPARC datasets collected during the IEEE ICRA 2026 Legged Robot Challenges and RoboCup Rescue 2026, release an open-source software stack for autonomous navigation, and provide initial simulation assets representing RoboCup Rescue test environments. Together, these resources aim to lower the barrier to entry for autonomous rescue robotics and facilitate reproducible research and collaborative development on a common hardware platform.

AI.tldr: SPARC是RoboCup救援机器人联赛下正在发展的新赛事，以Unitree A2-W为统一机器人平台，旨在降低自主救援机器人AI研究的门槛。本文介绍了赛事、基准环境与标准平台，并首次公开发布赛事数据集、自主导航开源软件栈及RoboCup Rescue测试环境的仿真资产，以促进可复现研究与协作开发。
AI.motivation: 自主救援机器人研究受限于定制硬件开发与维护的高门槛，许多缺乏硬件专长的研究团队难以参与；同时缺乏统一平台与基准环境导致研究结果难以比较和复现。
AI.method: 构建基于Unitree A2-W四足机器人的标准化赛事平台SPARC，配套RoboCup Rescue基准测试环境；整理IEEE ICRA 2026 Legged Robot Challenges与RoboCup Rescue 2026期间采集的数据集；开发并开源自主导航软件栈；提供对应测试环境的初始仿真资产。
AI.result: 发布了首个开放的SPARC数据集、开源自主导航软件栈以及RoboCup Rescue测试环境的初始仿真资产，并系统介绍了赛事设置与标准平台配置。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一硬件平台与配套数据、软件和仿真资源，SPARC降低了自主救援机器人研究的进入门槛，有助于推动可复现研究和基于共同平台的协作开发。

title: Transversal Passivity and Equilibrium Forces in Formation Control
summary: We consider controller synthesis for distance-constrained formations, aiming to stabilize the target formation manifold while sustaining admissible equilibrium edge forces. Using the newly introduced notion of transversal passivity, we encode the target formation shape, the prescribed edge lengths, and a subspace of internally balanced edge forces as the port target manifolds of the agents and the edge controller. The synthesis task is thereby reformulated as the joint design of a transversally passive edge controller and its output-target subspace. We then propose a general constructive realization of output-strictly transversally passive systems and specialize it to derive a dynamic edge controller that sustains admissible equilibrium edge forces. Through a compatibility analysis across the interconnection, we establish a closed-loop dissipation margin in terms of the controller parameters and prove local convergence of all agent and controller ports to their target manifolds. Numerical simulations validate the results.

AI.tldr: 提出基于横截无源性的距离约束编队控制器综合方法，将目标形状、边长与内部平衡边力编码为端口目标流形，实现边控制器与输出目标子空间的联合设计并保证局部收敛。
AI.motivation: 距离约束编队的控制目标不仅是稳定目标编队流形，还需维持可行的平衡边力；现有方法难以将编队形状约束与内力约束统一到同一端口-无源框架下进行系统性综合。
AI.method: 引入"横截无源性"概念，把目标编队形状、规定边长及内部平衡边力子空间表述为智能体与边控制器的端口目标流形，将综合任务转化为横截无源边控制器及其输出-目标子空间的联合设计；给出输出严格横截无源系统的一般构造性实现，并特化为可维持可行平衡边力的动态边控制器；通过互联兼容性分析，以控制器参数刻画闭环耗散裕度。
AI.result: 建立了由控制器参数表达的闭环耗散裕度，并证明所有智能体端口与控制器端口均局部收敛至各自目标流形；数值仿真验证了理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 横截无源性为距离约束编队的形状稳定与边力可行性提供了统一的端口哈密顿式综合框架，构造性实现与兼容性分析给出可调参数化的收敛保证。

title: Prediction or Persistence? What Future-Prediction Scores Miss About World Models
comment: Accepted at the CoRL 2026 Workshop "Do Robots Need World Models?"
summary: Pretrained video world models are compared and chosen as components for robot learning largely by future-prediction scores. On its own, such a score cannot be read as evidence of prediction, because it mixes encoder quality, the near future's resemblance to the recent past, and the predictor's own contribution. We separate the three with a matched control. On 27,000 future-retrieval trials from household egocentric video, a model must pick the true continuation of a clip among eleven candidates from the same video (chance 0.091), ranked zero-shot by its own training criterion. Each model is paired with a persistence control, an identical copy whose predictor is never invoked, so the paired difference isolates the predictor. Score and contribution dissociate within the native-video V-JEPA family alone: the predictor adds +0.291 top-1 for V-JEPA 2.1 but +0.03 to +0.04 for V-JEPA 2 on the identical trials. Across five models the contribution ranges from +0.291 to negative, and it is negative only for the two action-conditioned models, which we evaluate outside their training regime. Persistence alone recovers the encoder ordering expected from pretraining, a sign that the probe tracks real signal. We suggest reporting each future-prediction score together with its persistence baseline. The gap between them, not the score, is what makes the number interpretable: a necessary check costing one forward pass. Establishing downstream usefulness is a separate matter, for a planning or control evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用"匹配对照"（persistence control）拆分视频世界模型未来预测分数中的编码器质量、近期未来与近期过去相似性、以及预测器本身贡献三部分；实验表明预测分数与预测器贡献可解耦（如V-JEPA 2.1为+0.291而V-JEPA 2仅+0.03~0.04），建议同时报告预测分数与其persistence基线之差。
AI.motivation: 预训练视频世界模型作为机器人学习组件时，主要依据未来预测分数来选择，但该分数混合了编码器质量、近期未来与近期过去的相似性以及预测器自身贡献，单独解读无法作为"真正在预测"的证据。
AI.method: 在27,000次来自家庭第一视角视频的未来检索试验中，模型需从同一视频的11个候选中选出真实后续片段（随机概率0.091），并按其自身训练准则进行零样本排序。每个模型配对一个persistence对照（预测器从不被调用的相同副本），配对差值即隔离出预测器的贡献。共评估五个模型，其中包含两个动作条件模型（在其训练分布外评测）。
AI.result: 在原生视频的V-JEPA系列内部，分数与贡献即出现解耦：V-JEPA 2.1的预测器在相同试验上带来+0.291的top-1提升，而V-JEPA 2仅+0.03~+0.04。五个模型的贡献范围从+0.291到负值，且仅在两个动作条件模型上为负。仅凭persistence基线即可恢复预训练所预期的编码器排序，说明该探针捕捉到真实信号。
AI.conclusion: 建议将每个未来预测分数与其persistence基线一并报告，二者之差（而非分数本身）才是可解释的指标，作为只需一次前向传播的必要检查；下游实用性需另通过规划或控制评测来确定。

title: GuardianAgentFlow: Multi-Agent Coordination for Web Privacy Protection
summary: Web agents need to use private context without unnecessarily disclosing it. Effective protection must distinguish between requests that may be sent after sanitization and those that must be withheld, while preserving the information needed for authorized tasks. We present GuardianAgentFlow, a multi-agent framework that mediates outgoing Web requests through an explicit release contract. A dedicated restriction check grounds permission in the user's instruction; a shared protection scope aligns rewriting with disclosure checking; and candidate-grounded feedback guides revision before transmission. Experiments on Web requests with human-reviewed intent labels show improved request-contract success, while controlled comparisons and role ablations identify the contributions of restriction handling, policy evidence, and candidate checking. Evaluations of action proposals from PrivacyLens and AgentDAM demonstrate complementary protection when mediation is composed with privacy-aware agents. Experiments with smaller mediation models show that the coordination benefit persists with reduced model capacity. Dedicated-server measurements show lower mediation latency than full-policy reasoning, while real-site browser tests quantify integration overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出多智能体框架 GuardianAgentFlow，通过显式"释放契约"对 Web 智能体的出站请求进行中介，在脱敏后可发送与必须扣留之间做区分，兼顾隐私保护与任务可用性；实验表明请求-契约成功率提升，且可与隐私感知智能体互补、在小模型和真实浏览器中仍有效。
AI.motivation: Web 智能体需使用用户私有上下文完成任务，但不应过度披露。现有保护须解决两个难点：一是区分"脱敏后仍可发送"的请求与"必须扣留"的请求；二是保留授权任务所需的信息，避免过度屏蔽导致任务失败。
AI.method: GuardianAgentFlow 为多智能体中介框架，所有出站 Web 请求须通过显式 release contract（释放契约）。三项关键设计：1）专职 restriction check（限制检查）以用户指令为依据确定权限；2）共享 protection scope（保护范围）使改写与披露检查口径一致；3）candidate-grounded feedback（候选依据反馈）在发送前引导请求修订。
AI.result: 在带人工标注意图标签的 Web 请求上，request-contract 成功率提升；受控对比与角色消融实验验证了限制处理、策略证据与候选检查各自的贡献。PrivacyLens 与 AgentDAM 的动作提案评测显示，与隐私感知智能体组合时形成互补保护。较小中介模型下协作收益仍保持；专用服务器测量显示中介延迟低于完整策略推理，真实站点浏览器测试量化了集成开销。
AI.conclusion: 以释放契约为核心的显式中介机制可在保护私有上下文的同时保持授权任务的可用信息，模块化设计可解释、可与其他隐私智能体互补，并具备低延迟与工程可部署性。局限在于评估以请求-契约成功率和受控场景为主，对不同站点与任务类型的泛化性尚待进一步验证。

title: From Forecasting to World Modeling: Can Temporal Foundation Models Recover Causal Response?
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems (FMTS), non-archival. 15 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: A model that forecasts sales accurately can still mislead a retailer about how sales respond to a price change. We evaluate released tabular and time-series foundation models, as well as a foundation model pretrained specifically to estimate causal effects. We report three findings. First, forecast accuracy does not indicate the accuracy of the predicted effect of price, both on simulated data in which the true effect is known and on real retail sales records. Second, for the tabular foundation models, additional context improves forecasts but not the predicted effect of price. Third, instrumental variables, the standard remedy in econometrics, reduce this error only when supplied in a specific form and increase it for every model under confounding when supplied as raw instruments.

AI.tldr: 论文评估了表格与时序基础模型（含一个专门为因果效应估计预训练的模型）在价格效应估计上的表现，发现预测精度并不能反映价格效应估计的准确性；对表格基础模型而言，额外上下文可改善预测但不改善价格效应估计；工具变量仅在特定形式下能降低误差，以原始工具变量形式提供时在混杂情形下对所有模型都会增大误差。
AI.motivation: 准确预测销量的模型仍可能误导零售商对销量如何随价格变化的理解，即预测精度与因果效应（价格弹性）估计准确性之间存在潜在错位，而基础模型被广泛用于此类任务，需要系统检验其因果效应估计能力。
AI.method: 评估已发布的表格基础模型、时序基础模型，以及一个专门为因果效应估计而预训练的基础模型；在真实效应已知的模拟数据与真实零售销售记录上比较预测精度与价格效应估计误差，并检验额外上下文的影响以及工具变量在不同提供形式（特定形式 vs. 原始工具变量）下的作用。
AI.result: 三项发现：（1）在模拟数据与真实零售数据上，预测精度均不能指示价格效应估计的准确性；（2）对表格基础模型，更多上下文改善预测但不改善价格效应估计；（3）工具变量作为计量经济学标准补救手段，仅在以特定形式提供时降低误差，而在混杂下以原始工具变量形式提供时对所有模型都增大误差。
AI.conclusion: 高预测精度不足以作为因果价格效应估计可靠性的依据；基础模型的上下文扩展与常规工具变量用法均不能自动带来因果估计改进，需谨慎设计与验证因果建模流程。

title: FloCOS: Predicting Compact Forward Occupancy Sets of Surrounding Vehicles via Conditional Flow Matching
summary: Existing methods for predicting surrounding vehicles' forward occupancy may under-approximate the ground-truth occupancy, exposing the ego vehicle to collision risk, or produce overly conservative regions that unnecessarily restrict feasible space and cause planning failures. To address these issues, we propose FloCOS, a conditional flow-matching framework that predicts compact forward occupancy sets with high occupancy coverage. FloCOS represents the forward occupancy set as a time-varying union of half-space convex polygons parameterized by temporal basis coefficients. Conditional flow matching captures the conditional distribution of these coefficients to govern the temporal evolution of the convex components, trained under coverage and union-area losses that penalize missed occupancy and excess area. For downstream trajectory optimization, the predicted nonconvex union is directly incorporated into hyperplane-based collision-avoidance constraints. Evaluations on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset show that FloCOS generates compact forward occupancy sets with high coverage and achieves a higher interaction completion rate than evaluated baselines. Real-world vehicle experiments further confirm its ability to support collision-free planning in interactive scenarios.

AI.tldr: FloCOSS proposes a conditional flow-matching framework that predicts compact forward occupancy sets as a time-varying union of half-space convex polygons, achieving high occupancy coverage while enabling collision-free trajectory planning.
AI.motivation: Existing forward-occupancy prediction methods either under-approximate ground-truth occupancy (exposing the ego vehicle to collision risk) or produce overly conservative regions that restrict feasible space and cause planning failures.
AI.method: Represents the forward occupancy set as a time-varying union of half-space convex polygons parameterized by temporal basis coefficients; conditional flow matching captures the conditional distribution of these coefficients to govern the temporal evolution of convex components; trained with coverage and union-area losses penalizing missed occupancy and excess area; the predicted nonconvex union is directly embedded into hyperplane-based collision-avoidance constraints for downstream trajectory optimization.
AI.result: On the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, FloCoS produces compact forward occupancy sets with high coverage and achieves a higher interaction completion rate than evaluated baselines; real-world vehicle experiments confirm collision-free planning in interactive scenarios.
AI.conclusion: FloCOSS effectively balances occupancy coverage and compactness, yielding occupancy predictions well-suited for downstream nonconvex collision-avoidance constraints and interactive planning.

title: Assessing Data Center Hosting Capacity Considering Electromagnetic Transient Dynamics
summary: Hosting capacity is commonly assessed with steady-state optimization, which leaves the dynamic response of the data center and the grid at the resulting operating point untested. This paper assesses candidate data center capacities by coupling a unit commitment (UC) model with electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulation. During the capacity search, the UC model determines the economic dispatch for each tested data center capacity, and the resulting operating points are tested for settling with the generators committed online by the UC model and after a selected synchronous generator outage. Three nested capacities are obtained: the optimization-based steady-state capacity, the dynamic pre-outage capacity, and the post-outage dynamic capacity, each bounded by the previous one. On a test system with a detailed data center model, both dynamic capacities fall well below the optimization capacity, and the ranking of connection locations changes with the assessment stage and with the outage. In the most severe outage case at each candidate bus, the capacity is about 30% below the steady-state capacity. Thus, the dynamic response of the data center and the grid should be part of the hosting capacity assessment, and the comparison of connection locations should be made on the post-outage dynamic capacity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将机组组合(UC)稳态优化与电磁暂态(EMT)仿真耦合的数据中心容量评估框架，得到由稳态容量、故障前动态容量、故障后动态容量构成的三层嵌套容量，指出动态响应应纳入并网容量评估。
AI.motivation: 传统并网容量评估仅采用稳态优化，未检验数据中心与电网在所得到运行点上的动态响应，可能导致容量高估及接入位置排序失真。
AI.method: 在容量搜索过程中，用UC模型对每个候选数据中心容量确定经济调度，得到运行点；随后在UC确定的在线机组组合下，以及选定同步发电机跳闸后，用EMT仿真检验系统能否稳定（settling）。由此逐层收紧得到三个嵌套容量：稳态优化容量、故障前动态容量、故障后动态容量。
AI.result: 在含详细数据中心模型的测试系统上，两个动态容量均显著低于优化容量；接入位置排序随评估阶段和故障情形而变化；在最严重故障情形下，各候选母线的容量约比稳态容量低30%。
AI.conclusion: 数据中心与电网的动态响应应纳入并网容量评估；接入位置比较应基于故障后动态容量进行。

title: Keep Images in Sight: Visual Position Re-Anchoring for Long-Context MLLMs
summary: Long-context multimodal intelligence requires revisiting earlier images as conversations and documents accumulate, yet retaining an image does not guarantee reliable access to its details. By varying context length, redistributing a fixed text passage around the image, and changing positions without adding text, we identify the positional relation between images and questions as a direct influence on visual access. To address this gap, we propose Visual Position Re-Anchoring (VPR), a training-free method that shifts cached visual-key rotary phases toward a short-context reference before question processing. It operates directly on the existing KV cache, preserving standard attention computation without extracting attention maps or adding model forward passes. We develop static and continuous compensation schedules, using the static schedule by default. Across ten checkpoints and ten benchmarks, static VPR improves 97 of 100 model--task scores. Further analysis shows greater attention to regions containing answer evidence across six checkpoints, with minimal runtime overhead under fixed rotary frequencies. These findings demonstrate an efficient way to sustain visual access through positional adjustment within the cache.

AI.tldr: 本文发现长上下文多模态场景下，图像与问题的位置关系会直接影响模型对视觉细节的访问；提出免训练方法Visual Position Re-Anchoring (VPR)，在问题处理前将缓存视觉键的旋转相位调整至短上下文参考位置；在10个检查点×10个基准上，静态VPR使97/100个模型-任务分数提升。
AI.motivation: 长上下文多模态智能需在对话与文档累积时回溯早期图像，但"保留图像"不等于"可靠访问其细节"。作者通过三类控制实验（改变上下文长度、将固定文本段落围绕图像重新分布、不增文本仅改变位置）确认：图像与问题之间的位置关系直接影响视觉访问质量，而现有方法未针对该位置因素处理。
AI.method: 提出Visual Position Re-Anchoring (VPR)，一种免训练方法：在处理问题之前，将KV缓存中视觉键的旋转相位（RoPE）向短上下文参考位置平移。方法直接在已有KV缓存上操作，保持标准注意力计算，无需提取注意力图，也不增加额外前向传播。设计静态与连续两种补偿调度，默认采用静态调度。
AI.result: 在10个检查点与10个基准（共100个模型-任务组合）上，静态VPR提升了97个分数。进一步分析显示，在6个检查点上模型对包含答案证据区域的注意力增强；在固定旋转频率下运行时开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 通过在缓存内部进行位置调整，可高效地维持长上下文多模态场景中模型对视觉信息的访问能力，为无需训练的长上下文视觉推理提供了一种低成本、可插拔的解决路径。

title: Expanding the Decision Space of Pretrained Models through Structured Re-Decoding
summary: Native decoders limit how pretrained models combine local predictions under new structural constraints. We introduce Structured Re-Decoding (SRD), a training-free framework that constructs local candidates from model scores, samples, or external specifications, jointly optimizes their selection, and verifies reconstructed outputs. We show that candidate recombination expands feasible support and can improve attainable reward under a fixed KL divergence budget. Across molecular generation, protein design, RNA structure prediction, and antibody modeling, SRD enables improved structured inference, including verified molecules absent from the original sample pool. External chemical templates further extend SRD to noncanonical amino acids, peptide cyclization, and grammar-guided molecular construction. Preliminary experiments on a physical coherent Ising machine demonstrate the feasibility of hardware-based optimization, suggesting broader opportunities for quantum and quantum-inspired approaches to structured inference and combinatorial optimization across scientific domains.

AI.tldr: 提出无训练框架结构化重解码（SRD）：从模型分数、采样或外部规格构造局部候选，联合优化选择并验证重构输出，突破原生解码器在新结构约束下组合局部预测的限制。
AI.motivation: 原生解码器限制了预训练模型在新结构约束下如何组合局部预测，导致可行解空间受限、固定KL预算下可达奖励不足，需要一种无需训练的结构化推理改进手段。
AI.method: SRD为training-free框架：由模型分数、采样结果或外部规格生成局部候选，对候选的选择进行联合优化（组合优化式重解码），并对重构输出进行验证；外部化学模板可扩展至非规范氨基酸、肽环化与语法引导的分子构建；并在物理相干伊辛机上做初步优化可行性实验。
AI.result: 理论上证明候选重组可扩大可行支撑集，并在固定KL散度预算下提升可达奖励；实验中在分子生成、蛋白质设计、RNA结构预测与抗体建模上改进结构化推理，产生原始采样池中不存在的已验证分子；外部模板成功扩展至非规范氨基酸、肽环化与语法引导构建；相干伊辛机初步实验验证硬件优化可行性。
AI.conclusion: 候选重组式重解码是一种通用、免训练的结构化推理增强范式，可提升受约束生成质量并支持外部知识注入，且具备向量子及量子启发式硬件组合优化迁移的潜力。

title: SkinAdvisor: An AI-Driven Decision Framework for Skin Production Planning via Multi-Modal Transformer Sales Forecasting
summary: Skins, cosmetic in-game items, are a primary revenue stream for modern online games, yet production decisions (which skins to make, when to release, how to price) remain driven by intuition and retrospective analytics. We present SkinAdvisor, an AI-driven decision framework for skin production planning, powered by SkinCast, a deployed multi-modal Transformer forecasting 180-day per-day sales trajectories for unreleased skins. SkinCast couples four encoders: a pretrained Informer for player-preference time series, a pretrained Player-Hero-Skin graph embedder for relational priors, and two lightweight Transformers for skin attributes and release context, fused through a shared backbone with a local-plus-global day-x positional encoding and decoded by an N-layer Informer in a single non-autoregressive pass. SkinAdvisor plugs these forecasts into a serving pipeline (Select -> Fill -> Infer -> Sales -> ROI -> Ranking) that ranks candidate skins by forecast-based ROI and supports multi-candidate comparison. The system has been in production for a full release cycle. Offline experiments show SkinCast reduces RMSE by ~20% over the strongest baseline (Informer) and ~60% over classical methods; stress tests on a 16-core CPU server confirm p99 latency under 8ms and peak throughput above 1100 rps. We report two deployment lessons: order-of-magnitude accuracy suffices for production decisions, and pretrained embeddings can leak temporal information, requiring season-based splitting to prevent.

AI.tldr: 提出游戏皮肤生产决策框架 SkinAdvisor，其核心为已上线的多模态 Transformer 预测器 SkinCast，可预测未发布皮肤未来 180 天的逐日销量轨迹，并以预测 ROI 对候选皮肤排序。
AI.motivation: 现代在线游戏中皮肤是核心收入来源，但"做什么皮肤、何时上线、如何定价"等生产决策仍依赖直觉与事后分析，缺乏前瞻性量化支持。
AI.method: SkinCast 采用四编码器结构：预训练 Informer 编码玩家偏好时序、预训练 Player-Hero-Skin 图嵌入提供关系先验、两个轻量 Transformer 分别编码皮肤属性与发行上下文；经共享主干融合，配合局部+全局的 day-x 位置编码，由 N 层 Informer 解码器单次非自回归输出全序列。SkinAdvisor 将预测接入 Select→Fill→Infer→Sales→ROI→Ranking 服务流水线，按预测 ROI 排序并支持多候选对比。
AI.result: 已完整上线一个发行周期。离线实验中 RMSE 较最强基线 Informer 降低约 20%，较经典方法降低约 60%；16 核 CPU 服务器压力测试下 p99 延迟低于 8ms，峰值吞吐超过 1100 rps。总结两点部署经验：生产决策只需数量级精度即可；预训练嵌入可能泄漏时间信息，需用基于赛季的切分加以规避。
AI.conclusion: 该系统验证了多模态时序预测在游戏商业化决策中的可用性与工程可行性；同时提示实际部署中应关注精度需求边界与预训练嵌入的时间泄漏风险。

title: ActionCodec2: A Streaming Action Tokenizer
summary: Most action tokenizers for autoregressive vision language action (VLA) models compress motion into chunks that must be decoded in full before their actions become executable. We introduce ActionCodec2, a non-neural streaming tokenizer that releases actions incrementally while keeping trajectory reconstruction error within a prescribed tolerance. Its encoder quantizes each step relative to the decoder's reconstructed state, so the selected motion primitive corrects residual error rather than allowing errors from independently quantized increments to accumulate. Finding the smallest such primitive set is a geometric covering problem; we derive the exact minimum for translation and constant-factor-tight bounds for rotation. Set-BPE then losslessly merges co-occurring primitive symbols across coordinates and neighboring steps, without a fixed coordinate ordering. A universal version fitted on 20k hours of data from 24 embodiments averages 8.8 tokens per second for 15 Hz end-effector motion on this corpus. With the same VLA backbone, ActionCodec2 outperforms the compared tokenizers on three simulation benchmarks and in zero-shot real-robot evaluation. Its streaming representation allows policies to incorporate state feedback within an action chunk, substantially improving performance over open-loop execution under randomized dynamics, external disturbances, and moving objects. The same tokens also can serve as a direct control interface for VLM agents, which compose successful action sequences into reusable macros. These agent-built macros reduce control decisions and thinking-token usage across attempts and transfer to a held-out task. More results are available at https://zibindong.github.io/actioncodec2-page/

AI.tldr: 提出非神经流式动作分词器 ActionCodec2，以低误差增量释放动作并解码即执行。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归 VLA 的动作分词器把动作压缩成必须整体解码后才能执行的动作块，无法在执行中及时反馈状态，也限制了复用。
AI.method: 编码器以解码器已重建状态为基准对每步动作做量化，使所选运动基元修正残差而非累积误差；将最小基元集求解为几何覆盖问题，平移给出精确最小值、旋转给出常数因子紧界；再用 Set-BPE 无坐标顺序约束地对跨坐标与相邻步的共现符号做无损合并；另提供在 24 种本体、2 万小时数据上拟合的通用版本。
AI.result: 通用版在该语料 15 Hz 末端运动上平均每秒 8.8 个 token；同一 VLA 主干下，在三个仿真基准与零样本真机评测中优于对比分词器；流式表示允许策略在动作块内引入状态反馈，在随机动力学、外部扰动与移动目标下显著优于开环执行；token 亦可作为 VLM 智能体的直接控制接口，将成功动作序列组合为可复用宏，减少控制决策与思考 token 消耗并能迁移到留出任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过残差式量化与无损符号合并获得紧凑、低误差的流式动作 token，兼顾执行闭环性与智能体宏复用能力。

title: Quantifying the Cost of Restoring AC Feasibility for Approximate Optimal Power Flow Solutions
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, submitted to 2027 IEEE Power & Energy Society General Meeting
summary: Power system operations rely on approximate solutions of the AC optimal power flow problem, most notably the DC optimal power flow used in security-constrained unit commitment and economic dispatch, while convex relaxations, machine learning surrogates, and other approximations are studied extensively in the academic literature. Because these approximations neglect or relax parts of the AC power flow equations, their solutions must be adjusted before dispatch; for example, the DC optimal power flow, which neglects transmission losses, reactive power, and voltage magnitude variations, is known to produce solutions that are always infeasible. The cost of this adjustment is not adequately understood. This paper proposes a method that quantifies, for any approximate solution, the minimum cost of the adjustments that restore AC feasibility, which is a lower bound on the cost of the heuristic adjustments used in practice. We apply it to the DC optimal power flow, the second-order cone and quadratic convex relaxations, and the AC optimal power flow solved to a loose relative tolerance of $10^{-4}$ instead of $10^{-8}$. Relative to the AC optimal power flow solution obtained from a local nonlinear optimization solver, and even with the minimum adjustment, the DC optimal power flow requires adjusting, on average, generators that account for 15.6% of total generation capacity and incurs a 1.10% cost increase; the convex relaxations require more adjustment (17.2% and 16.9%) but smaller cost increases (0.68% and 0.78%); and the loose-tolerance AC optimal power flow requires 6.1% and incurs 0.42%. These results indicate significant value in operating markets directly on the AC optimal power flow, which avoids the distortion of the dispatch and prices caused by heuristic feasibility restoration.

AI.tldr: 论文提出量化任意近似AC最优潮流解"恢复可行性最小调整代价"的方法，发现DCOPF平均需调整15.6%发电容量、成本增1.10%，凸松弛调整更多但成本增幅更小，松容差AC-OPF为6.1%和0.42%，说明直接在AC-OPF上运行市场具有显著价值。
AI.motivation: 电力系统调度依赖AC最优潮流的近似解（如SCUC与经济调度中的DC-OPF，以及凸松弛、机器学习代理模型等），这些近似忽略或放松了部分AC潮流方程，其解必须经启发式调整才能调度（如DC-OPF忽略网损、无功与电压幅值变化，解恒不可行）。但这种"可行性恢复调整"的代价在文献中缺乏充分理解与量化。
AI.method: 提出一种方法，对任意给定近似解，求取使其恢复AC可行性的最小成本调整量；该值构成实际所用启发式调整成本的下界。将该方法应用于DC-OPF、二阶锥（SOC）松弛与二次凸（QC）松弛，以及仅求解到较松相对容差1e-4（而非1e-8）的AC-OPF，并以局部非线性求解器所得AC-OPF解为基准进行比较。
