AI.result: 即使在最小调整下：DC-OPF平均需调整占总发电容量15.6%的机组、成本上升1.10%；SOC与QC凸松弛需调整更多（17.2%与16.9%），但成本增幅较小（0.68%与0.78%）；松容差AC-OPF需调整6.1%、成本上升0.42%。
AI.conclusion: 近似解所需的可行性恢复调整代价显著，且会扭曲调度与价格；直接基于AC最优潮流运行市场可避免启发式可行性恢复带来的失真，具有重要价值。

title: From Seeing to Remembering: Brain-Informed Agentic Text-to-Video Generation for Enhancing Memorability
summary: Generating videos that faithfully convey intended semantics while remaining memorable to viewers is valuable for applications such as advertising, education, and storytelling. However, memorability-oriented text-to-video generation remains underexplored, as human memory involves complex neural processes that are difficult to model and translate into generation guidance. In this paper, we propose MemCrafter, brain-informed approach that enhances video memorability through iteratively agentic prompt refinement. The agentic framework contains two key components. First, we construct a cortical region-based neuro-memorability signal that predicts video memorability from estimated neural responses, providing both an optimization objective and interpretable region-level information. Second, we develop a sensitivity-aware feedback module, motivated by a conceptual sensitivity analysis of the optimization objective, to derive actionable guidance for prompt refinement while preserving semantic fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MemCrafter consistently improves predicted video memorability while maintaining semantic alignment and perceptual quality.

AI.tldr: MemCrafter：一种脑启发（brain-informed）的文本到视频生成框架，通过迭代式智能体提示词精炼提升视频记忆性。
AI.motivation: 广告、教育、叙事等应用需要既能忠实传达语义、又令观众印象深刻的视频；但面向记忆性的文本到视频生成仍鲜有研究，因为人类记忆涉及复杂神经过程，难以建模并转化为生成引导信号。
AI.method: 提出 MemCrafter，包含两个关键组件：(1) 基于皮层脑区的神经记忆性信号（cortical region-based neuro-memorability signal），从估计的神经响应预测视频记忆性，同时提供优化目标与可解释的脑区级信息；(2) 由优化目标的概念性敏感性分析（conceptual sensitivity analysis）驱动的敏感性感知反馈模块（sensitivity-aware feedback module），在保持语义保真度的前提下给出可操作的提示词精炼指导。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，MemCrafter 能持续提升预测的视频记忆性，同时保持语义对齐与感知质量。
AI.conclusion: 将神经科学先验引入智能体式提示词优化，可有效实现记忆性导向的文本到视频生成，并在记忆性、语义一致性与视觉质量之间取得平衡。

title: HyperSkill: Training-Free Omnimodal GRPO via Hypergraph-Indexed Skill-Library Evolution
summary: Reinforcement learning sharpens LLM reasoning, but parameter updates are expensive, forgetful, and opaque; training-free libraries swap gradients for a textual store but still use trajectory-level, correlation-based admission and flat structure. To address both, we propose HyperSkill, a Training-Free Omnimodal GRPO framework that keeps the backbone frozen and replaces gradient updates with auditable edits to a Hypergraph-Indexed Skill-Library, where skills are advantage-bearing nodes and compositions are hyperedges. It has three components: training-time distillation admits counterfactually checked skills and learns a protocol skill from failures; gated hypergraph retrieval injects advantage-ranked skills where a per-dataset gate admits them; and an execution protocol makes the frozen backbone commit to an answer. On 11 text, vision-language, and omnimodal benchmarks, HyperSkill is best or tied on every dataset and beats the best baseline by 13.0 average F1 points while keeping the backbone frozen. Our software and data are publicly available at https://github.com/LHRLAB/HyperSkill.

AI.tldr: HyperSkill：一种免训练的全模态 GRPO 框架，通过超图索引的技能库取代梯度更新，在 11 个基准上平均 F1 超最佳基线 13.0 点且骨干冻结。
AI.motivation: 强化学习能提升 LLM 推理，但参数更新代价高、易遗忘且不透明；现有免训练库以文本存储替代梯度，仍采用轨迹级、基于相关性的准入与扁平结构，缺乏因果校验与结构化组织。
AI.method: 冻结骨干，以对超图索引技能库的可审计编辑替代梯度更新，技能为带优势值的节点、组合为超边。含三部分：训练时蒸馏（反事实校验准入技能，并从失败中学习协议技能）、门控超图检索（按数据集级门控注入优势排序技能）、执行协议（促使冻结骨干给出确定答案）。
AI.result: 在 11 个文本、视觉-语言与全模态基准上，每个数据集均最优或并列最优，平均 F1 领先最佳基线 13.0 点，骨干保持冻结；代码与数据已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将 GRPO 式优势信号外化为结构化、可审计的技能库编辑，可在不更新参数的前提下显著提升跨模态推理性能，为免训练强化式改进提供可行范式。

title: Mask-Pattern Position Augmentation: Training-Free Long-Context Extrapolation for Diffusion LLMs
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate by iteratively unmasking tokens with bidirectional attention, but rotary position embeddings (RoPE) still confine them to a fixed pretraining window. Existing training-free extrapolation, notably LongLLaDA, copies NTK-based RoPE scaling from autoregressive (AR) models and applies one static, length-only transform at every position and denoising step. That transplant ignores a signal unique to dLLMs: the evolving mask pattern of the partially decoded sequence. We propose Mask-Pattern Position Augmentation (MPPA). MPPA linearly interpolates indices into the pretrained window, then adds a per-position, per-step offset from cumulative mask density. The offset restores rotary phase resolution that interpolation collapses, and it shrinks as tokens are committed, so late steps see near-clean interpolated geometry. On LLaDA-8B-Instruct at twice its 4096-token window, MPPA reduces perplexity from 19.51 under standard decoding to 3.12 at 8192 tokens, below the in-window figure, with 100% passkey retrieval and unchanged needle-in-a-haystack accuracy. These preliminary $2\times$ results motivate mask-conditioned position engineering as a diffusion-native path to long-context generation.

AI.tldr: 提出Mask-Pattern Position Augmentation（MPPA），一种无需训练的扩散LLM长度外推方法：在位置索引线性插值基础上，按每位置、每去噪步的累积掩码密度叠加偏移量，使LLaDA-8B在2×窗口（8192 tokens）下困惑度从19.51降至3.12。
AI.motivation: 扩散LLM（dLLM）虽以双向注意力迭代解掩码生成，但RoPE仍将其限制在预训练窗口内。现有免训练外推方法LongLLaDA直接照搬自回归模型的NTK-RoPE缩放，在每个位置、每个去噪步施加同一个仅依赖长度的静态变换，忽略了dLLM独有的信号——部分解码序列的动态掩码模式。
AI.method: MPPA先将位置索引线性插值映射回预训练窗口，再依据累积掩码密度为每个位置、每个去噪步生成额外偏移量。该偏移补偿因插值而被压缩的旋转相位分辨率，并随token逐步确定而衰减，使后期步骤接近干净序列的插值几何。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-8B-Instruct上，将4096 tokens窗口扩展至2×（8192 tokens），标准解码困惑度为19.51，MPPA降至3.12，低于窗口内水平；passkey检索通过率100%，needle-in-a-haystack准确率保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 初步的2×外推结果支持将掩码条件化的位置编码设计作为扩散原生（diffusion-native）的长上下文生成路径。

title: What Makes a VLA Reactive? A Study of Execution Strategies for Dynamic Manipulation
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, Efficient Foundation Models for Real-Time Embodied AI, CoRL 2026 Workshop
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict chunks of future actions, and when objects move, those chunks go stale before they are executed. We study what makes a pretrained VLA reactive, using \pihalf{} on two dynamic simulation benchmarks and three real-robot tasks. We vary the prediction and execution horizons, compare synchronous and asynchronous inference, test methods that deliver actions sooner or keep successive chunks continuous, and adapt the policy with motion cues and latent-space reinforcement learning. The best prediction horizon is about one second, and the best execution horizon depends on the checkpoint. Short horizons help more with asynchronous execution, and methods that keep the trajectory continuous outperform those that only reduce latency. Adapting the policy repairs targeted failures, but on the conveyor task changing the execution horizon gained as much. Reactivity depends on the execution pipeline as much as on the policy, so both should be evaluated together.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了预训练VLA模型在动态环境中的反应性来源：最优预测时域约1秒，最优执行时域取决于具体checkpoint；异步执行下短时域收益更大；保持轨迹连续性的方法优于仅降低延迟的方法；执行流水线与策略本身共同决定反应性，应联合评估。
AI.motivation: VLA模型预测未来动作块，当物体移动时动作块在执行前就失效（过期），导致动态场景下的反应性不足。作者希望厘清究竟是什么让预训练VLA具备反应性——是策略本身还是执行流水线。
AI.method: 在π0.5（π-half）模型上，于两个动态仿真基准和三个真实机器人任务上开展受控实验：变动预测时域与执行时域；对比同步与异步推理；测试更快送达动作（降低延迟）与保持相邻动作块连续性的方法；并通过动作线索（motion cues）与隐空间强化学习进行策略适配。
AI.result: 最优预测时域约1秒；最优执行时域依赖checkpoint；短时域在异步执行下收益更明显；保持轨迹连续的方法优于单纯降延迟的方法；策略适配能修复特定失败模式，但在传送带任务上，仅调整执行时域即可取得同等提升。
AI.conclusion: VLA的反应性不仅取决于策略，也同等取决于执行流水线；因此二者必须联合评估。工程层面的时域与流水线设计是可观的性能杠杆，甚至可与策略微调效果相当。

title: Scalable Reference Electrical Architectures for Modern Data Centers
summary: The rapid growth of cloud computing, artificial intelligence (AI), and high-performance computing is driving the deployment of data centers with electrical demands ranging from tens of megawatts to multi-gigawatt campuses, creating significant challenges for utility interconnection and power system planning. This paper presents scalable, vendor-neutral reference electrical architectures for colocation, hyperscale, and AI data centers. The proposed framework integrates modular Power PODs, hierarchical HV/MV/LV distribution, standby generation, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), battery energy storage systems (BESS), and scalable utility interfaces into a unified planning methodology. Three representative Power POD configurations are developed to support systematic capacity expansion while maintaining consistent electrical topology and equipment sizing. The proposed architectures facilitate utility interconnection studies, equipment demand forecasting, transmission planning, and grid infrastructure assessment, providing an open and reproducible benchmark for evaluating the impacts of large-scale data center deployment on future power systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向托管型、超大规模及AI数据中心的可扩展、厂商中立的参考电气架构，将模块化Power POD、HV/MV/LV分层配电、备用发电、UPS、BESS与可扩展电网接口整合为统一的规划方法，并给出三种代表性Power POD配置以支撑系统性容量扩展。
AI.motivation: 云计算、AI与高性能计算的快速增长使数据中心用电需求从数十兆瓦扩展至多吉瓦级园区，给电网互联与电力系统规划带来显著挑战；同时缺乏开放、可复现、厂商中立的参考电气架构作为评估基准。
AI.method: 构建统一的规划方法：集成模块化Power POD、HV/MV/LV分层配电、备用发电、UPS、电池储能系统（BESS）及可扩展的电网接口；设计三种代表性Power POD配置，在保持电气拓扑与设备选型一致的前提下支持系统性容量扩展。
AI.result: 所提架构可支持电网互联研究、设备需求预测、输电规划与电网基础设施评估，并为评估大规模数据中心部署对未来电力系统的影响提供开放、可复现的基准。
AI.conclusion: 该模块化、厂商中立的参考电气架构为数据中心负荷接入电网的规划与影响评估提供了统一框架，有助于标准化互联研究与系统级分析。

title: Toward Cross-Rubric Surgical Skill Assessment via Joint Embedding Prediction
summary: Expert review of surgical videos is essential for surgical training but labor-intensive, motivating AI-assisted skill assessment to provide feedback at scale. Although surgical assessment rubrics may use different language to describe similar skills, existing automated methods commonly predict predefined skill levels or numerical scores tied to fixed rubrics, limiting their ability to transfer across semantically equivalent assessment criteria. We propose Predictive Rubric Alignment (PRA), a joint embedding prediction approach that scores surgical videos using natural-language descriptions of skill levels. Rather than matching level probabilities, PRA predicts a rater-weighted combination of skill-level description embeddings. Adjacent description features define a score-parameterized path, and the predicted embedding is projected onto this path to read the score. We introduce two variants: \textit{PRA-item}, which uses learned queries for predefined assessment items, and \textit{PRA-cond}, which generates queries from textual item names to enable assessment of unseen items without retraining. On AIxSuture, a dataset of expert-rated suturing videos, PRA outperforms published baselines in skill classification. We further evaluate zero-shot transfer to the smaller surgical skill assessment benchmark JIGSAWS. Trained on only two AIxSuture rubric items, PRA-cond assesses unseen JIGSAWS items without further training, yielding positive score correlations and greater Grad-CAM overlap with instruments and suture than a description-matching baseline. These results support predictive rubric alignment as a promising direction for flexible and explainable automated surgical skill assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出预测性评分表对齐（PRA）方法，用技能等级的自然语言描述嵌入的加权组合来为手术视频打分，并推出PRA-item与PRA-cond两种变体，实现跨评分表迁移与零样本评估。
AI.motivation: 手术视频专家评审对培训至关重要但耗时费力，需要可扩展的AI辅助技能评估。现有自动方法通常预测与固定评分表绑定的预设技能等级或数值分数，难以在语义等价但表述不同的评估标准之间迁移。
AI.method: PRA是一种联合嵌入预测方法：不直接匹配等级概率，而是预测由评分者加权的技能等级描述嵌入组合；相邻等级描述特征构成一条由分数参数化的路径，将预测嵌入投影到该路径上读取分数。变体PRA-item使用预定义评估项的学习查询；PRA-cond由文本评估项名称生成查询，从而无需重训即可评估未见评估项。采用Grad-CAM进行可解释性分析。
AI.result: 在专家评级的AIxSuture缝合视频数据集上，PRA在技能分类上优于已发表基线；在JIGSAWS基准上，仅用两个AIxSuture评分项训练的PRA-cond可对未见JIGSAWS评估项零样本评分，获得正的分数相关性，且Grad-CAM在器械与缝线上的重叠优于描述匹配基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持预测性评分表对齐是灵活且可解释的自动化手术技能评估的有前景方向。

title: WordInferBench: Can Agents Infer How to Edit from Word Document Context?
summary: Document editing is among the most common knowledge-work tasks, yet existing benchmarks for evaluating autonomous agents on Word document editing provide fully specified attribute-modification instructions. They do not evaluate agents' ability to infer the appropriate attributes from document context, a capability essential in real-world editing where users expect consistency without spelling out every attribute. We introduce WordInferBench, a benchmark comprising 280 base document-editing instances, each paired with three instruction conditions: descriptive (the instruction explicitly lists every attribute change), referential (the instruction points to another object as an exemplar), and inferential (the agent must examine document context to infer what attributes to apply). To evaluate contextual attribute inference, each base instance is constructed so that the target formatting is recoverable from an in-document exemplar. The instances are derived from real Word documents collected from Common Crawl and cover 13 object types and 81 attributes. We evaluate six recent coding-agent systems and find that the best-performing evaluated system, Claude Code with Opus 4.6, achieves a 62.9% task-level pass rate on descriptive variants but only 40.7% on inferential variants, indicating that current systems complete tasks less reliably when the required formatting changes must be determined from document context.

AI.tldr: 提出 WordInferBench：280 个基础文档编辑实例×3 种指令条件（描述式/指代式/推断式），揭示智能体在需从文档上下文推断属性的场景下表现显著下降。
AI.motivation: 现有 Word 文档编辑基准给出的指令完全指明属性改动，未评估智能体从文档上下文中推断应施加何种属性的能力；而真实编辑中用户期望风格一致却不会逐一说明每个属性。
AI.method: 构建 WordInferBench：280 个基础实例，每个配三种指令条件——描述式（显式列出全部属性变更）、指代式（以另一对象为范例进行指代）、推断式（需检视文档上下文推断属性）。每个实例经构造使目标格式可从文档内范例恢复；实例源自 Common Crawl 采集的真实 Word 文档，覆盖 13 类对象、81 个属性。评测 6 个近期 coding-agent 系统。
AI.result: 表现最佳的 Claude Code + Opus 4.6 在描述式变体上任务级通过率 62.9%，在推断式变体上仅 40.7%。
AI.conclusion: 当所需格式变更须由文档上下文确定时，当前智能体完成任务可靠性明显下降，上下文属性推断是亟待补强的能力维度。

title: AROMA: Adaptive Representation-Oriented Multimodal Actuation for Vision-Language Model Control
summary: Mechanistic localization does not by itself yield usable control: causal sensitivity may occupy little activation energy, an accurate local direction may fail at finite scale, and a reachable numeral target may be wrong. We introduce AROMA (Adaptive Representation-Oriented Multimodal Actuation), a frozen-VLM control framework separating where to intervene, which geometry and gain to use, how to reach a target, which target to pursue, and when to act. In Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct, four dimensions of a causally validated cross-attention head explain 89.82% of cardinality sensitivity but only 9.52% of median activation energy; magnitude-normalized causal subspace actuation converts this mismatch into finite control, improving exact-count accuracy on untouched procedural data by +8.00 pp. Iterative Minimal-Effort Actuation (MEA) reaches 81.25% of oracle targets versus 15.18% for a frozen direction under matched step budgets. With target and gate frozen before evaluation, targeted MEA improves the previous frozen policy from 34.444% to 38.730% on a new natural Stage-2 cohort (N=630; paired p=4.63e-7) and yields 65.741% versus 65.153% over all 7,992 examples while editing only 63 inputs. Prospective routing, replication across heads and models, and comparisons with attribution-steering baselines further characterize each stage, separating localization, actuation, reachability, target quality, and selective deployment as distinct control problems.

AI.tldr: 提出AROMA框架，将冻结VLM的可控干预拆解为"在哪里干预、用何种几何与增益、如何到达目标、追求哪个目标、何时行动"五个独立控制问题，并证明机制定位本身不等于可用控制。
AI.motivation: 现有研究把机制可解释性定位（如找到因果敏感的头/方向）直接当作可控制性，但因果敏感性可能只占很小的激活能量、局部方向在有限尺度下失效、可达的数值目标本身可能是错误的。
AI.method: AROMA（自适应表征导向多模态驱动）在Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct上：对经因果验证的跨注意力头做幅度归一化的因果子空间驱动；提出迭代最小努力驱动（MEA）逐步逼近目标；并在评估前冻结目标与门控实现选择性部署；辅以前瞻性路由、多头多模型复现及归因引导（attribution steering）基线对比。
AI.result: 因果验证头仅四个维度解释89.82%的基数敏感性却只占9.52%的中位激活能量；幅度归一化驱动将错配转为有限控制，在未触碰的程序化数据上精确计数准确率+8.00pp；MEA达到81.25%的oracle目标命中率，而冻结方向仅15.18%；冻结目标与门控后，新自然Stage-2队列（N=630, 配对p=4.63e-7）由34.444%提升至38.730%，全量7,992例为65.741% vs 65.153%，且仅编辑63个输入。
AI.conclusion: 定位、驱动、可达性、目标质量与选择性部署是彼此独立的控制问题；机制定位仅为必要非充分条件，需配合幅度归一化几何、最小努力迭代、目标筛选与门控才能形成可用的冻结模型控制。

title: Reading the Table: Sim-to-Real Game State Detection for the Chef's Hat Card Game
comment: Presented at the Dungeons, Neurons, and Dialogues workshop (DnD-SIDC 2026) at ICANN 2026, https://dnd-sidc.github.io/
summary: Tabletop games offer a compelling scenario to study the interaction between artificial and human agents, combining social interaction with game state tracking and physical manipulation. To assess the game state, a robot needs to precisely detect closely related game objects, such as different card designs, requiring dedicated training data that is costly to annotate in the real world. Instead, we develop a fully automated synthetic data collection pipeline, using re-projection of known 3D coordinates to generate labels automatically and domain randomization to bridge the reality gap. This approach is used to collect a dataset of 25413 samples to finetune an object detection and a segmentation model, which are combined to assign detected cards to game-relevant zones and infer the game state. When evaluated on a real NICO humanoid robot, our pipeline achieves an F1-score of 0.906 for card-to-zone assignment, thus providing the perceptual foundation for a robot that can autonomously play Chef's Hat against human players.

AI.tldr: 提出全自动合成数据采集流水线：利用已知3D坐标重投影自动生成标注并结合域随机化弥合虚实差距，采集25413样本微调检测与分割模型，在真实NICO人形机器人上实现0.906的卡牌-区域分配F1分数，为机器人自主与人类玩Chef's Hat提供感知基础。
AI.motivation: 桌面游戏是研究人机交互的理想场景（兼具社交互动、状态跟踪与物理操作）。但机器人需精确检测外观相近的游戏物体（如不同卡牌图案），真实世界标注专用训练数据成本高昂。
AI.method: 构建全自动合成数据采集流水线：利用已知3D坐标重投影自动生成标签，并采用域随机化缩小虚实域差距；据此采集25413个样本微调目标检测与分割模型，将二者结合以把检测到的卡牌分配到游戏相关区域并推断游戏状态。
AI.result: 在真实NICO人形机器人上评估，卡牌到区域的分配取得F1分数0.906，支撑机器人自主与人类玩家对弈Chef's Hat。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据+自动标注+域随机化可低成本替代真实标注，为桌面游戏场景下的机器人感知与游戏状态推断提供可行且有效的方案。

title: Adaptive Model Predictive Control for Damping IBR-Induced SSOs
summary: We propose an adaptive model predictive control (MPC) approach to damp sub-synchronous oscillations (SSOs) induced by grid-following (GFL) inverter-based resources (IBRs). Unlike traditional model predictive controller designed considering the nominal plant that may not perform well in other conditions, we use plants that alter with changing operating point. To capture the plant dynamics, we use recursive least squares (RLS) based system identification with variable forgetting factor. This approach allows us to discount past data and avoid bias caused by large transient outliers while performing system identification. We present a proof of the convergence of the model parameters in the presence of finite outliers. We propose to update the model inside the MPC optimization problem periodically after a predetermined time interval instead of each sampling instant since the operating point changes slowly in a practical power system. The MPC design allows us to directly impose constraints on control inputs so that the IBR current limits are respected. Our approach also addresses the issue of unavailability of IBR models. We show the accuracy of the system identification and the superior performance of the proposed controller on the modified IEEE $4$-machine system and the modified IEEE $68$-bus system as compared with the traditional MPC.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自适应模型预测控制（MPC）方法抑制构网跟随型（GFL）逆变器型资源（IBR）引发的次同步振荡（SSO）；采用带可变遗忘因子的递推最小二乘（RLS）在线辨识被控对象，并在MPC中周期性更新模型，以尊重IBR电流限幅，且无需已知IBR模型。
AI.motivation: 传统MPC基于标称模型设计，在运行点变化时性能下降；同时实际电力系统中IBR模型往往不可得。GFL型IBR引发的次同步振荡需要控制器在运行点缓慢变化下仍保持鲁棒且满足电流约束。
AI.method: 采用随运行点变化的被控对象模型；使用带可变遗忘因子的RLS进行系统辨识，通过折扣旧数据并抑制大瞬态离群点带来的偏差；证明在存在有限离群点情况下模型参数的收敛性；在MPC优化中按预定时长周期性更新模型（而非每个采样时刻），因实际系统运行点变化缓慢；MPC设计可直接对控制输入施加约束以尊重IBR电流限值；方法不依赖IBR具体模型。
AI.result: 在修改后的IEEE 4机系统和修改后的IEEE 68节点系统上验证：系统辨识精度良好，所提控制器相比传统MPC具有更优的SSO抑制性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于可变遗忘因子RLS的自适应MPC可在模型未知、运行点变化的条件下有效抑制GFL型IBR引发的次同步振荡，并保证IBR电流约束，优于基于标称模型的传统MPC。

title: Duo: A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction
summary: In this report, we introduce the Reciprocal World Model (RWM) and present Duo v1, a full-duplex world model that continuously perceives audiovisual inputs while responding to users in real time. The RWM treats intelligence and physical reality as equally fundamental to what constitutes a world. Existing world models largely focus on simulating the latter, leaving reasoning and decision-making as external controls rather than intrinsic parts of the world itself. In RWM, we identify two equally fundamental capabilities: Intent, which provides the cognition underlying world interactions, and Realization, which generates coherent audio-visual behavior. To realize this formulation, Duo v1 introduces three key technical designs: (1) Leveraging autoregressive modeling for continuous interaction reasoning and participation decisions, rather than restricting it to instruction understanding for diffusion models. (2) Constructing chunk-specific conditions and synchronize tokens across Intent and Realization on a unified timeline. Module-specific attention masks enforce causal dependencies both within and across chunks, preventing access to future inputs. (3) Mitigating distribution shift in both modules through dual rollout distillation, training on autoregressively generated Intent tokens and synthesized audiovisual histories from Realization. Both modules continuously perceive real-time audio, video, and text, enabling full-duplex interaction with spontaneous conversations and interruptions. Beyond conversation, users can share real objects, reshape virtual scenes, guide assistants, or play audiovisual games without mouse or keyboard controls. The release of Duo v1 makes our first step, with the next version coming soon. We look forward to broader exploration of this emerging field.

AI.tldr: 提出互惠世界模型（RWM）框架，将"智能"与"物理现实"视为同等基础，并据此实现全双工世界模型 Duo v1：持续感知音视频输入并实时回应用户。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型主要聚焦于模拟物理现实，而将推理与决策作为外部控制手段，未将其视为世界的内在组成部分。作者提出应将智能与现实并列为世界的两大基本要素。
AI.method: RWM 将能力划分为 Intent（交互背后的认知）与 Realization（生成连贯音视频行为）两项同等基础能力。Duo v1 采用三项关键设计：(1) 用自回归建模承担连续交互推理与参与决策，而非仅作为扩散模型的指令理解模块；(2) 构建分块（chunk）特定条件，并在统一时间轴上同步 Intent 与 Realization 的 token，通过模块专属注意力掩码在块内与跨块施加因果依赖，禁止访问未来输入；(3) 采用双重 rollout 蒸馏（dual rollout distillation），在自回归生成的 Intent token 与 Realization 合成的音视频历史上训练，以缓解两个模块的分布偏移。
AI.result: 两个模块均可持续感知实时音频、视频与文本，实现支持自发对话与打断的全双工交互；除对话外，用户还可共享真实物体、重塑虚拟场景、引导助手或进行音视频游戏，无需鼠标键盘控制。
AI.conclusion: Duo v1 是迈向 RWM 的第一步，后续版本即将发布，作者期待该新兴领域得到更广泛探索。

title: AFTER: A World Model with Adaptive Fast--Slow Timescales for Error-Driven Retention
summary: In robotics and embodied AI, a core challenge for world models is adapting to sudden, persistent, yet initially unknown changes in robot dynamics during interaction. For instance, when a robotic arm grasps an object with an unknown payload, the robot dynamics change suddenly. If the world model fails to adapt, its prediction errors accumulate over the open-loop rollout and ultimately mislead the robot's actions. Existing world models, however, struggle to simultaneously satisfy three critical requirements for dynamics adaptation: responsiveness, reacting promptly to sudden changes to curb prediction error accumulation; stability, distinguishing persistent changes from transient disturbances to prevent incorrect updates; and persistence, retaining the adapted dynamics without new observations so that later predictions do not revert to the old dynamics. Inspired by predictive coding in the human brain with multi-timescale adaptation, we propose AFTER-WM, a world model with Adaptive Fast-slow Timescales for Error-driven Retention, whose prediction errors drive a fast correction that fades and a slow correction that persists, while dynamically adjusting the combination weights of pre-trained experts without altering them, to overcome the trade-offs among responsiveness, stability and persistence. On five simulated robot datasets and real UAV data, AFTER-WM has a lower multi-step mean error than all ten compared models and the highest mean return in a joint-failure control task. In simulation, its multistep mean error is 16%-34% below the strongest compared model's and is also the lowest 1-4 steps after a change and under transient disturbances alone, and its step-40 error is the lowest as well, reflecting responsiveness, stability and persistence. All code (method, baselines, experiments) and datasets will be released online.

AI.tldr: 提出 AFTER-WM，一种受大脑预测编码多时间尺度适应启发的世界模型：由预测误差驱动"快速修正（会衰减）"与"慢速修正（持久保留）"，并在不改动预训练专家参数的前提下动态调节专家组合权重，从而同时兼顾响应性、稳定性与持久性。
AI.motivation: 机器人在交互中会遇到突发、持续且初始未知的动力学变化（如抓取未知负载），若世界模型不能适应，开环 rollout 中预测误差累积并误导动作。现有世界模型难以同时满足动力学适应的三项要求：响应性（及时反应以抑制误差累积）、稳定性（区分持续变化与瞬态扰动，避免误更新）、持久性（无新观测时仍保留已适应的动力学，不回退到旧动力学）。
AI.method: 借鉴人脑预测编码的多时间尺度适应机制，构建快-慢自适应时间尺度世界模型：预测误差驱动一个快速衰减的修正项和一个持久保留的慢速修正项，并动态调整预训练专家的组合权重（专家本身参数冻结）。
AI.result: 在五个仿真机器人数据集与真实无人机数据上，AFTER-WM 的多步平均误差低于全部十个对比模型，并在联合失效控制任务中取得最高平均回报。仿真中多步平均误差比最强基线低 16%–34%；在变化后第 1–4 步以及仅存在瞬态扰动时误差最低，第 40 步误差同样最低，分别体现响应性、稳定性与持久性。
AI.conclusion: 快-慢双时间尺度加误差驱动的专家权重动态组合，可有效化解响应性、稳定性与持久性之间的权衡，在仿真与真实平台数据上均优于现有世界模型；代码（方法、基线、实验）与数据集将开源。

title: PhysXAI: A Theoretical Framework for Diagnosing Physical Hallucinations in Weather Foundation Models
summary: Modern machine learning models for global weather forecasting achieve remarkable predictive accuracy, yet they frequently produce states that violate fundamental physical laws, including conservation of mass, hydrostatic balance, or spectral energy scaling. We term these outputs physical hallucinations and propose PhysXAI, a rigorous diagnostic framework that detects, localises, and attributes such inconsistencies. Unlike existing post-hoc metric suites, PhysXAI is a learnable system that explicitly decouples forecast error from physical plausibility. We formalise the problem through a novel joint condition on numerical and physical residuals, and introduce a multi-branch encoder that extracts representations from conservation, dynamical, spectral, cross-variable, and spatiotemporal residuals. A key innovation is a physics-consistency contrastive learning objective, which we theoretically show the latent representation to be approximately isometric to the physical residual space, ensuring that diagnostic decisions remain grounded in physically meaningful deviations. We further derive an adaptive multi-objective loss with gradient-based weighting to balance competing diagnostic objectives. The framework produces spatially resolved hallucination maps, violation-type classifications, and calibrated Bayesian uncertainty, enabling both detection and interpretable attribution of physical inconsistencies. We conduct a comprehensive comparative evaluation of PhysXAI across ERA5, WeatherBench 2, and MERRA-2, using forecasts from GraphCast, Pangu-Weather, and NeuralGCM, with Python-written code and a fully reproducible experimental protocol. Our theoretical analysis and empirical evaluation establish PhysXAI as a principled framework for diagnosing physical hallucinations and advancing trustworthy AI for weather forecasting.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PhysXAI，一个可学习的物理幻觉诊断框架，用于检测、定位并归因全球天气预报AI模型输出中违反质量守恒、静力平衡、谱能量标度等物理定律的状态；通过联合数值与物理残差条件、多分支编码器与物理一致性对比学习，并输出空间化幻觉图、违规类型分类与贝叶斯不确定度。
AI.motivation: 现代机器学习全球天气预报模型预测精度高，但常产生违反基本物理定律的输出（作者称为"物理幻觉"）。现有的事后指标套件无法将预报误差与物理合理性解耦，也缺乏可解释的违规定位与归因能力。
AI.method: 1）以新颖的数值残差与物理残差的联合条件形式化问题；2）构建多分支编码器，从守恒、动力学、谱、跨变量、时空五类残差中提取表示；3）提出物理一致性对比学习目标，理论上证明潜表示近似等距同构于物理残差空间，使诊断决策扎根于有物理意义的偏差；4）推导带梯度加权（基于梯度的权重分配）的自适应多目标损失以平衡竞争性诊断目标；5）输出空间分辨的幻觉图、违规类型分类与校准的贝叶斯不确定度。评估在ERA5、WeatherBench 2、MERRA-2数据集上进行，使用GraphCast、Pangu-Weather、NeuralGCM的预报结果，代码为Python且实验协议完全可复现。
AI.result: 理论上证明了物理一致性对比学习下潜表示与物理残差空间的近似等距性；实证上在三个数据集与三个模型上完成全面对比评估，验证PhysXAI可有效检测物理幻觉并给出可解释的违规归因。
AI.conclusion: 理论分析与实证评估共同确立了PhysXAI作为诊断物理幻觉的原则性框架，有助于推进天气预报中可信AI的发展。

title: Generalized Inverse Kinematics via Conditional Flow
summary: Inverse kinematics (IK) is a foundational primitive in robotics, mapping the task-space objectives expressed by higher-level planners to robot configurations that realize them. Traditional IK methods generally treat each query as an isolated pose-to-configuration problem, but planners often need a distribution over valid realizations that accounts for future reachability and preferences such as collision avoidance and stability. We introduce GenGenIK, a generative modeling approach that supports mobile bases, multiple end-effectors and targets, scene awareness, and preferences over robot behavior within a common interface. Experiments show that GenGenIK outperforms existing methods in both solve rate and runtime across tasks such as bimanual lift and flip-up, while allowing flexible control over the sampled distribution and remaining effective under partial scene observations. Website: https://icra-2027-gengenik.github.io/.

AI.tldr: GenGenIK：面向机器人逆运动学的生成式建模方法，统一支持移动底盘、多末端执行器与多目标、场景感知及行为偏好，在求解率与运行时间上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统逆运动学（IK）将每次查询视为孤立的位姿到构型映射，仅求解单一位姿；而高层规划器往往需要有效构型的分布，以兼顾未来可达性以及避障、稳定性等偏好。
AI.method: 提出生成式建模方法 GenGenIK，在统一接口下建模构型分布，支持移动基座、多末端执行器与多目标、场景感知以及机器人行为偏好，并可对采样分布进行灵活控制。
AI.result: 在双臂举升（bimanual lift）、翻起（flip-up）等任务上，GenGenIK 的求解率与运行时间均优于现有方法；在部分场景观测下仍保持有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将 IK 重构为条件生成建模问题可同时获得更高的求解效率与分布可控性，为面向规划器的 IK 提供通用接口。

title: Robust Safe Control Under Uncertainty: Estimation, Contraction, and Regret Bounds
comment: 15 pages, temporary, (optional) simulation to be added
summary: Disturbance uncertainty requires safety filters based on control barrier functions (CBFs) to leave a robustness margin, which can alter the nominal control input and degrade closed-loop performance. This paper studies safety and the resulting performance loss for discrete-time nonlinear systems with additive disturbances and polytopic input constraints. We develop a causal disturbance observer and construct two robust barrier conditions. The first uses a time-dependent bound on the estimation error. The second uses a constant margin when the disturbance increments are uniformly bounded and moves the requirement on the initial error from the online filter to an explicit initialization condition. For affine barriers, both filters are quadratic programs. We bound their input deviations from an oracle filter with access to the current disturbance and derive sufficient conditions for uniform contraction of the oracle closed loop. The contraction analysis accounts for state-dependent actuation, unmatched disturbances, and active physical input limits. Combining the sensitivity and contraction estimates gives finite-time dynamic regret bounds that quantify the effects of observer convergence, disturbance variation, and robustness margins. With sublinear cumulative certified disturbance variation and observer innovation error, the bounds yield sublinear regret.

AI.tldr: 针对含加性扰动与多面体输入约束的离散时间非线性系统，设计基于因果扰动观测器的两类鲁棒控制障碍函数(CBF)安全滤波器，并量化其相对oracle滤波器的性能损失，给出有限时间动态遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 扰动不确定性迫使CBF安全滤波器预留鲁棒裕度，这会改变名义控制输入并降低闭环性能；因此需要刻画鲁棒滤波器带来的安全性—性能折衷，并定量分析其性能损失。
AI.method: 1) 构造因果扰动观测器；2) 构建两种鲁棒障碍条件：其一基于估计误差的时变界，其二在扰动增量一致有界时采用常数裕度，并将初始误差要求由在线滤波转移为显式初始化条件；3) 对仿射障碍，二者均化为二次规划(QP)；4) 推导相对"可获知当前扰动的oracle滤波器"的输入偏差界；5) 给出oracle闭环一致收缩的充分条件，分析涵盖状态依赖执行、非匹配扰动与物理输入限幅；6) 结合敏感性与收缩估计导出有限时间动态遗憾界。
AI.result: 得到两类QP形式的鲁棒安全滤波器及输入偏差上界；建立了oracle闭环一致收缩的充分条件；给出显式有限时间动态遗憾界，量化观测器收敛、扰动变化与鲁棒裕度的影响；当累积认证扰动变化量与观测器新息误差均为次线性时，遗憾界为次线性。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒CBF滤波器的性能损失可被严格分解为观测器收敛、扰动变化与鲁棒裕度三部分；在扰动变化温和的条件下，安全滤波仍可保证次线性动态遗憾，即渐近意义上不牺牲最优性。

title: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction Using V-JEPA Features
comment: 29 pages, 11 figures. Source code is available at https://github.com/Anwarshamim01/multi-view-3d-reconstruction-using-v-jepa-features
summary: Predictive video encoders provide dense visual representations, but adapting them to 3D reconstruction requires accurate depth, camera poses, and cross-view geometry. We study supervised RGB-only multi-view reconstruction using an architecture that combines video-pretrained features, camera estimation, scene aggregation, epipolar transport, and residual pointmaps. Experiments compare global and spatial camera regression with joint relative objectives on CO3D, alongside an independently trained TUM RGB-D model. On 168 CO3D five-view windows, the spatial-camera configuration achieves 29.3% lower absolute trajectory error than the global-camera configuration, but performs worse than identity poses in trajectory error and worse than the global configuration in depth error. The joint relative-objective configuration improves normalized intrinsics error and similarity-aligned Chamfer distance from 0.6447 to 0.5573, but increases raw Chamfer distance from 3.5535 to 4.4374. On 163 indoor windows, camera error is 0.3063 m versus 0.3694 m for identity poses, while depth error is 0.4279 versus 0.2516 for constant median depth. Refinement worsens indoor camera error, and additional experiments show competing depth and pose effects. Overall, the results distinguish representation adaptation, aligned shape, and raw reconstruction, highlighting the need for isolated component and encoder comparisons before attributing reconstruction gains to predictive video pretraining.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了基于视频预训练编码器的监督式RGB多视角3D重建架构，比较全局/空间相机回归与联合相对目标，并引入独立训练的TUM RGB-D模型作对照。结果显示空间相机配置在CO3D上轨迹误差较全局配置降低29.3%，但在轨迹上劣于恒等位姿、在深度上劣于全局配置；联合相对目标改善了归一化内参与对齐Chamfer距离，却使原始Chamfer距离变大。室内数据中相机误差为0.3063 m（恒等位姿0.3694 m），深度误差0.4279（常数中值深度0.2516），精化反而恶化室内相机误差。作者强调需先做隔离式组件与编码器对比，才能把重建增益归因于视频预训练。
AI.motivation: 预测式视频编码器能提供稠密视觉表征，但迁移到3D重建需要准确的深度、相机位姿与跨视角几何；现有工作常将重建增益直接归因于视频预训练，缺乏对表征适配、几何对齐与原始重建质量的区分与隔离验证。
AI.method: 采用仅RGB的监督式多视角重建架构，串联视频预训练特征、相机估计、场景聚合、对极传输与残差pointmap；在CO3D上对比全局相机回归与空间相机回归，并引入联合相对目标；另训练独立的TUM RGB-D模型。评估使用168个CO3D五视图窗口与163个室内窗口，报告ATE、内参误差、原始与相似变换对齐后的Chamfer距离、深度误差，并与恒等位姿、常数中值深度等基线对照，同时进行精化与组件/编码器隔离实验。
AI.result: CO3D五视图窗口：空间相机配置ATE比全局配置低29.3%，但ATE劣于恒等位姿、深度误差劣于全局配置；联合相对目标使归一化内参误差与相似对齐Chamfer距离由0.6447改善至0.5573，但原始Chamfer距离由3.5535升至4.4374。室内163窗口：相机误差0.3063 m（恒等位姿0.3694 m），深度误差0.4279（常数中值深度0.2516）。精化使室内相机误差变差，附加实验显示深度与位姿存在相互竞争效应。
AI.conclusion: 结果需在三个层面区分：表征适配、对齐后形状质量与原始重建质量。空间相机回归与联合相对目标带来的收益并不一致，且常被简单基线反超；因此应在归因于预测式视频预训练之前，先完成孤立的组件级与编码器级对比实验，避免将架构或对齐效应误判为预训练收益。

title: guardscope: Measuring Which Actions Runtime Controls Check in LLM Agent Systems
summary: Large-language model (LLM) agents execute actions on external systems through tool calls, and enterprises deploy runtime controls, such as agent gateways, to check this behavior in real time. However, a control can only evaluate the actions that cross the point where it is placed, and an agent can act through more paths than the tool-call channel; no existing work measures this coverage against kernel-level ground truth. In this paper, we present guardscope, a framework that makes this coverage measurable. guardscope works in two stages: a static stage that predicts which of an agent's 15 action paths a control can check from its source, and an empirical stage that runs a fixed workload on a deployment that realizes one of eight topology designs and classifies every executed action as checked, bypassed, or prevented by reconciling the control's decision records against kernel-level ground truth. guardscope makes a control's coverage claim verifiable: a runtime control developer can publish which paths its product inspects under a kernel-verified protocol. We conducted experiments with two agent harnesses and real runtime controls, including Microsoft's agent governance toolkit and agentgateway. guardscope is available at https://github.com/VulcanLab/guardscope.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 guardscope，一个用于度量大语言模型（LLM）智能体运行时控制覆盖率的框架，通过静态预测与内核实证两阶段，量化控制能检查的 15 条行动路径中被拦截、绕过或阻断的情况。
AI.motivation: 现有运行时控制（如智能体网关）只能评估经过其放置点的动作，而智能体可绕过工具调用通道经更多路径行动；此前缺乏以内核级真值（kernel-level ground truth）为基准的覆盖率度量工作。
AI.method: guardscope 分两阶段：静态阶段从控制源预测其可检查的 15 条行动路径；实证阶段在实现 8 种拓扑设计之一的部署上运行固定工作负载，将控制决策记录与内核级真值核对，把每个执行动作分类为已检查、被绕过或已阻断。
AI.result: 作者使用两个智能体框架（harness）和真实运行时控制（包括 Microsoft 的 agent governance toolkit 与 agentgateway）进行实验，验证了覆盖率的可测量性。
AI.conclusion: guardscope 使运行时控制的覆盖率声明可验证：开发者可在内核验证协议下公布其产品实际检查的路径。

title: Probabilistic State Space Enumeration in Neural Network Computation
summary: Deep neural networks typically realize dense computation by propagating information through all intermediate channels, while many approximation methods rank and retain individual computational components. We ask whether dense neural computation can instead be represented exactly as an expectation over a combinatorial state space, and approximated by evaluating only its most probable configurations. We introduce a novel probabilistic state-space framework for Transformer MLPs. The framework partitions the intermediate dimension into channel groups, defines an input-dependent distribution over binary inclusion states, and uses importance-corrected masked outputs such that the full expectation exactly recovers the dense MLP output. The key algorithmic novelty is NORDER-II, which enumerates complete joint states in decreasing probability without constructing or sorting the exponentially large state space. Truncating this ordering yields an anytime approximation governed by cumulative probability mass and a state budget. On Llama-3.2-1B and Gemma-2-2B, NORDER-II at a state budget of B=2048 achieves 92.4% and 93.8% MLP-output approximation accuracy, compared with 76.9% and 79.8% for Channel Top-k. When the first, middle, and last MLP layers are approximated jointly, WikiText-2 perplexity remains within 0.06% and 0.54% of dense inference. Relative to expected-count Grouped Top-k, NORDER-II yields 82.6% to 126.4% relative accuracy gains with only 0.18% to 0.19% additional local analytic FLOPs. These results establish the significance of joint-state structure beyond atomic salience and point to a new paradigm for neural computation: dense layers can be viewed as structured probabilistic inference over combinatorial computational states. This framework opens a path toward adaptive, probability-mass-controlled computation in pretrained neural networks.

AI.tldr: 提出Transformer MLP的概率状态空间框架，将稠密计算精确表示为二值包含状态上的期望，并用NORDER-II按概率降序枚举联合状态实现任意时刻近似。
AI.motivation: 现有近似方法（如Channel Top-k）仅对各计算组件单独排序与保留，忽略了组件间的联合结构；作者追问稠密神经计算能否被精确写成组合状态空间上的期望，并仅评估最高概率配置来近似。
AI.method: 将MLP中间维度划分为通道组，定义输入相关的二值包含状态分布，并用重要性校正的掩码输出使全期望精确还原稠密MLP输出；核心算法NORDER-II在不构建、不排序指数级状态空间的前提下按概率递减枚举完整联合状态，按累计概率质量与状态预算截断，得到anytime近似。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.2-1B与Gemma-2-2B上，B=2048时MLP输出近似精度达92.4%/93.8%，Channel Top-k为76.9%/79.8%；联合近似首、中、末MLP层时WikiText-2困惑度仅偏离稠密推理0.06%与0.54%；相对expected-count Grouped Top-k精度相对提升82.6%–126.4%，仅增加0.18%–0.19%局部解析FLOPs。
AI.conclusion: 联合状态结构比原子显著性更重要；稠密层可视为组合计算状态上的结构化概率推断，为预训练网络中自适应、概率质量可控的计算开辟新范式。

title: EMS-Nav: Embodied Multi-Scale Navigation
summary: Industrial inspection robots must reach work areas and specific equipment. These destinations span spatial scales from regions to objects, so robots must relate each target to its surroundings to interpret the task and determine where to go. Existing methods support multi-scale navigation through rich environment representations, but at substantial computational and storage cost. These costs limit deployment where wireless coverage is incomplete and robots must rely on onboard computation to keep navigating. We introduce EMS-Nav, a biologically inspired multi-scale navigation framework for online, on-device operation. Its core innovation is to organize perception, spatial understanding, and navigation around regions, making local spaces the basic units of both environmental understanding and computation. EMS-Nav groups objects and their relationships into functionally meaningful spaces and builds a hierarchy from local areas to the broader environment. This organization supports efficient map construction alongside the interpretation and execution of language goals at different scales. In multi-scale navigation experiments, EMS-Nav achieves the highest success rates across all four target categories: objects, rooms, regions, and specific instances. It outperforms state-of-the-art open-vocabulary mapping and navigation methods, improving overall first-attempt success by 9.39 percentage points over the strongest baseline while reducing mapping overhead and language-model input size. Local deployment in real indoor environments further demonstrates its applicability to on-device embodied navigation. By establishing regions as the organizing basis for perception, spatial understanding, and language-guided action, EMS-Nav provides a system that combines multi-scale understanding with computational efficiency to support diverse language goals on resource-constrained robots.

AI.tldr: EMS-Nav 是一个受生物学启发的多尺度导航框架，以"区域"为感知、空间理解与计算的基本单元，支持在资源受限机器人上在线本地运行语言引导的多尺度导航。
AI.motivation: 工业巡检机器人的目标涵盖从区域到物体的多种空间尺度，需将目标与周围环境关联以理解任务并确定行进方向。现有方法依赖丰富的环境表征实现多尺度导航，但计算与存储开销巨大，在无线覆盖不完整、只能依赖机载计算持续导航的场景中难以部署。
AI.method: 提出 EMS-Nav：将感知、空间理解与导航围绕"区域"组织，使局部空间成为环境理解与计算的基本单元；把物体及其相互关系聚合为具有功能意义的空间，并构建从局部区域到整体环境的层级结构；该组织方式同时支撑高效建图与不同尺度语言目标的解析和执行。
AI.result: 在多尺度导航实验中，EMS-Nav 在物体、房间、区域和具体实例四类目标上均取得最高成功率；相比最强基线，首次尝试总体成功率提升 9.39 个百分点，同时降低建图开销和语言模型输入规模；真实室内环境的本地部署验证了其机载具身导航的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 以区域作为感知、空间理解与语言引导行动的组织基础，EMS-Nav 在统一系统中兼顾多尺度理解与计算效率，可在资源受限机器人上支持多样化语言目标。

title: Quasi-Static Fault-Tolerant Feedback Control of a Quadrotor Carrying a Slung Payload under Rotor Failure
summary: This paper presents a nonlinear control law for a slung payload system (SPS) consisting of a quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) carrying a slung payload. We propose a fault-tolerant control (FTC) design for the case of a complete single-rotor failure, i.e., only three functioning propellers. The failure is not modeled as a disturbance to be handled by estimation. Rather, we model the faulty SPS in control-affine form and design a quasi-static feedback law directly for the faulty dynamics. The controller achieves local exponential convergence of the payload position to a geometric path in space, rather than tracking a timed reference trajectory. Moreover, the transverse dynamics are exponentially stable, and the path-following manifold is rendered controlled invariant by feedback. Controlled invariance allows motion along the path to be prescribed independently through a tangential command while the state stays on the path-following manifold. The UAV body angular velocity remains bounded under bounded applied torque despite the failure. To validate the control design, numerical simulations apply the controller derived from the faulty SPS model in coordinates to the coordinate-free SPS model. Code and animations are available at https://gradslab.github.io/qs-sl/.

AI.tldr: 本文为四旋翼吊挂负载系统提出一种针对单旋翼完全失效（仅剩三螺旋桨）的非线性容错控制律，直接在故障动力学上设计准静态反馈，使负载位置局部指数收敛到空间几何路径并保持流形受控不变。
AI.motivation: 传统容错控制多将单旋翼失效视为需估计与补偿的扰动，估计误差与瞬态性能难以保证；同时吊挂负载系统的路径跟踪任务中，时间标定的参考轨迹限制了运动时序的灵活性。
AI.method: 将故障状态下的吊挂负载系统（SPS）建模为控制仿射形式，针对故障动力学直接设计准静态反馈律，而非附加扰动估计器；控制目标设定为负载位置对空间几何路径的局部指数收敛（而非时间轨迹跟踪），并通过反馈使路径跟踪流形成为受控不变集，切向指令独立规定沿路径的运动。
AI.result: 横向动力学指数稳定，路径跟踪流形实现受控不变；在给定有界力矩下无人机机体角速度保持有界；数值仿真中将由坐标形式故障SPS模型导出的控制器作用于无坐标SPS模型，验证了设计有效性。
AI.conclusion: 直接在故障动力学上设计准静态反馈可实现单旋翼失效四旋翼吊挂负载的路径跟随容错控制，避免了对失效的扰动式估计，并保证收敛性、流形不变性与角速度有界性。

title: Reframing Video Inverse Tone Mapping as Blind Posterior Inference via Latent Luminance Supervision
summary: High-dynamic-range (HDR) displays are now common, but most video content, such as archival footage, broadcast material, and the output of generative video models, exists only in standard dynamic range (SDR). The need is sharpest for generated video, which has no HDR master at all and is graded alongside live-action and visual-effects material finished in HDR. Converting SDR to HDR means undoing a tone-mapping operation that was never recorded, and clipping destroys the radiance wherever it acts, so HDR recovery is a blind inverse problem. Methods built on generative video priors fill clipped regions with plausible structure, but their reconstructions are systematically biased: in every public method we test, saturated content leans too bright or too dark, and the direction of the lean moves with the tone operator behind the input. We call this failure the luminance error, measure both its magnitude and its sign, and make it the focus of this work. Reframing ITM as posterior inference under an unknown operator locates the failure in two places and yields two corrections. A fixed affine functional of the video-diffusion latent reads log-luminance without decoding; on that coordinate an asymmetric loss selects an expectile of the posterior, applied only where clipping leaves luminance unconstrained. We also synthesize training SDR through an explicit family of tone operators, so the model marginalizes over what the observation cannot show. Trained this way, our luminance error stays flatter across operators and smaller on average than any public method, and the full system achieves the best perceptual quality on all three benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 针对SDR→HDR逆色调映射(ITM)这一盲逆问题，作者指出现有生成式方法存在系统性"亮度误差"(饱和区域偏亮或偏暗，且方向随色调算子变化)，并通过将其重构为未知算子下的后验推断，提出两项修正：从扩散潜变量做固定仿射读出对数亮度+非对称期望分位数损失，以及显式色调算子族的训练数据合成，从而在多个算子下取得更平稳、更小的亮度误差与最佳感知质量。
AI.motivation: HDR显示已普及，但档案素材、广播内容与生成式视频模型输出多为SDR，生成视频尤为缺乏HDR母版且需与HDR实拍/VFX素材同场调色。SDR→HDR需反演一个未被记录的色调映射，裁剪处辐射度不可恢复，故为盲逆问题。现有基于生成视频先验的方法虽能填补裁剪区结构，但重建结果系统性偏置：所有被测公开方法中，饱和内容偏亮或偏暗，且偏向随输入背后的色调算子而变。
AI.method: 将ITM重新表述为未知色调算子下的后验推断，定位误差来源并给出两项修正：(1) 用扩散潜变量的固定仿射泛函免解码读出对数亮度，并在该坐标上使用非对称损失选取后验的期望分位数(expectile)，且仅施加于裁剪导致亮度不受约束的区域；(2) 通过显式色调算子族合成训练用SDR数据，使模型对观测无法揭示的部分进行边缘化。
AI.result: 经此训练，亮度误差在不同色调算子间更平稳、平均值小于任何公开方法；完整系统在三个基准上均取得最佳感知质量。
AI.conclusion: 亮度误差是生成式SDR→HDR方法的共性系统偏置，可归因于后验推断框架下的两处缺陷，通过潜空间亮度读出+非对称期望分位数监督与算子族数据合成可有效纠正，实现跨算子稳健且感知质量最优的SDR→HDR转换。

title: Can MLLMs Reason over Surround-View Driving Videos? A Multi-View Autonomous Driving QA Benchmark
summary: Surround-view video understanding in autonomous driving is a crucial capability for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to achieve reliable driving reasoning. Real-world driving often requires information beyond the front-view camera. Existing MLLMs primarily focus on front-view information, while their spatio-temporal understanding and reasoning abilities remain unknown. To address this gap, we propose MVDriveBench, a high-information-density video QA benchmark for autonomous driving, characterized by synchronized surround-view inputs, spatio-temporal understanding, and reasoning-chain-oriented evaluation. We design 12 categories of QA tasks that cover the complete reasoning pipeline from low-level visual perception to high-level driving decision-making, enabling a systematic evaluation of MLLMs surround-view spatio-temporal understanding and reasoning capabilities in complex driving environments. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of 23 open-source, closed-source, and expert MLLMs on MVDriveBench. The results show that current MLLMs still exhibit insufficient surround-view spatio-temporal reasoning ability. Meanwhile, closed-loop evaluations of specialist models in AlpaSim reveal a correlation between surround-view spatio-temporal reasoning capabilities and closed-loop driving performance, highlighting the importance of comprehensive multi-view understanding for reliable vehicle control.

AI.tldr: 提出MVDriveBench——面向自动驾驶的环视视频问答基准，含12类任务、时序同步多视角输入与推理链导向评测，对23个MLLM评测发现其环视时空推理能力不足，且该能力与闭环驾驶性能相关。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM主要关注前视信息，其环视时空理解与推理能力尚属未知；而真实驾驶常需前视相机之外的信息，缺乏相应评测手段。
AI.method: 构建高信息密度的环视视频QA基准MVDriveBench，特点为同步环视输入、时空理解与推理链导向评测；设计12类QA任务，覆盖从低层视觉感知到高层驾驶决策的完整推理流程；对23个开源、闭源及专家MLLM进行系统评测，并在AlpaSim中对专家模型做闭环评估。
AI.result: 当前MLLM的环视时空推理能力仍显不足；AlpaSim闭环评测显示环视时空推理能力与闭环驾驶性能存在相关性。
AI.conclusion: 全面的多视角理解对可靠车辆控制至关重要，MVDriveBench为诊断MLLM环视时空推理短板提供了系统化评测工具。

title: CoLaX: Context-Aware Local Explanations for Time Series Classification
summary: Post-hoc explanations for time series classifiers usually score local patterns, such as subsequences or shapelets, without regard to the rest of the sequence. Yet the same motif can carry different predictive meaning under different global temporal conditions, such as trends or regimes. We propose CoLaX, a context-aware post-hoc explanation framework that builds on shapelet-driven Shapley attribution and conditions local-pattern relevance on a learned representation of the full sequence. Global context acts at two levels: it produces sample-specific prototype weights and a temporally resolved signal that reweights the local activation map. The resulting context-conditioned segments are the players of a Shapley attribution game whose values come only from the frozen black-box classifier. On synthetic benchmarks where identical motifs change relevance across contexts, CoLaX improves AUPRC over the strongest baseline by 30\% on average. On real-world data, it achieves the highest AUPRC on ECG. Additional ablations indicate that the gains come from input-dependent conditioning rather than from additional learnable weights. CoLaX is therefore most useful when recurring local motifs change relevance across sequence-level contexts.

AI.tldr: 提出CoLaX：一种上下文感知的时间序列分类器事后解释框架，将shapelet级Shapley归因与全序列全局上下文的表示条件化相结合，在合成基准上AUPRC平均提升30%。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列事后解释方法仅对局部模式（子序列、shapelet）单独打分，忽略序列其余部分；而相同motif在不同全局时序条件（趋势、状态段/regime）下预测含义可能不同，需要上下文条件化的归因。
AI.method: CoLaX基于shapelet驱动的Shapley归因，并将局部模式相关性条件化于学习到的全序列表示。全局上下文在两个层面起作用：(1) 生成样本特定的原型（prototype）权重；(2) 生成随时间解析的信号，对局部激活图重新加权。得到上下文条件化后的分段（segments）作为Shapley博弈的参与者（players），其价值仅由冻结的黑盒分类器给出。
AI.result: 在相同motif随上下文改变相关性的合成基准上，AUPRC较最强基线平均提升30%；在真实数据ECG上取得最高AUPRC；消融实验表明增益来自输入依赖的条件化，而非额外的可学习权重。
AI.conclusion: CoLaX最适用于重复出现的局部motif随序列级上下文改变其相关性的场景。

title: Helping Hand: A Continuum Robotic Grasper for Traction in Single-Channel Endoscopic Submucosal Dissection
summary: Endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) is a minimally invasive approach for removing large polyps from the colon and offers many benefits compared to other surgical approaches. However, ESD is technically very challenging to perform, leading to limited adoption by physicians. We propose the Helping Hand, a two-segment continuum robotic grasper that, together with an electrosurgical knife, enables tissue traction and cutting within a single 3.7 mm working channel. We achieve this functionality by creating a slot at the base of the Helping Hand that lets the electrosurgical knife extend out, enabling countertraction and cutting through one instrument lumen. We evaluate the Helping Hand's workspace and its ability to provide traction forces from different starting configurations. Finally, we demonstrate the full workflow by isolating and removing tissue in an ex vivo chicken thigh, illustrating the potential for the Helping Hand to help improve ESD procedures.

AI.tldr: 提出两段式连续体机器人抓钳"Helping Hand"，与电刀共用一条3.7 mm工作通道，实现ESD中的组织牵引与切割一体化操作。
AI.motivation: 内镜黏膜下剥离术（ESD）是结肠大息肉微创切除手段，但技术难度高、医生采纳率有限，传统单通道下缺乏有效的组织牵引，导致操作费时且风险大。
AI.method: 设计两段式连续体机器人抓钳，在其基座开设槽口使电刀可伸出，从而在单一工作通道内同时完成反向牵引与切割；随后评估其工作空间，并测量不同初始构型下可施加的牵引力；最后在离体鸡腿组织上完成完整流程验证。
AI.result: 工作空间与多构型牵引力均得到量化评估；在离体鸡腿实验中成功完成组织游离与切除，验证了全流程可行性。
AI.conclusion: Helping Hand可在单通道内实现牵引—切割协同，具备改善ESD操作性能的潜力；目前仅为离体概念验证，尚需进一步体内验证。

title: Impact of Grid-Interactive Data Center Microgrids on Grid Reliability
summary: Traditional data centers, operating as passive loads with standby backup resources, present significant challenges for grid integration due to their scale, rapid load fluctuations, and limited operational flexibility. This article investigates the transformative potential of grid-interactive data center microgrids, which integrate battery energy storage, on-site generation, and intelligent microgrid controllers to actively support both facility and grid operations. The proposed simulation framework enables the study comparing conventional and grid-interactive architectures under a range of steady-state and contingency scenarios. Results reveal that grid-interactive microgrids can substantially reduce peak grid demand, improve voltage stability, and improve system reliability especially when data center and system load peaks coincide. The findings highlight the critical role of coordinated resource management in enabling the reliable and efficient integration of large data center loads, and provide a practical methodology for assessing their system-level impacts.

AI.tldr: 该文研究并网互动型数据中心微电网（集成电池储能、就地发电与智能控制器）替代传统被动式数据中心负荷的可行性，通过仿真框架对比两类架构在稳态与故障场景下的表现，证明其可降低峰值电网需求、改善电压稳定性和系统可靠性。
AI.motivation: 传统数据中心作为被动负荷运行，依赖备用资源待机，因其规模大、负荷波动快、运行灵活性有限，给电网接入带来显著挑战。作者希望挖掘数据中心由"被动负荷"转为"主动支撑资源"的潜力。
AI.method: 构建仿真框架，对常规架构与并网互动型微电网架构进行对比研究；并网互动架构整合电池储能、就地发电与智能微电网控制器，覆盖多种稳态工况与故障（contingency）场景。
AI.result: 并网互动型微电网可显著降低电网峰值需求、改善电压稳定性，并在数据中心负荷峰值与系统负荷峰值重叠时提升系统可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 协调资源管理对于大规模数据中心负荷的可靠、高效并网至关重要；所提框架为评估此类负荷的系统级影响提供了可操作的实用方法。

title: From Concepts to Interactions: Dynamic Graph Semantic Recomposition for Safe Visual Generation
summary: Recent advances in flow-matching Transformers have greatly improved Text-to-Image (T2I) and Text-to-Video (T2V) generation, but unconstrained generation risks producing illegal or unethical content. Safety alignment must therefore suppress unsafe content while preserving legitimate generation. A concept's safety depends on context: a knife used for cooking is safe, whereas its use in violence is harmful. Yet most concept erasure methods indiscriminately suppress static, isolated representations, overlooking evolving semantic interactions. Consequently, safe scenes containing potentially sensitive terms may be unintentionally suppressed, compromising generation quality. To address this, we propose Dynamic Graph Semantic Recomposition (DGSR), which dynamically constructs and updates a semantic interaction graph from evolving text visual states during sampling. Context aware graph reasoning captures semantic dependencies, while paired safe/unsafe supervision distinguishes harmful from legitimate interactions, enabling precise identification of and selective intervention on high risk semantic relationships while preserving benign semantics. DGSR freezes the pretrained backbone and supports both image and video generation. Experiments show that DGSR achieves the lowest Attack Success Rate (ASR) in 10 of 12 T2I evaluations and reduces the average T2V unsafe frame rate by 41.2\% relative to the strongest baseline, while maintaining high generation fidelity and temporal consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出动态图语义重组（DGSR），在流匹配生成采样过程中动态构建语义交互图，结合成对的安全/不安全监督识别高危语义关系并选择性干预，在冻结主干的条件下同时支持文生图与文生视频的安全对齐，10/12项T2I评测取得最低攻击成功率，T2V不安全帧率较最强基线降低41.2%。
AI.motivation: 流匹配Transformer显著提升了T2I/T2V生成质量，但无约束生成可能产生违规或不道德内容，需要安全对齐。关键问题在于概念的安全性依赖语境（如菜刀用于烹饪是安全的、用于暴力则有害），而现有概念擦除方法对静态、孤立表征进行一刀切抑制，忽略了动态演化的语义交互，导致含敏感词但安全的场景被误抑制、生成质量下降。
AI.method: DGSR在采样过程中基于不断演化的文本—视觉状态动态构建并更新语义交互图，通过上下文感知的图推理捕捉语义依赖关系；同时引入成对的安全/不安全监督，区分有害交互与合法交互，从而精确定位高风险语义关系并实施选择性干预，保留良性语义。方法冻结预训练主干，不依赖微调，可同时适配图像与视频生成。
AI.result: 在12项T2I安全性评测中的10项取得最低攻击成功率（ASR）；相较最强基线，T2V平均不安全帧率降低41.2%；同时保持较高的生成保真度与时间一致性。
AI.conclusion: 将安全对齐从静态概念擦除转向语境感知的语义关系调控是可行且有效的，DGSR在显著降低不安全内容生成的同时避免了良性语义的过度抑制，为无需重训练主干的T2I/T2V统一安全生成提供了新范式。

title: Towards Robust Vision-Language Reasoning: A Multi-Stage Optimization Pipeline with Masked Diffusion Model
summary: Discrete diffusion generation is emerging as a competitive alternative to autoregressive generation by denoising the entire token sequence through iterative refinement. Its global planning and progressive correction capabilities are particularly well suited to autonomous driving. However, transferring this generation paradigm from general-purpose settings to driving introduces substantial domain gaps in both training and inference. To unlock its potential, we propose a multi-stage optimization pipeline for standard vision-language model architectures, without auxiliary action experts or specialized mixture-of-experts Transformer, spanning post-training and inference. During supervised fine-tuning, we optimize the representation of planning inputs to suppress hallucinations in task responses. During reinforcement learning, we introduce metric-guided diversity filtering to identify stronger learning starting points and improve policy exploration. At inference time, we propose Dynamic Autonomous Driving Decoding (DAD), which adaptively adjusts decoding modes according to scene complexity. Based on this pipeline, we develop Masked Diffusion Drive (MD-Drive), improving its performance by 29.7\% over the unoptimized model. Experiments on the NAVSIM closed loop benchmark and the nuScenes and DriveCoT open loop datasets show that MD-Drive outperforms autoregressive VLM baselines with the same architecture, while achieving a more favorable balance between performance and computational cost than systems with different architectures through discrete diffusion training and inference.

AI.tldr: 提出多阶段优化流程使标准VLM架构胜任离散扩散式自动驾驶生成，形成MD-Drive，性能提升29.7%，在NAVSIM闭环与nuScenes/DriveCoT开环上优于同架构自回归基线且算力更优。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散生成通过迭代去噪实现全局规划与渐进纠错，天然契合自动驾驶；但将该范式从通用场景迁移到驾驶领域时，训练与推理均存在明显域间隙，需系统性优化才能释放潜力。
AI.method: 面向标准VLM架构的多阶段流程（无需辅助动作专家或专用MoE Transformer）：SFT阶段优化规划输入表征以抑制任务响应幻觉；RL阶段引入指标引导的多样性过滤，筛选更强的学习起点并提升策略探索；推理阶段提出动态自动驾驶解码（DAD），按场景复杂度自适应调整解码模式。
AI.result: 相比未优化模型性能提升29.7%；在NAVSIM闭环基准及nuScenes、DriveCoT开环数据集上，MD-Drive优于同架构自回归VLM基线，并通过离散扩散训练与推理在不同架构系统中取得更优的性能—计算成本平衡。
AI.conclusion: 离散扩散可直接嫁接到标准VLM架构并超越自回归范式，关键在于训练表征、RL采样起点与推理解码策略的联合设计；该流程具备良好的通用性与效率优势。

title: When Does Causality Help in Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection?
summary: Causality-aware scoring is common in multivariate time-series anomaly detection, yet the literature rarely states when it helps. Holding one causality-guided autoencoder (DeCauAE) fixed, we vary graph quality, anomaly type and protocol against ground truth. Graph quality fixes the payoff: on a twenty-variable DAG the gain over a graph-free autoencoder decays as the graph is corrupted. Anomaly type fixes the target: the structural factor lifts window F1 from 0.800 to 0.976 where anomalies break conditional structure, and its advantage vanishes below a break severity s 0.3. Protocol fixes the ranking: point-adjusted F1 lets a random score match the full model, while range-aware VUS separates the autoencoder family from the classical baselines. On real benchmarks the causal module pays only where density makes a system eligible and cross-subsample reproducibility selects entities inside it; enabling it everywhere costs 0.012 VUS-ROC. The structural factor also transfers to classical detectors .

AI.tldr: 以固定因果引导自编码器DeCauAE为实验对象，系统刻画"因果感知打分何时有效"：图质量决定收益、异常类型决定作用目标、评估协议决定排序结论。
AI.motivation: 多变量时间序列异常检测中因果感知打分被广泛采用，但文献很少说明其获益条件与边界，缺乏对"何时有用"的澄清。
AI.method: 控制变量实验：固定DeCauAE，在二十变量DAG上与真值对照，分别改变图质量（逐步破坏图）、异常类型（改变破坏条件结构的程度/严重度s）、评估协议（point-adjusted F1、range-aware VUS），并在真实基准上考察因果模块的可用性判据与跨子样本可复现性筛选。
AI.result: 图质量决定收益：随图被破坏，相对无图自编码器的增益单调衰减；异常类型决定目标：在破坏条件结构的异常上窗口F1从0.800提升至0.976，但当破坏严重度s<0.3时优势消失；协议决定排序：point-adjusted F1下随机打分即可与完整模型持平，而range-aware VUS能区分自编码器族与经典基线；真实基准上因果模块仅在密度使系统"合格"时获益，全面启用反而损失0.012 VUS-ROC。
AI.conclusion: 因果感知打分的收益高度依赖图质量、异常类型与评估协议三重条件；结构因子还可迁移到经典检测器，说明应"按条件启用"而非默认全局使用。

title: Single-View RGB-D Force--Deformation Estimation for Robotic Manipulation of Elasto-Plastic Materials
summary: Persistent deformation complicates elasto-plastic manipulation by coupling physical interaction with spatially distributed shape changes. We investigate the force--deformation relationship using a standard robot, a single eye-in-hand RGB-D camera, and intrinsic force estimates. A 7-DoF Franka Emika FR3 performs normal indentations while an Intel RealSense L515 captures pre- and post-contact surfaces. Point-cloud processing localizes deformation and estimates displaced volume. Force--volume characterization includes 27 measurements over nine force levels. A compact multilayer perceptron (MLP), trained on 52 force--volume pairs at four levels, achieves a held-out RMSE of 1.857 N and $R^2=0.440$. A separate comparison shows lower error for a quadratic model at 16 N and for the MLP at 19 and 23.5 N. An eight-step experiment at 4 N per interaction demonstrates cumulative deformation localization from the second indentation onward. These results establish a practical measurement basis for deformation-aware manipulation using intrinsic force estimates and single-view geometry.

AI.tldr: 该文提出以单目eye-in-hand RGB-D相机与内在力估计建立“力—位移体积”关系，用于表征持续性形变，并在8步序列实验中验证形变的累积定位。
AI.motivation: 持续性（塑性）形变使形状改变与物理交互相互耦合，给弹性—塑性操作带来困难；现有方法缺乏在标准机器人、单目视觉与内在力估计条件下可用的力—形变定量测量基础。
AI.method: 7自由度Franka Emika FR3执行法向压入，Intel RealSense L515采集接触前/后表面；点云处理定位形变区域并估计位移体积；在9个力级共27次测量上表征力—体积关系；以4个力级的52对力—体积样本训练紧凑MLP，并与二次模型对比；另做8步、每步4N的序列实验考察累积形变定位。
AI.result: MLP留出集RMSE为1.857 N、R²=0.440；单点对比中二次模型在16 N误差更低，MLP在19 N与23.5 N更优；8步序列实验显示自第二次压入起可实现累积形变定位。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，结合内在力估计与单视角几何可构成面向形变感知操作的实用测量基础；但力—体积映射精度有限、模型优劣随力级变化，需进一步扩充数据与改进建模。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Target Jerk Estimation in Interceptor Homing Phase
comment: Submitted to Journal of Spacecraft and Rockets
summary: We demonstrate the use of reinforcement meta-learning (meta-RL) to optimize a target jerk estimation policy, which is then used as the target acceleration rate of change in the propagation model of an unscented Kalman filter (UKF). The policy is learned through simulated engagements of a terminal phase high-altitude endoatmospheric interception of a highly maneuverable target, with a hit-to-kill accuracy requirement. As benchmarks, we tuned both a standard UKF and an interacting multiple model (IMM) filter, where the IMM uses a different constant jerk assumption for each model. The benchmarks and the proposed augmented UKF with the target jerk policy are tested in a 6-DOF simulation environment, which has sufficient fidelity to capture most factors relevant to guidance, navigation, and flight control. The augmented UKF demonstrates significant improvement in target interception rate, with more challenging maneuvers giving the largest performance differential. The meta-RL jerk policy is then tested on an expanded engagement scenario, with increased initial state estimate uncertainty and novel target maneuvers, demonstrating that the meta-RL policy generalizes well to conditions not seen during optimization.

AI.tldr: 利用强化元学习（meta-RL）学习目标加加速度（jerk）估计策略，并将其作为无迹卡尔曼滤波器（UKF）传播模型中的目标加速度变化率，从而显著提升高机动目标末段拦截的成功率。
AI.motivation: 在临近空间末段拦截高机动目标时，传统UKF与IMM滤波器依赖固定的加加速度假设，难以适应目标的复杂机动，导致命中杀伤精度不足，因此需要一种能自适应估计目标加加速度的方法。
AI.method: 通过仿真交战场景训练meta-RL策略以输出目标加加速度估计，并将其作为UKF传播模型中的目标加速度变化率（增广UKF）。设置标准UKF与采用不同常加加速度模型的IMM滤波器作为基准，在具备足够保真度的6自由度仿真环境中对比评估。
AI.result: 增广UKF在目标拦截率上显著优于基准滤波器，且目标机动越具挑战性，性能差异越大；在初始状态估计不确定性增大及出现新机动模式的扩展场景中，meta-RL策略仍表现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将meta-RL学习的目标加加速度策略嵌入UKF传播模型可有效提升高机动目标拦截性能，并具备对未见过条件的泛化性，为制导滤波设计提供了新思路。

title: MatrixSplat: Matrix-Parallel and Feature-Scalable 3D Gaussian Splatting Rendering on GPUs
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a mainstream representation for real-time novel view synthesis and 3D reconstruction. However, existing 3DGS rendering pipelines are poorly aligned with modern GPU architectures: depth-sorted alpha compositing introduces strong per-pixel sequential dependencies, limiting parallelism and resulting in scalar FMA-dominated execution that underutilizes high-throughput matrix units such as Tensor Cores. This mismatch becomes more severe for multimodal and semantically enriched 3DGS, where high-dimensional features must be accumulated from millions of Gaussians, leading to rapidly increasing computation and memory costs. We propose MatrixSplat, a matrix-parallel rendering framework for feature-scalable 3DGS on modern GPUs. We first identify the sequential dependency of alpha compositing as a key obstacle to efficient high-dimensional feature rendering, and adopt an order-independent weighted accumulation formulation that transforms feature rendering into matrix-oriented computation. Our framework features three key designs: (i) a tile-based splatting pipeline that maps feature accumulation to warp-level matrix-multiply-accumulate execution on Tensor Cores; (ii) a warp-granularity Gaussian packing strategy that mitigates visibility irregularity and improves feature reuse; and (iii) a lazy channel-batched feature-fetching pipeline that reduces shared-memory pressure, maintains high warp occupancy, and overlaps memory access with matrix execution for high-dimensional features. On Mip-NeRF 360, LERF, and 3D-OVS, MatrixSplat achieves up to 3.8$\times$ speedup over 3DGS and 2$\times$ over TC-GS while maintaining rendering quality and semantic accuracy, and further reduces render-kernel time by up to 36.7$\times$ for high-dimensional features. Integrated into existing fast renderers, it provides an additional 1.69-2.84$\times$ speedup.

AI.tldr: MatrixSplat 提出一种面向 GPU 张量核心的矩阵并行渲染框架，通过将 3DGS 的深度排序 alpha 混合改写为顺序无关的加权累积，实现高维特征可扩展渲染，最高取得 3.8×/2× 加速并将高维特征渲染核耗时降低 36.7×。
AI.motivation: 现有 3DGS 渲染流水线与现代 GPU 架构不匹配：深度排序 alpha 合成带来强的逐像素串行依赖，限制并行度，形成以标量 FMA 为主的执行，无法利用 Tensor Cores 等高吞吐矩阵单元。该问题在多模态、语义增强 3DGS 中更严重——需从数百万高斯中累积高维特征，计算与访存成本急剧上升。
AI.method: 核心思路：识别 alpha 合成的顺序依赖为高维特征渲染瓶颈，采用顺序无关的加权累积公式，将特征渲染转化为矩阵导向计算。三项关键设计：(i) 基于 tile 的 splatting 流水线，把特征累积映射到 Tensor Cores 上的 warp 级矩阵乘累加（MMA）；(ii) warp 粒度的高斯打包策略，缓解可见性不规则性并提升特征复用；(iii) 惰性通道分批特征取数流水线，降低共享内存压力、维持高 warp 占用率，并将访存与矩阵执行重叠以应对高维特征。
AI.result: 在 Mip-NeRF 360、LERF 和 3D-OVS 数据集上，相比 3DGS 最高 3.8× 加速、相比 TC-GS 提速 2×，同时保持渲染质量与语义精度；高维特征下渲染核时间最多降低 36.7×；集成到现有快速渲染器中还可额外获得 1.69–2.84× 加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过将顺序相关的 alpha 合成重构为矩阵并行计算，3DGS 渲染可有效对齐现代 GPU 的矩阵单元，显著提升高维/多模态特征渲染效率，且具备良好的可组合性与与现有快速渲染器的兼容性。

title: Verify by Doing: Co-Evolving Agent Execution and Evaluation without External Feedback
summary: Agent self-improvement requires feedback about task success, yet external feedback may be unavailable at test time. Agents must then infer success from observable evidence, and incomplete verification can misguide subsequent updates. We introduce Verify by Doing (VbD), a method that co-evolves Actor and Evaluator harnesses within a single task while keeping model weights fixed. The Evaluator actively inspects artifacts and environment state with tools; its findings ground an internal signal for output selection and guide updates to both execution and verification procedures. Proposed Evaluators undergo comparative review on common candidates, while Actor updates require support from their own fresh outputs. Across AutomationBench, $τ^3$ Banking, and selected GDPval tasks, VbD achieves the highest overall scores among the compared methods operating without external feedback, with gains of 3.3, 4.1, and 2.3 percentage points over the strongest baselines on the main backbone. Ablations support the contributions of active verification and Evaluator evolution, and selection from fixed candidate pools shows that improved verification can recover successful outputs without generating new ones.

AI.tldr: 提出Verify by Doing (VbD)：在权重固定的前提下，让Actor与Evaluator两套harness在同一任务内协同进化，用主动验证产生的内部信号替代外部反馈，实现智能体自我改进。
AI.motivation: 智能体自我改进依赖任务成功与否的反馈，但测试阶段往往无法获得外部反馈；此时智能体只能从可观测证据推断成功，而不完备的验证会产生误导性信号，污染后续更新。
AI.method: VbD在单任务内共进化Actor与Evaluator两套harness，模型权重保持冻结。Evaluator借助工具主动检查产物与环境状态，其发现构成内部信号，一方面用于输出选择，另一方面用于指导执行流程与验证流程的更新。候选Evaluator需在共同候选上进行对比评审，Actor的更新则必须得到其自身新输出的支撑。
AI.result: 在AutomationBench、τ³ Banking及部分GDPval任务上，VbD在无外部反馈的方法中总体得分最高；在主backbone上分别较最强基线提升3.3、4.1和2.3个百分点。消融实验验证了主动验证与Evaluator进化的贡献；固定候选池上的选择实验表明，验证能力提升可在不生成新输出的情况下恢复成功输出。
AI.conclusion: 主动、工具驱动的验证可作为可靠的内部监督信号，支撑无外部反馈条件下的Actor–Evaluator协同自我改进，并提升验证质量本身即可带来可观的性能收益。

title: Profile-Based Auditing of Domestic Violence Survey Selection Across South Asia
comment: Accepted at the AI4Science and New in ML Workshops, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Domestic violence (DV) data in the Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS) are collected through a specialized module whose household-level sampling and privacy requirements create a distinct observation process. We ask whether demographic, socioeconomic, and household characteristics form reproducible population profiles and whether these profiles contain information about selection into the DV module across South Asia. Using DHS Individual Recode data for 796,374 women aged 15-49 across Afghanistan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, and Pakistan, we harmonize 61 numeric and 8 categorical features, reduce the profile space with PCA, and identify six interpretable profiles. We then evaluate 22 machine-learning models under primary-sampling-unit-aware holdout validation. The best model, HistGradientBoosting, achieves ROC-AUC 0.9167 and PR-AUC 0.9612, versus 0.8475 and 0.9203 for a design-only baseline. Adding woman-level characteristics yields the largest incremental gain, while explicit interaction terms add little out-of-sample performance. Country-specific analyses reveal substantial heterogeneity, and leave-one-country-out evaluation shows that transferability of the incremental profile signal is limited. These results demonstrate that interpretable ML can audit differential coverage in sensitive survey modules beyond the formal sampling design.

AI.tldr: 利用南亚五国DHS 796,374名15–49岁女性的个体重编码数据，协调61个数值与8个分类特征，经PCA降维识别出6个可解释的人口社会经济画像，并用22种机器学习模型在PSU感知的留出验证下评估这些画像对DV模块选择性进入的预测能力；最佳模型HistGradientBoosting达ROC-AUC 0.9167、PR-AUC 0.9612，显著优于仅基于抽样设计的基线，表明可解释ML可用于审计敏感调查模块的差异化覆盖。
AI.motivation: DHS中的家庭暴力数据通过专门模块采集，其户级抽样与隐私要求构成了独特的观测过程，可能导致DV模块存在非随机的选择性进入（差分覆盖）。作者希望检验人口、社会经济与家庭特征能否形成可复现的总体画像，以及这些画像是否携带关于DV模块选择机制的信息，从而在正式抽样设计之外审计敏感模块的覆盖偏差。
AI.method: 使用阿富汗、印度、缅甸、尼泊尔、巴基斯坦五国DHS Individual Recode数据（796,374名15–49岁女性），协调61个数值特征与8个分类特征；用PCA压缩画像空间并识别出6个可解释画像；在初级抽样单元（PSU）感知的留出验证下比较22种机器学习模型；以仅含设计变量的模型为基线，并考察加入女性个体特征、显式交互项、分国分析与留一国交叉验证的增量效果。
AI.result: 最佳模型HistGradientBoosting取得ROC-AUC 0.9167、PR-AUC 0.9612，而仅设计基线为0.8475与0.9203。加入女性个体层面特征带来最大的增量增益，显式交互项对样本外性能提升甚微。分国分析显示显著异质性，留一国评估表明增量画像信号的可迁移性有限。
AI.conclusion: 可解释机器学习能够刻画DV模块进入的选择性结构，并在正式抽样设计之外审计敏感调查模块的差分覆盖；但增量信号的跨国可迁移性有限，提示需结合国别情境谨慎外推。

title: Recover, Don't Just Continue: Learning from Feedback for Physical Failure Understanding and Correction
summary: Multimodal large language models are regarded as the cognitive foundation of embodied intelligence, but planning from instructions alone cannot make them reliable. During execution, actions deviate from intended effects, constrained by the embodiment and environment. An embodied brain must understand why execution deviates, identify what can be reliably realized, and revise decisions using interaction experience. These correspond to causal failure localization, capability-constrained adaptation, and experience-driven revision. Current embodied foundation models largely lack these capabilities. To address this, we introduce Embodied-Corrector. We construct failure-recovery data by injecting perturbations at subtask boundaries of successful trajectories, replaying affected subtasks, and keeping failures that are observable from public evidence and recoverable from the current state. We align actions, consequences, failure causes, and recoveries into Judge-Cause-Sub-Fine supervision. Training uses evaluation-first SFT: the model learns Judge and Cause first, then Sub and Fine conditioned on accurate prefixes. Since deployment uses self-generated prefixes, evaluation errors propagate into recovery planning, and response-level rewards are too coarse to locate affected planning tokens. We therefore use OPD to internalize the planning distribution under accurate prefixes into that under self-generated ones: the model generates plans from self-generated prefixes, while a contrastive forward pass with accurate prefixes compares token probabilities to reinforce or suppress planning tokens. At deployment, this branch is removed. Experiments show stronger failure analysis and corrective planning: with a frozen VLA, composite task success improves by 6.1 percentage points; with fixed GPT-5.5 execution, manipulation and navigation tasks improve by 13.9 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出Embodied-Corrector：用子任务边界扰动构造失败-恢复数据，以Judge-Cause-Sub-Fine监督与OPD分布内化训练，使具身大模型具备因果失败定位、能力约束自适应与经验驱动修订能力，冻结VLA下复合任务成功率+6.1pp，固定GPT-5.5执行下操作与导航任务+13.9pp。
AI.motivation: 仅凭指令规划不可靠：执行中动作会因具身形态与环境约束偏离预期。具身"大脑"需具备三项能力——理解偏离原因的因果失败定位、识别可可靠实现项的能力约束自适应、利用交互经验修正决策，而现有具身基础模型普遍缺失。此外，部署时模型使用自生成前缀，评估误差会传播至恢复规划，而响应级奖励过粗、无法定位受影响的规划token。
AI.method: 1）数据构造：在成功轨迹的子任务边界注入扰动，重放受影响子任务，仅保留"可由公开证据观测"且"可从当前状态恢复"的失败；2）监督对齐：将动作、后果、失败原因、恢复组织为Judge-Cause-Sub-Fine四元结构；3）训练：评估优先的SFT，先学Judge与Cause，再以准确前缀为条件学习Sub与Fine；4）OPD（分布对齐）：用自生成前缀出计划，同时以准确前缀做对比前向，比较token概率以强化/抑制规划token，将准确前缀下的规划分布内化到自生成前缀条件下；部署时移除该分支。
AI.result: 失败分析与纠错规划能力显著增强：在冻结VLA执行下，复合任务成功率提升6.1个百分点；在固定GPT-5.5执行的设定下，操作与导航任务提升13.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将失败恢复显式建模为"定位—约束—修订"的监督与分布对齐问题，可有效弥补具身基础模型的执行纠错短板，且训练期辅助分支不增加部署开销。

title: Model Predictive Control on Analogue Hardware: A Dual-flow Approach
summary: Current Model Predictive Control (MPC) implementations are predominantly digital and, despite offering high precision and flexibility, often face challenges with ultra-low latency and hardware certification for safety-critical applications. We present an approach for solving the Quadratic Program (QP) of MPC using a continuous-time neural ordinary differential equation in the dual space. We obtain the solution to these QPs by mapping the differential equation's equilibrium point back to the primal space via a nonlinear transformation. The underlying dual-flow dynamics operate natively on analogue hardware. We validate this approach by demonstrating the hardware implementation of linear MPC on "The Analog Thing" analogue computer. Finally, we extend the framework to nonlinear MPC with successive linearisation, broadening the applicability beyond linear systems.

AI.tldr: 该文提出在对偶空间用连续时间神经常微分方程（NODE）求解MPC中的二次规划（QP），并借助模拟硬件原生运行对偶流动力学，在"The Analog Thing"模拟计算机上验证了线性MPC，进一步结合逐次线性化扩展至非线性MPC。
AI.motivation: 现有MPC实现以数字为主，虽精度高、灵活性强，但在超低时延和面向安全关键应用的硬件认证方面存在困难，因此需要探索模拟计算等替代实现路径。
AI.method: 将MPC的QP在对偶空间建模为连续时间神经常微分方程，以其平衡点经非线性变换映射回原空间得到QP解；该对偶流动力学可原生运行于模拟硬件，并在"The Analog Thing"模拟计算机上实现线性MPC；再通过逐次线性化推广到非线性MPC。
AI.result: 在模拟计算机上成功完成了线性MPC的硬件实现验证，表明对偶NODE求解QP的框架可在模拟硬件上落地；经逐次线性化后，框架可覆盖非线性系统。
AI.conclusion: 对偶空间连续时间NODE为MPC的QP求解提供了一种可映射到模拟硬件的实现方式，具备低时延潜力，并可经逐次线性化扩展到非线性MPC。

title: CineMME: From Dialogue Grounding to Narrative Reasoning in Multimodal Video Understanding
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). Project page: https://cinemme.github.io/
summary: Narrative video understanding requires more than recognizing visible events: models must extract evidence from dialogue, bind it to speakers, and use it to infer narrative meaning. Existing video benchmarks evaluate aspects of this problem, including video question answering, audio-visual reasoning, and temporal grounding, but rarely test whether these abilities form a coherent dialogue-to-plot evidence chain within the same clips. We introduce \textbf{CineMME}, a human-verified benchmark designed to diagnose dialogue-grounded plot understanding, supported by approximately $1,600$ expert person-hours of annotation. CineMME contains $975$ curated short narrative video clips and two linked tracks: \textit{CineMME-Grounding}, with $13,554$ timestamped speech segments and $33,083$ speaker face boxes for temporal dialogue localization, transcription, and active-speaker grounding; and \textit{CineMME-Reasoning}, with $1,600$ multiple-choice and $316$ open-ended questions spanning perception, audio, narrative, social, and scene-presentation understanding. Our main evaluation compares $20$ MLLMs on reasoning and $9$ omni-modal models on grounding. The results reveal a pronounced who-what-when decoupling: Gemini-3 Pro localizes dialogue in time ($68.34\%$ tIoU) and transcribes it with a WER of $28.99\%$, yet achieves only $7.74\%$ vIoU for active-speaker grounding while achieving $67.66\%$ MCQ accuracy on questions with extractable answers. Modality ablations further show that vision is not uniformly beneficial: it improves performance on perception-heavy questions but can hurt dialogue-centric reasoning. CineMME provides a compact diagnostic testbed for evaluating how multimodal video models connect dialogue, speakers, visual evidence, and narrative meaning.

AI.tldr: 提出CineMME基准，诊断多模态模型能否在叙事视频中构建"对话—说话人—情节"的证据链，发现who-what-when解耦现象。
AI.motivation: 叙事视频理解要求模型从对话中抽取证据、绑定到说话人并推断叙事意义，但现有基准（视频问答、视听推理、时序定位）各自评测孤立能力，很少检验同一视频片段内这些能力是否构成连贯的对话到情节证据链。
AI.method: 构建CineMME，约1600专家人时标注，含975个精选叙事短片与两个关联赛道：CineMME-Grounding（13,554条带时间戳语音片段、33,083个说话人脸框，用于时序对话定位、转写与活跃说话人 grounding）；CineMME-Reasoning（1,600道选择题与316道开放题，覆盖感知、音频、叙事、社会与场景呈现理解）。评测20个MLLM的推理与9个全模态模型的grounding，并做模态消融。
AI.result: 呈现明显的who-what-when解耦：Gemini-3 Pro时序定位tIoU达68.34%、转写WER 28.99%，但活跃说话人grounding的vIoU仅7.74%，而在有可抽取答案的题目上MCQ准确率为67.66%。模态消融显示视觉并非普遍有益：提升感知类问题表现，却可能损害以对话为中心的推理。
AI.conclusion: CineMME提供了紧凑的诊断测试平台，用于评估多模态视频模型如何连接对话、说话人、视觉证据与叙事意义。

title: Where Autonomy Belongs: A Separation of Powers for Agentic Program Evolution
summary: LLM-driven program evolution rests on three decisions: govern directs the search from accumulated evidence, propose constructs the next candidate, and judge settles validity and fitness. All three appear in every system, and existing work splits into two lines over who makes each. Controller-centric systems strengthen govern and neglect the autonomy of propose, which caps what evolution can reach. Agent-centric systems let a coding agent take over both govern and propose, at a cognitive and computational cost. Neither line protects the independent authority of judge, so benchmark reliability suffers. These failures share one root: autonomy is misallocated across the three decisions. We address this problem with EvoTrias, a separation-of-powers architecture in which each decision has one owner: Structured Governance for what spans evolution rounds, Open Proposal for construction inside a task, and Protected Judgment behind a private evaluator. These owners exchange typed contracts only, and runtime hooks reinforce the boundaries. This separation also lets EvoTrias run as a plugin that turns an existing coding agent into an evolution system. EvoTrias sets a new state of the art on mathematical, systems, and algorithm-design benchmarks. Three further results show what each owner buys: separating Governance from Proposal cuts token cost by 64%, Open Proposal extends evolution to a 680K-line industrial repository, and Protected Judgment keeps benchmark scores faithful to transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出 EvoTrias——一种"三权分立"式的 LLM 程序演化架构，将 govern、propose、judge 三项决策分别交给唯一所有者（结构化治理、开放提案、受保护评判），仅通过类型化契约交互，可作为插件将现有编码智能体升级为演化系统，在数学、系统与算法设计基准上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 程序演化系统在"谁负责 govern/propose/judge"上分为两派：控制器中心派强化治理但压制提案自主性，限制了演化可达空间；智能体中心派让编码智能体同时接管治理与提案，带来认知与算力开销。两派都未保障评判的独立权威，损害基准可靠性。其共同根源是自主性在三项决策间的错配。
AI.method: 采用分权架构，每项决策设唯一所有者：Structured Governance 负责跨演化轮次的全局调度；Open Proposal 负责任务内部的候选构造；Protected Judgment 置于私有评估器之后保证独立评判。三者仅交换类型化契约（typed contracts），并用运行时钩子（runtime hooks）强化边界。该分离使系统可作为插件把现有编码智能体转化为演化系统。
AI.result: 在数学、系统与算法设计基准上达到新的 SOTA；消融式证据显示：治理与提案分离使 token 成本降低 64%；开放提案使演化扩展到 68 万行工业级代码仓库；受保护评判使基准分数与迁移表现保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 程序演化的关键并非强化某一环节，而是对自主性做正确分配；分权架构在性能、效率、可扩展性与评测可信度上同时获益，并具备作为插件复用的通用性。

title: Serving-Aligned Entire-Space Conversion Modeling via Click-Through Rate Knowledge Distillation
summary: Recommendation systems may use predicted click-through conversion rate (pCTCVR), the product of predicted click-through rate (pCTR) and post-click conversion rate (pCVR), to guide ranking decisions. Many pCVR models build on the Entire Space Multi-Task Model (ESMM), which jointly trains pCVR and auxiliary pCTR towers using pCTR and pCTCVR losses, but deploys only the pCVR tower. At serving time, this tower may be paired with a separately trained pCTR model, creating a training-serving mismatch in pCTCVR when its predictions differ from those of the auxiliary pCTR tower. In this paper, we use knowledge distillation (KD) from logged serving pCTR scores to supervise ESMM's auxiliary pCTR tower and improve training-serving pCTCVR alignment. We denote variants by KD-$α$, where $α$ controls the hard-label loss weight. On the Ali-CCP dataset, KD-0.3, the best variant on serving pCTCVR, increases ROC-AUC not only for serving pCTCVR but also for pCVR by 2.1% and 1.6%, respectively, and PR-AUC by 9.9% and 8.8%, respectively, relative to the ESMM baseline. We also test negative downsampling with 5% nonclick retention.
