Against these references, released world models move their camera but barely move the scene: their scene response, the share of the real change in distance that the forecast reproduces, reaches at most about a third of real video's, and the trajectory score cannot tell an executed speed command from an ignored one. Interventions inside the generator trace the failure to the plan's channel. The forecast geometry follows the context frames; once they carry the planned geometry, plan tokens add little. ReTime-Compose therefore delivers the plan as geometry, without training. It transports the frames of one logged-speed rollout to the planned cameras, and the frozen model completes only what no frame covers. Frozen generators then follow a 0.54 m lateral shift nearly as the real scene does on KITTI, nuScenes and Argoverse 2, and respond more than re-sampling to slow-down plans in three generators and to speed-up plans in two.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示"计划条件驾驶世界模型"实际几乎不随计划改变场景，并提出无需训练的 ReTime-Compose 将计划以几何形式输入，使冻结生成器的场景响应接近真实。
AI.motivation: 计划条件世界模型用于比较候选轨迹，理应像真实场景那样随计划变化，但常用控制指标只检验相机是否跟随指令，无法验证场景是否真实响应。而已记录的数据中其实蕴含未被执行计划的可比参考（重定时得到不同速度下的姿态对齐图像与 LiDAR，立体相机得到横向平移视图）。
AI.method: 以重定时日志与立体位移作为"真实参照"，定义场景响应指标（预测复现的真实距离变化占比），对照评测已发布的世界模型；通过在生成器内部做干预实验定位失效来源；提出 ReTime-Compose：把某一段已记录速度 rollout 的帧传输到计划相机位置，冻结模型仅补全无帧覆盖区域，从而以几何而非 token 方式传递计划，无需训练。
AI.result: 已发布世界模型的相机虽移动，但场景几乎不动：场景响应最多约为真实视频的三分之一；轨迹评分无法区分"执行了速度指令"与"忽略了速度指令"。干预实验显示预测几何主要跟随上下帧上下文，一旦上下文携带计划几何，计划 token 作用甚微。ReTime-Compose 使冻结生成器在 KITTI、nuScenes、Argoverse 2 上对 0.54 m 横向位移的响应接近真实场景，并在三个生成器上对减速计划、在两个生成器上对加速计划的响应优于重采样。
AI.conclusion: 现有计划条件世界模型的"计划条件"是表面的，瓶颈在于计划信息的注入通道（token）而非容量；将计划编码为几何条件、并仅依赖冻结模型的补全能力，即可显著提升场景层面的计划响应，为世界模型评测提供了基于真实参照的严格指标。

title: Small Heads, Strong Decisions: A Controlled Study of Typed-Decision Models
summary: In September 2026, TypeSafe announced Jev as the first model in its System One category: unstructured state goes in, and typed, calibrated decisions that software can use directly come out. Jev's architecture and training data are unpublished, but many open typed-decision models have followed, including Nimble, the Decision 1.0--3.0 family and Clef. They answer structured questions about a piece of text, such as a yes/no check, a choice among labelled options or a graded score, by reading the text with a language model and scoring the options with a small readout. Each pairs a different readout with a different backbone, training mix and recipe, so it is unclear which design choices matter. We re-implement five readouts and train all of them under one protocol: the same backbone, the same 15 public English training sources, the same recipe with a per-head learning-rate sweep, and the same seed. Our experiments demonstrate that: The complexity of the head does not affect accuracy: on Qwen3-0.6B every readout reaches 81.3--82.0\% in-domain accuracy, and a 0.5M-parameter cosine head, which scores each option by its cosine similarity to the question, matches the 27M-parameter joint schema head adapted from Clef in-domain at half its inference time. Reading all of a text's questions from one prompt also matches one prompt per question in accuracy, with 1.6 times faster inference and 2.1--2.5 times faster training on one H100. The backbone's size matters more than either choice: moving from Qwen3-0.6B to Qwen3-4B adds 4 points in-domain and 11 points on held-out sources, while the base, instruct and thinking checkpoints of the same model tie. We recommend spending effort on the backbone and keeping the head minimal.

AI.tldr: 在统一协议下复现五种 typed-decision readout，发现 head 复杂度对精度无影响、合并提问可提速、backbone 规模才是关键。
AI.motivation: Jev 等 typed-decision 模型架构与训练数据未公开，其后出现的开源模型（Nimble、Decision 1.0–3.0、Clef）各自搭配不同 readout、backbone、训练混合与配方，导致无法判断哪些设计选择真正重要。
AI.method: 复现五种 readout，并在同一协议下训练全部模型：相同 backbone、相同 15 个公开英文训练源、相同训练配方（含 per-head 学习率扫描）、相同随机种子；在 Qwen3-0.6B 与 Qwen3-4B 上做对照实验，比较 head 复杂度、提问方式（一次 prompt 读全部问题 vs 每题一个 prompt）与 backbone 规模/检查点类型。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-0.6B 上所有 readout 的域内精度均达 81.3–82.0%；0.5M 参数的 cosine head 在域内与 27M 参数的 joint schema head（改编自 Clef）持平，且推理时间减半。一次 prompt 读取全部问题与每题一 prompt 精度持平，但推理快 1.6 倍，单张 H100 上训练快 2.1–2.5 倍。Qwen3-0.6B→4B 带来域内 +4 点、留出源 +11 点，而同模型的 base/instruct/thinking checkpoint 表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 应把投入放在 backbone 上，保持 head 极简。

title: Schedule-Calibrated Commitment Order in Blockwise Masked Diffusion Language Models
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Includes appendices and ancillary code for algebraic verification
summary: Sequential block schedules can make token commitment in masked diffusion language models appear strongly left-to-right even when within-block order is random or reversed. For equal contiguous blocks processed without interleaving in positional order, with untied irreversible commitments, we use a Spearman-rank identity to express global position-commitment correlation as a deterministic schedule reference plus a weighted mean within-block correlation. In a reported paired study of LLaDA-8B-Instruct on 500 math and code prompts with 256 generated positions and updates, increasing block size from 64 to 128 lowers mean global correlation from 0.9845 to 0.9149. Uniform-random within-block references are already 0.9375 and 0.7500. After calibration, mean within-block correlations are 0.751 and 0.660, so the larger raw residual at block size 128 does not indicate stronger local positional ordering. We give sharp bounds and derive calibrated intervals from reported summaries, while documenting the limitations of the aggregate-only empirical release. The analysis supports schedule-aware interpretation of commitment order; its empirical scope is one checkpoint and two schedules, without evaluation of output quality or inference speed.

AI.tldr: 该文指出掩码扩散语言模型中"令牌承诺呈强左到右顺序"的现象可由分块调度本身解释，提出用Spearman秩恒等式将全局位置-承诺相关分解为调度参考项与块内相关加权均值，并对LLaDA-8B-Instruct的配对实验数据做校准与界分析。
AI.motivation: 已有研究报告在掩码扩散语言模型中出现强烈的左到右令牌承诺顺序，但顺序块调度（块内顺序随机甚至逆序）本身可能人为制造这种表观顺序性，需要区分调度效应与真正的局部位置排序。
AI.method: 针对等长子连续块、按位置顺序非交错处理且承诺不可逆不共享的情形，利用Spearman秩恒等式把全局位置-承诺相关系数写成确定性的调度参考值加上块内相关系数的加权平均；对LLaDA-8B-Instruct在500个数学与代码提示、256个生成位置上报告的分块64与128配对结果进行校准，并给出紧界与由汇总统计导出的校准区间。
AI.result: 块大小由64增至128时，平均全局相关从0.9845降至0.9149；而均匀随机块内机制的参考值分别为0.9375与0.7500。校准后平均块内相关分别为0.751与0.660，说明块大小128下较大的原始残差并不意味着更强的局部位置排序。
AI.conclusion: 对承诺顺序的解读须考虑调度结构（schedule-aware）；该分析的经验范围限于单一检查点与两种调度，未评估输出质量或推理速度，且仅基于聚合级经验发布存在局限。

title: COMBS: Concealed Object Multi-modal Bayesian Search
summary: This work addresses the problem of finding a concealed object in an environment by unifying formalisms for partially observable environments with multi-modal priors drawn from a mix of ontologies, semantic networks, LLMs, and VLMs. We propose a concealment-adaptive mixed-observability MDP (CA-MOMDP), a Bayes-adaptive setting where uncertainty is over both object locations and which nodes can conceal them, held as a hypothesis with a bounded ontology prior and resolved only by interaction. We define a hierarchical transition system (HTS) to abstract the environment into room and object nodes that can be planned over via our CA-MOMDP. We further propose a COMBS-score: a multi-modal fusion of a human informed semantic network, LLM, and VLM, to initialize the belief over object locations, which grounds our abstractions and reduces reliance on a single model. Belief is maintained via Bayes' rule, which never lets a look rule out a closed container. We prove a present target is found in a bounded number of searches under exact perception and that its location is never ruled out given missed detection under noisy perception. We ablate each component to demonstrate their significance. Across five simulator configurations, from a gridworld to Matterport3D with a real detector, COMBS finds 92-100% of in-distribution and 92-100% of out-of-distribution targets, matches or beats the baselines in processing speed, significantly outperforms a per-step LLM policy at lower cost on the larger scenes, recovers more out-of-distribution placements than a TidyBot ranking, and matches an LLM-only prior at a fraction of its per-decision latency. COMBS is the only standalone method that can declare a target absent at a stated error level, and the per-step LLM policy offered a termination action abandons 12-22% of targets that were present, against 1.6-3.2% for COMBS on the same episodes.

AI.tldr: 提出CA-MOMDP与HTS抽象，并用多模态COMBS-score初始化信念，实现对隐藏目标的搜索，在仿真中召回92-100%且显著优于LLM策略与TidyBot排序。
AI.motivation: 在部分可观测环境中寻找被遮挡/隐藏的物体，需要同时处理目标位置不确定性与"哪些节点具备遮蔽能力"的不确定性，且单一模型（LLM或VLM）先验不可靠。
AI.method: 定义concealment-adaptive mixed-observability MDP（Bayes-adaptive），以有界本体先验表示遮蔽假设；构建分层转移系统（HTS）将环境抽象为房间与物体节点；提出COMBS-score，融合人工语义网络、LLM与VLM初始化位置信念；用贝叶斯规则更新信念，且允许已查看的封闭容器仍可能容纳目标；对遮蔽假设与感知噪声做消融。
AI.result: 证明精确感知下目标在有界搜索步数内被找到，噪声感知下漏检不会排除真实位置；五种仿真（含Matterport3D+真实检测器）中ID与OOD召回均为92-100%，速度不劣于基线，大场景下显著优于逐步LLM策略且成本更低，OOD放置恢复优于TidyBot排序，精度接近纯LLM先验而单步延迟大幅降低；COMBS是唯一能在给定误差水平下声明目标缺失的独立方法，LLM策略终止动作误弃12-22%真实存在目标，COMBS仅1.6-3.2%。
AI.conclusion: 多模态融合先验加遮蔽感知的贝叶斯信念更新，可在保证可证搜索界与不漏检排除的前提下高效完成隐藏目标搜索，并支持带误差保证的缺失判定。

title: Energy system device sizing under closed-loop operation with imperfect forecasts
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the 2027 European Control Conference (ECC)
summary: The value of renewable energy devices depends on their operation, which must adapt to weather and demand using limited, imperfect forecasts that update over time. Conventional energy systems planning practices assume unlimited foresight in a single-level formulation, potentially leading to long-term investment in suboptimal device sizes. Accounting for realistic operation corresponds to a bi-level problem: the upper level selects device sizes, while the lower level contains closed-loop operation under evolving forecasts. We solve this problem using backpropagation MPC (BP-MPC), a gradient-based method, with a deterministic MPC as the lower-level controller. Using forecast errors generated by a parameterized martingale model of forecast evolution, we investigate how forecast accuracy affects the benefits of operation-aware energy systems planning and the resulting device sizes. In a case study of an energy system comprising photovoltaics, a battery, a heat pump, and thermal storage with uncertain weather and energy demands, accounting for closed-loop operation yields higher average cost savings as forecast error increases. The resulting designs achieve these savings by progressively shifting investment from battery storage to solar generation and thermal storage, which buffers forecast mismatches.

AI.tldr: 论文指出传统单层规划假设无限预见会导致设备容量次优，因而将"运行感知"的能源系统规划建模为双层问题，用BP-MPC求解，并借助参数化鞅预报演化模型考察预报误差对规划效益与设备规模的影响。
AI.motivation: 可再生能源设备价值取决于其运行方式，而运行必须在预报有限、不完美且随时间更新的条件下适配天气与需求。常规规划实践在单层优化中假设无限预见，可能长期投资于次优的设备规模，因此需要把真实运行行为纳入规划。
AI.method: 构建双层问题：上层选择设备规模，下层为随预报演化的闭环运行。采用基于梯度的backpropagation MPC（BP-MPC）求解，下层控制器为确定性MPC；预报误差由参数化鞅预报演化模型生成。
AI.result: 在含光伏、电池、热泵与储热的算例中（天气与用能需求不确定）：随着预报误差增大，考虑闭环运行带来的平均成本节约更高；所得设计通过将投资逐步从电池储能转向光伏发电与可缓冲预报偏差的热储能来实现这些节约。
AI.conclusion: 将闭环运行纳入规划能提升系统经济性，且其收益随预报精度下降而放大；忽视运行可行性与预报更新会系统性偏离最优容量配置。双层BP-MPC框架为运行感知的能源系统规划提供了可计算途径。

title: PCLSegNet: Anatomy-Aware Deep Learning Framework for MRI-based Pancreatic Cyst Segmentation and Size Assessment
summary: Early detection and follow-up of pancreatic cystic lesions (PCLs) are crucial, as some of their subtypes, such as mucinous cystic neoplasms (MCNs) and intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasms, carry a significant risk of malignant transformation. Although most AI studies investigating PCLs rely on computed tomography (CT) scans, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) offers superior soft tissue contrast, making it highly suitable for PCLs assessment. In this work, we propose an anatomy-aware two-stage deep learning framework for automated PCLs segmentation on abdominal MRI scans. First, a publicly available pancreas segmentation model is used to localize the pancreas. Then, we introduce the anatomyaware PCLSegNet, which incorporates anatomical priors as guidance for pancreas and PCLs segmentation. To address the class imbalance problem, we develop a Class-Specific ErrorWeighted (CSEW) loss function. Postprocessing is applied through anatomical constraints.Our proposed method outperforms multi-organ segmentation models such as TotalSegmentator, achieving substantially higher Dice scores for pancreas segmentation. Moreover, it also achieves a superior normalized surface Dice (NSD) and recall for PCLs segmentationcompared to other state-of-the-art models like nnU-Net, while also notably reducing the false negative rate, facilitating the automatic early detection and the noninvasive imaging-based assessment of PCLs.

AI.tldr: 提出一种解剖感知的两阶段深度学习框架，用于腹部MRI上胰腺囊性病变（PCLs）的自动分割：先用公开胰腺分割模型定位胰腺，再用可融合解剖先验的PCLSegNet分割胰腺与PCLs，并设计类特定误差加权损失与解剖约束后处理。
AI.motivation: PCLs（如MCNs、IPMN）存在恶变风险，需早期检测与随访；现有AI研究多基于CT，而MRI软组织对比度更优、更适合PCLs评估，但相关自动化分割方法不足，且存在类别不平衡问题。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：①采用公开胰腺分割模型实现胰腺定位（粗定位）；②提出解剖感知的PCLSegNet，将解剖先验作为引导信息用于胰腺与PCLs分割；③设计类特定误差加权（CSEW）损失函数以缓解类别不平衡；④基于解剖约束进行后处理。
AI.result: 胰腺分割Dice显著优于TotalSegmentator等多器官分割模型；PCLs分割的归一化表面Dice（NSD）与召回率优于nnU-Net等SOTA模型，并明显降低假阴性率。
AI.conclusion: 该解剖感知两阶段框架在腹部MRI上实现了更优的胰腺与PCLs分割性能，有助于PCLs的自动早期检测与无创影像学评估。

title: MemCredit: From Relevance to Utility for Decision-Time Memory in Long-Horizon Web Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over long Web interaction histories, making memory management critical for reliable and efficient decision making. Existing methods primarily optimize storage, retrieval, or compression, but the memories most semantically relevant to the current state are not necessarily those that most improve the agent's action. We introduce MemCredit, a decision-centric memory framework that shifts memory selection from semantic relevance to decision utility. MemCredit estimates the state-, reference-context-, and policy-conditional marginal contribution of individual memories through controlled counterfactual interventions, and distills these intervention-derived credits into a lightweight utility estimator. At inference time, semantic relevance is used only for high-recall candidate generation, while predicted utility arbitrates which memories are retained under a fixed token budget, without modifying the underlying agent policy or requiring additional environment interaction. We evaluate MemCredit on ALFWorld and WebShop against representative memory baselines. On ALFWorld, MemCredit achieves 86.57 SR@50 under a 500-token historical-memory budget, compared with 65.67% for BM25 retrieval. Counterfactual analysis further shows that memory utility is sparse, strongly state dependent, and poorly captured by semantic relevance. These results suggest that decision utility provides a more effective principle than relevance alone for long-horizon agent memory management.

AI.tldr: MemCredit 提出以“决策效用”而非“语义相关性”为中心的长程 Web 智能体记忆选择框架：通过反事实干预估计单个记忆的边际贡献并蒸馏为轻量效用估计器，推理时仅用语义相关性做高召回候选生成、用预测效用做预算内仲裁，在 ALFWorld 上以 500 token 预算取得 86.57 SR@50（BM25 为 65.67%）。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体需在长程 Web 交互历史中做记忆管理，现有方法聚焦存储、检索或压缩，但默认“语义最相关”即“最有用”。作者指出这一假设不成立：与当前状态语义最相关的记忆未必最能提升智能体的动作质量，因此需要把记忆选择从相关性导向转向决策导向。
AI.method: 1）决策中心的记忆选择：以记忆对最终决策的边际贡献作为选择准则。2）反事实信用估计：通过受控反事实干预，估计单条记忆在给定状态、参考上下文与策略条件下的条件边际贡献（state-, reference-context-, policy-conditional）。3）蒸馏为轻量效用估计器：将干预得到的 credit 蒸馏成可在线快速推断的效用预测模型。4）推理阶段两级流水线：语义相关性仅用于高召回候选生成，再由预测效用在固定 token 预算下仲裁保留哪些记忆；不修改底层策略、不额外与环境交互。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上与代表性记忆基线对比。ALFWorld 上，500 token 历史记忆预算下达到 86.57 SR@50，BM25 检索为 65.67%。反事实分析表明：记忆效用具有稀疏性、强状态依赖性，且难以被语义相关性刻画。
AI.conclusion: 对长程智能体记忆管理而言，决策效用比单纯语义相关性更有效的选择原则；用反事实信用替代相关性排序，可在严苛 token 预算下显著提升任务成功率，且保持策略无关、免额外交互的部署友好性。

title: Regret Bounds for Quantum Linear Bandits
summary: We study $d$-dimensional quantum linear bandits with bounded rewards, where the learner selects an action and queries its quantum reward oracle or its inverse in each round. For general action sets, existing algorithms achieve regret $O(d^{3/2}\operatorname{polylog}(T))$ over $T$ rounds. Prior work established a lower bound of $Ω(d\log(1+T/d))$, leaving open whether the $d^{3/2}$ dependence in the upper bound is necessary. We resolve this question by proving a minimax lower bound of $Ω(d^{3/2}\log(1+T/d^{3/2}))$. To prove this result, we construct a family of hard instances in which the reward gap of each action is proportional to its squared distance from the optimal action. We establish a posterior Fisher information bound for adaptive quantum queries with quantum memory, relating the information acquired about the optimal direction to the regret incurred. Viewing each selected action as an estimate of the optimal direction, we use a matrix Cramér--Rao argument to derive a lower bound on expected regret. When the action set is fixed and has size $K$, we propose two phased elimination algorithms, Soft-G-Elim and QG-Elim. We adapt quantum phase estimation to construct SoftQME, a mean estimator with small bias and controlled tails. Soft-G-Elim estimates the mean reward of every surviving action from independent SoftQME outputs on the support of an experimental design. Controlling the bias and fluctuations of these estimates yields regret $O(d\log T\log(dT)\sqrt{\log(KT)})$, reducing the $\log(KT)\log\log(dT)$ factor in the previous regret bound to $\sqrt{\log(KT)}$. QG-Elim further reduces this factor to $\min\{\sqrt{\log(KT)},\sqrt d\}$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有界奖励的d维量子线性bandit，证明极小极大下界Ω(d^{3/2}log(1+T/d^{3/2}))，从而确认既有O(d^{3/2}polylog T)上界中d^{3/2}依赖是必要的；并针对|A|=K的固定动作集提出Soft-G-Elim与QG-Elim两种分阶段淘汰算法，改进对数因子。
AI.motivation: 量子线性bandit已有上界O(d^{3/2}polylog(T))，但先前下界仅为Ω(d log(1+T/d))，二者在d的依赖上相差√d，上界中d^{3/2}是否必要尚属开放问题；同时固定动作集情形下的对数因子也可进一步收紧。
AI.method: (1) 构造困难实例族：每个动作的奖励间隔与其到最优动作的平方距离成正比；(2) 为带量子内存的自适应量子查询建立后验Fisher信息界，将关于最优方向所获信息与累积遗憾相联系；(3) 把所选动作视为最优方向的估计，用矩阵Cramér–Rao论证导出期望遗憾下界；(4) 对规模为K的固定动作集，提出Soft-G-Elim与QG-Elim两种分阶段淘汰算法，改造量子相位估计构造低偏差、尾部可控的均值估计器SoftQME，并在实验设计的支撑集上以独立的SoftQME输出估计各存活动作的均值。
AI.result: 证明极小极大下界Ω(d^{3/2}log(1+T/d^{3/2}))，与上界的d^{3/2}阶匹配；Soft-G-Elim通过控制估计偏差与波动获得遗憾O(d log T log(dT)√(log(KT)))，将先前的log(KT)loglog(dT)因子降为√(log(KT))；QG-Elim进一步将该因子降为min{√(log(KT)), √d}。
AI.conclusion: 一般动作集下d^{3/2}依赖不可避免，量子线性bandit的复杂度刻画在d的多项式阶上已闭合；对固定有限动作集，基于SoftQME的分阶段淘汰可获得更紧的对数/维度因子，提升了现有最优遗憾界。

title: Video-Action Models for Data-Efficient Industrial Manipulation
summary: Industrial manipulation requires precise alignment and controlled handling of rigid, deformable, and flexible components. Yet, the benefits of pretrained visuomotor policies remain underexplored in settings where limited access to specialized hardware, components, and fixtures constrains demonstration collection and evaluation. Understanding task-specific data requirements is important for assessing their scalability across diverse processes on the factory floor. We investigate whether video pretraining can support reliable industrial manipulation with limited action data. We propose FLUX-mimic, a video-action model, motivated by the potential of video pretraining to capture motion and interaction patterns that enable sample-efficient training. FLUX-mimic is built on a backbone pretrained on large-scale web and industrial task data, and an action expert to generate robot trajectories. We train our policy by joint video-action training. Across four automotive manufacturing benchmark tasks and two bimanual robot platforms, FLUX-mimic outperforms all considered baselines on the dexterous robot platform and matches pi_{0.5}'s average success rate on the gripper-based robot platform. On a deformable part kitting task, FLUX-mimic reaches 77.5% success with as little as two hours of task-specific action-labeled demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FLUX-mimic，一个基于大规模视频预训练的 video-action 模型，通过联合视频-动作训练实现小样本工业操作策略学习，在汽车制造基准任务上以极少动作标注数据取得高成功率。
AI.motivation: 工业操作需精确对齐与受控处理刚性、可变形及柔性零件，但专用硬件、部件与夹具的获取受限，使示范采集与评估困难，预训练视觉运动策略在此场景的收益仍缺乏探索；理解任务特定数据需求对评估其在工厂场景的可扩展性很重要。论文关注：在动作数据有限的条件下，视频预训练能否支撑可靠的工业操作。
AI.method: 提出 FLUX-mimic：以在大规模网络数据与工业任务数据上预训练的骨干为基础，另加一个 action expert 生成机器人轨迹；采用视频-动作联合训练方式训练策略。在四个汽车制造基准任务与两种双臂机器人平台上评估，并与基线（含 pi_{0.5}）对比。
AI.result: 在灵巧机器人平台上，FLUX-mimic 优于所有对比基线；在夹爪式机器人平台上，其平均成功率与 pi_{0.5} 相当；在可变形零件配餐（kitting）任务上，仅用两小时任务特定的动作标注示范即达到 77.5% 成功率。
AI.conclusion: 视频预训练可显著提升动作数据的样本效率，使 video-action 模型在有限动作数据下实现可靠的工业操作，具备跨多种工厂流程规模化的潜力。

title: Velocity-Free Funnel Control of Euler-Lagrange Systems: An Artificial-Delay Approach
summary: Classical funnel control keeps the tracking error within a prescribed, time-varying envelope by increasing the feedback gain as the error approaches the boundary. For mechanical systems, this guarantee typically relies on velocity measurements. We show that it can be retained for fully actuated Euler--Lagrange systems using only position measurements. The proposed controller replaces the velocity error with a difference quotient of the position error over a fixed delay, while preserving the classical unbounded gain. It requires no plant model, reference derivatives, observer, or filter states. The central challenge is to reconcile the averaging inherent in delayed feedback with a gain that can grow without bound near the funnel boundary. We resolve this by establishing an a priori bound on the gain along closed-loop trajectories, independent of the delay. This bound yields a computable delay threshold that guarantees tracking within the prescribed funnel and boundedness of all closed-loop signals. The threshold depends only on bounds on the inertia, forces, and reference. Simulations demonstrate tracking accuracy comparable to full-state funnel control and tolerance of delays substantially longer than certified. With quantized position measurements, the controller also requires substantially less torque than an existing derivative-free funnel controller.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅用位置测量的漏斗控制方法：以固定时滞下位置误差的差商替代速度误差，在保留经典无界增益的同时，实现全驱动Euler–Lagrange系统的规定漏斗内跟踪。
AI.motivation: 经典漏斗控制通过误差逼近边界时增大反馈增益来保证跟踪误差处于时变包络内，但机械系统实现该保证通常依赖速度测量。本文旨在去掉速度测量这一要求，且不引入模型、参考导数、观测器或滤波器状态。
AI.method: 用固定时滞上位置误差的差商代替速度误差，保留经典的无界增益结构；核心是给出闭环轨迹上增益的先验上界（与时滞无关），由此得到可计算的时滞阈值，该阈值仅依赖惯量、力与参考信号的界。
AI.result: 获得保证规定漏斗内跟踪及所有闭环信号有界的可计算时滞阈值；仿真显示跟踪精度可与全状态漏斗控制相当，且能容忍明显长于认证值的时滞；在量化位置测量下，所需力矩显著低于现有无导数漏斗控制器。
AI.conclusion: 仅位置测量的漏斗控制可在全驱动Euler–Lagrange系统上保持经典保证，延迟反馈的 averaging 与无界增益可被增益先验界协调，方法简单（无模型、无观测器/滤波器）且具鲁棒性。

title: Track4D: Representing Dense 3D Tracking for Video Diffusion Models
summary: We study how to repurpose video diffusion models (VDMs), pretrained on millions of videos, for dense 3D point tracking, where training data is scarce. Doing so is non-trivial, as it requires representing 3D tracks as video-like signals that may lie outside the natural-video distribution on which the VDM was trained. We thus systematically assess the effectiveness of two such video representations. The first, Residual 3D Tracking Video (RTV), encodes per-pixel 3D offsets relative to a query frame and allows recovery of 3D trajectories directly from the generated video. The second, Normalized Coordinate Map Video (NCMV), labels each pixel with a canonical coordinate invariant through time. This is closer to a natural video and easier for the VDM to learn, but requires additional post-processing with an off-the-shelf 2D tracker to recover 3D tracks. RTV tracks more accurately, while NCMV shows that a VDM can generate dense correspondence as a video. We instantiate both representations with LoRA adaptation of a frozen Wan backbone, conditioned on point maps from an off-the-shelf 3D reconstructor as a geometric scaffold. Trained with a single dynamic 3D tracking dataset, Track4D achieves competitive zero-shot tracking on four real and synthetic benchmarks. A regression readout that bypasses the video VAE and uses additional training data brings further improvement, demonstrating the potential of this direction for dense 3D tracking. We hope our analysis will inspire future work that leverages VDM priors for dense 3D tracking and 4D reconstruction. Project page: https://nirvanalan.github.io/projects/track4d

AI.tldr: 论文系统评估两种“类视频”3D轨迹表示，通过LoRA适配冻结的Wan视频扩散模型并结合点图几何脚手架，实现数据稀缺条件下的稠密3D点跟踪；Track4D在四个基准上取得有竞争力的零样本性能。
AI.motivation: 稠密3D点跟踪训练数据稀缺，而视频扩散模型（VDM）在海量视频上预训练、蕴含丰富时空先验。但直接复用存在难点：3D轨迹需被表示为视频式信号，且该信号往往偏离VDM训练所用的自然视频分布，因此需要系统考察何种表示更适配VDM。
AI.method: 提出并对比两种视频化表示：(1) 残差3D跟踪视频（RTV），编码相对查询帧的逐像素3D偏移，可直接从生成视频中还原3D轨迹；(2) 归一化坐标图视频（NCMV），为每像素赋予时间不变的正则坐标，更接近自然视频、更易学习，但需借助现成2D跟踪器后处理恢复3D轨迹。实现上以冻结Wan骨干加LoRA微调，并以现成3D重建器输出的点图作为几何条件脚手架；另设绕过视频VAE的回归读出，可利用额外训练数据。
AI.result: 仅用单一动态3D跟踪数据集训练，即在四个真实与合成基准上取得有竞争力的零样本跟踪结果；RTV跟踪更精确，NCMV则证明VDM能以视频形式生成稠密对应；绕过VAE的回归读出配合更多训练数据可进一步提升性能。
AI.conclusion: VDM先验可有效迁移至稠密3D跟踪，表示设计（RTV vs NCMV）在精度与可学习性间存在权衡；该方向对稠密3D跟踪与4D重建具有潜力，值得后续研究。

title: A Reliability Study of Explainable AI for Freight Mode Classification
summary: Machine learning models are increasingly used to support freight transportation decisions, but their predictions are rarely accompanied by evidence that the associated explanations can be trusted. In this study we investigate explainable machine learning for classifying shipments as Air/Air Charter or Truck/Ocean using the PEPFAR Supply Chain Management System Delivery History dataset, with 5,964 shipment records and 47 input features after cleaning, where freight cost and pack price are excluded as near-proxies of the transportation mode. We compare three Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) architectures, Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and gradient boosting with imbalance-aware metrics and paired significance tests across one hundred random replications. We then evaluate the explanations themselves, namely the stability of SHAP feature rankings across retraining and across models, the faithfulness of SHAP and LIME attributions under a feature-deletion test, and the geographic structure of the destination effects, which we map for all 38 destination countries. The results suggest that the tree ensembles significantly outperform the neural and linear models (86.8% against 83.3-85.0% mean testing accuracy) while their leading features remain the most stable across retraining. Removing the five features ranked most important by SHAP or LIME changes the predicted probabilities roughly four times as much as removing randomly chosen features. The destination effects form a coherent geographic pattern that simple port access does not explain. However, models with similar accuracy disagree substantially on which features matter most, and thus explanation stability and faithfulness should be assessed before such explanations are used to support freight transport decisions.

AI.tldr: 该研究在PEPFAR供应链发货数据（5,964条记录、47个特征）上比较MLP、逻辑回归、随机森林与梯度提升，分类空运/包机与卡车/海运两种运输方式，并系统评估SHAP/LIME解释的稳定性、忠实性与地理结构。
AI.motivation: 机器学习日益用于支持货运决策，但其预测往往缺乏可被信任的解释证据；本文旨在检验这些解释本身是否可靠。
AI.method: 清洗后保留47个特征（剔除运费与包装价格作为运输方式的近似代理变量）；比较三种MLP架构、逻辑回归、随机森林与梯度提升；采用不平衡感知指标与配对显著性检验，重复100次随机实验；随后评估解释质量：SHAP特征排序在重训练与跨模型间的稳定性、SHAP与LIME归因在特征删除测试下的忠实性，并绘制全部38个目的地国家的目的地效应地理格局。
AI.result: 树集成模型显著优于神经网络与线性模型（平均测试准确率86.8% vs 83.3–85.0%），其主导特征在重训练中最为稳定；删除SHAP或LIME排名前五的特征后，预测概率变化约为随机删除的4倍；目的地效应呈现一致的地理模式，且无法由简单的港口可达性解释；但精度相近的模型在关键特征判断上存在实质分歧。
AI.conclusion: 树集成在准确率与解释稳定性上占优，SHAP/LIME归因通过忠实性检验，但模型间解释分歧显著，因此在将此类解释用于货运决策支持前，应先评估解释的稳定性与忠实性。

title: KQML-Liver: Interpretable Hybrid Quantum Machine Learning with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Liver Disease Classification
summary: Liver disease remains a major global health concern, highlighting the need for reliable and accessible early detection methods. Although recent advances in machine learning, deep learning and quantum machine learning (QML) have introduced promising diagnostic tools, many approaches suffer from limited interpretability and inflated performance caused by data leakage or overly simplistic evaluation protocols. These constraints reduce their reliability in real-world clinical practice. This paper proposes KQML-Liver, a hybrid framework that integrates QML with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) to enhance predictive performance and interpretability. The architecture combines parameterized quantum circuits for expressive feature representation with KAN-based functional mappings that capture nonlinear relationships in an interpretable manner. Evaluated on the Indian Liver Patient Dataset (ILPD) under a rigorous preprocessing protocol preventing data leakage, the proposed model achieves 82% classification accuracy and 100% recall, detecting all positive cases, outperforming existing baselines while providing improved transparency in clinical predictions. These results suggest that hybrid KAN-quantum architectures offer a promising direction for interpretable AI-assisted medical diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 提出KQML-Liver混合框架，将量子机器学习（QML）与Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）结合，用于肝病早期检测，在ILPD数据集上取得82%准确率与100%召回率。
AI.motivation: 肝病是全球重大健康问题，亟需可靠、易获取的早期检测手段。现有机器学习、深度学习及量子机器学习方法普遍存在可解释性不足，且因数据泄漏或不严谨的评估协议导致性能虚高，削弱了临床实用性。
AI.method: 构建KQML-Liver混合架构：以参数化量子电路进行表达性特征表示，结合基于KAN的函数映射以可解释方式刻画非线性关系；在印度肝病患者数据集（ILPD）上采用严格预处理流程以杜绝数据泄漏。
AI.result: 分类准确率达82%，召回率达100%（全部阳性病例均被检出），优于现有多条基线方法，并提升了临床预测的透明度。
AI.conclusion: KAN-量子混合架构为可解释的AI辅助医学诊断提供了有前景的方向。

title: DexRemo: A Force-Sensing Hand Platform and Task Suite for Contact-Rich Removal Manipulation
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Robotics (T-RO), 2026. Project website: https://dexremo.github.io
summary: Many manipulation tasks require separating adhered, embedded, contaminated, or mechanically constrained targets. We study this setting as removal manipulation, where progress depends on evolving contact states that are only partially observable from vision and kinematics. We introduce DexRemo, a three-finger robotic hand with high-force actuation, modular fingertips, and three-axis fingertip force sensing, together with a nine-scenario real-robot task suite spanning adhesive detachment, surface cleaning and self-cleaning, and occluded retrieval. To make multi-finger force observations easier to fuse, we express fingertip forces in a shared wrist-centered frame, giving force components consistent geometric meaning across fingers and time. Using an Action Chunking Transformer backbone, policies fuse multi-view vision, proprioception, fingertip pose, and force observations to predict closed-loop action chunks from demonstrations. Evaluation uses six core benchmark tasks for controlled fingertip-input and force-frame ablations, plus three extension scenarios for additional held-out coverage. Across these evaluations, the learned policies achieve consistent removal performance, and ablations show that wrist-frame forces, especially with fingertip pose, improve stability and generalization over local-frame force inputs and no-force baselines. Project website: https://dexremo.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出三指高力机械手DexRemo与九场景"移除操作"任务集，将指尖力统一表达在腕部中心坐标系下，用ACT骨干融合多视角视觉、本体感受、指尖位姿与力观测，实现闭环动作块预测；消融表明腕坐标系力+指尖位姿显著提升稳定性与泛化。
AI.motivation: 粘附分离、嵌入、表面污染与机械约束等"移除类"操作依赖随时间演化的接触状态，而这些状态仅凭视觉与运动学只能部分观测，缺乏力觉反馈难以支撑稳定推进与泛化。
AI.method: 硬件：三指机械手，具备高力输出执行、模块化指尖、三轴指尖力传感。数据：九场景真机任务套件（粘附分离、表面清洁与自清洁、遮挡取物），其中6个核心基准任务用于指尖输入与力坐标系的受控消融，3个扩展场景作留出覆盖。表征：将指尖力变换至共享腕部中心坐标系，使各指各时刻力分量具有一致几何语义，便于多指力融合。策略：以Action Chunking Transformer为骨干，融合多视角视觉、本体感受、指尖位姿与力观测，从示教中预测闭环动作块。
AI.result: 在全部评测中策略取得一致的移除性能；消融实验显示腕坐标系力输入（尤其与指尖位姿联合）相较于局部坐标系力输入与无力基线，在稳定性与泛化性上均更优。
AI.conclusion: 证明了力觉在部分可观测接触状态下的必要性，以及"共享腕坐标系力表征+指尖位姿"是提升多指移除操作策略稳定性与泛化的关键设计，为接触密集型操作提供了硬件—表征—策略一体的方案。

title: Structure-Preserving Learning for Nonlinear Nonholonomic Dynamics
summary: Learning the dynamics of mechanical systems subject to nonlinear nonholonomic constraints is challenging, as data-driven models may violate the underlying physical constraints, leading to inconsistent predictions. To address this problem, we develop a constraint-preserving learning framework based on the Lagrange-d'Alembert-Chetaev equations and tangency to the constraint submanifold, which together define an affine space of admissible accelerations. Using the kinetic-energy metric and the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse, we construct a metric projector and the corresponding Chetaev correction. Embedding this geometric structure directly into a Gaussian process prior ensures that both prior and posterior dynamics satisfy the acceleration constraints exactly. We characterize the resulting reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS), derive an adapted-coordinate representation, and establish nonexpansiveness and consistency transfer. Numerical experiments on a three-dimensional directional flocking system with up to 50 agents demonstrate exact constraint preservation and robustness to constraint-incompatible observations.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Lagrange-d'Alembert-Chetaev方程与约束子流形相切性的约束保持学习框架，用动能度量和Moore-Penrose伪逆构造度量投影与Chetaev修正，并将其嵌入高斯过程先验，使先验与后验动力学严格满足非完整加速度约束。
AI.motivation: 受非线性非完整约束的机械系统动力学学习困难：数据驱动模型可能违反底层物理约束，导致预测不一致。
AI.method: 利用Lagrange-d'Alembert-Chetaev方程和与约束子流形的相切性定义容许加速度的仿射空间；以动能度量与Moore-Penrose伪逆构造度量投影算子及相应Chetaev修正；将该几何结构直接嵌入GP先验，保证先验和后验动力学精确满足加速度约束；刻画对应的RKHS，给出适配坐标表示，并证明非扩张性与一致性迁移。
AI.result: 在含至多50个智能体的三维定向群集（directional flocking）系统数值实验中，实现精确约束保持，并对与约束不相容的观测具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将约束几何结构内嵌于GP先验是学习非完整约束机械系统动力学的有效途径，可在理论上保证约束满足并提升对不一致数据的鲁棒性。

title: Beyond the Explicit: Benchmarking and Detecting Implicit Harm in Short Videos
summary: Short videos have become a dominant online medium, where harmful content is increasingly conveyed in implicit and fragmented forms. Prior work largely focuses on explicit categories, such as violence and hate speech, and often fails to detect videos that subtly promote misleading values through narrative context, emotional framing, or cross-modal cues, partly due to the lack of dedicated benchmarks for implicit harm. To bridge this gap, we construct DeepHarm-7K, a large-scale harmful short-video dataset comprising 7,110 samples annotated according to a fine-grained harmful-content taxonomy. The dataset systematically covers implicitly harmful videos across diverse real-world scenarios and is constructed through a rigorous multi-stage quality-control process. Building on this dataset, we propose DeepHarm-VL, a multimodal detection framework that integrates visual, audio, and cross-modal reasoning. The framework employs a two-round reasoning strategy to progressively identify surface-level evidence and infer latent harmful implications. Experimental results show consistent improvements over strong baselines and state-of-the-art methods across multiple open-source video-language models, demonstrating its effectiveness in detecting both explicit and implicit harmful short videos.

AI.tldr: 论文构建了7,110条样本的隐式有害短视频数据集DeepHarm-7K，并提出多模态检测框架DeepHarm-VL，通过两轮推理先识别表层证据再推断潜在有害含义，在多个开源视频语言模型上稳定优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 短视频已成为主流媒介，有害内容日益以隐式、碎片化形式传播。已有工作多聚焦暴力、仇恨言论等显式类别，难以识别通过叙事语境、情绪框架或跨模态线索隐性传递误导性价值观的视频，主因是缺乏专门的隐式有害内容基准。
AI.method: 构建DeepHarm-7K大规模有害短视频数据集，依据细粒度有害内容分类体系标注，覆盖多类真实场景并经过多阶段严格质量控制；在此基础上提出DeepHarm-VL多模态检测框架，融合视觉、音频与跨模态推理，采用两轮推理策略，逐步识别表层证据并推断潜在的隐性有害含义。
AI.result: 在多个开源视频语言模型上，该方法相较强基线与现有最优方法均取得一致提升，对显式与隐式有害短视频均表现出有效检测能力。
AI.conclusion: 补足了隐式有害短视频的基准空缺，验证了细粒度数据构建与分阶段跨模态推理在隐式有害内容检测中的有效性。

title: DISCERN: Preserve at Write, Resolve at Read for Persistent LLM-Agent Memory
summary: Enterprise agents accumulate memory across dozens of sessions in which facts contradict, get superseded, and blur as similarly named entities collide in embedding space. The field treats this as a retrieval problem; we show it is not. On ENT-310, a synthetic enterprise sales-agent memory benchmark of 310 queries (210 answerable, 100 unanswerable), a vanilla Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) reader over a memory store already matches strong memory systems on the recall pillars. Retention and currency are near-saturated, roughly 0.93 to 0.98 for every competent system, so recall is essentially solved. What remains unsolved is resolution: which entity a query refers to, which time-state is current, and whether to commit an answer at all or decline when evidence is insufficient. We propose DISCERN (DISambiguation and Cross-session Episodic memoRy Navigation), an agent-memory framework built on a single rule: preserve at write, resolve at read. At write time DISCERN builds a strictly additive bi-temporal provenance graph that never merges confusable entities and never drops superseded values. At read time a zero-LLM tool surface drives an agentic loop that navigates this graph and commits exactly one of four gated terminal actions. A four-judge LLM-as-a-Judge council scores two axes: answer correctness on answerable questions, and the answer-versus-abstain decision as a classification problem. On ENT-310, DISCERN is the best-calibrated system on abstention (F1 0.924 versus at most 0.802 across eight baselines) and leads macro answer correctness under equal pillar weighting (0.861 versus 0.806 for the strongest baseline), a lead driven by entity resolution (0.800, where no baseline exceeds 0.40). Applied with zero tuning to the full LoCoMo corpus, the same pipeline again leads macro answer correctness (0.663 versus 0.638) and stays among the best-calibrated on false-premise abstention.

AI.tldr: 企业Agent跨会话记忆的矛盾/时效/同名实体歧义问题是"解析问题"而非检索问题。作者提出DISCERN框架，遵循"写时保留、读时解析"原则，构建严格增量式双时间溯源图并配合零LLM工具面的Agentic循环，在ENT-310上取得最佳弃答校准（F1 0.924）与最高宏观答案正确率（0.861），零调参迁移至LoCoMo仍领先。
AI.motivation: 现有工作将企业Agent长程记忆中的事实冲突、事实被替代和同名实体在嵌入空间碰撞等问题一律视为检索（recall）问题并着力提升召回；但作者指出，在ENT-310基准上，朴素RAG读取器在保留率与时效性等召回支柱上已接近饱和（0.93–0.98），说明召回基本已被解决，真正未解决的是解析（resolution）：查询指向哪个实体、哪个时间状态是当前有效状态、以及在证据不足时是否应当拒答。
AI.method: 提出DISCERN（DISambiguation and Cross-session Episodic memoRy Navigation）框架，核心规则为"写时保留、读时解析"。写入阶段构建严格增量（additive）的双时间溯源图，永不合并易混淆实体、永不删除被取代的旧值；读取阶段通过零LLM的工具接口驱动Agentic循环在该图上导航，并只允许提交四种带门控的终止动作。评估采用四评审LLM-as-a-Judge委员会，分别衡量可答问题的答案正确性，以及"作答 vs 弃答"的二分类决策质量；并额外在LoCoMo语料上零调参验证泛化。
AI.result: 在ENT-310（310条查询：210可答、100不可答）上，DISCERN弃答校准最佳（F1 0.924，八个基线最高仅0.802）；等权支柱加权下宏观答案正确率0.861，领先最强基线的0.806，且该优势主要由实体解析贡献（0.800，无基线超过0.40）。零调参应用于完整LoCoMo语料，宏观答案正确率同样领先（0.663 vs. 0.638），并在虚假前提弃答上保持最佳校准水平之一。
AI.conclusion: 企业Agent记忆的瓶颈应重新定位为读时解析与弃答决策，而非检索召回；以"写时保留、读时解析"为原则、结合增量双时间溯源图与门控式Agentic导航的DISCERN，在不牺牲召回的前提下同时显著改善实体解析、时效判定与弃答校准，并具备跨基准、免调参的迁移能力。

title: Dual Representation Enhanced Diffusion Policy for Flexible Job Shop Scheduling
summary: The Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling Problem (FJSP) is a fundamental and challenging optimization problem in smart manufacturing. Although recent deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches can learn effective scheduling policies through interaction with the environment, their performance often degrades as problem scale and processing-time uncertainty increase. In this paper, we propose DredRL, a dual representation enhanced diffusion-policy reinforcement learning scheduler. DredRL first constructs enhanced dual representations of operations and machines through self- and cross-attention mechanisms to capture both intra-entity and inter-entity dependencies. A diffusion model is further employed as the policy network, generating scheduling decisions through iterative denoising conditioned on the encoded state to enhance policy expressiveness and robustness. Extensive experiments on synthetic, public, large-scale, and stochastic FJSP benchmarks demonstrate that DredRL outperforms state-of-the-art learning-based schedulers across most configurations. Compared with SOTA learning-based methods, DredRL reduces makespan by up to 5.44% on synthetic instances. It also achieves the best learning-based performance on three of four public benchmarks and outperforms the stochasticity-aware algorithms on stochastic benchmarks. These results demonstrate that combining enhanced dual representations with diffusion-based policies provides an effective and robust approach for large scale scalable FJSP scheduling in complicated environment.

AI.tldr: DredRL：用“增强双重表征+扩散策略”的深度强化学习框架求解柔性作业车间调度（FJSP），在合成、公开、大规模与随机算例上多数配置优于SOTA学习型调度器。
AI.motivation: FJSP是智能制造中的核心难题。现有DRL调度方法虽能通过与环境交互学到有效策略，但在问题规模扩大与加工时间不确定性增加时性能明显退化，因此需要更强的状态表征与更具表达力、鲁棒性的策略网络。
AI.method: 提出DredRL。其一，利用自注意力与交叉注意力构建工序与机器的增强双重表征，同时捕获实体内部（intra-entity）与实体间（inter-entity）依赖；其二，以扩散模型作为策略网络，在编码状态条件下通过迭代去噪生成调度决策，从而提升策略表达力与鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在合成、公开、大规模及随机FJSP基准上，DredRL在大多数配置下优于SOTA学习型调度器；相较SOTA学习方法，合成算例最大缩短makespan 5.44%；在4个公开基准中的3个取得最佳学习型性能；在随机基准上优于考虑随机性的算法。
AI.conclusion: 增强双重表征与扩散策略的结合，为复杂环境下大规模可扩展FJSP调度提供了一种有效且鲁棒的方案。

title: JustRUA: A Controlled Study of GPT-6 Robot-Use Agents
comment: 30 pages, 14 figures. Project page: https://zefanw.github.io/JustRUA. Code: https://github.com/ZefanW/JustRUA
summary: GPT-6 Astra can drive a robot arm directly through a fixed harness, and scores of such robot-use agents on RoboDojo have risen quickly since. Reported systems differ in harness and test subset and often change several designs at once, so it is hard to tell which choices produce the gains. We take these designs apart and test them in one framework, along the harness around the model, the action interface, the reuse of experience and the scene geometry given to the model. A lean harness that keeps the full episode history and stops each motion early goes a long way. Reusing experience changes how the model acts but is not a free lunch, and scene geometry helps most, even when depth is predicted from RGB alone. JustRUA starts from the official L3 harness and keeps only what matters most. Even with no learned policy, self-improvement loop or task-specific tuning, this simple harness raises the score on the RoboDojo simulation benchmark substantially, from 29.7 to 50.3.

AI.tldr: 论文对机器人操作智能体（robot-use agent）的多项设计进行拆解并在统一框架下对比测试，发现"精简执行框架（lean harness）+ 场景几何信息"最关键，据此提出 JustRUA，在 RoboDojo 仿真基准上将分数从 29.7 提升至 50.3。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 GPT-6 Astra 等模型的机器人操作智能体在 RoboDojo 上分数提升很快，但各系统在执行框架（harness）、测试子集上不一致，且往往同时改动多个设计，导致无法判断究竟是哪些设计带来了性能增益。
AI.method: 在单一框架下对四类设计进行消融与对比：(1) 模型外围的执行框架（harness）；(2) 动作接口；(3) 经验复用；(4) 提供给模型的场景几何信息。在此基础上提炼关键要素，构建 JustRUA——以官方 L3 harness 为起点，仅保留最重要的组件：保留完整 episode 历史、每次运动提前终止（early stop）的精简 harness，并引入场景几何（即使深度由 RGB 单目预测得到）。不含学习型策略、自我改进循环或任务特定调优。
AI.result: 精简 harness（保留完整 episode 历史 + 提前终止每段动作）带来显著收益；经验复用会改变模型行为但并非"免费午餐"；场景几何帮助最大，即便深度仅由 RGB 预测得到也有效。JustRUA 在 RoboDojo 仿真基准上把分数从 29.7 提升到 50.3。
AI.conclusion: 机器人操作智能体的性能提升主要来自执行框架与输入信息层面的简单设计选择，而非复杂的学习机制；一个无学习策略、无需任务特定调优的精简 harness 即可大幅提升基准表现，同时说明统一框架下的受控对比对厘清设计贡献是必要的。

title: FlatSeek: LLM-Driven Symbolic Discovery of Flat Outputs via Backward Data Generation
summary: Differential flatness enables efficient planning and control, but discovering explicit flat outputs for general nonlinear systems remains difficult due to the lack of general methods and supervised data. We propose FlatSeek, a framework combining backward data generation with task-specific large language model (LLM) training. By reversing the defining reconstruction of flatness, we generate system-flat-output pairs with known certificates, then fine-tune an LLM to propose symbolic flat-output candidates for unseen dynamics. On literature and synthetic benchmarks, FlatSeek outperforms both the traditional symbolic methods and the untuned reference models in flat-output discovery success, and uncovers alternative symbolic flat outputs not reported in the literature.

AI.tldr: 提出 FlatSeek 框架，通过“反向数据生成 + 任务特定 LLM 微调”来为一般非线性系统自动发现显式平坦输出。
AI.motivation: 微分平坦性可实现高效规划与控制，但对一般非线性系统寻找显式平坦输出缺乏通用方法与监督数据，因而十分困难。
AI.method: 反转平坦性的定义性重构过程，构造带有已知证书（certificate）的系统—平坦输出配对数据；再用这些数据微调 LLM，使其能为未见动力学提出符号形式的平坦输出候选。
AI.result: 在文献基准与合成基准上，FlatSeek 的平坦输出发现成功率优于传统符号方法与未微调的参考模型，并发现了文献中未报道的替代符号平坦输出。
AI.conclusion: 逆向数据生成可为缺乏监督的符号发现问题提供有效训练信号，结合任务特定 LLM 微调可获得超越传统符号方法与通用模型的平坦输出发现能力，并具备发现新解的能力。

title: Arbor: When Labels Are Not Coarsened at Random
summary: Merging datasets labelled at different levels of a taxonomy leaves some images with only a coarse label, and some classes with no fine-grained label at all. Standard training scores a coarse label by the total probability of the classes under it. Coarse labels name superclasses, and the standard objective is exact only when every class within a superclass is equally likely to receive a coarse label. We call a class novel if it is never labelled finely, and known otherwise. A novel class violates the assumption, and the classifier assigns its images to a known sibling. We propose Arbor, which models how labels become coarse. In each superclass with a novel class, Arbor adds a virtual novel class, and a logistic gate divides the superclass's probability between it and the known classes. The gate is trained with the likelihood of the observed labels under this model, the coarsening likelihood. We prove that at its population optimum the gate equals the Elkan-Noto correction of positive-unlabelled learning, and show that training the correction into the classifier improves on applying it after training. Across Cars, CUB and Aircraft with 90% coarse labels, Arbor correctly assigns 76-85% of novel-class images to their superclass, more than hierarchical classifiers, hierarchical novelty detection and the Elkan-Noto correction. Its top-1 accuracy over the leaf classes on known-class images is within 1.6 points of the best baseline, although its final predictions return the superclass more often. On the more challenging iNaturalist-2019 benchmark, Arbor improves novel-class accuracy from 46% (uniform target, the strongest baseline) to 68%.

AI.tldr: 提出Arbor，将粗标签建模为分类标签的"粗化"过程：在每个含新类的超类中引入虚拟新类，用logistic gate在超类概率上划分已知/新类，并以"粗化似然"训练该gate，理论上其总体最优对应PU学习的Elkan-Noto校正。
AI.motivation: 不同层级标注的数据融合后，部分图像只有粗粒度（超类）标签，部分类从未获得细粒度标注（novel class）。标准训练用超类下各类概率之和来给粗标签打分，该目标仅在超类内各类等概率时才精确；novel class违反此假设，导致其图像被错误分配给已知同类。
AI.method: 在每个含novel class的超类中增加一个虚拟novel类，并用logistic gate把该超类的概率质量在虚拟类与已知类之间分配；以观测标签在该生成模型下的似然（coarsening likelihood）训练gate。理论上证明其总体最优等于PU学习中的Elkan-Noto校正，并据此把校正内嵌进分类器训练，而非训练后后处理。
AI.result: 在Cars、CUB、Aircraft（90%粗标签）上，Arbor将76–85%的novel-class图像正确归入其超类，优于层次分类器、层次新颖性检测和Elkan-Noto后校正；已知类图像上leaf级top-1精度与最佳基线差距在1.6个点内（尽管最终预测更常返回超类）。在iNaturalist-2019上，novel-class准确率由46%（uniform target，最强基线）提升至68%。
AI.conclusion: 粗标签应被显式建模为标签粗化过程而非简单概率求和；将PU式校正内嵌到训练中优于事后校正，可在保留已知类细粒度性能的同时显著提升novel class的超类归属准确性。

title: NIBench: benchmarking autonomous AI agents for execution, skill evolution and scientific judgment in neuroimaging
summary: Autonomous AI agents are increasingly used to automate biomedical research, creating a growing need to benchmark their capabilities on real scientific data and workflows. Their reliability in neuroimaging remains insufficiently characterized, where plausible analytical outputs can conceal errors that affect scientific conclusions. Existing studies have advanced scientific question answering and tool-based automation, but provide limited evidence on workflow reconstruction, acquisition of procedural expertise and evidence-based scientific judgment. Here we present NIBench, a neuroimaging benchmark comprising three complementary evaluations of autonomous agents. First, we benchmark execution and workflow reconstruction using 56 tasks across seven tool ecosystems, covering structural, diffusion and functional magnetic resonance imaging, positron emission tomography and multimodal analyses. Second, we examine whether agents can evolve their procedural skills through distillation of execution trajectories, evaluating the resulting skills on previously encountered tasks, unseen tasks and other models. Third, we assess scientific judgment using 36 claims from published Alzheimer's disease studies, requiring agents to analyse raw cohort data and provide reproducible evidence. We evaluate 19 language models within a shared agent framework, with selected models undergoing skill distillation and claim evaluation. Leading agents execute supplied analysis protocols nearly perfectly, whereas withholding procedural guidance widens performance differences. Distilled skills improve performance on acquisition tasks and transfer between models, but benefits on unseen tasks are inconsistent. Agents reproduce their reported results yet sometimes reach conclusions inconsistent with expert-derived answers, and access to data does not always improve judgment.

AI.tldr: 提出NIBench神经影像基准，从工作流重建、程序性技能蒸馏与科学判断三方面评估自主AI智能体，发现顶尖智能体按给定协议执行近乎完美，但缺乏程序指导时差距扩大，技能蒸馏收益不稳健，且结论正确性存在系统性缺陷。
AI.motivation: 自主AI智能体被日益用于自动化生物医学研究，但其在神经影像领域的可靠性缺乏刻画：看似合理的分析输出可能掩盖影响科学结论的错误。既有研究多聚焦科学问答与工具调用，对工作流重建、程序性专长获取与基于证据的科学判断证据不足。
AI.method: 构建NIBench基准，含三项互补评测：(1) 56个任务、7个工具生态的执行与工作流重建评测，覆盖结构像、弥散、功能MRI、PET及多模态分析；(2) 通过执行轨迹蒸馏使智能体演化程序性技能，并迁移到已见任务、未见任务及其他模型；(3) 基于36条已发表阿尔茨海默病研究主张的科学判断评测，要求分析原始队列数据并给出可复现证据。在统一智能体框架下评估19个语言模型。
AI.result: 领先智能体执行给定分析协议近乎完美，但撤除程序性指导后性能差异显著扩大；蒸馏技能在习得任务上提升明显并可跨模型迁移，但在未见任务上收益不一致；智能体能复现自身报告的结果，却有时给出与专家答案不一致的结论，且数据可及性并不总能改善判断质量。
AI.conclusion: 现有自主智能体在神经影像工作流执行层面已高度可靠，但程序性技能泛化与科学判断仍存在明显短板，数据访问不等于有效推理；NIBench为诊断此类可靠性与效度缺口提供了可复现的评测框架。

title: Protected Unbiased Sparsification: A Sharp Loewner Curve
comment: 44 pages, 11 figures. Code, protocols, and saved results are included as ancillary files
summary: Random sparsification replaces a probability vector by a random vector with few nonzero entries. We ask for unbiasedness, exact preservation of prescribed linear statistics, and a covariance guarantee for every downstream linear response. Let $p$ have $k$ positive coordinates, let $A$ specify the protected statistics, and let $d\le k-2$ be their effective rank. For every $d+1\le m\le k$, we construct an unbiased random probability vector $Q$ with at most $m$ nonzero coordinates, $AQ=Ap$ on every realization, and $\operatorname{Cov}(Q)\preceq h C_{p\mid A}$, where $h=(k-m)/((m-d)(k-d-1))$ and $C_{p\mid A}$ is the categorical covariance after optimal linear adjustment for the protected statistics. This coefficient is sharp uniformly over instances, even among biased estimators when error is measured by its second moment. A residual covariance bridge extends the concurrent unprotected curve to arbitrary pathwise linear protection. We also characterize instance-optimal constants for partitions with uniform weights within classes and derive bounds for peaked weights. For rational inputs, an exact Las Vegas sampler attains the curve within a factor $1+ε$ in expected polynomial time. A separate fast block-pivotal sampler preserves block masses and is no worse in covariance order than independent sampling within blocks. Experiments illustrate the theory on synthetic weights and language-model attention. In Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct decoding, the fast sampler preserves block masses, while comparisons with VarOpt remain statistically inconclusive and top-$m$ truncation scores highest on RULER.

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机稀疏化：用至多 m 个非零分量的随机概率向量 Q 替代原概率向量 p，要求 Q 无偏、逐实现严格保持指定线性统计量 AQ=Ap，并对任一下游线性响应的协方差给出保证。构造的 Q 满足 Cov(Q) ⪯ h·C_{p|A}，其中 h=(k−m)/((m−d)(k−d−1))，且该系数在所有实例上一致最优（即使允许有偏估计并以二阶矩度量误差）。
AI.motivation: 随机稀疏化（如 top-m 截断、VarOpt、独立采样）在注意力机制、采样与加权服务等场景广泛使用，但现有方法难以同时做到：无偏、逐实现保持指定线性统计量、并对每个下游线性响应提供协方差上界。缺乏对最优协方差权衡的刻画，也无法判断系数是否可改进。
AI.method: 1) 设 p 有 k 个正坐标，A 指定受保护统计量，有效秩 d≤k−2，对每个 d+1≤m≤k 构造随机概率向量 Q，使 |supp(Q)|≤m、AQ=Ap 逐实现成立、且 Cov(Q)⪯h·C_{p|A}，其中 C_{p|A} 为对受保护统计量做最优线性调整后的分类协方差；2) 通过下界论证证明 h 在实例上一致最优；3) 提出残差协方差桥接，把无保护情形下的曲线推广到任意逐路径线性保护；4) 对类内均匀权重的划分刻画实例最优常数，并对尖峰权重给出界；5) 有理输入下给出精确 Las Vegas 采样器，期望多项式时间内以 1+ε 因子达到该曲线；6) 另设计快速 block-pivotal 采样器，保持块质量且在协方差序上不劣于块内独立采样。
AI.result: 理论上得到紧的协方差系数 h 及最优性证明、残差协方差桥接、均匀权重划分的实例最优常数与尖峰权重界，以及精确 Las Vegas 采样器的 (1+ε) 近似保证和 block-pivotal 采样器的协方差序优势。实验在合成权重与语言模型注意力上进行；在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 解码中，快速采样器保持块质量，与 VarOpt 的比较在统计上不显著，而 top-m 截断在 RULER 上得分最高。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出了带线性统计保护的无偏随机稀疏化的完整协方差刻画，系数紧且可计算，并提供高效采样算法与推广。实验表明块质量保持可实现，但相对 VarOpt 的统计优势尚不确定，且在下游基准 RULER 上 top-m 截断反而表现更好，说明协方差最优未必直接转化为任务性能优势。

title: PERA: Plug-in Experts for Robotic Actions in Continual Whole-Body Control
summary: Motion imitation enables humanoid robots to acquire whole-body skills such as walking and dancing. However, fine-tuning an entire policy for a new skill can affect existing behaviors, while training a separate policy for each skill increases training and maintenance costs. We present PERA, a method for learning new skills by reusing existing motion capabilities. PERA freezes a pretrained mixture-of-experts policy and trains an additional task expert and its routing score using task rewards or teacher-action supervision. In Unitree G1 simulation, each added task module contains approximately 1.03% of the parameters of the base actor. Built on our pretrained policy, PERA successfully completes all ten new tasks. Disabling the expert restores the original computation path of the base policy, which still fully executes all 126 original motions. Enabling the expert also improves the execution of some dance motions not used to train that expert, indicating that its benefits extend beyond its training motions. Experiments with HoloMotion further demonstrate the applicability of PERA to different base policies.

AI.tldr: PERA 通过冻结预训练混合专家策略、仅新增一个小规模任务专家及其路由分数来学习新动作技能，在 Unitree G1 上以约 1.03% 的参数增量完成 10 项新任务，且不影响原有的 126 个动作。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人依赖动作模仿获得全身技能，但全策略微调会破坏已有行为，而为每个新技能单独训练策略又抬高训练与维护成本，因此需要一种能复用已有运动能力来增量学习新技能的方法。
AI.method: 冻结预训练的混合专家（MoE）策略，额外训练一个任务专家及对应的路由分数，监督信号可来自任务奖励或教师动作；新增专家仅占基础 actor 约 1.03% 的参数，禁用专家即恢复基策略的原始计算路径。
AI.result: 在 Unitree G1 仿真中，基于预训练策略成功完成全部 10 项新任务；禁用专家后基策略仍完整执行 126 个原始动作；启用专家还改善了未参与该专家训练的若干舞蹈动作；在 HoloMotion 上的实验表明方法可迁移到不同基策略。
AI.conclusion: 以模块化专家扩展替代整体微调，可在极低参数与训练成本下实现新技能增量学习，同时保证原有动作能力不退化，并具备跨基策略的适用性。

title: Quantum Network Flows That Solve Linear Equations
summary: We develop a distributed quantum network flow for solving linear equations from locally stored row data. Local pumping enforces each node's equation constraint, while neighboring registers interact through swaps. The node marginals obey an exact, closed flow combining consensus with local constraint enforcement. For consistent equations, all node states converge exponentially to a common state supported on the solution space; a unique solution yields full-network convergence to the product solution state. For inconsistent equations of full column rank, scaled encoding and readout recover the least-squares solution through successive large-gain and small-scale limits. For consistent systems, the marginal convergence rate is nondecreasing and concave in the swap gain, approaching a graph-independent limit for fixed local dissipators. Its leading finite-gain correction couples graph topology and row placement through the Laplacian pseudoinverse, enabling semidefinite optimization of edge rates under a fixed total swap-rate budget. For invertible systems, a dissipative HHL-type construction using the same pumping law provides a comparison of solution-state encodings, decay rates, and row-update locality under squared-row-norm pumping. Numerical examples are provided to validate the presented results.

AI.tldr: 提出一种分布式量子网络流方法，从各节点本地存储的行数据出发求解线性方程组；泵浦项实现本地约束，寄存器间经交换门交互，节点边缘态服从闭式流动方程，可收敛到解空间、最小二乘解，并可优化边速率。
AI.motivation: 希望在分布式（多节点、各持有部分行数据）架构下以量子网络流的方式求解线性方程组，兼顾本地约束执行、邻居交互与可解析分析的收敛行为，并量化图拓扑与行分布对收敛速度的影响。
AI.method: 1) 本地泵浦使每个节点的方程约束成立，相邻寄存器通过swap交互；2) 推导节点边缘态的精确闭式流动方程，将共识与本地约束执行结合；3) 对相容方程分析指数收敛到解空间，唯一解时全网收敛到乘积解态；对满列秩的不相容方程，采用缩放编码与读出，经大增益、小尺度极限恢复最小二乘解；4) 分析边缘收敛率关于swap增益的单调不减与凹性，以及有限增益修正项通过拉普拉斯伪逆耦合图拓扑与行分布，进而做总swap率预算下的边速率半定优化；5) 对可逆系统构造耗散型HHL式方案（平方行范数泵浦），比较解态编码、衰减率与行更新局部性。
AI.result: 相容情形下节点状态指数收敛到公共解空间态，唯一解时全网收敛到乘积解态；不相容满列秩情形可恢复最小二乘解；边缘收敛率对swap增益单调不减且凹，固定本地耗散下趋于与图无关的极限，其有限增益首阶修正由拉普拉斯伪逆耦合拓扑与行放置；由此可在固定总swap率预算下用半定规划优化边速率；耗散型HHL构造给出编码、衰减率与行更新局部性的对比。
AI.conclusion: 该分布式量子网络流框架统一处理相容与不相容线性系统，提供可解析的收敛刻画与拓扑相关的性能优化手段，并通过数值算例验证理论结果；耗散型HHL类比进一步揭示不同解态编码在衰减率与局部性上的权衡。

title: AcrossPlace: Do Vision--Language Models Recognize Places Beyond Their Source Views? A Comprehensive Benchmark
summary: Language-guided place recognition requires recovering geographic identity across visual observations beyond the image from which a description originates. However, aggregate retrieval scores often entangle observation transfer, gallery competition, and linguistic evidence, obscuring the underlying recognition capability. We introduce AcrossPlace, a provenance-aware benchmark establishing a systematic evaluation standard for bidirectional language--vision place recognition. Built upon GSV-Cities, AcrossPlace comprises 56,726 places across 23 cities, 156,800 automatically generated, rule-filtered descriptions, and 113,404 target images. Each description retains its source-image provenance, while retrieval operates on disjoint target observations. Text-to-image (T2I) and image-to-text (I2T) retrieval share a unified place-identity relevance criterion supporting multiple valid matches. Two geographic protocols evaluate unseen places within represented cities (P0) and generalization to held-out cities (P1). Paired observation comparisons, gallery-controlled evaluations, fixed-query scaling, and blinded annotation auditing systematically characterize retrieval performance. Across three training seeds, place-supervised SigLIP2 T2I Recall@1 decreases from 19.69% on source images to 12.31% on independent targets under P0. For fixed P1 queries, expanding the gallery from 500 to 8,425 places reduces Recall@1 from 14.67% to 2.87%. A 240-description audit further reveals discrepancies between automated acceptance and factual evidence. These findings establish AcrossPlace as a reproducible evaluation standard for assessing transferable place identity across visual observations and geographic environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AcrossPlace，一个面向双向语言-视觉地点识别的"溯源感知"基准，通过在独立目标观测上检索来解耦观测迁移、图库竞争与语言证据对检索分数的混杂影响，并揭示现有模型在跨观测与跨城市场景下的显著性能衰减。
AI.motivation: 语言引导的地点识别需要在描述来源图像之外的视觉观测上恢复地理身份，但现有聚合检索分数同时纠缠了观测迁移、图库竞争和语言证据三方面因素，掩盖了真实识别能力，缺乏统一的评估标准。
AI.method: 基于 GSV-Cities 构建 AcrossPlace：涵盖 23 座城市 56,726 个地点、156,800 条自动生成且规则过滤的描述、113,404 张目标图像；每条描述保留源图像溯源信息，检索在不相交的目标观测上进行；T2I 与 I2T 共用统一的地点身份相关性准则，允许多个有效匹配；设 P0（已见城市内未见地点）与 P1（留出城市泛化）两种地理协议；评估手段包括配对观测对比、图库控制评估、固定查询扩展实验与盲标注审计。
AI.result: 三个训练种子下，地点监督的 SigLIP2 在 P0 上的 T2I Recall@1 从源图像的 19.69% 降至独立目标的 12.31%；固定 P1 查询时，图库由 500 扩至 8,425 个地点使 Recall@1 从 14.67% 降至 2.87%；240 条描述审计显示自动接受标准与事实证据之间存在偏差。
AI.conclusion: AcrossPlace 可作为可复现的评估标准，用于衡量跨视觉观测与跨地理环境的可迁移地点身份识别能力，并暴露了溯源解耦评估与图库规模控制对性能判读的必要性。

title: Controlling the Probability of Unknown Unknowns in Pre-Deployment Testing of AI Systems
summary: In pre-deployment testing of AI systems such as AI agents, a developer can often deal with known failure modes (e.g., leaking API keys, deleting important databases, or installing a malicious package) by implementing fixes or making contingency plans for when the same issue might occur again. What is more challenging are the unknown unknowns: the unseen failure modes that haven't surfaced during testing. The decision to stop testing and deploy therefore faces an inherent tradeoff: continue testing to observe more behaviors, at the cost of time and resources, or stop testing and deploy, at the risk of failure modes remaining undiscovered. How then does the developer decide when they have tested enough? To answer this, we develop an algorithm that certifies when the probability of observing an unseen failure mode is sufficiently small. The algorithm constructs an anytime-valid upper confidence sequence on this quantity, so the developer can repeatedly test a system, inspect the bound, and decide to stop when it falls below a chosen threshold without invalidating the statistical guarantee. Our problem can be interpreted as a sequential variant of the missing-mass estimation problem which gave rise to the classic Good-Turing estimator (Good, 1953). On SWE-Chat, a dataset of real-world coding agent traces (Baumann et al., 2026), we implement our procedure and show that it achieves tighter upper bounds than a simple multiple-testing corrected Good-Turing baseline, and even dominates a fixed-horizon (non-multiple-testing-corrected) Good-Turing upper confidence bound, which is not anytime valid. Additionally, to better match realistic evaluation pipelines, we extend our method to handle sampling from a different task distribution and imperfect automated failure labeling.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种可随时停止（anytime-valid）的算法，用于判定AI系统"未知未知"失败模式的出现概率何时足够小，从而为"测试何时可以停止"提供统计认证。
AI.motivation: 预部署测试中，已知失败模式可通过修复或预案处理，真正困难的是测试中从未出现的"未知未知"失败模式。开发者在"继续测试"与"停止并部署"之间面临固有权衡：继续测试耗费时间和资源，停止则可能遗漏未发现的失败模式。因此需要一个能回答"测得是否足够"的统计判据。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为序贯版本的缺失质量估计问题（Good-Turing经典估计器的来源），构造对该缺失质量（即观测到未见失败模式的概率）的 anytime-valid 上置信序列，允许开发者在反复测试中随时查看界并在其低于设定阈值时停止，而不破坏统计保证；并扩展方法以应对从不同任务分布采样以及自动化失败标注不完美的情况。
AI.result: 在真实编码智能体轨迹数据集 SWE-Chat 上实现该流程，所得到的上界比经过多重检验校正的 Good-Turing 基线更紧，甚至优于固定视界（未做多重检验校正）的 Good-Turing 上置信界——后者不具备 anytime validity 保证。
AI.conclusion: 序贯缺失质量估计可为"测试是否充分"提供有效且更紧的统计认证，并可通过扩展适配真实评测流程中的分布偏移与标签噪声；相比 Good-Turing 类基线在实践中更具优势。

title: CastWorld: Benchmarking Context-Aware Agentic Time Series Forecasting Beyond Predictive Accuracy
summary: Agentic time series forecasting extends conventional approaches beyond one-shot numerical prediction toward autonomous, context-aware interaction. However, existing benchmarks offer limited integrated support for diverse contextual information, forecasting-specific adaptive interactions, and systematic evaluation of forecasting agents. In this paper, we introduce CastWorld, an agentic benchmark for context-aware time series forecasting. First, its context-rich dataset suite spans 8 domains and 25 real-world datasets, covering external variables, events, and historical cases under a unified context specification. Second, a lightweight, modular forecasting-native harness provides 49 core tools and a state-adaptive loop that tracks forecast versions and enables iterative evidence gathering and forecast revision. Intermediate forecasts can expose information gaps, while newly acquired evidence guides subsequent revisions and final version selection. Third, model-level evaluation assesses forecast quality, process execution, behavioral trustworthiness, and resource efficiency through decision trajectories and forecast-version histories. Also, systems-level evaluation compares predictive accuracy across forecasting systems. Experiments reveal distinct decision behaviors among agents with comparable accuracy. Additional interactions do not necessarily improve forecasts, and agents may fail to select their best previously generated predictions. Allowing evidence acquisition during forecast refinement improves task-aware forecast scores across all three evaluated models. CastWorld provides a reusable foundation for evaluating agentic time series forecasting under controlled conditions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 CastWorld，一个面向上下文感知时间序列预测的智能体基准，集成了富上下文数据集、预测原生工具环境与多维度评估。
AI.motivation: 现有基准在整合多样上下文信息、面向预测任务的自适应交互机制，以及系统性评估预测智能体方面支持不足，难以刻画智能体在真实情境中的决策过程。
AI.method: 构建涵盖8个领域、25个真实数据集的上下文丰富数据套件，统一规范外部变量、事件与历史案例；设计轻量模块化的预测原生执行框架，提供49个核心工具与状态自适应循环，追踪预测版本以支持迭代取证与修订；评估上兼顾模型级（预测质量、过程执行、行为可信度、资源效率）与系统级（预测精度对比）。
AI.result: 精度相近的智能体表现出明显不同的决策行为；额外交互并不必然提升预测效果；智能体可能无法选取自身此前生成的最佳预测；在预测细化过程中允许取证，可在全部三个被评估模型上提升任务感知预测得分。
AI.conclusion: CastWorld 为受控条件下评估智能体式时间序列预测提供了可复用的基础平台。

title: QVS-LIVO RiskMap: Health- and Information-Aware View Selection for Multi-Camera LIVO and Off-Road Risk Mapping
summary: Multi-camera observations in off-road environments vary significantly in reliability, posing challenges when complementing degraded geometric constraints. Motivated by this, we propose Quality-aware View Selection Lidar-Vision Odometry Risk Mapping (QVS-LIVO RiskMap), which decouples visual processing for state estimation from that for semantic mapping. The front end evaluates camera observations through read-only pretracking on a shared lidar-inertial posterior, combining observation health with geometric complementarity. Channel health memory and switching hysteresis govern selection of at most one eligible view for direct photometric correction. The posterior is retained when no view is eligible or the correction fails acceptance. The mapping back end integrates semantic observations from all available views in a shared world grid. Vehicle-scale geometry constrains semantic risk corrections, while spatial and temporal evidence supports risk confirmation. The system also produces a local bird's-eye-view (BEV) risk map and a global 2.5D semantic-terrain risk map with obstacle instance voxels. On two field sequences, QVS-LIVO achieved horizontal root mean square errors of 0.910 m and 1.664 m. It reduced error by 43.3% relative to FAST-LIO2 on the degraded long-route sequence. Across 12 controlled camera-fault configurations involving dropout, black frames and 60 ms timestamp shifts, it maintained complete trajectories with errors of 1.54-2.23 m. When deployed onboard an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, the system generates local and global maps at 9.94 Hz and 2.00 Hz, respectively, with a median local mapping latency of 32.4 ms. These runtime results demonstrate the real-time feasibility of selective visual state updates alongside multi-view semantic mapping under challenging off-road conditions. The code and related resources are available at: https://github.com/zihanPan-HIT/QVS-LIVO.

AI.tldr: 提出QVS-LIVO RiskMap：将视觉状态估计与语义建图解耦，前端在共享激光-惯性后验上做只读预跟踪，融合观测健康度与几何互补性筛选最多一路视图做直接光度校正；后端融合全部视图语义观测构建局部BEV与全局2.5D语义地形风险图。野外序列RMSE为0.910 m和1.664 m，退化长路线较FAST-LIO2降低43.3%误差，12种相机故障配置下保持完整轨迹（1.54–2.23 m），Jetson AGX Orin上局部/全局建图达9.94 Hz与2.00 Hz。
AI.motivation: 越野环境中多相机观测可靠性差异大，退化时几何约束难以互补，需要按质量选择可信视图以提升鲁棒性，同时避免视觉状态估计与语义建图相互干扰。
AI.method: 构建质量感知的视图选择激光-视觉里程计（QVS-LIVO）。前端在共享激光-惯性后验上执行只读预跟踪，结合观测健康度与几何互补性评估各相机，引入通道健康记忆与切换滞回，最多选一路视图进行直接光度校正；无可用视图或校正未通过验收时保留原始后验。后端在统一世界栅格中融合所有视图的语义观测，用车辆尺度几何约束语义风险修正，并以时空证据支持风险确认，输出局部BEV风险图与含障碍实例体素的全局2.5D语义地形风险图。
AI.result: 两条野外序列水平RMSE分别为0.910 m与1.664 m；退化长路线上较FAST-LIO2降低43.3%误差；12种受控相机故障（掉帧、黑帧、60 ms时间戳偏移）下均保持完整轨迹，误差1.54–2.23 m；NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上局部与全局建图频率9.94 Hz/2.00 Hz，局部建图中位时延32.4 ms。
AI.conclusion: 选择性视觉状态更新与多视图语义建图可并行实时运行，在挑战性越野条件下兼顾定位鲁棒性与风险建图实时性。

title: Adjacent Heat Transfer Effects Can Bias Savings Estimates When Controlling Only Part of a Multi-Zone Building
comment: 10 pages. Accepted at the 2027 ASHRAE Winter Conference
summary: Field demonstrations of advanced heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning control often operate a few thermal zones within a larger building and report savings for those zones alone. A recent theorem showed that this practice overestimates whole-building savings, because heat drawn from the neighboring zones is paid for by their equipment and is not counted. The error grows with the thermal conductance between the controlled and uncontrolled zones, with how much colder the controlled zones run over the test, and with the price of the heat their neighbors supply. For one controlled zone with one neighbor, a single thermal price, and slowly changing prices, the relative error reduces to the ratio of two conductances, a screening number that can be evaluated from the two conductances before a demonstration begins. This paper tests how far that reduction can be taken. A two-story house with one thermal zone per floor is simulated over a 90-day heating season in West Lafayette, Indiana, with receding-horizon model predictive control on the first floor and setpoint control on the second, under four combinations of electricity tariff (time-of-use or flat) and heating plant (heat pump or electric resistance). The exact correction from the theorem recovers the true savings in every case, and the full theorem, evaluated from the controlled zone's temperatures, the prices, and the building parameters, reproduces the measured relative error in every case. The conductance ratio bounds that error from above in all four cases, tightly under a flat tariff, within 3%, and loosely under a time-of-use tariff, where most of the controller's savings come from shifting load through the thermal mass rather than from lowering the temperature.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两层住宅的90天采暖季仿真，检验"用一个受控热区的节能报告估算整栋建筑节能"时误差修正定理的可推广性：定理的精确修正与完整公式在四种电价/热源组合下均能复现真实相对误差，而"导热系数比"筛除数仅在固定电价下紧致（误差<3%），在分时电价下偏松。
AI.motivation: 现场HVAC先进控制示范通常只控制大建筑中的少数热区，并仅报告这些区域自身的节能。已有定理指出这种做法会高估整栋建筑节能，因为从相邻区域抽取的热量由邻区设备付费却未被计入；误差随受控与未控区域间的热导、受控区运行更低的温度幅度以及邻区供热价格而增大。作者希望检验在单一热价、价格缓变的简化下，误差能否约简为两个热导之比（筛除数），以及该约简的适用范围。
AI.method: 构建每层一个热区的两层住宅模型，在Indiana州West Lafayette模拟90天采暖季；一层采用滚动时域模型预测控制（MPC），二层采用设定点控制；设计4种组合：电价（分时电价TOU / 固定电价）× 供热设备（热泵 / 电阻加热）。将定理的精确修正、完整定理公式（由受控区温度、价格与建筑参数计算）以及导热系数比上界三者与实际相对误差进行对比。
AI.result: 定理的精确修正在全部4种情形下都能还原真实节能；完整定理公式在全部情形下复现实测相对误差。导热系数比在所有4种情形下都给出误差上界：固定电价下紧致（3%以内）；分时电价下较松，因为此时控制器的大部分节能来自通过热质进行负荷转移而非降低温度。
AI.conclusion: 导热系数比是一个有效的、可在示范前评估的误差上界筛除数，但其紧致性依赖节能机制：以降温为主要节能来源时（固定电价）界定紧致，以热质负荷转移为主时（分时电价）则偏保守。因此实际应用中可用其作为安全上界，但需注意电价结构对误差估计精度的影响。

title: CaseScope: A Multi-Field Benchmark for Case-Level Pathology Diagnosis with Multimodal LLMs
summary: Pathologists rarely diagnose from a single image: they scan a section at low power for architecture, zoom into selected fields for cytology, and integrate the evidence across views and scales. Pathology benchmarks for multimodal large language models (MLLMs), however, mostly ask about one image or require whole-slide pipelines, and the few that show several fields draw nested regions from cancer slides of one public cohort. We introduce CaseScope, a benchmark of diagnosis from several curated fields of one lesion: CaseScope-Teaching, 436 cases from a residency-training image library, reconstructed, de-identified, harmonised against a WHO-based ontology and re-examined by a pathologist wherever an automated pre-review raised a doubt, and CaseScope-Atlas, 800 cases from 88 published atlases (387 of them figure series of one disease), labelled from the captions by two LLMs that must agree. They cover 843 entities across 18 organ systems and pose 4,679 items in six tasks, from open-ended and ten-way diagnosis with ontology-guided hard negatives under circular evaluation to the verification and location of morphological findings. Across twenty-eight open and four proprietary MLLMs, diagnoses are unstable -- the best open and proprietary models are correct under all ten option rotations on 17.9% and 61.7% of the teaching cases -- and wrong answers favour the classic look-alike; open models make little use of the additional fields on teaching cases, where the one-line specimen site matters more, although on atlas cases with three or more fields the fields count about as much as the site; and most open models verify findings barely above chance (median 62.0% vs. 50%, best 81.5%), gaining a median +3.4 points from images; proprietary models reach 83.2-93.2%. Rankings broadly replicate between the sources. The evaluation code is available at https://github.com/Wenchuan-Zhang/CaseScope.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CaseScope，一个从单个病变的多个精选视野进行诊断的病理学基准，包含教学库来源的 436 例与 88 本图谱来源的 800 例，覆盖 18 个器官系统、843 个实体、6 类任务共 4,679 题，用于评测 MLLM 的多视野、跨尺度诊断与形态学发现核验能力。
AI.motivation: 真实病理诊断依赖多视野、多尺度证据整合（低倍看结构、高倍看细胞学），但现有多模态大模型（MLLM）病理基准多只问单张图像，或需全切片流程；少数展示多视野的基准仅从单一公开队列的癌症切片中抽取嵌套区域，缺乏多样性与病例级真实性。
AI.method: 构建 CaseScope：CaseScope-Teaching（436 例，来自住院医师培训图像库，经重建、去标识、按 WHO 本体对齐，并在自动预审存疑处由病理学家复核）与 CaseScope-Atlas（800 例，来自 88 本出版图谱，其中 387 例为单疾病图组，标注由两个 LLM 从图注生成且须一致）。覆盖 843 个实体、18 个器官系统，设 6 类任务共 4,679 题：开放式诊断、十选一诊断（本体引导难负例、循环式评估）、形态学发现核验与定位等。评测 28 个开源与 4 个专有 MLLM。
AI.result: 诊断不稳定：在全部 10 种选项轮换下均正确的比例，最佳开源模型仅 17.9%，最佳专有模型 61.7%；错误答案倾向经典相似病变。开源模型对教学病例的额外视野利用不足，一行标本部位信息影响更大；而在含 3 个以上视野的图谱病例中，视野数量的作用与部位相当。多数开源模型核验发现仅略高于随机（中位 62.0% vs. 50%，最佳 81.5%），图像带来中位 +3.4 分增益；专有模型达 83.2–93.2%。两种数据来源间的模型排序总体一致。
AI.conclusion: CaseScope 表明当前 MLLM 在病例级、多视野病理诊断上仍存在显著缺陷：诊断稳定性差、易被相似病变误导、对多视野证据整合能力弱、形态学发现核验接近随机。基准可作为多视野病理推理的严格评测工具，评估代码已开源。

title: Before AI Agents Negotiate for Us: A Competitive Tournament of Rule-Based, Search, Optimization, Learned, and Language-Model Negotiators Under Scarcity
comment: 28 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Code, data and trained models: https://github.com/AILabFr8tech/wehaveadeal (archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.24122038)
summary: Automated bilateral negotiation underlies two-sided matching markets such as freight brokering, where many shippers and carriers negotiate price before a matching mechanism decides who is paired with whom. Prior strategy comparisons typically use isolated one-on-one duels or a single fixed market, so they cannot show how a strategy behaves against several live rivals under a changing balance of supply and demand. We built nine negotiation architectures spanning rule-based, search-based, optimization-based, imitation-learning, and reinforcement-learning families, and ran all nine simultaneously on both sides of a Gale-Shapley matching market under a balanced condition and two scarcity conditions rotated across all 36 exclusion pairs. In the balanced carrier market, an imitation-learned engine (ML2), a reinforcement-learning policy trained only on isolated negotiations (RL), and an expected-utility optimization engine (OPT) formed a statistically tied top group, and no architecture led in every condition and role. RL beat all eight carrier rivals when carriers were scarce, but its match rate collapsed from 62% to 16% when shippers were scarce and it had to compete with the other carrier agents for demand. A second reinforcement-learning policy trained against rival agents (RL2) kept its match rate above 91% in every condition, yet lost on realized payoff to all eight shipper-side rivals in two of the three conditions, traced to a confirmed train/deployment feature mismatch. We also tested nine large language models (LLMs), from 1 to 72 billion parameters, under the same protocol: they lost significantly to the two strongest engines (OPT2 and ML2) in 32 of 36 comparisons and won none. These results show that isolated or single-condition evaluation can hide failure modes that a many-sided, scarcity-varying, statistically corrected tournament exposes directly.

AI.tldr: 本文构建9种谈判架构（规则、搜索、优化、模仿学习、强化学习）与9个LLM，在Gale-Shapley双边匹配市场的均衡及两种稀缺条件下，以全部36个排除配对旋转进行多方循环赛，揭示单条件评估会隐藏失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有自动双边谈判策略比较多用孤立的一对一对决或单一固定市场，无法反映策略在供需平衡变化下对抗多个真实对手的表现，因此需要多方、变稀缺性、统计校正的锦标赛式评估。
AI.method: 构建9种谈判架构（覆盖规则、搜索、优化、模仿学习、强化学习五类），在Gale-Shapley匹配市场的托运方与承运方两侧同时运行；设置1个均衡条件与2个稀缺条件，按全部36个排除配对旋转；另以同一协议测试9个1B–72B参数的LLM，并进行统计校正比较。
AI.result: 均衡承运市场中，模仿学习引擎ML2、仅在孤立谈判上训练的RL策略与期望效用优化引擎OPT统计上并列第一，且无任何架构在所有条件与角色中领先。RL在承运方稀缺时击败全部8个对手，但托运方稀缺时匹配率从62%跌至16%；RL2（对抗对手训练）各条件匹配率均>91%，却在三个条件中的两个里实际收益输给全部8个托运方对手，归因于训练/部署特征不匹配。9个LLM在36次比较中32次显著输给OPT2与ML2，无一次获胜。
AI.conclusion: 孤立或单一条件评估会掩盖真实失败模式；多方、供需稀缺变化且统计校正的锦标赛式评估能直接暴露这些失效，为谈判策略与LLM的能力判断提供更可靠基准。

title: A hybrid machine learning-analog framework for downscaling unprecedented climate extremes
summary: Extreme weather events are critical for climate impact assessments. While physical models can simulate unprecedented extremes, for example, through ensemble boosting, this approach is computationally demanding, often restricting output to coarse spatial resolutions. Probabilistic generative downscaling offers a solution by enabling efficient sampling from the entire climate distribution, including its extreme tails. Here, we first demonstrate that machine learning generated regional climate model heatwaves over Paris are physically realistic. We then leverage an emulated machine learning dataset to perform analog-based downscaling of coarse global climate model ensemble boosting events. Our hybrid framework effectively bridges high-resolution regional detail with rare-event sampling, providing an efficient tool for extreme event downscaling and capturing multi-model uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 提出一种混合框架：先用机器学习生成区域气候模式热浪并验证其物理真实性，再以模拟ML数据集对粗分辨率全球气候模式集合增广事件做类比降尺度，实现极端事件的高效高分辨率降尺度并刻画多模式不确定性。
AI.motivation: 极端天气事件对气候影响评估至关重要。物理模式虽可通过集合增广（ensemble boosting）模拟前所未见的极端事件，但计算代价高昂，输出空间分辨率往往很粗。
AI.method: 两步策略：其一，检验机器学习生成的巴黎区域气候模式热浪在物理上是否真实可信；其二，借助机器学习模拟数据集，对粗分辨率全球气候模式的集合增广事件实施基于类比（analog-based）的降尺度。
AI.result: ML生成的热浪被证明在物理上是真实的；该混合框架成功将高分辨率区域细节与稀有事件采样相结合。
AI.conclusion: 该混合框架为极端事件降尺度提供了高效工具，既能保留区域细节，又能捕捉多模式不确定性。

title: Visibility-Aware Task and Motion Planning with Task-Centric Perception
summary: Long-horizon manipulation under uncertainty remains a challenging problem in robotics. We present \ourmethod{}, an algorithm for Visibility-Aware Task and Motion Planning. \ourmethod{} extends existing deterministic task and motion planning solvers to partially observable object rearrangement tasks, while still being able to take advantage of the efficiency and compositional generalization over long horizons of the base solver. This extension interleaves sensing actions into a plan skeleton that assumed full observability, and uses a novel persistent object-based memory to fuse observations into object mesh hypotheses and an observed occupancy map. We evaluate \ourmethod{} on real-world tabletop rearrangement tasks which feature heavy occlusion and partial visibility and demonstrate that it outperforms baselines that do not perform active perception or have persistent memory.

AI.tldr: 提出VATAMP（Visibility-Aware Task and Motion Planning），将确定性TAMP求解器扩展到部分可观测的物体重排任务：在假设全可观测的计划骨架上插入感知动作，并用持久化物体记忆融合观测为物体网格假设与占据地图，在严重遮挡的真实桌面重排任务中优于无主动感知或无持久记忆的基线。
AI.motivation: 不确定条件下的长时域操作仍是机器人难题。现有确定性TAMP求解器效率高、具备长时域组合泛化能力，但要求全可观测；而真实场景存在严重遮挡与部分可见，直接应用会失败，因此需在保留原求解器优势的前提下引入部分可观测性处理。
AI.method: 以确定性TAMP为基础，先在其生成的全可观测假设下得到计划骨架，再将感知动作插入骨架中形成感知—操作交错执行；引入新颖的持久化物体级记忆，将多视角观测融合为物体网格假设（object mesh hypotheses）与观测占据地图（observed occupancy map），从而实现可见性感知的规划与推理。
AI.result: 在真实桌面重排任务（具有严重遮挡和部分可见性）上评估，VATAMP优于不进行主动感知的基线以及缺乏持久记忆的基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过在确定性TAMP中嵌入感知动作与持久物体记忆，可在部分可观测重排任务中兼顾原求解器的效率与长时域组合泛化能力，主动感知与记忆机制对遮挡场景下的规划性能至关重要。

title: A New Analytical Method and Interpretation of Loss-of-Load Counts
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 1 table, submitted to IEEE PESGM
summary: This paper establishes the relationship between loss-of-load expectation (LOLE) and loss-of-load frequency (LOLF). We show why LOLE generally does not measure distinct-event frequency, mean event duration, or shortage magnitude. We identify conditions under which peak-based LOLE admits a frequency interpretation as the expected count of deficient daily peaks per horizon and distinguish this quantity from LOLF. We also derive an analytical formulation for frequency-and-duration indices that combines a convolution-derived generation probability-and-frequency model with chronological load changes. Under stationary generation, it uses the prescribed load profile directly, without constructing a separate load model or discretizing load magnitudes. Studies using generation and load data from the 24-bus IEEE RTS reveal different event frequencies and mean event durations at identical peak-based LOLE, motivating their separate assessment. Numerical comparisons demonstrate the accuracy advantage of the proposed analytical calculation over the conventional analytical implementations, quantifying the LOLF errors incurred by load discretization.

AI.tldr: 本文厘清了LOLE与LOLF的关系，指出峰值型LOLE仅在特定条件下可作"日峰缺额期望次数"解释，并给出结合卷积型发电概率-频率模型与时序负荷变化的频率/持续时间指标解析计算方法。
AI.motivation: 现有可靠性评估中LOLE被普遍误用为事件频率、平均事件持续时间或缺电量大小的度量，且传统解析法依赖负荷离散化，带来LOLF计算误差，缺乏对LOLE与LOLF关系的严格界定。
AI.method: 先辨析LOLE与LOLF的概念差异，给出峰值型LOLE可解释为"每时段缺额日峰期望次数"的条件，并将该量与LOLF区分；随后推导频率-持续时间指标的解析式，将卷积得到的发电概率-频率模型与时序负荷变化耦合。在平稳发电假设下直接使用给定负荷曲线，不另建负荷模型、不对负荷幅值离散化。
AI.result: 基于IEEE 24节点RTS的发电与负荷数据表明，在相同峰值型LOLE下系统呈现不同的事件频率与平均事件持续时间，说明二者需分别评估；数值对比显示所提解析法精度优于传统解析实现，并量化了负荷离散化导致的LOLF误差。
AI.conclusion: LOLE不能替代LOLF及频率-持续时间指标，应分别评估；所提解析方法避免负荷离散化、精度更高，为频率与持续时间类可靠性指标的准确计算提供了可行途径。

title: Vision-Grounded Semantic Learning and Alignment for Scalable Multilingual Text-Based Person Retrieval
summary: Multilingual Text-Based Person Retrieval (TBPR) aims to retrieve individuals with texts in multiple languages. Despite its practical importance, it has been overlooked by existing research, which mainly focuses on English-only retrieval. The only prior attempt at multilingual TBPR suffers from (1) the absence of a large-scale, multilingual pretraining dataset and (2) a suboptimal model architecture for multilingual text encoding and cross-modal alignment, which employs a shared encoder that overlooks linguistic heterogeneity and relies on English as a pivot for cross-modal alignment, introducing English-centric bias. For this, we contribute MultiPedes, the first large-scale, pedestrian-centric multilingual pretraining dataset. It contains 10 million image-text pairs across four languages, constructed by a multilingual quality-aware data construction pipeline.
