We also propose ViSeLA (Vision-grounded Semantic Learning and Alignment), a novel framework featuring: (1) a semantic-aware multilingual learning module that extends the mixture-of-experts architecture by routing language-invariant semantics to specialized experts for improved multilingual feature learning; and (2) a vision-grounded cross-modal alignment module that employs a semantic probe to capture fine-grained semantics across modalities, enabling direct cross-modal alignment without relying on a pivot language. Extensive experiments on both multilingual and English-only TBPR datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of ViSeLA. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/Flame-Chasers/ViSeLA

AI.tldr: 该论文提出首个大规模多语言行人中心预训练数据集 MultiPedes（4种语言、1000万图文对）与 ViSeLA 框架，通过语义感知多语言学习与视觉锚定的跨模态对齐，实现不依赖英语枢轴的多语言文本行人检索，并在多语言与纯英文TBPR数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 多语言文本行人检索（TBPR）具有现实重要性，但现有研究几乎只关注英文检索。唯一的多语言TBPR先期工作存在两点不足：(1) 缺乏大规模多语言预训练数据；(2) 模型架构欠优——共享编码器忽视语言异质性，且跨模态对齐以英语为枢轴，引入英语中心偏置。
AI.method: 数据层面：构建 MultiPedes，首个大规模、以行人为中心的多语言预训练数据集，含4种语言共1000万图文对，由多语言质量感知的数据构建流水线生成。模型层面：提出 ViSeLA 框架，包含(1)语义感知多语言学习模块，在混合专家（MoE）架构上扩展，将语言不变语义路由至专门专家，改善多语言特征学习；(2)视觉锚定的跨模态对齐模块，利用语义探针捕获跨模态细粒度语义，实现不依赖枢轴语言的直接跨模态对齐。
AI.result: 在多语言TBPR数据集与纯英文TBPR数据集上均开展了大量实验，结果表明 ViSeLA 有效，优于对比基线。
AI.conclusion: MultiPedes 与 ViSeLA 填补了多语言行人检索在数据与架构上的空白，证明了去英语枢轴、语言专家化建模的可行性；数据集与代码已开源。

title: Food Critic: An Agentic Visualization System for Auditable Restaurant-Safety Reasoning
summary: Generative AI agents are increasingly being embedded into visualization systems that can search data, invoke tools, summarize evidence, and produce recommendations. However, when agents rely solely on their own knowledge, the visualization problem is not only whether the agent provides a useful answer, but also whether users can inspect how that answer is grounded. We present Food Critic, an agentic visualization system for diners' restaurant decision support that integrates public health inspection records with crowd review data. The system grounds agents under three conditions: a database-only ReAct agent, a retrieval- augmented agent with access to food-safety regulations, and an ontology-guided agent that produces structured hypotheses and typed evidence. Food Critic externalizes the agent's reasoning within these groundings as inspectable visual evidence. We evaluate LLM models with several use cases under each grounding of our agentic system. Our work positions restaurant choice as a concrete case for studying human-agent collaboration, visual provenance of agent reasoning, and the design of visual interfaces for grounded GenAI decision support.

AI.tldr: 提出Food Critic——一个面向餐厅决策支持的智能体可视化系统，将公共卫生检查记录与大众点评数据整合，在三种“接地”条件下运行ReAct智能体，并将推理过程外化为可检查的视觉证据。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI智能体正被嵌入可视化系统，能检索数据、调用工具、总结证据并给出建议。但若智能体仅依赖自身知识，核心问题就不只是答案是否有用，还在于用户能否检查答案的依据（grounding/provenance）。作者以“餐厅选择”为具体场景，研究人-智能体协作与可追溯推理的视觉呈现。
AI.method: 构建Food Critic系统，融合公共卫生检查记录与 crowdsourced 评论数据；设计三种逐步增强的接地方式：①仅数据库的ReAct智能体；②可访问食品安全法规的检索增强（RAG）智能体；③生成结构化假设与类型化证据的本体引导智能体。系统将各接地条件下的推理外化为可检查的视觉证据，并在每种接地条件下用多个用例对LLM模型进行评估。
AI.result: 在三种接地条件下对多种LLM进行了多用例评估（摘要未给出具体量化结果），验证了将智能体推理外化为可视证据的可行性与设计思路。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将餐厅选择确立为研究人-智能体协作、智能体推理的视觉溯源，以及接地式GenAI决策支持界面设计的典型场景。

title: Learning Rate Transfer and Feature Learning Across Depth for Constrained Spectral Optimizers: Complete Scion
summary: Hyperparameter transfer across model depth is instrumental in training deep models, as it enables learning rates calibrated on shallow networks to be effectively applied to deeper architectures. The recent CompleteP framework establishes a $1/L$ residual scaling rule that demonstrates this for Adam-family optimizers. We study whether similar transfer extends to constrained optimization methods, specifically Frank-Wolfe and projected non-Euclidean normalized steepest descent, where updates are determined by linear minimization oracles. We derive scaling rules for these methods which confirm that the $1/L$ residual scaling applies, although the arguments differ from the Adam-family optimizers. Our analysis supports depth-wise transfer and width-wise transfer of the learning rate for the Scion algorithm while ensuring feature learning and avoiding the kernel-regime. In experiments on NLP transformers (nanoGPT on FineWeb), vision transformers (DeiT on ImageNet), and vision MLPs (MLP-Mixer on CIFAR-10), we observe learning rate transfer across depth and feature learning for appropriately chosen residual scaling.

AI.tldr: 论文研究约束优化方法（Frank-Wolfe 与投影非欧几里得归一化最速下降）是否也具备随深度迁移学习率的性质，证明 1/L 残差缩放规则同样适用，并在 nanoGPT、DeiT、MLP-Mixer 上验证了深度与宽度方向的学习率迁移及特征学习。
AI.motivation: 近期 CompleteP 框架给出了 1/L 残差缩放规则，使浅层网络标定的学习率可迁移到更深模型，但该结论仅针对 Adam 族优化器。作者希望检验这类超参数迁移是否也适用于以线性最小化 oracle 决定更新方向的约束优化方法（Frank-Wolfe、投影非欧几里得归一化最速下降），并推广到 Scion 算法。
AI.method: 为 Frank-Wolfe 和投影非欧几里得归一化最速下降推导随深度变化的缩放规则，论证 1/L 残差缩放同样成立（尽管推导论证与 Adam 族不同）；据此分析 Scion 算法的学习率在深度方向与宽度方向的迁移性，并保证处于特征学习区而非核回归区。实验涵盖 NLP Transformer（nanoGPT + FineWeb）、视觉 Transformer（DeiT + ImageNet）和视觉 MLP（MLP-Mixer + CIFAR-10）。
AI.result: 理论推导确认 1/L 残差缩放规则对上述约束优化方法同样适用，从而支持 Scion 的学习率跨深度与跨宽度迁移；三类实验在不同残差缩放下均观察到学习率随深度迁移现象，并保持特征学习、避开核区间。
AI.conclusion: 超参数随深度的迁移并非 Adam 族优化器所独有，而是可扩展到基于线性最小化 oracle 的约束优化方法与 Scion；恰当的 1/L 残差缩放是实现深度/宽度方向学习率迁移并维持特征学习的关键。

title: A Coupled Control Barrier Function Approach to Deadlock-Free Multi-Robot Conflict Resolution
summary: Many robotic applications involve scenarios where multiple robots interact and the decisions of one robot influence the behavior of others. This paper presents a quadratic programming (QP)-based feedback controller for multi-robot conflict resolution with input constraints. Safety is enforced using coupled Control Barrier Function (CBF), while a yielding matrix encodes how robots influence each other. Unlike existing methods with fixed or hard priorities, the proposed framework enables yielding preferences while guaranteeing deadlock-free operation by design. Sufficient conditions are established for the controller to be locally Lipschitz. The optimal CBF sign- indefinite slack is shown to admit a finite uniform bound, which is compensated through an enlarged CBF safety margin to obtain a forward invariant set contained within the desired safe set. The analysis also identifies an irreducible slack component due to finite maximum deceleration that cannot be eliminated by increasing the slack penalty. Finally, sufficient conditions on the yielding matrix and nominal controller are derived to exclude deadlock states. Simulations demonstrate adaptive coordination across yielding preferences and robustness to robot failures.

AI.tldr: 提出一种带输入约束的QP反馈控制器，用耦合CBF保证多机器人避碰安全，用让行矩阵编码机器人间的相互影响，实现可调让行偏好且设计上无死锁，并给出局部Lipschitz性、松弛有界性与无死锁性的充分条件。
AI.motivation: 多机器人交互场景中，一个机器人的决策会影响其他机器人行为；现有方法多采用固定或硬优先级，缺乏灵活的让行偏好表达，且难以保证无死锁。
AI.method: 构建基于二次规划（QP）的反馈控制器并考虑输入约束；采用耦合控制障碍函数（CBF）施加安全约束，并引入让行矩阵刻画机器人间的相互影响；在CBF约束中允许符号不定松弛，通过放大CBF安全裕度补偿最优松弛的有限一致上界，使前向不变集包含于期望安全集内；推导控制器局部Lipschitz的充分条件，并给出让行矩阵与名义控制器的充分条件以排除死锁状态。
AI.result: 证明最优CBF符号不定松弛具有有限一致上界，可通过放大安全裕度补偿并获得包含于期望安全集的前向不变集；识别出由有限最大减速度导致的不可约松弛分量，无法通过增大松弛惩罚消除；给出无死锁的充分条件；仿真显示控制器能按让行偏好自适应协调，并对机器人失效具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在保证安全与输入可行性的同时，以设计方式实现无死锁的可调让行偏好协调，为多机器人冲突消解提供具有理论保证的QP-CBF方案。

title: Mode-in-Variance Participation Factors under Stochastic Excitation
summary: This paper investigates how the dynamic modes of a power system contribute to the stationary variance of its variables under continuous stochastic excitation. Using a modal decomposition of the covariance matrix, the variance of each state or algebraic variable can be resolved into components associated with individual modal responses and their interactions. These components are shown to correspond to within-mode variance and cross-modal covariance, respectively, and the corresponding normalized contributions are termed mode-in-variance participation factors (PFs). The proposed PFs can be used to identify modes governing the variability of important system quantities such as frequency and voltage, quantify the effect of modal interactions, and reveal control dynamics that can be targeted to reduce their stochastic variability. These capabilities are demonstrated through case studies based on the Kundur two-area and IEEE 39-bus systems.

AI.tldr: 提出基于协方差矩阵模态分解的"方差内模态参与因子"(mode-in-variance PFs)，将随机激励下电力系统各状态/代数变量的稳态方差分解为各模态内部贡献与跨模态协方差贡献，用于识别主导频率、电压波动的模态及可调控的动态环节。
AI.motivation: 随机激励下的电力系统持续存在稳态波动，传统模态分析（特征值、参与因子）只刻画模态的可观测性/可控性，无法定量回答"哪个模态贡献了某变量稳态方差的多大比例"，也难以量化模态间交互对波动的影响，因而需要一种面向方差归因的模态解析工具。
AI.method: 对连续随机激励下系统的协方差矩阵进行模态分解，将每个状态变量或代数变量的稳态方差分解为与各模态响应相关的分量及其交互项；证明前者对应模态内部方差（within-mode variance）、后者对应跨模态协方差（cross-modal covariance），并对这些贡献做归一化，定义 mode-in-variance 参与因子。利用该指标识别主导频率与电压等关键量的波动模态、量化模态交互效应，并定位可通过控制设计加以改善的动态环节。
AI.result: 所提 PFs 能够定量给出各模态及其交互对特定变量稳态方差的贡献份额，可识别主导关键量波动的模态、评估模态耦合的作用，并揭示可用于降低随机波动的控制动态；在 Kundur 两区域系统和 IEEE 39 节点系统算例中验证了上述能力。
AI.conclusion: 方差内模态参与因子为随机电力系统的波动归因提供了系统化指标，把经典小信号模态分析与随机稳态方差联系起来，可作为筛选主导波动模态和指导控制设计的工具；后续可扩展到更复杂的随机激励模型与大规模系统。

title: CARE-Drive: Coupled Alternating Refinement for Ego-trajectories
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models bring multimodal understanding and world knowledge to end-to-end autonomous driving. To further improve the quality of predicted trajectories, existing studies introduce candidate refinement, residual denoising, and token correction. However, these methods typically focus on unified refinement of the entire trajectory, paying limited attention to the distinct physical quantities and their interactions. We further investigate physical specialization and coordination in trajectory refinement, centering on position and heading for simpler and more intuitive correction modeling. To this end, we propose CARE-Drive (Coupled Alternating Refinement for Ego-trajectories), which decomposes trajectory refinement into waypoint residual correction and position-conditioned heading generation. Through imitation learning and a future-token auxiliary task, the backbone provides predictive representations and a base trajectory. The position expert predicts bounded metric waypoint residuals, while the heading expert reconstructs vehicle orientation from adjacent angular increments conditioned on the corrected path. With the backbone frozen, the two experts are optimized alternately through supervised initialization and reinforcement fine-tuning. This design simplifies refinement through clear physical specialization while preserving conditional coupling during prediction and optimization. On NAVSIM v1, CARE-Drive achieves 88.8 PDMS, improving by 2.4 points over the unrefined base trajectories generated by the same backbone. Ablation studies further support the effectiveness of specialized experts and staged training.

AI.tldr: 提出CARE-Drive，将轨迹细化分解为"路点残差校正"与"以位置为条件的朝向生成"两个物理专家，并通过交替优化实现轨迹精化，在NAVSIM v1上达到88.8 PDMS。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA端到端自动驾驶的轨迹细化方法（候选细化、残差去噪、token校正）多是整体统一细化，忽视轨迹中各物理量（位置、朝向）的差异性及其交互关系，导致建模不够直观、精度受限。
AI.method: CARE-Drive将细化拆分为两个专家：位置专家预测有界度量空间的路点残差；朝向专家在校正后路径条件下，由相邻角度增量重建车辆朝向。主干经模仿学习与未来token辅助任务输出预测表征与基础轨迹；冻结主干，两专家通过监督初始化+强化微调交替优化，兼顾物理专门化与条件耦合。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM v1上取得88.8 PDMS，较同一主干的未细化基础轨迹提升2.4分；消融实验验证了专门化专家与分阶段训练的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以清晰的物理量专门化与条件耦合来简化轨迹细化建模是有效的，位置残差校正与朝向生成的分工协作能稳定提升端到端轨迹预测质量。

title: Reward-Driven Collider Physics Challenges for Self-Improving Agentic AI via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Recent advances in agentic AI have demonstrated the potential to automate complex high-energy physics (HEP) workflows. We focus on the regime of HEP tasks where frontier models still struggle to provide correct and complete solutions, and introduce an open-ended optimization task format with continuous, automatically evaluated rewards. Unlike conventional benchmarks focused on task completion, these tasks target reinforcement learning (RL) environments to generate agentic improvement on state- of-the-art HEP challenges. We benchmark frontier reasoning models on several HEP tasks and demonstrate an initial proof of concept in which a small language model improves through RL using automated feedback without human intervention. By connecting challenging HEP problems with verifiable scientific rewards and RL, we aim to advance agentic AI from reproducing established workflows to autonomously discovering better scientific solutions, paving the way toward self-improving scientific agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种开放式优化任务格式与连续、自动评估的奖励机制，面向高能物理中前沿模型仍难以正确完成的难题，将其作为强化学习环境，并在小模型上验证了无需人工干预即可通过自动化反馈实现自我改进的概念验证。
AI.motivation: 现有agentic AI多聚焦任务完成型基准，而高能物理中存在大量前沿模型仍无法给出正确且完整解的任务；作者希望把这类难题转化为可验证的强化学习环境，推动智能体从复现既有工作流走向自主发现更优科学解。
AI.method: 设计开放式优化任务格式，配套连续且自动评估的奖励函数（可验证的科学奖励）；在多个HEP任务上评测前沿推理模型，并以小型语言模型在自动化反馈下进行强化学习实验，全程无人工干预。
AI.result: 在多个高能物理任务上给出前沿推理模型的基准结果；小型语言模型借助自动化反馈的强化学习取得初步改进，验证了该范式的可行性（概念验证）。
AI.conclusion: 将具有挑战性的HEP问题与可验证科学奖励及强化学习相连接，可使agentic AI从复现既定流程转向自主发现更优科学解决方案，为通向自我改进的科学智能体奠定基础。

title: Sharp Covering-Number Bounds for Feedforward ReLU Networks via Parameter Symmetries
summary: In neural networks, distinct parameter configurations often realize the same input--output mapping, indicating that nominal parameter counts can overstate functional complexity. In this paper, we characterize the parameter-space symmetries of ReLU and Leaky ReLU networks across fully connected, convolutional, and residual architectures. We prove that every quasianalytic parameter map preserving the network function is a composition of positive channel scaling and channel permutation. By quotienting out both symmetries, we derive uniform covering-number upper bounds in which positive scaling reduces the complexity exponent from the total parameter count $S$ to $S-H$ (with $H$ denoting the number of scalable channels) and permutation symmetry divides the bound by the factorial count $G$ of channel permutations. We establish matching lower bounds showing that the exponent $S-H$ is sharp in general and that the divisor $G$ is attained for one-hidden-layer and generically identifiable networks. We further extend these results to general continuous piecewise-linear activated networks. Finally, we apply our covering-number bounds to derive statistical risk guarantees for empirical risk minimization and capacity control beyond i.i.d.\ settings, and show how the underlying symmetries help explain weight rebalancing in function approximation and flat directions in empirical risk optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了ReLU/Leaky ReLU网络（全连接、卷积、残差）参数空间的两类对称性（正通道缩放与通道置换），证明保函数光滑参数映射均为二者复合，据此得到统一覆盖数上界与匹配下界，并应用于统计风险与优化现象解释。
AI.motivation: 神经网络中不同参数配置可实现同一输入-输出映射，名义参数计数会高估函数复杂度，因此需精确刻画参数空间对称性并据此修正容量度量。
AI.method: 证明保持网络函数不变的拟解析参数映射必为正通道缩放与通道置换的复合；对两类对称性取商，推导覆盖数上界；构造匹配下界；推广到一般连续分段线性激活网络；并将覆盖数界用于ERM统计风险与非i.i.d.容量控制分析。
AI.result: 得到一致覆盖数上界：正缩放将复杂度指数由总参数数S降为S−H（H为可缩放通道数），置换对称将界除以通道置换阶乘数G；下界表明指数S−H一般紧，除数G在单隐层及一般可辨识网络中可达。
AI.conclusion: 对称性商化可显著收紧容量界，进而给出ERM风险保证与非i.i.d.情形下的容量控制，并解释了函数逼近中的权重再平衡与经验风险优化中的平坦方向。

title: BWM-Forge: Agentic World Programming for Embodied Intelligence
summary: Generating diverse robot videos requires control over scene geometry, robot motion, and viewpoints. End-to-end video generation offers limited direct access to these variables, making targeted edits and reuse across tasks difficult. We present BWM-Forge, a code-driven framework for controllable video generation in robotics. Given robot assets and a task description, the framework accepts an initial image, an image with motion data, or a human demonstration video. A coding agent constructs editable Blender scene programs that specify objects, robot motion, and cameras. The resulting proxy videos provide structural and motion references for a video generation model, which adds visual detail. A multi-agent harness coordinates input processing, scene construction, review, and rendering. Automated evaluation and user feedback support iterative refinement, while an experience repository stores and retrieves reusable modeling and rendering rules. This design supports multiple robot embodiments, synchronized viewpoints, and appearance variation from a shared scene program. We evaluate the framework on 15 tasks covering five robot types. Compared with LingBot-World Base Cam on these tasks, BWM-Forge achieves higher aesthetic quality, imaging quality, subject and background consistency, motion smoothness, and RoboJudge-9B physical adherence and instruction alignment scores. The baseline scores higher in dynamic degree. Qualitative cases illustrate viewpoint control, scene variation, feedback-driven edits, and experience reuse across scenes. These results demonstrate a practical approach to generating controllable robot videos through editable, executable scene representations.

AI.tldr: 提出BWM-Forge：一种代码驱动、可编辑的机器人视频生成框架，用编码智能体构建Blender场景程序作为结构/运动参考，再由视频生成模型补充视觉细节。
AI.motivation: 端到端视频生成对场景几何、机器人运动、视角缺乏显式可控性，难以做定向编辑与跨任务复用；机器人视频生成亟需可解释、可编辑的中间表示。
AI.method: 以机器人资产与任务描述为输入，接受初始图像、带运动数据的图像或人类演示视频；编码智能体生成可编辑Blender场景程序（物体、机器人运动、相机），产出代理视频作为结构与运动参考，交由视频生成模型细化外观；多智能体harness协调输入处理、场景构建、审查与渲染，并配自动评估与用户反馈迭代，经验库存储/检索可复用的建模与渲染规则。
AI.result: 在覆盖5类机器人、15项任务上对比LingBot-World Base Cam：美学质量、成像质量、主体与背景一致性、运动平滑度，以及RoboJudge-9B的物理合理性与指令对齐均更优；基线仅在动态程度上更高。
AI.conclusion: 可编辑、可执行的场景程序是可实现可控机器人视频生成的实用路径，支持多本体、多视角同步与外观变化，并可通过反馈与经验复用持续改进。

title: Improved Single-Input Space Vector for DC-Biased Sinusoidal Current Control in Battery Cyclers
comment: 8 pages, 17 figures. Accepted version of a paper presented at the 2026 IEEE Energy Conversion Congress and Expo (ECCE), Vancouver, Canada
summary: This paper presents improvements to the single-input space vector (SISV) concept for current control in a battery cycler based on a two-phase interleaved buck converter. The cycler is controlled to output a dc-biased sinusoidal current, enabling investigation of second-harmonic ripple effects on lithium-ion cell aging. A modified SISV generation scheme is introduced to track current references containing both dc and sinusoidal components, and an impedance-angle compensation method is proposed to decouple the d and q control axes without disturbing dc tracking. A dq phase-portrait visualization method is also introduced to evaluate transient performance for both SISV and proportional-integral-resonant (PIR) control methods. Simulation and experimental results validate dc-biased sinusoidal current tracking using PIR control and SISV control with different decoupling schemes. The phase-portrait framework allows for straightforward evaluation of transient performance for both SISV and PIR control methods and supports controller tuning to obtain desired trajectories. The results demonstrate the feasibility of SISV-based current control as an alternative to PIR control for battery-cycler applications. The proposed improvements support the development of battery cyclers capable of controlling both dc and sinusoidal current components.

AI.tldr: 该文改进单输入空间矢量(SISV)控制，用于两相交错Buck变换器电池循环仪的直流偏置正弦电流跟踪，并提出阻抗角解耦补偿与dq相图可视化方法，验证SISV可替代PIR控制。
AI.motivation: 基于两相交错Buck变换器的电池循环仪需输出直流偏置正弦电流，以研究二次谐波纹波对锂离子电芯老化的影响；传统PIR控制存在局限，需探索SISV控制在该场景下的可行性。
AI.method: 提出改进的SISV生成方案以跟踪含直流与正弦分量的电流参考；提出阻抗角补偿方法，在不干扰直流跟踪的前提下实现d、q轴解耦；并引入dq相图可视化方法评估SISV与PIR控制的暂态性能。
AI.result: 仿真与实验验证了PIR控制及采用不同解耦方案的SISV控制均能跟踪直流偏置正弦电流；相图框架可直观评估两种方法的暂态性能并支持控制器整定以获得期望轨迹。
AI.conclusion: SISV电流控制可作为PIR控制的可行替代方案用于电池循环仪；所提改进有助于开发同时控制直流与正弦电流分量的电池循环仪。

title: ChartGalaxy++: A Richly Annotated Dataset for Chart Understanding and Generation
summary: Infographic charts communicate data through cohesive compositions of visual elements such as charts, text, and images. Existing infographic chart datasets primarily annotate individual elements with bounding boxes and category labels. Such element-level annotations do not capture hierarchical and spatial relationships, limiting their use for understanding how elements are organized and related within an infographic and for generating well-organized designs. To address this limitation, we introduce ChartGalaxy++, a richly annotated dataset of 217,195 infographic charts. At the core of this dataset is a scene graph representation, in which nodes represent visual elements and semantic groups, and edges encode their hierarchical and spatial relationships. For real infographics, we construct scene graphs by detecting and progressively grouping visual elements; for synthetic ones, we derive them directly from the generation process. We demonstrate the utility of ChartGalaxy++ through three applications: 1) image-to-scene-graph prediction, 2) scene-graph-augmented infographic question answering, and 3) evaluation of scene graph preservation in image generation. Together, these applications highlight the value of ChartGalaxy++ for advancing chart understanding and generation.

AI.tldr: 提出ChartGalaxy++，一个包含217,195张信息图图表的场景图标注数据集，用节点表示视觉元素与语义分组、边编码层级与空间关系，并在三项任务上验证其价值。
AI.motivation: 现有信息图图表数据集仅以边界框和类别标签做元素级标注，无法刻画元素间的层级与空间关系，因而难以支撑对信息图组织结构的理解以及结构化设计的生成。
AI.method: 构建大规模场景图（scene graph）标注数据集：真实信息图通过检测视觉元素并逐步分组构造场景图，合成信息图则直接由生成过程导出场景图。
AI.result: 数据集规模达217,195张信息图图表，具备元素与语义分组节点及层级、空间关系边；并在三项应用中验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: ChartGalaxy++通过场景图表示弥补元素级标注的不足，在图像到场景图预测、场景图增强的信息图问答、图像生成中场景图保持性评估三方面体现价值，推动图表理解与生成研究。

title: Between Niti and Nyaya: A Society-Centered Framework for AI Governance
summary: Governments are making decisions about AI before they can measure its public effects, and those decisions determine whether a person can learn that AI influenced an outcome, challenge it, and see it corrected. Research has documented what AI governance produces: principles, strategies, registers, and audits. However, we lack shared language for understanding AI policy while it is still being made. We introduce the Society-Centered AI Governance Framework, which gives policymakers, researchers, and the public a way to assess instruments in any jurisdiction by whether a person can get notice, challenge a decision, and see it corrected. It reads a jurisdiction's instruments together by date and binding status, separates an agency duty from a right a person can invoke, and traces which later instrument must enforce each commitment. We evaluated it in North Carolina using interviews with nine AI Leadership Council members, conducted before and after the state's 2026 AI roadmap, and a provision-level reading, with human-reviewed model-assisted coding, of 49 AI governance documents from 19 states. For the state's own AI systems, we find visibility-first governance: visibility duties are in effect, notice exists as an agency duty with no right a person can invoke, and AI-specific challenge and correction remain advisory. The roadmap assigns owners and dates to the missing protections, so the gaps are documented but not yet closed. Recent federal preemption proposals focus on AI development, so recourse for a state's own systems is likely to remain a state decision. We identify "legitimacy before protection" as a testable risk of visibility-first governance and name the milestones that would test it. More broadly, judging AI policy by who can act on what it makes visible lets the field assess recourse while policy is still forming, before harm occurs.

AI.tldr: 提出"以社会为中心的AI治理框架"(Society-Centered AI Governance Framework)，以"个人能否获得通知、能否质疑决策、能否获得纠错"三项可诉权利为核心评估标准，结合访谈与49份州级治理文件的条款级编码，在"AI政策尚在形成中"即可评估其救济能力。
AI.motivation: 政府往往在尚无法测量AI公共影响时就做出决策，而这些决策决定了个人能否知晓AI影响了结果、能否质疑、能否获得纠正。已有研究多记录AI治理的产出物（原则、战略、登记册、审计），却缺乏一套共享语言去理解"仍在制定中"的AI政策，尤其缺少对个人可主张救济（recourse）的评估口径。
AI.method: 1) 构建框架：按日期与约束力状态把同一法域的多份治理文件作为整体解读，区分"机构义务(duty)"与"个人可援引的权利(right)"，并追踪后续哪份文件必须落实每项承诺；2) 实证检验：在北卡罗来纳州，对9名AI领导委员会成员在其2026年AI路线图发布前后进行访谈；3) 文本分析：对来自19个州的49份AI治理文件做条款级阅读，采用人工复核+模型辅助编码。
AI.result: 针对该州自身AI系统，发现"可见性优先"(visibility-first)治理形态：可见性义务已生效；通知仅作为机构义务存在，个人无可援引权利；AI专项的质疑与纠错机制仍属建议性。路线图虽为缺失的保护指定了责任主体与时间节点，但缺口只是被记录、尚未闭合。近期联邦层面的优先适用(preemption)提案聚焦AI开发环节，因此本州自有系统的救济路径大概率仍由州层面决定。
AI.conclusion: 提出"合法性先于保护"(legitimacy before protection)作为可见性优先治理的可检验风险，并列出可用于检验该风险的里程碑指标。总体上，以"谁能对AI所揭示的信息采取行动"来评判AI政策，使学界与政策界能在政策成形阶段、伤害发生之前评估救济机制。

title: TabOmics: A Small, Open Tabular Foundation Model for Wide Omics Data
summary: Omics studies often produce tables with thousands to tens of thousands of molecular features and few samples. Tabular foundation models use diverse strategies to predict labels for such tables, with some relying on in-context learning, while approaches to wide tables may involve subsampling, grouping, or compressing features. We present TabOmics, a small, open family of tabular foundation models with 7.3M parameters, pretrained exclusively on synthetic tables. TabOmics processes all features retained after preprocessing jointly and derives predictions, attention-derived feature-importance scores, and test sample embeddings from the same forward pass. On 46 classification tasks from three benchmarks of high-dimensional, low-sample-size tables, TabOmics v2.5 with eight ensemble members achieves the highest mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) among the evaluated models (0.943), outperforming TabPFN-3.5 with eight members on 32 tasks despite having about 30 times fewer parameters. With a single member, TabOmics v2.5 reaches a mean AUROC of 0.941, versus 0.942 for TabPFN-3.5 with eight members, with no significant paired difference under the reported task-level analysis. On synthetic tables, its feature-importance scores achieve feature recovery similar to that of TabPFN-Wide, and its predictions remain above chance at 30,000 features. On breast cancer tasks, the top ranked genes include PAM50 genes, which define the subtype labels, indicating concordance with the label definition rather than independent biological validation. The code, model weights, training recipes, and experimental artifacts are publicly available.

AI.tldr: TabOmics是一个仅7.3M参数、纯合成数据预训练的小型表格基础模型家族，可联合处理全部特征并在单次前向中同时输出预测、注意力特征重要性和样本嵌入，在46个高维小样本分类任务上以0.943平均AUROC超越参数量约30倍的TabPFN-3.5集成。
AI.motivation: 组学数据表格常包含数千至上万个分子特征、样本量极少；现有表格基础模型多依赖上下文学习，对宽表需子采样、分组或特征压缩，可能损失信息且模型规模大。
AI.method: 提出TabOmics小型开放模型家族（7.3M参数），仅在合成表格上预训练；对预处理后保留的全部特征进行联合建模，单次前向同时给出预测、基于注意力的特征重要性分数和测试样本嵌入；v2.5版本可构建8成员集成。
AI.result: 在三个高维小样本基准的46个分类任务上，8成员TabOmics v2.5取得最高平均AUROC（0.943），在32个任务上优于8成员TabPFN-3.5；单模型平均AUROC为0.941（对比TabPFN-3.5八成员0.942），任务级配对分析无显著差异；合成数据上特征重要性的特征恢复能力与TabPFN-Wide相当，且3万特征时预测仍优于随机；乳腺癌任务中排名靠前的基因包含定义标签的PAM50基因。
AI.conclusion: 小型、纯合成预训练的表格基础模型可在高维小样本组学任务上以极低参数量达到与更大模型相当或更优的性能，并附带可解释的特征重要性；但基因层面的结果仅反映与标签定义的一致性，而非独立的生物学验证；代码、权重与实验产物均公开。

title: What Can a VLA Learn from the Agent That Calls It? Task-Level Experience Distillation for Embodied Navigation
summary: Navigation agents use a large language model (LLM) planner to call a vision-language-action (VLA) model. Each episode needs the LLM, adding cost and delay. We distill successful agent experience into the VLA instead of distilling the planner. The VLA then navigates alone at test time. Agent sessions are not VLA demonstrations. They include motions driven by planner tools and sub-instructions, along with detours. We present H2E, a task-level experience distillation method that converts these sessions into VLA training data. Every motion becomes a VLA action under the original task instruction, with the resulting poses as targets. H2E masks the loss on steps that move away from the goal. It labels every visited state within 1 m of the goal as a stop. We then update the VLA with low-rank adaptation. The VLA learns to stop at the goal and find goals the base model never reaches. On all 3,189 REVERIE-CE val-unseen episodes, H2E raises the success rate of an 8B VLA from 35.0% to 44.9%.

AI.tldr: H2E：将LLM规划器引导的导航智能体会话蒸馏为VLA训练数据，使VLA在测试时独立导航，在REVERIE-CE val-unseen上将8B VLA成功率从35.0%提升至44.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有导航智能体依赖LLM规划器调用VLA模型，每个episode都需调用LLM，带来额外成本与延迟。作者希望通过蒸馏智能体的成功经验（而非蒸馏规划器本身）来消除测试时对LLM的依赖。挑战在于：智能体会话并非标准的VLA演示数据，其中包含由规划器工具和子指令驱动的动作以及绕行轨迹，不能直接用于训练。
AI.method: 提出任务级经验蒸馏方法H2E，将智能体会话转换为VLA训练数据：1）在原始任务指令下，将每个动作作为VLA动作，并以产生的位姿作为目标；2）对偏离目标的步骤屏蔽损失（loss masking）；3）将目标1米范围内的每个访问状态标注为停止；4）采用低秩适配（LoRA）更新VLA。
AI.result: 在REVERIE-CE val-unseen全部3,189个episode上，H2E将8B VLA的成功率从35.0%提升到44.9%。VLA学会了在目标处停止，并能找到基础模型无法到达的目标。
AI.conclusion: 任务级经验蒸馏可有效将规划器增强的智能体会话转化为VLA能力，使VLA在没有LLM规划器的情况下独立导航，同时降低部署成本与延迟，且成功率显著提升。

title: A Modulation Strategy for Bidirectional Integrated Onboard and Wireless EV Charging
comment: 7 pages, 9 figures. Accepted version of a paper presented at the 2026 IEEE Energy Conversion Congress and Expo (ECCE), Vancouver, Canada
summary: Integrated electric vehicle chargers reduce cost by sharing power conversion hardware between the onboard charger (OBC) and the wireless charger (WC). A previously proposed dual active bridge (DAB)-based OBC/WC shares the rectification stage between the OBC and WC; however, the modulation required to realize its wireless operation has not yet been reported. This paper details a modulation strategy that enables the operation of the integrated OBC/WC topology. Differential-mode operation is used for the OBC, and common-mode operation is used for the WC. In OBC mode, the shared full-bridge produces differential-mode voltage for wired power transfer while ideally generating zero common-mode voltage on the wireless charging path. In WC mode, the same full-bridge produces common-mode voltage for wireless power transfer while ideally generating zero differential-mode voltage on the onboard charging path. The method preserves conventional DAB phase-shift power control and enables bidirectional power transfer in wired and wireless charging modes without additional contactors. Design considerations for the OBC transformer and WC coils are derived based on the resulting square-wave voltage amplitudes. Offline PLECS simulations demonstrate power tracking and decoupled charger operation at $\pm$7.4 kW. Hardware-in-the-loop simulations using a PLECS RT Box and an external Texas Instruments microcontroller further validate the proposed modulation method.

AI.tldr: 该文针对已提出但缺乏调制的DAB型集成OBC/WC拓扑，提出差模/共模复用调制策略，实现有线与无线充电的解耦运行与双向功率传输，并通过PLECS与HIL验证7.4 kW下功率跟踪与解耦。
AI.motivation: 集成式充电器通过在OBC与无线充电器之间共享功率变换硬件来降低成本；已有基于DAB的OBC/WC共享整流级，但实现无线运行所需的调制策略尚未见报道，故需填补该空白。
AI.method: 提出使集成OBC/WC拓扑可运行的调制策略：OBC采用差模运行，共享全桥产生差模电压完成有线传输，同时理想情况下在无线路径上产生零共模电压；WC采用共模运行，同一全桥产生共模电压完成无线传输，同时理想情况下在有线路径上产生零差模电压。保留传统DAB移相功率控制，无需额外接触器即可实现双向功率传输；并依据所得方波电压幅值推导OBC变压器与WC线圈的设计准则。
AI.result: 离线PLECS仿真在±7.4 kW下展示了功率跟踪与充电器解耦运行；基于PLECS RT Box与外接TI微控制器的硬件在环（HIL）仿真进一步验证了所提调制方法。
AI.conclusion: 差模/共模复用调制可在不增加接触器的前提下实现集成OBC/WC的双向有线与无线充电，并保持DAB移相控制框架，仿真与HIL结果验证其有效性与解耦性。

title: Learning Motion-Appearance Coupling Priors for Solving Video Inverse Problems
summary: Reconstructing video from degraded measurements requires priors that capture both frame appearance and temporal dynamics. Many recent approaches combine pretrained image diffusion priors with motion guidance, sidestepping the costs of training large video models. Temporal consistency is often enforced via photometric losses or warping-based constraints, which implicitly assume that motion explains frame-to-frame or latent-to-latent changes up to small deviations, an assumption that fails under occlusions, lighting changes, and non-rigid deformation. In this paper, we propose to learn the coupling between motion and frame appearance as a generative prior. We learn the distribution of motion-induced appearance residuals with a conditional diffusion model and use it to regularize reconstruction in video inverse problems. Our motion-appearance prior acts as a plug-in regularizer for diffusion-based video reconstruction, preserving the benefits of image diffusion models while remaining compatible with existing appearance regularization techniques. Experiments on dynamic video inverse problems show that reconstruction with a learnt motion-appearance coupling prior outperforms photometric-consistency and noise-warping baselines, and that the approach also transfers to cardiac MRI reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将"运动-外观耦合"作为生成式先验，用条件扩散模型学习运动诱导的外观残差分布，作为即插即用正则项用于扩散式视频逆问题重建，在动态视频逆问题与心脏MRI重建上优于光度一致性和噪声-warping基线。
AI.motivation: 从退化观测重建视频需要同时刻画帧外观与时序动态的先验。现有方法多将预训练图像扩散先验与运动引导结合，以避免训练大型视频模型的开销，但时序一致性通常依赖光度损失或warping约束，这些方法隐含假设"运动可在小偏差内解释帧间或潜空间的变化"，该假设在遮挡、光照变化和非刚性形变下失效。
AI.method: 将运动与帧外观之间的耦合学习为生成式先验：用条件扩散模型学习运动诱导的外观残差分布，并将其作为正则项引入视频逆问题的扩散重建过程。该先验作为插件式正则器，保留图像扩散模型的优势，同时与现有外观正则化技术兼容。
AI.result: 在动态视频逆问题实验中，使用所学习的运动-外观耦合先验的重建效果优于光度一致性基线和noise-warping基线；此外该方法还能迁移到心脏MRI重建任务。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模运动-外观残差的生成分布，比基于光度一致性或warping的隐式假设更稳健，可作为通用插件正则器提升扩散式视频重建质量，并具备跨域（医学成像）的可迁移性。

title: Stack more levels: how to get general and human-like Mario playing
summary: Super Mario Bros. is widely used in game AI and procedural content generation (PCG), yet it remains unclear whether a model-free agent can reliably win unseen levels. To address this question, we train Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agents on increasingly large sets of PCG-generated Mario levels and evaluate their generalization on 1000 held-out test levels. We then shape competent PPO policies into three gameplay archetypes---runner, killer, and collector. Finally, we fine-tune these PPO policies using Diffusion-Reward Adversarial Imitation Learning (DRAIL) with human gameplay demonstrations. We find that increasing the number of distinct PCG-generated training levels generally improves unseen-level performance, and that fine-tuning PPO policies with DRAIL increases action-level human-likeness while preserving much of the persona induced by PPO pretraining.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究无模型智能体能否稳定通关未见过的《超级马里奥兄弟》关卡，考察训练关卡数量对泛化能力的影响，并将PPO策略塑造成三种玩法原型后，用DRAIL结合人类演示进行微调，兼顾拟人性与策略个性。
AI.motivation: 《超级马里奥兄弟》广泛应用于游戏AI与程序化内容生成（PCG），但无模型智能体能否可靠通关未见过关卡尚不明确；同时智能体行为的人类拟人性与玩法风格可控性也缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 在规模递增的PCG生成马里奥关卡集合上训练PPO智能体，并在1000个留出测试关卡上评估泛化；再将表现良好的PPO策略塑形为runner、killer、collector三种玩法原型；最后使用Diffusion-Reward Adversarial Imitation Learning（DRAIL）结合人类游戏演示对这些策略进行微调。
AI.result: 增加PCG生成的不同训练关卡数量总体上提升未见关卡上的表现；用DRAIL微调PPO策略可提高动作层面的人类拟人性，同时保留大部分由PPO预训练所塑造的玩法个性。
AI.conclusion: 训练关卡多样性是提升泛化性能的有效手段，DRAIL微调能在不大幅牺牲策略风格个性的前提下增强行为拟人性，为实现既像人又具个体风格的关卡智能体提供了可行路径。

title: MechBench: A Domain-Specific LLM Benchmark for Parallel Mechanisms
summary: Parallel mechanisms pose distinctive challenges to large language models (LLMs), as valid reasoning depends jointly on mechanism topology, loop closure, geometry, joint types, and modeling assumptions. Yet existing LLM benchmarks provide little systematic coverage of such domain-specific knowledge, constraint-sensitive analysis, and constructive design. To fill this gap, we introduce MECHBENCH, a 2,541-question benchmark for evaluating LLMs in parallel mechanisms across professional knowledge, mechanism analysis, and design. MECHBENCH contains standard and challenge tiers spanning six capability categories and nine executable analysis and design tasks. It is constructed through MECHFORGE, a domain-grounded framework that combines expert-organized knowledge, LLM-assisted question generation, programmatic instance generation, two-stage expert review, and task-aware scoring with exact matching, rubric-based evaluation, and program verification. We further develop MECHGPT as a diagnostic domain-adapted model. Experiments show that strong knowledge performance does not directly translate into executable mechanism reasoning: leading closed-service models achieve over 95 on the standard tier but only 47-60 on the challenge tier, while domain adaptation substantially improves MechGPT over its Qwen3-8B baselines but leaves a large gap in constrained analysis and design. These results establish MECHBENCH as a systematic testbed for measuring domain-specific LLM capabilities in mechanism science.

AI.tldr: 提出MECHBENCH——面向并联机构的2,541题LLM评测基准，覆盖专业知识、机构分析与设计；并构建领域自适应诊断模型MechGPT。结果显示知识问答高分不等于可执行推理，挑战层得分仅47-60。
AI.motivation: 并联机构的有效推理需同时依赖拓扑结构、闭环约束、几何、关节类型与建模假设，而现有LLM基准缺乏对这类领域知识、约束敏感分析与构造性设计的系统覆盖，导致难以衡量模型在机构学中的真实能力。
AI.method: 构建MECHBENCH基准（2,541题），分标准层与挑战层，涵盖6类能力、9项可执行的机构分析与设计任务；通过MECHFORGE框架生成，整合专家组织知识、LLM辅助出题、程序化实例生成、两阶段专家审核，以及任务感知评分（精确匹配、评分量规、程序验证）。另以领域自适应训练得到诊断模型MechGPT。
AI.result: 领先的闭源服务模型在标准层得分超95，但在挑战层仅47–60；MechGPT较其Qwen3-8B基座显著提升，但在约束条件下的分析与设计任务上仍存在明显差距。
AI.conclusion: MECHBENCH为机构学领域特定LLM能力提供了系统化测试平台，揭示"知识表现"与"可执行机构推理"之间的脱节，指明约束敏感分析与构造性设计是当前模型的主要短板。

title: Direct-Ink-Writing of Soft Thin Film Force-Sensitive Resistors with Velostat and Printed-Carbon Sensing Elements
comment: 12 pages, 18 figures, to be published in: IEEE Sensors
summary: Flexible resistive force sensors are useful for wearable, rehabilitation, and human--machine interfaces, but their performance depends on sensing-material architecture and fabrication. This work presents a parameterized Voltera NOVA-based direct-ink-writing workflow using printed silver electrodes with multilayer Velostat sensing elements on PET and TPU substrates, together with an exploratory fully printed carbon architecture. Velostat sensors containing 1, 2, 4, and 6 sensing layers exhibited strongly nonlinear force--voltage responses, with the greatest sensitivity at low forces. Best-fit straight-line $R^2$ values ranged from 0.475 to 0.641, area-based hysteresis from 3.90\% to 7.47\%, and 5-min voltage drift from 1.9\% to 7.3\%, with no consistent monotonic relationship between layer count and these metrics. Selected PET6 and TPU6 devices showed less than 0.05~V change in peak output between the first and final 100 cycles of a 10,000-cycle test. Printed-carbon devices demonstrated the feasibility of a more fully printed architecture, but configurations with six or fewer layers saturated below approximately 0.5~N or were nonfunctional, while the eight-layer device responded primarily below approximately 2~N. These results establish the feasibility of the printed-electrode Velostat workflow while identifying printed sensing materials as a key area for further development.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于Voltera NOVA直写打印的参数化柔性电阻式力传感器制备流程（打印银电极+多层Velostat敏感层，PET/TPU基底），并探索全打印碳体系；多层器件呈强非线性响应，低力量程灵敏度最高，线性拟合R² 0.475–0.641、迟滞3.90%–7.47%、5分钟漂移1.9%–7.3%，层数与指标无单调关系；PET6与TPU6在10,000次循环测试中首末100次峰值输出变化<0.05 V；碳器件可行性得到验证但层数≤6时约0.5 N以下饱和或失效，8层仅响应至约2 N，表明打印敏感材料是后续开发重点。
AI.motivation: 柔性电阻式力传感器在可穿戴、康复及人机接口中具有应用价值，但其性能高度依赖敏感材料结构与制备工艺；现有工作缺乏可参数化的打印流程与对多层结构、基底及全打印方案的量化比较，因此需要建立可复现的直写打印工艺并系统评估其传感性能与局限。
AI.method: 采用Voltera NOVA直写打印（DIW）参数化工作流：在PET与TPU基底上打印银电极，叠层1/2/4/6层Velostat敏感单元；另探索全打印碳基架构。对器件进行力—电压响应、线性度（最佳拟合直线R²）、迟滞（面积法）、短时电压漂移（5 min）及10,000次循环耐久性测试，并比较层数与基底的影响。
AI.result: 器件呈强非线性力—电压响应，低力区灵敏度最高；R²为0.475–0.641，面积迟滞3.90%–7.47%，5分钟电压漂移1.9%–7.3%，且层数与上述指标无一致单调关系。PET6与TPU6样品在10,000次循环中首末100次的峰值输出变化小于0.05 V，循环稳定性良好。全打印碳器件验证了架构可行性，但≤6层配置在约0.5 N以下即饱和或失效，8层器件主要响应范围约在2 N以下，量程与一致性不足。
AI.conclusion: 研究验证了打印电极+Velostat敏感层的直写打印流程可行，并能获得较好的循环稳定性；但打印敏感材料（尤其是全打印碳体系）在量程、线性度与一致性方面仍需重点改进，是后续研究的关键方向。

title: Survivability Guarantees for Delayed Serial Supply Chains under Demand Shocks
summary: When demand exceeds the maximum production capacity of a supply chain, it can be satisfied only for a finite time, determined by the inventory stored along the chain. Existing control methods ensure indefinite constraint satisfaction under bounded demand, but provide no guarantees on how long a supply chain can withstand a shock in which demand goes beyond production capacity. We address this gap for a serial supply chain with transportation delays and flow constraints. Under a specified flow policy, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions on the inventory distribution that guarantee a prescribed lower bound on the exit time from the set where demand is served. We use these conditions to compute inventory targets that minimize holding costs via a quadratic program. Then, we propose a two-mode controller that builds reserves under ordinary demand and depletes them during the shock. Simulations illustrate this approach.

AI.tldr: 本文针对运输延迟与流量约束的串行供应链，推导库存分布的充要条件以保证"需求超过产能"冲击下的最低可服务时长（exit time 下界），并用二次规划求最小持有成本的库存目标，提出双模式控制器在平常期积累储备、冲击期消耗储备。
AI.motivation: 现有控制方法只在有界需求下保证约束的永久满足，无法回答"当需求超过最大产能时，供应链凭沿线库存能支撑多久"这一问题，缺乏对冲击持续时间的定量保证。
AI.method: 对带运输延迟和流量约束的串行供应链，在给定流量策略下，推导库存分布的充要条件以保障指定的 exit time 下界；据此以二次规划计算最小化持有成本的库存目标；并设计双模式控制器：常规需求下建立储备，冲击期间释放储备。
AI.result: 给出库存分布的充要条件与对应的库存目标优化方法（二次规划），并通过仿真验证双模式控制器在冲击下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将"无限期约束满足"扩展为"有限时间内可服务保证"，为供应链韧性提供可计算的库存设计与控制方案。

title: IncR-3DSGG: Incremental Posed RGB Image Based 3D Scene Graph Generation via Privileged Depth Supervision
summary: Scene graphs provide a compact, structured representation of environments by capturing objects and their spatial or semantic relationships in a form suitable for embodied agents. Existing 3D scene graph generation methods often rely on depth sensing at inference, either to associate object instances across views via point cloud overlap or to compute inter-object relations from geometric cues, limiting deployment to platforms with depth sensors. We propose IncR-3DSGG, which builds 3D scene graphs incrementally from posed\footnote{RGB images with camera extrinsics estimated by an off-the-shelf visual SLAM system.} RGB images, eliminating the use of depth sensors at inference. Our method leverages a Parametric Relation Predictor (PRP) that learns to estimate pairwise distances and relative angles between objects from 2D visual features and 2D geometric cues, using 3D geometric supervision available only during training. These learned pairwise measurements are fused across views through Pose Graph Optimization (PGO)~\cite{grisetti2010tutorial} to recover metrically grounded 3D object positions and build a globally consistent 3D scene graph incrementally. On the real-world 3RScan~\cite{wald2019rio} dataset, our method attains $52.2$ mean object recall and $30.8$ mean predicate recall under the 3DSSG~\cite{wald2020learning} evaluation protocol, against $27.0$ and $17.6$ for MonoSSG~\cite{wu2023incremental}, while using no depth or reconstructed geometry at inference. This shows that relations and metrically grounded 3D object representations can be predicted from posed RGB images alone.

AI.tldr: 提出IncR-3DSGG，仅用带位姿RGB图像增量构建3D场景图，推理时不依赖深度传感器。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景图生成方法在推理时依赖深度传感，用于跨视图实例关联或几何关系计算，限制了在无深度传感器平台上的部署。
AI.method: 用现成视觉SLAM估计相机外参的带位姿RGB图像；设计参数化关系预测器（PRP），从2D视觉特征与2D几何线索学习估计物体间成对距离与相对角度，仅在训练时使用3D几何监督；通过位姿图优化（PGO）跨视图融合成对测量，恢复度量尺度下的3D物体位置，增量构建全局一致的3D场景图。
AI.result: 在真实数据集3RScan上，按3DSSG评测协议取得52.2平均物体召回率和30.8平均谓词召回率，显著优于MonoSSG的27.0和17.6，且推理时未使用深度或重建几何。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭带位姿RGB图像即可预测物体关系并获得度量尺度的3D物体表示，从而增量构建3D场景图，摆脱推理阶段的深度传感器依赖。

title: Turning Multi-Agent Communication into Token-Level Credit with On Policy Self Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning improves problem solving in large language model multi-agent systems. Existing approaches overlook communication knowledge or compress it into scalar rewards, leaving coarse credit with little guidance on which decisions each agent should reinforce or revise. OPSD4MAS converts future communication into fine-grained token-level credit through On Policy Self Distillation (OPSD). An external model extracts facts and assesses their trajectory relations for coarse-grained filtering, followed by fine-grained leave-one-out filtering of target-token influence against agent-wise outcome advantages. The fact-conditioned policy supplies token-level credit, combined with GRPO through a linearly annealed joint objective. Our method improves mathematical pass@4 over GRPO by up to 20.00 percentage points. Ablations support complete filtering, while frozen-history injection diagnostics support fact utility. Together, these results support combining agent-level outcome guidance with communication-derived token-level credit. Code is available at https://github.com/Camel-Prince/OPSD4MAS.

AI.tldr: OPSD4MAS 将多智能体之间的通信内容转化为 token 级细粒度信用，用于强化学习中的信用分配。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 多智能体强化学习方法忽略通信知识，或将其压缩为标量奖励，导致信用粒度过粗，无法指导各智能体应强化或修正哪些具体决策。
AI.method: 采用 On-Policy Self Distillation（OPSD）：先用外部模型抽取事实并评估其轨迹关系进行粗粒度过滤，再以留一法（leave-one-out）对目标 token 影响结合各智能体结果优势做细粒度过滤；由事实条件化策略提供 token 级信用，与 GRPO 通过线性退火的联合目标结合。
AI.result: 数学任务 pass@4 相较 GRPO 最高提升 20.00 个百分点；消融实验支持完整过滤流程的必要性，冻结历史注入诊断支持事实的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明将智能体级结果引导与通信衍生的 token 级信用相结合是有效的信用分配范式。

title: Breath-Dx: A Time Series Classification Benchmark for Disease Screening with eNose
comment: IEEE ICDM 2026 - Best Paper Runner-Up (Applied Track)
summary: Electronic nose (eNose) technology offers a portable, non-invasive route for disease screening via exhaled breath analysis. However, progress in the field is hindered by the lack of systematic benchmarks that compare machine learning methods under realistic conditions, particularly sensor drift, a known but rarely quantified failure mode. Most existing studies rely on small, private datasets with inconsistent protocols, rendering results non-comparable and slowing progress. We introduce Breath-Dx, the first comprehensive benchmark of time series classification methods for breath-based disease screening. Our work leverages the Scent of Health (S-OH) dataset, the largest public clinical eNose collection to date, comprising 1,234 patients across nine diagnostic groups, each providing a 17-channel multivariate time series with explicit temporal train/test splits that account for sensor drift. We systematically evaluate 10 methods spanning four families: feature-based tabular learners, convolution-based models, graph-based, and time series architectures. All methods degrade significantly under temporal validation (0.05-0.12 AUC drop compared to random cross-validation), confirming that drift embeds a strong temporal signal. Under this realistic evaluation, the best methods achieve ROC AUC of 0.74-0.76 for some lung conditions, though others remain near chance. Recurrent architectures show the most consistent performance across diseases, while specialized time series methods achieve the highest peak results. Demographic confounders matter: breath signals provide independent diagnostic value for some conditions but add little beyond age for others. We release the S-OH dataset, all temporal splits, evaluation protocols, and code to enable reproducible research and accelerate progress in clinical breathomics.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Breath-Dx——首个面向呼气式疾病筛查的时间序列分类综合基准，基于迄今最大公开临床电子鼻数据集S-OH（1,234名患者、9个诊断组、17通道多元时间序列，含显式时间划分以刻画传感器漂移），系统评测了四大类共10种方法，揭示了漂移导致的时间泛化衰减及不同模型家族的适用差异。
AI.motivation: 电子鼻呼气分析为疾病筛查提供便携、无创途径，但领域缺乏在真实条件下系统比较机器学习方法的基准。现有研究多依赖小型私有数据集与不一致的实验协议，结果无法横向比较；传感器漂移这一已知失效模式更是鲜有量化，阻碍了领域进展。
AI.method: 构建Breath-Dx基准，基于S-OH公开临床电子鼻数据（1,234例、9个诊断组、17通道多元时间序列），采用显式时间训练/测试划分以模拟传感器漂移。系统评测4大类共10种方法：基于特征的表格学习器、卷积模型、图模型与专用时间序列架构，并与随机交叉验证进行对照，同时分析年龄等人口学混杂因素的影响。
AI.result: 所有方法在时间验证下均显著退化，AUC较随机交叉验证下降0.05–0.12，证实漂移中蕴含强时间信号。在真实评估下，部分肺部疾病的最佳方法ROC AUC为0.74–0.76，但另一些疾病接近随机水平。循环架构跨疾病的性能最稳定，专用时间序列方法取得最高峰值结果。呼吸信号对部分疾病具有独立诊断价值，对另一些疾病则相对年龄增量有限。
AI.conclusion: 传感器漂移是影响呼气诊断模型泛化的关键因素，必须以时间划分进行真实评估；不同模型家族在跨疾病场景下表现各异。作者公开S-OH数据集、全部时间划分、评测协议与代码，以支持可复现研究并推动临床呼气组学发展。

title: Robot Navigation and Obstacle Avoidance from Randomly Positioned External Cameras
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, accepted as a regular paper for the 2027 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration
summary: We study robot navigation in indoor environments from fixed exocentric cameras (infrastructure-mounted, external to the robot). We show that standard Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), which succeeds with onboard cameras, fails to learn this navigation end-to-end in our setup. This failure results from the perspective mismatch between exocentric observations and egocentric action and goal formulations, which is too complex to resolve from the reward signal alone. To address this, we propose Viewpoint-Invariant Navigation from Exocentric Cameras (VINE). VINE uses an obstacle map estimation network, trained with supervised learning, that takes exocentric images, camera pose, robot pose, and room dimensions as input and produces a viewpoint-invariant obstacle map. This map can be used either by a PPO policy or by a planner such as A*. VINE's map estimation performs better than perspective mapping approaches, handles cameras placed across a wide range of positions and orientations without view-specific tuning, requires only approximate camera pose estimates (noise with a standard deviation of 30cm per axis in x, y, and z and about 20° of rotation error on average), is robust to intrinsic variation, and extends to two-camera setups with partial coverage. Despite operating from cameras randomized in position during evaluation, VINE surpasses the navigation success rate of PPO with an onboard camera in simulated environments.

AI.tldr: 提出VINE：用监督学习将固定外视角相机图像映射为视角不变的障碍物地图，再交由PPO或A*规划，实现外视角相机下的室内机器人导航，成功率超过机载相机PPO基线。
AI.motivation: 标准PPO在机载相机下可端到端学会导航，但在固定外视角（exocentric）相机设置下失败。原因是外视角观测与以机器人为中心的动作、目标表述之间存在视角错配，仅靠奖励信号难以端到端解决该问题。
AI.method: VINE包含一个监督学习训练的障碍物地图估计网络，输入为外视角图像、相机位姿、机器人位姿和房间尺寸，输出视角不变的障碍物地图；该地图既可直接供PPO策略使用，也可供A*等规划器使用。
AI.result: 地图估计优于透视映射方法；支持相机位姿与朝向大范围变化而无需逐视角调参；仅需粗略相机位姿（x/y/z各轴30cm标准差噪声、平均约20°旋转误差）；对相机内参变化鲁棒；可扩展到部分覆盖的双相机设置；评估时相机位置随机化下，导航成功率仍超过机载相机PPO的仿真结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式的视角不变地图估计中间表示，VINE有效化解外视角观测与自中心动作/目标之间的错配，使固定外视角相机成为可行的室内导航方案。

title: CT-RespGeomLib: Deterministic reconstruction of CT airway masks into editable,port-matched lumen geometry
summary: Patient-specific airway modelling requires geometrically consistent lumen surfaces with identifiable boundaries and support for controlled anatomical modifications. We present CT-RespGeomLib, a deterministic framework that converts CT airway masks into two complementary representations: an editable assembly of semantically labelled pipe and junction blocks connected through canonical shared ports, and a fused lumen surface reconstructed from tapered implicit primitives with validated port-to-boundary loop correspondence. The parametric representation further enables localised modelling of airway stenosis and dilation without re-segmentation. Evaluated on 42 reference airway masks from ATM22 (15 cases) and AeroPath (27 cases), the framework produced 37 topologically accepted reconstructions, with a median port-to-loop distance of 0.123 mm across 2174 matched ports. Reconstructed and reference equivalent radii showed strong agreement ($R^2 = 0.976$), with a mean bias of -0.414 mm arising primarily from the circular, inscribed-radius representation. Controlled pathology modelling generated 40 variants across five patient-specific geometries, including 25-75% stenosis and 50% dilation at tracheal and main-bronchus locations. Prescribed radius changes were reproduced with a mean absolute ratio error of 0.0056, while the median 95th-percentile deviation outside the modified region was 0.111 mm. Downstream applicability was demonstrated through volume meshing and an OpenFOAM simulation with individually prescribed model-based resistance conditions at 62 outlets. Although additional surface preparation may be required for numerical meshing, CT-RespGeomLib provides a reproducible framework for CT-derived airway reconstruction, quantitative boundary validation and controlled geometric pathology modelling.

AI.tldr: CT-RespGeomLib 是一个确定性框架，可从 CT 气道掩膜生成两种互补表示：语义标注的管道/连接块可编辑装配体（通过规范共享端口连接）与由锥形隐式基元融合重建的管腔表面（端口—边界环对应经验证），并支持无需重新分割的局部狭窄/扩张建模。
AI.motivation: 患者特异性气道建模要求管腔表面几何一致、边界可识别，并支持受控的解剖学修改；现有流程难以同时满足可编辑性、边界验证与参数化病理建模。
AI.method: 将 CT 气道掩膜转换为管道与连接块组成的语义化装配体及融合管腔表面；采用锥形隐式基元重建表面，并验证端口到边界环的对应关系；基于参数化表示对狭窄/扩张进行局部建模；在 ATM22（15 例）与 AeroPath（27 例）共 42 例参考掩膜上评估，并进行体网格生成与 OpenFOAM 模拟。
AI.result: 42 例中 37 例重建在拓扑上被接受；2174 个匹配端口的端口—环距离中位数 0.123 mm；等效半径与参考高度一致（R² = 0.976），平均偏差 −0.414 mm，主要源于圆形内切半径表示；5 个患者几何生成 40 个变异（25–75% 狭窄、50% 扩张）；处方半径变化的平均绝对比值误差 0.0056，修改区外第 95 百分位偏差中位数 0.111 mm；在 62 个出口施加基于模型的个体化阻力条件完成 OpenFOAM 模拟。
AI.conclusion: CT-RespGeomLib 为 CT 气道重建、定量边界验证与受控几何病理建模提供了可复现框架，但用于数值网格化时可能仍需额外表面处理。

title: Verifier Choice is a Benchmark Design Variable: Auditing Structural Counting Evaluation in Text-to-Image Models
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 24 pages. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/neurips2026-ed443/audit-release . Code: https://github.com/AzusaCat1111/verifier-choice-audit
summary: Automatic evaluation is now central to text-to-image benchmarking, but the verifier that converts generated images into scores is often treated as an implementation detail. We argue that this is unsafe: an automatic benchmark score is a property of the image generator, prompt distribution, verifier, verifier-use protocol, and scoring rule, not of the generator alone. We study this issue in structural counting, a controlled setting where human-visible counts can be audited. We construct a verifier-centric audit suite over seven counting objects: cell phones, chairs, and traffic lights for object counting, and clover leaflets, dresser drawer fronts, power-strip sockets, and turbine blades for substructure counting. Across 6,240 generated images from Qwen-Image-2512 and FLUX.2-dev, we compare open MLLM verifiers under count-only, reject-aware, zero-shot and few-shot protocols, plus TIFA-like target queries, a detector baseline, and frontier closed-model checks on two hard objects. On a balanced 2,280-image evaluation split, aggregate score matching can coexist with image-level disagreement, and verifier-use protocols and generator distributions change the measured reliability. Every verifier-protocol configuration also shrinks the human score difference between the two generators, by 7.5-25.0 pp, and with a third generator, Z-Image, all four tested protocols reverse the human ordering of Z-Image and FLUX.2-dev on our fixed prompt suite. GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7 checks do not remove the failure modes: GPT-5.5 still has only 59.92% clover valid-count fidelity, while Claude Opus 4.7 has lower same-slice agreement ($κ=0.432$). We propose reporting automatic benchmark scores with a factorized verifier reliability profile: aggregate score gap, image-level agreement, generator-comparison distortion, valid-image count fidelity, rejection behavior, output compliance, and directional bias.

AI.tldr: 自动评测中的"验证器"并非实现细节，而是基准分数的组成部分；在结构计数任务上，验证器与使用协议会系统性地压缩乃至反转生成器之间的人类判定排序。
AI.motivation: 文生图基准普遍以自动评分为核心，但把图像转成分数的验证器视为可忽略的实现细节。作者认为这不安全：基准分数是生成器、提示分布、验证器、验证器使用协议与评分规则的联合属性，而非生成器单独的属性。选择结构计数作为可控场景，因为其计数可由人工审计。
AI.method: 构建以验证器为中心的审计套件，覆盖七类计数对象：物体计数（手机、椅子、红绿灯）与子结构计数（三叶草小叶、梳妆台抽屉面板、插排插孔、涡轮叶片）。基于 Qwen-Image-2512 与 FLUX.2-dev 生成的 6,240 张图像，比较开放 MLLM 验证器在 count-only、reject-aware、zero-shot、few-shot 四种协议下的表现，并加入 TIFA 式目标查询、检测器基线与两个困难对象上的前沿闭源模型核查；在平衡的 2,280 张评测划分上进行图像级分析。
AI.result: 聚合分数匹配可与图像级不一致并存；协议与生成器分布会改变测得可靠性。所有验证器-协议组合都使两生成器间的人类分差缩小 7.5–25.0 个百分点；加入第三生成器 Z-Image 后，四种协议均在固定提示集上反转 Z-Image 与 FLUX.2-dev 的人类排序。GPT-5.5 与 Claude Opus 4.7 的核查未消除失效模式：GPT-5.5 三叶草有效计数保真度仅 59.92%，Claude Opus 4.7 同切片一致性更低（κ=0.432）。
AI.conclusion: 自动基准分数不可脱离验证器解读。作者提出以"因子化验证器可靠性画像"报告分数，包含：聚合分数差距、图像级一致性、生成器比较失真、有效图像计数保真度、拒答行为、输出合规性与方向性偏差七个维度。

title: One Fuzzer, Many Reasoners: Adaptive Neuro-Symbolic Fuzzing with Reliability-Calibrated and Context-Gated Guidance
summary: Neural-symbolic AI (NSAI) combines learned perception with programs, constraints, and compositional reasoning, but remains difficult to test because small semantics-preserving changes can alter grounded symbols and trigger discontinuous reasoning failures. Existing neural fuzzers mainly rely on neural coverage or representation-space feedback and do not provide a common testing interface for heterogeneous NSAI systems. We introduce NSAI-Fuzz, a unified semantics-aware fuzzing framework that separates task-specific valid mutation from architecture-neutral guided search and represents each candidate using five availability-aware, rank-normalized risk signals: boundary pressure, grounding uncertainty, representation drift, constraint violation, and archive novelty. We further propose Reliability-Calibrated Weighting (RCW), which learns dataset-model-level signal allocations from calibrated reliability, and Contextual Signal Gating (CSG), which adapts signal weights to the current candidate pool. We evaluate four NSAI systems across four reasoning tasks, nine compatible dataset-model cells, 20 policies, and 1,800 on-policy runs. Fixed five-signal guidance outperforms Random and Uniform in every cell, while RCW and CSG further improve over Fixed in all nine cells. Under matched mutation and query budgets, RCW and CSG achieve 16.17% and 16.06% aggregate failure discovery, compared with 6.06% for the strongest neural-fuzzing baseline. Wall-clock evaluation further shows that TensorFuzz requires 1.11x the runtime of RCW while achieving only 0.45x its failure throughput. These results show that effective and efficient fuzzing of heterogeneous NSAI systems benefits from a common neural-symbolic risk interface with adaptive signal allocation.

AI.tldr: 提出NSA I-Fuzz统一语义感知模糊测试框架，将任务相关变异与架构无关引导搜索解耦，用五种可用性感知的风险信号并按可靠性校准加权（RCW）与上下文信号门控（CSG）自适应分配权重；在4个NSAI系统、4类推理任务、9个数据集-模型单元、20种策略、1800次在线运行中，RCW/CSG聚合故障发现率约16%，显著优于最强神经模糊测试基线的6.06%。
AI.motivation: 神经符号AI（NSAI）将学习式感知与程序、约束、组合推理结合，但语义保持的小改动即可改变落地符号并引发不连续的推理失败，测试困难。现有神经模糊测试器依赖神经覆盖或表示空间反馈，缺乏面向异构NSAI系统的通用测试接口。
AI.method: NSA I-Fuzz框架：分离任务特定的有效变异与架构中立的引导搜索；每个候选样本用五个可用性感知、秩归一化风险信号表示——边界压力、落地不确定性、表示漂移、约束违反、归档新颖性。并提出可靠性校准加权（RCW），从校准可靠性学习数据集-模型级信号分配；以及上下文信号门控（CSG），按当前候选池自适应调整信号权重。
AI.result: 固定五信号引导在所有9个单元中均优于Random与Uniform；RCW与CSG在全部9个单元中进一步优于Fixed。在匹配变异与查询预算下，RCW与CSG聚合故障发现率分别为16.17%与16.06%，最强神经模糊测试基线为6.06%。Wall-clock评估显示TensorFuzz运行时间为RCW的1.11倍，故障吞吐仅为RCW的0.45倍。
AI.conclusion: 对异构NSAI系统的有效且高效模糊测试，有赖于统一的神经符号风险接口与自适应信号分配机制。

title: A Modified Glicko Model for Rating Soccer Clubs and National Teams Worldwide
summary: Comparing soccer teams that rarely or never meet is a fundamental challenge in sports analytics: clubs play mostly within their national leagues, and national teams within their confederations. We propose a rating framework that places clubs and national teams worldwide on a common probabilistic scale. Building on a recent extension of Glicko with order effects and strength-dependent draw probabilities, we adapt the model to soccer with goal-scoring adjustments, a decomposition of home advantage, extra time, league-aware rating initialization and rules of promotion and relegation that do not inflate the levels of leagues; national teams start from the levels of their confederations. The models are evaluated on about 1.2 million club matches of 252 leagues from 166 countries (2000-2026) and 12.6 thousand national team matches (1998-2026). On held-out seasons, the modified Glicko model is clearly more accurate than Elo and as accurate as score-matrix models built on the goal expectations of a gradient boosting model, including the Dixon-Coles and Markov chain models, while it is substantially more accurate in international club matches. Averaging the predictions of the rating model and the Markov chain model is more accurate than either model alone. For national teams, the model is significantly more accurate than all baselines, especially in the final tournaments, where teams of different confederations meet. The resulting ratings are interpretable and can be used for player evaluation, transfer analysis and match forecasting. The match data, the ratings and the code are publicly available at https://github.com/andreyshelopugin/SportsRatings

AI.tldr: 提出一个统一的概率评分框架，将全球俱乐部与国家队置于同一可比尺度，基于扩展Glicko模型（含次序效应与强度相关平局概率），在约120万场俱乐部赛事和1.26万场国家队赛事上验证，准确率优于Elo、与基于梯度提升期望进球的比分矩阵模型（Dixon-Coles、马尔可夫链）相当，国际俱乐部赛事与国家队赛事中显著更优。
AI.motivation: 足球中俱乐部多在本国联赛内交手、国家队多在本大洲内交手，跨联赛/跨大洲球队几乎不交锋，缺乏可比的实力基准，导致跨体系球队的实力比较成为体育分析的 fundamental 难题。
AI.method: 在近期带次序效应和强度依赖平局概率的 Glicko 扩展基础上改造：引入进球数调整；分解主场优势；考虑加时赛；联赛感知的评分初始化；升降级规则不虚增联赛层级评分；国家队以所属大洲联合会的水平为起点。数据为252个联赛、166国约120万场俱乐部比赛（2000–2026）与1.26万场国家队比赛（1998–2026），在留出赛季上评估。
AI.result: 留出赛季上，改进Glicko明显优于Elo，与基于GBM进球期望构建的Dixon-Coles及马尔可夫链比分矩阵模型精度相当，在国际俱乐部比赛中大幅更优；评分模型与马尔可夫链模型预测平均后精度高于任一单一模型；国家队方面显著优于全部基线，尤其在跨大洲球队相遇的决赛圈阶段。所得评分具可解释性，可用于球员评估、转会分析与比赛预测。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为全球俱乐部与国家队提供了统一、可解释的概率化实力尺度，精度优于Elo并可与更复杂的比分矩阵模型媲美，集成后可进一步提升；数据、评分与代码已开源。

title: Hibikino-Musashi@Home 2026 Team Description Paper
summary: This paper presents an overview of the integrated technologies developed for the Open Platform League at RoboCup@Home 2026 in Incheon. A vision system integrated with learning-based, training-free models enables robust object recognition for both known and unknown objects. We introduce a RoomPlan-based method that semi-automatically registers furniture geometry and labels to generate semantic maps. Additionally, a large language model-based planner interprets the instructions recognized by Whisper and generates primitive skill sequences for execution. A reservoir-computing framework serves as a lightweight temporal-processing model for action recognition. Its field-programmable gate array-based implementation enables low-power, real-time operation. This is key to removing operational time constraints for service robots. Open-source releases, including task environments, dataset tools, and navigation frameworks, enhance reproducibility, reuse, and continuous progress within the RoboCup@Home community.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了为2026年仁川RoboCup@Home公开平台联赛开发的集成技术栈，涵盖视觉识别、语义建图、语言规划、时序动作识别与开源工具。
AI.motivation: 服务机器人在RoboCup@Home场景中需在有限时间与功耗约束下完成识别、建图、指令理解与动作执行，各模块间缺乏可复现、可复用的集成方案，尤其是长时间运行时序处理带来的时间约束问题。
AI.method: 提出多模块集成系统：基于学习且免训练的视觉模型实现已知与未知物体的鲁棒识别；基于RoomPlan的方法半自动注册家具几何与标签以生成语义地图；基于大语言模型的规划器解析Whisper识别的语音指令并生成基础技能序列；采用储备池计算（reservoir computing）作为轻量级时序处理模型进行动作识别，并部署于FPGA实现低功耗实时运行；同时开源任务环境、数据集工具与导航框架。
AI.result: 系统在已知/未知物体识别上具备鲁棒性，实现语义地图的半自动构建，端到端由语音指令驱动技能序列执行；FPGA上的储备池计算实现低功耗、实时动作识别，从而解除服务机器人的运行时长约束；开源资源提升了社区的可复现性与复用性。
AI.conclusion: 该集成技术栈与开源发布为RoboCup@Home公开平台联赛提供了可复现、可持续迭代的技术基线，其中硬件加速的轻量时序模型是突破服务机器人运行时间限制的关键。

title: An Integrated Architecture for Data-Efficient Real-Time Neural Imitation of Nonlinear Time-Optimal Model Predictive Control
summary: Nonlinear time-optimal model predictive control (TOMPC) enables highly performant control of constrained systems, but its computational cost prohibits real-time use on fast dynamical systems. Neural network imitation of the TOMPC control law can reduce online computational costs, yet existing work mostly targets quadratic cost formulations in simulation and addresses the challenges of neural controllers in isolation. This work imitates a long-horizon nonconvex TOMPC with hard terminal constraints, whose high computational cost limits training-data generation. We present (i) \emph{self-informed sampling (SIFS)}, a data-efficient expert-sampling strategy that uses a learned time-to-go to query the expert only where the policy deviates from time-optimal behavior, (ii) a complete training and control architecture that jointly addresses dataset correlation, suboptimal expert labels, covariate shift, constraint satisfaction and model mismatch, and (iii) real-world validation on a Furuta pendulum. SIFS matches standard dataset aggregation performance in roughly one-third of the training time and with less than half the training data. The resulting controller matches the region of attraction of the expert TOMPC while raising the control frequency from 1.4~Hz to 1~kHz. On hardware, the controller swings up and stabilizes the pendulum along trajectories closely matching the expert TOMPC solution.

AI.tldr: 该文用神经网络模仿长时域、带硬终端约束的非凸时间最优MPC（TOMPC），提出自知情采样SIFS与完整训练/控制架构，在Furuta摆上实现与专家相当的最大吸引域，并把控制频率从1.4 Hz提升到1 kHz。
AI.motivation: 非线性TOMPC性能优越但计算开销大，难以用于快速动态系统的实时控制；用神经网络模仿控制律可降低在线成本，但现有工作多局限于仿真中的二次代价形式，且孤立处理神经控制器的各项挑战。长时域非凸TOMPC加硬终端约束导致训练数据生成成本极高。
AI.method: (i) 自知情采样SIFS：利用学习到的time-to-go，仅在策略偏离时间最优行为的区域查询专家，实现数据高效专家采样；(ii) 完整的训练与控制架构，联合处理数据集相关性、专家标签次优、协变量偏移、约束满足与模型失配；(iii) 在Furuta摆上进行实机验证。
AI.result: SIFS以约三分之一的训练时间和不到一半的训练数据达到标准数据集聚合（DAgger类）的性能；所得控制器匹配专家TOMPC的吸引域，控制频率由1.4 Hz提升至约1 kHz；硬件上实现摆的起摆与镇定，轨迹与专家TOMPC解高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 面向非凸时间最优MPC的神经模仿在数据效率与实时性上可同时实现，且通过系统化的训练与控制架构设计可保证约束满足与鲁棒性，并在真实快动态系统上得到验证。

title: ThermalSplat: Generalizable Pose-Free Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View Thermal 3D Reconstruction
summary: Thermal infrared imaging is vital for applications like search-and-rescue and autonomous navigation, yet trans- lating it into 3D scene representations remains a critical bottleneck. The low-texture nature and view-dependent emissivity of thermal images cause standard pose estima- tors to fail catastrophically, collapsing standard 3D Gaus- sian Splatting pipelines under sparse-view constraints. Fur- thermore, existing thermal reconstruction methods rely heavily on dense capture and computationally expensive per-scene optimization. Critically, many of these ap- proaches depend on aligned RGB-thermal datasets to ob- tain reliable camera poses and initial point clouds, ren- dering them unusable in purely thermal, unposed envi- ronments. To break this bottleneck, we present Thermal- Splat, the first generalizable, feed-forward Gaussian splat- ting framework that reconstructs 3D scenes directly from sparse thermal images without requiring known camera poses, RGB guidance, or per-scene training. We over- come thermal-specific challenges using a soft census loss for brightness-invariant structural matching and a bound- ary structure loss to explicitly supervise temperature discon- tinuities. Trained on an aggregated multi-source dataset, ThermalSplat synthesizes sharp reconstructions of unseen scenes in a single feed-forward pass. Extensive experi- ments demonstrate that ThermalSplat holds a strict advan- tage over scene-specific thermal splatting methods in the sparse regime. Furthermore, even compared against these baselines operating under their ideal dense capture set- tings, ThermalSplat achieves superior perceptual fidelity. By eliminating the need for computationally expensive per scene optimization, ThermalSplat offers an efficient and generalizable approach to thermal 3D reconstruction.

AI.tldr: ThermalSplat：首个直接从稀疏、无位姿热红外图像前馈重建3D高斯场景的可泛化框架，无需RGB引导或逐场景训练。
AI.motivation: 热红外成像在搜救与自主导航中很重要，但将其转为3D场景表示存在瓶颈：热图像低纹理、发射率视角相关，导致标准位姿估计器失效，并在稀疏视角下使3DGS管线崩溃；现有热重建方法依赖稠密采集和高成本逐场景优化，且多依赖对齐的RGB-热数据获取位姿与初始点云，无法用于纯热、无位姿环境。
AI.method: 提出前馈式高斯泼溅框架ThermalSplat：采用soft census loss实现亮度不变的结构匹配（应对低纹理与视角相关亮度），引入boundary structure loss显式监督温度不连续边界；在聚合的多源数据集上训练，单次前馈即重建未见场景。
AI.result: 稀疏条件下严格优于逐场景热泼溅方法；即便对手使用理想稠密采集设置，本方法仍取得更优的感知保真度。
AI.conclusion: 通过消除昂贵的逐场景优化，ThermalSplat为热3D重建提供了高效且可泛化的方案，突破了纯热、无位姿、稀疏视角的瓶颈。

title: Causals: An Open Knowledge Graph for Research on Causal Reasoning
summary: Applying causal knowledge to a new event requires connecting the event to relevant entities and the relationships through which its consequences may unfold. We present Causals, an open knowledge graph for research on this form of reasoning. Its initial release, constructed from news reports, contains 369,184 nodes and 1,272,418 edges linking reported events, organizations, commodities, financial instruments, and other entities. Structural relationships, observations, and attributed causal claims retain distinct semantics and links to source records. We describe the construction and representation of the resource and characterize its connectivity and multi-hop retrieval properties. Causals provides shared relational knowledge for studying how language models retrieve relevant context and apply mechanisms to particular events. The dataset is available under CC BY 4.0 at https://causals.org/, and we invite contributions to its ontology, records, and evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出 Causals，一个从新闻报道构建的开放因果知识图谱，含 369,184 个节点与 1,272,418 条边，连接事件、组织、商品、金融工具等实体，并区分结构关系、观测与归因因果断言三种语义。
AI.motivation: 将因果知识应用于新事件，需要把事件与相关实体及其后果展开所依赖的关系连接起来；现有资源缺乏共享的关系化因果知识，难以支撑语言模型检索相关上下文并对具体事件施加推理机制的研究。
AI.method: 初始版本由新闻报道构建；图中显式区分结构关系、观测记录与归因的因果断言三类语义，并保留指向原始来源记录的链接；随后对资源的连通性与多跳检索特性进行刻画分析。
AI.result: 发布含 369,184 个节点、1,272,418 条边的知识图谱，并给出其连通性与多跳检索性质的统计与评估；数据集以 CC BY 4.0 协议在 causals.org 公开。
AI.conclusion: Causals 为研究语言模型如何检索相关上下文、如何将机制应用于特定事件提供了共享的关系化因果知识基础，并开放邀请对本体、记录与证据的社区贡献。

title: Is the Importance Ratio Necessary for Stable Reinforcement Learning in LLMs?
comment: 21 pages, 11 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become central to post-training large language models (LLMs). However, popular RL methods like GRPO incur non-negligible overhead by computing both old-policy and current-policy likelihoods to form importance sampling ratios. In this work, we propose Likelihood-Gated Policy Optimization (LGPO), which enforces a soft trust region constraint via likelihood-based gating, eliminating the need to compute old-policy likelihoods. Empirically, we show that removing the importance sampling correction term does not harm training stability, whereas removing the trust region mechanism can lead to collapse. Moreover, ratio-based clipping can fail in fully on-policy training: the importance ratio stays at 1, so the ratio-based trust region constraint never activates. Under standard training settings where GRPO is stable, LGPO achieves comparable training stability and peak performance while reducing training time by ~18% on average relative to a standard implementation that recomputes old-policy likelihoods. In fully on-policy training, where GRPO fails, LGPO remains stable, enabling more efficient and robust LLM RL post-training across training regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出Likelihood-Gated Policy Optimization (LGPO)，用基于似然的门控实现软信任域约束，省去旧策略似然计算，在保持稳定性的同时平均减少约18%训练时间。
AI.motivation: GRPO等主流RL后训练方法需同时计算旧策略与当前策略的似然以构造重要性采样比，带来不可忽视的计算开销；且ratio-based clipping在完全on-policy训练中比值恒为1，信任域约束从未激活，导致GRPO失效乃至崩溃。
AI.method: LGPO以基于似然的门控施加软信任域约束，从而无需计算旧策略似然（去掉重要性采样修正项）。作者通过消融对比验证各组件作用：去除重要性采样修正项不影响稳定性，去除信任域机制则导致崩溃。
AI.result: 在GRPO稳定的标准训练设置下，LGPO达到相当的训练稳定性与峰值性能，并相对需要重算旧策略似然的标准实现平均缩短约18%训练时间；在GRPO失效的完全on-policy训练中，LGPO仍保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: LGPO提供了一种更高效、更鲁棒的LLM强化学习后训练方案，可跨不同训练范式适用。

title: Alloy: A Multi-Material Physics Engine for Robot Learning
summary: Robots handle much more than rigid objects: towels, cables, water, sand. The simulators used to train robots at scale are strongest on rigid bodies, and adding another material usually means a second engine and hand-written glue between the two. We present Alloy, an open-source physics engine for robot learning in which rigid robots, cloth, cables, liquids, granular material and soft bodies share one scene. Each object is described once; Alloy assigns it to a solver suited to its material, couples the solvers inside every control step, and runs the scene in many parallel worlds on one GPU, or on a CPU. Every world carries a health grade, to help tell a failure of the physics from a failure of the policy. Alloy is built on Newton, MuJoCo Warp and Warp, and it is written to be driven by coding agents: its documentation ships inside the package, every error names its fix, and the engine is exposed as tools over the Model Context Protocol. In a cold test, agents that had never seen Alloy installed a pre-release from the package index and trained policies for walking, cable handling and pouring on a single GPU. We also report how throughput grows with the number of worlds, depth-camera throughput, agreement with closed-form references, and a reliability test over a thousand worlds.

AI.tldr: Alloy 是一个面向机器人学习的开源物理引擎，让刚体机器人、布料、线缆、液体、颗粒与软体共享同一场景；它统一建模、按材料分配求解器并在每个控制步内耦合，支持单 GPU 大规模并行（或 CPU），并为每个世界提供"健康度"评分。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作对象远超刚体（毛巾、线缆、水、沙），而大规模训练用的仿真器以刚体最强；引入新材质通常意味着接入第二个引擎并手写两者之间的胶水代码，复杂度与不一致性高。同时，作者还希望引擎能被编码智能体直接驱动与使用。
AI.method: 1) 对象仅描述一次，引擎自动将其分配到适配其材料的求解器；2) 在每个控制步内对多个求解器进行耦合；3) 在单 GPU 上以多并行世界运行（亦支持 CPU）；4) 每个世界附带健康度评分（health grade），以区分物理失效与策略失效；5) 构建于 Newton、MuJoCo Warp 与 Warp 之上；6) 面向编码智能体设计：文档随包分发、错误信息给出修复方法、通过 Model Context Protocol 将引擎暴露为工具。
AI.result: 在冷启动测试中，此前从未接触过 Alloy 的智能体从包索引安装预发布版本，并在单 GPU 上训练出步行、线缆操作与倾倒三类策略；此外报告了吞吐量随世界数量的扩展性、深度相机吞吐、与闭式参考解的一致性，以及上千个世界的可靠性测试结果。
AI.conclusion: Alloy 以单一场景统一多材质仿真，免去多引擎拼接，具备大规模并行与可诊断性，并可作为智能体可调用工具链支撑端到端的策略训练，为机器人学习提供开源的多物理一体化仿真基础。

title: Control-Gibbs Distribution: Sampling for Optimal Control and Diverse Actions
summary: While conventional optimal control selects an optimal input sequence, probabilistic control assigns probability mass over all possible inputs and exploits a distribution of control sequences. Control distributions help enable exploration, capture diverse solutions, and solve deterministic optimal control problems. This work reviews an important probabilistic model for control distributions, the control-Gibbs distribution, i.e., the Gibbs distribution with an optimal control objective as the energy function. We point out its fundamental role in various probabilistic control frameworks, e.g., maximum entropy control, control-as-inference framework, model predictive path integral control, and energy-based models for control. This provides a model-central perspective to unify these probabilistic control frameworks. We also review the associated extensions of dynamic programming for computing closed-loop control distributions. To sample the control-Gibbs distribution, we consider projected Langevin sampling and develop non-asymptotic guarantees. The guarantees show the dual benefits of sampling the control-Gibbs distribution: obtaining diverse control solutions and solving the deterministic optimal control problem. We provide a numerical example where diverse arm trajectories are sampled from a control-Gibbs distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文以控制-Gibbs分布为核心统一模型，综述其在最大熵控制、控制即推断、模型预测路径积分控制和基于能量的控制中的基础作用，并给出投影Langevin采样的非渐近收敛保证。
AI.motivation: 传统最优控制只输出单一最优输入序列，而概率控制在所有可能输入上分配概率质量，可支持探索、刻画多样解并求解确定性最优控制问题。现有多种概率控制框架彼此割裂，缺乏统一的模型中心视角。
AI.method: 将最优控制目标作为能量函数构造控制-Gibbs分布，以此统一解释最大熵控制、控制即推断、模型预测路径积分控制及基于能量的控制框架；综述用于计算闭环控制分布的动态规划扩展；采用投影Langevin采样从该分布中采样，并建立非渐近收敛保证。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，采样控制-Gibbs分布具有双重收益：既能获得多样化的控制解，又能求解确定性最优控制问题；并给出一个数值算例，从控制-Gibbs分布中采样得到多组不同的机械臂轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 控制-Gibbs分布可作为概率控制框架的统一中心模型，投影Langevin采样在有限步内提供可证明的采样质量保证，从而兼顾多样性与最优性。

title: SteinPnP: Non-Parametric Uncertainty Quantification in the Perspective-N-Point Problem
summary: We propose SteinPnP, a probabilistic Perspective- N-Point (PnP) solver that models the full 6-DoF camera pose posterior using a non-parametric set of pose particles. By lever- aging Stein Variational Inference (SVI), SteinPnP combines the expressivity of particle-based representations with the efficiency of optimization-based solvers. However, a naive application of SVI struggles in the PnP problem, often missing alternative pose hypotheses or assigning incorrect probability weights to them. To address these limitations, we propose practical remedies that discover new potential poses, identify distinct hypothesis clusters, and balance their relative probability weights to capture the true underlying distribution. Our experiments across synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that SteinPnP accurately captures complex multimodal uncertainties while maintaining competitive accuracy.

AI.tldr: SteinPnP：基于Stein变分推断的粒子化6-DoF位姿后验PnP求解器
AI.motivation: 传统PnP求解器通常只输出单一位姿估计，难以刻画真实场景中多模态、复杂的位姿不确定性；而基于粒子的表示虽表达力强，但采样开销大、效率低。
AI.method: 用非参数位姿粒子集建模完整6-DoF相机位姿后验，借助Stein变分推断（SVI）将粒子表示的表达力与优化式求解器的高效性结合；针对朴素SVI在PnP中易漏失备择位姿假设、概率权重分配不当的问题，提出三项实用改进：发现新候选位姿、辨识不同假设簇、平衡各簇相对概率权重。
AI.result: 在合成与真实基准上，SteinPnP能准确刻画复杂的多模态不确定性，同时保持有竞争力的位姿精度。
AI.conclusion: SteinPnP为PnP提供了一种高效的概率化多模态位姿后验建模方案，在保持精度的同时显著增强不确定性表达能力。

title: SAGE-QA: Semantic-Aware, Grounded Evaluation for Closed-Context Question Answering on SQuAD 2.0
summary: Closed-context question answering (QA) requires a system to generate an answer strictly supported by a supplied passage, or to abstain when the passage lacks adequate evidence. SQuAD 2.0 is a widely used benchmark for this setting, scored by Exact Match (EM) i.e., character-level agreement with human reference spans after lexical normalization. For generative large language models (LLMs), however, an EM failure may reflect a valid paraphrase or an alternative passage-supported answer rather than a hallucination. The best prior leaderboard EM is approximately 91%, but evaluating generative models requires separating lexical divergence from factual error. We introduce SAGE-QA (Semantic-Aware, Grounded Evaluation for Question Answering), a multi-tiered framework combining reference-based Semantic Equivalence Scoring (SES) and passage-based Re-Validation Scoring (RVS). On a fixed set of 10,000 SQuAD 2.0 validation examples, we compute EM and decision-matrix F1 from TP, TN, FP, and FN counts for zero-shot closed-weight frontier models and for open-weight models, untuned and fine-tuned. Zero-shot, Claude Opus 4.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro reach 85.21 and 86.66 EM, outperforming untuned Llama 3 8B (56.88), gpt-oss-20b (66.28), and Llama 3.3 70B (71.39). Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adds 21.19 to 34.06 EM points, raising these models to 90.94, 87.47, and 94.24 EM, respectively. Auditing the frontier models with SAGE-QA and an external LLM judge yields dataset-wide SES scores of 92.81 for Claude Opus 4.6 and 91.67 for Gemini 3.1 Pro, and hybrid RVS scores, which combine benchmark credit with passage-based judge assessments, of 97.96 and 98.02. Fine-tuned open-weight models perform best, with fine-tuned Llama 3.3 70B surpassing the previous best known EM.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGE-QA多层评估框架（语义等价评分SES + 基于段落的再验证评分RVS），用于区分生成式LLM在SQuAD 2.0闭域问答中的词汇偏差与事实错误；微调后的Llama 3.3 70B达94.24 EM，超越此前最佳。
AI.motivation: SQuAD 2.0以EM（字符级匹配）为主要指标，对生成式LLM不公平：合法的同义改写或经段落支持的其他答案也会被判错，导致EM失败无法区分"词汇差异"与"幻觉/事实错误"，因此需要一个能语义感知且基于证据的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建SAGE-QA多层评估框架，含参考基的语义等价评分（SES）与基于段落的再验证评分（RVS）；在固定的10,000条SQuAD 2.0验证集上，对闭源前沿模型与开源模型（未微调/参数高效微调）计算EM及基于TP/TN/FP/FN的决策矩阵F1，并用外部LLM评审做交叉审计。
AI.result: 零样本下Claude Opus 4.6与Gemini 3.1 Pro分别达85.21/86.66 EM，优于未微调的Llama 3 8B（56.88）、gpt-oss-20b（66.28）、Llama 3.3 70B（71.39）；PEFT微调提升21.19–34.06 EM点至90.94/87.47/94.24。SAGE-QA审计得SES 92.81（Claude）与91.67（Gemini），混合RVS 97.96与98.02。
AI.conclusion: EM会系统性低估生成式模型的真实问答能力，语义感知+证据再验证的分层评估更合理；参数高效微调的开源模型表现最佳，微调Llama 3.3 70B超过此前已知最佳EM。

title: MORA: Correcting Time Series Forecasts with Coarse Future Signals
summary: Recent architectural advances have improved time-series forecasting. However, our analysis of forecasters with diverse architectures reveals a common pattern: a substantial share of residual energy is concentrated in a small number of low-frequency components. Simple linear probes further show that the forecasters' historical inputs still contain predictive information about errors in the forecast mean. Building on these findings, we propose Model-Output Residual Adaptation (MORA), a model-agnostic residual adapter that refines the outputs of frozen forecasters without requiring additional inputs. MORA estimates segment-wise means of the target sequence through structural extrapolation and learned estimation, rather than directly predicting backbone-specific residuals. It then converts discrepancies between these estimates and the corresponding statistics of the backbone forecast into stagewise corrections, scaling each update according to estimation reliability. Extensive experiments on twelve benchmarks with six forecasting backbones show average MSE reductions of 7.2% for long-term forecasting and 28.1% for short-term forecasting, with lower MSE in 96.2% of the 288 evaluated cases. The benefits also extend to three time-series foundation models evaluated at different context lengths. Together, these results demonstrate that predictable coarse-scale residuals can be effectively exploited to improve existing forecasts. Code repository: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MORA-B0B0/.

AI.tldr: 提出模型无关的残差适配器MORA，通过捕捉低频谱段结构化的可预测残差，对冻结预测器的输出进行分阶段校正，在12个基准、6个骨干上平均降低MSE 7.2%（长期）与28.1%（短期）。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测架构虽不断改进，但对多种架构的预测器分析发现共性现象：残差能量显著集中于少数低频分量，且线性探针表明历史输入仍含有关于预测均值误差的预测信息。这说明残差具有结构化、低频谱的可预测性，而现有模型未加利用。
AI.method: MORA为模型无关的残差适配器，不引入额外输入、不微调冻结骨干。其不对骨干特定的残差直接回归，而是通过结构外推与可学习估计两种方式估计目标序列的分段均值；随后将估计值与骨干预测对应统计量之间的偏差转化为分阶段（stagewise）修正，并按估计可靠性对每步更新进行缩放。
AI.result: 在12个基准、6个预测骨干上进行实验，长期预测平均MSE降低7.2%，短期预测平均降低28.1%，288个评估案例中96.2%取得更低MSE；在3个时间序列基础模型的不同上下文长度下同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 可预测的粗粒度（低频/分段均值）残差能够被有效利用以改进既有预测，MORA提供了一种轻量、通用、即插即用的后处理式提升方案。

title: Memory-Efficient Parallel Policy Learning for Collapse-Reactive Retreat via Hybrid Terrain Modeling
summary: At disaster sites and on unstable slopes, robot contact can collapse uninspected terrain, requiring retreat upon support loss. Massively parallel reinforcement learning of collapse-reactive retreat requires independent state--action experiences.
