title: What Conformal Selection Can Certify in CRISPR Off-Target Design:Benchmark Leakage, Free Baselines, and a Finite-Sample Cohort Requirement
summary: Conformal selection promises distribution-free, finite-sample control of the error rate of a decision, and has been proposed as a safety layer for machine-learning CRISPR guide design. We ask whether such a certificate is attainable from the validated off-target data that exist. The constraint is arithmetic: a conformal p-value cannot fall below one divided by the calibration cohort size plus one, so a Benjamini-Hochberg selection certifies a single candidate only when that cohort is at least the candidate pool size divided by the tolerated error rate. Public cohorts supply ten validated guides, whereas a pool of two thousand at a ten percent error rate needs twenty thousand; the accepted set is consequently empty in over ninety-six percent of splits. Two benchmarking findings explain why this went unnoticed. The standard CIRCLE-seq file lists ten guides under eighty on-target strings, so grouping cross-validation on the sequence column trains and tests on one guide; corrected, pair-level discrimination and per-guide fidelity collapse. With that leakage removed, a training-free position-weight score and a bare count of near-match genomic sites are not beaten by a trained oracle. We give the corrected protocol, the baselines a new model must beat, and the cohort size a certified pipeline needs.

AI.tldr: 本文从算术角度证明：基于现有公开脱靶验证数据构建的 conformal selection 无法可靠地给出 CRISPR 引导设计的有限样本误差保证——公开队列仅约十个验证引导，而 2000 个候选池在 10% 误报率下需要约 20000 的校准样本量，导致超过 96% 的数据划分下被认证集合为空。
AI.motivation: conformal selection 被提议作为 CRISPR 引导设计的"安全层"，宣称提供无分布假设、有限样本的误差率控制。作者质疑：这类证书能否由现有已验证脱靶数据真正实现，并指出过往基准评测中隐藏的数据泄漏掩盖了该问题。
AI.method: (1) 算术分析：conformal p-value 下界为 1/(n+1)，结合 BH 过程推出认证单个候选所需最小校准队列规模 n ≥ 候选池规模/容忍错误率；(2) 审计标准 CIRCLE-seq 数据文件，发现 10 个引导被列在 80 余条 on-target 字符串下，按序列列做分组交叉验证会使训练与测试落在同一引导上；(3) 修正为引导级（pair-level）划分后，重新评测无训练的 position-weight 打分与近匹配基因组位点计数两个基线，并与训练得到的 oracle 比较。
AI.result: 公开队列仅提供 10 个已验证引导，而 2000 候选池、10% 错误率需 20000 样本，故超过 96% 的划分中接受集为空；修正泄漏后，pair-level 判别能力与按引导的保真度指标显著下降；去除泄漏后，训练好的 oracle 模型并未优于无训练的 position-weight 打分和近匹配位点计数基线。
AI.conclusion: 现有公开脱靶数据不足以支撑 conformal 认证流程，需数量级更大的校准队列。论文给出修正后的评测协议、新模型必须超越的基线，以及可认证流程所需的队列规模，作为该领域后续工作的最低标准。

title: RGB-D SLAM on the Edge: Benchmarking and Profiling RTAB-Map and ORB-SLAM3 on the Raspberry Pi 5
summary: Micro aerial vehicles that operate without GPS often run SLAM on ARM-based edge boards, yet there is little published data on how standard RGB-D SLAM systems behave on such hardware. We benchmark RTAB-Map and ORB-SLAM3 on the Raspberry Pi 5 using six TUM RGB-D sequences at three image resolutions, recording tracking coverage, trajectory error, time per frame, memory, CPU load and temperature for every run, and we profile both systems at the stage and function level. RTAB-Map was configured to process and keep every frame, so its back end runs on every frame rather than at its default rate of 1 Hz. On the sequences that every configuration tracked, its front end takes 38-74 ms per frame and its full pipeline 150-462 ms, compared with 13-45 ms and 26-62 ms for ORB-SLAM3. RTAB-Map's main cost is optimizing a pose graph that keeps growing, because its working memory is unbounded by default; ORB-SLAM3's local bundle adjustment costs about as much as its tracking but runs in a parallel thread. At quarter resolution, both systems lose tracking on most sequences, and runs that lose tracking finish sooner and report lower error on the poses they keep, so time and accuracy must be read alongside coverage. Timing is repeatable to within 1-5%, but trajectory error varies by up to 27% between identical runs, so the accuracy differences between the two systems are inconclusive. No thermal throttling occurred.

AI.tldr: 在树莓派5上以三种分辨率、六条TUM RGB-D序列对RTAB-Map与ORB-SLAM3进行全指标基准测试与阶段/函数级剖析：RTAB-Map前段38-74 ms、全流程150-462 ms，ORB-SLAM3为13-45 ms与26-62 ms；四分之一分辨率下两者多数序列丢失跟踪；计时重复性1-5%，但轨迹误差同一配置间波动达27%，故精度差异不具结论性；无热降频。
AI.motivation: 无GPS的微型飞行器常在ARM边缘板（如树莓派5）上运行SLAM，但公开文献中缺乏标准RGB-D SLAM系统在该类硬件上的行为数据，工程选型与部署缺少可依据的量化参考。
AI.method: 在Raspberry Pi 5上对RTAB-Map与ORB-SLAM3做基准测试：使用6条TUM RGB-D序列×3种图像分辨率；逐次记录跟踪覆盖率、轨迹误差、每帧耗时、内存、CPU负载与温度；并对两系统进行阶段级与函数级性能剖析。RTAB-Map被配置为处理并保留每一帧，使其后端逐帧运行（而非默认1 Hz）。
AI.result: 在全部配置均成功跟踪的序列上，RTAB-Map前段每帧38-74 ms、完整流程150-462 ms；ORB-SLAM3分别为13-45 ms与26-62 ms。RTAB-Map的主要开销来自持续增长的位姿图优化，因其工作内存默认无界；ORB-SLAM3的局部BA开销约与跟踪相当但运行于并行线程。四分之一分辨率下两系统在多数序列丢失跟踪；丢失跟踪的运行更早结束且在其保留位姿上报告的误差更低，故时间与精度须与覆盖率一并解读。计时重复性在1-5%内，但相同运行的轨迹误差差异最高达27%，因此两系统间的精度差异无结论性。测试中未出现热降频。
AI.conclusion: ARM边缘平台上两系统均可实时性受限地运行：ORB-SLAM3在时延上具明显优势，RTAB-Map的瓶颈可由限制工作内存/位姿图规模缓解；精度比较受运行间随机性（最高27%）限制而不具结论性；低分辨率下覆盖率是首要约束，报告精度必须同时给出覆盖率，且该硬件未触发热节流。

title: RipBench: A Unified Benchmark for Multi-Level Rip Current Detection, Classification and Segmentation
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track. 47 pages, 11 figures. See https://ripbench.ai for dataset and project updates
summary: Rip currents are a serious and often under-addressed threat to beach safety and the leading cause of coastal drownings worldwide. They are difficult to detect due to their amorphous structure, similarity to the background, and large variability in viewpoints and environments. Despite their dangers and growing interest in automated detection, existing research remains fragmented across datasets, metrics, models, and approaches, leading to an incomplete understanding of model performance. We introduce RipBench, a unified benchmark that enables controlled evaluation of rip current detection spanning multiple tasks, including classification, axis-aligned and oriented object detection, and instance, semantic, and panoptic segmentation, on the same data with standardized splits. This allows direct comparison of model performance on all levels of visual abstraction. Across $304$ videos ($303{,}491$ frames, $51{,}011$ of them annotated for all six tasks) collected from diverse coastlines, our results expose a clear performance gap between coarse recognition and precise spatial understanding: frame-level classification reaches $F_2 = 0.93$, while the best detector and the best instance segmenter reach $0.72$ and $0.66$, with model rankings that change from task to task. Video-level confidence intervals, a blind inter-annotator study of the spatial labels, stratified analyses by viewpoint and visual signature, and video views with temporal baselines (single-seed, short-schedule reference runs) accompany the benchmark. All tasks are supported with carefully curated annotations and evaluated using standard metrics, with a focus on the $F_2$ score to emphasize recall in this safety-critical setting. RipBench, along with multiple baselines per task, is publicly available at https://RipBench.ai to support progress in real-world, multi-task vision for beach safety.

AI.tldr: RipBench：面向离岸流检测的统一多任务基准，覆盖分类、轴对齐/旋转目标检测与实例/语义/全景分割，在同一数据与标准划分下评测，揭示"粗粒度识别强、精细空间理解弱"的性能鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 离岸流是海滩安全的重要且常被忽视的威胁，是全球海岸溺亡主因；其形态无定形、与背景相似、视角与环境变化大，检测困难。现有研究在数据集、指标、模型与方法上高度碎片化，难以对模型性能形成完整认识，缺乏可控、可比的统一评测。
AI.method: 构建 RipBench 统一基准：采集多海岸线 304 段视频（303,491 帧，其中 51,011 帧对六项任务全部标注），采用标准化划分，在同一数据上评测分类、轴对齐与旋转目标检测、实例/语义/全景分割，实现各视觉抽象层级的直接比较。评测以 F₂ 为主指标以强调安全关键场景下的召回，并为每项任务提供多个基线；附带视频级置信区间、空间标签的盲式标注者一致性研究、按视角与视觉特征的 stratified 分析，以及含时间基线的视频视图（单种子、短训练计划参考运行）。
AI.result: 结果暴露粗粒度识别与精细空间理解之间的明显性能差距：帧级分类 F₂ = 0.93，最佳检测器与最佳实例分割器分别仅为 0.72 和 0.66；且模型排名随任务不同而变化。
AI.conclusion: 离岸流检测仍面临从"能识别"到"能精确定位"的瓶颈，任务间排名不一致说明单一任务评测不足。RipBench 与各任务基线已公开（https://RipBench.ai），以推动面向海滩安全的真实世界多任务视觉研究。

title: How Should Planning Agents ReSHAPE Their Search Space?
summary: Planning agents and benchmarks treat a user's initial specification as fixed. Yet the requests users write exclude plans they would gladly take, since they rarely discover the possible trade-offs they would accept until seeing the options. Agents already revise requests through interaction, but whether this helps planning is unknown. We formalize this step as the ReSHAPE task, which judges a revision by whether its search space matches the acceptable plans and a planner finds one there. Using ReSHAPE Planter, which builds instances from planning benchmarks with a human-validated simulated user, we analyze 5,800 agent-revised specifications in travel and shopping. We find that reshaping matters: one correct trade-off makes the same planner reach an acceptable plan up to 4.6x as often, and search space quality predicts what the planner finds. Current agents, however, admit at most 32% of the acceptable plans, where that trade-off alone admits over 52%, because they ask about preferences instead of showing plans; in travel, showing plans raises F1 by 9.7 points over asking, with two model families. Planning agents should thus treat a request as a hypothesis to test against the user's reactions to concrete plans to recognize user trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ReSHAPE任务，将用户请求的修订形式化为"搜索空间是否匹配可接受计划、且规划器能在其中找到解"的判定问题，并构建ReSHAPE Planter基准（基于规划基准+人类验证的模拟用户）分析5800条智能体修订规格，发现正确的权衡塑造可使同一规划器找到可接受计划的概率提升至4.6倍，但当前智能体最多仅容纳32%的可接受计划，因其倾向于"询问偏好"而非"展示计划"。
AI.motivation: 现有规划智能体与基准将用户的初始请求视为固定不变，但用户写下的请求会排除掉他们本可接受的方案——用户在看到具体选项前，难以发现自己能接受哪些权衡。智能体虽已通过交互修订请求，但这种修订是否真正有助于规划尚不清楚，缺乏形式化定义与量化评估。
AI.method: 将请求修订步骤形式化为ReSHAPE任务：以修订后请求所诱导的搜索空间是否与"可接受计划集合"匹配、以及规划器能否在其中找到解作为评价标准。构建ReSHAPE Planter，利用规划基准生成实例并配备经人类验证的模拟用户，在旅行与购物两个领域分析5,800条智能体修订的规格；同时对比"询问偏好"与"展示具体计划"两种交互策略。
AI.result: 塑造确实关键：仅引入一个正确权衡，就使同一规划器找到可接受计划的频率最高提升至4.6倍；搜索空间质量可预测规划器的最终结果。但当前智能体最多只容纳32%的可接受计划，而单靠该权衡即可容纳超52%；原因在于智能体询问偏好而非展示计划。在旅行领域中，相较提问，展示计划使F1在两个模型家族上提升9.7个点。
AI.conclusion: 规划智能体应将用户请求视为待检验的假设，通过用户对具体计划的反应来识别其权衡取舍，而非依赖直接询问偏好；未来智能体需从"静态需求解析"转向"基于具体方案的交互式请求塑造"。

title: Observations Drift, Structures Remain: Structural Pretraining with Time Alignment for Electromagnetic Signals
summary: Electromagnetic signal modeling is increasingly moving toward self-supervised pretraining on heterogeneous I/Q observations. However, an observed waveform is jointly shaped by signal generation, propagation environments, and acquisition processes, which mix reusable structural regularities with observation-specific variations. Existing methods usually pursue unified pretraining with reconstruction objectives on mixed observations. This heterogeneity creates two key mismatches for reconstruction pretraining: (1) appearance mismatch, induced by propagation-dependent waveform variations; and (2) temporal mismatch, induced by acquisition-dependent sampling coordinates. These mismatches make observation-specific appearances and sampling coordinates easier to reconstruct than stable signal structures, inducing observational shortcuts. We identify this failure mode as observation-biased pretraining. To address this, we propose Structural Pretraining with Time Alignment for heterogeneous EM signals. It mitigates temporal mismatch with RoPE-fs, which maps token positions to sampling-rate-normalized physical-time positions, and reduces reliance on appearance shortcuts by replacing waveform reconstruction with masked prediction of discrete structural units. These units are organized into atomic structural units and emergent structural units that capture variable-length compositional patterns beyond fixed patch boundaries. Across diverse EM benchmarks, our method improves both full-supervision and few-shot adaptation over existing EM pretraining baselines, showing that the learned representations better preserve structural consistency when observations drift in waveform appearance and temporal scale.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"观测偏置预训练"这一失效模式，指出现有重建式预训练易学到与观测相关的捷径；为此提出结构预训练+时间对齐（RoPE-fs + 离散结构单元掩码预测），在多种电磁基准上优于现有电磁预训练基线。
AI.motivation: 电磁信号自监督预训练常直接在异构I/Q观测上做重建。但观测波形由信号生成、传播环境与采集过程共同决定，可复用的结构规律与观测特有变化混在一起。由此产生两种不匹配：(1) 外观不匹配，源于传播导致的波形差异；(2) 时间不匹配，源于采集导致的采样坐标差异。二者使模型更易重建观测特有的外观与采样坐标，而非稳定信号结构，形成"观测偏置预训练"的捷径学习问题。
AI.method: 1) RoPE-fs：将token位置映射为按采样率归一化的物理时间位置，缓解时间不匹配；2) 用离散结构单元的掩码预测替代波形重建，降低对外观捷径的依赖；3) 结构单元分为原子结构单元与涌现结构单元，后者可捕捉跨越固定patch边界的变长组合模式。
AI.result: 在多个异构电磁基准上，该方法在全监督与少样本适配两种设定下均优于现有电磁预训练基线；当观测在波形外观与时间尺度上发生漂移时，所学表征仍能更好保持结构一致性。
AI.conclusion: 重建式统一预训练不适配异构I/Q观测；通过物理时间对齐与结构级（而非外观级）预测目标，可有效抑制观测偏置、学到更鲁棒可迁移的电磁信号表征。

title: Robots That Talk Too Much and Don't Listen Enough
comment: 4 pages, 3 figures, presented at EMF Workshop, HRI 2026, Edinburgh, Scotland
summary: Until recently, the biggest obstacles to natural spoken interaction with social robots were speech recognition errors and turn-taking failures. Advances in speech recognition have enabled much better spoken interaction, but turn-taking failures and other misunderstandings continue to be far too prevalent. This short paper looks back at earlier methods for improving speech recognition and turn-taking in interaction with social robots, and then looks at what can be done today, arguing that multimodal bidirectional streaming is needed to reduce the frequency of turn-taking failures.

AI.tldr: 该短文回顾社交机器人语音识别与轮流发言（turn-taking）的早期改进方法，指出现今识别错误已大幅缓解但轮流失误与误解仍普遍，主张采用多模态双向流式（multimodal bidirectional streaming）来降低轮流失误频率。
AI.motivation: 自然口语交互中，语音识别错误与轮流失误曾是主要障碍；识别技术进步后，轮流失误及其他误解仍高发，亟需新的改进路径。
AI.method: 综述性/立场性短文：回溯以往提升语音识别与轮流发言表现的方法，并讨论当前可行技术手段，进而提出论证。
AI.result: 作者论证多模态双向流式是减少轮流失误频率的必要方案（摘要为论点陈述，未给出实验数据）。
AI.conclusion: 社交机器人口语交互的瓶颈已从识别精度转向轮流管理，应采用多模态双向流式以降低轮流失误。

title: Fit-LRP: Fitting Linear Relaxations to Polytopes for Neural Network Verification over Non-Convex Regions
summary: State-of-the-art neural network verifiers evaluate linear relaxations over axis-aligned bounding boxes. However, verification domains in cyber-physical systems are rarely boxes. Reachability specifications, obstacle-avoidance constraints, and neural Lyapunov certificates typically yield oblique or non-convex polyhedral regions, over which box-based bounds become extremely loose. This paper proposes Fit-LRP (Fitting Linear Relaxations to Polytopes), a framework the implements exact optimization of affine bounds over non-convex domains (represented by unions of polytopes) by solving a sequence of small, low-dimensional linear programs. Our approach seamlessly enhances the final optimization step of LiRPA and $α,\! β$-CROWN branch-and-bound (BaB) algorithms. In BaB verification, approximating oblique constraints with axis-aligned splits causes severe combinatorial blowup and risks non-termination. By optimizing the final affine bound of a nonlinear function over the exact polyhedral state-space constraints our method eliminates box-induced over-approximations, enabling earlier search-tree pruning. On ARCH-COMP and neural Lyapunov benchmarks, Fit-LRP reduces branching on the hardest region by $47\times$, cuts worst-case verification time by $15\times$, and with region-wise partitioning, verifies on a single CPU $6.1\times$ faster than $α,\! β$-CROWN on a GPU.

AI.tldr: Fit-LRP 将 LiRPA/α,β-CROWN 的最后一步仿射界优化精确推广到非凸多面体域（多面体并），通过求解一系列小型低维 LP 消除盒式过近似，在 ARCH-COMP 与神经 Lyapunov 基准上显著加速验证。
AI.motivation: 现有 SOTA 神经网络验证器（LiRPA、α,β-CROWN 等）均在轴对齐包围盒上评估线性松弛。但信息物理系统中的验证域很少是盒：可达性规格、避障约束、神经 Lyapunov 证书通常产生斜面或非凸多面体区域。在这些域上用盒式包围界会极其宽松；在 BaB 中若用轴对齐分裂近似斜面约束，会导致严重的组合爆炸甚至不终止。
AI.method: 提出 Fit-LRP 框架：在由多面体并表示的非凸域上精确优化仿射界，方法是求解一串小型、低维线性规划。该框架可无缝嵌入 LiRPA 与 α,β-CROWN 分支定界（BaB）算法的最终优化步骤，即在精确的多面体状态空间约束上优化非线性函数的最终仿射界，从而消除盒式诱导的过近似。
AI.result: 在 ARCH-COMP 与神经 Lyapunov 基准上：最难区域的分支数减少 47×，最坏情况验证时间降低 15×；配合按区域划分策略，单 CPU 上比 GPU 上的 α,β-CROWN 快 6.1×。
AI.conclusion: 将最终仿射界优化从盒域推广到精确多面体域可有效消除过近似，实现更早的搜索树剪枝，缓解斜面约束下的组合爆炸，为 CPS 场景中的多面体可达性与 Lyapunov 验证提供高效方案。

title: FoveaDet: Software-Hardware Co-Design of Foveated CNN-Transformer for Object Detection
comment: 5 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE ISCAS 2027
summary: Deploying real-time object detection on power-constrained edge platforms is challenging as processing full-resolution frames is often computationally redundant. Inspired by biological foveation which assigns variable resolution based on visual saliency, we propose a novel software-hardware co-design framework called FoveaDet. On the software side, FoveaDet dynamically identifies salient regions to predict fixation points, followed by aggressive patch pruning in Vision Transformers (ViT) to discard irrelevant background data. To mitigate slowdowns from sequential patch generation, we implement optimized interpolation and patch selection algorithms. Evaluated on standard GPUs, this foveated approach reduces floating-point operations by 65.4% to 92.2% and accelerates inference by 4.76x, while suffering a negligible mAP drop compared to dense baselines. To eliminate hardware bottlenecks, we complement the algorithm with a custom RISC-V core featuring specialized instructions to accelerate the foveated processing pipeline. FoveaDet provides a scalable, efficient architecture capable of unlocking advanced vision processing on severely constrained mobile platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出软硬件协同设计框架FoveaDet，借鉴生物中央凹视觉按显著性分配变分辨率，软件端动态预测注视点并对ViT做激进patch剪枝，硬件端定制带专用指令的RISC-V核加速该流水线；在GPU上实现FLOPs降低65.4%–92.2%、推理加速4.76倍且mAP几乎不降。
AI.motivation: 在功耗受限的边缘平台上部署实时目标检测困难，处理全分辨率帧存在大量计算冗余；同时，注视点式顺序生成patch会带来流水线串行开销与硬件瓶颈，需从算法与硬件两侧协同优化。
AI.method: 软件侧：受生物中央凹视觉（foveation）启发，动态识别显著区域以预测注视点（fixation points），据此对ViT进行激进的patch剪枝，丢弃无关背景；为缓解顺序生成patch造成的减速，设计优化的插值与patch选择算法。硬件侧：定制RISC-V核，引入专用指令加速中央凹处理流水线，消除硬件瓶颈。
AI.result: 标准GPU评测显示：FLOPs降低65.4%–92.2%，推理加速4.76倍，相比稠密基线mAP下降可忽略；配合定制RISC-V核可进一步消除硬件瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: FoveaDet提供了一种可扩展、高效的软硬件协同架构，使先进视觉处理可在严苛受限的移动/边缘平台上落地。

title: One Model, Two Precisions: Does Disagreement Between Quantized Copies Tell You When a Small Model Is Wrong?
summary: Local language models often exist at several precisions, and quantization is known to change individual answers. This study asks whether the disagreement between two precisions of the same weights, an 8-bit copy that answers and a lower-precision copy that reads the same prompt, works as a per-question error score for abstention, escalation and re-asking. The cost is one extra forward pass over fewer bytes, with no sampling and no training. We simulate round-to-nearest quantization with per-group scales (3 to 6 bits, groups of 32 to 256) on Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B and score 8,398 multiple-choice questions from ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, MMLU and HellaSwag subsets. Error detection is measured by AUROC, risk-coverage curves and ECE on a held-out half, with paired bootstrap intervals over questions. For Qwen3-0.6B, the entropy of the 8-bit answer reaches AUROC 0.682; the best disagreement score, selected on a development half, reaches 0.684 (+0.001 [-0.009, +0.011]), and combining it with the confidence features adds +0.009 [+0.002, +0.015], mostly on ARC. On Qwen3-1.7B the selected score is -0.001 [-0.009, +0.006] from entropy and the combination +0.003 [-0.001, +0.006] on the test half. Gaussian weight noise at matched error energy is about as informative as rounding (0.6B only), so we find no evidence that the signal is specific to quantization, and shuffling the features within task and entropy cells removes the gain. One extra 8-bit pass that shifts the option order does better (+0.049 [+0.031, +0.067] over entropy) at about a third more weight traffic; routing to a larger model on free entropy beats both extra-pass scores at equal total traffic. After logistic recalibration the 0.6B confidences are calibrated within a few points of ECE. A deployment recipe and the cases where the method does not help are given.

AI.tldr: 本文检验“同一权重的8位副本与低精度副本对同一问题的答案分歧”能否作为逐题错误分数，用于弃答、升级与重问；在Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B上用模拟量化在8,398道选择题上评测。结果显示分歧信号相对熵仅有极小增益，且无证据表明其特异性来自量化。
AI.motivation: 本地模型常有多个精度版本，量化会改变单题答案。作者希望利用这一现象，以极低成本（一次额外前向、无需采样、无需训练）获得逐题可靠性信号，支撑弃答、升级到更大模型和重问等部署策略。
AI.method: 采用逐组scale的round-to-nearest模拟量化（3–6 bit，组大小32–256），作用于Qwen3-0.6B与Qwen3-1.7B；在ARC-Easy、ARC-Challenge、MMLU、HellaSwag共8,398道选择题上，比较8位答案熵与两位精度间分歧分数。以AUROC、risk-coverage曲线和ECE在留出半集上评估，并用配对bootstrap给出区间；另做高斯权重噪声对照、任务×熵单元内特征打乱消融，以及移位选项顺序的额外前向和“等总流量下路由到更大模型”的基线对比，最后做logistic重校准。
AI.result: 0.6B上8位答案熵AUROC达0.682；开发集选出的最佳分歧分数为0.684（+0.001 [-0.009,+0.011]），与置信特征组合增益+0.009 [+0.002,+0.015]（主要来自ARC）。1.7B上选定分数相对熵为-0.001 [-0.009,+0.006]，组合为+0.003 [-0.001,+0.006]。匹配误差能量的高斯权重噪声信息量与舍入相当（仅0.6B），任务与熵单元内打乱特征后增益消失。移位选项顺序的8位额外前向更优（+0.049 [+0.031,+0.067]），但权重流量约多三分之一；等总流量下按自由熵路由到更大模型优于两种额外前向方案。重校准后0.6B置信度ECE在数个百分点内。
AI.conclusion: 跨精度分歧作为不确定性分数有效但增益甚微，且并非量化特有；相比移位选项的额外前向和在等流量下升级到更大模型，其性价比更低。文章给出部署配方并明确指出方法失效的情形。

title: Learning a calibrated decision head from logged bandit feedback
comment: 40 pages, 6 figures. Code at https://github.com/yuan-phd/jevmark (tag v5-paper); adapters at https://huggingface.co/yuanphd/jevmark; logs and per-record results at https://huggingface.co/datasets/yuanphd/jevmark-runs
summary: A decision head reads a state and a list of options and returns a probability per option in one forward pass. Once deployed, it usually observes only whether the option it chose was right: logged bandit feedback. We adapt such a head, LoRA on Qwen3-0.6B-Base and 1.7B-Base, from that feedback and report three results. First, the Brier or log score of the sampled action's own probability is not a usable REINFORCE reward: every wrong action earns at least gold's reward, with a mean baseline the lowest-probability wrong action gets the largest advantage, and at two options the signal is zero; in one run it cut accuracy on ordered-scale questions from .636 to .111. Scoring the probability as a loss by the pathwise gradient avoids the collapse, as do the REINFORCE rewards r and r minus p. Second, with full labels, none of four tested bandit arms beat cross-entropy plus one temperature on mean expected calibration error (ECE) over four unseen label schemas. Third, from logged feedback alone, Chosen-Action Proper Scoring (CAPS), the direct method with a proper score on the chosen action's probability, beats fine-tuning on confirmed answers only, which discards negatives: on Banking77 by 2.6 accuracy points, .053 lower ECE and lower selective risk (three seeds against one baseline seed), and by 21.7 points on one seed on emotion data with an often-wrong logger. At N 5000, CAPS stays 1.5 points below full-label training at 0.6B and .6 points at 1.7B against one full-label seed, and propensity weights add nothing on this log. Under feedback flipped at a known rate, one seed per rate, CAPS's confidence tracks the noisy channel on average, backward correction recovers most of the clean calibration, and early stopping on held-out logged outcomes prevented memorising noisy draws in all three runs. Code, adapters, logs and per-record results are public.

AI.tldr: 论文研究在仅有记录式bandit反馈（logged bandit feedback）条件下，如何适配LLM决策头（LoRA微调Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B-Base），并系统比较了各类bandit奖励/损失与全标签监督的表现。
AI.motivation: 部署后的决策头通常只能观察到"所选选项是否正确"的bandit反馈（而非完整标签），需要判断哪些奖励设计可用、以及仅凭该反馈能否逼近全标签微调的校准与准确率。
AI.method: 在Qwen3-0.6B-Base与1.7B-Base上用LoRA适配决策头；对比①以被采样动作自身概率的Brier/log score作REINFORCE奖励、②pathwise梯度下的proper scoring loss、③REINFORCE奖励r与r−p；提出CAPS（对所选动作概率施加proper score的直接法）；考察倾向权重、已知翻转率的噪声信道与后向校正、基于held-out logged outcomes的早停。
AI.result: 用采样动作自身概率的Brier/log score作REINFORCE奖励不可用：任何错误动作奖励不低于gold，带均值基线时最低概率的错误动作获得最大advantage，二选一时信号为零（某次运行将有序量表题准确率从.636降至.111）；pathwise梯度与r、r−p无此崩溃。全标签下四种bandit臂均未在四种未见标签schema的平均ECE上超过交叉熵+单一温度。仅用logged反馈时CAPS优于仅用确认答案微调：Banking77上+2.6准确率点、ECE低.053且选择性风险更低（3种子对1基线种子），emotion数据单种子+21.7点；N=5000时CAPS在0.6B落后全标签1.5点、1.7B落后.6点；倾向权重无增益。已知速率翻转反馈下CAPS置信度平均跟随噪声信道，后向校正可恢复大部分干净校准，早停可防止记忆噪声抽样（三次运行均有效）。
AI.conclusion: proper scoring的直接法（CAPS）是logged bandit feedback下稳健有效的决策头适配目标，而REINFORCE类奖励存在严重失效模式；但仅凭日志反馈仍略逊于全标签监督，倾向权重在该日志上无必要。

title: Input-output characterization of robotic grasping: Connecting design parameters to grasp behavior through the admittance
summary: Low-impedance grippers make the dynamics of a grasp matter. Current grasp metrics, however, are static: they describe how a held object resists constant loads, not how it responds to time-varying ones. To quantify this, we rely on small-signal analysis to characterize a grasp by its admittance, the transfer matrix relating load perturbations to object displacements around an equilibrium. This transfer matrix recovers the stiffness and stability of the grasp at zero frequency and captures its natural frequencies and peak gain under time-varying loads. We apply this characterization to a planar two-finger gripper under proportional-derivative control. We show that two grasps of the same object in the same position and with the same contact forces can differ in stiffness by two orders of magnitude. Likewise, two grasps that share the same stiffness can exhibit very different resonances. Nonlinear simulations confirm the effectiveness of our small-signal analysis in capturing the dynamic behavior of grasping.

AI.tldr: 提出用"小信号导纳"（载荷扰动到物体位移的传递矩阵）来刻画抓取的动态特性，弥补传统静态抓取指标的不足，并在平面二指PD控制夹爪上验证了同一物体、同一位置、同一接触力下抓取的刚度可相差两个数量级，而刚度相同的抓取也可呈现截然不同的共振特性。
AI.motivation: 低阻抗夹爪使抓取的动力学特性变得重要，但现有抓取指标都是静态的：只描述被抓物体如何抵抗恒定载荷，而无法描述其对时变载荷的响应。因此需要一个能刻画抓取动态响应的量化工具。
AI.method: 采用小信号分析，以抓取的"导纳"（admittance）为刻画量，即平衡点附近将载荷扰动映射到物体位移的传递矩阵。该传递矩阵在零频处退化为刚度并给出稳定性信息，同时能提取抓取的自然频率与时变载荷下的峰值增益。将该刻画方法应用于采用比例-微分（PD）控制的平面二指夹爪，并用非线性仿真进行验证。
AI.result: 同一物体、同一位置且接触力相同的两种抓取，其刚度可相差两个数量级；而刚度相同的两种抓取，其共振特性也可以非常不同。非线性仿真证实了小信号分析能够有效捕捉抓取的动态行为。
AI.conclusion: 仅用静态刚度指标不足以描述抓取性能，导纳传递矩阵提供了统一的动态刻画框架，既包含零频刚度与稳定性，又揭示共振与峰值增益，可作为评估与设计低阻抗抓取的实用工具。

title: A Unified Interpretable Semantic Framework for Multi-Modal Fiber Sensing Under Data Scarcity
summary: We propose a unified interpretable semantic framework for multi-modal fiber sensing under data scarcity. The framework maps heterogeneous measurements from state of-polarization (SOP) monitoring, distributed acoustic sensing (DAS), and optical time-domain reflectometry (OTDR) into a shared set of physics-grounded semantic descriptors capturing impulsiveness, persistence, structural characteristics, and energy concentration. Inference is performed through reasoning over semantic class profiles, optionally assisted by retrieval of semantically similar examples to resolve ambiguity and support adaptation without model retraining. Experimental validation on real SOP, DAS, and OTDR datasets demonstrates robust performance across sensing modalities, achieving accuracies of 95.0%, 91.1%, and 94.6%, respectively, while providing transparent and physically interpretable decisions. The proposed framework establishes a unified and data efficient approach for optical fiber sensing in evolving and data scarce deployment environments.

AI.tldr: 提出面向数据稀缺场景的多模态光纤传感统一可解释语义框架，将SOP、DAS、OTDR异构测量映射到物理语义描述子空间，通过语义类剖面推理与检索增强实现免重训适应。
AI.motivation: 多模态光纤传感（SOP、DAS、OTDR）数据异构、标注稀缺，传统数据驱动的深度模型依赖大规模训练且缺乏物理可解释性，难以在动态、数据稀缺的部署环境中泛化与适应。
AI.method: 构建统一物理语义描述子空间，以脉冲性、持续性、结构特征、能量集中度四类描述子刻画三种异构测量；推理阶段基于语义类剖面进行匹配推理，并可选用语义相似样本检索来消解歧义、支撑无需模型重训的适应性迁移。
AI.result: 在真实SOP、DAS、OTDR数据集上分别取得95.0%、91.1%、94.6%的准确率，跨模态表现稳健，且决策过程透明、具备物理可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为演化中、数据稀缺的光纤传感部署提供统一且数据高效的技术路径，以语义中间层替代重型训练，兼顾跨模态一致性与可解释性。

title: Cat Royale Comprehensive Dataset: A Dataset for Pose Detection, Segmentation, Animal Action Recognition and Scene Understanding
comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to the International Journal of Computer Vision. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19498943
summary: Animal focused computer vision datasets are of a growing interest in the fields of both Computer Vision and Animal behaviour. The ability to make sense of complex scenes via a variety of Computer Vision tasks has substantial implications for behavioural understanding and welfare. The perfection of these tasks will help lead to better health and emotional outcomes for wild and domestic animals. In this work we present the Cat Royale Comprehensive Dataset (CRCD), a large, comprehensive, multi-modal dataset for feline understanding, based on a huge database of over 500 hours of video captured during the Cat Royale artwork and research project. Our dataset contains annotations for a range of computer vision problems including 20,000 images with instance segmentation masks, 5000 images with multi-subject pose coordinates, over 800 video clips with action classes, and over 800 clips with detailed text description. This is the first such dataset to link this wide range of annotation types together for multi-modal use. We release this entire dataset, and our custom annotation tools will also be made available, in order to allow for ongoing expansion. We also provide a series of benchmarks for the tasks of Instance Segmentation, Pose detection, Temporal Action Localisation, and finally video-text retrieval. The totality of this multi-modal dataset is the data needed to solve both these individual computer vision tasks as well as enabling more complex multi-modal tasks making use of a combination of annotations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Cat Royale 综合数据集（CRCD），基于 500 余小时猫类视频，包含 2 万张实例分割图像、5 千张三/多主体姿态图像、800 余段带动作类别标注的视频片段及 800 余段带详细文本描述的片段，首次将多类标注在猫类理解上统一链接，并配套开源标注工具与实例分割、姿态检测、时序动作定位、视频-文本检索四类基准。
AI.motivation: 动物相关计算机视觉数据集在计算机视觉与动物行为学中日益受关注；理解复杂场景对动物行为分析与福利改善（健康与情绪结果）具有重要价值，但现有工作缺乏将分割、姿态、动作、文本等多模态标注统一链接的大规模猫类数据集。
AI.method: 依托 Cat Royale 艺术与研究项目中超过 500 小时的视频素材构建 CRCD：提供实例分割掩码（20,000 张图像）、多主体姿态坐标（5,000 张图像）、带动作类别的视频片段（>800）以及带详细文本描述的片段（>800）；自研标注工具一并开源以支持持续扩展；并针对四项任务给出基准测试。
AI.result: 数据集包含四类互补标注并首次实现多模态关联；提供了实例分割、姿态检测、时序动作定位、视频-文本检索的基准结果（摘要未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: CRCD 是首个将多类标注类型统一链接以供多模态使用的大型猫类数据集，既可支撑各单项视觉任务，也支持组合标注的复杂多模态任务；数据集与标注工具全部公开，便于社区扩展。

title: Contain, Conform, Compare (Extended Version): A Red-Teamed Evaluation Kit for Small Coding Agents and the Full Record of Its Experiments
comment: 52 pages, 15 figures, 37 tables. Code: https://github.com/MinhThanghus/drydock-eval (tag v0.4.0). Data and analysis scripts are included as ancillary files
summary: A hosted score in the Gemma 4 Developer Agent competition is one noisy number, so development needs a local evaluator that is fast, safe for agent-written code, and matching the hosted scorer's prompts. drydock-eval evaluates a small coding agent (Gemma 4 E4B) at about 250 runs per hour on one RTX 5090. Contain runs each job in a fresh container without network and passed 200 scripted escape tests; conform provides eight checks that compare a local stack's requests with the scorer's configuration, down to rendered tokens; compare provides paired statistics that respect repository clusters. AI agents built and attacked the kit; a human owner approved machine use and release. This extended version repeats the short paper and adds the full record of the experiments made with and around the kit: 9,660 rows of agent runs, 2,494 grading controls and 72 serving measurements, all released. On four L4 GPUs the 31B model decodes 38.1 tokens per second in one stream and E4B 105.8. Six configurations of a 31B agent solved between 37 and 44 of 70 development tasks, and no pairwise difference was detected. A pre-registered five-arm experiment (231 tasks, 4,620 jobs) measured four prompt divergences: no E4B solve-rate change was detected (largest estimate -2.1 points, 95% interval -4.4 to +0.4). Three changes of the E4B agent led their screens by +1.0 to +6.2 points; each was then tested once on new tasks under a frozen pass rule, and none was confirmed (gains -0.35, -0.39 and +4.10 points). The unchanged baseline, run again on the same 128 tasks, moved by 1.17 points, and 65% of these tasks were solved in none of eight runs. Prompts and agent bundles are withheld; every run-level result is public.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并开源了本地评测工具包 drydock-eval，用于在单张 RTX 5090 上快速、安全、且与托管评分器一致的条件下评测小型编码智能体（Gemma 4 E4B，约 250 次运行/小时）；其扩展版公开了全部实验记录（9,660 条智能体运行、2,494 条评分对照、72 项服务测量），并显示小模型智能体改动带来的增益大多无法在独立任务上复现。
AI.motivation: Gemma 4 Developer Agent 竞赛的托管分数是单一且含噪的数字，无法支撑开发迭代；开发过程需要一个快速、能安全执行智能体生成代码、并且与托管评分器的提示和配置严格对齐的本地评测器，同时需要足够统计功效来区分真实改进与噪声。
AI.method: 构建 drydock-eval，包含三部分：Contain（每个任务在无网络的全新容器中运行，通过 200 项脚本化逃逸测试）、Conform（8 项检查，将本地栈请求与评分器配置逐项比对，细至渲染后的 token）、Compare（按仓库聚类的配对统计）。在四张 L4 GPU 上测量 31B 与 E4B 的吞吐；用 31B 的六种配置在 70 个开发任务上比较；执行预注册五臂实验（231 个任务、4,620 个作业）检验四处提示差异；对三项 E4B 智能体改动先做筛选（screen），再在冻结通过规则下于新任务上各测试一次；并对基线在同一 128 任务上重复运行以估计噪声。
AI.result: 单卡 RTX 5090 上约 250 runs/hour。四卡 L4 上 31B 单流解码 38.1 tok/s，E4B 为 105.8 tok/s。31B 的六种配置解出 70 个开发任务中的 37–44 个，未检测到任何两两差异。预注册五臂实验中，四处提示差异未引起 E4B 解题率变化（最大估计 −2.1 个百分点，95% 区间 −4.4 至 +0.4）。三项 E4B 改动筛选增益为 +1.0 至 +6.2 分，冻结规则下新任务复测均未确认（−0.35、−0.39、+4.10 分）。未改动基线在相同 128 任务上重跑偏移 1.17 分，且 65% 的任务在八次运行中均未被解出。
AI.conclusion: 本地评测基础设施在速度、沙箱安全与评分一致性方面可行，但小型智能体的评测方差极大：筛选阶段的正增益难以在独立任务上复现，基线自身漂移已与多数"改进"量级相当。提示与智能体包被保留不公开，所有运行级结果均公开，强调以配对统计与预注册、冻结规则来控制噪声。

title: Constructing and Validating Memorisation Audits for EHR Foundation Models
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Beyond Private Training: The New Landscape of AI Privacy (InfPriv) and the Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) 2026 Symposium, Findings Track
summary: Autoregressive electronic health record (EHR) foundation models may disclose training information at inference, yet clinical predictability makes patient-specific memorisation difficult to distinguish from generalisation. We evaluate fixed-window token reconstruction, sensitive-attribute disclosure, and random patient-level canaries in GPT-2-style models trained on MIMIC-IV, across early, best-validation, and final checkpoints. Reconstruction improves with additional context, but training--held-out differences remain small. Trajectory-unique prompts containing limited clinical information produce no excess sensitive disclosure for training patients. In a matched model with random binary patient-level canaries, training-patient label-recovery AUROC increases from 0.512 to 0.549 while held-out recovery remains at chance. An overfit 1,000-patient positive control achieves near-perfect recovery, confirming sensitivity to strong memorisation. These results reveal weak cohort-level memorisation but no reliable patient-level disclosure under the evaluated attacks. They motivate clinically grounded inference-time audits that can detect patient-specific memorisation in existing models without retraining with canaries.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对MIMIC-IV上训练的GPT-2式EHR基础模型，系统评估了推理阶段的训练数据记忆/披露风险；结果显示仅存在弱队列级记忆，在所评估攻击下无可靠的个体患者级披露。
AI.motivation: 自回归EHR基础模型可能在推理时泄露训练信息，但临床预测能力本身使"患者特异记忆"与"泛化"难以区分，缺乏可操作的隐私审计证据。
AI.method: 在MIMIC-IV上训练GPT-2式模型，跨早期、最佳验证、最终三类检查点，评估三类探测：(1)固定窗口token重建；(2)敏感属性披露；(3)随机患者级canary（含匹配模型与1,000患者过拟合阳性对照），以训练vs留出差异与AUROC为指标。
AI.result: 重建随上下文增加而改善，但训练-留出差距很小；含有限临床信息的轨迹唯一提示未产生训练患者的超额敏感披露；canary模型中训练患者标签恢复AUROC由0.512升至0.549、留出保持随机水平；1,000患者过拟合阳性对照接近完美恢复，证明探测具敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 观察到弱队列级记忆但无可靠患者级披露；主张发展"临床接地"的推理时审计方法，无需以canary重训练即可检测现有模型的患者特异记忆。

title: STVLA: Spatial-aware and Temporal-memory forVision-Language-Action Models
summary: Robotic manipulation often requires both spatial scene understanding and task history. However, many vision-language-action (VLA) policies rely primarily on current observations, without explicitly integrating spatial structure and task history. Appearance-based memories can be sensitive to occlusion and viewpoint changes, while spatial representations of the current scene alone do not preserve how the scene has changed during task execution. We introduce STVLA, a framework that incorporates features from a pretrained visual geometry foundation model into temporal memory alongside visual representations. This allows the policy to recall past scene structure as context for current action decisions. To select informative history, STVLA uses a mathematically grounded scoring rule that balances relevance to the current observation with complementary evidence from memory. Across evaluations on LIBERO, LIBERO-Mem, MIKASA-Robo, and SimplerEnv Bridge, STVLA achieves the highest average success rate among the compared methods on each benchmark. On real-world block stacking, object organization, and phone packaging, it improves success over $π_{0.5}$ by $58.33$, $30.00$, and $35.00$ percentage points, respectively. These results support integrating scene geometry into temporal memory to improve manipulation requiring both spatial precision and task history. Project website: \href{https://stvla.github.io/}{https://stvla.github.io/}

AI.tldr: STVLA将预训练视觉几何基础模型的特征引入时序记忆，使VLA策略在动作决策时能回溯过去的场景空间结构，从而兼顾空间精度与任务历史依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略主要依赖当前观测，未显式整合空间结构与任务历史：基于外观的记忆对遮挡和视角变化敏感，而仅用当前场景的空间表示又丢失了任务执行过程中的场景变化信息。
AI.method: 将预训练视觉几何基础模型提取的特征与视觉表示一并存入时序记忆，使策略能以上下文形式回忆过去的场景结构；并采用有数学依据的评分规则选择信息量大的历史，在"与当前观测的相关性"和"来自记忆的互补证据"之间取得平衡。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Mem、MIKASA-Robo和SimplerEnv Bridge上，各基准平均成功率均为对比方法中最高；真实世界积木堆叠、物品整理与手机包装任务上，相较π_{0.5}分别提升58.33、30.00、35.00个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将场景几何整合进时序记忆，可有效提升同时需要空间精度与任务历史的操作任务表现。

title: CoCode-World: Shared 3D Proxy Representation for Multi-Player World Models
summary: Multiplayer generative world models must produce observations that agree on shared entities despite different camera motions and occlusions. Explicit world representations provide spatial control, but precise modeling of individual game maps limits scene diversity, while shared geometry alone cannot ensure consistent appearance across views. We present CoCode-World, a shared 3D proxy framework that separates structural control from visual synthesis for two-player video generation. Programmable proxies specify scene layout, motion, and occlusion, while RGB references guide character and scene appearance. To coordinate visual details across players, we concatenate paired proxy videos, appearance references, and target views in a consistent spatial layout and generate both views jointly with a pretrained video model. This formulation uses the model's native attention for cross-view communication within a single generation branch, with LoRA adaptation learning proxy adherence and appearance correspondence from paired observations. We construct a two-player GTA~V dataset that pairs synchronized RGB observations with proxy videos derived from shared map geometry and game-engine state. Experiments demonstrate appearance transfer to characters and scene styles unseen during training, with improvements in video quality and cross-view player identity over the evaluated baseline. Ablations further examine how proxy construction and cross-view communication affect generation. Project page: https://iapple233.github.io/CCW/.

AI.tldr: 提出 CoCode-World，一种面向双人视频生成的共享 3D proxy 框架，将结构控制与视觉合成解耦：用可编程 proxy 指定场景布局、运动与遮挡，用 RGB 参考指定外观，并将两侧 proxy 视频、外观参考与目标视角按统一空间布局拼接，由预训练视频模型联合生成两路视角，借助原生注意力实现跨视角通信，配合 LoRA 学习 proxy 依从性与外观对应关系。
AI.motivation: 多人生成式世界模型需在相机运动与遮挡不同的情况下，对共享实体产生一致的观测。显式世界表示可提供空间控制，但精确建模每张游戏地图限制场景多样性；仅靠共享几何又无法保证跨视角外观一致。因此需要一个既能提供结构控制、又能保证跨玩家视觉一致性的框架。
AI.method: 1) 共享 3D proxy 作为结构控制：可编程 proxy 编码场景布局、运动与遮挡；2) RGB 参考图提供角色与场景外观引导；3) 将成对的 proxy 视频、外观参考与目标视角按一致的空间布局拼接，用预训练视频模型在单一生成分支中联合生成两路视角，利用模型原生注意力完成跨视角通信；4) 采用 LoRA 适配，从成对观测中学习 proxy 依从性与外观对应关系；5) 构建双人 GTA V 数据集，将同步 RGB 观测与由共享地图几何与游戏引擎状态导出的 proxy 视频配对。
AI.result: 实验表明可实现向训练中未见角色与场景风格的外观迁移，在视频质量与跨视角玩家身份一致性上优于所评估的基线方法；消融实验进一步分析了 proxy 构建方式与跨视角通信机制对生成结果的影响。
AI.conclusion: 将结构控制（共享 3D proxy）与视觉合成分离，并以空间拼接+原生注意力+LoRA 的方式实现跨视角协调，是构建多人一致生成式世界模型的可行且有效路径；proxy 构建与跨视角通信是影响一致性的关键设计因素。

title: HeMeR: Heterogeneous Memory Reconciliation for Embodied Agents via Structured KV Reuse
summary: Embodied agents make decisions by combining information from heterogeneous memory modules, including declarative memory for explicit knowledge, procedural memory for learned routines, and working memory for current observations. During interaction, the memory contents required for decision making change with the agent's state, goal, and task progress, while many contents remain shared across consecutive decisions. However, existing memory modules are typically accessed through separate interfaces, so each updated memory context is often processed as a new input to the foundation model. This prevents selective key-value (KV) cache reuse for unchanged memory contents and forces full KV cache recomputation even when much of the memory context remains valid. We introduce HeMeR, an inference framework that performs KV reconciliation between dynamically updated memory contexts and reusable KV states. HeMeR tracks declarative, procedural, and working memory contents across action decisions, preserves KV states for unchanged contents, and reconciles only the KV states affected by memory-content updates. This enables efficient and stable inference as memory contents evolve during interaction. We evaluate HeMeR on ALFWorld, Habitat, and real-world robotic deployments requiring coordinated use of heterogeneous memory contents. In the real-world setting, HeMeR achieves 83.20% task success and reduces per-step inference time from 2.94 to 1.87 seconds compared with MemRL, while preserving compatible KV states as task progress updates the memory context.

AI.tldr: HeMeR 是一个面向具身智能体的推理框架，通过在动态更新的异构记忆上下文与可复用 KV 状态之间进行"KV 调和"，仅重算受记忆更新影响的 KV，从而在保持任务成功率的同时显著降低每步推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体的决策依赖异构记忆模块（陈述性记忆、程序性记忆、工作记忆），而记忆内容随智能体状态、目标和任务进度动态变化，且相邻决策之间大量内容共享。然而现有记忆模块通过各自独立接口被访问，每次更新后的记忆上下文都被当作全新输入送入基础模型，导致无法对未变化内容进行选择性 KV cache 复用，即使大部分记忆仍然有效也必须完整重算 KV cache，推理开销大。
AI.method: 提出 HeMeR 推理框架，在动态记忆上下文与可复用 KV 状态之间执行 KV 调和（KV reconciliation）：跨动作决策追踪陈述性、程序性、工作记忆的内容，对未变化的内容保留其 KV 状态，仅对受记忆内容更新影响的 KV 状态进行增量重算，从而在记忆演化过程中实现高效且稳定的推理。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld、Habitat 以及需要协同使用异构记忆的真实机器人部署上进行评估。真实场景下 HeMeR 达到 83.20% 的任务成功率，并将单步推理时间从 MemRL 的 2.94 秒降至 1.87 秒，同时在任务推进、记忆上下文更新过程中保持 KV 状态的兼容与复用。
AI.conclusion: 通过选择性地复用与调和 KV cache，HeMeR 缓解了异构记忆频繁更新带来的全量重算瓶颈，在真实机器人任务中同时实现了更高的任务成功率与更低的推理延迟，为记忆驱动的具身智能体提供了高效稳定的推理路径。

title: AI4Plasma II: Geometry-Aware Surrogate Modeling for Variable Electrode Gap GEC Plasmas
summary:
Industrial plasma process development requires broad exploration of operating and geometric parameters. Geometric parameters, particularly electrode spacing, affect discharge structure and processing uniformity. Exploring these parameter spaces through repeated high-fidelity simulations can be computationally expensive. Surrogate models can offer rapid predictions, but geometric variation complicates their application because the computational domain and discretization may change across samples.
  In this work, six geometry-aware surrogate models based on prescribed and learned geometry mappings, extended-domain representation, continuous coordinates, and geometry-native discretizations are compared in terms of their data requirements for accurate predictions of full plasma fields and ion density profiles near the wafer. The simulation dataset spans pressure, voltage, frequency, and electrode gap, with each reference case requiring an average simulation cost of 5.32 CPU h.
  To achieve a 2% mean error across the four plasma fields, prescribed-mapping Geo-FNO and Transolver require 100 training cases, compared with 250-1000 for the other models. Predicting ion density profiles near the wafer is more demanding and reveals larger differences among models, with prescribed-mapping Geo-FNO requiring the fewest training cases for the profile accuracy targets considered. To further reduce the data required for accurate predictions near the wafer, we introduce charge-separation weighting into the training loss, which reduces the prescribed-mapping Geo-FNO's minimum tested training requirement for a 5% profile error from 1000 to 100 cases.
  These results support prescribed-mapping Geo-FNO as a practical starting point for the variable-gap problem studied here when a suitable geometry mapping is available, while Transolver achieves the highest prediction accuracy with sufficient training data.

AI.tldr: 本文对比六种几何感知代理模型在工业等离子体变电极间距问题上的数据需求：预设映射Geo-FNO与Transolver在100例即可达2%全场平均误差；引入电荷分离加权损失后，预设映射Geo-FNO达到5%离子密度剖面误差所需训练样本从1000降至100。
AI.motivation: 工业等离子体工艺开发需在压力、电压、频率与电极间距等宽广参数空间中寻优，高保真仿真单例平均耗时5.32 CPU h，代价高昂；代理模型可快速预测，但几何参数变化会导致计算域与离散方式随之改变，传统代理模型难以直接适用。
AI.method: 构建覆盖压力、电压、频率与电极间距的等离子体仿真数据集，比较六类几何感知代理模型：预设几何映射、学习式几何映射、扩展域表示、连续坐标表示与几何原生离散（含Geo-FNO、Transolver等）。以训练样本数为数据需求指标，评估全场四类等离子体物理场与近晶圆离子密度剖面的预测精度；并在训练损失中引入电荷分离加权以强化近晶圆区域拟合。
AI.result: 达到四类场2%平均误差时，预设映射Geo-FNO与Transolver仅需100个训练案例，其余模型需250–1000例；近晶圆离子密度剖面预测难度更高、模型间差异更大，预设映射Geo-FNO在给定剖面精度目标下所需样本最少；加入电荷分离加权后，其达到5%剖面误差的最低测试训练量由1000例降至100例。
AI.conclusion: 当可获得合适几何映射时，预设映射Geo-FNO可作为变间距问题的实用起点；若训练数据充足，Transolver可获得最高预测精度。

title: Reins: Frontier Multimodal Models Driving Real Robot Arms on Long-Horizon Tasks, Zero-Shot
summary: Frontier models such as GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 can now plan and call tools, yet they still struggle to drive real robots through long-horizon, contact-rich manipulation, blind while the arm moves and while they think. We present Reins, a harness in which an off-the-shelf model operates a dual-arm robot with 3D perception tools and atomic actions that report contact and grip. The model chains actions in one call, each with a condition that must hold, stopping at the first that fails; a second instance, the narrator, watches the cameras continuously and reports what changed with every result. From images, Reins also builds a simulation-ready twin of the scene for continual policy learning. With natural-language prompts and no task-specific code, GPT-6.1 Sol succeeds in 88% of real episodes on five tasks; without the harness, it fails every shell game, taking 8 times as long. Three frontier models perform alike but differ in tracking a scene that changes while the actor thinks. Code will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出 Reins：让现成前沿模型通过 3D 感知工具与原子动作操作双臂机器人，并用"执行者—解说者"双实例与仿真孪生实现长程接触丰富操作。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型已能规划与调用工具，但在真实机器人上仍难以完成长程、接触丰富的操作：机械臂运动与模型思考期间存在"盲区"，无法感知场景变化。
AI.method: Reins 框架：外挂式模型配备 3D 感知工具和可回报接触与夹持状态的原子动作；模型在单次调用中串联动作，每个动作附必须成立的前置条件，首个失败即停止；第二个实例"解说者"持续观察相机并在每次结果后报告变化；由图像构建可仿真的场景孪生用于持续策略学习。
AI.result: 仅用自然语言提示、无任务专用代码，GPT-6.1 Sol 在五类任务的真实回合中成功率达 88%；无该框架时全部 shell game 失败且耗时增至 8 倍。三个前沿模型表现相近，但在"执行者思考期间场景持续变化"的跟踪能力上存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 通过工具化感知、条件化动作链与并行解说者，可弥合前沿模型与真实长程操作之间的鸿沟；代码将在论文发表后开源。

title: Contrastive Bootstrap Representation Learning for Label-Efficient Agricultural Image Classification
summary: Expert annotation remains a major bottleneck in agricultural image classification, where collecting images is often easier than obtaining reliable labels from domain specialists. Self-supervised learning can reduce this dependence by pretraining transferable representations on unlabelled imagery. Contrastive and bootstrap methods provide two established but distinct training signals, motivating an empirical study of a formulation that applies both signals within one representation path under severe downstream label scarcity. We present Contrastive Bootstrap Representation Learning (CBRL), which jointly optimises SimCLR-style NT-Xent contrastive learning and bidirectional BYOL-style exponential-moving-average target prediction within a shared online projection space. Using a ViT-L/16 backbone and 10% of the downstream labels, we report single-seed point estimates on four primary agricultural test benchmarks plus an exploratory 33-image New Plant Diseases evaluation. CBRL records the highest macro-F1 point estimate on the four primary benchmarks. On DeepWeeds, its 79.77% test macro-F1 is 32.29 points above the random-initialisation, label-only baseline and 15.78 points above the next-highest comparison point estimate; on PlantVillage, its 98.14% macro-F1 is 10.43 and 0.43 points higher, respectively. On PlantDoc, however, all methods fail to reach practically useful performance. These results identify the evaluated joint formulation as a promising candidate for label-limited transfer, but they do not establish objective synergy, statistical superiority, or robustness across stochastic runs.

AI.tldr: 提出CBRL，将SimCLR式NT-Xent对比损失与BYOL式双向EMA目标预测联合优化于共享在线投影空间，在ViT-L/16骨干与10%下游标签条件下，于四个农业基准取得最高macro-F1点估计，但仅为单种子结果，未证实统计优越性。
AI.motivation: 农业图像分类中专家标注是主要瓶颈：采集图像容易，获得专家可靠标签困难。自监督学习可利用无标注图像预训练可迁移表征以降低标签依赖。对比学习与bootstrap（自蒸馏）两类训练信号各自成熟但相互独立，作者希望在同一表征路径中统一二者，并考察在极端下游标签稀缺下的表现。
AI.method: 提出Contrastive Bootstrap Representation Learning（CBRL）：在共享的在线投影空间中联合优化两部分损失——SimCLR风格的NT-Xent对比学习，以及BYOL风格的双向（bidirectional）EMA目标预测。骨干为ViT-L/16，下游仅使用10%标签进行微调/评估。评测对象为四个主要农业测试基准，并附加一个仅含33张图像的New Plant Diseases探索性评估。所有结果均为单随机种子点估计，与随机初始化标签监督基线及若干对比方法比较。
AI.result: CBRL在四个主要基准上取得最高的macro-F1点估计。DeepWeeds上测试macro-F1为79.77%，比随机初始化、仅用标签的基线高32.29个百分点，比次高对比方法高15.78个百分点；PlantVillage上为98.14%，分别高出10.43和0.43个百分点。但在PlantDoc上，所有方法均未达到实际可用性能。
AI.conclusion: 所评估的联合表述是标签受限迁移场景下的一个有前景的候选方案；但结果不足以证明两种信号之间存在客观协同效应，也无法确立统计显著性或在多次随机运行下的稳健性。单种子点估计、PlantDoc上的整体失败以及33张图像的探索性评估均限制了结论强度。

title: Time and Space: A Dual-Axis, Evidence-Grounded Context Substrate for Personal Agents
summary: We argue that a binding constraint for personal agents is not model capacity but the form in which context is represented: the agent does not know which entity a phrase denotes, when a fact held, or which source record licenses a claim. We call the missing representation spatio-temporal context (STC) and define it on two axes. The temporal axis carries event time, validity intervals and ingestion time. The spatial axis is a relational space in which entities are points, typed relations are edges, and distance is semantic rather than geographic; physical places are one entity type among many. Every relation is anchored to immutable source records, and every answer must be closed over those records. We formalise the substrate and six invariants, a context operator that composes temporal intersection with relational expansion, an ambiguity-preserving resolution state machine, a conflict detector that converts mutually exclusive facts into user adjudication rather than silent overwrite, and a four-regime consumption taxonomy spanning query, insight, triage and proactive reminder. We describe a local-first prototype of the retrieval layer built on SQLite with on-device embeddings and hybrid lexical-dense recall, report measurements from a deployed store of 341 documents, 340,079 chunks and 190,271 embedded vectors, and specify, but do not yet implement, the analytic layer on which the framework depends. We close with an evaluation protocol with per-invariant metrics for evidence coverage, temporal correctness, conflict precision and interruption cost. The proposal targets the representation of context rather than the volume of it.

AI.tldr: 论文主张个人代理的瓶颈在于上下文表示形式而非模型容量，提出"时空上下文"(STC)表示：时间轴含事件时间、有效期与摄入时间，空间轴为语义关系空间（实体为点、类型化关系为边），所有关系锚定不可变源记录。给出形式化基底与六条不变量、上下文算子、保歧义消解状态机、冲突检测器及四类消费分类，并基于SQLite构建本地优先检索原型（341文档、340,079块、190,271向量）进行测量。
AI.motivation: 个人代理的根本约束不是模型容量，而是上下文表示方式：代理无法确定短语指称哪个实体、事实成立于何时、哪条源记录为陈述背书，因此需要一种显式的时空上下文表示来消除这种指称与时效模糊。
AI.method: 将STC定义在时间轴（事件时间、有效区间、摄入时间）与空间轴（关系空间：实体为点、类型化关系为边、距离为语义距离）两维上；形式化基底并给出六条不变量；设计由时间交集与关系扩展复合而成的上下文算子、保歧义消解状态机、将互斥事实转为用户裁决的冲突检测器，以及覆盖查询、洞察、分诊、主动提醒的四类消费分类；实现基于SQLite、端侧嵌入与混合词法-稠密召回的原型。
AI.result: 在部署存储上报告测量：341份文档、340,079个块、190,271个嵌入向量；分析层仅作规格说明尚未实现；提出含证据覆盖、时间正确性、冲突精确率与打断成本的分不变量评估协议。
AI.conclusion: 应关注上下文的表示而非其体量；以源记录锚定与不变量约束的STC基底为个人代理提供可追溯、保歧义、可裁决的上下文基础，后续需实现分析层并完成实证评估。

title: Imputing Missing Near-Surface Air Temperature using Graph Attention Networks with Distance-Aware Edge Features
summary: We introduce a graph attention network for reconstructing near-surface air temperature fields from incomplete observations. The model represents each grid cell as a node connected to its $k$ nearest neighbors, with attention weights that depend on node features, distance, and land-ocean transitions. This graph representation avoids the polar distortions associated with treating the globe as a flat latitude-longitude image, as most deep learning reconstruction methods do. This is particularly relevant for historical temperature records, which extend back to the mid-nineteenth century but remain incomplete, with the largest gaps early in the record and at high latitudes. We train our model on CMIP6 CESM2 historical simulations masked with the time-varying HadCRUT5 observational coverage from 1850 to 2014. We then compare our approach with ordinary kriging, GraphEM, and the LaMa inpainting network on a held-out realization. The graph model achieves the lowest spatial RMSE (0.997 K), 10.1% lower than LaMa and approximately 31% lower than kriging and GraphEM. The largest gains occur in the Arctic and Antarctic, while LaMa remains slightly more accurate in the densely observed tropics. The graph model's error also falls faster as coverage increases, so its advantage over LaMa grows by more than a third from the 1850s to the 2000s. An ablation study shows that the model's skill comes mainly from the geometric graph construction rather than from auxiliary physical covariates.

AI.tldr: 提出基于图注意力网络的近地面气温场重建方法，将网格单元建模为节点并连接 k 近邻，避免经纬度图像的极区畸变，在稀疏历史观测下优于克里金、GraphEM 与 LaMa 插补网络。
AI.motivation: 历史气温记录可追溯至19世纪中叶但严重不完整，早期与高纬地区缺测尤甚。主流深度学习重建方法把地球视为平面经纬度图像，导致极区几何畸变，不适配稀疏且分布不均的观测覆盖。
AI.method: 构建图注意力网络：每个网格单元为节点，与 k 个最近邻相连；注意力权重由节点特征、距离及海陆过渡共同决定。以 CMIP6 CESM2 历史模拟为训练数据，并用 1850–2014 年随时间变化的 HadCRUT5 观测覆盖掩膜。在留出实现上与普通克里金、GraphEM 及 LaMa 图像修复网络对比，并进行消融实验。
AI.result: 图模型取得最低空间 RMSE（0.997 K），较 LaMa 低 10.1%，较克里金与 GraphEM 低约 31%。增益最大出现在北极与南极；在观测密集的热带，LaMa 略优。随覆盖度提高，图模型误差下降更快，其相对 LaMa 的优势从 1850 年代到 2000 年代扩大逾三分之一。消融表明性能主要来自几何图构建而非辅助物理协变量。
AI.conclusion: 几何图构建是重建技能的核心来源，图注意力网络为稀疏、非均匀覆盖下的历史气温场重建提供了优于传统统计插值与图像修复方法的方案，尤其适用于极区与早期低覆盖时段。

title: Rethinking Actions: Continuity-Aware Priors for World-Model Planning
summary: Actions in expert demonstrations exhibit temporal structure. An ordered-versus-shuffled analysis across five environments confirms this dependence. We ask whether action proposals that better reflect expert continuity can improve visual world-model planning. Rather than imposing generic smoothness, we learn continuations from the temporal structure of demonstrated actions. Our locality-gated deep-kernel Gaussian-process prior, LG-DKGP, combines recent and longer-range executed action history, predicts a neural continuation, and learns a temporal Gaussian-process (GP) residual. A training-derived exploration scale initializes search around the corrected mean; a frozen world model evaluates progress toward the goal. Training first fits the neural mean, then jointly optimizes the prior with the GP residual using expert future actions. The resulting planner achieves 87.07\% macro success across five simulated tasks spanning native and fragment-level goal attainment, compared with 71.03\% for INTACT, 61.66\% for PRISM, and 58.66\% for LeWM. Component interventions and expert-relative action-structure comparisons support demonstration-informed continuations and reveal task-dependent effects of visual conditioning, history length, and planning horizon.

AI.tldr: 提出局部性门控的深度核高斯过程先验（LG-DKGP），从专家示范动作的时间结构学习动作续接，用于视觉世界模型规划；在五个模拟任务上取得87.07%宏观成功率，显著优于INTACT（71.03%）、PRISM（61.66%）和LeWM（58.66%）。
AI.motivation: 专家示范中的动作具有时间结构（有序vs打乱分析已在五个环境验证），而现有视觉世界模型规划器未利用这种示范连续性；作者希望以示范驱动的方式替代通用平滑性约束，从而改进规划质量。
AI.method: 构建LG-DKGP先验：融合近期与较长跨度已执行动作历史，用神经网络预测动作续接作为均值，再学习时间高斯过程（GP）残差进行校正；以训练集推导的探索尺度在修正均值附近初始化搜索，用冻结的世界模型评估目标进展；训练分两阶段，先拟合神经均值，再利用专家未来动作联合优化GP残差先验。
AI.result: 五个模拟任务（涵盖原生长程与片段级目标达成）宏观成功率87.07%，对比INTACT 71.03%、PRISM 61.66%、LeWM 58.66%；组件干预与相对专家的动作结构比较支持示范驱动续接的有效性，并揭示视觉条件、历史长度与规划时域的任务相关影响。
AI.conclusion: 示范动作的时间结构是可利用的规划先验，局部门控的深度核GP先验能有效提升视觉世界模型规划性能，但视觉条件、历史长度、规划时域等设计选择的效果依赖于具体任务。

title: Speed-to-Power Dominates Energy Costs for AI Data Centers: Technoeconomic Analysis of Powering AI in the Continental United States
summary: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence is driving demand for new data centers at large scale and on short deployment timelines. To power them, firms connect to the commercial grid or contract generation directly, but interconnection and gas-turbine delays now incentivize on-site generation. We compare grid-connected and off-grid data center energy infrastructure (AC- and DC-coupled solar-plus-storage, islanded natural gas, and grid interconnection) across the continental U.S. Using an open-source technoeconomic framework built on empirically calibrated AI training loads, climate-driven cooling, stage-by-stage power conversion, and physics-based battery degradation, we model designs providing equivalent energy services. Our central contribution is a speed-adjusted cost of energy that values the compute unlocked by faster construction, making options with different deployment timelines directly comparable on one physically consistent basis. We find DC coupling reduces lifetime energy costs by 18% ($0.09/ kWh) on average versus AC counterparts by eliminating inverters and improving efficiency. Though rarely cheapest on unadjusted energy cost, DC-coupled microgrids' faster deployment makes them the lowest-cost modeled option in 85% of U.S. locations once foregone compute is valued, or 55% under accelerated natural gas timelines. For AI infrastructure, deployment speed rather than unit energy cost determines the economically preferred path to power.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"速度调整后的度电成本"（speed-adjusted cost of energy），将更快部署所释放的算力价值纳入统一物理口径，比较美国本土并网与离网数据中心供能方案；结果显示直流耦合光储微电网虽在未调整成本上极少最便宜，但因部署更快，在85%的美国选址中成为最低成本方案（天然气加速部署情形下为55%）。
AI.motivation: AI训练负荷规模大、上线周期短，而电网互联排队与燃气轮机交付延迟使在站发电更具吸引力；现有技术经济比较多以平准化度电成本为指标，无法反映不同建设周期对算力收益的时间价值差异，导致方案选择失真。
AI.method: 构建开源技术经济框架，采用经验校准的AI训练负荷曲线、气候驱动制冷、逐级功率变换损耗与基于物理机理的电池衰减模型，对并网与离网方案（交流耦合与直流耦合光储、孤岛天然气、电网互联）进行等效能量服务建模；核心指标为将提前投产所解锁算力货币化的速度调整度电成本，使不同部署周期的方案可在同一物理一致口径下比较。
AI.result: 直流耦合相比交流耦合平均降低全生命周期能量成本18%（约0.09美元/kWh），源于省去逆变器并提升效率；在未调整度电成本下直流耦合微电网极少最低，但计入算力机会成本后，在85%的美国选址中为最低成本方案，在加速天然气交付情形下仍达55%。
AI.conclusion: 对AI基础设施而言，决定经济最优供能路径的是部署速度而非单位能量成本；速度调整度电成本为跨建设周期方案提供了可比的决策框架，直流耦合微电网因快速部署具备显著优势。

title: Learning-Based Interpolation of Detector Gaps in Photon-Counting X-ray Imaging
summary: Image detectors assembled from tiled modules have physical gaps in the field of view that must be filled before downstream processing such as phase retrieval or tomographic reconstruction. Unlike natural-image inpainting, detector-gap interpolation must leave all other pixels unmodified and preserve the intensity statistics of the filled region, since even a small shift in mean intensity can cause ring artifacts after reconstruction. We adapted two generative models, a Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty (WGAN-GP) and a conditional Pix2Pix model, to this task. We implemented a masking strategy that restricts all changes to the gap pixels and loss terms that constrain the mean intensity and the intensity distribution of the filled region. Both models were trained on nanoCT projections with simulated gaps and compared with linear interpolation, Navier--Stokes inpainting, and the deep image-inpainting network MADF, quantitatively on simulated gaps and visually on real detector gaps. WGAN-GP and Pix2Pix achieved the best perceptual similarity (LPIPS) and histogram distance and, apart from linear interpolation, the shortest inference time. Pix2Pix required about five times fewer training GPU-hours than WGAN-GP. Ablation studies showed that masking the network output contributes by far the most to plausible inpainting results. Applied to sinograms, Pix2Pix produced the most natural gap filling but improved the reconstruction only slightly compared with linear interpolation. The source code and the weights of the final Pix2Pix model are available at https://github.com/J-3TO/detectorGapRemoval_Pix2Pix.

AI.tldr: 针对拼接式探测器视场物理缝隙的填补任务，作者将WGAN-GP与条件Pix2Pix两种生成模型改造为"仅修改缝隙像素"的受限修复框架，在nanoCT投影上与线性插值、Navier–Stokes及MADF对比，Pix2Pix在LPIPS与直方图距离上最优且训练成本约为WGAN-GP的1/5。
AI.motivation: 拼接模块化探测器在视场内存在物理缝隙，必须在相位恢复、层析重建等下游处理前填补。与自然图像修复不同，该任务要求非缝隙像素完全不变，且须保持填充区域的强度统计特性——均值强度的微小偏移都会在重建后引发环状伪影。
AI.method: 将WGAN-GP（带梯度惩罚）与条件Pix2Pix两种生成模型适配至该任务；采用掩码策略将网络输出修改严格限制在缝隙像素上；引入约束填充区域均值强度与强度分布的损失项；在含模拟缝隙的nanoCT投影上训练，并与线性插值、Navier–Stokes修复和深度修复网络MADF进行定量（模拟缝隙）与定性（真实探测器缝隙）比较；开展消融实验。
AI.result: WGAN-GP与Pix2Pix取得最佳感知相似度（LPIPS）与直方图距离，推理时间仅次于线性插值；Pix2Pix训练所需GPU小时约为WGAN-GP的1/5。消融显示对网络输出做掩码对修复合理性贡献最大。用于正弦图时，Pix2Pix填充最自然，但相较线性插值对重建质量的提升有限。
AI.conclusion: 掩码约束是保证"仅修补缝隙、保持强度统计"的关键设计，Pix2Pix在质量与训练成本间取得最佳折衷；但其对最终重建的增益仍有限，提示缝隙修复指标与重建指标之间存在差距。代码与Pix2Pix权重已开源。

title: ReA-Bench: Benchmarking Responsible Agent Auditing
summary:
As agents perform tasks autonomously in local and cloud environments, auditing their execution trajectories can help service providers identify risks and improve agent harnesses and foundation models. Our analysis of production and red-team trajectories shows that some risks are repeatedly missed across auditing configurations. Overall recall obscures which risks are missed and whether higher recall comes with more false positives on legitimate behavior. Existing benchmarks offer limited insight into these failures. Generated trajectories can contain inconsistent tool calls and responses, conspicuous risky actions, or repetitive attack patterns. Grouping results by risk type also makes it difficult to tell whether auditors overlooked evidence, accepted an unsupported conclusion, or lacked information needed to make a judgment.
  We introduce ReA-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for auditing responsible agent behavior. It organizes auditing challenges into six tiers: internal safety knowledge, contradictions within trajectories, evidence retrieval in long contexts, verification of sources and reasoning, indirect steering, and missing information. It includes challenging benign cases in which actions resemble risky ones but are consistent with the task and its authorization. It also provides paired trajectory versions to test whether auditors detect the same risks more reliably when the trajectory is shortened or missing information is supplied. Most samples are drawn from real production trajectories, with scenarios manually selected and adapted to preserve realistic tasks and risks that could plausibly arise during execution.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ReA-Bench，一个面向"负责任智能体行为审计"的诊断型基准，按六个层级组织审计挑战，包含与风险行为形似的困难良性样例及配对轨迹版本，以揭示现有审计配置具体漏掉哪些风险、是否以误报为代价换取召回。
AI.motivation: 生产与红队轨迹分析显示，部分风险在不同审计配置下被反复遗漏；总体召回率掩盖了"漏掉哪类风险"以及"高召回是否伴随对合法行为的更多误报"。现有基准对这类失效缺乏洞察：生成轨迹常含不一致的工具调用与响应、显眼的风险动作或重复的攻击模式；按风险类型分组的结果也难以区分审计者是忽略了证据、接受了无支撑的结论，还是缺少判断所需信息。
AI.method: 构建 ReA-Bench 诊断基准，将审计挑战划分为六个层级：(1) 内部安全知识；(2) 轨迹内部矛盾；(3) 长上下文中的证据检索；(4) 来源与推理的验证；(5) 间接引导；(6) 信息缺失。基准纳入具有挑战性的良性样例——其动作与风险动作相似但与任务及授权一致；并提供成对的轨迹版本（缩短轨迹或补全缺失信息），以检验审计者在何种条件下能更可靠地识别同一风险。多数样本取自真实生产轨迹，场景经人工筛选与改编以保留真实任务及执行中可能出现的风险。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，主要贡献为基准设计与数据构建：通过六层级挑战分解、困难良性对照与配对轨迹变体，使审计失败可归因到具体能力维度，并可分别度量漏检与误报。
AI.conclusion: ReA-Bench 提供了超越总体召回的细粒度诊断能力，支持服务提供方定位审计短板、改进 agent harness 与基础模型，并为负责任智能体行为审计建立更具区分度的评测框架。

title: Are Scaling Laws of Universal MLIPs Universal?
summary: Neural scaling laws enable the prediction of returns from larger training datasets, but machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP) datasets are heterogeneous and expensive to generate, and equal numbers of structures need not contain equal amounts of useful information. We study data scaling under fixed model configurations for M3GNet, MACE, and PET trained on subsets of a combined MatPES-MP-ALOE training pool. Across training structure subsets from 10,000 to 640,000, together with the full 1.16-million-structure training set, we compare uniform random sampling, three chemistry- and structure-informed stratification policies, iterative DIRECT, and furthest-point sampling using embeddings from three pretrained MLIPs. Models are evaluated using cohesive-energy, force, stress, and aggregate losses on both a held-out test set from the parent distribution and the distribution shifted MP-r$^2$SCAN test set. We observe power-law scaling improvements with increasing data, but the fitted scaling exponent, apparent error floor, and relative sample efficiency depend on the model architecture, target quantity, data sampling policy, and test set distribution. Sampling-policy rankings can reverse across test distributions: chemical stratification can improve cross-dataset performance while degrading in-distribution performance, whereas the embedding-space diversity policies frequently under-perform random sampling. Relative loss is strongly associated with test-to-train chemical-space divergence. These results show that structure count is a necessary but insufficient scaling variable for MLIPs. For training MLIPs, the return on additional first-principles calculations depends not only on how many additional structures are included, but also on how their chemical and configurational content aligns with the model's intended use.

AI.tldr: 在MatPES-MP-ALOE合并训练池上，对M3GNet、MACE、PET三种模型比较均匀随机采样、三种化学/结构分层策略、迭代DIRECT与基于预训练MLIP嵌入的最远点采样，发现MLIP数据缩放呈现幂律改进，但缩放指数、误差底、样本效率及采样策略排序均依赖模型架构、目标量、采样策略与测试分布；结构数量是必要但非充分的缩放变量。
AI.motivation: 神经缩放律可用于预测增大训练数据集的收益，但MLIP数据集异质且生成昂贵，相同数量的结构未必含相同信息量；需厘清数据采样策略与数据量对MLIP性能的联合影响。
AI.method: 固定模型配置，在MatPES-MP-ALOE合并训练池的10,000至640,000结构子集及完整116万结构集上训练M3GNet、MACE、PET；对比均匀随机采样、三种化学与结构信息驱动的分层策略、迭代DIRECT、以及基于三个预训练MLIP嵌入的最远点采样；在父分布留出测试集和分布漂移的MP-r²SCAN测试集上，用内聚能、力、应力及综合损失评估。
AI.result: 随数据量增加呈幂律性能改进，但拟合的缩放指数、表观误差底和相对样本效率随模型架构、目标量、采样策略与测试分布而变；采样策略排序可在不同测试分布间反转——化学分层可提升跨数据集性能却损害同分布性能，嵌入空间多样性策略常劣于随机采样；相对损失与测试-训练化学空间差异度强相关。
AI.conclusion: 结构数量是MLIP缩放的充分必要变量中的必要而非充分条件；训练MLIP时，增加第一性原理计算的回报不仅取决于新增结构数量，还取决于其化学与构型内容同模型预期用途的匹配程度。

title: NSDL: Neuro-Symbolic Division of Labor for Multi-Robot Task Planning
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to ICRA 2027
summary: Planning for a heterogeneous robot team from a scene image and an instruction involves two kinds of decisions. Some must be judged from the scene: which goals are already met, how the task splits, and which robot does what. Others follow from these and can be computed: prerequisite actions, handoffs between robots, and timing. We argue that each kind should go to the component suited to it: a small vision-language model learns the first, and a deterministic solver computes the second. In NSDL (Neuro-Symbolic Division of Labor), the trained model writes its judgments as a plan sketch, which lists the goals that still need action and the intended steps in order, each with a robot. The solver expands the sketch into an executable joint plan. The model calls two tools, a detector for evidence and the solver, and is trained with the solver in the loop. We evaluate on the public VIKI-L2 benchmark and on LOCUS-Bench, a new benchmark that grades the two kinds of difficulty separately. NSDL outperforms end-to-end planners and formalize-then-plan baselines on both benchmarks and with three backbones from 3B to 8B; the 7B model reaches 97.0% out-of-distribution accuracy on VIKI-L2. Ordering and scheduling errors nearly disappear once the solver writes the structure; the remaining failures are misjudged states, and most goals the model misses are ones it never lists. Code, model weights, and LOCUS-Bench are publicly available at https://github.com/Xincheng-Tan/NSDL.

AI.tldr: 提出NSDL神经-符号分工框架：由小型视觉语言模型仅输出"计划草图"（待完成目标、有序步骤及各步骤执行机器人），再由确定性求解器将其展开为可执行的联合计划；模型通过调用检测器与求解器两个工具、并以求解器在环方式训练。
AI.motivation: 异构机器人团队依据场景图像与指令规划时，涉及两类决策：一类必须从场景判断（哪些目标已达成、任务如何分解、哪个机器人做什么），另一类可由前者推导计算（前置动作、机器人间接力、时序）。作者主张应将两类决策分别交给各自擅长的组件，而非全部由端到端模型承担。
AI.method: NSDL将决策分工：小型视觉语言模型学习场景相关判断，并以"计划草图"形式输出——列出仍需动作的目标与按顺序排列的预期步骤，每步标注执行机器人；确定性求解器据此补全前置动作、接力与时序，扩展为可执行联合计划。模型可调用两个工具（用于提供证据的检测器、以及求解器），并采用求解器在环的训练方式。
AI.result: 在公开VIKI-L2基准及新提出的LOCUS-Bench（分别对两类难度打分）上，NSDL在3B至8B三种骨干模型下均优于端到端规划器与"先形式化再规划"基线；7B模型在VIKI-L2上取得97.0%的分布外准确率。由求解器负责结构生成后，排序与调度类错误几乎消失，剩余失败主要是状态误判，且模型漏掉的目标多为其从未列出的目标。
AI.conclusion: 将"需判断"与"可计算"的决策显式分离，让小型视觉语言模型只做场景判断、求解器保证结构正确性，是提升异构机器人团队规划可靠性、降低顺序与调度错误的有效范式；残余瓶颈在于模型对场景状态的正确识别与目标覆盖。代码、模型权重与LOCUS-Bench已公开。

title: WaveletLoRA: Frequency-Aware Content-Style Decomposition for Personalized Image Generation
summary: Content-style decomposition from a single image is a fundamental challenge in personalized image generation, aiming to separate subject identity from visual style for flexible recomposition. Existing approaches primarily operate in the spatial domain, without explicitly exploiting the distinct frequency characteristics naturally associated with content and style. In this paper, we propose WaveletLoRA, a novel frequency-aware framework for explicit content-style decomposition through wavelet-domain supervision. Specifically, we first apply a multi-level discrete wavelet transform (DWT) to decompose the reference image into low-frequency and high-frequency subbands. We then assign a dedicated LoRA branch to each subband, where the low-frequency branch models global appearance for style acquisition, while the high-frequency branches capture structural details for content preservation. To further improve disentanglement quality, we introduce a dense Mixture-of-Experts aggregation module together with a frequency-domain regularization objective, which reduces style leakage and enhance content fidelity. In addition, we establish WaveBench and develop a VLM-based evaluation protocol that explicitly measures both attribute similarity and attribute separation for disentanglement assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that WaveletLoRA consistently outperforms existing methods and produces results that better align with human preference.

AI.tldr: 提出WaveletLoRA，一种基于小波域监督的频率感知框架，实现单图的内容-风格解耦与重组。
AI.motivation: 现有单图内容-风格解耦方法主要在空间域操作，未显式利用内容与风格天然对应的频率特性差异。
AI.method: 对参考图做多级离散小波变换(DWT)分解为低频/高频子带；每个子带配一个专属LoRA分支，低频分支建模全局外观以获取风格，高频分支捕获结构细节以保留内容；引入稠密Mixture-of-Experts聚合模块与频域正则目标，减少风格泄漏并提升内容保真度；同时构建WaveBench数据集及基于VLM的评测协议，显式度量属性相似性与属性分离度。
AI.result: 大量实验表明WaveletLoRA持续优于现有方法，生成结果更符合人类偏好。
AI.conclusion: 频率域监督是实现显式内容-风格解耦的有效途径，子带专属性LoRA分支结合MoE聚合与频域正则可显著提升解耦质量。

title: How many LLM-labelled rows does a decision encoder need, and how wrong can the labels be?
summary: A decision encoder such as Laya reads a question with named options (for example, which department should handle a ticket) and a text, and picks an option. It reads both in one forward pass and returns a probability for every option, without writing any text. We ask how many LLM-written training rows such an encoder needs and how wrong those labels may be. We ran 19 fine-tunes of Laya (ModernBERT-large) on nested subsets of a 2,818-row pool and scored them on 1,065 held-out items from the same generator, so every test item is in-distribution and no out-of-family test was run. Accuracy rises from 69.4% before fine-tuning to 74.3% with 5% of the rows, 84.8% with 50% and 86.9% with all rows. The curve flattens, and a saturating fit with bootstrap intervals cannot pin down its plateau. Seed spread at 20% of the rows (s.d. 1.6 points) exceeds some of the steps between sizes. Giving small subsets as many updates as the full pool gains 1.9 points at 5% and 1.9 points at 20% of the rows (one seed; p=0.14 and 0.13), and at 20% that is below the 2.3-point difference between two ordinary seeds. A single run with 10% symmetric label noise shows no detectable change (-0.2 points, 95% interval -1.7 to +1.4); 20% costs 3.4 points and 40% costs 8.7 points. Confusable-pair noise at 20% costs 7.4 points, and under noise the model moves from over-confident to under-confident. An independent labeller disagrees with the gold labels on 3.5% of held-out items, and about half of its choice disagreements (16 of 33, leaving each item out of the partner map) name the partner option that the confusable-pair noise uses. Laya is +0.9 points ahead of a TF-IDF classifier trained on the same rows at full size (the interval includes zero) and +21.1 points ahead at 5% of the rows. Everything is synthetic, LLM-labelled and from one backbone, one trainer and mostly one seed.

AI.tldr: 决策编码器Laya（ModernBERT-large）在2,818行LLM标注池上做19次嵌套子集微调，准确率从69.4%升至全量86.9%，但曲线饱和、平台难定；10%对称标签噪声无显著影响，20%/40%分别降3.4/8.7点；全部为合成数据、单一骨干与单一训练器。
AI.motivation: 探究无生成式输出的决策编码器（Laya，读取问题+命名选项+文本，一次前向即输出各选项概率）究竟需要多少LLM撰写的训练行、以及标签允许多大错误率，从而为低成本数据标注策略提供定量依据。
AI.method: 在2,818行池的嵌套子集上做19次微调，于同生成器的1,065条同分布留出集上评估（无族外测试）；用带bootstrap区间的饱和曲线拟合估计平台；考察固定更新次数对比、种子方差、10%/20%/40%对称标签噪声与"易混淆对"噪声（含置信度校准变化）；并用独立标注者复核（留一伙伴映射）验证混淆对与真实分歧的一致性；与同数据TF-IDF基线对比。
AI.result: 准确率：未微调69.4% → 5%行74.3% → 50%行84.8% → 全量86.9%，曲线趋平但平台不可精确确定；20%行处种子标准差1.6点，超过部分规模间差距；小规模补足更新次数仅提升1.9点（p=0.14/0.13，单种子），且小于普通种子间2.3点差异；对称噪声10%无显著变化（−0.2，95%CI −1.7~+1.4），20%降3.4点、40%降8.7点；20%易混淆对噪声降7.4点，且模型由过度自信转为欠自信；独立标注者与金标分歧3.5%，其选择分歧中16/33对应混淆对噪声所用伙伴选项；全量下Laya仅领先TF-IDF 0.9点（区间含0），5%行时领先21.1点。
AI.conclusion: 决策编码器对少量LLM标注行即可获得大部分收益，但对标签噪声较敏感（约10%对称噪声可容忍，易混淆对噪声危害显著）、且小数据下的增益常被种子方差淹没；结论受合成数据、单一骨干/训练器/多种子缺失所限，需外部验证。

title: FADO: Learning Causal Explanations with Prior-Fitted Networks
summary: In regression and classification tasks with tabular datasets, most of the literature on explanation in ML (e.g. SHAP, permutation importance) has focused on predictive attribution: does feature $X_i$ help predict outcome $Y$? At its heart, predictive attribution captures correlation, not causation. We instead ask a causal question: would manipulating feature $X_i$ change outcome $Y$? We define a natural quantity to answer this question, the feature intervention effect: $Δ_i = E[Y\mid do(X_i=+1)]-E[Y\mid do(X_i=-1)]$. In general, estimating this quantity from observational data alone would entail strong causal assumptions. We propose FADO (Feature-wise Amortized Do-Operators), an amortized inference method using prior-fitted networks trained on synthetic tabular datasets generated by structural causal models. During training, the synthetic data-generating process is known, so we can compute ground-truth intervention effects $Δ_i$, and train a model to predict them at test time from a purely observational tabular dataset. As we demonstrate through extensive experiments, our new causal explainability method is easy to train and provides better explanations under a range of settings for which standard predictive attribution fails, including proxy variables, confounders, colliders, and placebos. We evaluate it on real, synthetic and semi-synthetic datasets, with and without hidden confounders, and compare it to existing predictive attribution methods and state-of-the-art causal inference methods.

AI.tldr: 提出FADO（Feature-wise Amortized Do-Operators），用基于合成SCM数据训练的prior-fitted网络，从纯观测表格数据中摊销推断特征干预效应Δ_i，实现优于预测归因的因果可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有ML解释方法（SHAP、置换重要性）主要做预测归因，本质刻画的是特征与结果的相关性而非因果性；而用户真正关心的是"操纵特征X_i是否会改变Y"这一因果问题，预测归因在代理变量、混杂、对撞、安慰剂等情形下会失效。
AI.method: 定义特征干预效应Δ_i=E[Y|do(X_i=+1)]−E[Y|do(X_i=−1)]作为目标量。由于仅用观测数据估计该量需强因果假设，作者提出FADO：使用prior-fitted网络（PFN）在由结构因果模型生成的合成表格数据上训练；训练时SCM已知，可直接计算真实干预效应Δ_i作为标签，从而训练模型在测试时仅凭纯观测数据集预测Δ_i（摊销推断）。
AI.result: 大量实验表明FADO训练简单，在标准预测归因失效的多种设置下（代理变量、混杂变量、对撞变量、安慰剂变量）给出更好的解释；在真实、合成与半合成数据集上（含/不含隐藏混杂）进行了评估，并与现有预测归因方法及最先进因果推断方法对比。
AI.conclusion: FADO将摊销推断与合成SCM数据结合，把特征解释从相关性层面推进到干预层面，为表格数据提供了一种易训练且更可靠的因果可解释性方法，在多种数据与混杂条件下优于预测归因和现有因果推断方法。

title: Safe and Efficient Navigation Considering Texting Pedestrians via Attention-Aware Cost-map Tuning
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 35th IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN 2026)
summary: Smartphone-distracted pedestrians deviate from social norms unpredictably and cannot be relied upon to yield to approaching robots -- a safety challenge that existing navigation methods are poorly equipped to handle, since they treat all pedestrians uniformly regardless of attention state. We propose an attention-aware navigation framework that classifies each pedestrian as attentive or distracted in real-time using 3D skeletal features and a Random Forest classifier, then dynamically widens cost-map safety margins around distracted individuals to drive proactive avoidance. A within-subjects user study with 12 participants across 252 trials demonstrates significant improvements in perceived smoothness (p = 0.003) and predictability (p = 0.034) over both a LiDAR-only baseline and a trajectory-prediction-only method, without any increase in travel time. Notably, trajectory prediction alone does not improve subjective navigation quality unless coupled with attention-state-aware cost adjustment -- confirming that appropriately responding to who is in front of the robot can matter more than trajectory smoothness alone.

AI.tldr: 提出注意力感知导航框架：用3D骨骼特征+随机森林实时判别行人“专注/分心”，对分心者动态扩大代价地图安全裕度，实现主动避让。12人252试次实验显示，相比LiDAR基线及纯轨迹预测方法，感知平滑性(p=0.003)与可预测性(p=0.034)显著提升且不增加通行时间。
AI.motivation: 低头看手机的分心行人行为偏离社会规范、无法可靠让行，构成安全挑战；而现有导航方法对所有行人一视同仁，忽视其注意状态，难以应对此类对象。
AI.method: 以3D骨骼特征结合随机森林分类器实时将行人分类为专注或分心；对被判定为分心的个体，动态扩大代价地图中的安全裕度，从而驱动更主动的避让行为。采用被试内设计，12名参与者、252次试验，与仅LiDAR基线和仅轨迹预测方法对比。
AI.result: 相对两种基线，主观感知平滑性(p=0.003)和可预测性(p=0.034)显著提升，且通行时间无增加；单独使用轨迹预测并不能改善主观导航质量，须与注意力状态感知的代价调整结合才有效。
AI.conclusion: “针对机器人前方何人、其注意状态如何作出恰当响应”比单纯追求轨迹平滑更重要，注意力状态感知应作为行人导航的核心要素。

title: MemInStream: Memorizing or Merely Recognizing? Rethinking Streaming Video Memory Evaluation
summary: Streaming video understanding aims to continuously process incoming visual observations, making the retention and retrieval of relevant information increasingly important as the video history grows. Although existing benchmarks include memory-related questions, question-answering accuracy alone does not reliably measure memory capabilities. Incorrect predictions may arise from failures in visual understanding rather than forgetting, whereas correct predictions may rely on linguistic priors or recent observations without requiring historical memory. To address these ambiguities, we introduce MemInStream, a benchmark dedicated to evaluating memory capabilities in streaming video understanding. We develop an evidence-controlled validation protocol that associates each question with temporally localized evidence intervals. The protocol validates evidence solvability and memory necessity by retaining questions that models can answer from the annotated evidence but cannot resolve using recent observations, post-evidence observations, or textual input alone. This helps disentangle memory limitations from understanding failures while reducing memory-independent shortcuts. MemInStream provides a systematic evaluation of memory capabilities through four major categories, covering Episodic Retrieval, State Tracking \& Updating, Multi-Evidence Integration, and Contextual Memory across diverse video scenarios. Overall, \textsc{MemInStream} provides a comprehensive and reliable benchmark for systematically evaluating memory capabilities in streaming video understanding.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MemInStream，一个专门评测流式视频理解中"记忆能力"的基准，通过证据可控的验证协议将记忆局限与视觉理解失败解耦。
AI.motivation: 流式视频需持续处理新输入，随着历史增长，相关信息的保留与检索愈发关键。现有基准虽有记忆类问题，但仅用问答准确率无法可靠衡量记忆能力：错答可能源于视觉理解失败而非遗忘，答对可能依赖语言先验或近期观测而无需历史记忆，存在混淆与"无记忆捷径"。
AI.method: 构建 MemInStream 基准，并设计证据可控验证协议：为每个问题关联时间上局部化的证据区间，并据此做两类校验——(1) 证据可解性：模型能仅凭标注证据区间作答；(2) 记忆必要性：模型无法仅用近期观测、证据后观测或纯文本输入解决。仅保留同时满足两者的题目。基准按 Episodic Retrieval、State Tracking & Updating、Multi-Evidence Integration、Contextual Memory 四大类别组织，覆盖多样视频场景。
AI.result: 形成一套经证据校验筛选的问题集合，可在降低记忆无关捷径的同时，将记忆受限与理解失败区分开，并按四大记忆类别提供系统化评测。
AI.conclusion: MemInStream 为流式视频理解中的记忆能力提供了全面且可靠的系统性评测基准。

title: Recalibrating a Typed-Decision Model in an Afternoon: A Hands-On Recipe for Laya's Confidence Scores
summary: A typed-decision model such as Laya reads a text and a list of options that the caller defines, for example ticket categories, and returns a probability for each option. Code around it compares the top probability with a threshold to answer, abstain or escalate to a person. Earlier work reports, for a Turkish model, that temperature scaling can raise held-out calibration error (ECE). This tutorial gives a five-step recipe (measure, diagnose, fit, validate, deploy) in 130 lines of numpy with standard methods, none new. On 1,065 synthetic, LLM-labelled items the released Laya checkpoint has a pooled ECE of 0.073 but a bucket-macro ECE of 0.143 (0.127-0.184), the mean over buckets (questions grouped by type and option count): the 12-option bucket is over-confident by +0.22, the three-to-five-option bucket under-confident by 0.05, and they cancel. One global temperature makes pooled ECE worse (0.173); a cross-fitted temperature per bucket brings macro-ECE to 0.073 (0.078 over 10 fold assignments) and reaches 0.089 with 10 labelled items per bucket, but holding out one of seven evaluation sets gives 0.099. After the refit, a gate aimed at 10% error answers 46.3% of items (10.5% wrong) against 6.9% on the published confidences, but one cut-off per bucket on the published confidences answers 45.4%, so most of the gain comes from separating buckets.
