Confidence-only maps (Platt, histogram, isotonic) need 20 or more labelled items per bucket to approach the temperature; with 320 per bucket the lowest macro-ECE belongs to Platt. In these files the retrained checkpoints store no per-bucket table and the stored 12-option value 0.1006 is clamped to 0.5 at runtime; the refit helps 31 of 33 checkpoints on random folds and 21 with a set held out. Fit and test share one generator and LLM labels, so these are findings about these checkpoints and this data.

AI.tldr: 针对Laya这类类型化决策模型的校准问题，提出五步（测量、诊断、拟合、验证、部署）130行numpy教程；发现汇总ECE掩盖了分桶后的严重偏差，按桶交叉拟合温度可将macro-ECE从0.143降至0.073，且大部分收益来自桶间分离而非重拟合本身。
AI.motivation: 调用方围绕类型化决策模型的输出概率设置阈值来决定回答、弃答或转人工，因此校准质量至关重要。已有工作报告土耳其语模型上温度缩放反而抬高留出集ECE，同时汇总ECE可能掩盖分桶异质性，需要一套可复现的测量—诊断流程来识别并修正按问题类型与选项数分桶后的校准偏差。
AI.method: 提出五步流程（measure, diagnose, fit, validate, deploy），仅用标准方法与约130行numpy实现，无新方法。在1,065条合成、LLM标注样本上计算pooled ECE与bucket-macro ECE（按问题类型与选项数分桶）；对比单全局温度、按桶交叉拟合温度（10折）、每桶10条标注数据情形、留出7个评测集之一；与仅依赖置信度的映射（Platt、直方图分箱、等渗回归，每桶20/320条）对比；并用31/33个检查点的随机折与留出集验证。
AI.result: Laya检查点pooled ECE=0.073，但bucket-macro ECE=0.143（0.127–0.184）；12选项桶过度自信+0.22，3–5选项桶欠自信0.05，两者相互抵消。单一全局温度使pooled ECE恶化至0.173；按桶交叉拟合将macro-ECE降至0.073（10折分配上0.078），每桶10条标注可达0.089，留出一评测集为0.099。重拟合后10%目标错误的门控回答46.3%（10.5%错误），而基于已发布置信度的单阈值仅6.9%；但用发布置信度做每桶单阈值即可达45.4%，说明收益主要来自分桶分离。置信度映射法需每桶≥20条才能接近温度缩放，每桶320条时Platt最低。已发布检查点不存每桶温度表，存储的12选项值0.1006在运行时被截断为0.5；重拟合在随机折上改善31/33检查点，留出集上改善21个。
AI.conclusion: 汇总ECE会掩盖分桶层面的系统性偏差，应改以bucket-macro指标诊断并按桶校准；按桶交叉拟合温度能显著降低macro-ECE且在少量标注下仍有效，但其主要价值在于识别桶间差异（分桶单阈值已获大部分收益）。结论仅适用于这些检查点与合成LLM标注数据（拟合与测试共享同一生成器与标注），且现有发布检查点缺少每桶温度表并在运行时截断，需在部署层面修正。

title: GLCR: Global-Local Collaborative Routing for Multi-Task Electromagnetic Signal Processing
comment: 13 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables. Code available at https://github.com/Dawn-try/GLCR
summary: Deep neural networks for electromagnetic signal processing are typically developed as single-task experts with fixed inputs and objectives, limiting cross-task transferability. Electromagnetic foundation models offer broader task coverage but incur substantial pretraining and inference costs. To balance accuracy and efficiency, we adopt model routing to dynamically dispatch unknown signals to matched experts within a heterogeneous pool. We construct HeteroSignal-7, a multi-task routing benchmark with 140,000 samples from seven datasets covering six task types, paired with seven classification and waveform-recovery experts and a unified evaluation protocol. We then propose GLCR, a two-stage routing method combining global dispatch with local discrimination of similar tasks. First, a lightweight one-dimensional convolutional neural network (CNN) with an additive-margin head predicts one of seven routing classes. Second, a gradient-boosted-tree specialist uses four physical statistics to re-evaluate samples whose top two candidates match a confusion pair automatically identified from validation errors. The pipeline is trained across the full signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) range and requires neither SNR labels nor noise estimation at inference time. GLCR outperforms all 19 baselines, achieving 96.16% routing accuracy and a 76.30% system score, exceeding the respective second-best baselines by 1.16% and 1.14%. It achieves the lowest routing latency among the compared methods at 1.43 ms per sample and reduces expected overall system FLOPs by 5.9 times compared with executing all experts. This work provides a public evaluation platform and an efficient, reproducible baseline for heterogeneous expert routing in electromagnetic signal processing.

AI.tldr: 提出异构专家路由基准 HeteroSignal-7 与两阶段路由方法 GLCR，在准确率、延迟与算力上取得最优权衡。
AI.motivation: 电磁信号深度模型多为固定输入与目标的单任务专家，跨任务迁移性差；电磁基础模型虽覆盖面广但预训练与推理成本高，需在精度与效率间折中。
AI.method: 采用模型路由将未知信号动态分派给异构专家池；构建 HeteroSignal-7 基准（7 数据集、14 万样本、6 类任务、7 个分类/波形恢复专家及统一评测协议）；提出 GLCR 两阶段路由：第一阶段轻量 1D-CNN 配合 additive-margin 头做 7 类路由预测，第二阶段梯度提升树专家以 4 项物理统计量，对落入验证误差自动识别的混淆对的 top-2 候选样本复判；全 SNR 范围训练，推理无需 SNR 标签与噪声估计。
AI.result: 优于全部 19 个基线，路由准确率 96.16%、系统得分 76.30%，较次优基线分别高 1.16% 与 1.14%；路由延迟最低，1.43 ms/样本；相比执行全部专家，期望系统 FLOPs 降低 5.9 倍。
AI.conclusion: 为电磁信号处理的异构专家路由提供公开评测平台与高效、可复现的基线。

title: EgoX: Egocentric Cross-Embodiment Manipulation with Embodiment Dreaming
summary: Generalist manipulation policies can benefit from the complementary experience of humans, real robots, and simulated agents. However, differences in morphology, sensing, and control interfaces make it difficult to learn effectively from their combined demonstrations. We introduce EgoX, an egocentric cross-embodiment learning framework that organizes heterogeneous demonstrations through semantically corresponding observation and action modalities. EgoX pretrains a Modularized Cross-Embodiment Transformer with Embodiment Dreaming (MXT+) on this mixture and fine-tunes it on target-embodiment demonstrations. Within each embodiment, MXT+ assigns a dedicated tokenizer to each observation modality and a dedicated expert to each action modality, with a Transformer trunk shared across embodiments. A training-only embodiment-dreaming objective predicts latent representations of future visual and proprioceptive states, encouraging the shared trunk to model each embodiment's dynamics. Across 13 task-embodiment pairs spanning five tasks and six robot embodiments, including five physical robots and one simulated humanoid, cross-embodiment pretraining raises MXT+'s average normalized task progress from 0.63 to 0.80 over training from scratch. The gains are particularly pronounced under out-of-distribution conditions, where average task progress increases from 0.53 to 0.77. Ablations demonstrate the benefits of broader pretraining mixtures, modular interfaces, and embodiment dreaming, with dreaming producing more similar latent geometry across embodiments. Project page: egox-dream.github.io.

AI.tldr: EgoX 是一个以自我为中心的跨具身学习框架，通过语义对应的观测与动作模态组织异构示教数据，在 13 个任务-具身组合上将平均归一化任务进度从 0.63 提升到 0.80（分布外条件下 0.53→0.77）。
AI.motivation: 通用操作策略可受益于人类、真实机器人与仿真智能体的互补经验，但形态、传感与控制接口的差异使混合示教难以有效学习。因此需要一个统一的跨具身学习框架来整合异构数据。
AI.method: 提出 EgoX：以语义对应的观测与动作模态组织异构示教；预训练模块化跨具身 Transformer（MXT+，含 Embodiment Dreaming），再在目标具身上微调。MXT+ 为每个观测模态配置专用 tokenizer、为每个动作模态配置专用 expert，Transformer 主干跨具身共享；并引入仅训练期使用的具身梦境目标，预测未来视觉与本体状态潜表征，促使共享主干建模各具身动力学。
AI.result: 在覆盖 5 个任务、6 种机器人具身（5 台实体机器人 + 1 个仿真人形）的 13 个任务-具身组合中，跨具身预训练将平均归一化任务进度从 0.63 提升至 0.80；分布外条件下由 0.53 提升至 0.77。消融实验证实更广泛的预训练数据混合、模块化接口与具身梦境均有益，且 dreaming 使不同具身间的潜空间几何更趋一致。
AI.conclusion: 跨具身预训练结合模块化接口与具身梦境可显著提升通用操作策略性能，尤其在分布外场景，并带来跨具身潜表征的可对齐性。

title: Ultrasound Elastography: Excitation Methods and Low-Cost Alternative
summary: Ultrasound elastography (or elasticity imaging) is a method that characterizes the tissue mechanical properties with the purpose of aiding the diagnosis of certain pathologies. Many novel clinical applications use the assumption that these tissue properties are changed in the presence of pathological processes. Characterization of tissue mechanical properties is achieved by imaging the response of the tissue to an induced stress or excitation. A plethora of approaches have been used in the scientific community to induce excitation in tissue, which usually require additional tools or devices than are costly. Furthermore these are usually integrated in the imaging pipeline using additional software or hardware for control. An alternative that is simpler, faster to integrate (and low-cost) is proposed in this work, by using readily available smartphones as a source of mechanical excitation. The induced displacements are used to solve the elasticity inverse problem (IP) using a finite element method (FEM) approach. Preliminary elasticity reconstructions of a phantom that mimics tissue are similar to when using a dedicated actuator as means of inducing harmonic displacements, illustrating the feasibility of our low-cost ultrasound elasography approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以普通智能手机作为机械激励源的低成本超声弹性成像方案，结合有限元方法求解弹性逆问题，实现组织仿体弹性参数重建。
AI.motivation: 传统超声弹性成像需借助专用激励装置（如致动器、振动器等），成本高且需额外的软硬件集成到成像流程中控制；作者希望寻找更简单、快速集成且低成本的替代激励方式。
AI.method: 利用现成智能手机产生的机械激励在组织内诱导位移，采集位移场后采用有限元方法（FEM）求解弹性逆问题（IP），从而估计组织力学参数；并以模仿组织的仿体进行验证。
AI.result: 仿体弹性重建结果与使用专用致动器施加谐波位移时的重建结果相近，表明基于智能手机激励的低成本超声弹性成像具有可行性。
AI.conclusion: 智能手机可作为简便、低成本且易于集成的机械激励源用于超声弹性成像，初步验证了该方案在弹性重建中的可行性，为低成本弹性成像应用提供了替代思路。

title: SignRot: LLM Quantization with Massive Outlier-Aware Sign-Adjusted Rotation
comment: 23 pages, 4 figures, 19 tables. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/HYU-ARK-Lab/SignRot
summary: While quantization compresses LLMs and accelerates inference, outlier activations impede efficient low-bit representation. In particular, massive outliers cause substantial performance degradation. Although rotation-based methods that rely on randomized Hadamard transforms for online inference aim to mitigate this, they can produce fragmented distributions with empty bins when a massive outlier dominates a token's activation. This fragmentation severely undermines uniform quantization performance. Moreover, massive outliers concentrate in the down-projection input, where the preceding nonlinearity requires the rotation to be applied at inference time. This constraint prevents training-based approaches such as SpinQuant from learning the online rotation at this position, as a learned dense matrix cannot use the Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform and would require a full matrix multiplication during inference. To address this, we propose SignRot (Sign-adjusted Rotation), which identifies massive outlier channels and constructs a sign adjustment vector that unifies the signs of the corresponding Hadamard row, collapsing the bimodal distribution into a unimodal profile amenable to quantization. Since the aligned outlier shifts the activation mean away from zero, we pair SignRot with asymmetric activation quantization, whose zero-point absorbs this shift. As a lightweight, drop-in improvement compatible with any Hadamard-based quantization method, SignRot requires only a single calibration forward pass and adds only element-wise sign flips at inference, without an additional matrix multiplication. Applying SignRot to QuaRot achieves a WikiText2 perplexity of 5.88 and an average zero-shot reasoning accuracy of 72.73, surpassing SpinQuant on the LLaMA3-70B model. Code is available at https://github.com/HYU-ARK-Lab/SignRot.

AI.tldr: 提出SignRot（符号校正旋转），通过符号调整向量将大离群值主导的双峰分布坍缩为单峰分布，配合非对称激活量化吸收均值偏移，作为即插即用模块仅需单次校准前向并只增加逐元素符号翻转，在LLaMA3-70B上超越SpinQuant。
AI.motivation: 量化虽可压缩LLM并加速推理，但激活中的大离群值（尤其集中在down-projection输入）严重损害低比特表示。基于随机Hadamard变换的在线旋转方法在大离群值主导某token激活时，会产生带空bin的碎片化分布，破坏均匀量化效果；同时因非线性层前置约束，SpinQuant等训练型方法无法在该位置学习在线旋转（稠密矩阵无法使用FWHT，推理需完整矩阵乘）。
AI.method: 先识别大离群值通道，据此构造符号调整向量，统一对应Hadamard行的符号，使双峰分布坍缩为适合量化的单峰分布；因对齐后的离群值使激活均值偏离零，配合带零点的非对称激活量化吸收该偏移。方法仅需一次校准前向，推理时只做逐元素符号翻转，无额外矩阵乘法，可与任意基于Hadamard的量化方法兼容。
AI.result: 将SignRot应用于QuaRot后，WikiText2困惑度为5.88，零样本推理平均准确率72.73，在LLaMA3-70B上超过SpinQuant。
AI.conclusion: SignRot是一种轻量、即插即用的旋转改进方案，解决了Hadamard旋转在大离群值下的分布碎片化问题，并在无需额外推理开销的前提下取得优于训练型旋转方法的量化性能。

title: Data-Free Metrics Don't Work: The Missing Invariance Under Functionally Preserving Reparameterisations
comment: NeurIPS 2026 (Negative Results Track), 44 pages, 21 figures and 18 tables
summary: Data-free methods for analysing and understanding the layers of neural networks offer many metrics for quantifying notions of 'strong' versus 'weak' layers, with the promise of increased interpretability. In particular, random matrix theory (RMT) offers data-free metrics that claim predictive power over the quality of pre-trained models at a layerwise precision and the ability to identify model pathologies, indicating a unique relationship with generalisation. As a result, metrics from RMT are championed for pre-training optimisation strategies and post-training compression. We establish that RMT-based metrics are unrelated to performance or training by showing that functionally preserving reparametrisations of a pre-trained model can have arbitrary metrics. We show this across a range of architectures and scales. To create functionally preserving reparametrisations, we exploit the well-established phenomenon of criticality: some layers can be re-initialised or re-randomised without affecting the functional behaviour of the model -- they are called robust -- while others cannot -- they are called critical. Re-initialising or re-randomising robust layers provides functionally preserving reparametrisations for which RMT-based metrics are arbitrary. Moreover, we show that relationships between metrics offered by RMT are spuriously related to generalisation. We conclude by showing that if many pre-trained models have data-free metrics in a 'good' range, it is, in part, dependent on model initialisation. Project page available at: https://gmw99.github.io/data-free-metrics-dont-work

AI.tldr: 本文通过功能保持的重参数化证明随机矩阵理论（RMT）类无数据指标与模型性能、训练质量无关，其与泛化性的关联是虚假的。
AI.motivation: RMT 等无数据指标被宣称可在逐层精度上预测预训练模型质量、识别病态结构，并被用于预训练优化与训练后压缩；作者希望检验这些指标是否真正反映泛化性。
AI.method: 利用"临界性"现象构造功能保持的重参数化：对鲁棒层（robust layers）重新初始化或随机化而不改变模型功能输出，从而在保持功能等价的前提下考察 RMT 指标的变化；跨多种架构与规模进行实验。
AI.result: 功能保持的重参数化可使 RMT 指标取任意值；RMT 指标与性能/训练无关联；RMT 指标之间的关系与泛化性只是虚假相关；许多预训练模型落在指标"良好"区间部分取决于模型初始化。
AI.conclusion: RMT 无数据指标不具备所宣称的预测能力，不宜作为预训练优化与压缩的可靠依据。

title: AgriSense: Vision-Language Decision Support and Robotic Intervention in a Virtual Greenhouse Copy title
summary: Autonomous greenhouse management increasingly requires robotic systems that integrate perception, navigation, environmental regulation, and plant-level intervention. This paper presents AgriSense, a framework combining an Isaac Sim virtual greenhouse, a quadruped mobile manipulator, RGB and LiDAR-inertial sensing, environmental control, and supervised vision-language decision support. Frozen DINOv2 and BERT encoders, together with structured environmental inputs, support joint prediction of twelve environmental references, a target zone, and an intervention flag. Checkpoint replay reproduces 41/43 zone decisions. Across five seeds on a source-grouped test set, the full, image-removed, and language-removed configurations each achieve 43/44 correct zone decisions, providing no evidence of incremental multimodal zone-accuracy improvement. The full model achieves mean absolute errors of 0.249 degrees C for temperature, 2.030 percentage points for humidity, and 0.997 percentage points for soil moisture. Sensor-only inputs match full-model zone accuracy, while language-only inputs achieve 68.64%. External real-image benchmarks reveal distribution-shift limitations. Five offline Point-LIO routes yield rigidly aligned trajectory errors of 5.22-17.32 mm. Of 40 virtual-arm targets, 32 satisfy geometric acceptance criteria and eight are rejected at boundaries. Six long-horizon climate cases and fault protocols characterize integration limits. Navigation and integrated treatment rely on simulator-state inputs; physical greenhouse performance and agronomic treatment efficacy remain unvalidated. The contribution is an evaluated decision-support and robotic-intervention framework for a virtual greenhouse.

AI.tldr: 提出AgriSense虚拟温室机器人框架，集成Isaac Sim仿真、四足移动机械臂、RGB与LiDAR-惯性感知、环境调控及监督式视觉-语言决策支持；在虚拟环境中完成分区决策、环境参数回归、轨迹精度与故障协议的系统评估。
AI.motivation: 自主温室管理需要同时集成感知、导航、环境调节与植株级干预的机器人系统，而现有工作缺乏在一个统一仿真框架内对这些环节进行联合评估的平台；作者希望验证多模态（图像+语言+环境）决策是否真能提升分区决策精度。
AI.method: 构建Isaac Sim虚拟温室与四足移动机械臂平台，融合RGB与LiDAR-惯性传感；采用冻结的DINOv2与BERT编码器结合结构化环境输入，联合预测12项环境参考值、目标分区与干预标志；设置消融配置（完整、去图像、去语言、仅传感器、仅语言）、5个随机种子、按来源分组测试集、checkpoint回放、5条离线Point-LIO轨迹、40个虚拟机械臂目标点几何校验，以及6个长时程气候案例和故障协议。
AI.result: checkpoint回放复现41/43分区决策；5种子下完整、去图像、去语言三配置均为43/44正确，无多模态增量收益证据；仅传感器输入与完整模型精度相当，仅语言为68.64%；完整模型MAE为温度0.249°C、湿度2.030个百分点、土壤湿度0.997个百分点；外部真实图像基准显示分布偏移限制；5条Point-LIO路线刚性对齐误差5.22–17.32 mm；40个机械臂目标中32个通过几何验收、8个在边界被拒。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于一个经过评估的虚拟温室决策支持与机器人干预框架；但导航与集成处理依赖仿真器状态输入，物理温室性能与农艺干预效果尚未验证，多模态融合的价值缺乏实证支持。

title: Taming Neural Fields with a Frequency-Lipschitz Curriculum for Sparse-View CT Reconstruction
summary: Sparse-view computed tomography (SVCT) reduces radiation dose by acquiring fewer projection views, but the resulting under-determined inverse problem requires careful regularization to prevent reconstruction algorithms from fitting streak artifacts and hallucinated structures. Existing implicit neural representation (INR) methods rely on implicit spectral bias or iterative external denoising, yet they provide limited control over when high-frequency capacity is exposed during optimization. To address this limitation, we propose FLIC (Frequency-Lipschitz INR Curriculum), a capacity-controlled self-prior INR framework that makes the network's representational capacity explicit and schedulable. The core of our method is a joint frequency-Lipschitz curriculum that couples random Fourier feature encoding with spectrally normalized MLP decoding under non-uniform Lipschitz budgets, guiding reconstruction along a coarse-to-fine trajectory from stable global anatomy to fine details. The terminal capacity is automatically calibrated from FBP gradient statistics, enabling scan-adaptive regularization without per-scan manual tuning of the terminal Lipschitz budget. We further introduce a prior-guided adaptive ray sampling strategy that concentrates integration samples near high-gradient anatomical boundaries, improving forward-model fidelity. The entire framework operates in a single training stage without iterative denoising, enabling efficient per-image reconstruction. Extensive experiments on four public CT datasets under noise-free and low-dose settings show that our method achieves state-of-the-art unsupervised reconstruction quality with consistent performance across diverse anatomical structures.

AI.tldr: 提出FLIC——一种容量可控的自先验INR框架，通过频率-利普希茨联合课程将网络表达能力显式化、可调度，实现单阶段、扫描自适应的稀疏视图CT重建，在四个公开数据集上达到无监督SOTA。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视图CT（SVCT）以较少投影降低剂量，但反问题欠定，重建易拟合条纹伪影与幻觉结构。现有隐式神经表示（INR）方法依赖隐式频谱偏置或迭代式外部去噪，对优化过程中高频容量的暴露时机缺乏可控性。
AI.method: 核心为频率-利普希茨联合课程：将随机傅里叶特征编码与谱归一化MLP解码耦合，在非均匀利普希茨预算下引导由粗到细的重建轨迹（从稳定全局解剖到细节）。终端容量由FBP梯度统计自动标定，实现免逐扫描调参的扫描自适应正则。另引入先验引导的自适应射线采样，将积分采样点集中于高梯度解剖边界以提升前向模型保真度。全流程单阶段训练，无迭代去噪。
AI.result: 在四个公开CT数据集的免噪与低剂量设置下，取得无监督重建的最优质量，并在多种解剖结构上表现一致。
AI.conclusion: 将INR的表示容量显式化并按频率-利普希茨课程调度，可作为SVCT的有效自先验正则范式；终端预算自标定与自适应采样进一步提升了实用性与前向一致性，且无需多阶段去噪即可高效逐图重建。

title: Lost in Delegation: Studying the Effectiveness of Task Orchestration in Generative Search
summary: LLMs have quickly evolved from models used in isolation to agentic systems that delegate tasks to external tools and other LLMs to solve complex assignments. This agentic augmentation has led to impressive capability gains. However, when and how delegation improves performance remains poorly understood. For example, it is unclear whether delegation helps when tasks involve post-cutoff information that the orchestrating LLM cannot reliably resolve from its own knowledge. In this work, we use purpose-built datasets with pre- and post-cutoff splits to compare various delegation modes. We find that delegation provides no consistent accuracy improvement over non-delegated setups, with effects varying across models and tasks. When tasks involve knowledge unavailable to the orchestrator, delegation can substantially degrade accuracy, while direct tool use with the same LLM performs much better. Our analysis identifies distorted delegated queries, inefficient tool use, and failures to preserve and use information between agents as recurring failure modes. These findings suggest that effective orchestration requires both well-calibrated delegation decisions and effective exchange of information between agents.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建含"截止日期前/后"信息切分的专用数据集，系统比较多种委派模式，发现委派并未带来稳定的准确率提升；当任务涉及编排模型自身缺失的知识时，委派甚至会显著降低准确率，而同一模型直接使用工具表现更好。
AI.motivation: LLM已从孤立模型演化为可向外部工具和其他LLM委派任务的智能体系统，能力提升显著，但"何时、如何委派才能提升性能"缺乏理解。特别是任务涉及训练截止日期之后的信息时，编排模型无法仅凭自身知识可靠解决，委派是否有效尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建带有"截止日期前/后"划分的专用数据集，在多种委派模式（非委派、委派给其他LLM、同一LLM直接调用工具等）间进行受控对比实验；分析失败案例以归纳失败模式。
AI.result: 委派相对非委派设置未带来一致的准确率提升，效果随模型与任务而异；当任务涉及编排者不具备的知识时，委派会显著降低准确率，而同一LLM直接使用工具表现明显更好。归纳出三类反复出现的失败模式：委派查询被扭曲、工具使用低效、智能体之间信息未能保留与利用。
AI.conclusion: 有效的编排既需要校准良好的委派决策，也需要智能体之间高效的信息交换。

title: A Mechanistic Interpretability Study of an Astronomy Foundation Model
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. A condensed version was selected for an oral presentation at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpretability for Discovery
summary: Foundation models are increasingly used across the sciences, but whether their internal computations correspond to known scientific operations or proceed through different mechanisms remains unclear. Understanding these mechanisms is essential for assessing reliability, identifying failure modes, and learning new science from the models. We present, to our knowledge, the first causal mechanistic interpretability study of an astronomy foundation model, AION-1, focusing on its multimodal advantage in redshift prediction, where combining imaging with photometry outperforms photometry alone. We find that this advantage is largest for spatially extended and dust-attenuated galaxies, and that most of it is localized to the first of the encoder's twelve blocks. Within that block, how well a property is linearly decodable does not predict whether it can be localized. Spatial extent is causally used, and one attention head dominates linear probing for it, yet ablating that head has negligible effect on redshift prediction: the information is distributed across heads and is decodable again one layer after we erase it. Dust attenuation shows the opposite pattern: it is only weakly decodable anywhere in the encoder, yet a single head is necessary for most of the multimodal advantage, particularly for the most dust-attenuated galaxies, and keeping that head as the only active head in its block preserves nearly all of the advantage. None of the astrophysically motivated operations we tested explains what this head computes. Whether this reflects a limitation of current interpretability methods or a computation that does not correspond to any known astrophysical operation remains open, and resolving it is a prerequisite for using interpretability as a tool for scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 首次对天文基础模型AION-1开展因果机制可解释性研究，发现其多模态红移预测优势集中于编码器首个block，且"线性可解码性"与"因果可利用性/可定位性"解耦：空间延展性信息分布冗余，尘埃衰减信息集中于单个注意力头。
AI.motivation: 基础模型在科学领域广泛应用，但其内部计算是否对应已知科学操作尚不清楚；厘清机制是评估可靠性、识别失效模式乃至从模型中学到新科学的前提。作者以AION-1在多模态红移预测中的优势（成像+测光优于单测光）为切入点。
AI.method: 因果机制可解释性分析：定位多模态优势的星系子群与网络层级；在block内做线性探针与注意力头消融/保留实验；对比"可解码性"与"因果必要性"；检验候选的天体物理动机操作是否能解释关键头的计算。
AI.result: 优势在空间延展、尘埃衰减强的星系上最大，且大部分集中于12个block的第1个。空间延展性：可被因果使用、单头在探针中占主导，但消融该头对红移几乎无影响，信息跨头分布且下一层可重新解码。尘埃衰减：整体可解码性弱，但单头对多模态优势必要，对强衰减星系尤为关键，仅保留该头即可维持几乎全部优势。
AI.conclusion: 线性可解码性不能预测因果可定位性；两类天体物理属性的机制截然不同（冗余分布 vs 单头瓶颈）。该关键头的计算无法由任何已测试的天体物理操作解释，究竟是现有可解释性方法的局限还是模型习得了未知计算仍待解决，这是将可解释性用作科学发现工具的先决条件。

title: ACE-CaP-0: Real-World Code-as-Policies in the Era of Experience
summary: Recent advances in frontier models have pushed the boundaries of agentic robot control, enabling agents to perform complex robotic tasks through reasoning and interaction. However, repeated calls to these models during execution can substantially increase task completion time. Code as Policies (CaP) offers a route for coding agents to acquire physical skills through experience and retain them in executable programs, allowing the reasoning invested in development to be reused across runs. Developing reliable code policies while limiting the cost of physical experimentation remains a central challenge. We investigate human guidance as a source of priors for feasible actions and simulation as an auxiliary environment for exploring and testing candidate policies. Our findings favor robot demonstrations available on request and simulation used selectively during real-world policy refinement. These findings inform ACE-CaP-0, an agentic recipe that couples policy revision with experience acquisition through Demonstrations on Request and Simulation on Demand. Across eight real-world manipulation tasks spanning alignment, multi-object handling, and bimanual coordination, the resulting frozen programs achieve 92.1\% success (221/240 trials). Mean execution times across tasks range from 0.97 to 2.27 minutes. The programs execute with runtime perception and control, without a human or coding agent in the loop. These results highlight CaP's potential to turn experience into reliable, reusable physical skills.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ACE-CaP-0，将"按需示范"与"按需仿真"耦合进 Code as Policies 的策略修订与经验获取流程，在八个真实机器人操作任务上以冻结程序取得 92.1% 成功率，单任务平均执行时间 0.97–2.27 分钟，且运行期无需人类或编码智能体介入。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型驱动的具身智能体虽能通过推理与交互完成复杂机器人任务，但执行期反复调用大模型会显著拉长任务完成时间。Code as Policies（CaP）让编码智能体通过经验获得物理技能并以可执行程序固化，使开发阶段的推理可跨多次运行复用。核心难题在于：如何以较低的真实实验成本，开发出可靠的代码策略。
AI.method: 研究人类引导（提供可行动作先验）与仿真（作为候选策略的探索与测试辅助环境）两类先验来源的作用。结论是：真实机器人示范宜"按需索取"，仿真宜在真实策略精修阶段"选择性"使用。据此形成智能体化流程 ACE-CaP-0，将策略修订与经验获取结合，采用 Demonstrations on Request（按需示范）与 Simulation on Demand（按需仿真）两项机制，最终产出冻结的可执行代码策略。
AI.result: 在覆盖对齐、多物体操作与双臂协同的八个真实操作任务上，冻结程序共完成 240 次试验中 221 次成功，成功率 92.1%；各任务平均执行时间 0.97–2.27 分钟。程序在运行期依靠自身感知与控制执行，回路中不含人类或编码智能体。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 CaP 有望将经验转化为可靠、可复用的物理技能：按需示范与选择性仿真的组合能有效控制真实实验成本，而推理成果一旦固化为程序，即可在不依赖在线大模型调用的前提下稳定完成真实操作。

title: CGOcc: Learning Cross-Gaussian Dependencies for 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction
summary: In Gaussian-based semantic occupancy prediction, overlapping primitives can provide ambiguous class predictions, making their joint interpretation important for voxel classification. However, current methods using spatially weighted mixtures neglect explicit modeling of cross-primitive dependencies, limiting the readout's ability to utilize category-specific relational evidence. Hence, we introduce CGOcc, a supervised multi-camera framework that explicitly models Cross-Gaussian dependencies for 3D semantic Occupancy prediction. CGOcc integrates appearance and geometric observations to refine Gaussian states and encodes cross-Gaussian dependencies in a diagonal-plus-low-rank representation. To incorporate these dependencies into voxel classification, CGOcc uses a class-conditional projection to extract diagonal and signed cross-Gaussian statistics without constructing a dense dependency matrix. The readout then refines occupied-class probabilities using these statistics while preserving a learned reference's occupied mass and free probability. Extensive experiments on nuScenes demonstrate CGOcc achieves state-of-the-art performance, with larger gains at high Gaussian overlap and improved predictions near boundaries. Ablation studies validate the effectiveness of covariance-aware prediction and support its synergy with geometric interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出CGOcc，一个显式建模跨高斯基元依赖关系的监督式多相机3D语义占据预测框架，以对角加低秩表示编码依赖并用类条件投影实现高效读出。
AI.motivation: 基于高斯的语义占据预测中，重叠基元会给出模糊的类别预测，因此其联合解读对体素分类至关重要；但现有空间加权混合方法忽略了对跨基元依赖的显式建模，限制了读出环节利用类别相关关系证据的能力。
AI.method: CGOcc融合外观与几何观测以精化高斯状态；将跨高斯依赖编码为“对角+低秩”表示；通过类条件投影提取对角与带符号的跨高斯统计量（无需构建稠密依赖矩阵），并据此在保持学习参考的占据质量与自由概率的前提下体素级修正占据类别概率。
AI.result: 在nuScenes上取得SOTA性能；在高斯重叠程度较高场景增益更明显，边界附近预测改善；消融实验验证了协方差感知预测的有效性及其与几何交互的协同作用。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模跨高斯基元依赖、并以低秩+类条件投影实现高效读出，可显著提升高斯占据预测的判别性与边界质量。

title: AI has its own style in mathematical proving
summary: As large language models increasingly generate mathematical proofs, whether they develop a proving style distinct from that of human mathematicians remains an open question. This question is particularly pressing as mathematicians increasingly voice concerns that proofs generated by large language models are difficult to interpret. Here we ask three large language models to independently reprove all 465 propositions of Euclid's \textit{Elements} and compare their citation choices against the human-proof baseline through Jaccard similarity and complex network analysis. We find that AI-generated proofs differ from human proofs, and this difference is stable and reproducible: mean pairwise Jaccard similarity among AI runs (~0.68) is nearly twice that between AI and human proofs (~0.37), and cross-run classification consistency is also high. By examining citation structure in detail, we identify the concrete signature of this difference: approximately 40% of AI citations point to foundational elements (definitions, common notions, and postulates), compared with only 13\% in human proofs; even among theorem-to-theorem citations, AI tends to cite more distant results. Roughly half of AI's extra citations trace to the upstream dependencies of the human proof. Together, these findings suggest that the AI proving style is a tendency to construct arguments on its own from foundational elements rather than directly citing later, more established results, which we term "building from the ground up". Our findings offer a new perspective on how AI systems organise and invoke mathematical knowledge, with implications for understanding the interpretability of AI-generated proofs.

AI.tldr: 该文让三个LLM独立重证欧几里得《几何原本》全部465个命题，通过Jaccard相似度与复杂网络分析比较其引用选择与人类证明基线的差异，发现AI证明风格稳定可复现，呈"从地基构建"倾向。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地生成数学证明，数学家普遍反映其证明难以解读；AI是否形成区别于人类的证明风格仍是开放问题，亟需对引用选择这一可量化维度进行系统刻画。
AI.method: 以《几何原本》465个命题为对象，令三个LLM独立重证；以人类证明为基线，用Jaccard相似度衡量引用集合重叠，并结合复杂网络分析引用结构（区分基础元素引用与定理间引用、引用的"距离"及上游依赖溯源）。
AI.result: AI内部成对平均Jaccard相似度约0.68，AI与人类仅约0.37，跨运行分类一致性亦高；约40%的AI引用指向定义、公理与公设等基础元素，而人类仅13%；定理间引用中AI更倾向引用较远结果；约一半的"额外"引用可追溯至人类证明的上游依赖。
AI.conclusion: AI证明风格可概括为"从地基构建"（building from the ground up）：倾向从基础元素自建论证，而非直接引用更晚、更成熟的结论；这为理解AI如何组织与调用数学知识及AI证明可解释性提供了新视角。

title: Beyond Reweighting: Certified Improvements from New Transitions in Discrete MCMC
summary: Optimizing transition probabilities on a fixed grap may leave substantial limitations on the efficiency of reversible Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC). We develop a framework for transition-support design that considers both allowed transitions and their stationary flows. For a fixed target distribution, observable, and node-flow budget, we derive a necessary and sufficient dual condition for support augmentation to strictly reduce the optimal value of the asymptotic variance, together with computable primal--dual certificates that establish improvements over every admissible original-support reweighting. We also construct a family in which adding a single edge reduces integrated autocorrelation time by an $Ω(n)$ factor relative to optimal original-support weighting, demonstrating that structural limitations can impose arbitrarily large relative losses in estimation efficiency. To realize these gains, we investigate energy-informed edge selection and constrained stationary-flow optimization. Experiments on molecular and Ising state graphs distinguish the potential value of new transitions from the performance of kernels constructed on them: on identical augmented Ising supports, full weight optimization certifies strict improvements in 24/24 conditions, whereas degree-based Metropolis--Hastings weighting certifies none. Our results provide a principled approach to characterizing, certifying, and exploiting transition-support improvements in explicitly represented finite state spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个同时考虑“允许的转移”与“平稳流”的转移支撑（transition-support）设计框架，给出支撑增广能严格降低渐近方差的充要对偶条件及可计算的原–对偶证书，并证明结构限制可造成任意大的相对效率损失。
AI.motivation: 在固定图上仅优化转移概率会严重限制可逆MCMC的效率，已有工作只做权重（reweighting）优化，忽略了改变支撑结构（新增转移）可能带来的本质改进。
AI.method: 针对固定目标分布、观测量与节点流预算，建立支撑增广的对偶分析框架：1）推导支撑增广严格降低最优渐近方差的充要对偶条件；2）构造可计算的原–对偶证书，证明其优于所有原支撑上的重加权；3）构造只增加一条边即可将积分自相关时间相对最优原支撑权重降低Ω(n)倍的图族；4）实现能量引导的边选择与带约束的平稳流优化。
AI.result: 理论上证明结构限制可带来任意大的相对效率损失（Ω(n)）；实验在分子图与Ising状态图上区分了“新转移的潜在价值”与“基于其构造的核的实际表现”：在相同的增广Ising支撑上，完整权重优化在24/24种条件下均给出严格改进证书，而基于度数的Metropolis–Hastings加权一个也未能证明改进。
AI.conclusion: 本文为显式表示的有限状态空间中转移支撑改进的刻画、认证与利用提供了原则性方法，表明支撑设计与权重优化需协同考虑。

title: Informative Path Planning with Gaussian Processes: Error Bounds, Algorithms, and Benchmarks
summary:
Accurate environmental monitoring relies on Informative Path Planning (IPP) to deploy autonomous systems that maximize information gain. While Gaussian Processes (GPs) provide a robust mathematical foundation for modeling the environment, contemporary IPP approaches remain hindered by heuristic operational constraints and the lack of simultaneous theoretical guarantees for worst-case estimation error and approximation quality. Rather than introducing yet another heuristic, this paper presents a rigorous theoretical analysis of existing error bounds and algorithms to further develop the mathematical foundation for IPP.
  By evaluating probabilistic and deterministic bounds on reconstruction error, we establish that predictive variance is the theoretically ideal optimization objective for GP-based IPP. Furthermore, we analyze GreedyCover, a recent approach for optimizing predictive variance, and demonstrate that its near-optimal approximation guarantee matches the fundamental hardness-of-approximation limit for the problem. Comprehensive benchmarking confirms that this approach delivers superior estimation accuracy and computational efficiency compared to prominent information-theoretic objectives and optimization methods used in IPP. Finally, this theoretical analysis establishes a rigorous, near-optimal foundation for discrete offline IPP under bounded uncertainty constraints, offering clear and principled guidance for future work in continuous-space and online formulations.

AI.tldr: 本文不提出新启发式算法，而是对GP-based IPP的误差界与算法做严格理论分析：证明预测方差是理论上最优的优化目标，并证明GreedyCover的近似保证已达问题近似难度下界，实验验证其在精度与效率上优于主流信息论目标与方法。
AI.motivation: 现有IPP方法受限于启发式操作约束，且缺乏对最坏情况估计误差与近似质量的同步理论保证；作者希望夯实IPP的数学基础而非再引入一个启发式。
AI.method: 系统评估重构误差的概率界与确定性界以确定最优优化目标；对GreedyCover（用于优化预测方差的方法）进行近似性理论分析，并与问题固有的近似困难性下界对比；结合多组基准实验，与主流信息论目标及优化方法对比估计精度与计算效率。
AI.result: 预测方差被确立为GP-based IPP理论上理想的优化目标；GreedyCover的近最优近似保证与问题的近似难度极限相匹配；基准测试显示其估计精度与计算效率优于现有主流信息论目标与优化方法。
AI.conclusion: 为有界不确定性约束下的离散离线IPP建立了严格且近最优的理论基础，并为连续空间与在线形式等未来工作提供清晰、有原则的指导。

title: How Far Can Frozen Vision-Language Models Go on Event Data? A Training-Free Study on EventBench
comment: "Technical report, EBMV @ ECCV 2026 Challenge. 13 pages, 9 figures
summary: We present a training-free system for the EBMV @ ECCV 2026 challenge "Event Stream Understanding with EventBench" (General Understanding track), which evaluates vision-language models on five event-camera understanding tasks. We use none of the challenge's training data: our goal is to measure how far off-the-shelf, RGB-pretrained models can go on event data through representation and prompting alone. For four of the five categories (gesture recognition, detailed understanding, causal reasoning, and event OCR) we render event bins as red/ON, blue/OFF frames, select a category-specific subset of bins, stitch them into a single grid image, and query the same frozen Qwen3.5 9B vision-language model with a category-specific prompt for all four tasks. The fifth category, action recognition, feeds every bin directly into the organizers' EventGPT-Plus-2B. The system reaches 62.28% overall accuracy across 2,084 test questions (rank 9/27), led by action recognition and causal reasoning (80.27%, 77.22%) and limited most by gesture recognition and event OCR (54.70%, 34.57%). We visualize test samples from every category together with the exact images the model receives, score six alternative representations against the evaluation server, and analyze the full test set post hoc. That analysis shows that our bounding-box crop almost never tightened around content, so event OCR text reached the model at roughly one fifth of its horizontal resolution, and that detailed-understanding predictions are skewed toward the first two answer options.

AI.tldr: 提出一个免训练的事件相机视觉语言理解系统，用RGB预训练模型+事件表征渲染与提示工程完成EventBench五项任务，取得62.28%总体准确率（9/27）。
AI.motivation: 旨在衡量现成RGB预训练模型在不使用任何挑战赛训练数据、仅依靠表征转换与提示的情况下，能在事件数据上达到何种程度，作为对事件数据与RGB域差异的可迁移性探针。
AI.method: 将事件bin渲染为红(ON)/蓝(OFF)帧，按类别选取bin子集拼接为单张网格图，用统一的冻结Qwen3.5-9B视觉语言模型配合类别专用提示处理手势识别、细粒度理解、因果推理、事件OCR四类任务；动作识别则直接将全部bin输入主办方的EventGPT-Plus-2B。此外可视化各类测试样本与模型实际输入图像，并对六种替代表征在评测服务器上打分、对全部测试集做事后分析。
AI.result: 在2,084道测试题上总体准确率62.28%（排名9/27）；动作识别与因果推理表现最好（80.27%、77.22%），手势识别与事件OCR最弱（54.70%、34.57%）；事后分析发现边界框裁剪几乎未收紧，导致OCR文本输入模型时水平分辨率仅约原五分之一，细粒度理解预测偏向前两个选项。
AI.conclusion: 免训练、仅靠表征渲染与提示的RGB预训练模型可在事件理解任务上取得中等偏上表现，但性能瓶颈集中于高分辨率文本类任务与密集裁剪流程；指出裁剪失效与答案位置偏置是主要改进方向。

title: SPARC: Accurate Photonic Matrix Multiplication via Representative Vectors
summary: Photonic neural network accelerators have emerged as a promising solution for reducing the power consumption of deep neural network (DNN) inference by executing matrix multiplication on analog photonic hardware. However, their inference accuracy is limited by low-bit quantization required for photonic processing and by analog photonic noise. This paper proposes an approach for improving inference accuracy by exploiting the high similarity among activation vectors in DNNs. Specifically, our approach constructs a representative vector for each group of similar activation vectors, computes its inner product digitally with high precision, and offloads the residual inner products to the photonic accelerator. Since the activation vectors within each group are highly similar, the residual vectors have much smaller norms, thereby reducing the effects of quantization errors and analog photonic noise. Furthermore, our approach preserves the photonic inner-product computation pipeline, allowing seamless integration into existing and future photonic accelerators without hardware modification. Experimental results on six representative DNN models demonstrate that the proposed approach can improve inference accuracy across diverse network architectures and application domains.

AI.tldr: 提出一种利用DNN中激活向量高度相似性的方法：对每组相似激活向量构造代表向量，其内积用高精度数字方式计算，残差内积则卸载到光子加速器，从而降低量化误差与模拟噪声的影响并提升推理精度。
AI.motivation: 光子神经网络加速器通过模拟光子硬件执行矩阵乘法来降低DNN推理功耗，但受限于光子处理所需的低位量化以及模拟光子噪声，其推理精度不足。
AI.method: 利用DNN激活向量间的高相似性，为每组相似激活向量构造一个代表向量，以高精度数字方式计算其内积，并把剩余的内积计算（残差）卸载至光子加速器；由于组内激活向量高度相似，残差向量范数显著更小，从而削弱量化误差和模拟光子噪声的影响，同时保持原有光子内积计算流水线，无需硬件修改即可集成。
AI.result: 在六个代表性DNN模型上的实验表明，该方法在不同网络架构与应用领域均能提升推理精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过将高相似性激活的公共部分交给数字高精度计算、把范数更小的残差交给光子硬件，可在不修改硬件的前提下有效缓解低位量化与模拟噪声带来的精度损失，具备良好的通用性与可集成性。

title: The Noise Floor of a Quantization Comparison: Engine, restart, batch and kernel drift, measured against 8-bit and 4-bit effects in two decision models
summary: A quantized model is usually judged by comparing it with its BF16 original, but that comparison changes more than the weights. It often changes the serving engine, it always runs on a different server instance, it may change how requests are batched, and on some stacks the library selects a different kernel depending only on which packages import. We measure each of these sources on the same 2,400 public decisions for two of Cloudflare's decision models, Clef-flash (9B) and Clef (27B), on an NVIDIA GB10, and state every quantization effect as the excess over them. Sources that are not quantization move between 0 and 0.92% of decisions. llama.cpp restarts are bit-identical on every record for both models. vLLM restarts flip 0, 5 and 20 decisions at BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 on Clef-flash and 4, 0 and 22 on Clef; a third instance of Clef's quantized builds (exploratory) leaves FP8 at 0 and puts NVFP4 at 4 to 22, depending on which two instances are compared. An engine change at BF16 flips 6 to 16, a batch-size change 8 to 15, and the Gated DeltaNet kernel transformers selects unasked 10 to 14. Quantization inside one engine moves more: for Clef-flash and Clef, 0.88% and 1.04% at Q8_0, 2.12% and 1.62% at FP8, 5.79% and 3.50% at Q4_K_M, and 5.79% and 5.67% at NVFP4. On both models, every 4-bit interval excludes every non-quantization source. Two of our five pre-registered predictions failed, and the same two fail when the tests are rerun on the 27B: FP8 is not inside restart noise, and changing engine moves fewer decisions than 8-bit quantization does. Accuracy hides most of this. Over the full 31,275 public questions, Clef's Q4_K_M build moves accuracy by a net six questions (-0.02 points [-0.20, +0.16]) while 436 of its decisions get worse (exploratory), and NVFP4 costs Clef-flash 0.95 points and Clef 0.65. We release the code, quantization recipes, per-record outputs and the pre-registration.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出量化模型与BF16原模型的对比中混杂了多种非量化噪声源（服务引擎、实例、批处理、内核选择），并在Cloudflare两个决策模型上量化了各噪声源幅度：非量化源改变0–0.92%的决策，而量化本身改变0.88%–5.79%；精度指标掩盖了大部分决策翻转。
AI.motivation: 通常用与BF16原模型对比来评估量化模型，但该对比不止改变权重：服务引擎、服务器实例、批处理方式、库根据导入包选择不同内核等都会改变。作者希望先量化这些非量化来源的影响，再将量化效应表述为超出噪声的"超额"效应，避免把噪声误归因于量化。
AI.method: 在NVIDIA GB10上，对Cloudflare的Clef-flash（9B）与Clef（27B）两个决策模型、2,400条公共决策进行测量。逐一操纵各潜在混淆源：llama.cpp与vLLM重启（含第三实例，探索性）、BF16下更换引擎、改变批大小、transformers非请求地选择Gated DeltaNet内核，以及在同一引擎内做Q8_0、FP8、Q4_K_M、NVFP4量化。所有量化效应以超出上述噪声的excess形式报告，并采用5项预注册预测与逐记录输出。
AI.result: 非量化源至多改变0.92%的决策：llama.cpp重启逐记录比特一致；vLLM重启在BF16/FP8/NVFP4下分别翻转0、5、20（Clef-flash）与4、0、22（Clef），第三实例下FP8为0、NVFP4为4–22；BF16换引擎翻转6–16，批大小改变8–15，内核选择10–14。同引擎内量化：Q8_0为0.88%/1.04%，FP8为2.12%/1.62%，Q4_K_M为5.79%/3.50%，NVFP4为5.79%/5.67%（Clef-flash/Clef）；两模型的4-bit区间均排除所有非量化源。5项预注册预测中2项失败（FP8不在重启噪声内；换引擎翻转数少于8-bit量化），在27B复测同样失败。全量31,275题上Clef的Q4_K_M净精度变化仅6题（-0.02点，[-0.20,+0.16]），但436条决策变差（探索性）；NVFP4使Clef-flash降0.95点、Clef降0.65点。
AI.conclusion: 量化评估必须控制非量化混淆源，量化效应应以超出噪声的超额形式报告；聚合精度会掩盖大量逐决策层面的变化，故需逐记录分析。作者释放代码、量化配方、逐记录输出与预注册材料。

title: CT-SGAL-LIO: Causal Continuous Time Refinement of Discrete LiDAR Inertial Odometry
summary: State-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial odometry methods, including those on richer state manifolds, achieve strong global accuracy, yet their pose stream alternates between propagation and correction and can oscillate over short horizons even when globally accurate. Most existing methods follow these approaches: they either modify the filter to enable faster updates or estimate a continuous-time trajectory from raw LiDAR and inertial data. The latter involves extra optimization, delaying state updates and becoming less robust during rapid rotations or accelerations. We propose CT-SGAL-LIO, a continuous-time refinement module that smooths the posterior pose stream of a discrete SGal(3) estimator without modifying the estimator itself. The key novelty is to perform continuous-time trajectory refinement directly on the projected SGal(3) posterior: we fit a cubic trajectory over a bounded window of recent poses and evaluate it at a small fixed lag. This places the query time within the observed interval, so the refined pose is obtained by interpolation rather than extrapolation, while preserving causal operation. CT-SGAL-LIO improves relative trajectory accuracy on 17 sequences from three public benchmarks. Across 17 sequences from GRAND-TOUR, MCD, and GEODE, CT-SGAL-LIO improves short-term motion accuracy while largely preserving global accuracy. RTE improves by up to 70% on GRAND-TOUR and on all seven GEODE sequences, with 9.9-51.1% reductions. A 19.5-min R-Campus run also reduces posterior jumps by 85.4% with only a 4.7 mm change in the end-to-start gap. We plan to release our source code and results to support community validation and reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 提出CT-SGAL-LIO，一种在SGal(3)后验位姿流上做连续时间轨迹细化的后处理模块，不改动原估计器，通过有界窗口三次轨迹拟合+固定小延迟插值实现平滑，提升短时相对精度。
AI.motivation: 现有LiDAR-惯性里程计（含SGal(3)等更丰富状态流形方法）虽全局精度高，但位姿流在传播与校正间交替，短时程上会振荡；改造滤波器以求更快更新，或直接从原始LiDAR/惯性数据估计连续时间轨迹（需额外优化、延迟更新、快速旋转/加速时鲁棒性下降）均各有缺陷。
AI.method: 作为独立细化模块，不修改离散SGal(3)估计器本身；直接在投影后的SGal(3)后验位姿序列上做连续时间细化：在最近位姿的有界窗口内拟合三次轨迹，并在固定的小延迟处求值，使查询时刻落在已观测区间内，从而以插值（而非外推）获得细化位姿，同时保持因果性。
AI.result: 在GRAND-TOUR、MCD、GEODE三个公开基准共17个序列上提升相对轨迹精度：GRAND-TOUR的RTE最高改善70%，GEODE全部7个序列RTE降低9.9%–51.1%；19.5分钟R-Campus长序列后验跳变减少85.4%，而起终点间距仅变化4.7 mm，全局精度基本保持。
AI.conclusion: 在几乎不损失全局精度的前提下显著改善短时运动精度与位姿流平滑性，验证了"后验流上插值式连续时间细化"的有效性；作者计划开源代码与结果以支持社区验证与可复现性。

title: Image Deblending with Diffusion Models
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 22 pages, 10 figures. Code: https://github.com/DanBotchan/image-deblending-diffusion
summary: Image deblending is the task of decomposing a composite image back into its source images, which is an ill-posed problem, as a single blended image can be decomposed into multiple plausible source layers. While diffusion models are often used to solve inverse problems, they typically address single-output reconstruction problems. In this work, we formulate deblending as a joint inverse problem, employing diffusion posterior sampling to simultaneously reconstruct two source images, demonstrating that a single diffusion prior is expressive enough to disentangle two full images at once rather than just one. Drawing inspiration from human perception, where semantic understanding helps disentangle visual inconsistencies, we propose a training-free framework that leverages text prompts to constrain this solution space. We address the blind deblending task through a two-stage architecture: text-guided latent diffusion performs semantic separation using prompts as high-level cues, followed by a pixel-space refinement to recover fine details. Stochastic sampling produces multiple plausible decompositions that can be ranked without ground truth. Extensive experiments show that our training-free method achieves state-of-the-art results on unseen domains and extends to spatially-varying alpha maps, while remaining competitive with supervised baselines on standard scalar blending benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 将图像去混合（deblending）建模为联合逆问题，用扩散后验采样同时重建两张源图，并借助文本提示构造免训练框架，两阶段实现语义分离与细节恢复。
AI.motivation: 去混合是病态问题——同一合成图可对应多种合理源层组合，现有扩散模型多用于单输出重建，难以一次解耦出完整的两张源图；同时语义歧义加剧了解空间的不确定性，需要额外高层先验加以约束。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架：把去混合写成联合逆问题，用扩散后验采样（DPS类）同步重建两个源图，证明单一扩散先验即可分离整图；受人类知觉中语义帮助消解视觉不一致的启发，用文本提示约束解空间。采用两阶段架构处理盲去混合：先由文本引导的潜空间扩散以提示为高层线索做语义分离，再进行像素空间细化以恢复细节；随机采样可产生多个可行分解，并可在无真值条件下排序。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该免训练方法在未见域上达到SOTA，可扩展到空间变化的alpha图，在标准标量混合基准上与有监督基线相当。
AI.conclusion: 语义文本先验结合联合扩散后验采样可有效缓解去混合的病态性，实现免训练、可多解的图像去混合，并具备跨域泛化与变alpha图推广能力。

title: Large Language Models as Digital Twins: a Distribution-Aware Questionnaire-Based Evaluation
comment: This work was partially funded by the European Union within the National Programme 'Research, Innovation and Competitiveness' 2021-2027, project SINTESI (Nr. MI_0000962). F. Di Cursi's, C. Boldrini's, A. Passarella's, and M. Conti's work was also partly funded by the PNRR - M4C2 - Investimento 1.3, Partenariato Esteso PE00000013 - "FAIR"
summary: This paper investigates whether Large Language Models can answer a personality questionnaire as a specific individual would. Given a user's social-media posts, the model completes the BFI-2-60 Big Five questionnaire as that user. The predicted responses are converted into trait scores and compared with the user's actual scores. We evaluate GPT-4, Gemma, Llama 3.1, and Mistral on the MyPersonality dataset. To determine whether predictions reflect information from the user's writing, we compare them with answers produced without user text and with values derived from general population tendencies. We measure prediction error across all users and separately for individuals with low, intermediate, and high trait scores. We also test whether an LLM can express an explicit personality profile when given only the target Big Five scores, without user text, and examine how predictions change as more text is provided. The results show that user text does not consistently improve performance. Models perform better near the middle of the trait distribution, while at the lower and upper ends they often remain close to central values or perform well at one end but poorly at the other. When given an explicit profile, GPT-4 most clearly translates trait information into consistent questionnaire responses, particularly for Extraversion and Neuroticism. Increasing context does not systematically reduce error: open-source models fluctuate more, whereas GPT-4 remains comparatively stable. Overall, the evaluated models do not consistently reproduce the questionnaire behavior of specific individuals.

AI.tldr: 本文检验大语言模型能否在给定用户社交媒体文本时，像该特定个体一样完成BFI-2-60大五人格问卷。结果显示用户文本并未稳定提升预测效果，模型在特质分布中段表现较好、两端较差；给定显式人格画像时GPT-4转化能力最强；增加上下文不系统性降低误差。总体而言，所评估模型无法稳定复现特定个体的问卷作答行为。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM是否具备"模拟特定个体人格"的能力，即基于用户社交媒体文本替代其填写人格问卷，并厘清预测究竟来自用户文本信息还是总体人群先验，从而检验LLM用于个体层面心理测量的有效性边界。
AI.method: 在MyPersonality数据集上评估GPT-4、Gemma、Llama 3.1、Mistral四个模型完成BFI-2-60问卷；将预测作答转换为特质分数并与用户真实分数比较。设置三类对照以检验信息来源：无用户文本的作答、基于总体人群倾向的数值、以及给定显式大五分数画像（无用户文本）的作答；按全体用户及低/中/高特质分组测量预测误差，并考察随文本量增加预测的变化。
AI.result: 用户文本未带来一致的性能提升；模型在特质分布中段误差较小，而在低端与高端常回归中心值，或仅在一端表现良好、另一端表现差。给定显式人格画像时，GPT-4最能将特质信息转化为一致的问卷作答，尤其在Extraversion与Neuroticism上。增加上下文并未系统性降低误差：开源模型波动更大，GPT-4相对稳定。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM尚不能稳定复现特定个体的问卷作答行为；预测更多依赖总体先验与中心化倾向，而非真正从用户文本中提取个体化人格信息。将LLM用于个体层面人格推断需谨慎，并需以分组误差分析与对照基线作为必要评估手段。

title: SpaceMCP: Vision Language Model Spatial Reasoning via Model Context Protocol
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Embodied Spatial Reasoning (ESR) at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Despite impressive advances in large language models (LLM), vision-language models (VLM) still exhibit limited spatial reasoning capabilities. Recent progress in feed-forward 3D reconstruction has enabled precise, real-time geometric understanding from visual inputs. In this work, we propose SpaceMCP, a framework that leverages these advances to introduce an MCP-style paradigm for spatial reasoning. Our approach augments a VLM with structured function calls, allowing it to query a scene graph for spatial information such as distances, object positioning, and camera properties. The scene graph is constructed in real time using feed-forward 3D reconstruction to recover metric geometry, combined with open-vocabulary segmentation to identify and localize relevant objects within the scene. Paired with the VLM's strong reasoning capabilities, the VLM is able to combine this primitive information to solve more complex spatial tasks. Without any training, SpaceMCP achieves state-of-the-art results on VSI-Bench, MMSI-Bench and VSTI-Bench, outperforming recent spatially post-trained VLMs and improving its base VLM by 15-22 points per benchmark. We argue that, given the contrast between the relatively slow progress in native VLM spatial reasoning and the rapid advances in feed-forward 3D computer vision, this paradigm offers a promising path forward for enabling robust spatial reasoning.

AI.tldr: SpaceMCP：借助前馈三维重建构建实时场景图，通过MCP式结构化函数调用为VLM注入空间信息，无需训练即在多个空间推理基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: VLM空间推理能力仍有限，而原生空间推理进展缓慢，同时前馈三维重建能快速提供精确的度量几何理解，二者进展速度不匹配，因此需要一种新范式把几何能力注入VLM。
AI.method: 提出SpaceMCP框架：用前馈三维重建实时恢复度量几何，结合开放词汇分割识别并定位场景中物体，构建场景图；为VLM提供结构化函数调用接口（MCP式工具调用），使其可查询距离、物体位置、相机参数等空间信息，再由VLM自身推理组合这些基元信息完成复杂空间任务。全程无训练。
AI.result: 在VSI-Bench、MMSI-Bench、VSTI-Bench上达到SOTA，超过近期经空间后训练的VLM，相对其基座VLM在每个基准上提升15–22个点。
AI.conclusion: 鉴于VLM原生空间推理进展缓慢而前馈三维视觉进展迅速，将三维几何作为可调用工具、由VLM负责推理的组合式范式是提升鲁棒空间推理的有前景路径。

title: Maximizing LLM Utility While Managing LLM Fallibility
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can supply autonomous systems with plans, predictions, and judgments, but these contributions are sometimes wrong. This review asks how a system can maximize an LLM's utility while managing its fallibility. Our answer is to adapt the system's reliance on the LLM as evidence about the LLM's performance accumulates. Systems built from imperfect components, such as noisy sensors and faulty software, have long worked in this way, and the classical methods they use can be applied to LLM-based systems as well. A system can change its reliance on an LLM in several ways, depending on the LLM's role and on the other components in the system. Each change needs an estimate of the LLM's reliability, and the LLM's role and the kind of contribution it makes determine what to estimate. Classical methods from decision theory, estimation, and online learning then turn these estimates into reliance decisions. These decisions can reduce how often LLM errors affect the system. However, some errors matter even when they are rare. An independently verified mechanism can prevent such errors from being executed. Without one, adapting reliance using reliability estimates can still keep their risk within a bound. Studies on adapting reliance on LLMs are emerging but limited, and the reviewed comparisons suggest that adapting reliance can improve system performance.

AI.tldr: 该综述主张：不应盲目信任或弃用LLM，而应依据对LLM可靠性的持续估计，动态调整系统对LLM的依赖程度；经典决策论、估计理论与在线学习方法可将这些可靠性估计转化为依赖决策，从而降低LLM错误对系统的影响并将风险控制在界内。
AI.motivation: LLM可为自主系统提供规划、预测与判断，但其输出时有错误。核心问题是：系统如何在利用LLM价值的同时管理其不可靠性。作者指出，由不完美部件（如噪声传感器、缺陷软件）构成的系统早已采用"按部件性能动态调整依赖"的思路，这类经典方法同样适用于LLM系统。
AI.method: 概念性综述与框架构建：1）按LLM在系统中的角色及其贡献类型，界定需要估计的可靠性指标；2）讨论系统改变依赖LLM的多种方式（取决于LLM角色与其他组件）；3）用决策论、估计与在线学习的经典方法将可靠性估计转化为依赖决策；4）对高影响稀有错误，提出以独立验证机制阻止其被执行，否则以可靠性估计自适应调整依赖仍可将风险约束在界内。
AI.result: 现有关于LLM依赖自适应调整的实证研究仍处起步阶段且数量有限；但综述中的对比表明，自适应调整依赖能够提升系统整体性能，并减少LLM错误传播至系统行为的频率。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM视为可评估可靠性的不完美组件，并借助成熟的自适应依赖机制加以管理，是兼顾LLM效用与可控风险的有效路径。未来需更多针对不同LLM角色、可靠性估计方法与验证机制的实证研究。

title: AIFR: Adaptive Identity Feature Recovery for Diffusion-Based Makeup and Anime Portraits
summary: Diffusion-based makeup and anime portraits are increasingly popular in online content creation (e.g., virtual makeup editing and anime avatar generation), but their altered appearances can hinder face recognition (FR) in identity-based content screening. Existing methods mainly adapt FR encoders or restore input images. The former require costly gallery re-encoding, while the latter may be incomplete or distort identity-related facial details. To address these limitations, we aim to correct identity features within a frozen FR model to recover its output embeddings in its original space. Appearance changes vary in strength and affect facial regions differently. To this end, we propose Adaptive Identity Feature Recovery (AIFR), a framework that inserts a lightweight recovery module at a single intermediate layer to predict sample-level correction strength and spatially adaptive residual updates. Module training uses fused identity targets to guide embedding recovery in the original FR space and an identity-shift score to regulate correction strength and limit unnecessary changes. At inference, AIFR processes a single portrait in one forward pass without reference images, producing recovered embeddings that can be directly matched with existing gallery templates without re-encoding. With only 1.22M trainable parameters, AIFR improves the average TAR at FAR=$10^{-4}$ from 66.1\% to 90.2\% over the original ArcFace, and further experiments show improvements across unseen makeup styles, stylization strengths, and generators. Beyond recognition, the recovered embeddings can directly condition a pretrained Arc2Face model to generate faces with improved identity preservation, showing compatibility with embedding-conditioned downstream generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应身份特征恢复（AIFR）框架，在冻结的人脸识别模型单个中间层插入轻量模块，通过样本级校正强度与空间自适应残差更新，把妆容/动漫化人脸的嵌入恢复到原始空间，无需重编码底库，即可显著提升识别性能并兼容下游身份条件生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型生成的妆容编辑与动漫头像在网络内容创作中日益普及，但其外观改变会削弱人脸识别（FR），影响基于身份的内容审核。现有方案要么微调 FR 编码器（需昂贵的底库重编码），要么先复原输入图像（恢复不完整且可能扭曲身份相关细节）。作者希望在冻结 FR 模型的原始嵌入空间中直接校正身份特征，以规避上述两类缺陷。
AI.method: 提出 AIFR 框架：在冻结 FR 模型的单个中间层插入轻量恢复模块（仅 1.22M 可训练参数），预测样本级校正强度与空间自适应残差更新；训练时以融合身份目标监督原始 FR 空间中的嵌入恢复，并用身份偏移分数（identity-shift score）约束校正强度、抑制不必要改动；推理阶段单张人像单次前向、无需参考图像，恢复后的嵌入可直接与已有底库模板匹配。
AI.result: 在 FAR=10⁻⁴ 下，相较原版 ArcFace，AIFR 将平均 TAR 从 66.1% 提升至 90.2%；进一步实验表明在未见过的妆容风格、风格化强度与生成器上均有提升；恢复后的嵌入可直接驱动预训练 Arc2Face 模型生成身份保持更好的人脸。
AI.conclusion: AIFR 以极低参数代价在冻结 FR 模型内部完成身份特征恢复，兼顾识别精度、泛化性与部署效率，并与嵌入条件式下游生成任务兼容，为外观改变场景下的人脸识别与身份审核提供了实用的解决方案。

title: AstroMemBench: A Benchmark for Memory Systems in Embodied Spacecraft Agents
comment: 31 pages, 4 figures, 19 tables. Includes Appendices A-E
summary: Long-term spacecraft autonomy requires embodied agents to use operational history under communication delays, time-critical operations, environmental uncertainty, complex physical interactions, power and computational constraints, and safety and reliability requirements. We introduce AstroMemBench and a Scenario-Challenge-Capability design method that maps these requirements to executable memory tests. The benchmark covers 16 memory subchallenges through 140 templates and 2240 instances across nine tasks in planetary surface operations, on-orbit servicing, and deep-space exploration. A deterministic environment scores actions for task completion, state changes, safety, and resource use. Ablations under nine conditions show that the benchmark is sensitive to how accurately agents recover and use historical information and to differences in memory-system design. Main experiments compare six configurations. Mem0, Chain-of-Memory, LightMem, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improve same-session mean scores over native Pi Agent, with no clear advantage of the three memory systems over RAG. After a session restart, Mem0 outperforms RAG by 12.25 points. Benefits favor instruction retention and result reuse over ongoing state tracking and energy reservation. AstroMemBench supports the design, development, and selection of memory systems for embodied spacecraft agents. AstroMemBench 1.0 and its evaluation code are publicly available: https://github.com/flyingView/AstroMemBench-v1.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AstroMemBench 基准与"场景—挑战—能力"（Scenario-Challenge-Capability）设计方法，将航天器具身智能体的记忆需求转化为可执行测试，覆盖 16 类记忆子挑战、140 个模板、2240 个实例与 9 项任务。
AI.motivation: 长期航天器自主运行要求具身智能体在通信时延、时间紧迫操作、环境不确定性、复杂物理交互、功耗与算力受限、安全与可靠性约束下利用历史运行经验；现有工作缺乏针对该场景记忆能力的系统化评测手段。
AI.method: 构建覆盖行星表面作业、在轨服务与深空探测的 9 项任务评测集；采用确定性环境对动作在任务完成度、状态变化、安全性与资源使用四个维度打分；设计 9 种消融条件检验基准敏感性，并对比 6 种智能体配置（原生 Pi Agent、Mem0、Chain-of-Memory、LightMem、RAG 等）。
AI.result: 消融实验表明基准对智能体历史信息恢复与利用精度、以及记忆系统设计差异敏感；Mem0、Chain-of-Memory、LightMem 与 RAG 均优于原生 Pi Agent 的同会话平均得分，但三类记忆系统相对 RAG 无显著优势；会话重启后 Mem0 比 RAG 高 12.25 分；收益主要体现在指令保持与结果复用，而非持续状态跟踪与能量预留。
AI.conclusion: AstroMemBench 可支撑具身航天器智能体记忆系统的设计、开发与选型，且基准与评测代码已开源（github.com/flyingView/AstroMemBench-v1）。

title: Characterizing Predictive Multiplicity in Ranking and Its Fairness Implications
summary: Prediction problems often admit competing models that achieve comparable performance yet produce conflicting outputs, a phenomenon known as predictive multiplicity. While this challenge has been extensively studied in classification tasks, its implications remain largely unexplored in ranking frameworks, which are critical for high-stakes societal decisions such as the allocation of welfare resources and social assistance. This paper investigates the phenomenon of predictive multiplicity in score-based ranking problems. We introduce formal definitions to capture multiplicity in ranking settings, supported by foundational theoretical guarantees. Furthermore, we examine the dual relationship between predictive multiplicity and algorithmic fairness in ranking problems: we analyze how model multiplicity can act as a potential source of unfairness, while demonstrating how exploring this decision space provides a principled avenue for discovering less discriminatory rankings. Finally, we complement our theoretical contributions with insightful empirical evaluations on both synthetic and real-world datasets, validating our analytical findings and illustrating their practical implications. Taken together, this work highlights the real-world relevance of predictive multiplicity in ranking and sheds light on the potential of leveraging this effect to achieve fairer outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文将"预测多重性"(predictive multiplicity)从分类任务拓展到基于分数的排序问题，给出排序多重性的形式化定义与理论保证，并揭示其与排序公平性的双重关系：多重性既是潜在不公平来源，也可作为搜索更少歧视性排序的原理性途径，最后用合成与真实数据验证。
AI.motivation: 预测问题中常存在性能相当却输出相互冲突的竞争模型，即预测多重性。该现象在分类任务中已被广泛研究，但在排序框架中几乎未被探讨；而排序对福利资源分配、社会救助等高风险社会决策至关重要，因此需要厘清多重性在排序场景下的含义与后果。
AI.method: 提出刻画排序场景下多重性的形式化定义，并给出基础性理论保证；从理论上分析预测多重性与排序公平性的双向关系——一方面论证模型多重性如何构成不公平的潜在来源，另一方面说明在此决策空间中进行探索可为发现歧视性更低的排序提供有原则的途径；辅以合成数据与真实数据集的实证评估。
AI.result: 理论结果给出了排序多重性定义下的保证，并刻画了多重性与公平性之间的双重关联；实证结果验证了分析结论，并展示了该现象在实践中的具体影响。
AI.conclusion: 本文凸显了预测多重性在排序问题中的现实相关性，并表明可利用这一效应来获得更公平的排序结果。

title: SALA: Semantically Aligned Latent Actions Enable Dual-Axis Scaling of Embodied Foundation Models
summary: Embodied foundation models hinge on diverse robot interaction data, which are costly to collect. Egocentric human videos offer a complementary source of experience, and latent action models (LAMs) provide a popular means of leveraging these videos for policy supervision. Compared with world-action models (WAMs), LAMs can offer greater training efficiency and potentially lower inference costs by avoiding explicit pixel prediction during policy learning and execution. However, most existing LAMs learn latent actions solely through video reconstruction, which can cause their representations to cluster by visual appearance rather than by the underlying actions. As a result, they struggle to align human actions with their robot counterparts. To bridge the gap, we introduce SALA, which emphasizes establishing the semantic correspondence for latent actions. Without requiring paired data, we use the language descriptions of unpaired human and robot clips to estimate semantic similarities and supervise cross-embodiment correspondence. Specifically, we translate these similarities into soft neighborhood structures that guide human latent actions toward semantically related robot latents, while robot action reconstruction grounds the latent space in control. The resulting shared latent action space provides a unified supervision signal for training an embodied foundation model on both human and robot videos. Notably, latent action supervision enables scaling along two axes: (1) pre-training on increasing amounts of general human video consistently reduces robot action prediction error on downstream tasks, and (2) post-training on increasing amounts of task-specific human video substantially improves real-world robot task success rates.

AI.tldr: 提出SALA，通过语言描述估计跨本体的语义相似度并构造软邻域结构，监督人类与机器人潜动作的语义对应，无需配对数据即可构建共享潜动作空间，用于具身基础模型训练。
AI.motivation: 具身基础模型依赖昂贵的机器人交互数据；第一人称人类视频可作补充，潜动作模型（LAM）相比世界动作模型（WAM）训练更高效、推理成本更低。但现有LAM仅靠视频重建学习潜动作，表征易按视觉外观而非底层动作聚类，难以将人类动作与机器人对应动作对齐。
AI.method: SALA强调建立潜动作的语义对应：无需配对数据，利用无配对的人类与机器人视频片段的语言描述估计语义相似度；将其转化为软邻域结构，引导人类潜动作向语义相关的机器人潜动作靠拢，同时以机器人动作重建将潜空间锚定于控制。所得共享潜动作空间为人类与机器人视频训练具身基础模型提供统一监督信号。
AI.result: 潜动作监督支持两个维度的扩展：(1) 预训练中增加通用人类视频数量，可一致降低下游任务的机器人动作预测误差；(2) 后训练中增加任务特定人类视频，可显著提升真实机器人任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 以语言为桥梁对齐跨本体潜动作，可在不依赖配对数据的前提下获得语义一致的共享潜动作空间，使人类视频成为可扩展的具身模型监督来源，兼顾预训练与后训练阶段的性能提升。

title: Prior-as-Skill: Remember Outside and Read Inside with On-Policy Self-Distillation for Self-Evolving VLM Agents
summary: Self-evolving visual agents keep what they learn as skills: key frames with step notes on a task's steps and their order. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is now a popular way to train such skills into a vision-language model that matches, on its own answers, a teacher that also reads the written order. At deployment, frames often go missing or show an unusual order, as when a person or a website reorders the steps. Existing internalization methods keep any order they store in the frame-reading weights: trained on full frames, the model guesses when they are missing, and trained with frames withheld, it stores the order, so memory can override what it sees. We propose PriorSplit, which fills in missing frames from an order kept outside the model, with no training beyond OPSD. It counts which of two neighboring steps comes first in training episodes, and the model checks if both asked steps are in view: if so, it answers from the frames, and otherwise the counts answer. Extensive experiments on synthetic skills with five models and on step-tagged order questions in new episodes of seen web, cooking and egocentric tasks demonstrate that, with frames missing, PriorSplit outperforms every compared method at OPSD's training cost. With Qwen3-VL-4B on synthetic skills, it also stays close to OPSD on unusual orders, where methods that gain most by storing the order fall behind.

AI.tldr: PriorSplit 将“步骤顺序”这一先验从模型权重中剥离，改为外置计数表：训练时统计相邻两步谁先出现，推理时若所问两步都在画面中则由帧决定，否则由计数回答，从而在不增加 OPSD 训练成本的前提下解决帧缺失与帧乱序问题。
AI.motivation: 现有 on-policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）把技能（关键帧+步骤注释及其顺序）内化进视觉语言模型权重，导致顺序记忆与视觉证据耦合：全帧训练时模型在缺帧时只能靠猜；抽帧训练时模型反而把顺序硬编码进权重，使内部记忆可压过实际观测。部署场景中帧缺失或步骤被重排十分常见，因此需要解耦“读帧能力”与“顺序知识”。
AI.method: 提出 PriorSplit：除 OPSD 外不引入额外训练。用一个位于模型之外的计数结构，统计训练回合中相邻两步的先后频次；推理时模型先判断被询问的两步是否同时可见——可见则完全依据帧作答，否则退回到计数先验作答。相当于让模型学习“按需查询先验”的路由策略，而非把顺序写进权重。
AI.result: 在合成技能上使用 5 个模型，以及在已见 web、烹饪、自我中心（egocentric）任务的新回合中做带步骤标注的顺序问答，实验表明：帧缺失情形下 PriorSplit 在 OPSD 同等训练成本下优于所有对比方法；在 Qwen3-VL-4B 的合成技能上，面对异常顺序时其表现仍接近 OPSD，而那些主要靠存储顺序获益的方法则明显退化。
AI.conclusion: 顺序知识应以外部可查询先验的形式保留，而非压入帧理解权重；显式的“何时看帧、何时查先验”路由可同时获得缺帧鲁棒性与乱序鲁棒性，且无需额外训练开销。

title: Singularity-Bench: Can Agents Build Agents?
summary: Frontier AI agents increasingly succeed on realistic, long-horizon tasks and are beginning to improve the systems through which they operate. Yet existing benchmarks often restrict agents to narrow action spaces, use simplified environments, or rely on verification methods that are unreliable for evaluating arbitrary agent-generated systems. We introduce Singularity-Bench, an open-ended benchmark for autonomous AI development with six end-to-end tasks spanning pre-training, mid-training, post-training, inference, the agent harness, and cluster orchestration. Each task requires agents to implement core systems from a minimal starting point and evaluates them against mature human-engineered baselines on identical hardware. Additionally, through extensive red-teaming covering 9 of the 10 categories in the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, we expose reward-hacking vulnerabilities in the conventional Harbor framework and develop Breakwater, an extension of Harbor that blocks all attacks tested in our study. Across 11 agents built from 7 frontier models and 2 harnesses, Opus 5.5 with Claude Code matches or outperforms the human baseline on all six tasks with a Singularity-Index of 1.25, suggesting it may have the skills needed to reach the singularity. The remaining agents average only 0.58. Our vision is for Singularity-Bench to track how much of AI development agents can already automate and when they may transition from assisting to taking end-to-end responsibility for building stronger successors.

AI.tldr: 提出开放式基准 Singularity-Bench，含预训练、中期训练、后训练、推理、智能体框架与集群编排六项端到端任务，要求智能体从最小起点实现核心系统并与人工基线在同硬件上对比；同时发现 Harbor 框架的奖励攻击漏洞并提出 Breakwater 修复；Opus 5.5 配 Claude Code 达 Singularity-Index 1.25，其余智能体平均仅 0.58。
AI.motivation: 现有基准将智能体限制在狭窄动作空间、使用简化环境，或依赖对任意智能体生成系统不可靠的验证方法，无法衡量智能体在真实长周期 AI 研发任务上的能力，也难以判断其何时可从"辅助"转向"端到端负责"。
AI.method: 构建含六项覆盖 AI 研发全链路任务的开放式基准，各任务从最小起点出发、在同构硬件上与成熟人工工程基线对比；对智能体应用 OWASP Top 10 中 9 类进行红队测试，揭示 Harbor 框架的奖励攻击漏洞，并开发防攻击扩展 Breakwater；评测 7 个前沿模型、2 种框架共 11 个智能体。
AI.result: Opus 5.5 + Claude Code 在六项任务上全部达到或超过人工基线，Singularity-Index 为 1.25；其余智能体平均仅 0.58。Breakwater 阻断了研究中测试的全部攻击。
AI.conclusion: Singularity-Bench 可作为追踪 AI 研发自动化程度、判断智能体何时从辅助角色转为端到端构建更强后继系统的观测工具；但结论建立在单一强配置之上，需持续跟踪并强化评测防奖励攻击能力。

title: Efficient Knowledge Transfer in Federated Bayesian Optimization through Neural Network Surrogates
summary: Federated Bayesian Optimization (FedBO) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for enhancing Bayesian Optimization (BO) in distributed, privacy-sensitive settings, enabling agents to accelerate the optimization of their local objectives by sharing knowledge about their similarities without exposing raw data. However, existing methods rely on restrictive assumptions, such as near-identical objective functions or shared Gaussian process hyperparameters that are often violated in heterogeneous real-world applications. We present GLOBAFED, a novel framework that enables efficient knowledge transfer across different but related objectives without compromising privacy. At its core is a probabilistic neural network surrogate with a shared feature-extracting backbone and agent-specific heads equipped with varia- tional Bayesian last layers to provide uncertainty estimates. During optimization, agents use federated learning on the shared backbone to collaboratively build a common latent feature representation, while agent-specific heads adapt to their individual objectives. Our empirical results demonstrate that GLOBAFED significantly accelerates convergence and reaches better final performance compared to state-of-the-art FedBO baselines, and enables agents to warm-start their optimization from previously learned global features.

AI.tldr: 提出 GLOBAFED：以共享特征提取骨干 + 智能体专属头（含变分贝叶斯最后一层提供不确定性）的概率神经网络代理模型，实现异构目标下的联邦贝叶斯优化。
AI.motivation: 现有 FedBO 依赖近似相同目标函数或共享 GP 超参等强假设，在异构真实场景中常被违反，限制了知识迁移的有效性。
AI.method: 概率神经网络代理：共享骨干通过联邦学习协同构建公共潜在特征表示；每个智能体使用专属头适配各自目标，末层采用变分贝叶斯提供不确定性估计。
AI.result: 与 SOTA FedBO 基线相比显著加速收敛并获得更优最终性能，且支持从已学到的全局特征进行热启动。
AI.conclusion: 通过在共享表示与个体适配间解耦，可在不泄露原始数据的前提下实现不同但相关目标间的高效知识迁移。

title: FORGE: Force-Aware Multi-Granularity Control for Efficient Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated locomotion, balance regulation, and manipulation under frequent contacts, making teleoperated demonstration collection difficult: a practical controller must simultaneously provide precision, stability, and contact awareness. We propose FORGE, a force-aware multi-granularity control system with a coarse-to-fine command space spanning velocity navigation, planar foot placement, wrist-pose tracking, and optional force-conditioning inputs. Policy training requires no full-body human motion trajectories or joint-angle references; deployment consumes only sparse bilateral wrist poses relative to the pelvis, coarse motion commands, and optional desired wrist-load inputs. For sustained contact, FORGE combines a momentum observer with a learned correction trained using simulator contact-force supervision. At deployment, it estimates low-frequency, wrist-equivalent interaction forces from proprioception and reconstructed low-level arm PD torques, without wrist force/torque sensors. A quasi-static virtual-target loop uses this estimate and an optional desired applied-force input to adapt the wrist target. A frozen locomotion prior and asymmetric residual actions stabilize manipulation-induced whole-body corrections. Experiments evaluate unified-control stability, task-space tracking, quasi-static wrist-equivalent force estimation, squeezing forces during sustained contact with a rigid box, and downstream diffusion-policy execution of a squat-and-lift task across payload conditions. Website: https://bb0928.github.io/forge/.

AI.tldr: 提出 FORGE——面向人形机器人全身移动-操作（loco-manipulation）的力感知多粒度控制系统，采用从粗到细的命令空间，无需全身人体动作轨迹或关节角参考，仅凭稀疏腕部位姿、速度指令与可选力期望即可完成遥操作示教与策略部署，并在无腕部力/力矩传感器条件下实现等效腕力估计与持续接触力控制。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人移动-操作需在频繁接触下协调行走、平衡调节与操作，遥操作示教采集困难，控制器须同时兼顾精度、稳定性与接触感知；同时现有方法常依赖全身人体动作捕捉轨迹或关节角参考，且需要腕部力/力矩传感器，部署成本高。
AI.method: 1）多粒度命令空间：速度导航→平面落脚点→腕部位姿跟踪→可选的力条件输入，由粗到细分层解耦；2）训练阶段不使用全身人体运动轨迹与关节角参考，部署仅消费相对骨盆的稀疏双侧腕部位姿、粗粒度运动指令与可选期望腕部负载；3）持续接触采用动量观测器 + 学习式修正，修正项以仿真器接触力为监督信号训练；4）部署端由本体感知与重建的低层手臂PD力矩估计低频、腕部等效交互力，无需腕部F/T传感器；5）准静态虚拟目标回路依据该力估计与可选期望施加力自适应调整腕部目标；6）以冻结的运动先验 + 非对称残差动作稳定操作引发的全身修正。
AI.result: 实验覆盖五项评估：统一控制稳定性、任务空间跟踪、准静态腕部等效力估计、与刚性箱体持续接触时的挤压力控制，以及在不同负载条件下的蹲起举升任务的扩散策略下游执行。
AI.conclusion: FORGE 以力感知的多粒度控制与残差式全身修正，在低成本稀疏输入、无腕部力传感器的条件下实现了精度、稳定性与接触感知的统一，可支撑人形机器人遥操作示教采集与下游扩散策略的实机执行。

title: VibePrevisBench: Evaluating Agentic Coding for 4D Scene Generation in Blender
summary: Controllable real-world video generation models can condition on a rendered graybox proxy video, which fixes layout, motion and camera. Coding agents can build such videos by reconstructing a 4D scene in Blender, yet no benchmark checks both these videos and the long, multi-shot scenes behind them. We introduce VibePrevisBench, a benchmark for 4D scene reconstruction: an agent turns a brief into an executable 4D scene and renders its proxy video. Its 242 tasks span four input kinds, including scripts, photos, continuations, and reference videos. Each delivery is scored along two evaluation dimensions. Rule-based Scene Check re-runs the code and compares the exported 4D scene with hidden ground truth facts in nine dimensions. VLM-based Screen Check asks a VLM judge whether the facts that pass can be recognized in the proxy video. We analyze the evaluation results and trajectories of 11 frontier coding agents and identify three key observations. First, multimodal understanding separates the agents, especially in understanding space and camera motion. Second, all agents seem to already master basic camera work and staging, and fail at challenging requests. Third, agents inspect their own renders but fail to correct their errors. Agents thus need better visual understanding of space and camera, explicit checks for challenging requests, and item-by-item verification of renders against the brief.

AI.tldr: 提出 VibePrevisBench，首个同时评测"由 brief 生成可执行 4D 场景并渲染 proxy 视频"与"其背后长时段多镜头场景"的基准，揭示 11 个前沿编码 agent 在空间/相机理解、难题处理与自我纠错上的三类缺陷。
AI.motivation: 可控真实世界视频生成模型可用渲染的 graybox proxy video 作为条件（固定布局、运动与相机）。编码 agent 可在 Blender 中重建 4D 场景来生成这类视频，但目前缺乏既评测 proxy 视频、又评测其背后长时段多镜头场景的基准。
AI.method: 构建 VibePrevisBench：242 个任务，覆盖脚本、照片、续写、参考视频四类输入；agent 需将 brief 转化为可执行 4D 场景并渲染 proxy 视频。采用双维度评测：(1) 规则式 Scene Check，重跑代码并将导出的 4D 场景与隐藏 ground truth 事实在九个维度上比对；(2) VLM 式 Screen Check，由 VLM judge 判断通过的事实能否在 proxy 视频中被识别。
AI.result: 对 11 个前沿编码 agent 的评测结果与轨迹分析得出三点观察：其一，多模态理解（尤其空间与相机运动理解）是 agent 间的区分因素；其二，所有 agent 已掌握基础运镜与场面调度，但在高难度请求上失败；其三，agent 会检查自身渲染结果，却无法据此纠正错误。
AI.conclusion: agent 需要更强的空间与相机的视觉理解能力、针对高难度请求的显式检查机制，以及将渲染结果与 brief 逐项核验的流程。

title: A Dual-Branch Graph and Convolutional Network for Interpretable Movement EEG Classification
summary: Decoding upper-limb movements from scalp electroencephalography (EEG) is an important problem for brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), but many deep learning models provide limited insight into the brain regions underlying their predictions. We propose a two-branch architecture that combines an LGGNet-inspired local-global graph branch with an EEGNet-style convolutional branch for movement-versus-rest classification. The graph branch groups 61 EEG electrodes into anatomically informed regions and learns their spatial relationships, providing a direct representation of the regions emphasized by the model. We evaluate the proposed architecture using leave-one-subject-out cross-validation on the Ofner upper-limb movement dataset. The model achieves a mean F1-score of 0.74 +/- 0.06 across subjects. Beyond classification performance, we analyze the learned graph structure to identify the regions with the strongest connectivity. Across all held-out subjects, the highest connectivity is consistently observed in the Parietal Left Low region, corresponding to electrodes P1 and P3. This region is opposite to the performed right-arm movements and lies within the posterior parietal area previously associated with upper-limb movement processing. These results show that incorporating a region-based graph into the decoder can provide an anatomically interpretable representation while maintaining effective movement classification, offering a practical approach toward more transparent EEG-based BCIs.

AI.tldr: 提出双分支EEG解码架构（LGGNet式局部-全局图分支+EEGNet式卷积分支），在Ofner上肢运动数据集上以留一被试交叉验证实现运动/静息分类平均F1=0.74±0.06，并通过图结构识别出左侧顶叶低区（P1、P3）为最强连通区域，兼顾性能与解剖可解释性。
AI.motivation: 基于头皮EEG的上肢运动解码对BCI意义重大，但现有深度学习模型多为黑箱，难以揭示其预测所依赖的脑区，缺乏解剖学层面的可解释性。
AI.method: 构建双分支架构：一支为受LGGNet启发的局部-全局图分支，将61导联按解剖先验划分为若干脑区并学习区域间空间关系；另一支为EEGNet风格卷积分支；用于"运动vs静息"二分类。采用留一被试交叉验证在Ofner上肢运动数据集上评估，并对学习到的图结构进行连通性分析。
AI.result: 跨被试平均F1为0.74±0.06；在所有留出被试中，最强连通性一致出现在左侧顶叶低区（Parietal Left Low，对应P1、P3电极），该区域位于执行右臂运动肢体的对侧，属既往与上肢运动加工相关的后顶叶区域。
AI.conclusion: 在解码器中引入基于脑区的图结构，可在保持有效运动分类性能的同时提供解剖可解释的表示，为构建更透明的EEG-BCI提供了可行路径。

title: Curiosity-0826-4B: Generative Medical Event Sequence Modeling Across Pediatric and Adult Populations
summary: We introduce Curiosity-0826-4B, an updated version of the generative medical event foundation model trained on Epic Cosmos that simulates patient timelines to produce zero-shot clinical predictions. Curiosity-0826-4B incorporates a broader patient population and richer clinical event representations, while generally matching or exceeding Curiosity-0226-1B, the largest model in the previous Curiosity-0226 series, on evaluated tasks supported by both models. Laboratory value prediction improved, with MAE 18--46% lower than that of Curiosity-0226-1B. We evaluated prediction of disease events across pediatric cohorts aged 2--17 years. AUROCs for new asthma diagnosis (0.742--0.785) and asthma exacerbation (0.829--0.852) were comparable to those in the adult reference cohort, while AUROCs for sickle cell crisis (0.820--0.847) were lower than in adults (0.915). Explicit representation of documented death enabled new mortality prediction tasks among adults across hospice, inpatient, and ambulatory settings (AUROC 0.821--0.942). Scaling-law analysis guided compute-optimal initial pretraining followed by continued pretraining with context extension. The resulting Curiosity-0826-4B model has more parameters (4.3B versus 1B) and a longer context window (16K versus 8K). It processes 56% fewer training tokens and requires 2.2 times the training floating point operations (FLOPs) compared with its predecessor. By extending a common zero-shot prediction strategy to pediatric patients and additional outcomes, Curiosity-0826-4B broadens opportunities to develop clinical and operational applications without training separate task-specific models. Further validation should assess local calibration, performance across patient subgroups and event frequencies, timeline completion rates, and generalization to new settings, alongside prospective evaluation of clinical and operational utility.

AI.tldr: Curiosity-0826-4B 是基于 Epic Cosmos 训练的生成式医疗事件基础模型升级版，参数增至 4.3B、上下文窗口扩展至 16K，通过模拟患者时间线实现零样本临床预测，并新增儿科疾病与成人死亡预测任务。
AI.motivation: 扩展前代 Curiosity-0226 系列在患者人群覆盖与临床事件表征上的局限，使零样本预测能力延伸至儿科人群及更多结局（如死亡），从而在无需单独训练任务模型的前提下支持临床与运营应用。
AI.method: 整合更广的患者人群与更丰富的临床事件表示；依据缩放律分析确定计算最优的初始预训练，随后进行上下文扩展的继续预训练。模型规模由 1B 增至 4.3B 参数，上下文由 8K 增至 16K；训练 token 减少 56%，训练 FLOPs 为前代的 2.2 倍。
AI.result: 在两者共同支持的任务上总体持平或更优：实验室值预测 MAE 降低 18–46%。儿科（2–17 岁）队列中，新发哮喘 AUROC 0.742–0.785、哮喘急性加重 0.829–0.852，与成人参考队列相当；镰状细胞危象 AUROC 0.820–0.847，低于成人（0.915）。显式建模“记录死亡”后，可在临终关怀、住院与门诊场景开展成人死亡预测（AUROC 0.821–0.942）。
AI.conclusion: Curiosity-0826-4B 将通用零样本预测策略扩展至儿科患者及新结局，拓宽了无需任务特定模型的临床与运营应用空间；后续仍需验证本地校准、亚组与事件频率下的表现、时间线完成率、新场景泛化性及前瞻性临床与运营效用。

title: Inner Product Regularization for Imitation Learning
summary: Robots that learn from demonstrations should extrapolate their policy despite state perturbations such as sensor noise, scene variation, and compounding errors. One approach to this robustness is regularization. Prior regularizers consider each state on its own and limit how sensitive the policy is to any perturbation at that state. By contrast, we explore how the policy's output shifts when given the same perturbation at different states. Our insight is that, locally, the robot should respond to state perturbations in a consistent manner: e.g., if changing an irrelevant object position does not impact the policy at one state, that same change should not shift the policy output at a nearby state. Applying this insight, we develop inner product regularization (InneR). We show that the inner product on action space induces an inner product on state space through the policy Jacobian (the Fisher information for stochastic policies), and that the null space of this inner product governs which state perturbations have a first-order effect on the policy. By clustering states whose inner products are aligned, averaging the inner products within each cluster, and minimizing the smallest eigenvalues of that average, InneR shapes the learned policy so that nearby states share a common null space. InneR enforces consistent responses to perturbations without limiting policy expressiveness, and can be appended to existing imitation learning pipelines for deterministic or stochastic policies. In simulated experiments, InneR makes learned policies more robust to irrelevant state dimensions and shifts between training and test distributions, whereas norm penalties often perform worse than behavior cloning. On a real robot arm performing three manipulation tasks, InneR raises the average success rate of a diffusion policy from 18% to 57% without additional data.
