To address this challenge, we propose BiScopeNet, a framework that augments existing video-LLMs without modifying their vision encoders or language models. BiScopeNet incorporates two components: FocusAlign, a gated text-guided attention-based module that selectively aligns video features with textual context to emphasise action-relevant cues, and MetaLoss, a masked, object-weighted loss that prioritises visually grounded terms. To supervise sub-action detection, we introduce BiScopeCap-100K, a large-scale video-level dataset curated from existing egocentric datasets, providing dense captions that jointly describe high-level actions, left/right-hand roles, and manipulated objects, enriched with spatial metadata for grounding. Across the evaluated Video-LLM backbones, BiScopeNet improves action, hand-role, and object recognition over the corresponding supervised baselines, achieving the strongest aggregate performance among the evaluated configurations on BiScopeCap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出子动作检测任务与BiScopeNet框架，在不改动视觉编码器和语言模型的前提下增强视频大模型对第一人称动作中左右手角色及操作物体的辨识能力，并构建BiScopeCap-100K数据集进行监督，在多类骨干上取得最佳综合性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视频大模型（VLMs）在第一人称视角动作理解中，难以区分左手与右手在高层动作中的具体角色及其所操作的物体，缺乏对左右手分工的显式建模。
AI.method: 定义“子动作检测”任务，要求模型显式识别左右手角色与操纵物体；提出BiScopeNet，作为即插即用框架增强现有video-LLM，不改动视觉编码器与语言模型。其包含两个模块：FocusAlign——基于门控的文本引导注意力模块，选择性对齐视频特征与文本上下文以强化动作相关线索；MetaLoss——掩码式、物体加权损失，优先关注视觉可定位的术语。同时构建BiScopeCap-100K大规模视频级数据集，从现有第一人称数据集整理而来，提供密集描述，联合描述高层动作、左右手角色与被操作物体，并附空间元数据以支持定位。
AI.result: 在多个评测的Video-LLM骨干上，BiScopeNet相较对应的有监督基线在动作识别、手部角色识别和物体识别上均有提升，并在BiScopeCap上取得所评估配置中最强的综合性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式的子动作检测任务与轻量级增强模块，可在不修改骨干结构的情况下有效提升第一人称视频理解中左右手角色与物体辨别的能力，配套数据集为后续研究提供了监督基础。

title: CADET: Construction of PCB Routing Instances with Executable Demonstrations
comment: 28 pages, 10 figures, 15 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/LGAI-Research/CADET
summary: Printed circuit board (PCB) routing is the stage of physical layout that finds paths connecting the placed pads of each net. Public datasets in this domain are few, and most contain only the final states of routed boards, not demonstrations of the electronic design automation (EDA) engine actions that produce them. To close this gap, we propose CADET (Constructing executAble Demonstrations for Engine-grounded Training), which jointly generates synthetic boards and demonstrations built from EDA engine actions. The resulting RouteDemos provides 100,000 synthetic boards routed with zero design rule violations (DRVs), together with their demonstrations. Their distributions over 17 statistics resemble those of 142 real reference boards. CADET trains a routing policy on these demonstrations with behavior cloning and fine-tunes it with reinforcement learning (RL). On real test boards, the policy raised the rate of complete DRV-free routing from 38.0% to 67.2% over an RL-only baseline. This rate was comparable to that of the open-source autorouter FreeRouting and exceeded those of the other baselines, including GPT-6 Astra. We release the dataset and its generation code as open source at https://github.com/LGAI-Research/CADET.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CADET，通过 EDA 引擎真实动作联合生成合成 PCB 板与可执行演示数据（RouteDemos，10 万块零 DRV 板），并以行为克隆加 RL 训练布线策略，在真实测试板上将完全无 DRV 布线率从 38.0% 提升至 67.2%，与 FreeRouting 相当，开源数据集与生成代码。
AI.motivation: PCB 布线是物理布局中为每个网络连接已放置焊盘的关键阶段，但该领域公开数据集稀少，且多为布线后的最终板状态，缺乏产生这些状态的 EDA 引擎动作演示，导致难以用监督方式训练引擎对齐的布线策略。
AI.method: CADET 联合合成电路板与由 EDA 引擎动作构建的可执行演示，产出 RouteDemos 数据集（10 万块零设计规则违例板及其演示，17 项统计分布与 142 块真实参考板相近）；在此基础上以行为克隆预训练布线策略，再用强化学习微调。
AI.result: 在真实测试板上，完全零 DRV 布线率由仅 RL 基线的 38.0% 提升至 67.2%，与开源自动布线器 FreeRouting 相当，并优于包括 GPT-6 Astra 在内的其他基线。
AI.conclusion: 引擎真实动作驱动的合成演示数据可有效支撑布线策略学习，缩小公开数据缺口；数据集与生成代码已在 GitHub（LGAI-Research/CADET）开源。

title: Your Hypergradient is Skewed: Antithetic Neumann Estimation for Bilevel Optimization
summary: Bilevel optimization is a core tool in practical machine learning workflows, including hyperparameter tuning, data reweighting, robust learning, reinforcement learning, and imbalanced classification. Hypergradient computation requires the inverse of the inner Hessian, typically estimated via a truncated Neumann series. While existing analyses focus on bias and variance, we show that the product structure of the Neumann series introduces a third source of error: skewness. We identify that, unlike ordinary gradients, whose asymmetry is suppressed by mini-batch averaging, the Neumann estimator amplifies skewness across factors, with the third-moment error growing, under weak contraction, with truncation depth, inner condition number, and per-factor noise asymmetry. This arises in many practical settings such as corrupted labels, outliers, heterogeneous or class-imbalanced datasets. To address this, we introduce the Antithetic Neumann Estimator (ANE), which pairs each Hessian sample with a mirrored counterpart around a reference Hessian and averages the resulting inverse-Hessian estimates. With an exact reference, the antithetic product retains only even-order noise, eliminating all odd-order perturbation terms; with an approximate reference, the residual odd-order contribution is bounded linearly in the reference error. ANE requires only a modification of the Hessian vector step and combines with existing stochastic or variance-reduced bilevel methods. We instantiate ANE-SGD and ANE-VR, the latter adding recursive variance reduction. Across robust regression, data cleaning, offline reinforcement learning, and imbalanced classification, ANE-based methods improve on stochastic and variance-reduced baselines on every task (20 seeds each), lowering loss by 4 to 25% relative to the best baseline; the largest gains, on robust regression, are a 25% lower test loss and a 54% higher test r-squared.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出Neumann级数估计双层层优化超梯度时存在被忽视的"偏斜(skewness)"误差源，提出对偶Neumann估计器(ANE)通过镜像采样消除奇数阶噪声，在多个任务上优于随机与方差缩减基线。
AI.motivation: 双层层优化（超参数调优、数据重加权、鲁棒学习、强化学习、不平衡分类等）中超梯度计算需内层Hessian的逆，通常用截断Neumann级数估计。现有分析只关注偏差与方差，忽略了估计器本身的误差结构。作者发现Neumann级数的乘积结构会引入第三个误差源——偏斜（三阶矩误差），且该误差在弱收缩条件下随截断深度、内层条件数、单因子噪声不对称性而增大；在标签噪声、离群点、异构或类不平衡数据等实际场景中普遍存在。
AI.method: 提出对偶Neumann估计器（ANE）：将每个Hessian样本与围绕参考Hessian镜像得到的对应样本配对，对由此得到的逆Hessian估计取平均。理论上，参考Hessian精确时对偶乘积仅保留偶数阶噪声，消除所有奇数阶扰动项；参考Hessian近似时，残余奇数阶贡献与参考误差呈线性有界。ANE只需修改Hessian-向量乘积步骤，可与现有随机或方差缩减双层层方法结合，实例化为ANE-SGD与ANE-VR（后者加入递归方差缩减）。
AI.result: 在鲁棒回归、数据清洗、离线强化学习、不平衡分类四类任务上（每项20个随机种子），基于ANE的方法在全部任务上均优于随机与方差缩减基线，相对最佳基线损失降低4%–25%；增益最大的鲁棒回归任务测试损失降低25%，测试R²提升54%。
AI.conclusion: 偏斜是Neumann超梯度估计中独立于偏差、方差的第三类误差源，对偶镜像采样可高效消除其奇数阶成分；ANE实现简单、即插即用，并与方差缩减正交兼容，为双层层优化提供了新的误差控制维度。

title: Pothole Risk Assessment with Geometrically Grounded Vision Language Models
comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, 17 tables. Submitted to IEEE Access. Code and data: https://github.com/malekaburaddaha/Pothole_Assessment_Pipeline
summary: Potholes impose billions of dollars in annual vehicle damage, yet detectors report only where potholes are, not how severe they are or what to do. Judging severity from a single RGB image is ill-posed, and ungrounded vision-language model (VLM) assessments tend to be over-conservative. We present a five-stage modular framework for the offline assessment of already-detected potholes that combines geometric measurements with VLM reasoning: perspective transformation, zero-shot SAM segmentation, geometric feature extraction, Gemini 2.5 Pro severity classification with composite risk scoring, and natural-language warning generation. We evaluate it on 3,092 potholes in 1,119 dashcam scenes against independent references. Severity agreement with a prediction-free three-annotator panel is weak (Cohen's $κ= 0.139$, 95% CI [0.00, 0.28]; $n = 101$) and far below the annotators' agreement with one another ($κ= 0.605$); against physically measured depth on an independent RGB-D dataset, it is also weak ($κ= 0.098$), although the predicted classes preserve the order of measured depths. The severity classes are therefore perceived visual categories, not depth measurements. Geometric grounding does change the warnings: relative to an image-only baseline, it moves 26.7% of scenes out of the high-urgency tier and raises critical-tier assignments by 109% (Stuart-Maxwell $p < 10^{-15}$), and in a blind study, three raters preferred the grounded warnings 3.5:1. A six-arm prompt ablation attributes the hybrid prompt's rule adherence to the per-pothole measurements rather than to the rubric or worked examples. At USD 0.105 per scene, it suits large-scale offline infrastructure assessment; its maneuver suggestions are advisory research outputs, not validated vehicle guidance.

AI.tldr: 提出一个五阶段模块化框架，将透视变换、零样本SAM分割、几何特征提取与Gemini 2.5 Pro严重度分级结合，用于已检测坑洞的离线严重度评估与预警生成；实验表明分级结果反映的是视觉范畴而非物理深度，但几何接地显著改变预警决策并提升可接受度，单场景成本0.105美元。
AI.motivation: 现有坑洞检测器只回答"哪里有坑"，不回答"多严重、该怎么办"；单张RGB图像判断严重度本质上是病态问题，而无接地的VLM评估往往过度保守。因此需要一个低成本、可大规模离线部署的分级+预警生成方案，并需澄清其输出究竟代表什么。
AI.method: 五阶段模块化流水线：（1）透视变换；（2）零样本SAM分割；（3）几何特征提取；（4）Gemini 2.5 Pro严重度分类与复合风险评分；（5）自然语言预警生成。评测覆盖1,119段行车记录仪场景中的3,092个坑洞，对照独立参考：与三名标注者面板的一致性（n=101）、与独立RGB-D数据集的物理深度一致性；并做图像-only基线的对照分析、六臂提示消融与盲评人类偏好研究。
AI.result: 与预测无关的三人标注面板一致性弱（Cohen's κ=0.139，95% CI [0.00, 0.28]，n=101），远低于标注者彼此间一致性（κ=0.605）；与RGB-D实测深度一致性亦弱（κ=0.098），但预测类别保持了实测深度的排序。几何接地使26.7%场景脱离高紧急层级、关键层级分配增加109%（Stuart-Maxwell p<10⁻¹⁵）；盲评中三名评审者以3.5:1偏好接地预警。六臂提示消融显示混合提示的规则遵循性源于逐坑几何测量，而非评分细则或示例。成本为0.105美元/场景。
AI.conclusion: 框架适合大规模离线基础设施巡检，但严重度标签应被理解为感知性视觉范畴而非深度测量；其机动建议仅为探索性研究输出，不构成经校验的车辆操控指导。

title: Universal Infectious Disease Forecasting with Mantis 2
summary:
Public health agencies need to anticipate how outbreaks will unfold, when they will peak, and how long demand on health services will remain elevated. We previously developed a foundation model, Mantis, which was trained entirely on simulated outbreaks---enabling us to generate the diversity and scale of training data needed to support forecasting across diseases. However, our previous work left unresolved when simulation improves predictions and how it should complement observational data.
  Here, we varied the balance of simulated and observed training data while holding forecasting tasks fixed and varying the available surveillance history. We found that simulation-rich training was particularly valuable with limited local history, and its relative advantage diminished as more observations became available. We also found that simulation-based training reduced exceptionally large forecast errors, suggesting that mechanistic knowledge can help compensate for limited local evidence.
  Building on these findings, we developed Mantis 2, which combines simulated and observational training to jointly forecast up to six variables sixteen weeks ahead. Across 30 forecasting tasks, Mantis 2 achieved the best aggregate probabilistic accuracy over short, medium, and long horizons among the machine learning, statistical, and baseline models evaluated. It missed roughly 30\% fewer outbreak peaks than the strongest comparison model, with successfully anticipated peaks identified more than six weeks in advance on average. We publicly release Mantis 2, enabling public health agencies and researchers to forecast disease outcomes without developing a separate model for each disease or location.

AI.tldr: 本文研究仿真数据与观测数据的最优配比对疫情预测的影响，并提出联合训练的基础模型 Mantis 2，可同时预测六项指标、提前十六周，在30项任务中取得最佳概率精度并显著减少峰值漏报。
AI.motivation: 公共卫生机构需要预判疫情走势、峰值时间与医疗需求持续时长。此前的 Mantis 模型完全基于仿真疫情训练，虽能获得规模与多样性，但"仿真何时有用、如何与观测数据互补"这一问题未解决。
AI.method: 在固定预测任务、变化监测历史长度的条件下，系统改变仿真与观测训练数据的配比，进行消融式对比实验；据此设计 Mantis 2，将仿真数据（提供机制性知识）与观测数据（提供本地证据）联合训练，输出多变量、十六周的多步概率预测。
AI.result: 仿真数据占比较高时，在本地历史有限的情形下收益最明显，随观测数据增多其相对优势递减；仿真训练还能抑制极端大的预测误差。Mantis 2 在30项预测任务中，短、中、长期概率精度均为最优（对比机器学习、统计与基线模型），峰值漏报比最强基线少约30%，成功预警的峰值平均提前六周以上。
AI.conclusion: 仿真与观测数据互补：仿真弥补本地证据不足并提供机制约束，观测数据在历史充分时贡献更大。Mantis 2 作为单一通用模型可跨疾病与地区直接用于疫情预测，并已公开释放，免去为每种疾病或地区单独建模的需要。

title: Owned Edits to a Shared Decision Rule: Learning Private Exceptions as Typed, Gated, Withdrawable Weight Edits
comment: 58 pages, 7 figures. Every reported value is generated from a versioned results ledger (release r8)
summary: Organisations that apply the same published decision rule often hold private evidence that the rule is wrong for their own cases, and will not pool it. We describe a learning mechanism for that setting whose unit of change is an owned edit. The published rule is compiled exactly into a small ReLU network, a structured prior. Each party's learner searches a small typed space of declarations, a few named values such as subject, scope, form and size, and proposes one only when its own records pass a selection-aware evidence gate. The learning is that gated search around the prior. In two analyses registered before they ran, on synthetic data with 20 sampled hidden truths, the learner at 30 records per party was non-inferior, within 2 points, to all seven tuned baselines (a confined gradient learner, Ditto, FedRep, federated averaging, two pooled networks and pooled gradient-boosted trees), scoring 96.6% against 91.7% for the unchanged rule; the same search without the prior or the gate scored 84.0%. In a third registered test, typed edits over a network trained on shared records beat that network alone by 5.4 points and the same edits over the published rule by 3.1. An acceptance body recomputes each edit from its declaration and writes it into units reserved for that party, so by construction an edit changes no decision about any other subject, withdraws exactly, discloses at most log2 of the typed space's size in bits, and can hide nothing beyond its declared values. We report where it loses: truths shared by all parties, relaxations, ten records, a pre-stated gate criterion that failed in both runs, and a language model given the records that decided about as accurately on one draw. On a rule-only base, a table of owned exceptions makes the same decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"拥有式编辑"(owned edit)的隐私保护学习机制：将已发布决策规则精确编译为小型ReLU网络作为结构化先验，各方learner在小规模类型化声明空间中做带证据门控的搜索，仅当本方记录通过选择性感知证据门控时才提出编辑；验收方按声明重算并写入该方专属单元，从而在构造上保证编辑不影响其他主体、可精确撤回、泄露≤log2(空间大小)比特。
AI.motivation: 机构常采用同一套已发布的决策规则，但各自握有"规则对本方个案不适用"的私有证据且不愿共享（不愿池化数据）。因此需要一个既能利用私有证据修正规则、又不泄露私有数据、且修改可审计与可撤回的学习机制。
AI.method: 1) 将已发布规则精确编译为小型ReLU网络作为结构化先验；2) 每方learner在少量命名值构成的类型化声明空间（subject、scope、form、size等）中搜索，仅当本方记录通过selection-aware证据门控时提出一个声明；3) 学习即为围绕先验的门控搜索；4) 验收机构根据声明重算编辑并写入该方专属保留单元，实现构造性的非干预、精确撤回与有界披露。对比实验含7个调优基线，并做了消融（去掉先验或门控）。
AI.result: 两项预注册分析（合成数据，20个抽样隐藏真值）：每方30条记录时，learner以96.6%对未改动规则的91.7%，在2个百分点内不劣于全部7个调优基线（受限梯度learner、Ditto、FedRep、联邦平均、两个池化网络、池化梯度提升树）；去掉先验或门控的同种搜索仅84.0%。第三项预注册测试中，在共享记录训练的网络之上做类型化编辑比该网络单独提升5.4个百分点，比在已发布规则上做同样编辑高3.1。失败情形：所有方共享的真值、放松型编辑、仅10条记录、预设定门控准则在两次运行中均未通过、以及给语言模型记录后单次抽样精度相当。在纯规则基线上，一张拥有式例外表可做出相同决策。
AI.conclusion: 该机制在预注册设定下于小样本、非共享证据场景中显著优于调优基线，且通过构造保证可撤回、非干预与披露有界；但其优势局限于局部、可声明化的修正，对全局共享真值、放松型规则、极少样本及未通过门控的情形失效，说明其适用边界明确。

title: Split-and-scale Latent 3D Representations
summary: Latent 3D representations have significantly expanded the capabilities of modern shape modeling, enabling compact encoding of 3D scenes and supporting powerful 3D generative models. Despite this progress, current representations struggle to capture the fine details of complex objects, fundamentally limited by the capacity of their latents. However, scaling latent capacity at training time is computationally expensive and often infeasible under memory limits, and naively increasing the number of latents at inference fails to make effective use of the added capacity. In this paper, we address both challenges with \textit{split-and-scale}, a method that effectively expands latent capacity at inference while keeping training cost tractable. Our key observation is that by representing 3D scenes as continuous functions of 3D coordinates, a single pretrained tokenizer can be applied at inference to arbitrarily small sub-regions of a scene, allocating the same latent capacity to a smaller spatial extent and thus capturing far higher detail. We validate this insight by conducting extensive ablations to study the trade-offs between compute, memory, latent capacity, and reconstruction quality, demonstrating our inference-time scaling method achieves quality competitive with much larger models that exceed single-GPU memory limits. We further demonstrate that split-and-scale supports high-quality generative modeling, training an autoregressive 3D generator that performs competitively with state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 split-and-scale 方法，通过在推理时将预训练三维 tokenizer 应用于任意小的空间子区域，在不增加训练开销的前提下有效扩展隐表示容量，显著提升复杂物体细节重建与生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有三维隐表示受限于隐变量容量，难以刻画复杂物体的细粒度细节；而训练时扩大隐容量计算昂贵且常受显存限制不可行，推理时简单增加隐变量数量也无法有效利用新增容量。因此需要一种兼顾训练可行性与推理期容量的方案。
AI.method: 核心观察：若将三维场景表示为三维坐标的连续函数，则单个预训练 tokenizer 在推理时可作用于场景中任意小的子区域，把相同的隐容量分配给更小的空间范围，从而捕获更高细节。方法包括对场景进行空间切分（split）并在推理期对子区域分别编码（scale），同时通过大量消融实验系统研究计算量、显存、隐容量与重建质量之间的权衡。
AI.result: 消融实验揭示了计算、显存、隐容量与重建质量的权衡关系；推理期缩放方法的重建质量可与超出单卡显存限制的更大模型相竞争。进一步，split-and-scale 支持高质量生成建模，训练的自回归三维生成器与当前最优基线表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 将三维场景建模为连续坐标函数使预训练 tokenizer 可在推理期灵活作用于子区域，实现"训练成本可控、推理容量可扩"的隐容量缩放范式，兼顾高保真重建与生成建模，为受显存约束的三维形状建模提供实用路径。

title: S1-Evo: Experience-Guided Evidence Competition Attacks on Typed System-1 Decision Models
summary: Typed System-1 (S1) decision models are increasingly deployed in LLM agents for routing, moderation, and authorization to cut inference cost, yet untrusted context can still manipulate typed outputs and alter execution branches. Unlike autoregressive System-2 (S2) models, S1 interfaces score dynamic rules and options without token-by-token decoding, mismatching attacks targeting text continuation or explicit override commands. We propose S1-Evo, a self-evolving framework tailored to S1's contract-based option competition and margin feedback. S1-Evo perturbs untrusted fields via contract-aware evidence channels to induce \emph{evidence competition} with original task evidence while preserving fact invariance. Offline on seed tasks, it optimizes candidates via feedback search guided by directional margins and re-verification, distilling verified flips into experience cards. At test time, S1-Evo retrieves relevant cards to construct perturbations for unseen tasks. Across four benchmarks and three S1 models, S1-Evo reaches 71.99\% mean ASR and 57.47\% high-confidence ASR on \texttt{jev-1.14}, and causes up to 24.00\% E2E agent violations.

AI.tldr: 提出 S1-Evo 自演化框架，针对基于契约选项竞争的 Typed System-1 决策模型实施扰动攻击，在四个基准、三个 S1 模型上平均 ASR 达 71.99%，并可导致最高 24.00% 的端到端智能体违规。
AI.motivation: Typed S1 决策模型被广泛用于 LLM 智能体的路由、审核与授权以降低推理成本，但不可信上下文仍可操纵其类型化输出并改变执行分支。这类模型以动态规则与选项打分，而非逐 token 解码，因此面向文本续写或显式覆盖指令的传统攻击并不适配，存在方法学空白。
AI.method: S1-Evo 利用 S1 的契约式选项竞争与边际反馈机制：通过契约感知的证据通道扰动不可信字段，在保持事实不变的前提下诱发"证据竞争"；离线阶段在种子任务上用方向性边际引导的反馈搜索与再验证优化候选，并将验证成功的翻转蒸馏为经验卡片；测试阶段检索相关卡片，为未见任务构造扰动。
AI.result: 在四个基准与三个 S1 模型上，S1-Evo 在 jev-1.14 上取得 71.99% 平均 ASR 与 57.47% 高置信度 ASR，并可造成最高 24.00% 的端到端智能体违规。
AI.conclusion: S1 决策接口存在被契约感知扰动操纵的实质风险，且通过经验卡片式的自演化迁移可跨任务生效，提示需在 S1 接口层面重新审视安全评估与防御设计。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Inventory Control under Regime-Switching Demand: A Controlled Comparison of LSTM, MLP, and (s,S) Policies
summary: Classical inventory policies such as (s,S) are provably optimal under stationary demand but cannot adapt when demand switches between hidden regimes, and memoryless deep reinforcement learning policies, confined to a fixed observation window, cannot maintain a belief over latent demand structure. We ask whether a recurrent policy offers a measurable advantage over both a memoryless policy and a classical baseline under regime-switching demand, and how that advantage scales with supply-chain lead time. We build a custom Gymnasium environment in which daily demand is generated by a two-state hidden Markov process with Poisson emissions, so that the regime is known at evaluation time but hidden from the agent. An optimised (s,S) heuristic, an MLP PPO agent, and an LSTM Recurrent PPO agent are trained under matched compute and evaluated at lead times of 0, 3, 6, and 10 days over 30 deterministic episodes each. The recurrent policy outperforms both alternatives at every lead time, and its margin over the MLP widens monotonically with lead time, from parity at lead time 0 to 2.17$\times$ at lead time 10. Principal component analysis of the LSTM hidden state explains the widening gap: the representation shifts from encoding a binary regime indicator at short lead times to encoding multi-step pipeline state at long lead times. Recurrent memory becomes the decisive architectural factor as the credit-assignment horizon lengthens.

AI.tldr: 在双状态隐马尔可夫需求（泊松发射）的库存环境中，LSTM循环PPO在全部提前期上优于优化(s,S)与MLP-PPO，且相对MLP的优势随提前期单调扩大，LT=0时持平、LT=10时达2.17倍；PCA表明隐藏状态表征从短提前期的二值状态指示转向长提前期的多级管道状态编码，说明循环记忆在信用分配跨度变长时成为决定性架构因素。
AI.motivation: 经典(s,S)策略在平稳需求下可证最优，但需求在隐状态间切换时无法自适应；无记忆深度强化学习受限于固定观测窗口，难以维护对潜在需求结构的信念。作者据此提出两个问题：循环策略相对无记忆策略与经典基线是否具有可测量的优势，以及该优势如何随供应链提前期变化。
AI.method: 构建定制Gymnasium环境：日需求由两状态隐马尔可夫过程经泊松发射生成，状态在评估时已知但对智能体隐藏。对比三种策略——优化的(s,S)启发式、MLP-PPO、LSTM循环PPO，在匹配算力下训练，并在提前期0、3、6、10天下各评估30个确定性回合；对LSTM隐藏状态做PCA以解释性能差距来源。
AI.result: 循环策略在每个提前期均优于两种对照。相对MLP的边际随提前期单调扩大：LT=0时基本持平，LT=10时达2.17倍。对LSTM隐藏状态的PCA显示：短提前期时表征主要编码二值状态指示，长提前期时转为编码多级在途管道状态。
AI.conclusion: 在状态切换需求下，循环记忆是决定性架构因素：信用分配时域越长，显式信念维护带来的收益越大，且该收益可被隐藏状态表征的变化所解释。这为提前期较长的库存决策中采用循环策略提供了实证依据。

title: Imitating the Imperfect: Offline-to-Online Robust Imitation Learning from Heterogeneous Demonstrators
summary: Imitation learning (IL) typically relies on large-scale offline demonstrations collected from multiple human or algorithmic demonstrators. However, most existing approaches assume these demonstrators are homogeneous or near-optimal experts, a convenient but unrealistic assumption in real-world applications. In practice, demonstrations are often collected from heterogeneous demonstrators with unknown and varying levels of expertise, resulting in highly mixed-quality data. In this work, we study a challenging yet practical setting of imitation learning from such heterogeneous imperfect demonstrators. We propose Latent Expertise and Optimality Scoring based Imitation Learning (LEOS-IL), a principled framework that jointly learns (i) a state-action optimality scoring model and (ii) latent expertise levels for each demonstrator from unlabeled suboptimal offline demonstrations. The learned scoring model is then integrated into an online policy optimization procedure, where the agent is trained to maximize estimated optimality scores while its online rollouts are iteratively leveraged to refine the scoring model, thereby mitigating distributional shift during online adaptation. We further provide theoretical guarantees for optimality score identification and conditional optimal occupancy and policy recovery under explicit sufficient conditions. Experiments on continuous control benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms existing baselines across highly heterogeneous and low-quality demonstration regimes.

AI.tldr: LEOS-IL 从异质且次优的离线演示中联合学习状态-动作最优性评分与每位演示者的潜在专业水平，并将评分模型嵌入在线策略优化以缓解分布偏移，在连续控制基准上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有模仿学习大多假设演示者同质或近似最优，而真实场景中演示来自专业水平未知且各异的异质演示者，形成高度混合质量的数据；该论文研究此更实际但更具挑战的设定。
AI.method: 提出 LEOS-IL 框架：在无标签的次优离线演示上，(i) 学习状态-动作最优性评分模型，(ii) 学习每位演示者的潜在专业水平；随后将评分模型集成到在线策略优化中，使智能体最大化估计的最优性分数，并用在线 rollout 迭代精化评分模型，以缓解在线适应中的分布偏移。
AI.result: 给出了最优性评分可辨识性以及条件最优占用测度与策略恢复的理论保证（在明确的充分条件下）；在连续控制基准测试中，于高度异质与低质量演示情形下持续超越现有基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模演示者异质专业水平并进行在线联合精化，LEOS-IL 为混合质量演示下的模仿学习提供了有理论支撑且实证有效的方案。

title: GOOSELoc: A Multimodal Benchmark for Ground-to-Aerial Localization in Unstructured Off-Road Terrain
summary: Cross-view pose estimation estimates a ground camera's geographic pose by matching onboard sensor data with geo-referenced overhead imagery. This is particularly relevant when GNSS is unreliable, for example under forest canopy or in urban canyons. Existing metric cross-view benchmarks, such as VIGOR and cross-view KITTI, are dominated by urban and road scenes with strong human-made structure without off-road terrain. We introduce GOOSELoc, a multimodal benchmark for ground-to-aerial localization in unstructured environments, including forests, fields, and rural tracks. GOOSELoc comprises 9,356 scenes recorded across all four seasons around Munich, Germany, pairing geo-referenced aerial orthophotos with surround-view RGB imagery and 3D LiDAR point clouds. Paved/unpaved labels enable analyzing the impact of terrain structure, while the seasonal recordings allow studying the appearance gap to mostly summer-captured orthophotos. To assess the transferability of existing methods, we adapt and fine-tune four state-of-the-art cross-view localization baselines on GOOSELoc. Despite task-specific fine-tuning, the performance degrades substantially in off-road environments. We therefore propose a multimodal baseline combining surround-view imagery and LiDAR geometry, improving localization performance and providing a stronger reference for future work. Data and baselines are released at https://gooseloc.github.io.

AI.tldr: GOOSELoc：面向非结构化环境（森林、田野、乡村道路）的地对空跨视角定位多模态基准，含9,356个全季节场景，配正射影像、环视RGB与3D LiDAR；现有SOTA微调后性能显著下降，提出融合环视图像与LiDAR几何的多模态基线。
AI.motivation: 现有度量级跨视角基准（VIGOR、cross-view KITTI）以城市与道路场景为主，缺乏非道路（off-road）地形，导致方法在GNSS不可靠的林冠下、城市峡谷外等非结构化环境中的可迁移性无法评估。
AI.method: 构建慕尼黑周边全四季采集的9,356个场景数据集，配对地理参考航空正射影像与环视RGB图像及3D LiDAR点云；提供铺装/非铺装标签以分析地形结构影响，并利用季节差异研究相对夏季正射影像的外观域差；在基准上适配并微调四种跨视角定位SOTA基线，并设计融合环视图像与LiDAR几何的多模态基线。
AI.result: 即便经过任务特定微调，现有SOTA在非道路环境中定位性能仍大幅下降；所提多模态基线通过融合环视图像与LiDAR几何提升定位精度，为后续研究提供更强参照。
AI.conclusion: 跨视角定位在非结构化环境中存在显著泛化缺口，需借助多模态（外观+几何）与地形/季节因素的系统评测；数据与基线已开源（gooseloc.github.io）。

title: The Value of Thinking: Learning When to Reason in Hybrid Decision Models
summary: Existing adaptive-reasoning methods shorten the explicit reasoning a model writes, or skip it by switching modes; either way the answer is still written out token by token. \emph{Rather than deciding how much to think}, we explore a different paradigm, \emph{zero-or-$T$ thinking}: a single model either answers from the implicit thinking inside one forward pass, generating no token, or performs full autoregressive reasoning at a cost of $T$ tokens when that is worth paying. We realise it in a \emph{hybrid decision model} (HDM), where one frozen backbone serves both modes and a lightweight \emph{self-routing block} chooses between them. The block estimates the \emph{value of thinking}, the utility the slow mode is expected to add over the fast one, from what that implicit thinking has already produced, and the slow mode runs only where that value exceeds a price $λ$ set per request. Where no per-decision label exists, as in episodic agentic tasks, we introduce \emph{Calibrated Decision Policy Optimisation} (CDPO), a reinforcement-learning recipe that trains the block from episode-level returns. We evaluate HDM on MMLU-Pro, AGIEval, GPQA-Diamond, JevBench, BANKING77 and MiniWoB. Specifically, on JevBench HDM-4B scores $0.857$ against Jev's $0.851$ ($+0.7\%$) at a median $0.179$\,s against $0.652$ ($-72.5\%$). On the agentic venue MiniWoB HDM-27B cuts token cost by $80.1\%$.

AI.tldr: 提出"零或T思考"范式与混合决策模型(HDM):单一冻结骨干支持"无token的隐式思考"与"完整自回归推理"两种模式,由自路由块估计"思考价值"并按每请求价格λ决定是否付出T个token;用CDPO从episode级回报训练路由块,在多个基准上以极低成本保持或提升精度。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应推理方法只是在"缩短显式推理"或"切换模式跳过推理",答案仍然逐token写出,没有触及"是否思考"这一层面。作者希望在单模型内实现两种截然不同的作答方式:直接从一次前向传播的隐式思考作答(零token),或在值得付费时进行完整推理(代价T个token)。
AI.method: 1) 混合决策模型HDM:一个冻结骨干同时服务快/慢两种模式,外加轻量自路由块在两者间选择。2) 自路由块基于隐式思考已产生的表征估计"思考价值"(慢模式相对快模式的预期增益),仅当价值超过按请求设定的价格λ时才触发慢模式。3) 针对缺少逐决策标签的情景(如episodic智能体任务),提出校准决策策略优化CDPO:一种利用episode级回报训练路由块的强化学习方案。
AI.result: 在MMLU-Pro、AGIEval、GPQA-Diamond、JevBench、BANKING77与MiniWoB上评测。JevBench上HDM-4B得0.857,略高于Jev的0.851(+0.7%),中位延迟0.179s对0.652s(-72.5%);智能体场景MiniWoB上HDM-27B降低token成本80.1%。
AI.conclusion: 将自适应推理从"思考多少"转向"是否思考",通过隐式思考触发的价值估计与按需定价的路由,在近乎零额外推理成本下匹配或超过完整推理基线,并在智能体任务上显著削减token开销;CDPO使路由块可在仅episode级奖励下训练。

title: Riordan Arrays as Structured Operators for Artificial Intelligence
summary:
Riordan arrays have traditionally been studied as infinite lower-triangular matrices that encode generating-function transformations and combinatorial relationships. This note proposes a complementary direction: using Riordan arrays as structured operators in artificial intelligence and data analysis. For a data sequence with generating function $A(z)$, a Riordan array $(g(z),f(z))$ produces the transformation \[
  A(z)\longmapsto g(z)A(f(z)). \] This yields a parameterized family of causal linear operators that combine convolution, substitution, and multiscale mixing. The resulting structure may support parameter-efficient neural-network layers, variable-length sequence models, interpretable recurrent systems, invertible architectures, and models for hierarchical or recursively generated data. We explain what the infinite-dimensional viewpoint does and does not provide, outline several possible architectures, identify theoretical and numerical challenges, and propose an initial experimental program. The aim is not to claim that Riordan arrays are appropriate for all data, but to identify settings in which their algebraic structure supplies a useful inductive bias.

AI.tldr: 将 Riordan 阵列视为人工智能与数据分析中的结构化算子：对生成函数 \(A(z)\) 施加变换 \(A(z)\mapsto g(z)A(f(z))\)，得到一族参数化的因果线性算子，并讨论其在神经网络层、变长序列建模、可解释循环系统、可逆架构与层次化数据建模中的潜在用途。
AI.motivation: Riordan 阵列传统上只作为编码生成函数变换与组合关系的无限下三角矩阵来研究；作者希望开辟互补方向，即把其代数结构当作 AI 与数据分析中的归纳偏置来源，寻找其真正适用的场景，而非宣称其普适。
AI.method: 以生成函数变换 \(A(z)\mapsto g(z)A(f(z))\) 定义 Riordan 阵列 \((g(z),f(z))\) 的作用，据此构造同时包含卷积、代换与多尺度混合的参数化因果线性算子族；采用无限维视角，提出若干候选架构，梳理理论与数值难点，并给出初步实验方案。
AI.result: 论文为立场/展望型工作，未报告实证结果；其输出是一组概念性结论：该算子族可支撑参数高效的网络层、处置变长序列、构建可解释的循环系统与可逆架构，以及建模层次化或递归生成的数据；同时明确界定了无限维视角能提供与不能提供的内容。
AI.conclusion: Riordan 阵列并非适用于所有数据，其价值在于识别那些代数结构能提供有用归纳偏置的特定设置；后续工作应围绕所提架构、理论数值挑战与实验计划展开验证。

title: SPEM: Scan-Prior Entropy Modeling for LiDAR Point Cloud Compression
summary: LiDAR point clouds exhibit scan-induced spatial regularities that are informative for geometry compression. Existing scan-aware approaches often exploit these regularities by transforming coded geometry into spherical or beam-aligned coordinate systems. However, this couples acquisition priors with geometry representation, altering spatial partitioning and quantization, and potentially preventing exact recovery of the original Cartesian geometry. We argue that acquisition priors should guide probability modeling rather than dictate the coding representation. We propose SPEM, a Scan-Prior Entropy Modeling framework that exploits LiDAR scanning regularities within the entropy model without requiring coordinate transformation. We introduce a multi-frequency spherical rotary positional encoding that captures scan-aligned spatial relationships in both backbone self-attention and decoded-context retrieval. Building upon this encoding, we develop a decoded-memory autoregressive predictor that efficiently exploits previously decoded occupancy information through reusable key/value caches. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both lossy and lossless LiDAR geometry compression, highlighting the effectiveness of scan-prior modeling across different coordinate representations.

AI.tldr: 提出SPEM框架，在熵模型内部利用LiDAR扫描规律进行概率建模，无需坐标变换，在无损与有损几何压缩上均达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有scan-aware方法通过将几何变换到球面或光束对齐坐标系来利用扫描规律，但这将采集先验与几何表示耦合，改变空间划分与量化方式，可能无法精确恢复原始笛卡尔几何。作者主张采集先验应指导概率建模而非决定编码表示。
AI.method: SPEM在多频球面旋转位置编码的基础上，将此编码同时用于主干自注意力与解码上下文检索；并构建解码记忆式自回归预测器，借助可复用的key/value缓存高效利用已解码占用信息，全程无需坐标变换。
AI.result: 在有损与无损LiDAR几何压缩任务上均取得state-of-the-art性能，并表明扫描先验建模在不同坐标表示下均有效。
AI.conclusion: 解耦采集先验与几何表示是可行且有效的：在熵模型中引入扫描先验即可充分挖掘空间规律，同时保留原始笛卡尔表示以实现精确重建。

title: Compiling Known Rules into Compact Neural Agents: Weight-Space Programming on Unseen Games
summary: Weight-space programming (WSP) uses language models to construct neural network weights without training. We test whether known game mechanics can be compiled into compact agents that generalise to held-out levels, renderings and start states within a game family. Writers receive simulator source with held-out level data removed for 20 privately authored, unpublished ARC-AGI-3-style game families. With a fixed 57k-parameter recurrent architecture, the strongest writer reaches 56% held-out-level success with feedback, while the four main writers' Python players reach 97-100%. An exploratory free-architecture condition reaches 68-90%. Learning from support-level examples transfers much less well, but these learners lack the source information given to writers. Written networks have a program-like structure: 93% of parameters are zero, and 90% of the rest are small integers or powers of two. NumPy players under comparable computation caps reach 91%, versus the networks' 79%. Training the strongest writer's architectures from scratch yields about 1% success within our budget. Written fixed-network weights are fragile, and standard PPO removes most of their success. Prompts for noise robustness increase tolerance by about four orders of magnitude for two of three writers, but PPO makes larger updates and still removes most success. These results demonstrate rule-to-network compilation in this setting, while showing limited benefits over Python programs and no successful combination with the tested PPO fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 论文检验"权重空间编程"(WSP)——用语言模型免训练地生成神经网络权重——能否将已知游戏机制编译为紧凑智能体,并在同一游戏族内泛化到留出的关卡、渲染与初始状态。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成(如直接写 Python 玩家)已被证明有效,但作者想探究权重空间是否是另一条可行路径:能否把游戏规则"编译"进网络权重,以及它与程序式解法、与训练方法相比是否有实质优势。
AI.method: 在 20 个未公开的 ARC-AGI-3 风格游戏族上提供去掉留出关卡数据的模拟器源码,让语言模型"作者"写网络权重。主条件使用固定 57k 参数循环架构;另设自由架构探索条件;对照组包括同作者编写的 Python 玩家、同算力上限的 NumPy 玩家、从头训练、以及 PPO 微调。分析权重结构(稀疏性、取值分布),并加入噪声鲁棒性提示词实验。
AI.result: 固定架构下最强"作者"在有反馈时留出关卡成功率达 56%;四位主要作者的 Python 玩家达 97–100%;自由架构条件达 68–90%。仅从支持关卡样例学习(少源码信息)迁移很差;NumPy 玩家在同等算力上限下达 91%,高于网络 79%;从头训练同架构仅约 1%。写出的权重呈程序化结构:93% 参数为零,其余 90% 为小整数或 2 的幂。权重脆弱,标准 PPO 抹去大部分成功率;噪声鲁棒性提示对三分之二作者把容差提高约四个数量级,但 PPO 更新幅度更大仍破坏成功。
AI.conclusion: 该设置下确实实现了"规则到网络"的编译,但相对 Python 程序收益有限;写出的权重高度脆弱且与 PPO 微调不兼容。权重空间编程在此基准上尚不能取代程序式方法。

title: WELP : Weighted Ensemble in the LooP for committor learning
summary: Understanding how complex molecular systems transition between metastable states is a central challenge in computational chemistry and biophysics. A key tool for characterizing these transitions is the committor function: the probability that a trajectory initiated from a given configuration reaches one state before another. Because the committor encodes both the progress and the mechanism of a transition, it is an ideal collective variable (CV). Learning it, however, requires sampling the rare transitions it describes. We address this circular dependency with a ``WE-in-the-loop'' framework that couples committor learning with weighted ensemble (WE), an enhanced sampling method that uses a CV to drive transition dynamics. Our framework alternates between the two: WE simulation generates transition data for training a neural network committor with a self-consistent loss, and the learned committor then serves as an improved CV for subsequent WE simulation. Across a two-channel 2D system, alanine dipeptide, and chignolin, our framework consistently outperforms greedy baselines, highlighting the importance of principled exploration. We also curate a public benchmark of empirically determined committor values for alanine dipeptide. Together, the framework and benchmark provide a new method for studying rare transitions in high-dimensional molecular systems and a standard for evaluating committor learning methods.

AI.tldr: 提出"WE-in-the-loop"框架，将committor函数学习与加权系综（WE）增强采样交替耦合，解决稀有跃迁采样与committor学习之间的循环依赖；在二维双通道体系、丙氨酸二肽和chignolin上优于贪婪基线，并公开丙氨酸二肽committor经验基准。
AI.motivation: committor函数（从某构型先到达某一态而非另一态的概率）同时编码跃迁进度与机制，是理想的集合变量（CV）。但学习committor需要采样它所描述的稀有跃迁，而稀有跃迁采样又依赖好的CV，形成循环依赖。
AI.method: 构建"WE-in-the-loop"迭代框架：WE模拟利用当前CV驱动跃迁并生成数据；用自洽损失（self-consistent loss）训练神经网络committor；学得的committor再作为改进CV返回下一步WE模拟，二者交替进行。另构建丙氨酸二肽的经验测定committor公开基准。
AI.result: 在二维双通道体系、丙氨酸二肽和chignolin上，该框架一致优于贪婪（greedy）基线，说明有原则的探索策略更为关键。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为高维分子体系稀有跃迁研究提供了新方法，其公开基准也为评估committor学习方法提供了标准。

title: ScrewSense: Mapping the Invisible - Anomaly Detection and Error Classification in Screwdriving Processes
comment: Accepted manuscript, 59th CIRP Conference on Manufacturing Systems (CMS 2026). 6 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables
summary: The growing volume of process data generated by screwdriving systems, combined with advancements in computing power, data storage, and algorithms, is facilitating the application of artificial intelligence in this field. Accurately detecting and classifying screwdriving errors is crucial for ensuring product quality, avoiding costly rework in manufacturing, and supporting sustainability by facilitating the maintenance, reuse, and recycling of screw-connected products. In this context, machine learning approaches offer a promising alternative to traditional monitoring techniques, such as window-based methods or envelope curves. This study examines the use of deep learning techniques for anomaly detection and error classification in screwdriving processes. The data corpus consists of multivariate time series capturing process parameters, such as torque and rotation angle. For anomaly detection, the embedding space of a vector quantized variational autoencoder was analyzed. In terms of error classification, four different model architectures were evaluated. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of anomaly detection and confirm that deep learning models can distinguish between multiple error categories beyond traditional binary classification. This extends the capabilities of conventional monitoring approaches, achieving accuracies of up to 100%. Additionally, real-world data material was examined in order to further demonstrate model robustness. Overall the results indicate strong generalization capability and highlight the practical potential of the developed models for use in industrial screwdriving processes, eliminating the need for expert knowledge in error identification and significantly reducing manual effort and analysis time.

AI.tldr: 该研究将深度学习用于拧紧工艺的异常检测与错误分类，基于扭矩、转角等多变量时间序列，用向量量化变分自编码器的嵌入空间做异常检测，并比较四种分类架构，最高准确率达100%。
AI.motivation: 拧紧系统产生的过程数据日益增多，加上算力与算法进步，使AI应用成为可能；准确检测与分类拧紧错误对保证产品质量、避免昂贵返工、以及支持螺纹连接产品的维护、再利用与回收（可持续性）至关重要。传统监测方法（基于窗口的方法、包络曲线）能力有限，机器学习是更有前景的替代方案。
AI.method: 数据语料为记录扭矩、旋转角度等工艺参数的多变量时间序列。异常检测方面，分析向量量化变分自编码器（VQ-VAE）的嵌入空间；错误分类方面，评估比较四种不同的模型架构。此外引入真实场景数据进行鲁棒性验证。
AI.result: 异常检测有效；深度学习模型能够区分多类错误，超越传统二分类，准确率最高达100%；在真实数据上亦表现出较强的泛化能力与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所开发模型在工业拧紧过程中具有良好的实用潜力，可摆脱错误识别对专家知识的依赖，并显著减少人工投入与分析时间。

title: WorldDraft: If Code Builds the World, Can Video Models Just Render It?
summary: Multimodal coding agents decouple 4D world construction from visual generation, repurposing video models from world generators toward generative renderers. This division of labor raises a fundamental question: if code builds the world, can video models just render it? A reliable generative renderer hinges on two complementary criteria: (i) world preservation, retaining prescribed 4D kinematics and camera paths; and (ii) visual realization, persistently binding text-specified target attributes over time. To evaluate this capability, we introduce WorldDraft, a benchmark of $432$ strictly paired test cases across $48$ executable 4D world families spanning six dynamic challenge categories. Under a $3 \times 3$ factorial design, WorldDraft orthogonally crosses draft granularity (abstract proxy to previs) and appearance alignment (neutral to conflicting) under identical dynamics. Extensive evaluations across $12$ representative models reveal that: (I) world preservation and visual realization remain in stark operational tension; (II) richer draft scaffolding anchors structure but paradoxically impairs appearance fidelity; and (III) conflicting source cues trigger severe source leakage (up to $64\%$), exposing fragile cross-modal disentanglement. To mitigate these bottlenecks, we propose WorldDraft-Primer, a plug-and-play visual prompting strategy that consistently improves both objectives across frozen video renderers. Together, WorldDraft and WorldDraft-Primer lay a foundation for bridging programmatic 4D simulation with video generation, advancing physically grounded generative rendering.

AI.tldr: 论文提出WorldDraft基准（432个严格配对测试用例、48个可执行4D世界家族、六类动态挑战、3×3因子设计正交控制草稿粒度与外观对齐），用于评估"代码构建世界、视频模型仅做渲染"场景下生成式渲染器的可控性，并揭示了世界保持与视觉实现之间的张力、更丰富草稿反而损害外观保真、冲突线索导致最高64%源泄漏等瓶颈，进而提出即插即用的视觉提示策略WorldDraft-Primer。
AI.motivation: 多模态编码智能体将4D世界构建与视觉生成解耦，使视频模型从"世界生成器"转变为"生成式渲染器"。这一分工引出核心问题：若代码已构建好世界，视频模型能否仅完成渲染？可靠的生成式渲染器需同时满足世界保持（保留预设的4D运动学与相机路径）与视觉实现（随时间持续绑定文本指定的目标属性），而现有工作缺乏对该能力的系统评测。
AI.method: 构建WorldDraft基准：432个严格配对测试用例，覆盖48个可执行4D世界家族与六类动态挑战；采用3×3析因设计，在相同动力学下正交交叉草稿粒度（从抽象代理到预演previs）与外观对齐程度（从中性到冲突）。在此基准上评测12个代表性模型，并据此提出WorldDraft-Primer——一种即插即用的视觉提示策略，可在冻结的视频渲染器上同时提升两项指标。
AI.result: 评测发现：(I) 世界保持与视觉实现存在明显的操作性张力；(II) 更丰富的草稿脚手架能锚定结构，却反而损害外观保真度；(III) 冲突的源线索引发严重的源泄漏（最高达64%），暴露出跨模态解耦的脆弱性。WorldDraft-Primer在多个冻结视频渲染器上对两项指标均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: WorldDraft与WorldDraft-Primer为连接程序化4D仿真与视频生成奠定基础，推动具有物理依据的生成式渲染研究；同时也表明当前视频模型尚不能简单地"只做渲染"，跨模态解耦与双重目标平衡仍是关键待解问题。

title: Primer: An AI Framework for Instructor-Centered Educational Simulation Creation
summary: Educational simulations are a well-established pedagogical technique that gives learners opportunities to apply knowledge, respond to challenges, and reflect on their performance. High-quality simulations, however, are difficult to build, requiring instructor input, scenario design, character development, scaffolding, technical implementation, and repeated revision. This paper presents Primer, an open-source, LLM-agnostic AI-supported system that helps educators create adaptive educational simulations. Educators contribute their knowledge of the subject, lesson, and students, while generative AI produces responsive variations of practice for students. Primer uses a multi-agent system centered around executing educator's instructional intent through the entire learning experience. We hope that by releasing Primer as an open-source system, including its prompts and GitHub repository, we provide a foundation for development and research on educator-in-the-loop AI authoring, multi-agent educational workflows, and simulation-based pedagogy. Further, by allowing the use of various AI models, including local and open source models, we provide the opportunity for implementation under varied governance regimes. Primer points toward a model of educational AI in which instructors can create locally grounded practice opportunities based on their own materials, goals, examples, and knowledge of students.

AI.tldr: Primer 是一个开源、LLM 无关的 AI 支持系统，帮助教育者通过多智能体系统构建自适应教育模拟，将教师的教学意图贯穿整个学习体验。
AI.motivation: 高质量教育模拟虽能让学生应用知识、应对挑战并反思表现，但构建成本高，需教师投入、情景设计、角色开发、脚手架搭建、技术实现与反复迭代。作者希望降低这一门槛，并探索“教育者参与式 AI 创作”与多智能体教育流程。
AI.method: 提出 Primer：开源、LLM 无关的系统，教师提供学科、课程与学生相关知识，生成式 AI 生成可变的练习变体；核心为多智能体系统，围绕执行教育者的教学意图贯穿完整学习体验；支持本地与开源模型。
AI.result: 系统以开源形式发布，包含提示词与 GitHub 仓库，为教育者参与式 AI 创作、多智能体教育流程与基于模拟的教学法提供开发与研究基础；模型可替换性使系统可在不同治理环境下部署。
AI.conclusion: Primer 指向一种教育 AI 模式：教师基于自身材料、目标、示例与学生认知，创建本地化、情境化的练习机会；开源发布旨在支撑后续开发与研究。

title: PhysICL: In-Context Learning of Physical Fields on Unstructured Meshes from Procedural Priors
summary: Engineering design studies produce a few tens to a few hundred simulations of one problem, each on its own mesh, and their surrogates are retrained for every study. Tabular foundation models instead infer a new task from its examples in one forward pass, after pretraining on synthetic tasks. We demonstrate the feasibility of in-context learning for physical field prediction on unstructured meshes. A single model, PhysICL, pretrained solely on procedural tasks, predicts fields, with quantiles, directly on each query mesh from labeled simulations, without updating its weights. The same checkpoint accepts variable numbers of context examples, scalar inputs and input fields, and any number of output fields, while mesh size and connectivity can vary within a task. Its procedural prior draws generic laws and boundary-element physical models on morphed 2D and 3D template meshes, evaluated only at the points the model samples, fast enough that tasks generated on the fly by CPU workers keep the GPUs busy throughout pretraining. On five PLAID datasets never seen in pretraining, its field error decreases as the context grows and, from $K = 32$, is below that of the nearest context simulation on every dataset and context draw. It is on par with per-dataset reduced-order models on two of them, behind them where the fields are low-rank. On AhmedML surfaces with a median of 1.1 million nodes, twenty times the largest pretraining mesh, its fixed spatial budgets keep the peak GPU memory at $K = 64$ at 4.27 GiB, against 4.07 GiB on the 6,000-node meshes of 2D\_MSHE. Finally, on 2D\_MSHE, far from the prior, fine-tuning on procedural tasks that reproduce its geometry and loads, without any of its outputs, at a tenth of the pretraining cost, divides the stress error by 2.7.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PhysICL：一个仅用程序生成任务预训练的表格基础模型，在单次前向传播中对非结构网格上的物理场进行上下文学习（in-context learning），无需更新权重，可同时输出分位数。
AI.motivation: 工程设计研究通常只产生几十到几百个仿真，且各自使用不同网格，代理模型每次研究都要重新训练，成本高、泛化差。作者希望验证：能否用一个预训练模型，仅凭少量标注仿真作为上下文示例，直接在新任务的查询网格上预测物理场。
AI.method: PhysICL 仅在程序化任务上预训练：在形变的 2D/3D 模板网格上，用通用物理定律与边界元物理模型生成合成任务，并仅在模型采样的点处求值，由 CPU worker 在线即时生成任务以保持 GPU 满负荷。推理时模型不更新权重，单个 checkpoint 支持可变数量的上下文示例、标量输入与输入场、任意数量输出场，且任务内网格规模与连通性可变。
AI.result: 在五个未见过的 PLAID 数据集上，场误差随上下文数增加而下降；从 K=32 起，在所有数据集与所有上下文抽样下均优于最近的上下文仿真。其中两个数据集上与按数据集训练的降阶模型（reduced-order model）相当，在场呈低秩时则落后。在节点中位数约 110 万（为最大预训练网格的 20 倍）的 AhmedML 表面上，固定空间预算使 K=64 时的峰值 GPU 显存为 4.27 GiB，而 2D_MSHE 的 6000 节点网格上为 4.07 GiB。在远离先验的 2D_MSHE 上，用复现其几何与载荷（不含任何输出）的程序化任务进行微调，成本为预训练的十分之一，应力误差降低 2.7 倍。
AI.conclusion: 上下文学习可有效用于非结构网格的物理场预测；单一程序化预训练模型具备跨任务、跨网格规模与连通性的零权重更新泛化能力，显存随网格规模基本恒定，且廉价微调可显著缓解先验失配。

title: Disentangled Embedding Optimization for Diffusion-Based Dataset Distillation
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026)
summary: Dataset distillation aims to compress large-scale datasets into compact synthetic subsets that enable efficient model training with comparable performance to the original data. Recent advances show that diffusion models are highly effective for this task due to their strong generative capability. Existing diffusion-based approaches typically perform class-wise clustering and use the obtained cluster prototypes as diffusion inputs to generate distilled samples. However, the uniformly distributed original samples in a category inevitably lead to entanglement near cluster boundaries, pulling the cluster prototypes closer and reducing the inter-cluster separation. Consequently, the diffusion model receives overly similar latent inputs, resulting in synthetic data with limited diversity. To address this issue, we propose Disentangled Embedding Optimization (DEO), a simple yet effective framework that replaces static clustering with trainable embeddings. These embeddings are optimized to match the Gaussian statistics (i.e., mean and covariance) of the original data distribution, while a diversity regularizer is designed to encourage separation among these embeddings to improve the intra-class variability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed DEO can generate more diversified and representative distilled data than existing cluster-based diffusion methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance and superior generalization across multiple datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出Disentangled Embedding Optimization (DEO)框架，用可训练嵌入替代扩散式数据集蒸馏中的静态聚类原型，并匹配原始数据的高斯统计量，从而提升合成样本的类内多样性与蒸馏性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的数据集蒸馏方法通常先做类内聚类，再将聚类原型作为扩散模型输入生成蒸馏样本。但类别内原始样本分布均匀，聚类边界处样本纠缠，导致原型彼此靠近、簇间可分性下降；扩散模型因此接收到过于相似的隐输入，合成数据多样性受限。
AI.method: DEO以可训练的嵌入向量取代静态聚类原型，将这些嵌入优化为匹配原始数据分布的统计量（均值与协方差，即高斯统计），并设计多样性正则项促使嵌入之间相互分离，以提升类内变化性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，DEO相比现有基于聚类的扩散蒸馏方法能生成更具多样性与代表性的蒸馏数据，在多个数据集上取得SOTA性能并具有更优的泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 以可学习、统计对齐且受多样性约束的嵌入替代聚类原型，是缓解扩散式数据集蒸馏中隐输入同质化问题的有效途径，可持续提升蒸馏数据质量与跨数据集泛化能力。

title: AnalogLayoutWorld: An Open Benchmark for Agentic Analog Layout Design
summary: Coding agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in software development, yet their ability to tackle long-horizon engineering tasks governed by physical constraints remains less understood. We study this question through analog circuit layout, which demands domain knowledge, geometric reasoning, and iterative interaction with design and verification tools. We introduce \textbf{AnalogLayoutWorld}, an open-source agent benchmark with 40 expert-reviewed tasks for end-to-end layout generation from fixed transistor-level netlists. It combines an integrated design environment with independent physical and post-layout electrical verification, as well as objective layout quality metrics co-designed with analog layout experts. Across 13 model--harness configurations, 91.1\% of attempts produce GDS layouts, but only 23.0\% satisfy the benchmark's acceptance criteria. We also evaluate Novara, an internally developed agent system, which achieves the highest reported aggregate score. Our analysis links performance differences to test-time scaling under fixed budgets, suggesting that reasoning efficiency and effective use of verification feedback help sustain design quality as task complexity grows.

AI.tldr: 提出开源基准 AnalogLayoutWorld（40个专家审核的模拟电路版图生成任务），评测13种模型-框架配置：91.1%能产出GDS版图，但仅23.0%满足验收标准；内部智能体 Novara 取得最高综合得分，性能差异可归因于固定预算下的测试时扩展与验证反馈利用效率。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体在软件开发上表现强劲，但其在受物理约束的长时程工程任务中的能力尚不清楚；模拟电路版图恰需领域知识、几何推理与工具迭代交互，是检验该问题的理想场景，而此前缺乏端到端、可独立验证的基准。
AI.method: 构建 AnalogLayoutWorld：从固定晶体管级网表出发端到端生成版图，集成设计环境、独立的物理验证与版图后电学验证，并与模拟版图专家共同设计客观版图质量指标；在13种模型-框架配置上进行评测，并另外评估内部智能体系统 Novara。
AI.result: 91.1% 的尝试能生成 GDS 版图，但仅 23.0% 满足基准验收标准，说明"能画出版图"与"能通过验证"之间存在显著鸿沟；Novara 获得所报告的最高综合得分。
AI.conclusion: 现有智能体在物理约束下的长时程工程任务中仍有明显不足；性能差异与固定预算下的测试时扩展相关，推理效率和对验证反馈的有效利用是随任务复杂度提升而维持设计质量的关键。

title: Subject-Held-Out Evaluation of Deep Ground Reaction Force Estimators Across Two Laboratories: Leakage and Cross-Laboratory Transfer
comment: 15 pages (9 main + 6 supplementary), 5 figures. Submitted to IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics. Code and run outputs: https://github.com/hsantos10/Metahuman_Attention
summary: Deep networks that estimate ground reaction forces and centers of pressure from motion-capture markers are validated within one laboratory, in a seldom-stated coordinate frame, and sometimes with trial-level splits that put the same person in the training and the test set. We measured what each practice costs, and whether such models transfer between laboratories. Three sequence models (convolutional, convolutional-recurrent, and convolutional-transformer) were evaluated on two independent datasets, locomotion (6 subjects) and occupational patient handling (10 subjects), under one pipeline, one tuning procedure, three seeds, and four protocols: trial-level split, leave-one-subject-out, pooled two-laboratory training with matched held-out subjects, and cross-laboratory transfer. At a fixed configuration, trial-level splits overstated the subject-held-out coefficient of determination by +0.040 to +0.194; on occupational data the overstatement exceeded every difference between architectures. With subjects held out, the three models reached values between 0.583 and 0.804; the leader differed between datasets, and gaps lay within subject-to-subject variability. Pooling the laboratories changed neither dataset on matched subjects. Transfer between laboratories was below chance in both directions, including the vertical force, which no in-plane rotation can affect. Leaving force targets in the plate frame while inputs were heading-aligned cost 0.57 of locomotion anteroposterior-force explained variance, enough to make that force look hardest; a Newton's-law correlation detected the mismatch before training. Split protocol and target frame changed reported accuracy more than architecture did. Learned force estimators should be validated with subjects held out, checked for frame consistency before training, and tested across laboratories before deployment claims are made.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统量化了运动捕捉估计地面反作用力与压力中心时，试验级划分、坐标系不一致以及跨实验室迁移这三种做法对报告精度的影响，指出数据划分协议与目标坐标系对精度的影响大于模型架构本身。
AI.motivation: 现有从动作捕捉标记估计地面反作用力与压力中心的深度网络，多仅在单一实验室内验证、使用很少说明的坐标系，甚至采用把同一受试者同时放入训练集与测试集的试验级划分，且缺乏跨实验室可迁移性的检验；作者希望量化这些做法的代价。
AI.method: 在统一流程、统一调参、三个随机种子下，比较三种序列模型（卷积、卷积—循环、卷积—Transformer）于两个独立数据集（6人步态、10人职业搬运）上的表现，采用四种协议：试验级划分、留一受试者、两实验室合并训练并匹配留出受试者、跨实验室迁移；并考察目标坐标系（测力台坐标系 vs 航向对齐坐标系）的影响，辅以牛顿定律相关性的事前诊断。
AI.result: 试验级划分相对受试者留出将决定系数高估+0.040至+0.194，在职业搬运数据上该高估超过所有架构间差异；受试者留出下三模型R²为0.583–0.804，最优模型随数据集变化且差异落在受试者间变异内；合并两实验室数据对匹配受试者无改善；跨实验室迁移双向均低于随机水平，连不受平面旋转影响的垂直力亦如此；在测力台坐标系下保留力目标而输入为航向对齐时，步态前后向力解释方差损失0.57，足以使该力看似最难估计，牛顿定律相关性可在训练前检出该失配。
AI.conclusion: 数据划分协议与目标坐标系对报告精度的影响大于架构选择；学习式力估计器应以受试者留出方式验证、训练前检查坐标系一致性，并在宣称可部署前进行跨实验室测试。

title: ATune: Unsupervised Photo Retouching Through Image-Editor Controls
comment: 27 pages, 12 figures, 18 tables. Main paper 8 pages plus supplementary material
summary: Photo retouching models are trained on pairs of original and retouched photographs, usually edited by experts. Expert edits are costly, so the two main public sets, FiveK and PPR10K, hold only 16,161 originals. Good photographs on their own are far easier to find: commercial stock collections and free ones such as Pixabay and Unsplash hold millions. We learn retouching from them alone: we damage each photograph the way a camera or a careless edit would, which gives a worse and a better version of the same photograph. From these pairs, our model, ATune, learns how 13 measured attributes, such as brightness, contrast and sharpness, should change to raise a photograph's quality. The edit is declarative: ATune sets target values for the attributes, and a simple search adjusts the sliders of an out-of-the-box photo editor until the photograph reaches them. Every edit is a list of slider values a person can read and adjust. The same model can drive any editor that makes those changes; we test RawTherapee and darktable. We train on 10M photographs from a commercial stock collection and test on FiveK, PPR10K and SPAQ. Nine quality judges score every edit, and in a user study 157 human raters made 9,253 choices between our edit and another method's edit of the same photograph. When Claude Opus 5 and GPT-6 Astra edit the same photographs in the same editor, raters prefer our edits to GPT-6 Astra's (54.3%) and rate them even with Claude's (50.5%). We also compare with supervised retouchers on their home ground: NeurOP on FiveK and AdaInt on PPR10K, each trained on that set's own expert edits. Raters chose our edits in 46.3% of those comparisons. ATune, a 54M-parameter model trained without a single expert edit, now matches frontier models at setting an editor's sliders.

AI.tldr: ATune 仅用无专家标注的"损坏-原图"配对，从千万级商用图库学习 13 个可测量属性的目标值，再通过简单搜索驱动现成编辑器（RawTherapee/darktable）完成修图，54M 参数即达到甚至略胜前沿大模型与监督式修图模型的偏好水平。
AI.motivation: 专家修图配对数据昂贵稀缺（FiveK 与 PPR10K 合计仅 16,161 张原图），而高质量照片本身极易获取（Pixabay、Unsplash 及商业图库达数百万张）。因此希望摆脱对专家编辑的依赖，仅从"好照片"本身学习修图策略。
AI.method: 1）对每张高质量照片按"相机成像退化"或"粗心编辑"的方式施加损坏，构造"较差-较好"同源图像对；2）训练模型 ATune 学习 13 个测量属性（亮度、对比度、锐度等）应如何变化以提升画质，输出声明式的目标属性值；3）用简单搜索在现成照片编辑器上调滑块，直至达到目标值；4）编辑结果即人类可读可改的滑块列表，同一模型可驱动不同编辑器（RawTherapee、darktable）；5）在 10M 商业图库照片上训练，在 FiveK、PPR10K、SPAQ 上测试。
AI.result: 九个质量评审对每次编辑打分；157 名人类评分者在 9,253 次同一照片的 A/B 比较中：对比 GPT-6 Astra 胜率 54.3%，与 Claude Opus 5 持平（50.5%）；与各自在本数据集专家编辑上训练的监督修图器（FiveK 上 NeurOP、PPR10K 上 AdaInt）比较时胜率 46.3%，基本持平。模型仅 54M 参数。
AI.conclusion: 无需任何专家编辑、仅用合成退化配对训练的 ATune，在"设定编辑器滑块"这一任务上可媲美前沿大模型与监督式修图模型，同时保持可解释、可编辑的声明式输出与编辑器无关的可迁移性。

title: Skill Adapter: Personalized Modification and Online Routing of General-Purpose Skills
summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents use external skills to reuse task procedures and experience with tools. General-purpose skills describe shared execution procedures, while specific tool choices, operating practices, and output requirements vary across users. In long-horizon tasks, subgoals, available inputs, and environmental states change as execution progresses. Agents must select currently applicable skills from an expanding skill pool and prepare candidates for subsequent steps.
  We propose Skill Adapter, which enables personalized modification and online routing of general-purpose skills. The system distills local adjustments from user requirements and execution feedback and stores them as Adapters linked to general-purpose skills. The routing agent selects general-purpose skills and applicable Adapters based on the current subtask, execution progress, and environmental feedback, incrementally maintaining a task-level online skill library that the main LLM reads on demand. The system preloads candidates for subsequent nodes and rechecks their applicability once actual inputs are determined. Reinforcement learning optimizes the two types of decisions using modification gains and routing outcomes, respectively.
  We evaluate Skill Adapter on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SkillsBench. Compared with SkillRL, it improves task success rates by an average of 11.43 percentage points and reduces mean execution time on all three benchmarks. Skill Adapter retains its performance advantage when the skill pool grows to 1,000 skills.

AI.tldr: 提出 Skill Adapter 系统，实现通用技能的个人化修改与在线路由，在 ALFWorld、WebShop、SkillsBench 上相较 SkillRL 平均提升 11.43 个百分点成功率并缩短执行时间。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体依赖外部技能复用任务流程与工具经验，但通用技能只描述共享执行流程，而工具选择、操作规范与输出要求因用户而异；长程任务中子目标、可用输入与环境状态持续变化，智能体需从不断扩张的技能池中选择当前适用技能，并为后续步骤预备候选项。
AI.method: Skill Adapter 从用户需求与执行反馈中蒸馏局部调整，存为与通用技能关联的 Adapter；路由智能体依据当前子任务、执行进度与环境反馈选择通用技能及适用 Adapter，增量维护任务级在线技能库供主 LLM 按需读取；系统为后续节点预加载候选，并在实际输入确定后复核适用性；用强化学习分别以修改增益与路由结果优化两类决策。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、SkillsBench 上评测，相较 SkillRL 任务成功率平均提升 11.43 个百分点，三项基准平均执行时间均下降；技能池扩展至 1000 个技能时仍保持性能优势。
AI.conclusion: 将"个性化适配"与"在线路由"解耦为 Adapter 修改和路由选择两类决策，并结合预加载—复核机制与强化学习优化，可有效支撑长程任务下大规模技能池的技能复用与可扩展性。

title: Characterizing the Edge of Stability in Variational Training Without Priors
summary: Variational approaches in deep learning promise to deliver improved uncertainty quantification and out-of-distribution generalization by inferring a distribution over weights, regularized by a divergence to a chosen prior. However, prior elicitation presents a significant challenge in deep learning, resulting in the common practice of significantly downweighting the regularization term in the variational objective. Recently, it was proposed to train solely via the expected loss by relying on implicit regularization from the optimizer, rather than explicit regularization from the divergence to the prior. While this approach largely sidesteps the issue of prior elicitation, current theory lacks an understanding of how key optimization hyperparameters impact the implicit regularization. Here, we theoretically and empirically demonstrate that larger learning rates and fewer parameter samples lead to flatter minima of the loss landscape, which are known to generalize better. We show that training on the expected loss operates at a modified edge of stability, characterized by the signal-to-noise ratio of the gradient estimates and the number of Monte Carlo samples. Experiments on out-of-distribution benchmark datasets confirm the practical significance of the theoretical results.

AI.tldr: 该论文从理论与实验两方面证明：在仅以期望损失训练的变分贝叶斯深度网络中，较大的学习率与较少的参数采样数会使解收敛到更平坦的极小值，其隐式正则由梯度估计的信噪比与蒙特卡洛样本数决定，训练运行在一种"修正的稳定边缘"上。
AI.motivation: 变分方法本应通过权重后验推断提升不确定性量化与分布外泛化，但深度学习中先验难以合理给定，实践中常大幅下调KL正则项权重；近期提出的"仅用期望损失+优化器隐式正则"方案虽绕开先验设定问题，却缺乏理论解释关键优化超参数如何影响该隐式正则。
AI.method: 作者对以蒙特卡洛期望损失为目标、不使用显式散度正则的训练进行理论分析，刻画梯度估计的信噪比与MC样本数对隐式正则的调控作用，并提出"修正的稳定边缘"（modified edge of stability）分析框架；同时在分布外基准数据集上开展实证验证。
AI.result: 理论表明学习率越大、每次迭代的参数样本数越少，损失曲面的极小值越平坦（通常对应更好泛化）；训练动力学位于由梯度信噪比和MC样本数共同决定的修正稳定边缘。分布外基准实验与理论预测一致，验证了结论的实际意义。
AI.conclusion: 变分训练的隐式正则可由学习率、样本数与梯度噪声显式刻画，为无需先验设定的贝叶斯深度学习提供了可操作的超参数设计原则：通过调大学习率、减少MC采样即可获得平坦极小与更优的分布外泛化。

title: Reconstruct What You Can: Distractor-free 4D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Dynamic reconstruction from casual video must preserve valid subject motion while suppressing transient occluders, shadows, and volumetric effects. Existing methods either suppress valid motion through static-scene assumptions or model all observations jointly, producing ghosting and unstable geometry. We introduce ReCan-GS, a 4D Gaussian Splatting framework that separates coherent scene content from inconsistent observations. It derives a Jacobian-based deformation-sensitivity score from the learned deformation field, using it as an empirical proxy for reconstruction ambiguity. The score guides separation into dynamic Core Gaussians and per-view Distractor Gaussians, or post-hoc pruning of sensitive Core Gaussians. The same criterion supports removal of spatial occluders, photometric artifacts, and evolving smoke or fog without masks, pretrained segmenters, or medium-specific supervision. Experiments on synthetic and real dynamic scenes and synthetic smoke/fog scenes demonstrate its usefulness across the evaluated distractor regimes.

AI.tldr: ReCan-GS 提出基于变形场雅可比敏感度的 4D 高斯泼溅框架，将一致场景内容与不一致观测分离，在无掩码、无预训练分割器、无介质专属监督的条件下抑制瞬态遮挡物、阴影与烟雾雾气等伪影。
AI.motivation: 从随意拍摄的视频做动态重建时，必须保留有效的主体运动，同时抑制瞬态遮挡物、阴影和体积效应。现有方法要么以静态场景假设压制了有效运动，要么对所有观测联合建模，导致鬼影与不稳定几何。
AI.method: 从学习到的变形场中导出基于雅可比的变形敏感度分数，作为重建歧义的经验代理。该分数用于两种策略：(1) 将高斯分离为动态 Core Gaussians 与逐视角的 Distractor Gaussians；(2) 事后剪枝敏感的核心高斯。同一准则可同时处理空间遮挡物、光度伪影以及演化中的烟雾或雾，无需掩码、预训练分割器或介质专属监督。
AI.result: 在合成与真实动态场景以及合成烟雾/雾场景上的实验表明，该方法在所述的各类干扰情形下均具有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以变形场雅可比敏感度作为歧义代理是一种简洁有效的分离准则，使统一的 4D 高斯框架在多种干扰机制下实现鲁棒的动态重建与伪影抑制。

title: Your Vision Foundation Model Is Secretly an EEG Foundation Model
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are pretrained on thousands of hours of recordings, yet their frozen features transfer poorly to downstream tasks, and this transfer does not consistently improve with larger models or more pretraining data. We show that a vision foundation model that has never seen EEG is a stronger frozen EEG encoder than these specialized models, once the signals are rendered as images that a vision transformer can read. Our method, SeeEEG, keeps the vision backbone frozen and learns only how EEG is displayed to it. Each channel occupies a dedicated row of patches and is drawn either as a waveform at a fixed gain or as a scalogram whose frequency range spans the patch height, so that task-relevant patterns fall within individual tokens. The montage, filtering, and contrast parameters of this display are initialized from a standard clinical montage and optimized with the task loss through the frozen backbone, which amounts to at most 1,113 trainable parameters per view. We compare SeeEEG with seven EEG foundation models on eight clinical, sleep, affective, and brain-computer interface datasets, with every encoder frozen and paired with identical readout heads. With a frozen DINOv3 ViT-B, SeeEEG outperforms every EEG foundation model in balanced accuracy on all eight datasets and reaches a mean rank of 1.3 in Cohen kappa or AUROC, compared with 2.9 for the strongest baseline, REVE. The learned displays transfer without further optimization to the video encoder V-JEPA 2.1, which outperforms every EEG foundation model on both metrics on six of the eight datasets. Replacing DINOv3 with a randomly initialized ViT-B lowers the score by 15.2 points on average, so the ability to read rendered EEG comes from visual pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SeeEEG：将 EEG 信号渲染为图像，交由冻结的视觉基础模型编码，仅学习"如何显示 EEG"（蒙太奇、滤波、对比度等≤1,113 个参数），在 8 个临床/睡眠/情感/BCI 数据集上全面超越 7 个 EEG 基础模型。
AI.motivation: EEG 基础模型虽在大规模记录上预训练，但其冻结特征迁移到下游任务效果差，且随模型规模与预训练数据增加并无稳定提升。作者试图质疑"领域专用预训练"的必要性，探索从未见过 EEG 的视觉基础模型是否可作为更强的冻结 EEG 编码器。
AI.method: 核心思路是把 EEG 转成 ViT 可读的图像：每个通道占据专属的 patch 行，以固定增益波形或频带覆盖 patch 高度的时频图（scalogram）绘制，使任务相关模式落在单个 token 内。视觉主干完全冻结，仅优化"显示参数"（蒙太奇、滤波、对比度），由标准临床蒙太奇初始化，经冻结主干用任务损失反传优化，每个视图最多 1,113 个可训练参数。实验采用 7 个 EEG 基础模型、8 个数据集，所有编码器冻结并配相同读出头作对比。
AI.result: 冻结 DINOv3 ViT-B 时，SeeEEG 在全部 8 个数据集的平衡准确率上优于所有 EEG 基础模型，Cohen kappa/AUROC 平均排名 1.3（最强基线 REVE 为 2.9）。学到的显示配置无需再优化即可迁移至视频编码器 V-JEPA 2.1，并在 8 个数据集中的 6 个上两项指标均超越所有 EEG 基础模型。将 DINOv3 换成随机初始化 ViT-B，平均分数下降 15.2 分，说明"读图能力"源自视觉预训练。
AI.conclusion: 通用视觉预训练 + 可学习的信号渲染方式，可作为一种极轻量（千级参数）、强迁移的 EEG 编码方案，优于领域专用 EEG 基础模型的冻结特征，且其优势来源于视觉预训练而非模型规模或 EEG 预训练数据量。

title: FlowIR: Depth-driven Rectified Flow for Resolving Thermal Ambiguity in Infrared Super-Resolution
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Multimedia & Expo (ICME 2026)
summary: Distinguishing different heat sources in low-resolution infrared (IR) images is inherently difficult, as multiple thermal emitters often collapse into ambiguous and overlapping responses. Existing super-resolution methods hallucinate structures from such ambiguous 2D evidence, leading to thermal drift, boundary merging, and unreliable restoration under infrared degradations. We propose FlowIR, a depth-driven rectified flow framework that resolves thermal ambiguity by injecting 3D geometric cues into the generation process. Pseudo-3D depth lifting and depth-guided 3D convolutions disentangle overlapping foreground objects, while cluster-wise inter-attention suppresses cross-source feature contamination. A Thermal-Geometry Consistency Loss further enforces geometric alignment during refinement. Built upon a lightweight rectified flow backbone, FlowIR restores IR images in only a few steps, producing sharply separated, degradation-robust, and geometrically faithful high-resolution results.

AI.tldr: 提出FlowIR——一种深度驱动的整流流(rectified flow)框架，通过注入3D几何线索解决低分辨率红外图像中热源歧义，实现少步、几何保真、抗退化的红外超分辨率重建。
AI.motivation: 低分辨率红外图像中多个热辐射体常塌缩为重叠、模糊的响应，热源区分本质上困难。现有超分方法从这类歧义的2D证据中"幻觉"结构，导致热漂移、边界融合与红外退化条件下的不可靠恢复。
AI.method: 1) 伪3D深度提升(pseudo-3D depth lifting)与深度引导3D卷积，用于解耦重叠前景目标；2) 簇间注意力(cluster-wise inter-attention)抑制跨热源特征污染；3) 热-几何一致性损失(Thermal-Geometry Consistency Loss)在精修阶段约束几何对齐；4) 轻量级rectified flow主干，仅需少数采样步完成恢复。
AI.result: 在少数步骤内即可恢复红外图像，输出热源边界清晰分离、对退化鲁棒、几何忠实的高分辨率结果。
AI.conclusion: 以深度几何先验引导生成式超分，是缓解红外热源歧义的有效途径；FlowIR在效率（少步采样）与几何保真度之间取得较好平衡。摘要未给出定量指标与数据集，需结合正文实验验证。

title: Reasoning Supervision and Capability Retention in LoRA Domain Adaptation
summary: Fine-tuning foundation models on financial data has a wide range of applications, including identifying event types from news, monitoring risk and compliance language, and answering questions over filings and earnings calls. In this setting, the main challenge is to improve task performance without degrading the generalization capabilities of the model. In this paper, we present an extensive set of ablations for fine-tuning Qwen3-8B with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We compare three training regimes: (1) response-only LoRA, where the supervised response is the label alone; (2) single-adapter reasoning, where reasoning traces from a teacher model are included alongside the labels in the training loss; and (3) dual-adapter composite training, where separate LoRA adapters are trained on traces and labels. Response-only LoRA improves in-domain performance and leaves general capabilities near those of the frozen model. The in-domain change is largest for calibration and argmax accuracy. Under single-adapter reasoning, the in-domain metrics remain behind those of the response-only regime, while MMLU-Pro can rise slightly and the other retention benchmarks stay within ordinary variation. Dual-adapter composite training remains on the same side of this comparison and yields no further gain. Finally, we compress the teacher traces by summarizing them before training, and show that shorter summaries move calibration toward the response-only regime without reaching it.

AI.tldr: 本文对 Qwen3-8B 使用 LoRA 微调金融数据，系统对比三种训练范式（仅回答 LoRA、单适配器推理、双适配器复合训练），并考察将教师推理链压缩为摘要后的影响。
AI.motivation: 在金融数据上微调基础模型有广泛用途（新闻事件类型识别、风险与合规语言监测、财报与业绩会问答），核心难点是在提升任务性能的同时不损害模型原有泛化能力，因此需要明确不同 LoRA 训练范式中"任务收益"与"能力保持"的权衡。
AI.method: 在 Qwen3-8B 上做大规模消融实验，比较三种 LoRA 训练设置：(1) 仅对监督回答（标签本身）计算损失；(2) 单适配器推理训练，将教师模型的推理轨迹与标签一并纳入训练损失；(3) 双适配器复合训练，分别在推理轨迹与标签上训练独立 LoRA 适配器。另将教师轨迹先摘要压缩后再训练。评估涵盖域内指标（校准度、argmax 准确率）与通用能力保持基准（MMLU-Pro 等）。
AI.result: 仅回答 LoRA 提升域内表现，通用能力接近冻结模型水平，域内收益主要体现于校准与 argmax 准确率。单适配器推理的域内指标落后于仅回答方案，MMLU-Pro 可略有上升，其余保持性基准处于正常波动范围内。双适配器复合训练结果与之同侧，未带来额外增益。将教师轨迹摘要压缩后，较短的摘要使校准向仅回答方案靠拢，但未能达到其水平。
AI.conclusion: 在金融领域微调中，注入推理轨迹并未带来域内性能增益反而略有损失，双适配器结构亦无叠加收益；仅回答 LoRA 是兼顾域内提升与泛化保持的最优选择，推理链压缩只能部分弥合校准差距。

title: Runtime Analysis of Cartesian Genetic Programming on Max: A Proven Exponential Speedup
comment: Accepted as a poster at NeurIPS 2026. To appear in the conference proceedings
summary: Genetic Programming (GP) is a search paradigm inspired from natural evolution for the automated discovery of expressions, functions, and computer programs. Cartesian GP (CGP) is a flavor of GP that uses a graph-based model to encode candidate programs, as contrasted to the conventional Tree-based GP (TGP). Since its inception two decades ago, CGP has predominantly been analyzed empirically, thus little is known regarding its theoretical performance guarantees. This paper analyzes CGP for the Max problem, which has been only rigorously studied for TGP with a proven expected runtime superlinear in the optimal program length $n$. We prove that the expected time for the ($1$+$1$)~CGP employing common mutation operators to evolve an equivalent optimal of the same output is polylogarithmic in $n$, specifically at most $O(\log^9{n})$. This is remarkable, as it shows an exponential speedup by switching to CGP. Our results shed light on the benefit and the compactness of the graph-based representation for programs, and on how CGP can navigate its search and fitness spaces efficiently. This is a first proven performance guarantee for CGP on an established benchmark problem. Experiments complement our theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次为笛卡尔遗传规划（CGP）在经典基准问题Max上给出严格的理论性能保证：证明采用常见变异算子的(1+1) CGP期望运行时间仅为O(log^9 n)，相比树式遗传规划（TGP）的超线性（已被证明）期望时间实现了指数级加速，实验也验证了理论结论。
AI.motivation: CGP自提出二十年来主要以经验性研究为主，缺乏理论性能保证；而已有严格理论分析的TGP在Max问题上期望运行时间为最优程序长度n的超线性。作者希望填补CGP理论分析的空白，揭示图式编码表示的紧凑性优势及其在搜索空间与适应度空间中的高效导航机制。
AI.method: 针对Max基准问题，对采用常见变异算子的(1+1) CGP（基于图结构编码候选程序）进行理论运行时分析，推导其进化出与最优程序输出等价解所需的期望时间上界，并以实验对理论结果进行补充验证。
AI.result: 证明(1+1) CGP在Max问题上进化出等价最优解（相同输出）的期望时间为关于n的多对数级，具体不超过O(log^9 n)；相较TGP的超线性界限，实现了指数级加速。这是CGP在成熟基准问题上首个被证明的性能保证，实验结果与理论相符。
AI.conclusion: 研究从理论上说明了图式程序表示的紧凑性与优势，以及CGP高效遍历搜索空间与适应度空间的能力，为CGP相对于TGP的指数级加速提供了首个严格证据。

title: DEDCA: Test-Time Adaptation for Generalized AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: AI-generated image detectors face significant challenges when deployed in real-world environments, particularly when test samples are produced by unseen generators that deviate from the source training distribution. Existing detectors often rely on a single type of evidence, such as semantic representations or low-level generation traces, making them vulnerable when the corresponding cue becomes unreliable. Moreover, adapting detectors to newly emerging generators usually requires target labels or retraining, which is costly and impractical. To address these challenges, we propose Dual-Evidence Disagreement-Constrained Adaptation (DEDCA), a test-time adaptation framework for generalized AI-generated image detection. DEDCA constructs a dual-evidence detector by combining CLIP-based semantic evidence with trace evidence extracted from shuffled entropy and residual statistics, and introduces a reliability-aware gate to perform sample-specific adaptive fusion. Our key idea is to exploit the disagreement between the two evidence streams as an unlabeled adaptation signal, enabling the detector to adjust to target-domain shifts without relying on target labels or blindly trusting a single prediction stream. Experiments show that DEDCA achieves superior performance on the GenImage benchmark by outperforming state-of-the-art AI-generated image detectors and test-time adaptation methods with 92.0\% average accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出DEDCA测试时自适应框架，融合CLIP语义证据与低级生成痕迹证据，并利用两路证据的分歧作为无标签自适应信号，在GenImage上平均准确率达92.0%。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测器在实际部署中面临未见生成器带来的分布偏移，且通常仅依赖单一类型证据（语义表示或低级生成痕迹），某一线索失效时性能骤降；同时适配新生成器需目标标签或重训练，成本高且不实用。
AI.method: 构建双证据检测器：CLIP语义证据 + 由shuffled entropy与残差统计提取的痕迹证据；引入可靠性感知门控进行样本级自适应融合；核心思想是以两路证据间的分歧作为无监督自适应信号，使检测器在无目标标签条件下适应目标域偏移，避免盲信单一预测流。
AI.result: 在GenImage基准上优于现有SOTA AI生成图像检测器与测试时自适应方法，平均准确率达92.0%。
AI.conclusion: 双证据互补结合可靠性门控与分歧驱动自适应，可在无标签、无需重训练条件下有效提升生成图像检测的泛化能力。

title: Protocol-Aware Auditing of Domain-Blind Feature Attribution in Network Intrusion Detection
comment: Accepted as a poster at the LXAI Research Workshop, NeurIPS 2026; 6 figures
summary: Feature-attribution methods can query rule-violating network states through perturbations, coalitions, references, paths, and ablations, making explanations and their evaluation sensitive to model behavior outside the operational domain. We formalize this failure mode as domain blindness and prove valid-query invariance: when models agree on the required oracle information within a declared rule-valid set, a procedure confined to that set returns the same attribution. We instantiate one protocol-aware query-control principle in LIME, SHAP, Integrated Gradients, and DeepLIFT and audit paired configurations across four NIDS datasets and three classifier families. In six settings where standard LIME reports perfect top-feature repeatability, PA-LIME reveals substantial variability, with a mean of 0.575. Under FGSM followed by protocol repair, PA-DeepLIFT and PA-IG achieve the largest attribution-similarity curve areas, 0.452 and 0.413, while mean within-PA rank agreement rises to 0.366 from 0.217. PA-XAI therefore turns structured domain assumptions into explicit, testable controls for explanation auditing; support modeling, raw-flow reconstruction, and adaptive explanation attacks provide complementary validation layers.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“域盲（domain blindness）”这一可解释性失效模式并证明“有效查询不变性”，据此将协议感知的查询控制原则（PA-XAI）实例化到 LIME、SHAP、IG、DeepLIFT 中，在四个 NIDS 数据集与三类分类器上做配对审计，显示 PA-XAI 能揭示标准方法掩盖的解释不稳定并提升对抗扰动后的归因稳健性。
AI.motivation: 特征归因方法依赖扰动、联盟、参考点、路径与消融等方式查询模型，这些查询常常落在违反规则约束（非操作域）的网络状态上，使解释及其评估对模型在操作域外的行为高度敏感；需要把这类隐患显式化并可检验。
AI.method: 将上述失效形式化为“域盲”，证明有效查询不变性（在声明的规则有效集内模型给出相同 oracle 信息时，限定于该集合的流程返回相同归因）；提出一种协议感知的查询控制原则，并在 LIME/SHAP/Integrated Gradients/DeepLIFT 中实例化（PA-LIME、PA-SHAP、PA-IG、PA-DeepLIFT）；在四个 NIDS 数据集与三类分类器上做配对配置审计，辅以支持建模、原始流量重构与自适应解释攻击三层验证。
AI.result: 在标准 LIME 报告“完美”top-feature 可重复性的六个设置中，PA-LIME 揭示出显著变异，平均 0.575；在 FGSM 后经协议修复的条件下，PA-DeepLIFT 与 PA-IG 取得最大的归因相似度曲线面积（0.452 与 0.413），PA 内部平均秩一致性由 0.217 提升至 0.366。
AI.conclusion: PA-XAI 把结构化的域假设转化为显式、可检验的控制手段，为解释审计提供可操作框架；支持建模、原始流量重构与自适应解释攻击构成互补的验证层。

title: Selective Generative Restoration for Video Deraining via Uncertainty-Aware Diffusion
summary: Video deraining is challenging due to rain streaks, occlusions, and atmospheric effects. Existing methods mainly follow a deterministic restoration paradigm, assuming that clean scenes can be uniquely recovered from rainy observations. However, rain degradation is spatially heterogeneous. Reliable regions require faithful reconstruction, whereas severely occluded regions contain ambiguous content that require stronger prior-driven inference. Therefore, conventional deterministic restoration often produces over-smoothed results, while global generative restoration may introduce unnecessary hallucinations. We introduce a Selective Generative Restoration paradigm for video deraining, where generative priors are adaptively activated according to restoration uncertainty. Based on this principle, we propose Selective Generative Video Deraining (SGVD), an uncertainty-aware diffusion framework that enables adaptive fidelity preservation and generative recovery. Specifically, SGVD exploits stochastic diversity between dual one-step diffusion predictions to estimate region-level restoration uncertainty, which determines where observation fidelity should be preserved and where generative inference should be activated. Furthermore, an anchor-guided trajectory consistency mechanism is proposed to regularize stochastic diffusion evolution across frames, reducing temporal generation drift and improving video coherence. To achieve practical efficiency, SGVD adopts one-step diffusion inference while maintaining uncertainty-aware generative capability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SGVD achieves superior restoration performance, perceptual quality, and temporal consistency compared with state-of-the-art video deraining methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"选择性生成复原"范式与SGVD框架：用双一步扩散预测的随机差异估计区域级复原不确定性，据此自适应地决定何处保持观测保真、何处启用生成推断；并以锚点引导的轨迹一致性约束抑制跨帧生成漂移。
AI.motivation: 视频去雨面临雨痕、遮挡与大气效应，退化在空间上异质：可靠区域需忠实重建，严重遮挡区域内容模糊、需更强先验推断。现有确定性复原范式易产生过平滑，而全局生成复原会引入不必要的幻觉，二者均未考虑区域异质性。
AI.method: 提出SGVD不确定性感知扩散框架（1）利用双一步扩散预测间的随机多样性估计区域级复原不确定性，作为保真/生成的自适应切换依据；（2）提出锚点引导的轨迹一致性机制，正则化跨帧随机扩散演化，减小时间生成漂移；（3）采用一步扩散推断以兼顾效率。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SGVD在复原性能、感知质量与时间一致性上均优于现有最先进视频去雨方法。
AI.conclusion: 按不确定性自适应激活生成先验，可在避免过平滑与抑制幻觉之间取得平衡，是视频去雨的有效范式；一步扩散可实现不确定性感知的实用高效推理。

title: CapLite: Prompt-Injection Defense for Small Language Model Agents without Model-Written Security Artifacts
summary: Enforcement defenses against prompt injection, such as CaMeL, Progent, IPIGuard and DRIFT, ask the agent's own model to write a security artifact (a program, a privilege policy, a dependency graph or a constraint list) that code then enforces. We ask whether small language model (SLM) agents can be trusted to write these artifacts. Across 15 open-weight models, 13 of them between 1.7B and 12B parameters, they cannot: the policies, graphs and constraints that the agent's model writes admit attacks on 14 (Progent), 13 (IPIGuard) and 11 (DRIFT) of the models, and CaMeL's programs fail to run in up to 68% of episodes. We present CapLite, which derives its policy from the tool schemas, commits the write calls before any tool result is read, and admits a write only if every argument that decides whom or what it affects is stated in the user's request. This guarantees write integrity: injected text cannot add a write, and no write reaches a recipient, amount, object or destination that the user did not state. No attack succeeds in 13,935 attacked AgentDojo episodes. CapLite reaches utility under attack comparable to CaMeL's (29.0% vs. 27.2%) with fewer tokens than every other enforcement defense and than the undefended agent: 17.1k per episode, 18% of CaMeL's, and the highest utility per token of all enforcement defenses.

AI.tldr: 现有执行层提示注入防御（CaMeL、Progent、IPIGuard、DRIFT）依赖智能体自身模型编写安全工件，但小模型在这些工件上不可信；本文提出 CapLite，以工具模式派生策略、先提交写调用后读工具结果、并对写参数施加用户明示约束，实现写完整性保证，在 AgentDojo 上 13,935 个受攻击回合零攻破，且以最省 token 达到与 CaMeL 相当的效用。
AI.motivation: 执行层防御（程序、权限策略、依赖图、约束列表）通常由智能体自身模型生成，再交由代码执行。作者质疑：小语言模型（SLM）智能体能否可信地写出这些安全工件。若不能，则防御的"执行保障"建立在不可靠的生成之上，安全前提被架空。
AI.method: 1) 评测：在 15 个开放权重模型（其中 13 个为 1.7B–12B）上检验 CaMeL / Progent / IPIGuard / DRIFT 所生成工件的可攻击性。2) 提出 CapLite：策略由工具模式（tool schemas）直接派生，不依赖模型自由生成；在任何工具返回结果被读取前先提交写调用（commit write calls）；仅当决定"影响谁、影响什么"的每个参数都能在用户请求中被明示时才放行写入。
AI.result: SLM 生成的工件存在普遍失效：模型自写的策略/图/约束分别导致 14 个（Progent）、13 个（IPIGuard）、11 个（DRIFT）模型被攻破；CaMeL 的程序最多在 68% 的回合中无法运行。CapLite 在 13,935 个受攻击 AgentDojo 回合中无一攻击成功；受攻击效用 29.0%，与 CaMeL 的 27.2% 相当；每回合 17.1k token，为 CaMeL 的 18%，少于所有其他执行层防御甚至无防御智能体，单位 token 效用最高。
AI.conclusion: SLM 不具备可靠编写安全工件的能力，执行层防御不应把安全性寄托于模型自生成策略。CapLite 通过模式驱动策略与写完整性保证，在不依赖模型可信性的前提下实现零攻破、可比效用与最低 token 开销，表明"由系统而非模型承担安全工件构造"是更可靠的防御范式。

title: Hand in Silhouette: Synthetic-to-Real Multi-View Hand Reconstruction via Binary Masks
summary: Calibrated multi-view hand reconstruction has advanced rapidly, yet the effectiveness of existing methods depends strongly on real captured data, which is costly to acquire, limited in hand-geometry diversity, and often affected by imperfect annotations. Synthetic data offers a scalable alternative with accurate supervision, but a substantial synthetic-to-real appearance gap hinders its use. To address this, we introduce Hand in Silhouette (SilHand), a calibrated multi-view hand reconstruction framework that operates on binary hand masks, obtainable at low cost either automatically or manually, to reduce the synthetic-to-real observation gap.
