AI.method: 以Generic Event Boundary Detection（GEBD）为探针，先由无监督方法生成候选边界，再由LVLM对候选进行精炼；面向小时级第一视角视频，采用粗到细的时间发现与局部化LVLM接受/拒绝判断以降低整视频精炼的不可行性；并进行与人类标注的一致性人工评估。
AI.result: Kinetics-GEBD上LVLM直接逐帧预测会漏掉大量边界，但精炼无监督候选可达到SOTA的无监督GEBD性能；小时级视频中LVLM与群体共识的一致程度落在人类标注者之间的一致性区间内，分歧集中于低共识样本；代表性监督与无监督方法在EgoBoundary上显著性能下降。
AI.conclusion: LVLM更适合作为边界候选的精炼者而非直接检测器；长时程第一视角事件边界检测仍具挑战性，EgoBoundary可作为该方向的评测基准。

title: Hiding a Gap Does Not Close It: The Price of Removing the Mean Group Contrast from Learned Models of Learning Dynamics
comment: 98 pages, 18 figures, 55 tables. Code: https://github.com/SostheneHB/Gen-AI-Tutoring (release v1.6, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24147314)
summary: Adaptive tutors use models learned from student data, and a common fairness remedy erases the group signal from these models. We turn the cost of this remedy into an audit tool. Building on mean-parity regression, we give the minimum extra error, relative to the best predictor, of removing the mean group contrast from a predictor that cannot use the group, $p_0p_1Δ^2/R^2$, and the exact cost of any correction built from an estimated group model, which, for the best predictor, is never below this minimum. A three-stage audit (fit on training units, announce the cost on validation units, test on independent units) estimates this cost before the correction is used. In a controlled study, the price can be large even when the state predicts the group poorly. On three real data sets, erasing the group from a learned model of learning dynamics predicts almost no gap where one is observed. In a selected knowledge-tracing network, erasing the hidden state leaves most of the gap; a correction of the prediction removes it at an extra Brier score of 0.021 on average. On Eedi, with the network selected on separate units, the audit accepted the announced cost in all five splits, the measured cost fell inside the announced interval in all five, and the gap reduction transferred to new classes in four; on new ASSISTments schools the audit abstains. In a tutoring simulator, the objective and the help budget matter more than the erasure, and floors on each group's knowledge separate narrowing a gap from levelling down. Hiding a gap in a model does not close it.

AI.tldr: 论文将“从模型中抹除群体信号”这一公平性补救的代价转化为审计工具：给出最小额外误差的理论下界 \(p_0p_1\Delta^2/R^2\) 及任意基于估计群体模型修正的精确代价，并设计三阶段审计流程在实际修正前估计该代价。实验表明隐藏差距并不等于消除差距。
AI.motivation: 自适应教学系统依赖从学生数据学习的模型，常见的公平性补救是删除组别信号。但抹除群体信号会带来预测精度损失，这种代价通常不可见。作者希望把这一代价显式化，作为审计手段，判断“去掉群体信息”是否真的缩小了可观测的差距，而非仅仅把差距藏进模型。
AI.method: 基于均值对齐回归（mean-parity regression）：1）推导在无法使用群体信息的预测器上抹除均值组间对比所需的最小额外误差 \(p_0p_1\Delta^2/R^2\)，并给出由估计群体模型构建的任意修正的精确代价（对最优预测器而言不低于该最小值）；2）提出三阶段审计：在训练单元拟合、在验证单元宣布代价、在独立单元检验，从而在修正使用前估计代价；3）在受控模拟、三个真实数据集（Eedi、ASSISTments）与教学模拟器上评估，并考察知识追踪网络隐藏状态抹除的影响与分组知识下限的作用。
AI.result: 受控研究中，即使状态对群体预测很差，代价也可能很大；三个真实数据集上，从学习动力学模型抹除群体几乎不预示任何差距，而实际差距仍存在。在选定的知识追踪网络中，抹除隐藏状态仍保留大部分差距，对预测做修正可消除差距，平均额外 Brier 分数为 0.021。Eedi 上（网络在独立单元选择），五个划分中审计均接受宣布的代价，实测代价均落在宣布区间内，四个划分的差距缩减可迁移到新班级；在 ASSISTments 新学校上审计弃权。教学模拟器中，目标函数与帮助预算的影响大于抹除本身，各组知识下限可区分“缩小差距”与“向下拉平”。
AI.conclusion: 在模型中隐藏差距并不能消除差距。将公平性补救的代价作为可事前审计的量，可判断抹除群体信号是否真实有效；审计在部分场景（如 Eedi）具备可迁移性，在分布偏移场景（如新学校）应弃权，且需配合分组知识下限以避免向下拉平。

title: PiLLVD: A Real-World Low-Light Video Dataset for Dynamic Scenes Captured with Off-the-Shelf Cameras
comment: 14 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Dataset available on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23015904
summary: Low-light image and video enhancement has received increasing attention in recent years. However, most existing enhancement methods are developed and evaluated on still images, while progress in low-light video enhancement remains limited by the lack of real-world paired video datasets. Acquiring paired low-light and normal-light video sequences is challenging because it requires spatially and temporally aligned captures while avoiding motion blur, exposure mismatch, and correspondence errors in dynamic scenes. To address this gap, we introduce PiLLVD, the Pi-based Low-Light Video Dataset, a paired low-light video dataset captured using an accessible Raspberry Pi-based multi-camera system with off-the-shelf cameras. PiLLVD provides paired low-light and aligned normal-light reference sequences for dynamic indoor and outdoor scenes, including diverse human and object motion under varying illumination conditions. Unlike existing datasets that are often image-based, static, synthetic, or limited to simple motion patterns, PiLLVD focuses on motion-rich scenes where frame-to-frame stability and motion-related artefacts are important for evaluation. In addition to presenting the dataset and acquisition pipeline, we benchmark representative pre-trained low-light video enhancement methods on PiLLVD under a zero-shot setting. The results show that existing methods do not generalise uniformly across the proposed sequences, highlighting the challenges posed by the proposed dataset and its value for both benchmarking existing methods and supporting the development of future low-light video enhancement algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PiLLVD——一个基于树莓派多相机系统采集的配对低光视频数据集，用于推动低光视频增强研究。
AI.motivation: 现有低光增强方法多在静态图像上开发与评估，低光视频增强进展受限于缺乏真实场景的配对视频数据集。采集空间与时间对齐的配对低光/正常光视频十分困难，需避免动态场景中的运动模糊、曝光失配与对应错误。
AI.method: 构建低成本、易复现的树莓派多相机采集系统，用现成相机同步采集配对低光序列与空间对齐的正常光参考序列，覆盖室内外动态场景及多样的人与物体运动；并给出数据采集流程说明；在零样本设定下对代表性预训练低光视频增强方法进行基准测试。
AI.result: 与现有多为图像级、静态、合成或仅含简单运动模式的数据集不同，PiLLVD 侧重运动丰富的场景，可评估帧间稳定性与运动相关伪影；基准测试显示现有方法在所提序列上泛化能力不一致。
AI.conclusion: PiLLVD 揭示了真实动态低光视频的挑战性，既可作为现有方法的评测基准，也能支撑未来低光视频增强算法的研发。

title: Feature-Aware Edge Sampling for Approximate One-Step Laplacian Propagation
summary: This paper studies how to approximate one-step combinatorial Laplacian messages in graph neural networks using edge sampling. We propose a spanning tree based hybrid sampler that combines feature-conditioned message scores and effective-resistance leverage scores, derive the expected one-step message error and obtain the optimal sampling probabilities and error frontier for a given expected edge budget. Preliminary experiments on synthetic community graphs show that message error decreases, while classification accuracy increases slightly, as the edge budget grows, and performance of the hybrid sampler is in between of optimal selection uniform random sampling. We leave multi-step propagation and evaluation on larger and real graphs for future work.

AI.tldr: 该文研究用边采样近似GNN中的单步组合拉普拉斯消息，提出基于生成树的混合采样器，结合特征条件消息得分与有效电阻杠杆得分，推导期望单步消息误差，并在给定边预算下给出最优采样概率与误差前沿。
AI.motivation: GNN中基于组合拉普拉斯的消息传播需在全图上进行，边数大时计算开销高；需在有限边预算下近似消息传播，同时控制近似误差。
AI.method: 提出基于生成树的混合采样器：将特征条件消息得分与有效电阻杠杆得分相结合构造采样概率；推导期望单步消息误差表达式，并在给定期望边预算下求解最优采样概率及误差前沿。
AI.result: 在合成社区图上：随边预算增加，消息误差下降、分类准确率略有提升；混合采样器性能介于最优选择与均匀随机采样之间。
AI.conclusion: 生成树混合采样可有效权衡消息误差与边预算，但现有多步传播与更大规模真实图上的评估尚未完成，留待后续工作。

title: UniSpark: Exploring Hybrid Attention for Multimodal Understanding and Generation
summary: We present UniSpark-9B, a unified multimodal model that investigates hybrid attention for visual understanding and generation. Built on a Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts backbone with approximately 9B parameters in each branch, UniSpark combines full attention for explicit token interactions with GatedDeltaNet linear attention for compact context propagation. Autoregressive text prediction and visual flow matching jointly support visual question answering, text-to-image generation, instruction-guided editing, and interleaved text-image prediction. In interleaved generation, noisy visual targets are isolated from subsequent predictions, while clean visual representations provide context for later outputs. A blockwise protocol enforces this distinction through attention masks in full-attention layers and recurrent-state retention rules in linear-attention layers. The selected training sources contain 159.7M generation samples, 213.4M understanding samples, and 624.8K interleaved sequences. A four-stage curriculum jointly trains multimodal understanding and visual generation, refining answer accuracy and instruction following while extending image synthesis to 2K. UniSpark scores 2470.3 on MME-S and 0.83 on GenEval. Qualitative examples further illustrate its capabilities in interleaved image generation, video synthesis, and video editing. Together, these results demonstrate that hybrid attention provides an effective backbone for unified multimodal understanding and generation.

AI.tldr: UniSpark-9B 是一个约9B参数的统一多模态模型，采用全注意力与GatedDeltaNet线性注意力的混合注意力及MoTE主干，统一支持视觉问答、文生图、编辑与交错图文生成，MME-S 2470.3、GenEval 0.83。
AI.motivation: 探索混合注意力（全注意力+线性注意力）能否作为统一多模态理解与生成的骨干，兼顾显式token交互与紧凑上下文传播。
AI.method: 基于Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts主干（每分支约9B参数），结合全注意力与GatedDeltaNet线性注意力；以自回归文本预测与视觉流匹配联合训练；交错生成中通过块级协议隔离含噪视觉目标（全注意力层用attention mask，线性注意力层用循环状态保留规则）；训练数据含159.7M生成样本、213.4M理解样本、624.8K交错序列；四阶段课程联合训练。
AI.result: MME-S得分2470.3，GenEval 0.83；答问准确率与指令遵循得到改善，图像合成扩展至2K；定性示例展示交错图像生成、视频生成与视频编辑能力。
AI.conclusion: 混合注意力可作为统一多模态理解与生成的有效骨干。

title: Self-Supervised Attention-Based Virtual Metrology for CMP MRR Prediction
comment: Submitted to the IEEE International Symposium on Semiconductor Manufacturing (ISSM 2026)
summary: Chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) is a critical semiconductor manufacturing process where material removal rate (MRR) is a key metric for process monitoring and advanced process control (APC). Virtual metrology enables MRR estimation from process time series signals, supporting run-to-run(R2R) control and process optimization while reducing reliance on physical metrology. Existing approaches typically rely on simplified linear assumptions or require handcrafted feature engineering. In this paper, we propose Global Regression Pretraining(GREP), a self-supervised, attention-based framework for CMP MRR prediction. GREP learns temporal representations from unlabeled sensor signals through global proxy-target regression, followed by supervised fine-tuning for MRR estimation. The framework is evaluated against a feature-engineered supervised baseline under three conditions: limited labeled data, sensor noise, and temporal process drift. Experiments on the PHM 2016 CMP dataset demonstrate competitive performance under limited labeled-data conditions, with improvements in selected cases and performance largely comparable to the baseline across different labeled-data fractions. Both models exhibit relatively small changes in prediction error with increasing noise, while GREP achieves a 17.0% RMSE reduction in the final temporal interval.

AI.tldr: 提出自监督注意力框架GREP，通过全局代理目标回归从无标签CMP传感器时序信号学习表征，再微调预测MRR，在标签受限、噪声与时间漂移条件下与人工特征监督基线对比。
AI.motivation: CMP中MRR是过程监控与APC的关键指标，虚拟量测可从时序信号估计MRR以支持R2R控制并减少物理量测依赖；但现有方法多依赖简化线性假设或需人工特征工程。
AI.method: GREP为基于注意力的自监督框架：先在无标签传感器信号上以全局代理目标回归做预训练学习时序表征，再以监督微调完成MRR估计；在PHM 2016 CMP数据集上与特征工程监督基线在三种条件下比较：标签数据有限、传感器噪声、时间过程漂移。
AI.result: 标签受限条件下性能具竞争力，部分情形有提升，不同标签比例下总体与基线相当；随噪声增大两模型预测误差变化均较小；GREP在最后时间区间RMSE降低17.0%。
AI.conclusion: 自监督预训练可为CMP虚拟量测提供有效表征，在标签稀缺与时间漂移下具优势，是替代人工特征工程的有前景方向。

title: Context-Predictive Low-Rank Adaptation for Face Presentation Attack Detection
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Face presentation attack detection requires representations that distinguish physical spoofing cues across changes in acquisition devices, subjects, and attack media. Large visual encoders offer transferable representations, but conventional binary fine-tuning supervises their final decisions without explicitly constraining how local facial evidence is represented under partial observation. We present CP-JEPA, a context-predictive adaptation framework that combines low-rank tuning of a pretrained CLIP image encoder with a joint-embedding predictive objective. A student predicts complete-image teacher features at masked spatial locations, while unmasked classification, masked classification, and prediction consistency retain the connection to the live/spoof task. An exponential-moving-average teacher supplies evolving latent targets. The auxiliary components are used only during training; inference requires only the LoRA-adapted CLIP visual encoder and binary classifier. {We evaluate CP-JEPA under single-source and multi-source OCIM transfer, additional CelebA-Spoof training, transfer to CelebA-Spoof, two-source training, and unseen-attack evaluation on SiW-Mv2.} On the standard OCIM benchmark, CP-JEPA achieves 3.74\% mean HTER and 98.73\% mean AUC. {Single-source evaluation achieves 11.36\% mean HTER across twelve source--target combinations.} With CelebA-Spoof added to the three OCIM training sources, CP-JEPA reduces mean HTER from 3.45\% to 2.35\% and increases mean AUC from 98.68\% to 99.32\%. On SiW-Mv2, it achieves 3.36\% mean HTER across the held-out attack categories. Controlled loss ablations examine the contributions of latent prediction, masked classification, and prediction consistency. The results show that context-predictive adaptation can improve cross-dataset PAD performance, although the gains vary with the training sources and evaluation setting.

AI.tldr: 提出CP-JEPA：将CLIP图像编码器的LoRA低秩微调与联合嵌入预测目标结合，用掩码空间位置上的完整图像教师特征预测来约束局部人脸表征，实现跨数据集人脸呈现攻击检测（PAD）。
AI.motivation: 人脸PAD需要能跨采集设备、受试者和攻击介质区分物理欺骗线索的表征。大型视觉编码器具备可迁移性，但常规二分类微调只监督最终决策，未显式约束部分观测下局部人脸证据的表征方式。
AI.method: CP-JEPA框架：(1) 对预训练CLIP图像编码器做低秩（LoRA）调优；(2) 学生网络在掩码空间位置预测完整图像教师特征（联合嵌入预测目标）；(3) 结合未掩码分类、掩码分类与预测一致性三项损失保持与活体/攻击任务的联系；(4) 教师为指数滑动平均（EMA）更新以提供演化潜在目标；辅助组件仅用于训练，推理时仅需LoRA适配的CLIP视觉编码器与二分类器。并做了受控损失消融。
AI.result: OCIM基准：平均HTER 3.74%，平均AUC 98.73%。单源OCIM迁移：12个源-目标组合平均HTER 11.36%。三源OCIM加入CelebA-Spoof训练后，平均HTER由3.45%降至2.35%，平均AUC由98.68%升至99.32%。SiW-Mv2未见攻击类别上平均HTER 3.36%。
AI.conclusion: 上下文预测式适配可提升跨数据集PAD性能，但增益随训练源与评测设置而变化；消融表明潜在预测、掩码分类与预测一致性各有贡献。

title: JudgeMix: Judge-Guided Mixed-Rollout Data Synthesis for LLM Agents
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on expert trajectories is a standard paradigm for training LLM agents. However, it suffers from a well-known training-inference distribution mismatch, calling for target-aware data synthesis strategies that ground the training data in the target model's native state distribution. To bridge this gap, emerging approaches incorporate the expert either to guide mixed rollouts alongside the target model, or to provide dense step-wise supervision. Nonetheless, existing methods apply expert assistance blind to the target model's inherent behavior: they either disrupt the rollout using sub-optimal random intervention heuristics, or they enforce indiscriminate uniform supervision that unnecessarily overwrites the model's already-correct actions. We introduce JudgeMix, a judge-guided data synthesis framework that dynamically interleaves the target model and expert based on step-wise semantic evaluations. JudgeMix queries expert guidance precisely when the target model struggles, ensuring high trajectory success rates while keeping the state distribution aligned with the target model. It additionally uses the judge evaluation to reweight expert supervision on different steps, preserving model's inherent valid behavior while correcting its errors. On two agentic tool-use benchmarks, AppWorld and AutomationBench, JudgeMix demonstrates consistent superior performance to existing methods, with improvements up to 10 pass@1 points.

AI.tldr: 提出 JudgeMix——一种以评判器（judge）引导的数据合成框架，通过逐步语义评估动态地在目标模型与专家之间交替，实现目标感知的专家辅助数据合成。
AI.motivation: 对专家轨迹做监督微调（SFT）存在训练-推理分布不匹配问题，需要基于目标模型自身状态分布的数据合成。现有引入专家辅助的方法要么用次优的随机干预启发式破坏 rollout，要么施加无差别的统一监督、覆盖模型本已正确的动作，均未考虑目标模型的固有行为。
AI.method: JudgeMix 依据逐步语义评判结果：(1) 仅在目标模型表现吃力时调用专家引导，在保持高轨迹成功率的同时使状态分布与目标模型对齐；(2) 利用评判分数对不同步骤的专家监督进行重加权，保留模型固有有效行为、只纠正错误。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 与 AutomationBench 两个智能体工具使用基准上，JudgeMix 稳定优于现有方法，pass@1 提升最高达 10 个点。
AI.conclusion: 以评判驱动的自适应专家介入与监督重加权，可有效缓解 SFT 的分布不匹配，是构建目标感知智能体训练数据的有效范式。

title: Pl@ntNet machine-to-machine identification service with Pl@ntNet API: enabling automated biodiversity monitoring through large-scale plant identification
summary: 1. Monitoring plant biodiversity requires identifying large numbers of plants across space and time. Although artificial intelligence (AI) can now identify plant species from images with high accuracy, most existing systems rely on users manually submitting images. As ecological monitoring increasingly generates large image collections from cameras, drones, robots and online platforms, there is a growing need for plant identification services that can be directly integrated into automated data-processing workflows. 2. Here, we present Pl@ntNet's machine-to-machine AI plant identification service. This service uses an application programming interface (API) to provide programmatic access to Pl@ntNet's plant recognition models and the associated taxonomic processing. This service enables the implementation of automated identification workflows without human intervention and can thus directly link large image collections and automated observation systems to an AI-based plant identification system. 3. We establish that this service, which covers 85,000 species from around the world, (1) has a species prediction accuracy of 0.89, (2) process images up to 666 times faster than workflows requiring human intervention, (3) and has processed over 84 million identification requests since its launch, including more than 40 million in 2025 alone. We demonstrate how it has already enabled the implementation of a new generation of ecological workflows: identifying plants from images of insects to reconstruct the plant-pollinator interactions, analysing geolocated images from social media to study plant distribution, detecting invasive plants using images taken at the roadside, and identifying weeds using agricultural robots. Finally, we illustrate its application using a reproducible example: identifying plants from insect photos on iNaturalist. In approximately 30 min on a standard laptop, 2,424 images were processed to generate a dataset of 708 plant-pollinator interactions, with a weighted precision of 0.98 for flower detection and an accuracy of 0.88 for genus plant identification. 4. In conclusion, this machine-to-machine species identification is already operating on a considerable scale and meets a genuine need. All of this paves the way for a new paradigm in biodiversity monitoring, in which automated sensors and image collections can be directly connected to AI-based identification services.

AI.tldr: Pl@ntNet 推出机器对机器的 AI 植物识别服务（API），覆盖 8.5 万物种，物种预测准确率 0.89，处理速度比人工流程快最多 666 倍，上线以来已处理超 8400 万次识别请求，为生态监测的自动化工作流奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 植物多样性监测需在时空尺度上识别大量植物。现有 AI 识别系统虽精度高，但多依赖用户手动上传图像；而相机、无人机、机器人及网络平台正产生海量图像，亟需可直接嵌入自动化数据处理流程的识别服务。
AI.method: 提出 Pl@ntNet 的机器对机器 AI 植物识别服务：通过应用程序接口（API）以编程方式访问其植物识别模型及配套的分类学处理流程，实现无人干预的自动识别工作流，将大规模图像集合与自动化观测系统直接对接 AI 识别系统；并以 iNaturalist 昆虫照片识别植物为例提供可复现案例。
AI.result: 服务覆盖全球约 85,000 个物种；物种预测准确率 0.89；处理速度较需人工介入的流程最多快 666 倍；上线以来处理超 8,400 万次识别请求，其中 2025 年超 4,000 万次。应用案例包括：由昆虫图像重建植物—传粉者互作、分析社交媒体地理标记图像研究植物分布、利用路边图像检测入侵植物、借助农业机器人识别杂草。可复现示例中，普通笔记本约 30 分钟处理 2,424 张图像，得到包含 708 条植物—传粉者互作的数据集，花朵检测加权精确率 0.98，属级植物识别准确率 0.88。
AI.conclusion: 机器对机器的物种识别已在实际规模上运行并满足真实需求，为生物多样性监测开辟新范式：自动化传感器与图像集合可直接连接 AI 识别服务，实现端到端的自动化生态监测。

title: Same-State Pairs Make One JEPA Proof of the Platonic Representation Hypothesis Vacuous
summary: In a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), the JEPA proof of the Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) assumes that every observation determines the world state and that a spectral gap makes minimizers unique up to rotation. Under the hard-whitening population objective, same-state positive pairs make the induced world kernel the identity: every centered whitened state function is a global minimizer, and, when $d_z-1\ge 2k$, two minimizers can have best-rotation squared residual $2k$. The uniqueness claim is conditional; for $k<d_z-1$, where $d_z$ is the number of world states, this limit makes its premise unsatisfiable, so the claim has no content there. The experiments that motivate it leave the assumption: a caption sees only part of an image, and the paper states no experiment meets its hypotheses exactly. The theorem does not reach those experiments, and for $k<d_z-1$ its idealized same-state limit is vacuous. One of the paper's four quantitative results survives: a gap-free lower bound. Its bound vanishes only at perfect scene-explained fraction; it bounds alignment error but cannot certify good-view alignment. A canonical frame is determined only up to a rotation and a latent permutation. Paired samples fix the relative frame at effective rank $k$; a global rotation remains. Component semantics fix the relative permutation only up to signs; value anchors fix it once the mixing frame is pinned. A resource--gauge ledger records which resource fixes which gauge.

AI.tldr: 该文批评JEPA对Platonic Representation Hypothesis(PRH)的"证明":其唯一性主张依赖"观测决定世界状态"与谱隙两条假设,但硬白化总体目标下同状态正对使世界核成为恒等,当d_z-1≥2k时两个极小元的最佳旋转平方残差可达2k;唯一性仅在条件成立时有内容,而k<d_z-1时前提不可满足、结论空洞。四项定量结果仅剩一条无谱隙下界,且该下界只约束对齐误差、不能认证良好视角对齐。规范框架仅确定到旋转与潜变量置换,需由成对样本、分量语义与数值锚点逐层固定,故提出"资源—规范账本"。
AI.motivation: 检验JEPA框架下PRH"证明"的有效性:指出其假设(观测完全决定世界状态、谱隙保证唯一性至多差一个旋转)与实际实验(如caption仅见图像局部)不符,并厘清其定理能覆盖与不能覆盖的范围。
AI.method: 解析性/反例式分析:在硬白化总体目标下推导世界核为恒等、任意中心化白化状态函数均为全局极小,构造最佳旋转平方残差为2k的两个极小元;按k与d_z-1的关系划分定理前提是否可满足;逐一审查四项定量结果,识别仅存的无谱隙下界;用规范(gauge)分析刻画成对样本、分量语义、数值锚点分别固定相对框架、相对置换与混合框架的条件,并整理为资源—规范账本。
AI.result: (1)唯一性主张有条件,k<d_z-1时前提不可满足、结论空洞;(2)硬白化下同状态极限使问题退化,存在最佳旋转平方残差达2k的不同极小元;(3)论文所述实验无一严格满足假设(如caption只见部分图像),定理不适用于这些实验;(4)四项定量结果中仅一条无谱隙下界存活,其值仅在完美场景解释比例处消失,且只能约束对齐误差、无法认证良好视角对齐;(5)规范仅能确定到旋转与置换:成对样本固定相对框架(全局旋转仍存),分量语义仅固定置换至符号,数值锚点需在混合框架固定后才行。
AI.conclusion: JEPA对PRH的"证明"在k<d_z-1区域为空,且与 motivating 实验脱节;仅余的无谱隙下界不足以支撑对齐质量的认证。表示的可辨识性必须显式核算"哪种资源固定哪种规范",资源—规范账本为此提供了系统化的账目框架。

title: ActWorld-JEPA: Action-Conditioned JEPA World Models Meet Latent Planning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) enable future prediction in latent space without pixel reconstruction. However, latent predictive consistency alone does not establish the relative driving quality of candidate plans. We present ActWorld-JEPA, a joint-embedding formulation for candidate-based driving. Where Plan-Conditioned JEPA (PC-JEPA) uses global and step-wise trajectory intentions to guide recurrent latent prediction, then combines the predicted future with the current scene through gated cross-attention; Relational Residual Reranking ($R^3$) models agreement and discrepancy between plan and future representations under planning supervision, yielding bounded, gated residual corrections to the base planning scores. This formulation connects latent prediction to candidate selection using only observed context and proposed trajectories at inference. Benchmark-specific implementations report 94.1 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest, with the final selector calibrated using aggregate NAVTEST feedback, and 91.6 and 42.7 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest and navhard, respectively. The nuScenes evaluation reports a mean $L_2$ error of 1.20 m and a predicted collision rate of 0.76% over 1--6 s. This work provides an effective path from JEPA's predictive representations to driving decisions informed by anticipated consequences.

AI.tldr: 提出 ActWorld-JEPA：用 PC-JEPA 在潜空间做全局与逐步意图引导的预测，并用 R³ 在有监督下建模计划与未来表示的一致/差异，对基础规划分数做有界门控残差修正，实现从 JEPA 预测表示到候选轨迹选择的衔接；NAVSIM v1 navtest 94.1 PDMS，v2 navtest/navhard 91.6/42.7 EPDMS，nuScenes 1–6 s 平均 L2 1.20 m、碰撞率 0.76%。
AI.motivation: JEPA 能在潜空间预测未来而无需像素重建，但仅凭潜空间预测一致性无法判别候选规划的相对驾驶质量，缺少把预测表示与候选选择联系起来的机制。
AI.method: 面向候选式驾驶的联合嵌入公式：(1) Plan-Conditioned JEPA（PC-JEPA）以全局与逐步轨迹意图引导循环潜空间预测，再通过门控交叉注意力将预测未来与当前场景融合；(2) Relational Residual Reranking（R³）在规划监督下建模计划表示与未来表示之间的一致与差异，产生有界、门控的残差修正，作用于基础规划分数。推理时仅用观测上下文与候选轨迹。
AI.result: NAVSIM v1 navtest 达 94.1 PDMS（最终选择器用聚合 NAVTEST 反馈校准）；NAVSIM v2 navtest 91.6 EPDMS、navhard 42.7 EPDMS；nuScenes 1–6 s 平均 L2 误差 1.20 m、预测碰撞率 0.76%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出从 JEPA 预测表示通向后果感知驾驶决策的有效路径，说明潜空间预测可作为候选规划质量判定的有用信号。

title: Flow-CAD: Flow Matching for Contextual Anomaly Detection and Explanation in Tabular Data
summary: Contextual anomaly detection in tabular data aims to identify objects whose behavior is unexpected under their contextual conditions. In data-engineering pipelines, this task screens table rows whose measurements violate context-dependent integrity relationships. Most existing approaches rely on either shallow conditional models with limited distributional expressiveness or localized estimators that require per-context modeling, making it difficult to capture complex conditional relationships and scale to high-dimensional settings. We propose Flow-CAD, a new framework for contextual anomaly detection based on Flow Matching. Flow-CAD learns a single global and amortized conditional generative model that flexibly represents behavioral distributions conditioned on context, without assuming simple parametric forms or retraining local models. To enable robust and interpretable anomaly scoring, we introduce a scale-normalized and truncated residual energy derived from the learned conditional flow, which stabilizes anomaly scores, mitigates domination by extreme deviations, and supports feature-wise attribution. We further provide theoretical insights showing that the proposed residual-based anomaly score is stable under velocity estimation error, and that its Monte Carlo estimator satisfies concentration bounds. Experiments on 20 benchmark datasets with 13 competitors demonstrate that Flow-CAD has the best average rank for PR AUC, ROC AUC, and P@n, highlighting its effectiveness and practicality for contextual anomaly detection in tabular data. We provide the source code at https://github.com/ZhongLIFR/FlowCAD.

AI.tldr: Flow-CAD：基于 Flow Matching 的单一全局摊销条件生成模型用于表格上下文异常检测，配合尺度归一化截断残差能量评分，在20个数据集上取得最优平均排名。
AI.motivation: 表格数据上下文异常检测需识别在给定上下文条件下行为异常的表格行。现有方法存在两类局限：浅层条件模型分布表达能力不足；局部化估计器需逐上下文建模，难以刻画复杂条件依赖且难以扩展到高维场景。
AI.method: 提出 Flow-CAD 框架，利用 Flow Matching 学习单一全局、摊销的条件生成模型，灵活建模以上下文为条件的行为分布，无需简单参数假设或局部重训练；在此基础上定义尺度归一化与截断的残差能量作为异常分数，稳定评分、抑制极端偏差主导并支持特征级归因。
AI.result: 理论上证明该残差评分在速度估计误差下具有稳定性，且其蒙特卡洛估计满足集中界；在20个基准数据集、13个对比方法上，PR AUC、ROC AUC、P@n 三项指标平均排名最优。
AI.conclusion: Flow-CAD 以全局摊销条件建模兼顾表达力与可扩展性，归一化截断残差评分兼顾鲁棒性与可解释性，适用于表格数据的上下文异常检测，效果与实用性得到实验与理论支持。

title: Do the Details Help the Whole? One-Way Transfer from Person Actions to Group Intent in VLMs on JRDB-Social
summary: Social scene datasets label people at two levels: what each person is doing and what the group is there for. Training on both levels at once is often assumed to help each of them. We test this assumption for vision-language models (VLMs) on JRDB-Social, treating person actions as the details and group intent as the whole. We fine-tune Qwen3.5 4B under eight training arms with three seeds, repeat the core arms on Qwen3.5 9B and Qwen3-VL 4B, and judge every arm with a verdict rule fixed before testing. Writing each member's actions before the intent raises intent macro-F1 from 30.1 to 31.0, and writing the intent first reaches 31.2, while action F1 stays within 0.2 points of an action-only model. Under the selected recipe, no arm trained with intent improves actions. The gain requires correct, image-grounded actions: empty action lists or actions borrowed from another group with the same intent lower intent F1. Forced-prefix tests, occlusion, member masking, linear probes and component grafting show that the intent follows the written actions, relies more on people and partly resides in the vision tower. Supplying actions as input instead of as targets hurts both levels.

AI.tldr: 在JRDB-Social上检验"同时学习个体动作与群体意图可互促"的假设，发现只有"先写动作后写意图"或"先写意图"的生成式链式监督才提升意图宏F1，且动作水平不得下降；该增益依赖正确、图像对齐的动作。
AI.motivation: 社会场景数据集通常同时标注个体层（每个人在做什么）与群体层（群体为何在场）。直觉上联合训练两个层级应互相促进，但该假设在视觉语言模型上缺乏受控验证。作者以动作=细节、意图=整体，系统检验该假设是否成立。
AI.method: 在JRDB-Social上微调Qwen3.5 4B，设置8个训练臂、3个随机种子；核心臂在Qwen3.5 9B与Qwen3-VL 4B上复现。测试前固定判定规则（verdict rule）评估每个臂。辅助分析包括强制前缀测试、遮挡、成员掩码、线性探针与组件嫁接。
AI.result: 先写各成员动作再写意图使意图宏F1由30.1升至31.0，先写意图达31.2；动作F1与仅动作模型相差不超过0.2点。在选定配方下，含意图目标的训练臂均未提升动作性能。增益需正确且图像对齐的动作：空动作列表或借用同意图他组动作会降低意图F1。分析显示意图跟随所写动作、更依赖人物信息并部分存在于视觉塔中；把动作作为输入而非监督目标会同时损害两个层级。
AI.conclusion: "联合训练两层级互益"的假设不成立：意图监督不能提升动作，仅有条件地以生成式动作先行的方式小幅提升意图。有效增益依赖真实、图像接地的人体动作描述，动作应作为生成目标而非输入条件。差异虽小但由预注册判定规则与多种子、多模型复现支持。

title: When can an interpretability claim be trusted? Stability and certification of feature dimensionality, ridge leverage and the feature recovery rate
comment: 70 pages. Also archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23842568. The AI use statement is in the paper
summary: Interpretability tools increasingly support safety claims, such as that a sparse dictionary has recovered most of a model's features. Such claims rest on measurements with arbitrary thresholds, and small changes to the model weights, a different training seed or a different threshold can reverse them. We study two widely used measurements in toy models and synthetic dictionaries with known ground truth: the feature dimensionality of Elhage et al. and the feature recovery rate (FRR) with a cosine threshold. We characterize exactly where feature dimensionality is discontinuous and replace it with a regularized (ridge) version with sharp stability bounds: the ridge leverage score changes by at most $3\sqrt{3}/(8\sqrtλ)$ times the operator-norm change of the weights, and this constant cannot be improved; for the regularized dimensionality the stability constant grows like $ρ/4$ in the scale $ρ=R/\sqrtλ$, with explicit upper and lower bounds. We also prove certificates stating when a claim "feature $i$ is recovered" must survive a given change of the dictionary. The certificates held in every test and are informative for small perturbations, but certify no feature non-trivially across independently trained dictionaries; at the standard threshold, whether a feature counts as recovered changed with the training seed for 55 percent of features. Experiments use toy models only. The proofs, code and text were drafted by AI agents directed by the authors and checked by an independent blind AI reviewer and by numerical tests; the authors take full responsibility for the content.

AI.tldr: 该文在已知真值的玩具模型与合成字典上分析两类可解释性度量——Elhage 等人的特征维数与基于余弦阈值的特征恢复率（FRR），揭示其对阈值和扰动的不稳定性，提出带显式稳定性界的岭正则化替代，并给出"特征 i 已被恢复"声明的稳健性证书。
AI.motivation: 可解释性工具日益被用于支撑安全论断（如稀疏字典已恢复模型的大部分特征），但这类论断依赖带任意阈值的测量；模型权重的微小变动、训练种子或阈值的变化都可能使其反转。作者希望刻画这类度量在何处不连续，并为相关声明提供可证明的稳定性保障。
AI.method: 在玩具模型与合成字典（真值已知）上研究特征维数与带余弦阈值的 FRR；精确刻画特征维数的不连续点，并以岭（ridge）正则化版本替换；推导稳定性界（岭杠杆得分变化 ≤ 3√3/(8√λ) 乘以权重算子范数变化，且该常数不可改进；正则化维数的稳定性常数在尺度 ρ=R/√λ 下按 ρ/4 增长，给出显式上下界）；同时证明形如"特征 i 被恢复"的声明在字典发生给定变化时仍成立的证书，并用数值测试与独立盲审验证。
AI.result: 特征维数的不连续位置被精确刻画；岭杠杆得分的稳定性常数 3√3/(8√λ) 已达到最优，正则化维数对应常数随 ρ/√… 呈 ρ/4 量级增长并有明确上下界；证书在全部测试中成立且对小扰动具有信息量，但对独立训练的字典无法非平凡地证明任何特征未被恢复；在标准阈值下，55% 的特征是否被视为已恢复会随训练种子改变。
AI.conclusion: 基于任意阈值的可解释性度量不具有稳健性，不宜直接支撑安全论断；岭正则化版本提供了可证明、常数最优的稳定性保证，而"特征已恢复"类的证书实际适用范围有限，且实验仅限玩具模型。

title: ReFineR: Single image to dense point cloud registration at pixel level with point splatting
summary: Cameras and LiDARs (Light Detection and Ranging) provide complementary observations of the same scene: cameras capture rich appearance cues while LiDAR sensors provide accurate geometric measurements. In this work, we address the problem of fine image-to-point cloud registration from a single image and a roughly estimated camera pose. On robotic platforms, residual reprojection errors of several pixels are commonly observed even after calibration due to temporal desynchronization, mechanical vibrations, or inaccuracies in point cloud reconstruction. Such errors can lead to decimeter-level geometric discrepancies at moderate distances and significantly affect multiple downstream tasks, such as dense cross-modal supervision, texture mapping, and semantic label transfer. To address this challenge, we introduce ReFineR: an offline framework to finely register individual images to pre-reconstructed point clouds. ReFineR builds upon differentiable point splatting rasterization and a smooth Gradient Orientation Measure (GOM) to iteratively refine the camera pose through analysis-by-synthesis optimization. We evaluated the method on a curated dataset of manually calibrated images collected from heterogeneous data sources. Furthermore, we show that an automatic point cloud rescale factor can be estimated prior to optimization, enabling robust refinement across a wide range of scenarios using a single scale-invariant formulation. The project page can be found at https://refiner-project.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出 ReFineR：基于可微点泼溅光栅化与平滑梯度方向测度（GOM）的离线分析-合成优化框架，将单张图像与其粗略位姿精细配准到预先重建的点云上，并可在优化前自动估计点云尺度因子以实现尺度不变的鲁棒精化。
AI.motivation: 相机与LiDAR观测互补，但在机器人平台上，即使经过标定，仍会因时间不同步、机械振动或点云重建误差而残余数像素的投影误差；在中等距离处可造成分米级几何偏差，严重影响跨模态稠密监督、纹理映射与语义标签迁移等下游任务。
AI.method: 构建离线精配准框架：以可微点泼溅（differentiable point splatting）光栅化为核心，配合平滑的梯度方向测度（Gradient Orientation Measure, GOM）作为跨模态相似性度量，通过分析-合成（analysis-by-synthesis）迭代优化相机位姿；并在优化前自动估计点云重缩放因子，形成单一尺度不变的目标函数。
AI.result: 在由异源数据构建、经人工标定核验的图像数据集上完成评测，验证了方法的有效性；同时表明自动估计的重缩放因子可使同一尺度不变公式在广泛场景下保持稳健的精化效果。
AI.conclusion: ReFineR 能够以单一尺度不变公式稳定地精化单幅图像相对预重建点云的位姿，适用于异源点云与多类场景，为跨模态稠密监督、纹理映射和语义标签迁移等下游任务提供更精确的几何对齐。

title: An Extensive Evaluation of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Approaches for Sentiment Analysis: Insights from Amazon Customer Reviews
summary: The rapid growth of user-generated text on online platforms creates opportunities for understanding customer opinion and supporting data-driven decisions. This study compares five traditional machine learning classifiers (Random Forest, Logistic Regression, Bernoulli Naive Bayes, Linear Support Vector Classifier, and Multinomial Naive Bayes) and six deep learning architectures (LSTM, Bi-LSTM, GRU, RNN, Attention, and FastText) for three-class sentiment classification of 568,454 Amazon Fine Food Reviews. Machine learning models used Bag-of-Words (BoW) and TF-IDF features limited to 5,000 terms; deep learning models used learned embeddings over a 20,000-word vocabulary. Models were evaluated on the original imbalanced data and on a random-oversampled balanced set of 1,070,469 reviews, using accuracy, macro and per-class precision, recall, and F1-score, and training time. On the balanced set, Random Forest with BoW achieved 99\% accuracy and the Attention model achieved 98.7\%. Linear SVC reached 89\% accuracy in 1 min 15 s, and Logistic Regression reached 90\% in 3 min 37 s. On the imbalanced set, the Attention model achieved 97.8\% accuracy, and FastText achieved 95.3\% in 3 min 26 s, while the RNN reached 91.9\% with a neutral-class F1-score of 0.08. Deep learning models were more stable across class distributions, whereas the best classical model depended on balancing. We also report a user-facing application that applies the trained Random Forest and Attention models to new review text. Because the labels are derived from star ratings, the results measure agreement with rating-derived sentiment classes rather than annotated sentiment; the dataset is a single source, and the findings should be read with that limitation in mind.

AI.tldr: 该研究在568,454条Amazon Fine Food Reviews上进行三分类情感分类，比较5种传统机器学习与6种深度学习模型，在原始不平衡集与随机过采样平衡集（1,070,469条）上评估精度、宏/每类P-R-F1及训练时间，并给出一个面向用户的应用演示。
AI.motivation: 在线平台用户生成文本快速增长，为理解客户意见与支持数据驱动决策提供机会；需要系统比较传统机器学习与深度学习在情感分类上的性能、稳定性与效率，为模型选型提供依据。
AI.method: 数据为Amazon Fine Food Reviews（568,454条），三分类情感任务。传统模型（Random Forest、Logistic Regression、Bernoulli NB、Linear SVC、Multinomial NB）使用BoW与TF-IDF特征，词表限5,000；深度学习模型（LSTM、Bi-LSTM、GRU、RNN、Attention、FastText）使用20,000词表的学习型嵌入。在原始不平衡集与随机过采样平衡集（1,070,469条）上，以accuracy、宏平均与每类precision/recall/F1及训练时间评估。
AI.result: 平衡集上：Random Forest+BoW达99%准确率，Attention达98.7%；Linear SVC以1分15秒达89%，Logistic Regression以3分37秒达90%。不平衡集上：Attention达97.8%，FastText以3分26秒达95.3%，RNN为91.9%但中性类F1仅0.08。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习模型跨类别分布更稳定，而最佳传统模型依赖是否做平衡处理；作者同时给出将Random Forest与Attention模型应用于新评论文本的用户端应用。局限在于标签由星级评分推导，结果衡量的是与评分派生情感类别的一致性而非人工标注情感，且数据来源单一。

title: Towards Democratising Low-Data Medical Image Classification: CPU-Trainable ZACH-ViT and Its Geometric Variants
summary: Medical image classification in resource-constrained settings must contend with limited annotations and computational capacity. We evaluate four ZACH-ViT variants with linear, Euclidean prototype, Poincare and spherical heads alongside two compact multiple-instance-learning baselines. All models are trained from scratch with fewer than 260,000 parameters across seven MedMNIST+ datasets and three external benchmarks (PCam, ISIC2017 and Shenzhen tuberculosis radiographs). The low-data protocol uses 50 training images per class and five seeds, with validation-selected checkpoints at 23 and 47 epochs; a full-data reference uses one seed. Compact-TransMIL achieves the highest ten-dataset mean test Macro-F1 at 23 epochs (53.34%) and with full data (73.93%). At 47 epochs, ZACH-Linear narrowly leads (57.76% versus 57.54% for Compact-TransMIL). Extending training improves Macro-F1 in 239 of 300 paired comparisons. On ISIC2017, hZACH-Spherical has the highest 47-epoch low-data Macro-F1 (44.09% with SD 4.09%), whereas ZACH-EuclideanProto leads with full data (51.27%). We additionally conduct 40 CPU-only training runs on ISIC2017 and Shenzhen using four CPU threads; model-only single-image inference requires approximately 4-9 ms, while image decoding and preprocessing substantially increase end-to-end latency. The results demonstrate the feasibility of CPU-only training on the tested platform and the task- and regime-dependence of compact medical imaging under strict resource constraints.

AI.tldr: 在严格资源约束下，以少于26万参数的紧凑模型（ZACH-ViT四种头变体与两种MIL基线）从零训练，系统评测其在7个MedMNIST+数据集与3个外部基准上的少数据与全数据表现，并验证纯CPU训练与推理的可行性。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分类在资源受限场景中同时面临标注稀缺与算力不足的双重约束，缺乏对"极紧凑模型+低数据+CPU-only"这一组合的系统评测。
AI.method: 评测4种ZACH-ViT变体（线性头、欧氏原型头、Poincaré双曲头、球面头）与2种紧凑多示例学习（MIL）基线；全部模型参数量<260k、从头训练。少数据协议：每类50张训练图、5个随机种子、按验证集选checkpoint（23与47 epoch）；全数据协议：单种子。数据集为7个MedMNIST+与PCam、ISIC2017、深圳结核胸片三个外部基准。另在ISIC2017与深圳数据上用4线程做40次纯CPU训练，并测量单图推理延迟。
AI.result: 23 epoch时Compact-TransMIL的十数据集平均测试Macro-F1最高（53.34%），全数据下亦最高（73.93%）；47 epoch时ZACH-Linear以57.76%略优于Compact-TransMIL的57.54%。300组配对比较中239组显示延长训练提升Macro-F1。ISIC2017少数据47 epoch以hZACH-Spherical最佳（44.09%，SD 4.09%），全数据以ZACH-EuclideanProto最佳（51.27%）。CPU-only训练可行，模型单图推理约4–9 ms，但图像解码与预处理显著抬高端到端延迟。
AI.conclusion: 在测试平台上纯CPU训练紧凑医学图像模型是可行的；极紧凑模型的表现高度依赖具体任务与数据/训练体制，不存在普适最优结构，需按任务与资源预算选择配置。

title: Optimal feature selection for firewall log analysis using Machine learning and Hybrid Metaheuristic algorithms
comment: 13 pages. Revised version of engrXiv preprint (doi:10.31224/osf.io/pm3hy) with a corrected, leakage-free evaluation protocol; original results retained for reference
summary: Firewall log classification is important to monitor network traffic. Machine learning classifiers using network-related features have shown good results for this task, but high-dimensional features slow down classification. In this paper, we apply feature selection using bee swarm optimization with Q-learning-based local search (QBSO-FS) to the UCI Internet Firewall Data Set, together with random forest (RF), k-nearest neighbor (KNN), and Bernoulli naïve Bayes (Bernoulli NB) classifiers. The first version of this preprint selected and evaluated feature subsets on the same 5-fold cross-validation of the full data set, which contains 12.8\% exact duplicates; the reported scores are therefore optimistically biased. In this extended version, we re-evaluate the method with a leakage-free protocol: the data are split into training, validation, and test sets, features are selected using the validation set only, and accuracy and macro-averaged scores are measured once on the untouched test set, for both the raw data and a deduplicated, preprocessed version. On a single stratified split, QBSO-FS selects 5--7 features. The selected subsets clearly improve Macro-F1 over all features for KNN on both data sets and for RF on the deduplicated data (by 8--19 percentage points). For RF on the raw data and for Bernoulli NB, the differences (0.2--1.5 percentage points) may not hold for a different split. RF with 7 selected features reaches 99.90\% accuracy and 94.88\% Macro-F1 on the deduplicated data. On the same split, this exceeds our re-implementations of the deep neural network configurations of previous studies and the feature subset selected by particle swarm optimization in one of them, while the run time saved on this low-dimensional data set is small. These results suggest that the method can support automatic firewall log analysis, while evaluation over multiple splits remains future work.

AI.tldr: 该文将Q学习引导局部搜索的蜂群优化特征选择（QBSO-FS）用于UCI Internet Firewall数据集，并发现原预印本因12.8%重复样本导致评估偏乐观；扩展版采用无泄漏的三分划协议重新评估，QBSO-FS选出5–7个特征，在去重数据上RF达99.90%准确率与94.88% Macro-F1，优于DNN复现与PSO子集，但运行时间收益有限，多划分验证仍待完成。
AI.motivation: 防火墙日志分类对网络流量监控很重要，机器学习分类器效果良好，但高维特征拖慢分类速度，因此需要高效的特征选择。同时，原预印本在全数据集的同一5折交叉验证上做特征选择与评估，数据含12.8%完全重复样本，导致报告分数存在乐观偏差，需要无泄漏协议重新验证。
AI.method: 采用Q学习引导局部搜索的蜂群优化特征选择（QBSO-FS）对UCI Internet Firewall Data Set降维，搭配随机森林（RF）、K近邻（KNN）与伯努利朴素贝叶斯（Bernoulli NB）分类器。扩展版将数据划分为训练、验证、测试集，仅用验证集做特征选择，在未触碰的测试集上一次性计算准确率与宏平均指标；分别对原始数据和去重预处理数据评估，并进行单次分层划分实验。
AI.result: QBSO-FS选出5–7个特征。所选子集在KNN（两个数据集）和去重数据上的RF上使Macro-F1较全特征提升8–19个百分点；对原始数据的RF与Bernoulli NB提升仅0.2–1.5个百分点，可能不具跨划分稳健性。去重数据上RF用7个特征达99.90%准确率和94.88% Macro-F1，同划分下超过复现的既往DNN配置及其中一项研究的PSO特征子集，但该低维数据上节省的运行时间较小。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可支撑防火墙日志的自动分析，且无泄漏评估揭示了原评估的乐观偏差；但由于结果仅基于单次分层划分，跨多个划分的稳健性评估仍为后续工作。

title: Improved CNN-Transformer Network for Neutron Image Super-Resolution
summary: The spatial resolution of neutron images is of great importance for material defect diagnosis, structural characterization, and nondestructive testing. However, owing to limitations in neutron beam quality, scintillator conversion efficiency and light scattering, detector pixel size, and noise levels, conventional neutron images often suffer from speckle noise, blurred edges, and missing details, making them inadequate for high-precision analysis. To address these issues, an improved super-resolution model combining convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and Transformers is proposed. First, to overcome the difficulty of obtaining high-quality and clear training images for neutron imaging, a pretrained image restoration model is fine-tuned using real neutron images and then employed to enhance existing neutron images, thereby providing high-quality reference images for subsequent super-resolution model training. Second, an improved CRAFT-based super-resolution network is developed by incorporating a hybrid prior-guided channel fusion module (HPCF), a mean-standard deviation dual-statistics squeeze-and-excitation block (MS-SEBlock), and a partial convolution feed-forward network (PCFN), with the aim of improving the reconstruction of important information, such as textures and fine details, in neutron images. Simulation results demonstrate that, compared with bicubic interpolation, SRCNN, SRGAN-VGG, and other methods, the proposed network achieves superior performance in both full-reference metrics, including PSNR and SSIM, and no-reference metrics, including AGM and SMD. The visual quality and structural fidelity of the reconstructed images are also significantly improved. This study provides a new approach to improving neutron image quality.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合CNN与Transformer的改进超分辨率模型，并引入预训练图像复原模型微调生成高质量参考图像，以提升中子图像的空间分辨率与细节保真度。
AI.motivation: 中子图像空间分辨率对缺陷诊断、结构表征与无损检测至关重要，但受中子束质量、闪烁体转换效率、光散射、探测器像元尺寸及噪声限制，常规中子图像存在散斑噪声、边缘模糊与细节缺失，难以满足高精度分析需求。
AI.method: 先对预训练图像复原模型用真实中子图像微调，用于增强现有中子图像以构建高质量参考图像；再改进CRAFT超分网络，引入混合先验引导通道融合模块（HPCF）、均值-标准差双统计SE模块（MS-SEBlock）与部分卷积前馈网络（PCFN），强化纹理与细节重建。
AI.result: 仿真显示，在PSNR、SSIM等全参考指标及AGM、SMD等无参考指标上均优于双三次插值、SRCNN、SRGAN-VGG等方法，重建图像视觉质量与结构保真度显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为中子图像质量提升提供了一种新途径。

title: Few-Shot Cross-Subject Neural--Image Retrieval via Stimulus-Anchored Latent Bias Calibration
summary: In cross-subject neural--image retrieval, comparing the mean of a few stimulus-matched target observations with the global source mean conflates subject-specific representation shifts with stimulus-composition effects. To address this problem, we propose Stimulus-Anchored Latent Bias Calibration (SA-LBC), which estimates the first-order shift under fixed preprocessing and a frozen source-trained representation by averaging residuals between target responses and same-stimulus source-population anchors, then shrinks the correction using source-derived uncertainty. Under uniform sampling without replacement from a finite stimulus population, we derive exact finite-population MSE expressions for the unshrunk anchored and global-mean estimators, including residual--anchor cross-covariance, and establish a necessary and sufficient condition for anchoring to reduce MSE relative to global-mean estimation. In a 10-subject leave-one-subject-out evaluation on THINGS-EEG2, SA-LBC increases mean reciprocal rank (MRR) for the Attention--CLIP ViT-B/32 configuration from 0.1867 without calibration to 0.2013 and 0.2336 with M=2 and M=16 stimulus-level calibration samples, respectively. Across six neural--visual configurations and all calibration budgets, stimulus-matched anchors yield higher MRR than anchors with shuffled stimulus identities, but retrieval gains over no calibration remain representation-dependent. At (M=2), shrinkage improves MRR over the unshrunk anchored estimator in all six configurations, but its effects at larger budgets vary across representations; the relative ranking of translation and orientation corrections also depends on regularization strength. Thus, lower shift-estimation MSE does not guarantee higher retrieval performance. The source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/Xizhang-Yao/SA-LBC.

AI.tldr: 提出刺激锚定潜在偏差校准（SA-LBC），用同刺激源群体锚点估计跨被试一阶表征偏移，并给出有限总体MSE理论条件，在THINGS-EEG2上验证检索增益依赖表征。
AI.motivation: 跨被试神经—图像检索中，用少量刺激匹配目标观测的均值与源全局均值比较，会把被试特异的表征偏移与刺激构成效应混为一谈，导致偏差估计不准确。
AI.method: SA-LBC在固定预处理与冻结源训练表征下，以目标响应与同刺激源群体锚点之差的残差均值估计一阶偏移，并用源域导出的不确定性对校正量做收缩；在有限刺激总体无放回均匀采样假设下，推导未收缩锚定估计与全局均值估计的精确有限总体MSE（含残差—锚点交叉协方差），给出锚定优于全局均值MSE的充要条件。
AI.result: THINGS-EEG2十被试留一被试评估：Attention–CLIP ViT-B/32 的MRR从无校准0.1867提升至M=2时0.2013、M=16时0.2336；六个神经—视觉配置、各校准预算下，刺激匹配锚点均优于打乱刺激身份的锚点，但相对无校准的增益依表征而定；M=2时收缩在所有配置均提升MRR，较大预算下效果因表征而异，平移与方向校正的相对排序受正则强度影响。
AI.conclusion: 刺激锚定可有效剥离刺激构成效应，但更低的偏移估计MSE并不保证更高检索性能，需结合表征与校正策略协同设计。

title: When Chekhov's Gun Fires Anyway: Over-Realization in Text-to-Image Models
summary: In text-to-image generation, a target that the prompt mentions often appears in the generated image in a way the prompt does not call for. We call this failure over-realization. Mental-spaces theory points to the situations where it can happen: under a negation, inside what a character believes or imagines, as the vehicle of a figurative comparison, or behind a viewpoint that hides the target. Prior work has studied only negation in depth, and the conventional alignment and preference metrics do not penalize the failure. We build OverReal to measure it: OverReal-Gen, 698 prompts covering the four situations, on which we measure each generator's over-realization rate; and OverReal-Det, 2,841 generated images human-labeled for whether and how the target is over-realized, on which we verify the automatic judge that produces this rate. Our evaluation of eight text-to-image systems reveals that all of them over-realize, and that conventional metrics such as CLIPScore reward the failure rather than penalize it. Prompt expansion only partly mitigates the failure. Inside the generator, the diffusion backbone attends to a mentioned target almost as much as to a requested one. The cue words that should hold the target back receive less attention than ordinary words.

AI.tldr: 提出"过度实现"(over-realization)失败模式：提示中提及但未被要求出现的目标仍被生成。构建OverReal基准(OverReal-Gen 698条提示 / OverReal-Det 2,841张人工标注图像)，评测8个T2I系统发现普遍存在该问题，且CLIPScore等传统指标反而奖励该失败；扩散骨干对"被提及目标"的注意力接近"被请求目标"，而本应抑制该目标的线索词注意力低于普通词。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I研究仅深入研究了否定场景，而心理空间理论指出的其他情形(角色信念/想象、比喻载体、遮蔽性视角)未被覆盖；同时传统对齐与偏好指标无法惩罚这一失败，导致问题被掩盖。
AI.method: 基于心理空间理论界定四类触发情境(否定、信念/想象、比喻比较载体、遮蔽性视角)；构建OverReal-Gen(698条提示)用于测量各生成器的过度实现率，以及OverReal-Det(2,841张图像、人工标注是否及如何被过度实现)用于验证自动判别器；对8个T2I系统进行评测，并分析提示扩写的作用与扩散骨干的注意力分布。
AI.result: 全部8个T2I系统均出现过度实现；CLIPScore等常规指标对该失败给予正向奖励；提示扩写只能部分缓解；生成器内部扩散骨干对被提及目标的注意力几乎等同被请求目标，而抑制性线索词的注意力低于普通词。
AI.conclusion: 过度实现是T2I中系统性且被现有指标掩盖的失败模式，需专门基准(OverReal)度量；其根源在于注意力层面无法区分"提及"与"请求"，提示扩写与常规指标均不足，需在机制层面改进。

title: Rectified Looped Transformer
summary: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared block, offering a parameter-efficient approach to language modeling. However, most existing works directly reuse each loop's output as the next's input, which can lead to hidden-state scale growth and perturbation amplification as recurrence deepens. We propose Rectified Looped Transformer (RLT), which redesigns feedback between loops using an interpolation schedule inspired by flow-based modeling. At each loop, RLT forms the next input by linearly interpolating between the current state and its prediction. Such interpolation distributes state changes across loops, encouraging a smoother trajectory from the initial input to the final output. Theoretical analysis proves that, under appropriate assumptions, RLT keeps state magnitudes uniformly bounded across loops and reduces the worst-case perturbation amplification. We evaluate RLT on language modeling corpora and downstream benchmarks. At matched training and inference depths, RLT consistently achieves lower perplexity than a standard looped Transformer, while exhibiting greater robustness to input perturbations and variance in inference depth. Consistent with the theoretical results, latent trajectory analysis shows that RLT maintains more stable hidden-state norms across loops, which also facilitates extrapolation-based decoding strategies. Notably, RLT achieves these gains without requiring additional trainable parameters or extra recurrent block evaluations, thus providing a simple yet more stable feedback mechanism for looped Transformers.

AI.tldr: 提出Rectified Looped Transformer（RLT），用受flow建模启发的线性插值反馈机制替代直接回传，稳定循环Transformer的隐状态尺度与扰动传播，在不增加参数和循环块前向次数的前提下提升困惑度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有循环（looped）Transformer通过反复复用共享块来提升有效深度，参数效率高；但多数工作直接把每轮的输出当作下一轮输入，随递归加深会导致隐状态尺度增长（scale growth）和扰动放大（perturbation amplification），训练与推理不稳定。
AI.method: RLT重新设计循环间反馈：每轮将当前状态与其预测做线性插值，作为下一轮输入（插值调度受flow-based modeling启发），使状态变化分摊到各循环，形成从初始输入到最终输出的更平滑轨迹。理论分析证明在合理假设下RLT使跨循环状态幅值一致有界，并降低最坏情况下的扰动放大。方法不引入额外可训练参数，也不增加额外循环块评估。
AI.result: 在语言建模语料与下游基准上，训练与推理深度匹配时RLT的困惑度持续低于标准looped Transformer；对输入扰动与推理深度变化更鲁棒；隐轨迹分析显示跨循环隐状态范数更稳定，并有利于基于外推的解码策略。
AI.conclusion: 线性插值反馈为循环Transformer提供了一种简单且更稳定的反馈机制，在不增加参数量与计算开销的情况下同时改善性能、鲁棒性与深度外推能力。

title: Learning the Missing Derivative: Neural Multiple-Scattering Operators for Inverse Volume Rendering
summary: Reconstructing optically thick media from photographs requires modeling multiple scattering and its response to changes in extinction. Frozen-source tomography discards this derivative; differentiable path tracing estimates it through expensive, noisy sampling. We instead predict the multiple-scattering field with a neural operator and differentiate through it during inverse rendering, while computing transmittance and single scattering directly. A further challenge arises during optimization: an operator that predicts the field accurately on held-out media can still produce poor derivatives at the density states visited by the optimizer. We address this by fine-tuning on states generated during inversions driven by the operator, using Monte Carlo scattering-field supervision. On held-out optically thick clouds, our method improves relighting over frozen-source tomography at equal time and outperforms differentiable path tracing given substantially more time. Training on inversion trajectories also improves derivative alignment at visited states and reduces optimization drift.

AI.tldr: 提出用神经算子预测多次散射场并在其内部求导进行逆渲染，通过“反演轨迹微调”改善导数质量，在光学厚云重建与重光照上优于冻结源层析和可微路径追踪。
AI.motivation: 从照片重建光学厚介质需建模多次散射及其对消光系数变化的导数。冻结源层析丢弃该导数；可微路径追踪虽能估计但采样昂贵且噪声大，难以支撑稳定优化。
AI.method: 以神经算子直接预测多次散射场，并在逆渲染中对算子反向传播求导；透射率与单次散射仍解析/直接计算。针对“预测场准确但导数在优化器所访问密度状态下失真”的问题，用算子驱动的反演过程中产生的中间状态进行微调，并以蒙特卡洛散射场作为监督信号。
AI.result: 在留出的光学厚云数据上，等时间预算下重光照质量优于冻结源层析；在显著更多时间下优于可微路径追踪；按反演轨迹训练还提升了访问状态处的导数对齐度并减小优化漂移。
AI.conclusion: 将多次散射建模为可微神经算子，并针对优化器访问的密度分布进行导数对齐微调，是替代冻结源层析与可微路径追踪的高效、稳定逆渲染方案。

title: LoCoJAX: Host-Local Coordination for Small-Model RL on TPUs
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly targets small language models, and executing these workloads efficiently across multiple accelerators requires effective coordination. On TPUs, Pathways-based RL uses a single controller to coordinate computation across hosts. This execution model is effective for large models, but its coordination computational costs are harder to amortize when small models repeatedly invoke short computations. To characterize these computational costs, we sweep dense models from 0.6B to 405B parameters on TPU v7x under a decode-heavy workload and measure how host and network computational overhead vary with model size. At 0.6B, host orchestration occupies 36% of step time and network communication 2%, whereas for large models, estimated network computational costs dominate the non-compute time. Motivated by these findings, we present Local Coordination JAX (LoCoJAX), which implements local rollout and reward processing on each TPU host with synchronous global training. In controlled comparisons against a tuned and optimized Pathways baseline on Qwen3-0.6B across three workloads and 8-64 TPU v7x chips, its colocated mode (LoCoJAX-CO) is 1.3-3.6x faster per step; on GSM8K, it completes a step faster on 8 chips than Pathways does on 64. Finally, a Ray-managed disaggregated mode (LoCoJAX-DA) overlaps rollout and training on separate hosts, and placement experiments establish when this overlap compensates for dividing devices and transferring weights: only when rollout dominates the step and receives most of the hosts. On NuminaMath-CoT at 256 chips, giving rollout 75% of hosts cuts step time by about 15% compared with LoCoJAX-CO.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对小语言模型RL在TPU上的协调开销问题，提出LoCoJAX：将rollout与奖励处理本地化到各TPU主机，同时保留同步全局训练，在colocated模式下比Pathways快1.3–3.6x，并给出disaggregated模式何时能通过重叠rollout与训练获益的判据。
AI.motivation: 强化学习日益面向小语言模型，但Pathways采用单一控制器跨主机协调计算。该模型对大规模模型有效，然而小模型反复触发短计算时，协调开销难以摊薄，因此需要量化主机与网络开销随模型规模的变化规律。
AI.method: 在TPU v7x上对0.6B至405B参数的dense模型，以decode-heavy负载进行扫描，测量host编排与网络通信开销占比；基于测量结果提出LoCoJAX，在每个TPU主机上本地执行rollout与奖励处理、全局训练保持同步。并在Qwen3-0.6B、三种负载、8–64芯片上，与调优后的Pathways基线做受控对比；另实现Ray管理的disaggregated模式（LoCoJAX-DA），通过放置实验研究rollout/训练重叠的适用条件。
AI.result: 0.6B时host编排占step时间36%、网络通信占2%；大模型时估计网络开销主导非计算时间。LoCoJAX-CO每步快1.3–3.6x；GSM8K上8芯片完成一步快于Pathways的64芯片。NuminaMath-CoT、256芯片下，将75%主机分配给rollout，step时间比LoCoJAX-CO降低约15%。
AI.conclusion: 小模型RL的瓶颈在于主机端协调开销，本地化协调可显著提速；disaggregated重叠仅在rollout主导step且获得多数主机时才划算，否则划分设备与传输权重的代价超过收益。

title: MuViRL: Multimodal View-Invariant Visual Speech Representation Learning via Calibrated View Aggregation
summary: Multimodal representation learning combines complementary signals to capture shared semantic information. For dynamic scenes, these representations need to remain consistent across views while preserving distinctions between temporal states. In visual speech representation learning, view variation changes the visibility and reliability of articulation cues, making it difficult to learn such representations from synchronized audio and video. To address this challenge, we propose MuViRL, a self-supervised framework for multimodal view-invariant visual speech representation learning via calibrated view aggregation. The framework combines synchronized 3D Gaussian view synthesis with multimodal self-supervision to learn consistent representations from real and synthesized data. A multimodal decision model learns relative view utility from teacher prediction losses, and its calibrated scores guide the aggregation of complementary information. Aggregation-to-Single Distillation transfers the aggregated predictions to a single branch. Real-synthetic alignment matches synchronized windows across views while preserving their temporal relations. Experiments on real and synthesized multiview data demonstrate that MuViRL improves multimodal representation consistency and visual speech recognition performance across views.

AI.tldr: 提出MuViRL自监督框架，用3D高斯视图合成与多模态自监督学习视图无关的视觉语音表示，并通过校准的视图效用分数进行视图聚合。
AI.motivation: 动态场景的多模态表示需跨视图一致、又保留时间状态差异；视觉语音中视图变化会改变发音线索的可见性与可靠性，使同步音视频下的表示学习困难。
AI.method: 同步3D高斯视图合成+多模态自监督；多模态决策模型从教师预测损失学习相对视图效用并输出校准分数以指导互补信息聚合；聚合到单支蒸馏（Aggregation-to-Single Distillation）；真实-合成对齐在跨视图匹配同步窗口并保留时间关系。
AI.result: 在真实与合成多视图数据上，MuViRL提升了多模态表示一致性以及各视图下的视觉语音识别性能。
AI.conclusion: 以视图效用校准驱动聚合、结合合成视图增广与蒸馏，可有效缓解视图差异带来的线索可靠性波动，获得视图无关的视觉语音表示。

title: StateAlign: Internalizing State-Aware Decision-Making for Reliable Multi-Turn Tool Agents via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning has improved the tool-use capabilities of large language models. However, better task performance can coincide with increased tool hallucination. Reliable tool use requires decisions to follow the current task state: available information, tool capabilities, and task progress. Our analysis shows that agents sometimes execute when they should ask for information, retrieve it, or decline an infeasible request, even when reasoning identifies missing information. We introduce StateAlign, combining task-state construction with state-contrastive reinforcement learning. The data cover five task conditions and pair states with different action requirements. Outcome rewards guide task completion; token-level contrasts compare the same generated reasoning and actions under paired states to train outputs that fit the current state. Experiments across five base models from three families show improvements on BFCL v4 multi-turn, ToolSandbox, and When2Call. Ablations show that state construction improves performance and reliability under different reward designs. The complete method further reduces tool hallucination across three Qwen3 sizes. On Qwen3-8B, StateAlign improves BFCL v4 multi-turn accuracy from 45.5% to 55.2% and reduces no-tool hallucination on SimpleToolHalluBench from 62.2% under outcome-only training to 56.1%. Behavioral analyses show more consistent decisions, more complete multi-call execution, and stronger recovery after tool errors.

AI.tldr: 针对"任务表现提升伴随工具幻觉增加"的问题，提出 StateAlign：将任务状态构建与状态对比强化学习相结合，使工具调用决策与当前任务状态（信息、工具能力、任务进度）对齐，在多个基准上同时提升准确率并降低工具幻觉。
AI.motivation: RL 提升了 LLM 的工具使用能力，但任务性能提升可能伴随工具幻觉增加。可靠的工具使用要求决策跟随当前任务状态：可用信息、工具能力与任务进度。作者分析发现，智能体即使在推理中已识别出信息缺失，仍会错误地执行而非询问、检索或拒绝不可行请求，即"知道却做错"的状态-动作不匹配问题。
AI.method: StateAlign 由两部分组成：(1) 任务状态构建：数据覆盖五种任务条件，并将状态与不同动作要求配对；(2) 状态对比强化学习：使用结果奖励引导任务完成，同时在配对状态（相同生成推理与动作、不同状态）上做 token 级对比，训练输出与当前状态相匹配。两种奖励信号结合使用。
AI.result: 在三个模型家族共五个基座模型上，于 BFCL v4 multi-turn、ToolSandbox、When2Call 三个基准取得提升。Qwen3-8B 上 BFCL v4 multi-turn 准确率由 45.5% 提升至 55.2%；SimpleToolHalluBench 上无工具幻觉率（no-tool hallucination）从仅结果奖励训练下的 62.2% 降至 56.1%；并在三个 Qwen3 规模上一致降低工具幻觉。消融显示状态构建在不同奖励设计下均提升性能与可靠性。行为分析显示决策更一致、多次调用执行更完整、工具报错后的恢复能力更强。
AI.conclusion: 工具使用鲁棒性的关键在于决策与任务状态的对齐，而非仅优化任务结果奖励；状态构建 + 状态对比 RL 可同时提升任务完成度与可靠性（降低工具幻觉），并带来更一致、更完整、更具错误恢复能力的工具调用行为。

title: Sprint3D: Accelerating End-to-End 3D Asset Generation through Pipeline Optimization
summary: Image-to-3D generative models now produce asset-quality textured meshes, but at minutes per asset they remain slow to iterate with and costly to deploy. Prior work has mostly accelerated the sampling of the networks, and where it also optimizes the mesh processing, it trains its own generators. We instead start from a publicly released pipeline and ask how much of its end-to-end time can be saved. Profiling the public Pixal3D pipeline shows that its latency is dominated by what happens after the networks: the four rectified flows take 14% of the wall-clock time and mesh post-processing takes 85%, most of it in CPU-based UV unwrapping. We therefore first rebuild the mesh post-processing on the GPU and take it off the critical path, then cut the per-evaluation overhead of the flows and distill them from 76 to 8 network evaluations. The resulting pipeline, Sprint3D, reduces the median time per asset from 133 s to 4.05 s on one H200 GPU at the same export settings (33$\times$). At the same time, on 2,653 held-out Toys4K objects it improves every input-view normal metric of the Pixal3D protocol, with a slightly lower mean silhouette IoU, lower point-cloud alignment scores and less fine texture detail. The rebuilt post-processing alone also speeds up TRELLIS.2, which uses the same export code, by 6.7$\times$ without a detectable change in the evaluated metrics.

AI.tldr: Sprint3D 在不重训生成器的前提下，对已公开的 Pixal3D 端到端管线做系统加速：将网格后处理迁移到 GPU 并移出关键路径，同时把四个整流流的单次开销压缩并从 76 步蒸馏到 8 步，使单资产中位耗时从 133 s 降至 4.05 s（33×），且在 Toys4K 上多数法线指标优于原管线。
AI.motivation: 图像到 3D 生成模型已能产出资产级带纹理网格，但单资产需数分钟，迭代慢、部署成本高。已有工作主要加速网络采样，或同时优化网格处理但需自训练生成器；本文希望从公开管线出发回答"端到端时间还能省下多少"。
AI.method: 先对 Pixal3D 做性能剖析，定位瓶颈：四个 rectified flow 仅占 14% 墙钟时间，网格后处理占 85%，其中主要是 CPU 端 UV 展开。据此（1）在 GPU 上重建网格后处理并使其脱离关键路径；（2）降低 flow 的单次推理开销，并将其从 76 次网络评估蒸馏至 8 次。
AI.result: 单张 H200、相同导出设置下，单资产中位时间由 133 s 降至 4.05 s（33×）。在 2,653 个 Toys4K 留出对象上，按 Pixal3D 协议所有输入视角法线指标均提升，但平均轮廓 IoU 略低、点云对齐分数更低、细节纹理稍弱。仅重建后的后处理即可让共享同一导出代码的 TRELLIS.2 提速 6.7×，且评测指标无可见变化。
AI.conclusion: 端到端瓶颈不在生成网络而在网格后处理，GPU 化后处理加 flow 蒸馏可实现约 33× 加速，且法线质量不降反升；代价是轮廓、几何对齐与纹理细节的轻微退化，说明加速与保真度之间存在可量化的权衡。后处理改进具有可迁移性。

title: Overcoming Spurious Correlations in Conditional Diffusion Models via Doubly Robust Target Correction
summary: While conditional diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generation tasks, they memorize spurious correlations within training data. This causes them to deviate from ideal target distributions. Minimizing a covariate shift-adjusted target risk can address this issue. However, retraining models from scratch for different distributions is computationally prohibitive. To overcome this limitation, we propose DR-Diff, a framework that efficiently fine-tunes pre-trained conditional diffusion models. Specifically, DR-Diff leverages a functional gradient approach to derive a pseudo-target. This pseudo-target captures the residual between the base model's noise prediction and the ground-truth noise under the target distribution. Training the model to fit this pseudo-target enables efficient target adaptation. Theoretically, we prove that DR-Diff guarantees target risk reduction at the population level. It also achieves a pseudo-doubly robust property, providing resilience against density ratio estimation errors and base model misspecifications. Empirically, DR-Diff matches the noise prediction accuracy of models trained from scratch on synthetic datasets. Furthermore, it mitigates inter-group disparities in downstream classification tasks.

AI.tldr: DR-Diff 框架通过对预训练条件扩散模型进行高效微调，利用函数梯度构造伪目标，在无需从零重训的前提下将模型适配到协变量偏移校正后的目标分布，理论上保证目标风险下降并具备伪双重稳健性。
AI.motivation: 条件扩散模型在生成任务上表现优异，但会记忆训练数据中的虚假相关（spurious correlations），导致生成分布偏离理想目标分布。最小化经协变量偏移校正的目标风险可缓解该问题，但针对不同分布从零重训代价过高。
AI.method: 提出 DR-Diff 微调框架：基于函数梯度（functional gradient）方法推导出“伪目标”（pseudo-target），该伪目标刻画目标分布下基模型噪声预测与真实噪声之间的残差；通过让模型拟合该伪目标实现高效的目标域适配，避免从零训练。
AI.result: 理论证明 DR-Diff 在总体层面保证目标风险下降，并具备伪双重稳健性（对密度比估计误差与基模型设定偏差均具鲁棒性）；实验上，在合成数据集上其噪声预测精度与从零训练的模型相当，且在真实数据下游分类任务中缩小了组间性能差异。
AI.conclusion: DR-Diff 为条件扩散模型提供了一种高效、理论可证、且具稳健性的目标分布适配方案，可替代昂贵的从零重训并改善下游任务的组间公平性。

title: What Limits Thermal Infrared Drone Detection? A Cross-Dataset Benchmark Analysis
comment: Accepted at 2027 IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision Workshops (WACVW), Workshop "Real World Surveillance: Applications and Challenges, 7th"
summary: Thermal infrared (IR) imaging enables drone detection with reduced dependence on ambient illumination, supporting continuous surveillance beyond the limitations of visible-spectrum sensing. However, substantial and often undocumented variability in camera systems, processing pipelines, and annotation practices across public IR drone datasets complicates the assessment of detector performance and cross-domain generalization. To examine these sources of variability and their implications for drone detection, we systematically characterize existing IR datasets and establish an artifact taxonomy reflecting their origins across the acquisition and processing pipeline, encompassing optical and sensor effects, tone mapping and image enhancement, and recording-related artifacts. Focusing on long-wave IR data, we investigate the impact of training data composition and model characteristics on YOLO-based detection performance, generalization, and condition-dependent failure modes. Our results demonstrate that detection performance is governed more strongly by training data composition than by YOLO generation or model capacity, while cross-dataset generalization exhibits pronounced asymmetries. Even the best-performing configuration fails to detect over 40\% of drones, with elevated miss rates for very small targets, cluttered urban backgrounds, and thermal crossover, highlighting the shortcomings of existing datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文系统刻画了公开红外无人机数据集在相机系统、处理流程与标注规范上的差异，建立跨采集与处理链路（光学/传感器效应、色调映射与图像增强、记录相关效应）的伪影分类体系，并基于长波红外数据考察训练数据组成与YOLO模型特性对检测性能、泛化及条件相关失效模式的影响。结果表明性能主要由训练数据组成决定，而非YOLO代际或模型容量；跨数据集泛化存在显著不对称性，最佳配置仍漏检超40%的无人机。
AI.motivation: 热红外成像可降低对光照的依赖，支持超越可见光传感的持续无人机监视；但公开红外无人机数据集在相机系统、处理管线和标注实践上存在大量且常未被记录的差异，使检测器性能评估与跨域泛化分析难以可靠进行。
AI.method: （1）系统性地刻画现有红外无人机数据集的特征；（2）构建反映伪影在采集与处理管线中来源的分类体系，涵盖光学与传感器效应、色调映射与图像增强、记录相关伪影；（3）聚焦长波红外数据，考察训练数据组成与模型特征对基于YOLO的检测性能、泛化能力及条件相关失效模式的影响。
AI.result: 检测性能受训练数据组成的影响强于受YOLO代际或模型容量的影响；跨数据集泛化呈现明显不对称性；即使最佳配置也漏检超过40%的无人机，在极小目标、杂乱城市背景和热交叉（thermal crossover）情形下漏检率更高。
AI.conclusion: 现有红外无人机数据集存在显著缺陷：数据组成而非模型规模是性能瓶颈，跨域泛化不均衡且整体检测召回不足。因此亟需在数据采集、处理与标注层面建立规范化与多样性，并针对小目标、复杂背景与热交叉等困难条件改进数据与评测协议。

title: Wanda-Guided Sparse Perturbations for Efficient Zeroth-Order Optimization
summary: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models through forward-only evaluations, but high-dimensional random perturbations can limit optimization efficiency. Sparse perturbations reduce the search dimension, making the selection of informative coordinates critical. We propose Wanda-Importance Sparsity-MeZO (WIS-MeZO), which uses Wanda weight--activation saliency to construct task-conditioned sparse perturbation masks while keeping the pretrained model dense. We analyze support quality through gradient energy capture and relate it to gradient estimation and convergence. Across 16 benchmarks with LLaMA and Qwen models ranging from 3B to 32B parameters, WIS-MeZO achieves higher aggregate scores than MeZO and reaches comparable validation losses in fewer optimization steps. Comparisons with random and magnitude-based sparse perturbations further highlight the importance of informative support selection.

AI.tldr: 提出WIS-MeZO，用Wanda权重-激活显著性构造任务相关的稀疏扰动掩码，在保持预训练模型稠密的前提下提升零阶微调效率。
AI.motivation: 零阶（ZO）优化仅靠前向评估即可实现大模型显存高效的微调，但高维随机扰动限制了优化效率；稀疏扰动虽能降低搜索维度，但如何选取有信息量的坐标（支撑集）是关键问题。
AI.method: WIS-MeZO：利用Wanda权重-激活显著性生成任务条件化的稀疏扰动掩码，用于零阶梯度估计，同时不改变预训练模型本身的稠密度；并通过梯度能量捕获指标分析支撑集质量，并将其与梯度估计误差及收敛性建立联系。
AI.result: 在LLaMA与Qwen（3B–32B参数）共16个基准上，WIS-MeZO的聚合得分高于MeZO，并在更少的优化步数内达到可比的验证损失；与随机稀疏扰动和基于幅值的稀疏扰动对比，凸显了支撑集选择的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 信息量驱动的稀疏支撑集选择是提升零阶微调效率的有效途径，任务条件化的显著性掩码比随机或幅值掩码更优。

title: From Foundation VLM to Versatile Driving VLM: A Triplet Incremental Training Approach
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026)
summary: Adapting general Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to Autonomous Driving (AD) is thought to require heavy 3D spatial priors or intrusive architectural overhauls to compensate for a lack of spatial grounding. In this work, we present a counterintuitive pilot study: off-the-shelf general VLMs already exhibit remarkable adaptability across diverse driving tasks, while precise metric depth remains the primary missing link, a bottleneck readily addressable via onboard sensors and depth foundation models. To this end, we introduce the Triplet Incremental Training Framework, a non-intrusive paradigm that seamlessly instills 3D geometric awareness into a general VLM backbone while fully preserving its open-world capabilities. Driven by automatically constructed (image, depth, QA pair) triplets, our framework operates via a unified tri-stream training pipeline: an unfrozen primary VLM stream to adapt to driving tasks, an auxiliary depth stream that guides the visual backbone to implicitly imagine 3D scene geometry via explicit geometric constraints, and a frozen twin VLM stream employing logit-level KL distillation to prevent semantic drift. Crucially, the auxiliary depth branch is discarded during deployment, ensuring the enhanced geometric awareness comes with zero inference overhead. We evaluate our framework across four major benchmarks targeting four diverse capabilities spanning 3D spatial perception, driving-oriented language reasoning, end-to-end planning, and general multimodal understanding. Our approach outperforms state-of-the-art driving VLMs, rivals domain-specific expert models in 3D perception, and successfully retains its original general reasoning capabilities. This demonstrates that Triplet Incremental Training offers a unified, deployment-ready paradigm for transforming general foundation models into robust driving intelligences.

AI.tldr: 提出TripIT（Triplet Incremental Training）非侵入式训练框架，通过(image, depth, QA)三元组与三流训练（主VLM流、辅助深度流、冻结孪生VLM流KL蒸馏），让通用VLM无需架构改造即可获得3D几何感知，且部署时丢弃深度分支实现零推理开销。
AI.motivation: 将通用VLM适配到自动驾驶通常被认为需要重型3D空间先验或侵入式架构改造以弥补空间接地（spatial grounding）缺失。作者认为这一前提值得重新审视：现成通用VLM在多样驾驶任务上已具备良好可塑性，真正缺失的关键环节是精确的度量深度（metric depth），而该瓶颈可借助车载传感器与深度基础模型解决。
AI.method: 1) 自动构建(image, depth, QA pair)三元组数据；2) 统一三流训练管线：不冻结的主VLM流适配驾驶任务；辅助深度流以显式几何约束引导视觉主干隐式"想象"3D场景几何；冻结孪生VLM流以logit级KL蒸馏抑制语义漂移；3) 部署阶段丢弃辅助深度分支，几何能力内化到主干，零额外推理开销。
AI.result: 在覆盖3D空间感知、驾驶导向语言推理、端到端规划、通用多模态理解四类能力的四个主要基准上评测：优于当前最先进驾驶VLM，在3D感知上可与领域专用专家模型比肩，同时保持原有通用推理能力。
AI.conclusion: TripIT表明通用基础模型可通过轻量、非侵入式增量训练转化为稳健的驾驶智能，是一种统一且可直接部署的范式；关键在于将度量深度作为几何监督信号而非部署期依赖。

title: Climate Temporal Temperature Prediction via an Adaptive Stacked Bidirectional Residual Mamba Network
summary: Accurate temperatures forecasting relies on traditional meteorological parameters that are essential for monitoring weather informatics and guiding forecasting efforts. This study presents Deep DualMamba, a novel deep learning framework for temporal temperature prediction, built upon an enhanced variant of the recently proposed Mamba network. Unlike conventional Transformer-based architectures, which dominate foundation models but suffer from computational inefficiencies on long sequences, Deep DualMamba leverages selective structured state space models (SSMs) to achieve both scalability and performance. We identify a core limitation of prior subquadratic-time models-namely, their inability to perform long-term and robust forecasting and introduce two key innovations. First, we propose an adaptive bidirectional Mamba as encoders to learn complex and efficient features. Second, we develop a hardware-aware, parallel recurrent algorithm to compensate for the loss of convolutional efficiency, ensuring practical viability at scale. Last, the Deep DualMamba's approximation ability and convergence is theoretical analyzed. These design choices culminate in a simplified, attention- and MLP-free neural architecture that exhibits linear complexity with sequence length and significantly improved inference throughput. To demonstrate its applicability in climate informatics, we implement a full forecasting pipeline using historical meteorological data from UK monitoring stations.

AI.tldr: 提出Deep DualMamba——基于改进Mamba的选择性状态空间模型框架，用于时间序列温度预测；采用无注意力、无MLP的简化架构，具备线性复杂度与更高推理吞吐，并在英国气象站历史数据上完成完整预测流水线验证。
AI.motivation: 准确的温度预测依赖传统气象参数，对气象信息监测与预报指导至关重要。主流基于Transformer的基础模型在长序列上存在计算效率低下的问题，而现有次二次时间复杂度的模型难以实现长期且稳健的预测。
AI.method: 1）提出自适应双向Mamba作为编码器，学习复杂且高效的特征；2）设计硬件感知的并行递归算法，弥补卷积效率的损失，保证大规模下的实用性；3）对Deep DualMamba的逼近能力与收敛性进行理论分析；最终形成无注意力、无MLP、随序列长度呈线性复杂度的简化神经架构。
AI.result: 架构在序列长度上呈线性复杂度，显著提升推理吞吐量；理论上给出了逼近能力与收敛性分析；并使用英国监测站历史气象数据构建了完整的预测流水线，展示了其在气候信息学中的适用性。
AI.conclusion: Deep DualMamba以选择性结构化状态空间模型替代Transformer，在保持可扩展性与性能的同时解决了长序列建模的计算瓶颈，为长期稳健的气象时间序列预测提供了高效可行的新方案。

title: Fog-FWL: A Large-Scale Full-Waveform LiDAR Dataset for Recovering Fog-Hidden Objects
summary: LiDAR is a core sensor for autonomous driving, yet it is highly vulnerable to fog. Fog scattering produces strong backscatter near the sensor and attenuates reflections from objects behind it, so weak object returns are often discarded by the peak detection that converts received signals into point clouds. Full-waveform LiDAR (FWL), which records the received optical signal before peak detection, retains these weak returns, but the lack of suitable data has prevented research on recovering fog-hidden objects from FWL. We present Fog-FWL, a dataset foundation for this task that consists of a real-world benchmark, Fog-FWL-Real, and a large-scale synthetic training set, Fog-FWL-Sim. Fog-FWL-Real contains 7,527 real foggy FWL frames from 8 scenes and 58 sequences, which is 579x larger than the only existing real foggy FWL data, together with histogram-level Object/Fog/Noise labels, 10,719 3D bounding boxes, and three difficulty levels defined by the attenuation of object reflections. Fog-FWL-Sim contains 12,000 frames generated by our physics-based simulator, Fog-FWL-Simulator, which integrates spatially heterogeneous fog density fields, time-resolved light transport including multiple scattering, and a photon-counting SPAD receiver model. The two subsets share the same sensor format and annotation protocol, enabling a strict sim-to-real evaluation in which no real waveforms are used for training. Our analysis shows that, under the hardest condition, object returns are included in the three strongest peaks for only 34.9% of object rays, underscoring the need for waveform-level recovery. Fog-FWL-Real, Fog-FWL-Sim, and the Fog-FWL-Simulator will be publicly released to facilitate research on fog-robust LiDAR perception.

AI.tldr: 该文发布Fog-FWL数据集基础，包含真实雾天FWL基准（7,527帧，579倍于现有数据）与物理仿真训练集（12,000帧），支持严格的sim-to-real波形级目标恢复研究。
AI.motivation: LiDAR是自动驾驶核心传感器但对雾敏感：雾散射在近端产生强后向散射、同时衰减远处目标回波，弱目标回波常被峰值检测丢弃。全波形LiDAR（FWL）在峰值检测前记录光信号，保留了这些弱回波，但缺乏合适数据，导致从FWL恢复雾中隐藏目标的研究长期空白。
AI.method: 构建Fog-FWL：①Fog-FWL-Real——8个场景、58个序列共7,527帧真实雾天FWL，含直方图级Object/Fog/Noise标签、10,719个3D框，并按目标回波衰减定义三级难度；②Fog-FWL-Sim——基于自研物理仿真器生成12,000帧，集成空间异质雾密度场、含多次散射的时间分辨光传输与SPAD光子计数接收模型。两子集共享传感器格式与标注协议，可实现不使用真实波形训练的严格sim-to-real评估。
AI.result: 真实数据规模为现有唯一真实雾天FWL数据的579倍；分析表明最困难条件下目标回波仅对34.9%的目标射线进入最强三个峰，凸显波形级恢复的必要性。
AI.conclusion: Fog-FWL-Real、Fog-FWL-Sim及Fog-FWL-Simulator将公开发布，推动雾鲁棒LiDAR感知研究。

title: Does Deep Knowledge Tracing Learn Semantic Relations Between Knowledge Components?
summary:
Deep Knowledge Tracing (DKT) is a knowledge tracing (KT) model that updates a shared latent state from sequences of interactions, each pairing a knowledge component (KC) with a response. An interaction with one KC can therefore affect predictions for other KCs. We ask: Are the KC relations learned by DKT semantic? We construct text-derived semantic KC representations using nine pipelines to test whether the conclusions hold across alternative ways of constructing those representations.
  The first test compares DKT-derived KC relation graphs with semantic relation structures induced by pairwise cosine similarities among the KC representations. Across the evaluated datasets, embedding models, and pipelines, the two structures align only weakly and inconsistently. The second test introduces semantic information into DKT; the pretrained text-derived representations do not consistently outperform the standard DKT baseline.
  In the reduced-data experiments, semantic initialization yields a higher test area under the ROC curve (AUC) than the baseline at eight of nine nested sample sizes for ASSISTments 2017. KC-supervised fine-tuned BERT produces small positive AUC differences in some matched comparisons, but the study does not establish their stability across runs. These effects remain limited and inconsistent. The findings suggest that behavioral, temporal, structural, or psychometric signals may also shape DKT's learned relations. DKT-derived relations are not primarily semantic: the tested text-derived semantic structures do not strongly recover the DKT-derived relation structure.

AI.tldr: 本文检验DKT学到的知识点(KC)关系是否具有语义性：构建9条文本语义表示流水线，比较DKT诱导的KC关系图与语义相似度结构，并注入语义信息考察是否提升性能。结论是DKT关系并非以语义为主，二者仅弱且不一致地对齐。
AI.motivation: DKT通过共享隐状态更新，使一个KC的交互会影响其他KC的预测，隐含了KC间关系。若这些关系是语义性的，则可借助文本先验改进模型；若非，则说明关系可能来自行为、时间、结构或心理测量信号。作者因此要检验DKT所学KC关系的语义性。
AI.method: 构建基于文本的语义KC表示，并设计9条不同流水线以检验结论对表示构建方式的稳健性。第一项检验：将DKT导出的KC关系图与由KC表示两两余弦相似度诱导的语义关系结构进行比较。第二项检验：将语义信息（预训练文本表示、语义初始化、KC监督微调的BERT）注入DKT，与标准DKT基线对比。并在ASSISTments 2017上做缩减数据实验（9个嵌套样本量）。
AI.result: 在两结构对齐上，跨数据集、嵌入模型与流水线，DKT关系图与语义关系结构仅呈弱且不一致的对齐。语义信息注入未稳定优于标准DKT基线。缩减数据下，语义初始化在ASSISTments 2017的9个嵌套样本量中有8个AUC高于基线；KC监督微调BERT在部分匹配比较中产生小幅正向AUC差异，但跨运行稳定性未被证实。整体效应有限且不一致。
AI.conclusion: DKT导出的KC关系并非主要源于语义：文本导出的语义结构无法较强地恢复DKT关系结构。其学习到的关系可能更多受行为、时间、结构或心理测量信号塑造，提示后续工作应从多源信号角度解释与改进KT模型。

title: PhysLoop: Harnessing LLMs' Physics Awareness for Self-Improving Video Generation Models
summary: Video generation models produce visually realistic videos but still struggle with physical dynamics and causal consistency. Learning from generated videos requires fine-grained physical supervision, yet reliable quality judgments, correction pairs, and controlled variations are difficult to obtain. Large language models (LLMs) possess physical knowledge, but struggle to reliably guide video generation models in producing their training videos. We present PhysLoop, a unified harness designed to support physically grounded self-improvement in video generation models. The harness guides and constrains LLMs throughout video generation, selection, and correction, distilling their physical knowledge into physically consistent videos. The framework supports controllable training-data construction and inference-time video repair. By identifying and correcting failures, PhysLoop marks a key milestone toward recursive self-improvement (RSI) in video generation models with limited human intervention. We release 100K videos spanning diverse, realistic indoor and outdoor scenes, along with generation tools and two evaluation datasets: PhysLoop-Gen and PhysLoop-Repair. We evaluate controllable generation and localized repair on these datasets, respectively, and assess physical behavior on the external Physics-IQ Verified benchmark.

AI.tldr: PhysLoop：一个统一框架，引导LLM在视频生成、筛选与修正全流程中约束视频生成模型，将物理知识蒸馏为物理一致的视频，支持可控训练数据构建与推理时修复，并开源100K视频及两个评测数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型视觉真实但缺乏物理动力学与因果一致性；从生成视频中学习需要细粒度物理监督，而可靠的质量判断、修正配对与可控变化难以获取。LLM虽具备物理知识，却难以可靠地指导视频生成模型产出其训练视频。
AI.method: 提出PhysLoop统一harness：在视频生成、选择、修正各环节中引导并约束LLM，把其物理知识蒸馏为物理一致的视频；框架支持可控训练数据构建与推理时视频修复，通过识别并修正失败案例实现少人工干预的递归自我改进（RSI）。
AI.result: 发布100K规模、覆盖多样真实室内外场景的视频，以及生成工具和两个评测数据集PhysLoop-Gen与PhysLoop-Repair；分别在二者上评测可控生成与局部修复，并在外部Physics-IQ Verified基准上评估物理行为。
AI.conclusion: PhysLoop通过LLM引导的生成—选择—修正闭环，实现了物理接地的视频生成模型自我改进，是迈向视频生成递归自我改进的关键一步，并提供数据与评测资源支撑后续研究。

title: DRAMA: Dissecting Attention Redundancy for Accelerating Multimodal Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text through iterative masked denoising with bidirectional attention, offering a compelling alternative to autoregressive vision-language modeling. However, each denoising step requires a full forward pass over long multimodal sequences in which visual tokens dominate the sequence length, and a fixed step budget further compounds this quadratic per-step cost. Existing inference acceleration approaches for multimodal dLLMs characterize attention redundancy implicitly, motivating designs from isolated attention visualizations rather than from measurement.
