We close this gap with DRAMA, a training-free acceleration framework grounded in a systematic dissection of attention redundancy in multimodal dLLMs. By probing attention tensors along spatial and temporal axes, we reveal two persistent redundancy structures: (i) attention mass consistently concentrates on a sparse subset of visual tokens, and (ii) attention distributions rapidly stabilize across denoising steps after an initial formation phase. These findings motivate two complementary mechanisms: Spatial-Redundancy-Aware Visual Token Pruning (SVTP) and Sufficiency-Guided Adaptive Stopping (SGAS). Together, DRAMA achieves an average 18.67 times inference speedup across six vision-language benchmarks without training, architectural modification, or attention caching, while maintaining competitive accuracy. Our results establish a strong, measurement-grounded acceleration baseline for multimodal dLLM inference.

AI.tldr: DRAMA是一个免训练的多模态扩散大语言模型推理加速框架，基于对注意力冗余的系统性测量，提出视觉token剪枝与自适应早停两种机制，在六个视觉语言基准上平均实现18.67倍加速且精度保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 多模态扩散大语言模型（dLLM）通过双向注意力的迭代掩码去噪生成文本，但每步去噪需对长多模态序列做完整前向，视觉token占据序列长度主体，固定步数预算进一步放大逐步二次复杂度。现有加速方法仅凭孤立注意力可视化隐式刻画冗余，缺乏测量依据。
AI.method: 沿空间与时间轴探测注意力张量，揭示两种稳定的冗余结构：(i) 注意力质量持续集中于稀疏视觉token子集；(ii) 注意力分布在初始形成阶段后于去噪步间快速稳定。据此设计两个互补机制：空间冗余感知的视觉token剪枝（SVTP）与充分性引导的自适应停止（SGAS）。
AI.result: 六个视觉语言基准上平均18.67倍推理加速，无需训练、结构修改或注意力缓存，精度保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 建立了基于测量、可复现的多模态dLLM推理加速强基线，为后续加速设计提供实证依据。

title: ORCA:Orthogonal Residual Consensus Alignment for Multi-View Clustering
summary: Deep multi-view clustering often suffers from redundant information accumulation during fusion and indiscriminate alignment across representation levels. We propose Orthogonal Residual Consensus Alignment (ORCA) to address these challenges. Its semantic incremental recurrent fusion module extracts cross-view orthogonal residuals as non-redundant increments and adaptively weights recurrent states through divergence-guided gating. Its consensus-calibrated hierarchical contrastive alignment module uses the global consensus to weight contrastive alignment of view-level, pairwise, and recurrent representations. Together, these modules balance view-specific structure with cross-view consistency. Experiments on five benchmarks against fifteen competing methods demonstrate ORCA's effectiveness, including a 5.25 percent accuracy improvement over the strongest baseline on 100leaves. Ablation studies validate both modules. Code is available at https://github.com/XiaojianDing/2026-NeurIPS-ORCA.

AI.tldr: ORCA通过跨视图正交残差增量融合与共识校准的层级对比对齐，解决深度多视图聚类中信息冗余累积和表征层级无差别对齐的问题，在五个基准上优于十五种对比方法。
AI.motivation: 深度多视图聚类在融合过程中存在冗余信息累积，且对不同表征层级（视图级、成对级、循环级）进行无差别对齐，导致视图特有结构与跨视图一致性失衡。
AI.method: 提出正交残差共识对齐（ORCA），含两个模块：(1) 语义增量循环融合模块，提取跨视图正交残差作为非冗余增量，并通过散度引导门控对循环状态自适应加权；(2) 共识校准层级对比对齐模块，利用全局共识为视图级、成对级和循环级表征的对比对齐加权。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上与十五种竞争方法对比验证有效性，在100leaves上相较最强基线准确率提升5.25%；消融实验验证了两个模块的必要性。
AI.conclusion: ORCA通过正交残差增量融合与共识引导的层级对齐，在视图特有结构与跨视图一致性之间取得平衡，是有效的深度多视图聚类框架。

title: MutAtlas: A PDB-Wide Energy-Guided Atlas of Protein Mutation Effects
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Protein mutation effect prediction is fundamental to protein engineering and disease variant interpretation, yet experimentally measured mutation data remain accurate but extremely sparse. To provide scalable supplementary mutation signals, we construct a PDB-wide mutation augmentation dataset that exhaustively enumerates single-site substitutions on experimentally resolved protein structures and aligns mutation signals from physics-based energy models, protein language models, and inverse folding models. Large-scale analysis under a unified mutation preference representation reveals substantial differences in the consistency, concentration, and substitution patterns of mutation distributions across models, indicating that disagreement is pervasive and reflects conflicting inductive biases rather than random noise. Motivated by these observations, we propose an unsupervised multi-source mutation preference distillation framework that learns from relative mutation preferences while explicitly modeling cross-source disagreement. Without using any experimental mutation labels during training, our approach achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated zero-shot baselines and naive multi-source fusion strategies on ProteinGym. We release the dataset and evaluation pipeline to support reproducible studies of protein mutation effects.

AI.tldr: 构建PDB全库单点突变增强数据集，揭示物理能量模型、蛋白语言模型与逆折叠模型的突变偏好存在系统性分歧，并提出无监督多源突变偏好蒸馏框架，在ProteinGym零样本任务上取得最佳整体性能。
AI.motivation: 实验测量的突变效应数据准确但极其稀疏，难以支撑蛋白质工程与致病突变解读，需要可扩展的补充突变信号；而现有多源信号之间的一致性关系尚不清楚，简单融合可能引入偏差。
AI.method: 在实验解析的蛋白结构上穷举单点替换，构建PDB全库突变增强数据集，对齐物理能量模型、蛋白语言模型与逆折叠模型的突变信号；在统一突变偏好表示下开展大规模分析（一致性、集中度、替换模式）；进而提出无监督多源突变偏好蒸馏框架，学习相对突变偏好并显式建模跨源分歧。
AI.result: 分析表明各模型突变分布在一致性、集中度与替换模式上差异显著，分歧具有普遍性且反映冲突的归纳偏置而非随机噪声；不使用任何实验突变标签训练的前提下，该方法在ProteinGym上优于所评估的零样本基线及朴素多源融合策略。
AI.conclusion: 多源突变信号的分歧是结构性而非噪声性，显式建模分歧的蒸馏是有效的无监督利用方式；论文发布数据集与评测流程以支持可复现的蛋白突变效应研究。

title: Efficient Periocular Recognition through Model Scaling and Cross Spectral VIS NIR Verification
comment: Munuscript In revision Process, abstract limited to 1920 ch
summary: Periocular recognition offers an efficient alternative to full-face verification when facial regions are occluded or image resolution is limited. We present AdaEye, a systematic study of input and backbone scaling for periocular verification in visible-spectrum (VIS) and cross-spectral (VIS/NIR) settings. Using an AdaFace-style framework, we compare full-face, masked-face, and dedicated 80x40 periocular inputs while varying backbone width and embedding dimensionality. Across four VIS/VIS and VIS/NIR protocols, we assess verification accuracy, computational cost, inference throughput, training memory, template size, and training stability. Direct periocular processing reduces recognition cost from 6.30 to 1.64 GMACs per image and increases measured throughput by approximately threefold. Its effectiveness depends on the evaluation protocol: periocular models perform better on native UFPR periocular images, whereas face-based protocols favor retaining more input information. Moderate backbone width reductions maintain comparable mean verification performance on CASIA and ND-NIVL while reducing computation. Embedding compression decreases template-storage requirements, primarily benefiting deployment. Multi-seed experiments reveal that some configurations require numerical stabilization, particularly when embedding and backbone reductions are combined. These findings support selecting compact periocular architectures according to the target protocol and deployment constraints, balancing accuracy, efficiency, storage, and robustness.

AI.tldr: AdaEye 系统研究了可见光与跨光谱眼周验证中输入尺度与骨干规模的缩放规律，发现直接眼周处理可将成本从 6.30 降至 1.64 GMACs、吞吐提升约三倍，且其收益依赖评测协议。
AI.motivation: 全脸验证在面部被遮挡或图像分辨率受限时失效，眼周识别可作高效替代；但眼周输入与网络规模如何协同影响精度、效率与稳定性尚缺乏系统分析。
AI.method: 基于 AdaFace 风格框架，对比全脸、遮挡脸与专用 80x40 眼周输入，并联合变化骨干宽度与嵌入维度；在四个 VIS/VIS 与 VIS/NIR 协议上评测验证精度、计算量、推理吞吐、训练显存、模板大小与训练稳定性，并进行多种子实验考察数值稳定性。
AI.result: 直接眼周处理将单图计算量由 6.30 GMACs 降至 1.64 GMACs，实测吞吐提升约 3 倍；眼周模型在原生 UFPR 眼周图像上更优，而基于人脸的协议更倾向保留更多输入信息；适度缩减骨干宽度在 CASIA 与 ND-NIVL 上保持相近平均性能并降低计算；嵌入压缩主要降低模板存储；嵌入与骨干同时缩减时部分配置需数值稳定化处理。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑眼周架构宜依据目标协议与部署约束选择，在精度、效率、存储与鲁棒性之间权衡；输入尺度与主干规模的收益并非普遍成立，而与评测协议和部署条件强相关。

title: Bait: Mitigating Harmful Agentic Reinforcement Learning via Probing Reward Function
summary: We expose a safety vulnerability on nascent agentic reinforcement-learning-as-a-service. Specifically, with a cost as low as \$20, we show that safety alignment of a large language model (e.g., Inkling) can be completely subverted through rounds of harmful agentic reinforcement learning (agentic RL) with a toxic environment from its users. We also demonstrate that upon a successful harmful agentic RL attack via the service API, the attackers can potentially use the safety-degraded model to assist with real-world harmful activities, e.g., exploit software vulnerabilities and launch code re-use attacks. To mitigate harmful agentic RL, we propose Bait, a defense that mitigates the attack via proactively probing the reward function. Experimental results show that such a simple defense can sufficiently mitigate learning from a harmful reward function and can still learn from a benign reward function that promotes benign agentic tasks. Further analysis on both empirical and theoretical aspects shows that an adaptive attacker who assumes the knowledge of Bait defense cannot perfectly subvert it due to a systematic challenge. Source code is available at https://github.com/git-disl/Bait.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了新兴"智能体强化学习即服务"（agentic RLaaS）的安全漏洞：仅需约20美元即可通过有毒环境诱导的多轮有害智能体强化学习，完全破坏大模型的安全对齐，并提出基于奖励函数主动探测的防御方案Bait。
AI.motivation: 智能体强化学习即服务允许用户以低成本调用API对模型进行agentic RL微调，但用户所提供的"环境/奖励函数"可能是有毒的。现有工作未系统评估这一新型服务范式的安全风险，作者旨在量化该威胁并给出防御。
AI.method: 攻击侧：通过服务API，以精心构造的有毒环境（有害奖励信号）对目标模型（如Inkling）执行多轮有害agentic RL，实现低成本安全对齐破坏。防御侧：提出Bait，通过在训练过程中主动探测奖励函数（主动查询/试探以识别并规避有害奖励），从而缓解从恶意奖励中学习；同时从经验与理论两方面分析自适应攻击者（已知Bait机制）的可行性边界。
AI.result: 攻击实验表明，仅约20美元成本即可完全颠覆模型安全对齐；安全退化后的模型可被用于现实有害活动，如利用软件漏洞与实施代码复用攻击。防御实验表明，Bait能充分缓解从有害奖励函数中学习，同时仍能在良性奖励函数（促进良性agentic任务）上正常学习。理论与实证分析显示，即便自适应攻击者掌握Bait知识，也因系统性挑战而无法完美绕过该防御。
AI.conclusion: agentic RLaaS存在现实且低门槛的安全对齐破坏风险，威胁可延伸至现实攻击。简单的奖励函数主动探测防御Bait在保持良性学习能力的同时有效缓解该类攻击，且具备对自适应攻击者的鲁棒性。代码已开源。

title: Evaluating Video LLMs' Understanding of Corner Cases in Autonomous Driving
summary: Natural language explanations promised by modern Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) offer autonomous driving systems a path toward detailed scene description and interpretable decision making on the road. While recent benchmarks have begun assessing these models on driving scenes, they mainly target routine traffic conditions and general comprehension tasks based on existing driving datasets and therefore fail to evaluate model performance on the rarest and most safety-critical driving events, also known as "corner cases". To provide a comprehensive evaluation of Video LLMs on precisely these scenarios, we introduce DashBench, a benchmark testing 25 Video LLMs on 1,709 carefully curated driving videos spanning not only collision-related corner cases but also rare non-collision ones. Through extensive prompts and open-ended question answering, we expose a critical capability gap: all evaluated models perform substantially below the threshold required for safety-critical driving applications, frequently misjudging or missing dangerous events on the road ahead and hallucinating non-existent agents or actions in their explanations. We believe DashBench, combining an extensive dataset with a rigorous evaluation toolkit and a detailed diagnosis of current model limitations, drives progress toward safer, more explainable autonomous driving systems. The code and data will be shared at: cornercase-dashbench.github.io

AI.tldr: 本文提出DashBench，一个面向罕见且安全攸关的"corner case"驾驶场景的视频大模型评测基准，涵盖1,709段精选行车视频与25个Video LLM，揭示模型在安全关键应用中存在显著能力缺口。
AI.motivation: 现代Video LLM的自然语言解释能力被视为自动驾驶实现场景描述与可解释决策的途径，但现有驾驶场景基准主要基于常规交通条件与通用理解任务，无法评测模型在最罕见、最安全攸关的corner case上的表现。
AI.method: 构建DashBench基准：精挑1,709段行车视频，既包含碰撞相关的corner case，也包含罕见的非碰撞corner case；采用多样化提示与开放式问答（open-ended QA）形式，对25个Video LLM进行系统评测，并提供严格评测工具包。
AI.result: 所有被评测模型的表现均显著低于安全关键驾驶应用所需阈值：频繁误判或漏检前方道路上的危险事件，并在解释中虚构不存在的交通参与者或行为（幻觉）。
AI.conclusion: DashBench以大规摸数据集、严格评测工具与对当前模型局限的细致诊断，推动更安全、更可解释的自动驾驶系统研究；代码与数据将公开。

title: Recursive State-Augmented Language Models: Persistent Latent-State Adaptation of Pretrained Language Models
summary:
Language models rely on finite token contexts, limiting access to earlier interactions. We introduce Recursive State-Augmented Language Models (Recursive SALM), a framework in which a persistent latent state evolves with each observation and generates adaptations of a pretrained language model. A modular read-transition-write architecture separates observation encoding, latent dynamics, and predictor adaptation. We develop deterministic and stochastic formulations.
  The experiments evaluate only deterministic SALM with frozen GPT-2 small and exclude earlier evidence from its decoder context. On a four-turn hypothesis-inference task, latent-gated LoRA reaches 89.1% accuracy, comparable to 88.0% for a trained full-context LoRA baseline, with earlier evidence available solely through a 64-dimensional state. Zeroing or shuffling the state substantially reduces accuracy. In a two-turn task with codewords unseen in training, several interfaces improve candidate ranking over chance, but rarely generate the exact codeword under the evaluated training schedule. These experiments show that persistent latent-conditioned adaptation can support sequential inference when earlier evidence is absent from the decoder context.

AI.tldr: 提出 Recursive SALM 框架，用持续演化的 64 维潜在状态替代有限 token 上下文；在冻结 GPT-2 small 上，潜门控 LoRA 在四轮假设推断任务中达 89.1% 准确率，接近全上下文 LoRA 的 88.0%。
AI.motivation: 语言模型受限于有限 token 上下文，难以访问早期交互信息，因此需要一种不依赖解码器上下文的持续记忆机制。
AI.method: 提出 Recursive State-Augmented Language Models（Recursive SALM）：一个持续潜在状态随每次观测更新，并生成预训练语言模型的自适应参数；采用"读—转移—写"（read-transition-write）模块化架构，分离观测编码、潜在动力学与预测器适配，并给出确定性与随机性两种形式。实验仅评估确定性 SALM，基座为冻结的 GPT-2 small，且解码器上下文中不含早期证据。
AI.result: 四轮假设推断任务中，潜门控 LoRA 准确率 89.1%，与经训练的全上下文 LoRA 基线（88.0%）相当，而早期证据仅通过 64 维状态传递；将状态置零或打乱后准确率显著下降。两轮任务中，对训练未见的码字，多种接口的候选排序优于随机，但在所评估的训练方案下很少生成精确码字。
AI.conclusion: 当早期证据不在解码器上下文中时，持续潜在状态条件的模型适配仍可支撑序列推断，为突破 token 上下文限制提供可行路径；但精确生成未训练码字仍具挑战。

title: EG360: Efficient and Generalizable $360^\circ$ Depth Estimation via Adaptive Panorama-Perspective Distillation and Spherical Cross-Level Feature Fusion
summary: Generalized panorama depth estimation has witnessed great advances in recent years. These methods typically achieve robust zero-shot generalization performance using large pretrained models, but their high computational cost makes real-time inference on embedded platforms challenging. In contrast, previous lightweight panorama models have mostly been developed for single-domain evaluations and cannot generalize well due to domain shifts. To reduce the gap between these two types of models, we introduce EG360, an efficient and generalizable panorama depth estimation model. Specifically, building on a lightweight depth model, we design an Adaptive Panorama-Perspective Distillation (APPD) strategy guided by scene geometry, along with a Spherical Cross-Level Feature Fusion (SCFF) module for global semantic perception. As a result, with only 6.593M parameters after reparameterization, EG360 achieves strong zero-shot performance on real-world benchmarks and runs at 35 FPS on a Jetson Orin NX 16GB in MAXN mode, whereas a previous ViT-small model runs at less than 2 FPS. Our code will also be made public for future research.

AI.tldr: EG360：轻量且可泛化的全景深度估计模型，重参数化后仅6.593M参数，在Jetson Orin NX 16GB上35 FPS，兼具零样本泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 全景深度估计存在两类模型的鸿沟：基于大规模预训练模型的方法零样本泛化强但计算开销大，难以在嵌入式平台实时推理；此前的轻量全景模型多为单域评测设计，受域偏移影响泛化差。目标是弥合二者差距。
AI.method: 在轻量深度模型基础上，提出由场景几何引导的Adaptive Panorama-Perspective Distillation（APPD）蒸馏策略，以及用于全局语义感知的Spherical Cross-Level Feature Fusion（SCFF）模块；并通过重参数化压缩参数。
AI.result: 重参数化后仅6.593M参数，在真实世界基准上取得较强零样本性能；在Jetson Orin NX 16GB（MAXN模式）上达35 FPS，而此前ViT-small模型不足2 FPS。
AI.conclusion: EG360以极低参数与高推理效率实现了全景深度估计的良好零样本泛化，为嵌入式平台部署提供可行方案，代码将开源。

title: Experience-Handoff Reinforcement Learning for Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: It is common to train Large Language Models (LLMs) for agentic tasks with Reinforcement Learning (RL) from scalar rewards. However, this throws away the fine-grained information about the environment that the agent experienced during the trial (e.g., error logs). To utilize this rich information, recent works wrap the agent in a harness that refines its own inputs through reflection or compaction and hands past experience to future rollouts, but the construction of the handed-off artifacts (e.g., a playbook) is itself not learned. We want the best of both worlds: gradient updates from a scalar reward, while also utilizing environment information to hand off experience. As a concrete testbed, we fix the Agentic Context Engineering (\ace{}) harness and train one model to act, reflect, and curate task-local playbooks. Our method, \acerl{}, evaluates candidate experience-handoff artifacts by their downstream effect on future actor rollouts, and co-optimizes the role-specific behaviors (action generator, insight reflector, and playbook curator) under a fixed scaffold. Across agentic benchmarks, \acerl{} achieves higher held-out performance than baseline methods. The results suggest that agent training should optimize not only the actions in the current rollout, but also the model-written experience that future rollouts inherit.

AI.tldr: 提出ACE-RL：在固定的Agentic Context Engineering脚手架下，用标量奖励的强化学习同时训练单一模型担任行动者、反思者与手册管理者，使"经验交接工件"本身也成为可学习、可优化的对象。
AI.motivation: 用标量奖励做RL训练LLM智能体时会丢弃轨迹中的细粒度环境信息（如错误日志）；近期工作通过反思/压缩等harness把历史经验传给后续rollout，但交接工件的构造过程本身并未被学习。作者希望兼得二者：既保留标量奖励的梯度更新，又利用环境信息进行跨轮次经验传承。
AI.method: 固定ACE harness作为试验台，训练单个模型承担三种角色行为：行动生成器、洞察反思者、手册管理者（playbook curator）。以候选经验交接工件对未来actor rollout的下游影响来评估其价值，并在固定脚手架下对三类角色行为进行协同优化（co-optimization）。
AI.result: 在多个agentic基准上，ACE-RL的held-out性能优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 智能体训练不应只优化当前rollout中的动作，还应优化模型书写的、将被未来rollout继承的经验；把经验交接工件的构建纳入RL优化目标是有效的。

title: Kosmo-GFM: A Production-Ready Geometry Foundation Model
summary: We present Kosmo-GFM, a scene reconstruction system that integrates a geometry foundation model (GFM), a pose optimization engine (PoseEngine), and reconstruction-derived supervision from KosmoWorld. GFM predicts camera parameters, depth, cross-view correspondences, and dynamic 3D points from images and videos. PoseEngine combines these predictions with geometric optimization to recover scene-level camera poses and geometry for downstream 3D and 4D Gaussian Splatting. KosmoWorld generates images and geometric supervision from reconstructed real-world scenes to improve GFM's geometric predictions. On the Sparse and Medium subsets of SpatialBench, GFM achieves the lowest absolute relative depth error and the highest relative-pose AUC at 5 degrees among the compared methods. It also achieves the lowest mean endpoint errors for dynamic points and scene flow across the five evaluated datasets. Across 34 scenes completed by all compared reconstruction systems, PoseEngine achieves the highest scene-averaged pose AUC at thresholds of 1, 3, and 5 degrees, with a cumulative runtime of 14.07 hours, approximately 20% of GLUEMAP's 69.67 hours. PoseEngine Flash provides a further accuracy-efficiency trade-off, with a measured mixed-precision runtime of 2.62 hours, approximately 4% of GLUEMAP's runtime. Separate scaling experiments show generally favorable trends with increased data, model computation, and training budgets. These results support the use of learned geometric priors within a scene-level reconstruction pipeline.

AI.tldr: Kosmo-GFM 将几何基础模型 GFM、位姿优化引擎 PoseEngine 与 KosmoWorld 的重建监督结合，在深度、位姿、动态点与场景流精度上取得最优，并以约 20%（Flash 版约 4%）于 GLUEMAP 的运行时完成场景级重建。
AI.motivation: 现有场景级重建依赖纯几何优化，位姿与几何精度受稀疏视角与动态场景限制，计算开销大；作者希望验证学习式几何先验能否与几何优化结合，在精度和效率上同时优于传统重建系统。
AI.method: 系统由三部分组成：GFM 从图像/视频预测相机参数、深度、跨视角对应与动态 3D 点；PoseEngine 将这些预测与几何优化融合，恢复场景级相机位姿与几何，供下游 3D/4D 高斯泼溅使用；KosmoWorld 由重建的真实场景生成图像与几何监督，反向提升 GFM 的几何预测。另给出混合精度版本 PoseEngine Flash，并做了数据、模型计算与训练预算的缩放实验。
AI.result: 在 SpatialBench 的 Sparse 与 Medium 子集上，GFM 取得最低绝对相对深度误差和最高 5° 相对位姿 AUC；在五个数据集上取得最低动态点与场景流平均终点误差。在全部系统均完成的 34 个场景上，PoseEngine 在 1°/3°/5° 阈值下场景平均位姿 AUC 最高，累计耗时 14.07 小时，约为 GLUEMAP（69.67 小时）的 20%；Flash 版为 2.62 小时，约为 4%。缩放实验显示随数据、计算与训练预算增加，性能总体呈有利趋势。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在场景级重建流程中引入学习式几何先验是可行且有效的，可在保持位姿与几何精度的同时显著降低计算成本。

title: SoScale: Second-Order Scale Search for FP4 Quantization
summary: Low-bit quantization reduces the memory footprint and inference cost of large language models (LLMs), yet accurate FP4 quantization remains challenging. Practical formats such as MXFP4, NVFP4, and HiF4 pair a 4-bit floating-point payload with block-wise or hierarchical scale codes, making accuracy highly sensitive to how each local distribution is scaled. Default maximum-absolute-value scaling preserves dynamic range, but can spend scarce FP4 levels on rarely occupied outlier regions and leave dense tensor values poorly resolved. Existing scale-search methods minimize local element-wise reconstruction error, optimizing tensor fidelity rather than layer-output fidelity. We propose SoScale, a second-order weight scale-code search method for hierarchical FP4 quantization. SoScale searches hardware-valid scale codes under a Hessian-aware layer reconstruction objective and couples this search with GPTQ-style error recovery, selecting scales by their impact on layer outputs. Across Qwen3 models, SoScale consistently reduces downstream quantization degradation under MXFP4, NVFP4, and HiF4.

AI.tldr: SoScale：面向层级FP4量化的二阶权重尺度码搜索方法，以Hessian感知的层输出重构目标替代逐元素重构误差来选择硬件有效的尺度码，并与GPTQ式误差补偿耦合，在Qwen3系列模型上一致降低MXFP4/NVFP4/HiF4的下游精度退化。
AI.motivation: 低比特量化可降低LLM显存与推理开销，但FP4精度难以保证。MXFP4、NVFP4、HiF4等实用格式将4比特浮点载荷与块级/层级尺度码配对，精度对局部分布的缩放方式高度敏感。默认的max-abs缩放虽保留动态范围，却可能把稀缺的FP4量化级分配给稀疏的离群区域，导致稠密值分辨率不足；现有尺度搜索方法最小化局部逐元素重构误差，优化的是张量保真度而非层输出保真度。
AI.method: SoScale搜索硬件有效的尺度码，目标函数为Hessian感知的层重构误差（即考虑量化误差经权重-激活交互对层输出的影响），并将该搜索与GPTQ式逐列误差补偿相耦合，使尺度选择依据其对层输出的实际影响，而非元素级误差。
AI.result: 在Qwen3系列模型上，SoScale在MXFP4、NVFP4与HiF4三种格式下均一致降低了量化带来的下游任务性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 尺度码选择应从张量级保真转向层输出级保真；二阶（Hessian感知）目标与GPTQ误差恢复的联合优化，是一种对层级FP4量化通用且有效的改进方向。

title: Visual Cipher Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Visual Reasoning
summary: While language-model agents excel at long-horizon coding and terminal tasks, this success relies on two conditions: explicit text specifications and immediate execution feedback. However, neither condition holds in real-world problems where critical information exists only in images, leaving it unclear whether long-horizon capability transfers from text to visual reasoning. In such visual settings, because rules and clues resist text transcription and lack test-case feedback, agents must repeatedly inspect images, simulate spatial transformations, and autonomously cross-check clues. Despite this challenge, existing evaluations fail to capture such capability: visual reasoning benchmarks largely reduce tasks to single-turn, short-chain question answering, whereas agent benchmarks focus on text-based environments or interactive states that permit trial-and-error. To bridge this gap, we introduce Visual Cipher Bench, a collection of 40 original visual puzzles across four categories: spatial manipulation and simulation, logical constraints and planning, rule induction, and knowledge-based decoding. Each puzzle provides only one to three black-and-white line drawings and a minimal submission instruction, requiring agents to discover the underlying solving mechanism entirely from the images. Across 29 reasoning-effort configurations of eight frontier models, even the strongest model, GPT-6 Astra (max), achieves only 26.7% accuracy, while five of the eight models score below 1%. Yet on a ten-task subset, providing a single non-spoiler mechanism hint boosts accuracy from 7.8% to 55.6%. This sharp contrast shows that the primary bottleneck of current agents lies not in executing multi-step plans, but in autonomously discovering rules from visual evidence. Visual Cipher Bench thus provides a rigorous benchmark for measuring long-horizon visual reasoning in agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Visual Cipher Bench：40 道原创视觉解谜（分四类），每题仅给 1–3 张黑白线稿与极简提交说明，要求智能体完全从图像中自主发现解题机制。8 个前沿模型、29 种推理强度配置下最强模型 GPT-6 Astra（max）仅 26.7%，8 个模型中 5 个低于 1%；而在 10 题子集上给出单句非泄底机制提示后，准确率从 7.8% 升至 55.6%。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体在长程编码与终端任务上的成功依赖两个前提：显式文本规范与即时执行反馈。真实问题中关键信息常仅存在于图像里，规则与线索难以转写为文本、也缺乏测试用例反馈，因而"长程能力"能否从文本迁移到视觉推理尚不清楚。现有评测无法刻画该能力：视觉推理基准多被简化为单轮短链问答，而智能体基准集中于文本环境或可试错的交互状态。
AI.method: 构建 Visual Cipher Bench：40 道原创视觉谜题，涵盖空间操作与模拟、逻辑约束与规划、规则归纳、知识型解码四类；每题只提供 1–3 张黑白线稿和极简提交指令，迫使智能体反复检视图像、模拟空间变换并自主交叉验证线索。评测覆盖 8 个前沿模型的 29 种推理强度配置，并设置"非泄底机制提示"对照实验（10 题子集）以定位瓶颈。
AI.result: 最强模型 GPT-6 Astra（max）准确率仅 26.7%；8 个模型中有 5 个低于 1%。加入单条非泄底机制提示后，10 题子集准确率由 7.8% 提升至 55.6%。
AI.conclusion: 这一反差表明当前智能体的主要瓶颈不在执行多步计划，而在从视觉证据中自主发现规则。Visual Cipher Bench 为衡量智能体的长程视觉推理提供了严格基准。

title: A Recipe for Physical Action Model Training
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables; ancillary code and numerical results included
summary: Choosing robot model capacity and demonstration budgets also requires decisions about data composition, representation, optimization, and deployment. We connect these decisions through a common conditional-distribution target. Nested learning oracles give exact risk accounting; local information geometry, conditional mutual information, and empirical convergence provide conditional training prescriptions. Known-target numerical checks expose capacity-data coupling, representation-induced mixture mismatch, and an example where deployment KL increases while negative log-likelihood decreases. An analysis of 206 public PushT trajectories evaluates fixed-feature information-design criteria without fitting a policy. Under asymmetric evaluation targets, the selected allocations reduce this criterion by 4.5-6.2% relative to target matching; balanced targets show no benefit. These results clarify which quantities can support training recommendations and when an apparently favorable predictive metric has a different interpretation.

AI.tldr: 论文以统一的“条件分布目标”串联数据组成、数据表征、优化与部署决策，用嵌套学习预言机做精确风险核算，给出基于局部信息几何、条件互信息与经验收敛的训练处方；在206条公开PushT轨迹上验证了固定特征的信息设计准则，非对称评估目标下分配方案使准则降低4.5–6.2%，平衡目标无收益。
AI.motivation: 选择机器人模型容量与示教预算时，需同时决定数据组成、表征、优化和部署方式，而这些决策通常被分开研究、缺乏统一的风险核算框架；同时预测指标（如NLL）与部署表现（KL）可能不一致，需要厘清哪些量能支撑训练建议。
AI.method: 构建以条件分布为共同目标的统一分析框架：利用嵌套学习预言机实现精确风险分解与核算；借助局部信息几何、条件互信息和经验收敛界推导条件性训练处方；在已知目标的数值实验中做校验；并在206条公开PushT轨迹上以固定特征评估信息设计准则（不拟合策略）。
AI.result: 数值检验揭示容量-数据耦合、表征引起的混合分布失配，以及部署KL上升而负对数似然下降的反例；PushT数据分析显示，在非对称评估目标下所选分配相对目标匹配将准则降低4.5–6.2%，而平衡目标下无显著收益。
AI.conclusion: 该工作明确了各决策量之间的条件依赖关系，指出训练建议仅在特定条件（如非对称评估目标）下成立，并提示看似有利的预测指标可能具有不同解释，为容量-数据预算分配提供了可审计的分析依据。

title: Raysemble: Metric 3D Bone Reconstruction from a Single X-ray
summary: Raysemble reconstructs eight lumbar and pelvic bones from a single X-ray by separating shape and placement. Each 3D query samples regional and global features at its image projection. A shared decoder predicts normalized bone shapes. Predicted depth and camera geometry determine 3D centers and scales for resampling these shapes onto a common grid in millimeters. Evaluation uses 23 held-out patients with 43 CT scans, each generating one simulated anteroposterior radiograph. Without rigid alignment to CT,Raysemble leads 15 evaluated methods, averaging 65.24% Dice, 9.09 mm HD95, and 3.32 mm ASSD over three random seeds. With identical inputs, it improves Dice over VolumeNeRF by 5.86 percentage points.

AI.tldr: Raysemble 通过“形状—位姿”解耦，从单张 X 光片重建腰椎与骨盆共 8 块骨骼的三维结构。
AI.motivation: 从单张 X 光片重建多块骨骼的三维形状与空间位置存在尺度模糊与位姿耦合问题，作者希望将形状预测与摆放（深度、中心、尺度）分离，避免不同骨骼间的相互干扰。
AI.method: 每个三维查询点在其图像投影位置采样局部（regional）与全局特征；由共享解码器预测归一化骨骼形状；再依据预测深度与相机几何确定各骨骼的 3D 中心与尺度，将归一化形状重采样到统一的毫米栅格上。
AI.result: 在 23 名留出患者、43 例 CT（各生成一张模拟正位 X 光片）上评估；在不对 CT 做刚性配准的条件下，Raysemble 在 15 种对比方法中领先，三个随机种子平均 Dice 65.24%、HD95 9.09 mm、ASSD 3.32 mm；相同输入下 Dice 较 VolumeNeRF 提升 5.86 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 形状与摆放解耦的范式在多骨骼单视图 X 光重建中有效，统一毫米栅格重采样带来可比的三维几何精度，并在公平（无刚性配准）协议下优于现有方法。

title: Helgason-Fourier Random Features for Scalable Hyperbolic Latent Variables
summary: Hyperbolic geometry is well suited to embedding hierarchical data, capturing tree-like structure faithfully even in the low dimensions where Euclidean dimensionality reduction is severely constrained. We introduce Random Helgason--Fourier Features (RHFF), an explicit finite-dimensional feature map for kernels on hyperbolic space. We characterize the spectral density from which RHFF frequencies are drawn, allowing kernels such as the Matérn family to be specified directly in the frequency domain. We also prove a uniform approximation error bound for RHFF. Building on this representation, we develop a hyperbolic latent variable model called RHFF-LVM, which requires no numerical quadrature, variational bounds or auxiliary variables unlike previous hyperbolic GP-LVMs. Our RHFF-LVM recovers the metric of a synthetic tree more faithfully than all baselines and attains the best mean rank, driven by large gains on tree-structured atlases at $Q\!=\!2$. Furthermore, it fits $5\times10^{5}$ points in $505$ seconds, making it the first non-parametric hyperbolic LVM to reach this scale.

AI.tldr: 提出随机Helgason–Fourier特征（RHFF），为双曲空间核给出显式有限维特征映射并推导均匀逼近误差界；据此构建免数值积分、免变分界的双曲潜变量模型RHFF-LVM，在合成树结构上与大规模数据上均取得最优表现。
AI.motivation: 双曲几何能忠实刻画层次/树状结构，在低维降维受限时优势明显；但双曲空间上的核方法缺乏显式有限维特征映射，已有双曲GP-LVM依赖数值积分、变分界与辅助变量，且难以扩展到大规模数据。
AI.method: 1) 提出RHFF：显式有限维随机特征映射，刻画抽取频率所依据的谱密度，使Matérn等核可直接在频域中指定；2) 证明RHFF的均匀逼近误差界；3) 基于该表示构建RHFF-LVM，无需数值求积、变分界或辅助变量。
AI.result: RHFF-LVM在合成树度量恢复上优于全部基线，平均排名最优，主要来自Q=2时树结构图谱上的大幅提升；可在505秒内拟合5×10^5个点，是首个达到该规模的非参数双曲潜变量模型。
AI.conclusion: RHFF为双曲核提供兼具理论保证与计算可行性的显式特征表示，使双曲潜变量建模在保持几何表达力的同时兼具简洁性与可扩展性。

title: TokenStream: Multi-Subject Personalized Video Generation with Token-wise LoRA and Guided Attention
summary: We introduce TokenStream, an optimization-based framework that composes independently learned subject identities in text-to-video generation without a reference-video training dataset or joint optimization of each new subject combination. Learning from a single reference image makes subject appearance difficult to separate from static-image bias, while merging independently trained adapters can mix identities. Token-wise LoRA (ToRA) restricts low-rank updates to the cross-attention value projections of subject-associated text tokens, providing a separate adaptation path for each subject. A T2V-guided stream copies queries and keys from the frozen base model during early denoising to reuse its layout and motion priors while retaining personalized values. We also introduce Multi-DB, a 30-subject, 122-prompt benchmark with appearance-free prompts and varied interactions. On Multi-DB at 1.3B, TokenStream improves identity preservation from 0.422 for DreamBooth to 0.467 and textual alignment from 0.652 to 0.688.

AI.tldr: TokenStream：一种基于优化的无参考视频训练数据、无需联合优化的文本到视频多主体组合生成框架。
AI.motivation: 单图学习易将主体外观与静态图像偏差耦合；独立训练适配器直接合并会导致身份混淆。目标是在不依赖参考视频数据集、也不对每个新主体组合联合优化的前提下，实现独立学习主体的组合生成。
AI.method: 提出 Token-wise LoRA（ToRA），将低秩更新限制在与主体关联文本 token 的 cross-attention value 投影上，为每个主体提供独立适配路径；并设计 T2V 引导流，在去噪早期从冻结基模型复制 queries 与 keys，以复用其布局与运动先验，同时保留个性化 values。另构建 Multi-DB 基准（30 个主体、122 条提示，提示不含外观描述、交互多样）。
AI.result: 在 1.3B 规模的 Multi-DB 上，身份保持度由 DreamBooth 的 0.422 提升至 0.467，文本对齐度由 0.652 提升至 0.688。
AI.conclusion: Token 级约束的低秩适配与基础模型先验复用可有效解耦多主体身份，实现可组合的个性化文本到视频生成。

title: Learning Temporal Dynamics with Derivative Representations for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series forecasting aims to predict the future evolution of complex systems by learning their underlying dynamics from past observations. Despite recent advances in deep learning, Transformers in particular still struggle to capture the temporal evolution of system dynamics. Existing approaches have been largely driven by architectural innovation, with comparatively little attention paid to training strategies that explicitly exploit the temporal structure governing system dynamics. In this work, we introduce DeltaTSF, a dynamics-aware forecasting framework based on discrete derivative representations of time series. Specifically, DeltaTSF jointly learns the series and their discrete temporal derivatives across both input and forecast horizons within a unified, model-agnostic framework. By coupling these representations over time, the model is encouraged to maintain temporal consistency, a property we show to induce a form of discrete Taylor consistency during training. This formulation enables the model to better reflect the underlying system dynamics, resulting in more stable and physically coherent forecasts. Notably, DeltaTSF does not require explicit derivative computation and introduces no additional computational overhead at inference time. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks and backbone architectures demonstrate that DeltaTSF consistently improves forecasting performance and yields more dynamically coherent predictions than strong SOTA methods. These results highlight the effectiveness of enforcing dynamic coherence through derivative representations as a model-agnostic paradigm that operates alongside and complements architectural design. Source code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: DeltaTSF是一个基于离散导数表示的动力学感知时间序列预测框架，通过在同一模型中联合学习序列及其离散时间导数来增强时间一致性，模型无关、推理无额外开销，在多种基准和骨干网络上稳定提升预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测研究多聚焦于架构创新（如Transformer），而较少关注能从训练策略层面显式利用系统动力学时间结构的做法；同时Transformer等模型仍难以刻画系统动态的时间演化。
AI.method: 提出DeltaTSF：在统一、模型无关的框架中，对输入区间与预测区间同时联合学习时间序列及其离散时间导数表示；通过跨时间耦合这些表示来施加时间一致性约束，作者证明该性质在训练中诱导出一种离散泰勒一致性；方法无需显式计算导数，且推理阶段不引入额外计算开销。
AI.result: 在多样化的基准数据集与多种骨干架构上的大量实验表明，DeltaTSF一致地优于强SOTA方法，预测性能稳定提升，且预测结果具有更强的动态连贯性。
AI.conclusion: 通过导数表示施加动态一致性是一种模型无关的有效范式，可与架构设计并行并相互补充，为提升时间序列预测的动力学一致性提供了新思路；源代码将在论文录用后公开。

title: Automated PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Scoring with Uncertainty-Guided Triage in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
comment: 55 pages (29-page main text with 5 figures and 3 tables, followed by 26 pages of supplementary material)
summary: Programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) tumor proportion score (TPS) informs immunotherapy selection in non-small cell lung cancer. Near the 1% and 50% cutoffs, the score should also indicate when closer review is warranted. We designed a three-stage framework to follow the sequence of TPS assessment. Stage 1 identifies tumor regions and excludes macrophage-rich patches. Stage 2, a dual-branch cell counting network (D2Count-Net), counts PD-L1-positive and PD-L1-negative tumor cells in these regions to calculate TPS. Stage 3, TPS-Guard, an uncertainty-guided triage mechanism, reports model uncertainty as the disagreement among independently trained models, refers the most uncertain slides, and flags scores near the 1% or 50% cutoff when model estimates disagree across that cutoff. Flags state the reason for referral or alert the pathologist to possible scoring errors on auto-reported slides. In a retrospective, single-center study, 154 whole-slide images were scored by three pathologists, and the model and each pathologist were compared in turn with the mean of the other two. On the 114 slides unseen in training, model mean absolute error (MAE) was 6.96 percentage points, within the range of the three pathologists (4.24 to 8.29), and model uncertainty correlated with absolute TPS error (Spearman rho = 0.77) and inter-pathologist disagreement (rho = 0.71). After referral of the 15% most uncertain slides, model and pathologist MAE both decreased. Applied without retraining to an external, publicly available dataset, TPS-Guard still directed review to higher-error cases, and referring more uncertain cases raised sensitivity at the 50% cutoff. TPS-Guard provides reasons for reviewing individual automated scores and identifies slides that also produce greater disagreement among pathologists. Prospective reader studies should assess TPS-Guard's effect on TPS reporting.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出三阶段框架用于PD-L1 TPS自动评分：肿瘤区域识别并排除巨噬细胞富集区、双分支细胞计数网络D2Count-Net计算TPS、以及不确定性引导的分诊机制TPS-Guard，在接近1%或50%阈值时提示复核。模型MAE为6.96个百分点，位于三位病理医师区间内，不确定性与误差及病理医师间分歧均强相关。
AI.motivation: PD-L1 TPS决定NSCLC免疫治疗选择，而1%和50%为关键决策阈值；在这些阈值附近，评分需要提示何时应进行更细致的复核。现有自动评分方法缺乏对个体化评分可信度的说明与转诊机制。
AI.method: 设计遵循TPS评估流程的三阶段框架：阶段1识别肿瘤区域并排除巨噬细胞富集斑块；阶段2为双分支细胞计数网络D2Count-Net，统计区域内PD-L1阳性与阴性肿瘤细胞以计算TPS；阶段3为TPS-Guard，以独立训练模型间的分歧作为模型不确定性，将最不确定的全片图像转诊，并在模型估计跨越1%或50%阈值时标记。回顾性单中心研究，154张WSI由三位病理医师评分，模型与每位医师分别与其余两位均值比较。
AI.result: 在114张未参与训练的切片上，模型MAE为6.96个百分点，处于三位病理医师4.24–8.29的范围内；模型不确定性与TPS绝对误差相关（Spearman rho=0.77），与病理医师间分歧相关（rho=0.71）。转诊最不确定的15%切片后，模型与病理医师MAE均下降。不经再训练应用于外部公开数据集时，TPS-Guard仍能将复核导向高误差病例，增加不确定病例转诊可提高50%阈值处的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: TPS-Guard可为个体化自动评分提供复核理由，并能识别同样引起病理医师更大分歧的切片；其对TPS报告的实际影响尚需前瞻性阅片者研究验证。

title: RESYNC: Residual Latent-State Synchronization for Deadline-Bound Streaming Inference
summary: Predicting every observation in a high-rate stream requires a model to finish before the next arrival. A large model may offer better predictions but miss that deadline. We propose RESYNC: the large model runs asynchronously, while a fast path updates its latest exact but stale latent state using the observations received since that state was computed and applies its unchanged prediction head. The updater learns from the frozen model's representations without task labels. Across one real and two synthetic streams and five architecture families, RESYNC beats the best compact or distilled alternative with a paired 95% interval above zero in all twelve dataset--architecture pairs with a material teacher advantage at anchor ages of 4--12 observations, and in eleven pairs at older tested ages up to 32. The share of the teacher's gain preserved remains complete on the real stream but is lower and generally declines with anchor age on the synthetic streams. In live replay with 1 ms arrivals, the synchronous large models cannot deliver any predictions on time while RESYNC serves at least 99.4% of arrivals within the interval, with 0.35--0.62 ms median latency on one CPU thread: around the same speed as or faster than the compact model, and 7.9--17.7$\times$ faster than synchronous large-model inference. RESYNC targets settings with background compute available but a strict per-observation response deadline.

AI.tldr: RESYNC让大模型异步运行，用轻量更新器基于新观测修正其过时潜状态并复用原预测头，在严格逐样本时延约束下近乎保留大模型精度，且推理速度达同步大模型的7.9–17.7倍。
AI.motivation: 高频流中每条观测都需在下一条到达前完成预测，大模型精度更高但难以满足截止时间；压缩/蒸馏小模型虽快却损失精度。作者希望在"有后台算力、但每条响应有硬性时延"的场景下兼得两者。
AI.method: 大模型在后台异步计算精确但陈旧的潜状态；快路径用一个更新器，根据该状态计算以来新到达的观测修正潜状态，并直接套用冻结模型未改动的预测头；更新器以冻结模型的表示为学习目标，无需任务标签（自监督式对齐）。
AI.result: 在1条真实流+2条合成流、5类架构共12个"数据集–架构"组合上，RESYNC均以配对95%区间大于0优于最优的紧凑/蒸馏基线（锚点年龄4–12条观测时教师优势显著，年龄至32时仍有11/12成立）；真实流上完整保留教师增益，合成流上保留比例较低且随锚点年龄下降。在1 ms到达的实时回放中，同步大模型无法按时输出，而RESYNC在单CPU线程下至少99.4%的到达按时预测，中位时延0.35–0.62 ms，与紧凑模型相当或更快，并比同步大模型推理快7.9–17.7倍。
AI.conclusion: RESYNC适用于具备后台算力但每条观测有严格响应截止时间的流式预测场景，通过"异步大模型+无标签潜状态更新"实现精度与时延的折中；其收益在真实流上完整、在合成流上随陈旧度累积而衰减。

title: Report of the 8th LSVOS Challenge: Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Report of the MUMU track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge, held in conjunction with ECCV 2026. Project page: https://lsvos.github.io/mumu
summary: This report summarizes the Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding (MUMU) track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge, held in conjunction with ECCV 2026. MUMU asks for a single unified model that jointly performs multi-concept image tagging over quality, scene, and event vocabularies, open-vocabulary object detection, and concise image captioning, within a budget of 0.5B parameters and 8 GB of peak inference memory. Submissions are ranked by a weighted task score scaled by an efficiency factor. We describe the tasks, rules, and evaluation protocol, report the final results, and review the methods of the top three teams. All three leading solutions build on the compact Florence-2-base model, but extend it in different ways: lightweight tagging heads with cross-task inference refinement, a shared low-rank adapter trained on coverage-aware multi-source data with task-dependent decoding, and a training-free pipeline that maps captions to tags and applies detection test-time augmentation. The results show that a compact prompt-based vision-language model can serve all three outputs when supervision, decoding, and cross-task cues are designed for each task, while open-vocabulary detection on novel categories remains the main bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 本文是ECCV 2026第8届LSVOS挑战赛MUMU赛道的总结报告：在0.5B参数、8GB峰值显存约束下要求单一统一模型同时完成多概念图像打标、开放词表目标检测与简短图像描述，按加权任务分数乘以效率因子排名，前三名均基于Florence-2-base并以不同方式扩展。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型通常任务专用且规模庞大，难以在移动端内存与参数量预算内同时支持打标、检测与描述三类任务；MUMU赛道旨在检验紧凑统一多模态理解模型在受限资源下的可行性，并明确其性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 赛道设定统一模型需联合完成质量/场景/事件词表的多概念图像打标、开放词表检测和简短描述；评分采用加权任务分数乘以效率因子。前三方案分别为：(1) 在Florence-2-base上增加轻量打标头并进行跨任务推理精炼；(2) 使用共享低秩适配器，在覆盖感知的多源数据上训练，并采用任务相关解码；(3) 免训练流水线，将描述映射为标签并对检测施加测试时增强。
AI.result: 所有三支领先队伍均以紧凑的Florence-2-base为基础并取得最优成绩；实验表明，当监督信号、解码策略与跨任务线索针对各任务分别设计时，单一基于提示的视觉语言模型可同时输出三类结果。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑提示式视觉语言模型具备统一多任务多模态理解的可行性，但面向新类别的开放词表检测仍是主要瓶颈，是后续改进的核心方向。

title: HALight: Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Traffic Signal Control under Lane-Level Missing Observations
summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning has shown great promise for traffic signal control. However, most existing methods rely on two key assumptions: (i) agents are assumed to be homogeneous with unified observation/action spaces; (ii) full and reliable lane-level traffic observations are available to all agents. In practice, urban road networks exhibit substantial structural heterogeneity (e.g., lane configurations and phase designs), while sensor failures and incomplete detector coverage often result in missing incoming lane measurements. Such issues can severely impair coordination and destabilize learning. To address these challenges, we propose HALight, a communication-enhanced heterogeneous multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for traffic signal control under lane-level missing observations. HALight supports intersection-specific observation and action modeling to accommodate heterogeneous intersections, and incorporates a lightweight one-hop neighborhood communication module to enrich spatial context when lane-level observations are partially unavailable. Moreover, HALight adopts a sequential policy update scheme to improve coordination among heterogeneous agents. Experimental results on two real-world road networks demonstrate that HALight outperforms representative homogeneous and heterogeneous baselines in terms of traffic efficiency and convergence behavior. The code and datasets used in this work are available at https://github.com/Huchenkaii/HALight.

AI.tldr: 提出HALight——面向车道级观测缺失场景的通信增强异构多智能体强化学习信号控制框架，支持路口特定观测/动作建模、一跳邻域轻量通信与序贯策略更新，在真实路网上优于同质与异构基线。
AI.motivation: 现有方法假设智能体同质（统一观测/动作空间）且可获得完整可靠的车道级观测；而实际路网存在结构异构（车道配置、相位设计不同）以及传感器故障、检测器覆盖不全导致的入车道测量缺失，会损害协调并导致学习不稳定。
AI.method: HALight框架：1）路口特定的观测与动作建模，容纳异构交叉口；2）轻量一跳邻域通信模块，在车道级观测部分缺失时补充空间上下文；3）序贯策略更新机制，提升异构智能体间的协调性。
AI.result: 在两个真实道路网络上实验，HALight在交通效率和收敛行为上均优于代表性的同质与异构基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 面向异构路口与车道级观测缺失的现实条件，通过异构建模、邻域通信与序贯更新可有效提升多智能体信号控制的效率与学习稳定性；代码与数据集已开源。

title: A Disease-specific Retinal Aging Biomarker for Predicting Progression to Late Age-related Macular Degeneration
summary: Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) is a leading cause of irreversible vision loss in older adults. While chronological age is a primary risk factor, it inadequately reflects individual variations in retinal aging, limiting effective AMD risk stratification and timely intervention. Here, we propose and validate fundus-based AMD age (FAA), which quantifies disease-specific retinal aging in AMD and captures accelerated AMD-related retinal aging, thereby improving prognostic precision over chronological age. Trained on 36,782 images from 2,192 participants in the Age-Related Eye Disease Study (AREDS) dataset and validated across AREDS and AREDS2 cohorts, our model demonstrates significant improvements over traditional chronological age-based approaches. Specifically, integrating the proposed FAA into Cox proportional-hazards models significantly enhances prediction performance. FAA improved the C-index from 0.836 to 0.888 and reduced the 5-year Brier score from 0.050 to 0.046 in AREDS, with consistent gains observed in AREDS2 (C-index 0.715 to 0.756; 2-year Brier 0.078 to 0.076). FAA showed improved prognostic performance across the two datasets and under different phenotype definitions (reading center-defined vs. specialist-defined grading), supporting its potential utility for AMD risk stratification. These findings highlight the advantage of incorporating FAA into AMD risk prediction frameworks, supporting further evaluation of FAA for AMD risk stratification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证“眼底AMD年龄（FAA）”，用深度学习从眼底图像量化AMD特异性的视网膜衰老程度，并将其作为协变量纳入Cox比例风险模型，在AREDS与AREDS2队列中显著提升AMD进展预测精度。
AI.motivation: 实际年龄虽是AMD主要风险因素，但无法反映个体视网膜衰老的差异，导致风险分层不精确、干预时机难以把握。作者希望构建一个可捕捉“加速的AMD相关视网膜衰老”的影像学生物标志物，以超越实足年龄的预后判别能力。
AI.method: 提出FAA（fundus-based AMD age）：基于眼底图像训练的模型，将图像映射为疾病特异的“视网膜年龄”，并与实足年龄的差值表征加速衰老。模型在AREDS数据集的36,782张图像（2,192名受试者）上训练，在AREDS与AREDS2两个队列中外部/内部验证；将FAA作为预测因子加入Cox比例风险模型，以C-index与Brier评分评估增量预后价值，并在读片中心分级与专科医师分级两种表型定义下考察稳健性。
AI.result: 在AREDS中，纳入FAA使C-index由0.836提升至0.888，5年Brier评分由0.050降至0.046；AREDS2中C-index由0.715升至0.756，2年Brier由0.078降至0.076。两种表型定义下结果一致，显示跨队列、跨分级标准的稳定增益。
AI.conclusion: FAA可作为量化AMD相关加速视网膜衰老的影像标志物，显著改善AMD进展的风险分层与预后预测；将其纳入AMD风险预测框架具有潜在临床价值，值得进一步前瞻性评估。

title: DySR-GNN: Dynamic Sensor-Relationship Graph Neural Network for Root Cause Analysis in Automotive HiL Multivariate Time Series
summary: Root-cause analysis in automotive Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL) systems is challenging because faults can propagate across multiple interacting signals, making the most abnormal sensor different from the actual fault origin. This work proposes DySR-GNN, a Dynamic Sensor-Relationship Graph Neural Network for supervised multi-label root-cause identification in multivariate HiL time series. The approach jointly extracts temporal patterns within individual sensor signals and structural relationships across sensors. Each sensor is processed by a shared temporal encoder and combined with a trainable sensor-identity representation, from which a sparse relationship graph is reconstructed independently for every input window. This window-specific structure provides an explicit representation of the sensor relationships used for graph message passing and direct root-location prediction. Under a recording-disjoint evaluation protocol, the proposed model outperforms CNN--LSTM, Static GCN, Static GAT, and context-based variants, achieving a recording-level Macro-F1 of 0.9524, MCC of 0.9302, and strict exact-match accuracy of 0.8519. Analysis of the learned graphs reveals both persistent and state-dependent relationships among sensor variables. The results demonstrate that extracting adaptive relational structure alongside temporal representations can improve multi-label root-cause identification in complex automotive cyber--physical systems.

AI.tldr: 提出 DySR-GNN：为每个输入窗口独立重建稀疏传感器关系图，结合共享时序编码器与可训练传感器身份表示，做多标签根因定位，记录级 Macro-F1 0.9524。
AI.motivation: 汽车 HiL 系统中故障会沿多个相互作用的信号传播，导致"最异常的传感器"往往并非真实故障源，传统单点异常检测难以定位根因；同时故障在时间上呈动态、窗口级变化，静态传感器拓扑图无法刻画。
AI.method: DySR-GNN：每个传感器信号先经共享时序编码器提取时序模式，再与可训练的传感器身份表示（sensor-identity embedding）融合；据此对每个输入窗口独立重建稀疏传感器关系图，作为窗口专属的显式结构用于图消息传递，并直接输出多标签根因位置预测。
AI.result: 在记录不相交（recording-disjoint）评估协议下优于 CNN–LSTM、Static GCN、Static GAT 及基于上下文的变体；记录级 Macro-F1=0.9524，MCC=0.9302，严格完全匹配准确率=0.8519；对学到的图结构分析发现传感器变量间同时存在持久性与状态依赖的关系。
AI.conclusion: 在时序表示之外自适应提取关系结构，可有效提升复杂汽车信息物理系统中的多标签根因识别效果。

title: ElasticDino: Dense Semantic Features Using Elastic Deformations
summary: Vision transformers (ViTs) serve as the backbone for countless vision tasks, including dense prediction tasks, such as segmentation and depth estimation, even though the quadratic complexity of self-attention severely limits feature resolution and induces spatial artifacts. In this work, we introduce ElasticDino, a lightweight adapter which produces high-resolution feature maps, adhering to the fine details of the input image. As a key insight, we observe the consistency of artifacts across channels, and simultaneously resolve them to match the input image structure. Using a slim architecture based on spatial deformations, ElasticDino produces pixel-aligned, high-resolution feature maps efficiently. Leveraging deformations allows strictly preserving sharp semantics, and thereby avoiding the smoothness biases inherent to alternative approaches. Due to the absence of ground truth, we employ pixel-level semantic segmentation and depth estimation with linear heads to predict a set of downstream dense tasks, guiding the deformation process without leaking task-specific semantics into the model. We demonstrate superior accuracy over current methods on a range of popular dense task benchmarks, with better computational performance.

AI.tldr: ElasticDino 是一个轻量适配器，基于空间变形生成像素对齐的高分辨率特征图，用于修正 ViT 自注意力二次复杂度导致的低分辨率与空间伪影，并在密集预测任务上以更低计算量取得更优精度。
AI.motivation: ViT 作为密集预测任务（分割、深度估计）的主干时，自注意力的二次复杂度严重限制特征分辨率并引入空间伪影，现有方案在提升分辨率时往往牺牲细节或引入过度平滑偏差。
AI.method: 关键观察是伪影在通道间具有一致性，因此可同时统一消解并与输入图像结构对齐。据此设计基于空间变形（spatial deformation）的瘦身架构，高效输出像素对齐的高分辨率特征图，并以变形保持语义锐利、避免平滑偏差。因缺乏真值，采用带线性头的像素级语义分割与深度估计作为下游代理任务来引导变形过程，同时避免任务特定语义泄漏进模型。
AI.result: 在多个主流密集任务基准上取得优于现有方法的精度，且计算性能更佳。
AI.conclusion: 利用通道一致的伪影特性与空间变形，可在低计算开销下生成高分辨率、结构对齐的特征，为 ViT 密集预测提供轻量即插即用的增强方案。

title: Asymmetric Multimodal Learning with Decomposed JEPAs
summary:
Cross-modal alignment is the standard objective for building multimodal representations. We show that alignment as a \emph{sole} objective is lossy wherever modalities are informationally asymmetric---where neither can express what the other carries. Visual question answering is an obvious case: a question is a selective relational operator probing a dense visual field whose fine-grained features no query recovers, so what alignment preserves is not what the task requires. We prove an \textbf{Alignment Redundancy Bound}: alignment-only Dirichlet energy minimization retains at most the redundant information atom $\Red(Z; X_1, X_2)$, annihilating private modality-specific structure $\Unq(Z; X_m)$ and cross-modal synergy $\Syn(Z; X_1, X_2)$.
  We introduce \textbf{Decomposed JEPA (D-JEPA)}, which factorizes latents into an aligned shared core and private modality-specific fibers. The shared core retains most of the structure alignment targets; the private fibers recover what alignment discards, via contextual masked prediction and asymmetric cross-subspace independence. Under information asymmetry, alignment-only training undergoes catastrophic semantic collapse on compositional reasoning benchmarks, surviving only on binary queries. D-JEPA averts this collapse, substantially improving downstream accuracy over both alignment-only and alignment-with-reconstruction baselines, and restoring a positive multimodal synergy gap in place of the baseline's inverted gap. Information-theoretic audits confirm that D-JEPA recovers most of the mutual information available from a frozen backbone, and causal fiber-swap interventions demonstrate that the recovered information is causally localized in the private fibers.

AI.tldr: 论文指出仅以跨模态对齐作为唯一目标在多模态信息不对称时会丢失私有模态结构与跨模态协同信息，提出对齐冗余上界，并提出分解式JEPA（D-JEPA），将潜变量分解为共享核心与私有纤维，从而缓解语义坍塌并提升下游性能。
AI.motivation: 跨模态对齐是多模态表征学习的标准目标，但当模态间信息不对称（任一模态都无法表达另一模态所携带的信息）时，对齐作为唯一目标是有损的。VQA是典型场景：问题是探测稠密视觉场的选择性关系算子，细粒度特征无法被查询恢复，因此对齐所保留的信息并非任务所需。
AI.method: 1) 理论：证明对齐冗余上界——仅做对齐的Dirichlet能量最小化至多保留冗余信息原子Red(Z;X1,X2)，会湮灭私有模态特异结构Unq(Z;Xm)与跨模态协同Syn(Z;X1,X2)。2) 方法：D-JEPA将潜变量分解为对齐的共享核心与私有的模态特异纤维；共享核心保留对齐目标的大部分结构，私有纤维通过上下文掩码预测与非对称跨子空间独立性约束来恢复被对齐丢弃的信息。
AI.result: 在信息不对称条件下，仅对齐训练在组合推理基准上出现灾难性语义坍塌，仅在二值查询上存活；D-JEPA避免了坍塌，相对仅对齐与对齐+重建基线显著提升下游准确率，并将基线的负多模态协同差距扭转为正协同差距。信息论审计表明D-JEPA恢复了冻结骨干网络可提供的大部分互信息；因果纤维交换干预证明恢复的信息因果性地定位于私有纤维。
AI.conclusion: 对齐不应作为多模态表征学习的唯一目标；显式分解共享与私有子空间能在信息不对称场景下保留协同与模态特异信息，缓解语义坍塌，并获得可验证（信息论与因果干预）的增益。

title: AURA 2.0: From User-Driven Responses to Model-Initiated Conversations in Streaming Video
summary: Most AI assistants respond only when prompted, remaining silent even when events in the video stream offer meaningful opportunities for conversation. To move beyond purely user-driven interaction, we present AURA 2.0, a streaming video large language model that introduces three core upgrades to AURA. The key advance is Model-Initiated Conversation (MIC), which enables the model to identify topics worth discussing in the evolving visual stream and initiate conversations at appropriate moments without a user query. Stream-Aware Tool Calling (SATC) enables the model to invoke external tools using the current visual and conversational context and incorporate returned information into the ongoing interaction. Interactive Visual Grounding (IVG) supports visual grounding in both user inputs and model outputs. The model can identify objects marked by users on video frames and produce frame-aligned bounding boxes to link its responses to specific objects and regions. To develop these capabilities, we construct a dedicated streaming interaction dataset and adopt a three-stage training scheme to integrate the new behaviors with AURA's existing streaming interaction abilities. We further incorporate Long-Horizon Interaction Memory (LHIM) to maintain contextual continuity over extended video streams. Evaluations on public streaming benchmarks show that AURA 2.0 achieves leading performance among open-source streaming models, while targeted evaluations further validate its new interaction capabilities. We open-source the model weights and inference code.

AI.tldr: AURA 2.0 是一个流式视频大语言模型，通过模型主动发起对话（MIC）、流感知工具调用（SATC）和交互式视觉接地（IVG）三大升级，使助手能在视频流中主动发起并持续多轮交互，开源权重与推理代码。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 助手仅在用户提问时才响应，即使视频流中出现值得讨论的事件也保持沉默，交互仍完全由用户驱动，缺乏主动性与持续上下文能力。
AI.method: 在 AURA 基础上引入 MIC（识别值得讨论的话题并在合适时机主动发起对话）、SATC（基于当前视觉与对话上下文调用外部工具并将返回信息融入交互）、IVG（同时支持输入与输出端视觉接地，识别用户标注目标并输出帧对齐边界框）；构建专门的流式交互数据集，采用三阶段训练方案融合新行为与既有流式能力，并加入长时程交互记忆（LHIM）维持长视频流中的上下文连续性。
AI.result: 在公开流式视频基准上取得开源流式模型中的领先性能，针对性评测进一步验证了新增交互能力；模型权重与推理代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: AURA 2.0 将流式视频助手从被动应答推进到主动发起对话、工具调用与双向视觉接地的统一框架，并通过记忆机制保障长时程交互一致性。

title: Dataset Distillation via Drifting
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project Page: https://drifting-distillation.github.io/
summary: The task of dataset distillation concerns the learning of a small set of synthetic samples that can serve as an effective replacement for a large real dataset when used for downstream tasks. While many solutions have been proposed since the problem's inception, most of them primarily seek to optimize the distilled data with respect to a classifier. In this work, we propose a new distillation method that learns a set of samples such that they directly approximate the per-class data distribution. Specifically, we "drift" our distilled data in the latent space of a feature extractor such that they move both toward the real data and away from each other without using a classification objective. We find that our drifted data cover the real distribution significantly better than existing methods while still serving as powerful training samples for classification. Furthermore, we showcase our method's use as a visualization tool for better interpreting models and extend it beyond images to other modalities. Our work advances the frontier of dataset distillation, offering a novel synthesis method and proposing distribution-based metrics as a complementary evaluation. More broadly, our findings help address the growing need to understand both data and models by uncovering more about how they interact.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需分类目标的数据集蒸馏方法，通过在特征空间中"漂移"合成样本使其直接逼近真实数据的逐类分布，覆盖分布更优且仍可用于分类训练。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集蒸馏方法大多围绕某一分类器优化蒸馏数据，容易过拟合于特定模型与分类目标，未必能真实反映原始数据分布。
AI.method: 在特征提取器的隐空间中"漂移"蒸馏样本：一方面向真实数据靠拢，另一方面彼此远离（类内吸引、样本间排斥），全程不使用分类损失，从而直接近似逐类数据分布。
AI.result: 漂移后的数据对真实分布的覆盖显著优于现有方法，同时仍能作为强力的分类训练样本；该方法还可作为模型解释的可视化工具，并可从图像推广到其他模态。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为数据集蒸馏提供了新的合成思路，并提出基于分布的度量作为补充评估手段，有助于更深入理解数据与模型的交互关系。

title: Ropedia Xperience 2: A Gold Standard for Scaling Physical AI Environments and Behaviors
summary: Large foundation models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 have recently been shown to control robots directly from visual observations. They nevertheless remain brittle on long-horizon, contact-rich tasks in real-world environments. Further progress depends on two complementary resources: demonstrations of human behavior that supervise how tasks are performed, and interactive environments in which policies can be rolled out, evaluated, and improved in closed loop. Language models have advanced along well-characterized scaling laws; the corresponding question for physical AI is how capability scales with environments and behaviors, which first requires identifying which data to scale and how to produce and reuse such data continuously. To address this question, we introduce Ropedia Xperience 2, comprising 1,589 released metric-scale 3D scans and a collection of 4,230 egocentric recordings of 74 tasks (131 hours). We further show that each capture can be repurposed for robot learning: scenes are converted into physically interactive simulation environments, human motion is retargeted to whole-body robot trajectories, and additional robot behaviors are obtained through virtual teleoperation and automated long-horizon trajectory generation. We propose this joint capture of environments and behaviors as a gold standard for physical AI data collection, laying a data foundation for establishing scaling laws over environments and behaviors.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Ropedia Xperience 2 数据集，包含 1,589 个米制尺度 3D 扫描与覆盖 74 项任务、131 小时的 4,230 段第一人称人类演示，并提出"环境+行为"联合采集范式，通过场景转可交互仿真、人体动作重定向为全身机器人轨迹、虚拟遥操作与自动化长程轨迹生成来复用数据，为研究物理 AI 在"环境与行为"维度上的缩放律奠定数据基础。
AI.motivation: 大型基础模型（如 GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1）虽能直接从视觉观测控制机器人，但在真实环境中的长程、富接触任务上仍表现脆弱。进一步提升依赖两类互补资源：监督任务执行方式的人类行为演示，以及可部署、评估并闭环改进策略的交互式环境。语言模型已有清晰的缩放律，而物理 AI 的核心问题——能力如何随环境与行为规模增长——尚待回答，其前提是明确"该缩放哪些数据"以及如何持续生产与复用数据。
AI.method: 构建 Ropedia Xperience 2：采集 1,589 个已发布的米制尺度 3D 场景扫描与 4,230 段第一人称（egocentric）人类演示（74 项任务，131 小时）。每份采集均可被重用于机器人学习：将场景转换为物理可交互的仿真环境；将人体运动重定向为全身机器人轨迹；并通过虚拟遥操作与自动化长程轨迹生成获得额外的机器人行为数据。据此提出环境与行为联合采集作为物理 AI 数据采集的"黄金标准"。
AI.result: 释放了 1,589 个米制尺度 3D 扫描和 4,230 段覆盖 74 项任务的第一人称演示（131 小时）；验证了单一采集可多路复用为仿真环境、人体重定向机器人轨迹以及虚拟遥操作/自动生成的长程轨迹，展示了数据的高复用性。
AI.conclusion: 将环境与行为联合采集视为物理 AI 数据收集的黄金标准，可支撑在"环境规模"与"行为规模"两个维度上建立缩放律，为长程、富接触真实世界任务的可扩展学习提供数据基础。

title: GNN-Enhanced TCN Algorithms for ECG Anomaly Detection
comment: Follow-up to arXiv:2310.02774, which introduced a pipeline for an industrial dataset. A shortened version of that earlier paper appeared in the GSI 2025 proceedings. Here we extend the theoretical analysis and develop a pipeline tested on a benchmark dataset. Research conducted in 2025. Under journal peer review
summary: To a time series can be also given the structure of directed graph, opening the doors to the usage of graph neural networks (GNNs) in this context. In this paper we develop a new pipeline involving novel geometric deep learning models that merge the capabilities of ordinary TCNs with the ones of GNNs to solve an anomaly detection problem on electrocardiogram signals.

AI.tldr: 该文将时间序列建模为有向图，提出融合TCN与GNN能力的几何深度学习新流水线，用于心电图信号异常检测。
AI.motivation: 时间序列通常以序列方式处理，而将其表示为有向图可引入图神经网络的结构化建模能力，从而在心电图（ECG）异常检测中同时利用时序局部特征与图结构依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出一条新的处理流水线，采用新颖的几何深度模型，将时间卷积网络（TCN）的时序特征提取能力与图神经网络（GNN）的图结构建模能力相融合；输入时间序列被赋予有向图结构，并在ECG信号上执行异常检测。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果（如准确率、F1等指标），仅声明所提流水线可有效解决ECG异常检测任务。
AI.conclusion: 将时间序列转化为有向图并用TCN-GNN混合的几何深度学习架构建模，是ECG异常检测的一条可行且有前景的技术路线。

title: SALT: State-Aligned Low-Rank Transfer for Single-Temporal Cross-Dataset Structural Localization in Remote Sensing
comment: Accepted at the Third Workshop on Computer Vision for Geospatial Image Analysis (GeoCV), IEEE/CVF WACV 2027
summary: Change detection in remote sensing conventionally relies on spatially aligned bi-temporal imagery, which may be unavailable or unreliable in practical scenarios. Recent single-temporal approaches address this limitation by learning structural evidence, such as building regions, from a labeled source dataset and transferring it to unseen target imagery using only the current image. However, adaptation to the source dataset can over-specialize pretrained features and reduce their cross-dataset generalization, a risk that this paper argues is higher when the feature adaptation is parameterized independently of the states used for prediction. To address this issue, the current study introduces SALT, a State-Aligned Low-Rank Transfer framework. SALT keeps a DINOv3 backbone frozen and learns negative and positive structural states that both score each patch and, through State-Aligned Low-Rank Adaptation (SALA), span the rank-2 subspace in which patch features are corrected. Directional State Alignment supervises these corrections to raise the evidence of positive patches and lower that of negative ones, while Geometry Preservation limits changes to the pairwise relations among pretrained patch features. Experiments on LEVIR-CD and the WHU aerial building dataset show that, at the pixel level and in both transfer directions, SALT outperforms four baselines reproduced under a common source-only protocol, improving over the strongest reproduced baselines by 9.45 and 5.79 points in pixel-level AP and by 27.69 and 14.25 points in IoU (LEVIR-CD to WHU and WHU to LEVIR-CD, respectively), with only 0.068M trainable parameters and 40.2 ms per image. In order to facilitate reproducibility and further research, the source code of SALT is available at https://github.com/gthpapadopoulos/SALT

AI.tldr: 提出SALT（状态对齐低秩迁移）框架：冻结DINOv3骨干，学习正/负结构状态并用于打分与低秩修正，实现单时相跨数据集变化检测迁移。
AI.motivation: 传统变化检测依赖空间对齐的双时相影像，实际中常不可用；现有单时相方法从源域学习建筑等结构证据迁移到目标域，但源域适配易使预训练特征过特化、降低跨数据集泛化；论文进一步指出当特征适配的参数化与预测所用状态解耦时，该风险更高。
AI.method: SALT保持DINOv3骨干冻结；学习负/正结构状态，既对每个patch打分，又通过状态对齐低秩适配（SALA）张成秩2子空间用于修正patch特征；方向性状态对齐监督修正方向（提升正patch证据、降低负patch证据）；几何保持约束限制预训练patch特征间成对关系的变化。仅0.068M可训练参数。
AI.result: 在LEVIR-CD与WHU航拍建筑数据集上，统一source-only协议下两方向均优于4个复现基线：像素级AP分别提升9.45与5.79点，IoU分别提升27.69与14.25点（LEVIR-CD→WHU、WHU→LEVIR-CD）；推理40.2 ms/图。
AI.conclusion: 将低秩适配子空间与预测状态对齐可有效抑制源域过特化，在极少参数与低时延下显著提升单时相变化检测的跨数据集泛化，代码已开源。

title: Manifold Attracting Flow Matching: Physics-Constrained Sampling via Continuous Geometric Dynamics
summary: Generating scientific data under previously unseen equality constraints requires satisfying the prescribed constraints without destroying the physical structure learned from data. Existing inference-time approaches often enforce physical constraints by repeatedly correcting predicted endpoints, but such discrete corrections can distort learned generative structure and introduce unstable feedback. In this work, we propose Manifold Attracting Flow Matching (MAFM), which continuously evolves a persistent anchor through an ODE whose dynamics drive it analytically toward the constraint manifold. Specifically, its geometric correction preserves model-guided tangent motion while prescribing the normal motion to contract constraint violations toward the manifold. This construction separates model tracking from constraint attraction and provides theoretical guarantees for residual contraction and local feedback stabilization. Experiments across geometric and partial differential equation benchmarks demonstrate improved generation quality over variant constraint-guided baselines while maintaining low constraint residuals. MAFM provides a flexible framework for coordinating learned physical structure and explicit constraints through controllable sampling dynamics, without retraining the underlying generative model.

AI.tldr: 提出 Manifold Attracting Flow Matching（MAFM），用连续 ODE 驱动的持久锚点将采样轨迹解析地吸引至约束流形，在无需重训练的前提下同时保证物理约束满足与生成质量。
AI.motivation: 在未见过的等式约束下生成科学数据，需在满足给定约束的同时不破坏从数据中学到的物理结构。现有推理时方法通过反复修正预测端点来施加物理约束，此类离散修正会扭曲已学得的生成结构，并引入不稳定的反馈。
AI.method: MAFM 维护一个持久锚点，使其在 ODE 动力系统中连续演化，该动力学以解析方式将锚点驱向约束流形。几何修正中，切向运动保持模型引导的原有方向，法向运动被显式规定为使约束违反量向流形收缩；由此将"模型跟踪"与"约束吸引"解耦，并对残差收缩与局部反馈稳定性给出理论保证。
AI.result: 在几何任务与偏微分方程基准上，MAFM 相较多种约束引导的变体基线取得更优的生成质量，同时保持较低的约束残差。
AI.conclusion: MAFM 通过可控的采样动力学协调已学习的物理结构与显式约束，构成一个灵活框架，且无需对底层生成模型进行重训练。

title: Joint Null-Space Projection for Data-Free Model Merging
summary: Merging independently fine-tuned checkpoints into a single multi-task model requires no data, no labels, and no gradient steps. In practice the task vectors of different tasks interfere, and the standard remedies--averaging, magnitude pruning, sign election--operate entry by entry, ignoring that each delta induces a low-dimensional update on the hidden features it acts upon. We recast merging as a subspace interference problem. For every two-dimensional weight tensor we take the top-r right-singular subspace of each task's delta--the input directions along which that task moves the representation most--and remove from each task vector the component lying in the union of the other tasks' subspaces. The resulting Joint Null-Space Projection (JNSP) is closed-form and order-independent, needs no forward pass, and is defined entirely by the checkpoint set. On eight CLIP image-classification tasks JNSP merges ViT-B/16 experts to 89.45% average accuracy without using a single image, 11.88 points above the strongest parameter-wise training-free baseline (TIES-Merging, 77.57%), 14.22 above Task Arithmetic, and 0.98 above WUDI's data-free consensus merge (88.47%). The gain holds across three backbones on the independently trained TALL release (+10.8, +12.6, +9.1 over TIES for ViT-B/16, ViT-B/32, ViT-L/14) and replicates there at 89.20%; controls confirm the source--a single shared subspace instead of per-task ones loses 2.9 points, and a sequential variant collapses to 69.6%. On RoBERTa-large the same projection underperforms plain task arithmetic, which we report rather than hide. Code is available at https://github.com.

AI.tldr: 提出Joint Null-Space Projection (JNSP)，将多任务checkpoint合并重构为子空间干扰问题：用各任务delta的top-r右奇异子空间并集作零空间投影，去掉任务向量中的干扰分量；在CLIP/ViT-B/16八任务上无需任何图像即达89.45%平均精度。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练合并方法（参数平均、幅度剪枝、符号选举TIES等）均逐元素（entry-wise）操作，忽略了每个delta对隐特征施加的是低维更新，因而无法处理任务向量之间的干扰。
AI.method: 对每个二维权重张量，取各任务delta的top-r右奇异子空间（即该任务对表示影响最大的输入方向），构建其他任务子空间的并集，并从每个任务向量中减去落在该并集中的分量。JNSP为闭式解、与任务顺序无关、无需前向传播，仅由checkpoint集合定义。
AI.result: CLIP八任务图像分类：ViT-B/16专家合并至89.45%，比最强逐参数免训练基线TIES-Merging（77.57%）高11.88点，比Task Arithmetic高14.22点，比WUDI无数据共识合并（88.47%）高0.98点；在TALL独立训练权重上三个骨干均稳定提升（ViT-B/16、B/32、L/14较TIES分别+10.8、+12.6、+9.1），复现89.20%；消融显示单一共享子空间替代逐任务子空间损失2.9点，顺序化变体跌至69.6%。RoBERTa-large上该投影弱于朴素Task Arithmetic（如实报告）。
AI.conclusion: 将合并视为子空间干扰并以联合零空间投影消除干扰，是免数据、闭式、顺序无关的有效方案，在视觉CLIP模型上显著优于逐元素基线；但其优势依赖架构/任务特性，在RoBERTa-large上不成立，适用边界需进一步刻画。

title: Edge-Gradient Augmentation under Reinforcement Learning for Temporal Graph
summary: Temporal link prediction is critical for understand- ing dynamic interactions in evolving networks, informing appli- cations ranging from social network analysis to recommendation systems. Existing methods typically rely on raw temporal graph data, often neglecting explicit edge-change information that can significantly improve predictive performance. To address this gap, we propose edge-gradient reinforced learning (EG-RL), a framework that explicitly encodes edge-gradient events (edge births and deaths) through dedicated node and link encoding modules. EG-RL uses a policy-driven reinforcement-learning mechanism to dynamically select and augment the most infor- mative edge snapshots, guided by critic-based feedback to opti- mize prediction accuracy. The model comprises distinct modules for node encoding, link encoding, token mixing, and channel mixing, integrated through global pooling and followed by a two-layer multilayer perceptron classifier. Extensive experiments on multiple dynamic graph datasets demonstrate substantial gains in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve and average precision. Ablation studies further confirm the necessity of adaptive edge-gradient augmentation and validate the effectiveness of the proposed encoding and reinforcement- learning mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 提出EG-RL框架，显式编码边的"梯度事件"（边生与边死），并用强化学习策略动态选择最有信息量的边快照以提升时序链路预测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有时序链路预测方法多直接使用原始时序图数据，忽视了能显著提升预测性能的显式边变化信息（边结构增删），导致性能受限。
AI.method: 1）将边梯度事件（edge births 与 edge deaths）显式建模，通过专门的节点编码模块与链路编码模块进行编码；2）采用策略驱动的强化学习机制，在critic反馈引导下动态选取并增强最具信息量的边快照；3）模型由节点编码、链路编码、token mixing、channel mixing 等模块组成，经全局池化整合后接两层MLP分类器。
AI.result: 在多个动态图数据集上，ROC-AUC与平均精度（AP）均取得显著提升；消融实验验证了自适应边梯度增强的必要性，以及所提编码机制与强化学习机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 显式边梯度信息结合强化学习式自适应增强可有效改善时序链路预测；但其增强策略的训练开销与在更大规模、更稀疏动态图上的泛化性仍需进一步评估。

title: TuMAP: A Dual-View, Morphotype-Aware Pathomics Pipeline for Quantifying Renal Tubular Remodeling
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE ISBI 2027
summary: Quantifying disease-associated renal tubular remodeling is challenging because tubular appearances are heterogeneous. We introduce TuMAP (Tubular Morphotype-Aware Pathomics), a pipeline combining (1) dual-view foundation-model representations and provisional morphotype annotation, (2) compositional and within-morphotype pathomics, and (3) patient-level statistical inference. From 456,158 tubules in 358 PAS-stained kidney biopsy slides, TuMAP identified eight image-based morphotypes, seven of which showed stable subsampling assignments. Across 219 patients in six diagnostic groups, diabetic nephropathy (DN) and tubulointerstitial nephritis/acute tubular injury (TIN/ATI) each differed from minimal change disease in seven morphotype proportions, while IgA nephropathy differed in six. DN showed reduced nuclear solidity and increased eccentricity across all eight morphotypes. Area-normalized nuclear density exposed additional within-morphotype differences. TuMAP provides a framework for separating changes in tubular morphotype composition from phenotypic differences within morphotypes.

AI.tldr: TuMAP是面向PAS染色肾活检切片的管状形态型感知病理组学流程，从456,158个肾小管中识别出8种图像形态型（7种亚采样稳定），并在219例患者中揭示糖尿病肾病等疾病在形态型组成与形态型内部表型上的差异。
AI.motivation: 肾小管形态异质性强，传统的定量方法难以刻画疾病相关的肾小管重塑，也缺乏将"组成变化"与"形态型内部表型差异"区分开来的分析框架。
AI.method: 提出TuMAP三步流程：(1) 双视图基础模型表征＋临时形态型标注；(2) 组成性病理组学与形态型内部病理组学；(3) 患者层面统计推断。数据为358张PAS染色肾活检切片、456,158个肾小管、219例患者（6个诊断组）。
AI.result: 识别出8种图像形态型，其中7种亚采样归属稳定；与微小病变相比，糖尿病肾病(DN)和肾小管间质性肾炎/急性肾小管损伤(TIN/ATI)各有7种形态型比例不同，IgA肾病有6种；DN在全部8种形态型中均表现为核实度降低、偏心率增大；面积归一化核密度进一步揭示形态型内部的额外差异。
AI.conclusion: TuMAP提供了可分离"形态型组成改变"与"形态型内表型差异"的量化框架，提升了对肾小管重塑异质性的刻画能力。

title: From Data to Wisdom: Rethinking AI Through an Epistemic Lens
summary: This paper proposes the Data-to-Wisdom Epistemic Architecture for AI (EAAI), a conceptual framework treating Data, Information, Knowledge, Understanding and Wisdom as five distinct but recursively interacting epistemic functions: observation, contextual interpretation, modeling and prediction, critical evaluation and informed judgment. Two observations motivate it: sequential readings of the Knowledge Pyramid obscure how these functions interact, and a targeted review of ten Bayesian reference books finds that prior distributions are defined mathematically while "prior information" and "prior knowledge" are not consistently distinguished as epistemic categories. A Bayesian interpretation relates the likelihood, prior and posterior distributions, posterior prediction, model checking and decision analysis to the five functions, without limiting EAAI to Bayesian systems. Extending "prior" in an epistemic sense, the paper distinguishes five kinds of prior context that can shape the model, the likelihood, the prior, evaluation and action. Three worked applications -- quantitative financial risk, actuarial modeling in health insurance and agentic AI for medical reimbursement claims -- show how EAAI structures the analysis of model assumptions, evidence interpretation, validation, dependencies and decision consequences, separating the prediction of a risk, the appraisal of its reliability and the justification of action. It draws implications for AI and machine learning, including evaluation by function, treating intermediate model outputs as evidence open to challenge and separating generation from appraisal, and compares EAAI with work on DIKW, Bayesian workflow, AI evaluation and risk governance. Its contributions are an epistemic vocabulary with recursive relationships, a more accessible reading of Bayesian methodology, a typology of prior context and clearer methodological terminology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"面向AI的数据到智慧认知架构"（EAAI），将数据、信息、知识、理解和智慧视为五种递归交互的认知功能，并以贝叶斯方法为参照，区分五类"先验语境"，通过三个应用案例说明该架构如何分离风险预测、可靠性评估与行动论证。
AI.motivation: 两点动机：一是知识金字塔的线性（顺序）解读掩盖了各认知层次之间的交互作用；二是对十本贝叶斯参考书的定向综述发现，先验分布被数学化定义，而"先验信息"与"先验知识"未被一致地区分为认知范畴。
AI.method: 概念性框架研究。将DIKW五层重构为观察、语境解释、建模与预测、批判性评估、明智判断五种认知功能；用贝叶斯解释把似然、先验、后验、后验预测、模型检验与决策分析映射到这五种功能（但不限于贝叶斯系统）；并将"先验"扩展为认知意义上的五类先验语境，分别作用于模型、似然、先验、评估与行动。
AI.result: 三个实例（量化金融风险、健康险精算建模、医疗报销理赔的智能体AI）表明，EAAI能结构化地分析模型假设、证据解释、验证、依赖关系与决策后果，把"风险预测""可靠性评价""行动正当性论证"三者分离开来。文中还给出对AI/机器学习的启示：按功能进行评估、把中间模型输出视为可被质疑的证据、将生成与评价分离，并与DIKW、贝叶斯工作流、AI评估与风险治理研究进行了比较。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于：一套含递归关系的认知词汇体系、一种更易理解的贝叶斯方法论解读、一份先验语境类型学，以及更清晰的方法学术语。框架为概念性而非实证验证。

title: Predicting Ethanol Drinking Status from Nonhuman Primate Liver Histology: A Proof of Concept for Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning in Few-Shot Vision-Language Modeling
comment: 3 pages, 2 figures. Accepted for publication in the proceedings of IEEE BIBM 2026. The code is publicly available: https://github.com/Advanced-Vision-and-Learning-Lab/ALD_VLM
summary: Combining vision-language models (VLMs) with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) offers a promising approach to few-shot whole-slide image (WSI) classification in computational pathology. This study evaluates this approach for predicting ethanol drinking status from nonhuman primate liver histology. Adapters are evaluated against non-PEFT configurations on a subset of the Monkey Alcohol Tissue Research Resource (MATRR). All evaluated PEFT configurations achieve higher mean balanced accuracy than the non-PEFT baselines. For example, in the four-shot setting, attention-based multiple instance learning (ABMIL) alone achieves 43.5% mean balanced accuracy, compared with 78.1% after adding an adapter. Qualitative attention analysis shows that textual pathway adaptations produce localized attention heatmaps, while visual pathway adaptations produce more diffuse ones. A pathologist's review identified similar histological features across adaptations.

AI.tldr: 研究将视觉语言模型（VLM）与参数高效微调（PEFT）结合用于计算病理学的少样本全切片图像（WSI）分类，并以非人灵长类肝脏组织学预测乙醇饮用状态为任务进行评测。结果表明所有PEFT配置的平衡准确率均优于非PEFT基线，且文本通路与视觉通路适配会产生不同形态的注意力热图。
AI.motivation: 少样本WSI分类在计算病理学中数据稀缺，VLM+PEFT被视为有前景的方案，但缺乏系统的实证评估；同时，不同适配通路对模型注意力行为的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 在Monkey Alcohol Tissue Research Resource（MATRR）数据子集上，将Adapter与多种非PEFT配置进行对比，基于ABMIL等MIL架构做少样本分类评测；并进行定性注意力分析，比较文本通路与视觉通路适配生成的注意力热图；最后由病理学家复核各适配方案所关注的组​​织学特征。
AI.result: 所有PEFT配置的平均平衡准确率均高于非PEFT基线；四样本（4-shot）设置下，单独ABMIL为43.5%，加入Adapter后提升至78.1%。注意力分析显示文本通路适配产生更局域化的热图，视觉通路适配则更弥散；病理学家在两种适配下识别出相似的组织学特征。
AI.conclusion: VLM结合PEFT可显著提升少样本WSI分类性能，且不同适配通路的可解释性表现存在差异，为计算病理学的少样本场景提供了有效方案。

title: On the Difficulty of Sequence-Level Supervised Learning for Autoregressive Language Models
summary: During the supervised learning phase, autoregressive language models are typically trained by minimizing the negative log-likelihood of the training data, which decomposes as a sum of token-level cross-entropies via teacher forcing. This objective is simple and efficient but potentially suffers from so-called exposure bias: a mismatch between the way the model is trained and the way it is used at inference time. Can we instead design sequence-level loss functions that incorporate inference-time decoding procedures, such as greedy decoding or autoregressive sampling? We show that two natural attempts lead to loss functions that are fundamentally flawed: unbounded below. We further show that these two flawed loss functions are intimately connected: using autoregressive Gumbel tricks, the sampling based loss is the expected greedy loss under Gumbel perturbations. Since the pathology stems from the dependence of the decoded sequence on the model parameters, we analyze the update direction obtained by applying a stop gradient on the sampling procedure, leading to a moment matching direction. While it is not the gradient of any loss function, we prove that it defines a valid descent direction in function space for the autoregressive negative log-likelihood. Despite these theoretical insights, the moment matching direction suffers from high variance. We conclude that teacher forcing may well be ``all you need'' for supervised learning of autoregressive models.

AI.tldr: 论文分析了两类将推理期解码过程（贪心解码、自回归采样）纳入损失的序列级目标，证明二者下界无界、根本性失效，并揭示其相互联系；进而用stop-gradient导出的矩匹配方向虽为自回归负对数似然在函数空间中的合法下降方向，却方差过大，故结论是监督学习阶段teacher forcing可能已足够。
AI.motivation: 自回归语言模型监督训练以token级交叉熵（teacher forcing）为目标，简单高效但存在曝光偏差：训练与推理（贪心解码/自回归采样）不匹配。作者试图回答：能否设计把推理期解码过程直接嵌入的序列级损失来消除该偏差。
AI.method: 构造两类以解码过程为输入的序列级损失（基于贪心解码的损失与基于采样的损失），分析其优化性质；借助自回归Gumbel技巧建立二者联系；对采样过程施加stop-gradient以切断解码序列对参数的依赖，导出矩匹配更新方向，并在函数空间中分析其与自回归负对数似然的关系；进一步分析该方向的方差。
AI.result: （1）两种自然构造的序列级损失均下界无界，属根本性缺陷；（2）二者紧密相关：在Gumbel扰动下，采样损失的期望等于贪心损失，即采样损失是Gumbel扰动下贪心损失的期望；（3）stop-gradient导出的矩匹配方向虽非任何损失的梯度，但被证明是自回归负对数似然在函数空间中的有效下降方向；（4）该方向方差很高，实践中不可用。
AI.conclusion: 直接以解码过程构造序列级损失存在原理性障碍，stop-gradient式的矩匹配虽理论可行但方差过大；因此对于自回归模型的监督学习，teacher forcing可能"就是全部所需"。

title: STeP-C: Real-Time Neural Compression for Distributed Fiber-Optic Sensing at Scale
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027 (Applications Track). 10 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables
summary: Distributed fiber-optic sensing (DFOS) technologies such as Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) generate continuous, high-resolution spatio-temporal data at rates exceeding hundreds of megabytes per second, creating severe challenges for real-time storage and transmission. While neural compression methods can achieve strong rate-distortion performance on sensing data, prior approaches either require per-segment retraining incompatible with streaming, or have only been validated offline. None have been demonstrated end-to-end on a continuously streaming DAS acquisition system at scale. We present STeP-C (Spatio-Temporal Predictive Compression), a neural compression framework that decouples spatial encoding, temporal prediction, and entropy-optimized residual coding, trained end-to-end with a rate-distortion objective motivated by conditional entropy reduction. Critically, we identify entropy coding as the dominant bottleneck for streaming deployment. We address it through GPU-side symbol computation, cached probability tables, and parallel GIL-free arithmetic coding, together with FP16 inference and batched entropy coding, enabling a full real-time pipeline built around a GPU ring buffer. We validate this pipeline on a live DAS testbed, achieving a 98.85% file size reduction at 31.04 dB full-band PSNR and an average throughput of 535 MB/s, exceeding the 324 MB/s requirement for 1 kHz, 81 km DAS streams. We further show that STeP-C substantially outperforms conventional codecs at practical streaming bitrates, can be applied to unseen channel ranges within the same acquisition system without retraining, and largely maintains downstream detector consistency, with 96.62% high-confidence class agreement and 100% Jaccard similarity on detected event types.

AI.tldr: 提出STeP-C神经压缩框架，解耦空间编码、时间预测与熵优化残差编码，通过GPU侧符号计算、概率表缓存、无GIL并行算术编码等工程优化，实现DFOS/DAS流式数据的实时压缩，在实测平台上达到98.85%体积压缩、31.04 dB全频带PSNR、535 MB/s吞吐。
AI.motivation: DFOS（如DAS）以数百MB/s速率产生连续高分辨率时空数据，实时存储与传输压力巨大。既有神经压缩方法要么需要逐段重训练而无法流式处理，要么仅在离线场景验证，尚未在规模化连续流式DAS采集系统上完成端到端验证。
AI.method: STeP-C将压缩解耦为空间编码、时间预测和熵优化残差编码，并以条件熵削减为动机的率失真目标端到端训练。作者指出熵编码是流式部署的主要瓶颈，采用GPU端符号计算、缓存概率表、无GIL并行算术编码，配合FP16推理与批量熵编码，构建基于GPU环形缓冲区的全实时流水线。
AI.result: 在实时DAS试验台上实现98.85%文件体积缩减、31.04 dB全频带PSNR、平均535 MB/s吞吐，超过1 kHz、81 km DAS流所需的324 MB/s；在实用流式码率下显著优于传统编解码器；可在同一采集系统内对未见通道范围免重训练泛化；下游检测器一致性为96.62%高置信类别一致、事件类型Jaccard相似度100%。
AI.conclusion: STeP-C是首个在规模化连续流式DAS采集系统上端到端实时运行的神经压缩方案，证明熵编码工程优化是流式部署的关键，且在压缩率、重建质量、吞吐与下游任务保真度上同时满足实用要求。

title: Interpretable machine learning diagnosis of degradation mechanisms in lead-free $RbSn_{0.5}Ge_{0.5}I_{3}$ solar cells from temperature- and illumination-dependent electrical measurements
summary: Machine learning coupled with device simulation is widely used to optimize thin-film solar cells, but almost exclusively in the forward direction, from device parameters to predicted performance. The inverse problem encountered after fabrication, namely identifying the mechanism that limits a given device, is still addressed by manual inspection of characterization data.
