In this work, both directions are examined for lead-free $RbSn_{0.5}Ge_{0.5}I_{3}$ solar cells using approximately 42,000 SCAPS-1D simulations. Replacing the Spiro-OMeTAD hole transport layer with CuI increases the simulated power conversion efficiency from 19.6\% to 21.6\%, almost entirely through the fill factor. Surrogate models trained and tested on a factorial parameter grid substantially overstate their predictive accuracy. An XGBoost regressor attains $R^2 = 0.9997$ on held-out grid points but only 0.58 on independently sampled devices, whereas training on a Latin hypercube design of comparable size restores $R^2 = 0.995$. For the inverse problem, a multi-label classifier identifies which of six degradation mechanisms are present from simulated temperature- and illumination-dependent open-circuit-voltage measurements. It achieves a macro $F_1$ score of 0.938, compared to 0.687 for a calibrated physics-rule baseline. The classifier does not, however, generalize to combinations of mechanisms absent from the training set.

AI.tldr: 该文以约42,000次SCAPS-1D仿真同时研究正向（参数→性能）与逆向（表征数据→机理）两个方向：CuI替代Spiro-OMeTAD使效率由19.6%提升至21.6%；并揭示因子网格训练的代理模型严重高估精度，而拉丁超立方设计与多标签分类器可有效解决逆向识别问题。
AI.motivation: 机器学习与器件仿真结合优化薄膜太阳能电池几乎全是正向预测，而制备后诊断"何种机理限制器件"的逆向问题仍依赖对表征数据的人工判读，缺乏自动化方法。
AI.method: 对无铅RbSn0.5Ge0.5I3电池开展约42,000次SCAPS-1D仿真；比较Spiro-OMeTAD与CuI空穴传输层；训练XGBoost回归代理模型，并对比因子参数网格与拉丁超立方设计的泛化性；构建多标签分类器，从模拟的温度与光照依赖Voc测量中识别六种退化机理，并与校准的物理规则基线对比。
AI.result: CuI替代Spiro-OMeTAD使模拟PCE由19.6%升至21.6%，提升几乎全部来自填充因子；XGBoost在因子网格留出点上R²=0.9997，但在独立采样器件上仅0.58，改用同等规模拉丁超立方设计后R²恢复至0.995；多标签分类器macro-F1=0.938，显著优于物理规则基线的0.687。
AI.conclusion: 代理模型的精度高度依赖采样设计，因子网格会低估实际误差；逆向多标签分类可高精度识别单一或已见组合的退化机理，但对训练集未出现的机理组配不具备泛化能力。

title: HiVE-VQA: Hierarchical Interaction via Volumetric Embedding for Video Quality Assessment
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027, 11 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables
summary: The proliferation of user-generated video content has made accurate and robust no-reference video quality assessment (NR-VQA) a highly important challenge. Existing research increasingly relies on architecturally complex multi-branch pipelines or computationally intensive fine-tuning of single-branch backbones. In this paper, we investigate whether a single frozen video foundation model can serve as an effective NR-VQA backbone, and propose HiVE-VQA, the first framework (to our knowledge) to apply a JEPA-based video encoder to this task. HiVE-VQA extracts token grids from multiple depths of a pre-trained V-JEPA 2.1 encoder and stacks them into a hierarchical spatio-temporal volume, which a compact 3D convolutional head fuses across its layer, spatial, and temporal axes, combining low-level distortion cues from shallow layers with the semantic and temporal context captured at greater depths. The encoder remains frozen throughout, so only the head is trained: 5.2M parameters (5.7\% of the total), with no auxiliary multi-modal models and an inference cost that is invariant to video resolution. Trained solely on LSVQ and evaluated without any fine-tuning, HiVE-VQA outperforms 17 state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods in SROCC and PLCC on both intra-dataset (LSVQ-test, LSVQ-1080p) and cross-dataset (KoNViD-1k, LIVE-VQC) benchmarks. These results indicate that hierarchical, depth-wise fusion of features from a single frozen video foundation model provides a more effective and efficient basis for NR-VQA than task-specific multi-network fusion. Code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/RobHam99/HiVE-VQA.

AI.tldr: 提出HiVE-VQA，首个将基于JEPA的视频编码器（V-JEPA 2.1）用于无参考视频质量评估的框架：冻结编码器、从多深度提取token网格堆叠为分层时空体，由紧凑3D卷积头沿层/空间/时间轴融合，仅训练5.2M参数即可超越17个SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有NR-VQA研究依赖结构复杂的多分支流水线，或对单分支骨干进行高算力微调；作者希望验证单一冻结视频基础模型能否作为有效的NR-VQA骨干，以避免任务专用的多网络融合带来的复杂度与开销。
AI.method: 采用预训练V-JEPA 2.1编码器并全程冻结，从其多个深度层提取token网格，堆叠成层次化时空体（hierarchical spatio-temporal volume）；用紧凑3D卷积头沿层、空间、时间三个轴进行融合，结合浅层失真线索与深层语义及时间上下文；仅训练头部（5.2M参数，占总参数5.7%），不使用辅助多模态模型，推理开销与视频分辨率无关；仅在LSVQ上训练。
AI.result: 在LSVQ-test、LSVQ-1080p（域内）及KoNViD-1k、LIVE-VQC（跨域）基准上，无任何微调情况下，SROCC与PLCC均优于17个SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 单一冻结视频基础模型的分层深度融合特征，比任务专用的多网络融合更适合作为NR-VQA的更有效、更高效的基础；代码与权重已开源。

title: Beyond Binary Classification: Multiclass Machine Learning for Diabetes and Prediabetes Risk Prediction Using NHANES
summary: Detecting diabetes risk early is important for preventing disease progression. Most existing machine learning approaches focus on binary classification, which limits their ability to capture intermediate risk states such as prediabetes. We develop a supervised learning framework to classify adults as normal, prediabetic, or diabetic using National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey data. The framework uses routinely collected demographic, clinical, and lifestyle variables from 15,356 adults, with glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) used only to define labels and excluded from input features to prevent leakage. We compare conventional machine learning and transformer-based models and examine two binary formulations: normal versus prediabetes, and normal versus combined prediabetes and diabetes. Models are evaluated on a held-out test set using precision, sensitivity, specificity, and F1 score. In the multiclass setting, performance is broadly consistent across models, with accuracy up to 0.72 and macro-averaged F1 of 0.70. Prediabetes remains the most challenging class, with F1 scores of 0.54 to 0.56 for conventional models and 0.53 to 0.55 for transformers, reflecting its overlap with both neighboring states. When the task is reduced to normal versus prediabetes, F1 scores rise modestly to 0.62 to 0.64. A more substantial improvement is observed under a broader screening formulation combining prediabetes and diabetes, with F1 scores of 0.73 to 0.74 across all models. These findings suggest that feature overlap along the biological continuum between normal and diabetic states contributes more to the difficulty of prediabetes detection than model architecture. Multiclass prediction provides a more clinically informative representation of metabolic risk progression but highlights a trade-off between clinically meaningful stratification and predictive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 基于NHANES数据构建三分类（正常/糖尿病前期/糖尿病）监督学习框架，发现特征重叠而非模型架构是糖尿病前期检测的主要难点。
AI.motivation: 早期识别糖尿病风险对防止疾病进展很重要，但现有机器学习方法多聚焦二分类，难以刻画糖尿病前期等中间风险状态。
AI.method: 使用NHANES中15,356名成人的常规人口学、临床与生活方式变量；HbA1c仅用于定义标签并从输入特征中剔除以防泄漏；比较传统机器学习与Transformer模型，覆盖三分类及两种二分类（正常vs糖尿病前期、正常vs前期+糖尿病）设定；在留出测试集上以精确率、灵敏度、特异度、F1评价。
AI.result: 三分类性能跨模型基本一致，准确率最高0.72、宏平均F1为0.70；糖尿病前期最难，F1在传统模型为0.54–0.56、Transformer为0.53–0.55；正常vs前期F1略升至0.62–0.64；正常vs前期+糖尿病F1达0.73–0.74。
AI.conclusion: 正常与糖尿病状态间生物连续体上的特征重叠对糖尿病前期检测难度的贡献大于模型架构；多分类预测更具临床信息价值，但存在临床意义分层与预测精度之间的权衡。

title: SpotDiff: A Plug-and-Play Framework for Zero-Shot Change Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: Remote sensing change detection usually relies on large collections of temporally aligned, pixel-level annotations, which limits its scalability across regions, imaging platforms and application domains. Recent zero-shot approaches reduce the need for supervision, but they often localize fine-grained changes poorly because their features are coarse or inconsistent across time. We present SpotDiff, a training-free, plug-and-play framework for zero-shot change detection built by composing complementary vision foundation models. SpotDiff uses DINOv3 for semantically robust features, AnyUp to reconstruct them at pixel resolution, and SAM 3 for text-guided region-of-interest proposals, which an inference-time multi-scale strategy (SWIMS) makes reliable on small objects. Change is then measured by comparing the reconstructed features of the two dates inside the proposed regions, with no learnable components, fine-tuning or change labels. To our knowledge, SpotDiff is the first change detection method to use a universal feature upsampler, which alone adds 13.8 F1 over bilinear upsampling of the same features. On LEVIR-CD, SpotDiff reaches 82.46 F1, 2.06 points above the strongest prior training-free method, and on the multi-class SECOND benchmark it improves building change detection by 10.3 IoU and the six-class average by 2.2 IoU. Qualitative results on PlanetScope (3 m) and Sentinel-2 (10 m) imagery show that the same pipeline transfers across resolutions without modification. Our results indicate that composing modern foundation models is an effective route to scalable, label-free change detection.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、即插即用的零样本变化检测框架SpotDiff，通过组合DINOv3、AnyUp与SAM 3实现跨分辨率、无标签的高精度变化检测。
AI.motivation: 传统遥感变化检测依赖大规模时相对齐的像素级标注，难以跨区域、跨平台、跨领域扩展；现有零样本方法虽减少监督需求，但因特征粗糙或跨时不一致，细粒度变化定位效果差。
AI.method: 训练无关的组合式框架：用DINOv3提取语义鲁棒特征，用AnyUp将其重建到像素分辨率，用SAM 3生成文本引导的感兴趣区域提议，并辅以推理时多尺度策略SWIMS提升小目标可靠性；在提议区域内比较两时相重建特征来度量变化，不含可学习组件、微调或变化标签。
AI.result: 首次将通用特征上采样器用于变化检测，单项即较双线性上采样提升13.8 F1；LEVIR-CD上达82.46 F1，领先最强已有免训练方法2.06点；SECOND上建筑变化检测IoU提升10.3，六类平均提升2.2 IoU。
AI.conclusion: 在PlanetScope(3 m)与Sentinel-2(10 m)影像上的定性结果显示同一流程无需修改即可跨分辨率迁移，表明组合现代基础模型是实现可扩展、无标签变化检测的有效途径。

title: Class-Competence Aggregation: Output-Layer Routing for Federated Multiclass DDoS Detection under Class-Concentrated Non-IID Data
summary: Federated learning over distributed intrusion-detection sensors naturally produces \emph{class-concentrated} non-IID data, where an entire attack class is held by a single client and absent elsewhere. We show this collapses federated averaging in a specific, localized way: the output layer holds one decision boundary per class, and when a class's aggregation weight comes overwhelmingly from clients that have never seen it, its neuron receives an active anti-signal rather than mere dilution, collapsing to zero. On CIC-DDoS2019, standard FedAvg drives the concentrated LDAP class to $0.00 \pm 0.00\%$ F1 across every seed. We propose Class-Competence Aggregation (CCA), which aggregates the output layer per class using each client's own locally reported validation F1 as the weight, while hidden layers remain under standard size-weighted FedAvg. CCA requires no server-held auxiliary data and adds only one F1 scalar per class per round beyond the feature-scaling and class-count exchanges common to any federated pipeline. On our primary CNN-LSTM architecture, CCA alone raises LDAP F1 from $0\%$ to $84.83 \pm 1.65\%$, and the full method reaches $91.64 \pm 0.57\%$ macro F1, closing the federated-to-centralized gap from $-42.53$ to $-4.05$ points. Benchmarked against four other federated methods under identical partitions and seeds, CCA is the only one that recovers the concentrated class substantially and reliably; a $178\times$ smaller MLP shows the same qualitative recovery, though less completely, confirming the effect holds across architecture scale even as its magnitude varies. Results are validated across three seeds and replicated on a second dataset, CICIDS2017.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示类集中式 non-IID 数据会使 FedAvg 的类别神经元坍缩至零，并提出按类用客户端局部验证 F1 加权聚合输出层的 CCA 方法，显著恢复集中类别性能。
AI.motivation: 分布式入侵检测传感器上的联邦学习天然产生"类集中"non-IID 数据（某一攻击类仅存在于单个客户端）。作者发现这会以特定且局部的方式使联邦平均失效：输出层每类有一个决策边界神经元，当某类的聚合权重主要来自从未见过该类的客户端时，该神经元收到的是主动反向信号而非单纯稀释，导致其坍缩为零。在 CIC-DDoS2019 上，标准 FedAvg 使集中的 LDAP 类在所有随机种子下 F1 均为 0.00±0.00%。
AI.method: 提出类胜任度聚合（Class-Competence Aggregation, CCA）：仅对输出层按类聚合，权重采用各客户端本地报告的该类验证 F1；隐藏层仍使用标准按样本量加权的 FedAvg。CCA 无需服务器端辅助数据，每轮每类仅额外传输一个 F1 标量，另加常规的特征缩放与类别数交换。
AI.result: 在 CNN-LSTM 主架构上，仅 CCA 即将 LDAP 的 F1 从 0% 提升至 84.83±1.65%，完整方法达到 91.64±0.57% 的宏平均 F1，将联邦与集中式差距从 -42.53 点缩小至 -4.05 点。在相同划分与种子下与四种联邦方法对比，CCA 是唯一能大幅且稳定恢复集中类别的方法。小 178 倍的 MLP 呈现相同定性恢复（幅度较小），说明效应跨架构规模成立。结果经三个种子验证，并在 CICIDS2017 上复现。
AI.conclusion: 类集中 non-IID 导致输出层神经元坍缩是 FedAvg 失效的机理根源；用客户端自身类胜任度（验证 F1）对输出层按类加权即可低成本、无需辅助数据地有效缓解，且在架构规模与数据集上具备一定泛化性。

title: Validation-Guided Prompt Selection for Differential Morphing Attack Detection
summary: Differential morphing attack detection (D-MAD) compares a trusted live capture with a document image that may contain a facial morph. We investigate whether labelled validation data can improve a frozen-parameter vision-language evaluator through prompt selection rather than model fine-tuning. Version~1 generates 50 candidate prompts and selects the top-ranked instruction using a security-oriented loss that prioritises missed morph attacks (MACER) while accounting for bona fide classification errors (BSCER), response failures, parse failures, and decision inconsistency. Version~2 recursively revises prompts using aggregate validation feedback. On a subject-disjoint test set of 160 pairs spanning LMA, MIPGAN-2, and PIPE, the selected Version~1 prompt achieves a (19.17\%) morph attack classification error rate (MACER), with (0.00\%) observed bona fide sample classification error rate (BSCER), compared with (70.00\%) MACER for a controlled manual prompt. The paired (50.83) percentage-point difference has a (95\%) subject-bootstrap interval of ([43.33,58.33]). Recursive revision does not surpass the best Generation~0 validation loss; the reported revised descendant obtains (31.67\%) test MACER. All 23 attacks missed by Version~1 are landmark-based (LMA) morphs. Overall, the results show that prompt formulation can substantially influence frozen-parameter VLM-based D-MAD performance, while also highlighting the challenge of recursive prompt refinement under a compact 10-subject validation setting.

AI.tldr: 在冻结参数的视觉语言模型上，通过验证集驱动的提示词筛选（而非微调）可选中使D-MAD的MACER从70.00%降至19.17%（BSCER为0.00%），但递归式提示词修订未能超越初代最优，且遗漏攻击全为LMA类。
AI.motivation: 探索在冻结参数条件下，标注验证数据能否通过提示词选择/构造提升VLM在差异化形变攻击检测（D-MAD）中的安全性表现，避免昂贵的模型微调。
AI.method: Version 1：生成50个候选提示，用安全导向损失（以MACER为主，兼顾BSCER、响应失败、解析失败与决策不一致）排序选取Top-1指令；Version 2：基于聚合验证反馈递归修订提示。评测在160对subject-disjoint测试集（LMA、MIPGAN-2、PIPE）上进行，并设人工提示作对照，采用受试者bootstrap估计置信区间。
AI.result: Version 1最优提示测试MACER=19.17%、BSCER=0.00%；对照人工提示MACER=70.00%，配对差50.83个百分点，95% subject-bootstrap区间[43.33, 58.33]。递归修订未超过Gen-0最优验证损失，其修订后代测试MACER=31.67%。Version 1漏检的23个攻击全部为landmark-based（LMA）形变。
AI.conclusion: 提示词构造能显著影响冻结参数VLM的D-MAD性能；但在仅10名受试者的紧凑验证集下，递归提示词精炼难以稳定增益，LMA类形变仍是主要薄弱环节。

title: Consensus Capture in Reference-Based UAV Video Stabilization: A Benchmark on Dynamic Urban Scenes
comment: 50 pages, 17 figures, 24 tables. Code at https://github.com/rfonod/stabilo-benchmark and data at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23623540 and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15050577
summary: Reference-frame stabilization registers every frame of a hovering-drone video onto one reference frame, keeping object positions comparable. The registration pipelines it relies on are selected on feature-matching benchmarks in which only the camera moves. Over a busy intersection, vehicles moving together supply mutually consistent correspondences that can draw the robust homography estimate toward their motion: consensus capture, which inlier statistics cannot flag. A two-part benchmark measures it and the object masking meant to prevent it. A static protocol scores ten pipelines under exactly known homographies on 4K aerial frames, tuned on a site-disjoint split at a matched resolution and feature budget. A dynamic protocol scores them at an offline and a real-time budget on hovers selected from the video alone to span the amount and coherence of moving foreground, plus a stationary control. It measures background alignment, object position error and the share of a moving group's displacement an estimate follows, against a pseudo-ground-truth reference audited with manually annotated ground control points, which also score every candidate. On static scenes, tuned AKAZE, RootSIFT, SIFT and BRISK lead, retuning the matcher thresholds raises the mean average accuracy (mAA) by at most 0.0062, and masking costs less than 0.005. Unmasked ORB is captured on 28 of 304 real-time dynamic pairs and on 6 offline; its real-time captured estimates have a median corner error of 18.8 px yet typical inlier counts and ratios. Masking removes capture for every pipeline and leaves the leading pipelines unchanged. Code, data and results are released.

AI.tldr: 论文针对悬停无人机视频的参考帧稳定化，提出“共识捕获”这一失效模式：繁忙路口上同向运动车辆提供的相互一致对应会把鲁棒单应估计拉向目标运动，而内点统计无法察觉。作者构建静态与动态两段式基准，在已知单应与伪真值（人工地面控制点审计）下评测十条配准管线，并检验目标掩膜的防护效果。
AI.motivation: 现有配准管线的选型依赖“仅相机运动”的特征匹配基准，与真实悬停航拍场景中前景目标运动的情形不匹配，导致选型结论可能失效，且缺乏对“共识捕获”风险的度量手段。
AI.method: 构建两部分基准：静态协议在4K航拍帧、精确已知单应下对十条管线打分，并在站点不重叠划分、匹配分辨率与特征预算匹配的条件下调参；动态协议在离线与实时两种预算下，从视频本身筛选出覆盖不同运动前景量与一致度水平的悬停片段（含静止对照），度量背景对齐、目标位置误差及估计对运动群位移的跟随比例，参考基准为经人工标注地面控制点审计的伪真值，并对每个候选解评分。
AI.result: 静态场景中调参后的 AKAZE、RootSIFT、SIFT、BRISK 领先；重调匹配器阈值至多将 mAA 提升 0.0062，掩膜代价小于 0.005。未掩膜的 ORB 在 304 对实时动态样本中被捕获 28 次、离线 6 次，其被捕获的实时估计中位角点误差达 18.8 px，而内点数与内点比仍属正常范围。掩膜可消除所有管线的捕获现象，且不改变领先管线的排序。
AI.conclusion: 内点统计不足以发现共识捕获，静态基准上的配准选型在动态场景中可能被前景一致运动破坏；目标掩膜是有效且代价低的防护手段，且不改变管线优劣排序。代码、数据与结果均已公开。

title: Detection Is Not Early Warning: Evaluating Token-Level Alarms on Language Model Failures
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpretability as a Science. 30 pages (10 main text), 6 figures, 16 tables. Code: https://github.com/swiss-ai/degeneration-probe
summary: Many failures of language models begin at a specific token, the onset. A monitor that reads the model during generation can classify the finished response, detect the failure once it is under way, or warn before it begins, and only a warning leaves time to stop or steer the generation. Monitors are usually evaluated with response-level metrics such as AUROC, which ignore when the monitor fires. We introduce PREWARN, an evaluation protocol for any failure with an annotated onset. It calibrates each monitor's threshold on validation data to an error rate chosen for the application, runs the monitor, and scores its alarms relative to the onset on all three tasks. As a case study we apply it to repetitive degeneration in three open language models, with early warning as the main task, using linear probes on activations and six untrained baselines. Response-level metrics saturate on this failure, and a rule that reads only the response length scores almost perfectly, while probes that AUROC ranks as equal warn very differently under PREWARN. Probes warn before the onset on most degenerate responses of two of the three models, low-rank adapters below the probe more than double the share of tokens just before the onset that it flags, largely by flagging degenerate responses long before the onset, and no untrained baseline warns much more often than random alarms. We release the probes with calibrated thresholds at https://huggingface.co/collections/marcodene/prewarn-degeneration-probes

AI.tldr: 提出PREWARN评测协议：针对带标注"起始点(onset)"的失败，将监视器阈值校准到指定误报率后按其报警相对onset的位置打分，并同时评估"生成中检测/生成后分类/起始前预警"三任务；以重复退化为例，发现响应级AUROC指标饱和失效，而PREWARN能区分AUROC排名相同的探测器。
AI.motivation: 语言模型的许多失败始于某个特定token（onset）。能提前预警的监视器才有时间中止或干预生成，但常用响应级指标（如AUROC）忽略报警时机，无法评价"何时"报警，导致不同监视器难以区分。
AI.method: 提出PREWARN协议：对任意带onset标注的失败，先在验证集上把每个监视器阈值校准到应用指定的错误率，再运行监视器，并按报警相对onset的位置对三类任务（响应级分类、进行中检测、onset前预警）分别评分。案例研究：三个开源模型的重复退化，主任务为预警，使用激活上的线性探针与六个未训练基线。
AI.result: 响应级指标在该失败上饱和，仅用响应长度的规则几乎满分，而AUROC排名相同的探针在PREWARN下预警表现差异显著。两个模型中，探针在多数退化响应的onset前即发出预警；探针之下接低秩适配器可使其在onset前一小段token上的报警比例提高一倍以上，主要通过更早（远早于onset）标记退化响应实现；未训练基线报警频率并不明显高于随机报警。
AI.conclusion: 响应级指标掩盖了预警能力的差异，需以时机敏感的协议评价监视器；PREWARN提供了可校准、可比较的评测框架，并公开带校准阈值的探针。

title: eDMD: Endpoint Distribution Matching for Few-Step Diffusion Distillation
summary: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) has emerged as a leading paradigm for distilling diffusion models into few-step students, where an auxiliary fake score model tracks the student's distribution and the discrepancy between the teacher and fake predictions drives the student toward the teacher. In multi-step distillation, although only the student's final output is delivered, existing methods train the fake model on intermediate states or across all denoising steps. Consequently, the student's update signal becomes entangled with intermediate distributions, which can distort the matching direction and remain nonzero even after the student's final outputs already match the teacher distribution. To resolve this mismatch, we propose Endpoint Distribution Matching Distillation (eDMD), which trains a single shared fake model exclusively on the student's final outputs and uses it to correct every denoising step. Our theoretical analysis proves that this endpoint reference guarantees that the distribution matching term vanishes if and only if the student's final output distribution matches the teacher's, regardless of intermediate distributions. Beyond the fake reference, we further strengthen teacher supervision through a precise teacher (PT) that replaces single-step guided predictions with short multi-step trajectories on the final noise interval, paired with a calibrated query density for intermediate steps. Experiments on SD3-Medium, FLUX.2-klein (4B and 9B), and Qwen-Image-2.1 demonstrate that eDMD consistently outperforms existing distribution matching methods for 4-step generation.

AI.tldr: 提出端点分布匹配蒸馏（eDMD），仅在学生最终输出上训练单一共享fake模型并用于校正每个去噪步，理论上保证匹配项当且仅当最终输出分布一致时消失；配合多步轨迹"精确教师"与校准查询密度，在SD3-Medium、FLUX.2-klein、Qwen-Image-2.1上4步生成优于现有分布匹配方法。
AI.motivation: DMD类多步蒸馏中，学生只交付最终输出，但现有方法却在中间状态或全部去噪步上训练fake模型，导致学生的更新信号与中间分布纠缠，既扭曲匹配方向，又在最终输出已对齐教师后仍非零（匹配项不收敛）。
AI.method: 1）eDMD：使用单个共享fake模型，仅在其最终输出上训练，并用该同一模型校正每一个去噪步；2）理论分析证明，端点参考下分布匹配项当且仅当学生最终输出分布匹配教师时为零，与中间分布无关；3）精确教师（PT）：在最后噪声区间用短多步教师轨迹替代单步引导预测，并为中间步配合校准的查询密度以强化教师监督。
AI.result: 在SD3-Medium、FLUX.2-klein（4B与9B）及Qwen-Image-2.1上的4步生成实验中，eDMD一致优于现有分布匹配蒸馏方法。
AI.conclusion: 多步蒸馏的fake参考应锚定学生最终输出而非中间状态；端点式分布匹配可消除目标错配并使匹配项具备正确的零点性质，结合精确教师监督可稳定提升少步生成的分布对齐质量。

title: Calibration and Conformal Prediction for Medical Question Answering in Arabic and English: Evidence from Two Non-Parallel Benchmarks
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly tested on medical exam questions, but accuracy alone does not show when an answer can be trusted. I study the calibration and uncertainty of two open-weight models, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Jais-adapted-7B-chat (both run in 4-bit precision), on 2,816 English multiple-choice questions from MedMCQA and 4,927 Arabic multiple-choice questions from MedAraBench. Accuracy was 0.561 (English) and 0.430 (Arabic) for Qwen, and 0.369 and 0.308 for Jais. Raw option probabilities were overconfident in all four settings (expected calibration error 0.242 to 0.486), and a single temperature parameter removed 82% to 93% of that error. Split conformal prediction reached its nominal coverage in all 24 settings I tested (within 0.006), but the sets were large when accuracy was low: at 90% coverage, temperature-scaled sets contained on average 63% (Qwen, English), 78% (Qwen, Arabic), 86% (Jais, English) and 89% (Jais, Arabic) of the options. The margin between the top two option probabilities separated correct from incorrect answers best for Qwen on English (AUROC 0.734) and worst for Jais on Arabic (0.579). Answering only the 20% most confident questions lowered Qwen's English error from 0.439 to 0.098. Jais showed a strong prior for option C (49% of English and 60% of Arabic predictions). Scoring Latin letters only cut the Arabic share to 29% but left accuracy, raw ECE and AUROC nearly unchanged. Because the two benchmarks differ in subject, level and number of options, I do not attribute differences between languages to language itself. Code is available at https://github.com/Mariyaaleem/arabic-english-medqa-uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct与Jais-adapted-7B-chat（均4-bit量化）在英文MedMCQA（2816题）和阿拉伯语MedAraBench（4927题）上的校准与不确定性。原始选项概率普遍过度自信（ECE 0.242–0.486），单一温度参数可消除82%–93%的校准误差；分裂共形预测在全部24种设置下均达到名义覆盖率（误差≤0.006），但低准确率时预测集很大（90%覆盖率下平均含63%–89%的选项）。
AI.motivation: LLM在医学考试题上的评测普遍只报告准确率，而准确率无法反映"答案何时可信"。作者希望补充校准（calibration）与不确定性量化视角，比较开源模型在英语与阿拉伯语医学多选题上的置信度是否可靠，为下游安全使用提供依据。
AI.method: 选取两个开源权重模型（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Jais-adapted-7B-chat，均4-bit精度），在英文MedMCQA（2816题）与阿拉伯语MedAraBench（4927题）上评测。指标包括：准确率、期望校准误差（ECE）、温度缩放（单一温度参数）、分裂共形预测（24种设置下的覆盖率与预测集大小）、Top-1与Top-2概率间隔的AUROC、选择性回答（仅答最自信20%）、选项先验偏置（选C比例）以及"仅拉丁字母"评分变体。
AI.result: 准确率：Qwen英语0.561、阿拉伯语0.430；Jais分别为0.369与0.308。原始概率在四种设置下均过度自信（ECE 0.242–0.486），温度缩放消除82%–93%的校准误差。分裂共形预测在24种设置均达到名义覆盖率（误差在0.006内），但90%覆盖率下预测集平均包含63%（Qwen英语）、78%（Qwen阿语）、86%（Jais英语）、89%（Jais阿语）的选项。Top-1/Top-2概率间隔的区分度最佳为Qwen英语（AUROC 0.734），最差为Jais阿拉伯语（0.579）。仅回答最自信20%题目使Qwen英语错误率由0.439降至0.098。Jais存在强烈C选项先验（英语49%、阿语60%）；仅评分拉丁字母将阿语C占比降至29%，但准确率、原始ECE与AUROC几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: 温度缩放与共形预测可有效修正LLM医学答题的过度自信并给出有覆盖保证的预测集，但低准确率场景下预测集过大，实用性受限。置信度间隔可作为选择性回答的有效信号，但区分能力随模型与语言下降。由于两个基准在学科、难度与选项数上不同，作者未将语言间差异归因于语言本身。代码已开源。

title: MALNISI-Infused Graph Construction and Weighted Contrastive Loss based GAT for Unsupervised Representation Learning in HSI
summary: Hyperspectral images (HSI) possess discriminating spectral characteristics with respect to land utilization due to high-dimensional information. Recently, unsupervised representation learning using graph neural networks has unveiled these utilization-specific complex spectral relations. This article has three main contributions. First, it proposes an index, the Mean Absolute Local Neighborhood Inverse Spectral Index (MALNISI), which measures the similarity between two pixels based on their neighborhood information. The index is used to construct a weighted adjacency matrix, giving the HSI a graph structure. Second, it proposes an upgraded Graph Attention Network that learns compact latent representations of hyperspectral data from the constructed graph. In this network, an enhanced multi-head attention mechanism incorporates the MALNISI weights as an auxiliary feature to emphasize learned attention between neighboring pixels. To alleviate over-smoothing and preserve fine-grained spectral details, the architecture integrates residual connections, skip projections, and feature normalization, which together enhance representation capability, stabilize learning, and accelerate convergence. Third, it proposes a weighted contrastive loss function that incorporates neighborhood-aware MALNISI between connected pixels, encouraging strongly connected pixels in the high-dimensional space to remain close in the latent space, and weakly connected pixels to stay apart. The resulting discriminative low-dimensional embeddings are then clustered using spectral clustering. Experimental analysis on six benchmark HSI datasets demonstrates the efficiency and necessity of the three aforementioned contributions, and the comparative study highlights superior performance over fourteen state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出MALNISI邻域光谱相似性指标构建HSI图结构，结合改进图注意力网络与邻域加权对比损失学习判别性低维表征，用于无监督高光谱聚类。
AI.motivation: 高光谱图像高维信息蕴含判别性光谱特性，但无监督表征学习需刻画像素间复杂光谱关系；现有图方法对邻域光谱相似度量、注意力权重引导及过平滑问题处理不足。
AI.method: 三项贡献：(1) 定义Mean Absolute Local Neighborhood Inverse Spectral Index (MALNISI)，基于邻域信息度量像素相似性并构建加权邻接矩阵，赋予HSI图结构；(2) 提出改进图注意力网络，将MALNISI权重作为辅助特征融入增强多头注意力机制，并以残差连接、跳跃投影与特征归一化缓解过平滑、保留细粒度光谱细节；(3) 设计邻域感知加权对比损失，使强连接像素在潜空间保持接近、弱连接像素分离，最后对低维嵌入做谱聚类。
AI.result: 在六个基准HSI数据集上的实验验证了三项贡献的有效性与必要性，对比实验显示优于14种先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 邻域光谱相似性指标与图注意力表征学习、加权对比损失相结合，可有效实现高光谱图像的无监督判别性低维表征与聚类。

title: Sustainable Federated Fine-Tuning with LoRA: Environmental Impact and Performance Footprint
comment: Accepted author manuscript for publication in the Proceedings of the 2027 IEEE Consumer Communications & Networking Conference (CCNC 2027), Las Vegas, Nevada, USA, January 9-12, 2027
summary: Federated Learning (FL) with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) enables efficient adaptation of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its energy and carbon costs across hardware remain poorly understood. We evaluated federated Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning on NVIDIA A40, RTX 6000 Ada, and A100 GPUs using a $2^2$ full factorial design with 135M/360M models and 10/100 local steps. CodeCarbon tracked energy and estimated CO$_2$-equivalent emissions. Descriptive allocation of variation assigned 84.8-91.2% of energy and emissions variation to local steps within these ranges. On A40 and RTX 6000 Ada, configurations with fewer steps achieved comparable accuracy with roughly 6-8-fold lower energy consumption and higher accuracy per kWh. These findings support smaller local budgets for energy-efficient federated fine-tuning within the evaluated setting.

AI.tldr: 该论文在三种GPU上评估联邦LoRA微调的能耗与碳排放，发现本地步数解释了84.8–91.2%的能耗与排放变异，减少本地步数可在保持精度的同时将能耗降低约6–8倍。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习结合参数高效微调（PEFT）可高效适配大语言模型，但其在不同硬件上的能耗与碳成本尚缺乏系统理解，缺少可指导配置选择的实证依据。
AI.method: 在NVIDIA A40、RTX 6000 Ada、A100三种GPU上对联邦LoRA微调进行评测，采用2²全因子实验设计，因素为模型规模（135M/360M）与本地步数（10/100）；使用CodeCarbon追踪能耗并估算CO₂当量排放；对变异进行描述性分配分析。
AI.result: 在所考察范围内，本地步数分配了84.8–91.2%的能耗与排放变异；在A40与RTX 6000 Ada上，较少本地步数的配置可达到相当精度，同时能耗约低6–8倍，且每kWh精度更高。
AI.conclusion: 在所评估的设定下，较小的本地训练预算（较少本地步数）有助于实现能效更高的联邦微调，可作为能耗感知配置的实用指导。

title: Objects as Addresses: Instance Binding in Vision Transformer Attention
summary: Humans naturally parse visual scenes into coherent individual objects rather than scattered features, a capability cognitive science calls object binding. While recent work shows that pretrained Vision Transformers (ViTs) intrinsically acquire this ability, how native self-attention computations mechanistically keep object instances separate remains unresolved. By studying this across eight pretrained ViTs, we found that instance separation is expressed more strongly in attention routing than in token content: selected query-key relations distinguish individual objects more reliably than value similarity or residual representations. Inside heads, patches belonging to one individual tend to read from a common image region, which we term their attention address. Visually distinct parts of one person share an address, whereas identical duplicated instances receive separate, movable addresses. These shared destinations arise in part because query interactions with the spatial structure of keys direct attention toward consistent regions for one object and elsewhere for another. In DINOv2 and most other backbones we tested, editing this query component at the selected head redirects its attention address toward another individual. Grouping patches by this query component separates same-category instances, reaching .615 FG-ARI versus .289 for the same clustering of final-layer features, which tend to merge them.

AI.tldr: 预训练ViT的自注意力机制通过"注意力寻址"实现物体实例分离：同一物体的patch倾向于读取共同图像区域，该机制主要编码在query分量与key空间结构的交互中，可被编辑、可迁移，并可用于实例分割聚类。
AI.motivation: 认知科学中的object binding表明人类将视觉场景解析为连贯物体，已有研究显示预训练ViT固有地获得此能力，但其自注意力计算如何在机制层面保持实例分离尚不清楚。
AI.method: 系统分析8个预训练ViT的注意力路由与token内容；区分query-key关系、value相似性与残差表示对实例区分的贡献；提出"注意力地址"（attention address）概念刻画头内patch的共同读取区域；检验相同物体不同部分、重复实例的地址共享/分离与可移动性；分析query与key空间结构交互的作用，并在选中注意力头上对query分量进行编辑干预。
AI.result: 实例分离在注意力路由中强于token内容：query-key关系比value相似性或残差表示更可靠地区分实例；同一人物视觉上不同的部位共享地址，而复制的相同实例获得独立且可移动的地址；在DINOv2及多数测试骨干中，编辑选中头的query分量可将注意力地址重定向至另一实例；按query分量对patch分组进行聚类，FG-ARI达0.615，显著高于最终层特征聚类的0.289。
AI.conclusion: ViT的实例分离由注意力寻址机制承载，核心在于query与key空间结构的交互而非价值/特征内容；该机制可定位、可操纵，为理解ViT物体绑定提供了机制性解释，并为无需训练的实例分割与聚类提供了新途径。

title: DPA: Decentralized Primal Averaging with Quasi-Global Momentum for Highly Heterogeneous Data
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 7 figures. Code available at https://github.com/Diyako754/DPA
summary: Decentralized training of deep learning models keeps training data local and supports on-device learning over networks. In realistic scenarios, heterogeneity across agents' local data poses an optimization challenge and can severely degrade test accuracy, especially on sparse communication graphs. Building on recent advances in centralized primal averaging, we propose Decentralized Primal Averaging (DPA), a decentralized learning algorithm that combines primal averaging with a local quasi-global momentum buffer. DPA maintains three coupled sequences for optimization, gradient evaluation, and output averaging, while using consecutive mixed iterates to construct a network-aware momentum direction without transmitting an auxiliary tracking variable. For smooth nonconvex objectives, we establish a convergence bound for DPA and identify conditions for linear speedup in the number of agents for sufficiently many iterations. We also introduce DPA-1G, a variant that uses one communication round per iteration and matches the per-iteration communication cost of DSGD-style baselines. Experiments following the GUT decentralized image-classification benchmark show that DPA compares favorably with DSGD, gradient tracking, QG-DSGDm, momentum tracking, and QG-GUTm across datasets, architectures, topologies, and heterogeneity levels, with the largest gains under high heterogeneity on sparse rings. At the same total communication cost, both DPA variants achieve higher mean test accuracy than the best baseline on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with ResNet-20. Our code is publicly available.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出去中心化原始平均算法DPA，在稀疏拓扑与数据异质性下提升去中心化训练的测试精度。
AI.motivation: 去中心化训练可保持数据本地化，但各智能体本地数据异质性带来优化困难，在稀疏通信图上尤其严重地降低测试精度；同时现有方法常需额外传输辅助跟踪变量，通信开销大。
AI.method: 借鉴集中式原始平均的进展，提出DPA：将原始平均与本地准全局动量缓冲相结合，维护优化、梯度评估与输出平均三条耦合序列，并利用连续混合迭代构造网络感知的动量方向，无需传输辅助跟踪变量；进一步提出DPA-1G变体，每次迭代仅一轮通信，单次迭代通信开销与DSGD类基线相当。针对光滑非凸目标给出收敛界，并给出足够多迭代下随智能体数线性加速的条件。
AI.result: 在GUT去中心化图像分类基准上，DPA在数据集、架构、拓扑与异质性水平上均优于DSGD、梯度跟踪、QG-DSGDm、动量跟踪与QG-GUTm，在稀疏环拓扑高异质性下增益最大；在相同总通信代价下，DPA两种变体在CIFAR-10与CIFAR-100（ResNet-20）上平均测试精度均超过最佳基线。
AI.conclusion: DPA通过原始平均与网络感知动量的结合，在无辅助变量传输、通信开销可控的前提下有效缓解数据异质性与稀疏拓扑带来的性能退化，并具备理论收敛与线性加速保证，代码已公开。

title: Consistent Video-to-Video Translation via Explicit Correspondences
summary: Interactive video-to-video applications require real-time generation while maintaining long-range temporal consistency. However, recent methods achieve speed by restricting attention to a fixed-length causal window. This limits long-range consistency whenever relevant history falls outside the context window. To address this limitation, we introduce vid2vid-long, a correspondence-based approach grounded in a simple observation. Video-to-video translation provides an explicit cross-frame reference: the regions that match in the input video should match in the output video too. Concretely, we compute patch-level correspondences in the input, guiding retrieval of previously generated outputs in the corresponding regions, and condition the model on these patches through correspondence cross-attention. Our experiments demonstrate that vid2vid-long consistently improves long-range temporal consistency across recent video models while preserving generation quality and real-time performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 vid2vid-long，利用输入视频的块级对应关系检索历史生成结果，并以对应关系交叉注意力为条件，在不牺牲实时性的前提下提升长程时序一致性。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频到视频（vid2vid）应用需同时满足实时生成与长程时序一致性。现有提速方法将注意力限制在固定长度的因果窗口内，一旦相关历史落在窗口之外，长程一致性便失效。
AI.method: 基于一个简单观察：vid2vid 翻译天然提供跨帧参照——输入视频中匹配的区域在输出视频中也应匹配。据此在输入视频上计算块级（patch-level）对应关系，用其检索先前已生成输出中对应区域的历史块，并通过对应关系交叉注意力（correspondence cross-attention）将这些块作为条件注入模型。
AI.result: 在多个近期视频模型上，vid2vid-long 一致地改善长程时序一致性，同时保持生成质量与实时性能。
AI.conclusion: 以输入侧对应关系为线索检索历史输出，是突破固定因果窗口限制、兼顾实时性与长程一致性的有效途径。

title: Factored One-sided Adam-Moment for Practical and Scalable SOAP
comment: NeurIPS 2026. 17 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Code: https://github.com/naver-ai/foam
summary: Second-order optimizers (e.g., Shampoo, SOAP) have emerged as compelling alternatives to Adam/AdamW and promise faster per-step convergence than AdamW in transformer training. However, they still remain costly in practice, and even SOAP still pays substantial optimizer-state memory and eigendecomposition overhead. We ask whether the benefits of SOAP can be retained at nearly the efficiency of AdamW. In this paper, we answer yes with a lightweight SOAP variant, Factored One-sided Adam-Moment (FOAM). The path to practical impact is twofold: first, FOAM employs input-only preconditioning, dropping the output-side Kronecker factor to reduce memory and remove one eigendecomposition. The Kronecker structure of the Hessian shows that this is exact for a diagonal output-side curvature and nearly lossless for a near-diagonal one, as we observe empirically. Second, FOAM replaces SOAP's dense rotated second moment with a factored Adam-moment estimator based on row-by-column statistics. Under the K-FAC Fisher assumption with a diagonal output curvature, this estimator exactly recovers SOAP's dense second moment, and we measure only a 15-20% K-FAC violation, with negligible effect on the update. Our empirical results support the claim that FOAM matches strong SOAP and Muon baselines in validation loss across scales of large language model (LLM) pre-training, uses half of SOAP's optimizer state, runs at Muon-class wall-clock time, and retains robustness across a three-fold learning-rate range. The results hold from 124M to 760M parameters, demonstrating that SOAP's gains need not require SOAP's cost. Code: https://github.com/naver-ai/foam

AI.tldr: FOAM（Factored One-sided Adam-Moment）是一种轻量级SOAP变体：采用仅输入侧预条件（去除输出侧Kronecker因子）并用行列统计的分解式Adam二阶矩估计替代稠密旋转二阶矩，在124M–760M参数LLM预训练中达到与SOAP、Muon相当的验证损失，优化器状态减半、耗时与Muon同级。
AI.motivation: 二阶优化器（Shampoo、SOAP）在Transformer训练中收敛更快，但存在优化器状态内存开销大与特征分解计算开销高的问题。作者希望回答：能否以接近AdamW的效率保留SOAP的收益。
AI.method: 提出FOAM两处简化：(1) 输入侧预条件，丢弃输出侧Kronecker因子，省去一次特征分解并降低内存；基于Hessian的Kronecker结构论证：当输出侧曲率为对角时该简化精确，近对角时近乎无损（经验验证）。(2) 用基于行/列统计的分解式Adam二阶矩估计替代SOAP的稠密旋转二阶矩；在K-FAC Fisher假设且输出曲率对角时，该估计可精确还原SOAP的稠密二阶矩，实测K-FAC违背程度仅15–20%，对更新影响可忽略。
AI.result: 在124M至760M参数LLM预训练中，FOAM的验证损失与强基线SOAP、Muon相当；优化器状态仅为SOAP的一半，实际耗时处于Muon量级，并在3倍学习率范围内保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SOAP的收益并不必然伴随SOAP的开销；通过输入侧预条件与分解式二阶矩估计，可在接近AdamW/Muon效率下获得二阶优化的性能。

title: FLEX-LBP: Learning Local Binary Patterns with Exact Binary Inference for Texture Classification
summary: Local Binary Patterns (LBP) remain among the most widely used texture descriptors, from industrial inspection to medical imaging. Yet their radius, sampling angles, color transform and thresholds are fixed by hand for each dataset. We present FLEX-LBP, which learns these parameters by backpropagation while every forward pass computes exact binary codes and hard histogram counts. A straight-through estimator acts only in the backward pass, so the deployed descriptor is an interpretable hard-binary LBP with 90 learnable parameters and unchanged inference cost. In a controlled ablation on six color texture benchmarks, the component worth learning is dataset-dependent. One configuration, applied unchanged everywhere, learns the geometry and thresholds with the color transform frozen. It improves the nearest-neighbor accuracy of the identical fixed descriptor by 3.55 points on average over five seeds, significantly on five of six benchmarks and never significantly worse. With a linear discriminant readout, it gains 0.9 points; the fully learned descriptor gains 2.7 and has the highest mean. FLEX-LBP is more accurate than five classical LBP-family descriptors, PCANet and a neural LBP on five of six benchmarks. Its mean nearest-neighbor accuracy exceeds that of frozen ImageNet ResNet-50 features (23.5 million parameters). On the Kather colorectal cancer histology benchmark, the fully learned descriptor reaches 93.8%, significantly above the best classical descriptor (Completed LBP, 92.8%). The learned radii adapt in directions that recur across seeds. Noise drowns single-pixel comparisons and illuminant change flips inter-channel ones; median sampling or gray-world normalization restores 96-97%. The code is available as a drop-in PyTorch layer at https://github.com/medalimoussa/FLEX-LBP.

AI.tldr: FLEX-LBP 通过反向传播学习 LBP 的半径、采样角、颜色变换与阈值，前向传播仍计算精确硬二值编码与硬直方图，部署时为仅 90 参数、推理开销不变的可解释硬二值描述子，在多数彩色纹理基准上超过经典 LBP 家族、PCANet、神经 LBP 及冻结的 ResNet-50 特征。
AI.motivation: LBP 是最常用的纹理描述子之一，但其半径、采样角度、颜色变换与阈值通常需针对每个数据集人工设定，缺乏自适应性与可迁移性，限制了其性能上限。
AI.method: 提出 FLEX-LBP：将 LBP 的几何（半径、采样角）、颜色变换与阈值参数化，用反向传播学习；前向保持精确二值码与硬直方图统计，仅在反向使用直通估计器（straight-through estimator），从而部署时仍是可解释的硬二值 LBP（90 个可学习参数，推理成本不变）。在六个彩色纹理基准上做受控消融，考察各组件可学习性的数据集依赖性；给出固定配置（冻结颜色变换、学习几何与阈值）；并用线性判别读出评估。
AI.result: 固定配置相对同一固定描述子的最近邻精度平均提升 3.55 个百分点（5 个随机种子），在 6 个基准中 5 个显著提升且无一显著变差；线性判别读出下提升 0.9 点，全学习版本提升 2.7 点并取得最高均值。FLEX-LBP 在 6 个基准中的 5 个上优于 5 种经典 LBP 家族描述子、PCANet 与一种神经 LBP，其平均最近邻精度超过含 2350 万参数的冻结 ImageNet ResNet-50 特征。在 Kather 结直肠癌组织学基准上，全学习描述子达 93.8%，显著高于最佳经典描述子 Completed LBP（92.8%）。学到的半径在多个随机种子间呈一致的调整方向；噪声会淹没单像素比较、光源变化会翻转通道间比较，而中值采样或灰度世界归一化可恢复至 96–97%。
AI.conclusion: LBP 的关键参数可端到端学习，且硬二值、低参数、推理零额外开销的设计在保持可解释性的同时带来稳定精度提升；哪些组件值得学习依赖数据集，而冻结颜色变换、学习几何与阈值的统一配置具有良好通用性。代码以 PyTorch 层形式开源，可直接替换使用。

title: Time Flies When You Parallelise: Pareto-efficient Time Series Foundation Models with Linear Recurrences
summary: Time series foundation models have demonstrated strong zero-shot forecasting performance, but computational efficiency remains a central architectural challenge. Temporal self-attention incurs quadratic cost in the number of temporal tokens, while nonlinear recurrent state transitions restrict parallel computation along the temporal dimension. We introduce ci-proto, a family of time series foundation models based on Mamba-3, whose linear state recurrences support chunk-wise parallel-in-time computation during training, and inference costs that scale linearly with sequence length. The architecture alternates recurrent temporal processing with cross-variate attention, supporting multivariate probabilistic forecasting with past-only and future-known covariates. Across fev-bench's 100 forecasting tasks, ci-proto XL sets a new state of the art among time series foundation models. The five ci-proto variants also make up the entire Pareto frontier for mean scaled quantile loss and mean absolute scaled error against both parameter count and median runtime.

AI.tldr: 提出 ci-proto，基于 Mamba-3 线性状态递推的时间序列基础模型族，训练时支持分块并行，推理开销随序列长度线性增长，交替进行时间递推与跨变量注意力，支持含过去型和未来已知协变量的多元概率预测；ci-proto XL 在 fev-bench 100 项任务上取得 SOTA，五个变体构成 MSQL/MASE 对参数量与中位运行时的完整 Pareto 前沿。
AI.motivation: 时间序列基础模型零样本预测性能强，但计算效率是核心架构瓶颈：时间自注意力对时间步数呈二次复杂度，而非线性循环状态转移又限制了沿时间维度的并行计算。
AI.method: 以 Mamba-3 为基础构建 ci-proto 模型族：利用线性状态递推实现训练期的分块时间并行（chunk-wise parallel-in-time），并使推理成本随序列长度线性增长；架构交替堆叠循环时间处理模块与跨变量（cross-variate）注意力，以支持多元概率预测并纳入仅过去型与未来已知型协变量。
AI.result: 在 fev-bench 的 100 个预测任务上，ci-proto XL 在时间序列基础模型中刷新 SOTA；五个 ci-proto 变体在平均缩放分位数损失（MSQL）与平均绝对缩放误差（MASE）两个指标上，相对参数量与中位推理运行时均构成完整 Pareto 前沿。
AI.conclusion: 线性状态空间递推结合跨变量注意力可在保持零样本概率预测效果领先的同时显著改善效率，实现精度—参数—时延的多目标最优权衡，为时间序列基础模型的高效架构设计提供可行范式。

title: Spatial Foundry: A Multimodal Dataset for Spatial Intelligence
summary: Spatial intelligence requires connecting visual observations to the geometry, objects, and persistent state of an environment. Images alone leave these relationships implicit, while disconnected annotations make it difficult to study appearance, camera motion, and scene changes under a common reference. We introduce Spatial Foundry, a collection of 5,280 furnished residential 3D scene configurations with editable assets and aligned visual, geometric, and temporal data. Its modalities include floor plans, perspective and panoramic RGB, metric depth, point clouds, meshes, instance-level 3D bounding boxes, and camera trajectories paired with video. Shared scene coordinates link observations across views and time; editable source scenes enable additional camera paths and controlled object changes. We describe the data representation and construction workflow, and discuss applications in floor-plan-conditioned 3D generation, geometric reconstruction, instance-level perception, camera-conditioned video generation, shared world modeling, and scene editing. Controlled camera and scene variations support spatial perception and world-model research. The public project page provides videos and an interactive colored point-cloud preview.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Spatial Foundry，一个包含 5,280 个带家具住宅 3D 场景配置的数据集，资产可编辑，并提供对齐的视觉、几何与时间数据，用于空间感知与世界模型研究。
AI.motivation: 空间智能需要将视觉观测与环境几何、物体及持久状态关联。但单张图像使这些关系隐含，而彼此割裂的标注难以在统一参考系下研究外观、相机运动与场景变化。
AI.method: 构建 5,280 个住宅场景配置，模态包括平面图、透视与全景 RGB、度量深度、点云、网格、实例级 3D 包围盒，以及与视频配对的相机轨迹；通过共享场景坐标系链接跨视角、跨时间的观测，并利用可编辑源场景生成额外相机路径与受控物体变化。文中描述了数据表示与构建流程。
AI.result: 数据集提供跨视图与时间对齐的多模态观测，并支持受控的相机与场景变化；公开项目页提供视频与交互式彩色点云预览。
AI.conclusion: Spatial Foundry 可支撑平面图条件 3D 生成、几何重建、实例级感知、相机条件视频生成、共享世界建模与场景编辑等应用，助力空间感知与世界模型研究。

title: Temporal Regularized Learning: Self-Supervised Learning Local in Space and Time
summary: Layer-local self-supervised objectives remove the backward pass between layers, but almost all still compute their loss over a batch of samples and are therefore local in space but not in time. We introduce Temporal Regularized Learning (TeReL), a spatially and temporally local learning rule for self-supervised representation learning from sequential input streams. The key idea is to instantiate a VICReg-style objective with temporally adjacent positives and non-differentiated running population statistics, yielding a per-neuron online loss with bounded state. The objective is a soft form of Slow Feature Analysis, and its gradient is a Hebbian update of the feedforward weights and an anti-Hebbian update of one lateral matrix per layer. The aim of the experiments is to show that the rule works in a small network, not to compete with backpropagation. On a class-chunked MNIST stream, a two-layer fully connected network trained with batch size one outperforms random features (96.48% versus 95.09% linear-probe accuracy) and classical SFA, and a variant that relaxes both locality constraints is comparable to supervised backpropagation. Because training and inference use the same computation, the network can keep learning from unlabeled data during inference without loss of accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文提出TeReL（Temporal Regularized Learning），一种在空间和时间上都局部的自监督表征学习规则：将VICReg式目标与时序相邻正样本、不可微的滑动总体统计量结合，得到每神经元的在线损失，梯度等价为前向权重的Hebbian更新和每层一个侧向矩阵的anti-Hebbian更新。
AI.motivation: 现有层局部自监督目标消除了层间反向传播，实现了"空间局部性"，但仍在整批样本上计算损失，因此不具备"时间局部性"，无法在在线流式输入下以batch size=1学习。
AI.method: 以VICReg目标为基础构造时序版本：正样本来自时间相邻输入，方差/协方差正则项使用不参与微分的running population statistics，使损失逐神经元、状态有界。该目标可视作软形式的慢特征分析（SFA）；其梯度分解为前馈权重的Hebbian项与每层单个侧向矩阵的anti-Hebbian项。
AI.result: 在按类别分块的MNIST流上，两层全连接网络以batch size=1训练，线性探针准确率96.48%，优于随机特征（95.09%）和经典SFA；放松两项局部性约束的变体可与监督反向传播相当。
AI.conclusion: TeReL验证了空间+时间双局部自监督学习在小规模网络中可行（作者声明目标非对标BP）；由于训练与推理使用同一计算，网络可在推理阶段继续从无标签数据学习而不损失精度。

title: BrickFlow: Connectivity-Guided Brick Reconstruction
summary: Given a set of LEGO parts and an image of an assembled object, our task is to infer the pose of each part to assemble the object. In contrast with traditional 3D reconstruction, doing so requires satisfying discrete physical constraints, which provide structure but render the problem combinatorial and highly sensitive to small pose errors. To learn a prior over how parts fit together, we train a set-conditioned SE(3) flow model on procedurally generated assemblies. We then finetune this model to inject image conditioning, using 1% as much data. However, while the learned flow captures global structure, it does not enforce connectivity. To address this, we introduce an analytic connectivity-field guidance to pull predictions toward connected assemblies at test time. Through this, we demonstrate improved build quality with model size, pretraining, and guidance. We make our models and data available for research purposes at https://kulits.github.io/BrickFlow/

AI.tldr: 给定一组LEGO零件与一张组装物体的图像，推断每个零件的位姿以完成装配。作者提出 BrickFlow：先在程序生成的装配数据上训练集合条件（set-conditioned）的 SE(3) 流模型学习零件组合先验，再用仅 1% 的数据微调注入图像条件，并在测试时引入解析的连接性场引导（connectivity-field guidance）使预测趋向连通的装配体。
AI.motivation: 传统 3D 重建不涉及离散物理约束；LEGO 装配需满足零件间离散的接触/连接约束，这类约束虽提供结构信息，却使问题具有组合性质，且对小幅位姿误差高度敏感，直接回归易失败。因此需要学习"零件如何拼合"的先验。
AI.method: 1) 在程序化生成的装配数据上训练集合条件的 SE(3) 流模型（flow model），学习零件联合位姿分布的先验；2) 用约 1% 的数据量微调该模型以注入图像条件，实现单图条件下的装配位姿推断；3) 测试时提出解析的连接性场引导（analytic connectivity-field guidance），将采样轨迹拉向满足连接约束的构型，弥补学习流仅捕捉全局结构、不保证连通性的缺陷。
AI.result: 装配质量随模型规模、预训练以及引导强度提升而改善；解析连接性引导显著提高装配的连通性与可拼装性。作者同时公开模型与数据（https://kulits.github.io/BrickFlow/）。
AI.conclusion: 将生成式流模型与离散物理约束的解析引导相结合，是处理高敏感、组合性装配问题的有效途径；大规模无图像预训练加少量图像微调可高效实现图像条件装配推断。

title: Capacity-Constrained Delayed Feedback for Online Conformal Risk Control
summary: Online conformal risk control (OCRC) enables reliable uncertainty quantification in machine learning by converting model outputs into prediction sets with long-term risk guarantees. These guarantees, however, hinge on the assumption that the loss of each round is revealed immediately and losslessly. In practice, feedback may be delayed, and limited resources may prevent tracking all pending predictions, causing some feedback to be lost. To address this challenge, we develop capacity-aware OCRC (CA-OCRC), a framework that jointly determines how to allocate limited tracking feedback capacity and how to construct prediction sets. CA-OCRC is based on a randomized tracking policy that samples a proxy delay to decide whether, and for how long, feedback for the current round is tracked. CA-OCRC updates the prediction sets via inverse probability weighting, compensating for the possibility of feedback lost due to delays and limited tracking capacity. We analyze risk bounds for both arbitrary and stochastic delays, revealing a trade-off between receiving more feedback and avoiding capacity saturation. Building on these bounds, we optimize the proxy delay distribution, showing scaling laws for the tracking capacity that ensure the same long-term risk as OCRC with unlimited feedback. Experiments on medical imaging, natural language processing, computer vision, and wireless communications show the effectiveness of CA-OCRC as compared to existing OCRC mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 提出容量感知在线保形风险控制（CA-OCRC），用随机跟踪策略与逆概率加权在有延迟、跟踪容量有限的反馈条件下仍能构造带长期风险保证的预测集，并给出容量缩放律。
AI.motivation: OCRC 的长期风险保证依赖每轮损失即时无损揭示；实际中反馈存在延迟，且有限资源无法跟踪全部待定预测，导致反馈丢失，原有保证失效。
AI.method: CA-OCRC 联合设计反馈跟踪容量分配与预测集构造：采用随机化跟踪策略，采样一个代理延迟以决定是否跟踪当前轮反馈及跟踪时长；通过逆概率加权更新预测集，以补偿因延迟和容量限制造成的反馈丢失；分别推导任意延迟与随机延迟下的风险界，据此优化代理延迟分布，导出保证与无限反馈 OCRC 同等长期风险所需的容量缩放律。
AI.result: 理论分析揭示“获得更多反馈”与“避免容量饱和”之间的权衡，并给出容量的缩放律；在医学影像、自然语言处理、计算机视觉与无线通信实验中，CA-OCRC 相较现有 OCRC 机制表现更有效。
AI.conclusion: CA-OCRC 为延迟反馈与有限跟踪容量下的在线保形风险控制提供了可行方案，兼顾风险保证与资源约束，具有跨领域适用性。

title: K2V: Generative Keyframing For Physically Plausible Video Generation
summary: Video diffusion models are able to generate samples with high-quality appearance and textural qualities. However, content produced by these methods is known to exhibit significant physical errors. This is because, in a classical video generation setting, all physical reasoning must take place simultaneously and exclusively within the diffusion process.We propose to resolve these issues by redistributing the task of physical reasoning onto a language model-backed keyframe generation module, which allows for explicit reasoning in language, and fine-grained control over the appearance of the video at important moments in the video. We then condition a video generation model with these keyframes, reducing the role of the diffusion model to the simpler task of interpolating between physically-correct intermediate states, rather than inferring an entire sequence with diffusion. Results demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing approaches, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the Physics-IQ Verified benchmark and PhyGenBench.

AI.tldr: 将物理推理任务从扩散模型转移到语言模型驱动的关键帧生成模块，再以关键帧条件化视频生成，实现物理一致的视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有视频扩散模型外观与纹理质量高，但在经典设定下所有物理推理必须同时且仅在扩散过程中完成，导致生成内容存在明显物理错误。
AI.method: 把物理推理重分配至语言模型驱动的关键帧生成模块，利用语言进行显式推理并细粒度控制关键帧外观；再用这些关键帧条件化视频生成模型，使扩散模型只需在物理正确的中间状态间插值，而非用扩散推断整段序列。
AI.result: 所提方法显著优于现有方法，在 Physics-IQ Verified benchmark 与 PhyGenBench 上取得 SOTA 性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦物理推理与视频渲染，将物理一致性交由语言模型显式推理、将连续帧生成交由扩散插值，是提升视频生成物理合理性的有效范式。

title: LazyWeights: Decode-on-Demand Edge LLMs
summary: Memory decides which LLMs an edge device runs, and how fast: capacity on a $4$ GB Jetson Nano, bandwidth on an $8$ GB Jetson Orin Nano Super. Deployed formats (GPTQ, AWQ, $\texttt{llama.cpp}$'s K- and I-quants) spend equal bits on every integer code of a matrix, although the codes are far from uniform. $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ keeps these formats but tunes GPTQ so the codes compress, Huffman-codes them losslessly in interleaved lanes, and decodes them on demand in a small unit between DRAM and L2, so GPU kernels run unchanged and DRAM moves only coded bytes. At $1\%$ and $3.5\%$ perplexity budgets, coded Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B and SmolLM-1.7B are $5.7-31.4\%$ smaller than the best $\texttt{llama.cpp}$ format. A bit-exact $0.21$ mm$^2$ ASIC decoder unit ($1$ GHz, $7$ nm) cuts Orin latency and energy per token by up to $36\%$ and $38\%$ ($54\%$ and $44\%$ with prompt-lookup speculation). On the Nano, $\texttt{LazyWeights}$ needs $58-64\%$ less time and $53-57\%$ less energy per token than CPU $\texttt{llama.cpp}$, and runs a streamed Mistral-7B 6.6$\times$ faster at $3.89$ bits per weight. A Huffman decoder beats an rANS decoder in rate and area at equal throughput; the ASIC decoder unit runs bit-exact on a Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA (AMD ZCU102).

AI.tldr: LazyWeights 在不改变现有部署格式的前提下，通过重调 GPTQ 使整数量化码更易压缩、交错通道 Huffman 无损编码、并在 DRAM 与 L2 间以小型解码单元按需解码，显著降低边端 LLM 的存储与带宽开销。
AI.motivation: 内存决定边缘设备能运行哪个 LLM 以及运行多快：4 GB Jetson Nano 受容量限制，8 GB Jetson Orin Nano Super 受带宽限制。而 GPTQ、AWQ、llama.cpp 的 K/I-quant 等部署格式对矩阵中每个整数码分配相同比特，尽管码分布高度不均匀，存在压缩空间。
AI.method: 1) 保留既有量化格式，仅调整 GPTQ 训练使整数码可压缩；2) 在交错通道（interleaved lanes）上做 Huffman 无损编码；3) 在 DRAM 与 L2 之间设置小型解码单元按需解码，GPU kernel 无需修改，DRAM 只传输编码字节；4) 设计位精确的 0.21 mm² ASIC 解码器（1 GHz，7 nm），并在 AMD ZCU102（Zynq UltraScale+）FPGA 上验证位精确性。
AI.result: 在 1% 与 3.5% 困惑度预算下，编码后的 Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B、SmolLM-1.7B 比最优 llama.cpp 格式小 5.7–31.4%。ASIC 解码单元使 Orin 每 token 延迟与能耗最多降低 36% 和 38%（结合 prompt-lookup 推测时达 54% 和 44%）。Nano 上每 token 耗时减少 58–64%、能耗减少 53–57%，并以 3.89 bit/weight 流式运行 Mistral-7B，速度快 6.6×。等吞吐下 Huffman 解码器在码率与面积上均优于 rANS。
AI.conclusion: 以码分布非均匀性为切入点，在保持格式兼容与计算不变的前提下，通过可压缩量化 + 无损 Huffman 编码 + 近内存轻量解码，可同时缓解边缘 LLM 的容量与带宽瓶颈；Huffman 方案在率失真与硬件开销上优于 rANS，且解码器已通过 FPGA 位精确验证。

title: TTB: Test-time Baking for Efficient Rendering of Decoder-only View Synthesis Models
summary: Decoder-only Large View Synthesis Models (LVSMs) with KV-cache have recently achieved state-of-the-art quality by regressing novel views from neural networks without reconstructing 3D geometry, while Test-Time Training (TTT) layers save computation but sacrifice quality. We propose Test-Time Baking (TTB), a strategy that learns to bake global scene information from cross-view attention into a lightweight MLP, enabling fast and high-fidelity novel-view decoding. The first key is to repurpose the fast-weight MLP of TTT to learn the cross-view attention mapping explicitly from its input-output pairs, rather than replacing attention entirely, achieving the same rendering efficiency as TTT while delivering substantially higher quality. The second key addresses a modality misalignment between context prefilling and novel-view rendering: we disentangle context tokens into camera-only context rendering tokens to serve as TTB input, and context ground-truth tokens with image content to serve as the TTB mapping target, ensuring the baked MLPs are relieved of the modality generalization challenge between context and novel-view processing. Our method achieves up to **23x** rendering speedup with quality on par with the state-of-the-art across several benchmarks. Project page: https://test-time-baking.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出Test-Time Baking (TTB)，把跨视角注意力中的全局场景信息"烘焙"进轻量MLP，实现与TTT同等渲染效率但质量接近SOTA的新视角合成，最高23倍渲染加速。
AI.motivation: Decoder-only大视角合成模型(LVSMs)配合KV-cache虽达到SOTA质量，但需从网络直接回归新视角、不重建3D几何，代价高；Test-Time Training(TTT)层虽节省计算，却牺牲渲染质量。动机在于同时获得TTT的推理效率与注意力机制的渲染保真度。
AI.method: 两个关键设计：(1) 复用TTT的fast-weight MLP，显式地从跨视角注意力的输入-输出对中学习该注意力映射，而非用其完全替代注意力；(2) 解决context预填充与新视角渲染之间的模态错位——将context token解耦为仅含相机信息的context rendering token作为TTB输入，以及含图像内容的context ground-truth token作为TTB映射目标，使烘焙后的MLP免于context与novel-view处理间的模态泛化难题。
AI.result: 在多个基准上实现最高23倍的渲染加速，且渲染质量与SOTA持平。
AI.conclusion: TTB通过"注意力蒸馏为轻量MLP + 模态解耦"的策略，在不重建几何的decoder-only框架下兼顾了效率与保真度，为LVSMs的实时高质量新视角合成提供了可行路径。

title: Near-Optimal Regret for Oracle-Efficient Adversarial Contextual Bandits
summary:
We study contextual bandits with $K$ actions, a class of $N$ policies, and i.i.d.\ contexts from a distribution that the learner can sample. For any sequence of loss functions fixed before play, we give an oracle-efficient algorithm with expected regret $O(\sqrt{KT\log(2N)}\,\log(2KT))$ against the best policy in hindsight on the realized contexts. This improves the $T^{2/3}$ dependence on the horizon in prior oracle-efficient bounds and achieves the optimal regret rate in this setting up to logarithmic factors.
  Our algorithm perturbs policy scores using a Poisson sample of auxiliary contexts. At each sampled context, the perturbation assigned to an action is a Laplace noise draw multiplied by a scale specific to that context and action. We show that choosing these scales to minimize a convex objective determined by past observations yields the stated regret bound. We further approximate the minimizing scales by projected stochastic gradient descent using only an exact offline cost-sensitive optimization oracle that returns the optimum value. Since the table of scales can be large, the algorithm represents the SGD iterates implicitly by storing the random draws that determine each update and evaluates the scales only at queried contexts. Both the oracle complexity and the remaining resource bounds are polynomial in $T$, $K$, and $\log(2N)$.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于"上下文采样+泊松/拉普拉斯扰动"的 oracle 高效算法，在上下文赌博机中对固定损失序列达到 $O(\sqrt{KT\log(2N)}\log(2KT))$ 的期望 regret 上界，逼近最优率。
AI.motivation: 已有的 oracle 高效（仅依赖离线代价敏感优化 oracle）上下文赌博机算法 regret 对时间跨度 $T$ 的依赖为 $T^{2/3}$，与最优率 $\sqrt{T}$ 存在差距，需要一种既保持 oracle 高效性又能达到近最优 regret 的方法。
AI.method: 算法用辅助上下文（来自可采样分布的 i.i.d. 样本）对策略得分做扰动：每个被采样的上下文上，对每个动作施加由"该上下文-动作专属尺度"缩放的拉普拉斯噪声，并用泊松采样确定扰动的上下文数量。尺度通过最小化一个由历史观测决定的凸目标来选取，理论上证明该最优尺度给出所述 regret 界；实际中用投影随机梯度下降（PSGD）近似，仅借助返回最优值的精确离线代价敏感优化 oracle。由于尺度表规模巨大，算法隐式表示 SGD 迭代：存储决定每次更新的随机抽样，仅在查询上下文处即时计算尺度。
AI.result: 对任意在博弈前固定的损失函数序列，相对事后在已实现上下文上的最优策略，期望 regret 为 $O(\sqrt{KT\log(2N)}\log(2KT))$；相较先前 oracle 高效界将 $T^{2/3}$ 改进为近 $\sqrt{T}$，且达到该设定下忽略对数因子后的最优速率。oracle 复杂度及所有其他资源开销均为 $T$、$K$、$\log(2N)$ 的多项式。
AI.conclusion: 通过上下文采样加自适应拉普拉斯扰动、并用 SGD 隐式维护尺度，可在仅使用精确离线代价敏感优化 oracle 的前提下实现近最优 regret，同时保持多项式级 oracle 复杂度与计算/存储开销。

title: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
summary: How multimodal language models should encode visual input remains up for debate. Most models use a pretrained vision encoder, while some recent recipes train the encoder from scratch with the language model or remove it entirely. Vision encoders bundle together three design choices: a visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and pre-fusion placement of that capacity (i.e., before the multimodal backbone). Because published models also differ in data, architecture, and compute, comparing them cannot isolate the effect of each choice. We disentangle these choices via a controlled framework where we pretrain all models from scratch on common data and compare them on visual question answering and language benchmarks at matched lifetime compute. We find that the visual prior is not necessary; an encoder trained jointly from scratch is on par with a pretrained one, without a separate training stage. What matters instead is dedicated vision capacity: an encoder-free model trails on visual understanding even when its backbone is enlarged by the encoder's parameter count. Yet that capacity need not precede multimodal fusion, as vision-only modules added in-fusion to early backbone layers perform comparably to a pre-fusion encoder and can lower time to first token. These results also hold across backbone sizes, when encoder pretraining is treated as free, and when starting from a pretrained language model. Overall, our findings favor dedicated vision capacity trained jointly with the backbone and placed early within it.

AI.tldr: 在同等总计算量下受控对比发现：视觉先验并非必需，联合从零训练的视觉编码器可媲美预训练编码器；真正关键的是专用视觉容量，且该容量可置于多模态融合内部（早期骨干层）而非融合之前，效果相当并能降低首token时延。
AI.motivation: 多模态语言模型如何编码视觉输入尚无定论：主流做法用预训练视觉编码器，近期也有与语言模型联合从零训练或完全去掉编码器的方案。但视觉编码器实际捆绑了三个设计选择——上游预训练带来的视觉先验、专用视觉容量、以及该容量在融合前的位置。而已发表模型在数据、架构、算力上各不相同，无法隔离每个选择的作用。
AI.method: 构建控制变量框架：所有模型在同一数据上从零预训练，在匹配"生命周期总计算量"的条件下，于视觉问答与语言基准上比较。分别拆解视觉先验、专用视觉容量、融合前位置三项因素，并进一步验证跨骨干规模、将编码器预训练视为零成本、以及从预训练语言模型出发等设定下结论的稳健性。
AI.result: （1）视觉先验不必要：联合从零训练的编码器与预训练编码器表现相当，无需单独训练阶段；（2）专用视觉容量重要：无编码器模型即便按编码器参数量放大骨干，视觉理解仍落后；（3）容量不必先于融合：在融合内部、早期骨干层加入视觉专用模块，表现与融合前编码器相当，且可降低首token时延。上述结论在多种骨干规模及不同初始化设定下均成立。
AI.conclusion: 主张采用"与骨干联合训练、并置于骨干早期层内部"的专用视觉容量方案，而非依赖上游预训练视觉编码器或彻底去除编码器。

title: Bellman Contraction under MMD: A Unified Framework
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 88 pages, 18 figures, 13 tables
summary: We introduce a mathematical framework for studying contraction of the distributional Bellman operator under Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD). We show that contraction reduces to conditional positive definiteness of an associated kernel constructed from the base kernel, which we call the Bellman difference kernel. Focusing on radial kernels, we use Schoenberg's theorem to connect this condition to Bernstein functions. This gives contraction criteria that hold in any dimension and can be verified analytically or tested numerically. Our framework unifies known results for the Gaussian RBF, power-distance, and multiquadric kernels. A numerical search identifies 11 new kernels that induce contraction. We also propose chaining, a general construction that produces kernels inducing contraction with any prescribed factor. To reconcile theory with practice, we show that contraction on a set only requires conditional positive definiteness on that set. This explains why the RBF kernel can remain a valid choice when rewards are bounded, despite its lack of global contraction. Finally, we identify a fundamental tradeoff between contraction rate and discriminative power, where kernels that contract faster tend to discriminate less between distributions. Code is available at https://github.com/BaptisteDebes/BellmanContractionMMD

AI.tldr: 该文在MMD下研究分布贝尔曼算子的压缩性，将其归约为"贝尔曼差分核"的条件正定性，用Schoenberg定理与Bernstein函数给出任意维度的判据，统一已有结果、发现11个新核，并提出chaining构造与"集合上局部压缩"解释。
AI.motivation: 分布强化学习中以MMD度量分布时，贝尔曼算子的压缩性是收敛性保证的核心，但已有结论零散（多针对Gaussian RBF等个别核、个别维度），缺乏统一的、可在任意维度验证的判据，也难以解释实践中RBF核虽无全局压缩却仍有效。
AI.method: 构造由基础核导出的"贝尔曼差分核"，证明MMD下压缩性等价于该核的条件正定性；对径向核借助Schoenberg定理把条件正定性转化为Bernstein函数刻画，得到任意维度可解析验证或数值检验的压缩准则；进一步提出chaining构造以生成任意指定压缩因子的核，并给出集合上的局部条件正定性版本。
AI.result: 框架统一了Gaussian RBF、power-distance与multiquadric核的已知结论；数值搜索发现11个可诱导压缩的新核；chaining可产生任意给定压缩因子的核；证明集合上压缩只需该集合上的条件正定性，从而解释有界奖励下RBF仍有效；揭示压缩速率与判别能力之间的权衡——压缩越快判别力越弱。
AI.conclusion: MMD下贝尔曼算子的压缩性可完全归结为贝尔曼差分核的条件正定性，并可由Bernstein函数系统刻画；该理论兼顾统一性、可构造性与实践解释力，但存在压缩率与分布判别力的固有权衡。

title: Back to Pixels: Lifting Latent Video Diffusion into Pixel Space
summary: Frontier video generation models work in a VAE latent space that compresses video in both space and time. This compression made training tractable, but now limits high-resolution, controllable, and interactive generation -- doubling resolution quadruples token count, conditions apply to groups of frames rather than individual ones, and each response must wait for the rest of its multi-frame block. We present PixVid, a simple yet effective method that lifts a pretrained latent video model to directly generate every frame in pixel space. PixVid keeps the diffusion transformer and replaces the VAE decoder with a convolutional head that renders its outputs into pixels. We find that predicting clean video rather than velocity, together with a larger noise shift, is key to quality. Finetuned from Wan2.1-14B, PixVid is competitive with the latent baseline within $\sim 1.3$M training clips. Working framewise in pixels, it generates at $2\times$ higher resolution with the same per-frame token count, keeps depth-conditioned video editing aligned under fast motion, and responds to each action at the next frame. Project page: https://chenshuo20.github.io/PixVid/

AI.tldr: 提出 PixVid，将预训练潜空间视频扩散模型改造为像素空间逐帧直接生成，去除 VAE 解码器、保留 DiT，用卷积头输出像素。
AI.motivation: VAE 潜空间的时空压缩虽使训练可行，但制约高分辨率、精细可控与交互式生成：分辨率翻倍使 token 数增至 4 倍；条件只能作用于帧组而非单帧；每帧输出须等待整个多帧块生成完毕，无法即时响应。
AI.method: 保留 Wan2.1-14B 的扩散 Transformer，将 VAE 解码器替换为卷积渲染头，直接在像素空间逐帧预测；关键设计为预测干净视频而非速度场，并采用更大的噪声偏移（noise shift）。
AI.result: 在约 1.3M 训练片段微调后，质量与潜空间基线相当；相同单帧 token 数下分辨率提升 2 倍；深度条件视频编辑在快速运动下保持对齐；可逐帧响应动作。
AI.conclusion: 像素空间逐帧生成是解锁高分辨率、单帧级可控与交互式视频生成的有效路径，且能以极低微调成本从强潜空间模型迁移。

title: Using an energy pixels approach to estimate the size a 2nd Generation DEL must be to train a high-resolution binding model
summary: DNA-encoded libraries (DELs) are commonly used to find small-molecule binders to a target protein. But the hard part is no longer finding a hit. It is building a machine-learning model good enough to guide the medicinal chemistry that follows, one that can resolve the shift in affinity when a chemist changes a single atom. Such a model needs two things from its training data: dense sampling of the small patch of chemical space around the hit, and an adequate number of genuinely tight binders within it. A diverse naive DEL gives neither. It samples an enormous space, so any one neighborhood is covered far too thinly, and the tightest binders are rare. A model trained on that naive DEL data must extrapolate to binders tighter than any it has seen, and that is where models can fail. One way to get training data with both properties is a second-generation DEL built around the hit. We ask how complex that library must be. We treat binding as a sum of small, independent interactions, called pixels on the target and antipixels on the ligand. From the spread of affinities measured in the naive library, with no structural information and nothing yet synthesized, we estimate the complexity such a library must have to supply that dense sampling and those tight binders. The method does two useful things. It turns the number of tight binders a model needs into the number of compounds a library must contain. And it estimates the expected yield of a randomly designed second-generation DEL, so the gain from designing the library with machine learning or active learning can be measured against a baseline, without the expense of a control library as large as the experiment itself.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种在尚无结构信息和化合物合成前，仅依据naive DEL亲和力分布估计"围绕hit设计的第二代DEL"所需复杂度的方法，从而把模型所需的紧结合物数量换算为文库化合物数，并给出随机设计二代文库的期望产率基线。
AI.motivation: DEL的难点已从"找到hit"转向"训练出能分辨单原子亲和力变化的机器学习模型"。此类模型要求训练数据兼具两点：对hit附近化学空间的密集采样，以及足够数量的真正紧结合物。naive DEL空间巨大、邻域覆盖过稀且紧结合物稀少，模型被迫外推至更强结合物而失败；而第二代（围绕hit构建）DEL可满足这两点，但其所需复杂度未知。
AI.method: 将结合视为若干小而独立相互作用的加和，即靶点上的"像素"与配体上的"反像素"。利用naive文库测得的亲和力离散度，在不依赖结构信息、无需合成的前提下，估计第二代文库为提供密集采样与足量紧结合物所需的复杂度。方法包含两步：把模型所需的紧结合物数目转换为文库应有的化合物数；并估计随机设计的二代DEL的期望产率。
AI.result: 给出由亲和力分布推算文库复杂度的定量关系；提供随机设计二代DEL期望产率的估计，使以机器学习/主动学习设计文库所获增益可与基线比较，且无需设置与实验本身同等规模的对照文库，从而节省成本。
AI.conclusion: 第二代DEL的复杂度可由naive文库的亲和力离散度先行估算，为药物化学后续优化所需的机器学习训练数据提供设计依据；同时建立了无需大型对照文库的基准评价框架，使主动学习设计的收益可被经济地度量。

title: Paper-Faithful Federated Learning: Scientific Checks for Practitioner and Agent Development
summary: Federated learning experiments can produce reasonable-looking results even when the experiment implementation differs from the intended experimental protocol. Small errors in configuration, data partitioning, aggregation, randomness, evaluation, or checkpoint recovery may therefore affect a comparison without causing the program to fail. We present FedBrew, a research codebase for controlled and reproducible federated learning experiments. Its focus is controlled simulation with checks of specified conditions of the intended experimental protocol. FedBrew uses configuration checks, identifiable client data partitions, checkpoint recovery checks, self-describing run records, and development-time checks of scientific conditions. These checks assess, for example, whether client partitions are disjoint and exhaustive and aggregation weights match the prescribed rule; numerical and recovery checks examine non-finite client model states and interrupted runs. The same structure also provides clear extension points and automated checks for new algorithms, datasets, models, and tasks, whether they are added by researchers or AI coding agents. FedBrew therefore supports reproducible and inspectable FL experiments through checks of specified software and scientific conditions and the run records associated with reported results.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FedBrew——一个面向可控、可复现联邦学习实验的研究代码库,通过配置校验、可识别客户端数据划分、检查点恢复校验、自描述运行记录与开发期科学条件校验,使实验实现偏离预期协议时能被检出而非"静默通过"。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习实验中,配置、数据划分、聚合、随机性、评估或检查点恢复的细微实现错误往往不会导致程序崩溃,却能悄然改变实验结论,使看似合理的结果实际不可比、不可复现。现有代码库缺乏对"实验协议是否被真正遵守"的显式校验。
AI.method: FedBrew 以受控仿真为核心:①配置校验;②可识别的客户端数据划分;③检查点恢复校验;④自描述的运行记录(run records);⑤开发期科学条件检查。检查内容包括客户端划分是否互斥且完备、聚合权重是否符合规定规则,以及非有限的客户端模型状态与中断运行后的恢复正确性;同时为新算法、数据集、模型和任务提供清晰的扩展点与自动化检查(面向研究者及 AI 编码代理)。
AI.result: 通过软件条件与科学条件的双重检查以及与之绑定的运行记录,FedBrew 能够暴露实现与协议之间的偏差,支持可复现且可审计的联邦学习实验,并降低新组件接入时的错误风险。
AI.conclusion: FedBrew 将"预期实验协议"显式化为可自动检验的条件,把正确性保证从结果外观转移到流程校验与运行记录上,为联邦学习研究提供了可控、可复现、可检视的实验基础设施。

title: Support-Constrained Offline Policy Improvement for Pediatric ECMO from Limited Clinical Data
summary: Managing children on ECMO (Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation) requires balancing short-term physiological stability with the long-term goal of preventing neurological injury. Standard reinforcement learning can propose risky, out-of-distribution actions, while imitation learning is limited to reproducing clinician behavior. We introduce Support-Constrained Fitted Q-Iteration (FQI-SC), an offline reinforcement learning framework that cautiously improves upon expert behavior by restricting optimization to empirically supported state-action pairs and defaulting to the clinician baseline in low-data regions. On 78 pediatric trajectories totaling over 6,000 hours of clinical data, we evaluate our framework using Fitted Q-Evaluation (FQE) and a behavioral disagreement. Additionally, we formalize the performance-safety trade-off by introducing a unified Balance Score ($S(π)$). Our empirical evaluation shows that support-constrained policy improves the Balance Score by 38\% relative to FQI, improves estimated value by 1.28 FQE units over imitation learning, and reduces disagreement with clinician actions by 71\% relative to FQI.

AI.tldr: 提出支持约束拟合Q迭代（FQI-SC）离线强化学习框架，在儿童ECMO管理中兼顾生理稳定与神经保护，性能与安全性均优于FQI与模仿学习。
AI.motivation: 儿童ECMO管理需在短期生理稳定与长期防止神经损伤之间权衡。标准强化学习易提出高风险、分布外动作；模仿学习只能复现临床医生行为，无法改进。
AI.method: 提出FQI-SC：将优化限制在经验支持的(state, action)对上，在低数据区域回退到临床医生基线策略，实现谨慎的策略改进。基于78条儿童轨迹、逾6000小时临床数据，用Fitted Q-Evaluation（FQE）与行为不一致性评估，并引入统一的Balance Score S(π)形式化性能—安全权衡。
AI.result: 支持约束策略相较FQI使Balance Score提升38%；估计价值较模仿学习提升1.28个FQE单位；与临床医生动作的不一致率相较FQI降低71%。
AI.conclusion: 支持约束为离线RL在安全关键的临床决策中提供了可行路径：在提升策略性能的同时保持与专家行为的高度一致，避免分布外高风险动作。

title: ISLA: A Coordinate-Free, Measure-Weighted Transformer for Boundary-Driven PDEs
comment: 48 pages, 14 figures, 26 tables. Companion paper to "AeroZoo: A Benchmark of Well-Posed Flow Problems for Foundation Models of Aerodynamics" (Sharpe et al., 2026)
summary: A foundational principle of physics is that all coordinate systems are equally valid: the behavior of a PDE-governed system does not depend on the origin or orientation of the frame, nor on the units or mesh used to write it down, and neither should a surrogate model. Yet the neural surrogates with the lowest errors on today's aerodynamics benchmarks lack these invariances and fail under simple transformations of the same problem: for models trained on PDEs of cars in one pose (i.e., translation and rotation) and from one mesher, rotating the full PDE raises the surface-pressure error from 4% to more than 100%, and re-sampling its boundary raises it to about 30%. We introduce ISLA (Invariant Slice Attention), a slice-attention transformer for steady, boundary-driven PDEs in which no learned operation receives a coordinate and every sum over the boundary is a quadrature. Positions enter only as distances and relative angles to learned slice anchors, lengths are measured in a unit computed from the boundary, and interior points query the boundary through a tree-accelerated learned kernel without influencing one another. With every boundary cell a token and an exact boundary read, ISLA is equivariant to rigid motions and reflections, invariant to the units of its declared data, and consistent under mesh refinement, while at every setting each query is independent of all other queries. On AeroZoo, 2,816 flows that vary in shape, size, speed, and boundary conditions, its mean reference-scaled velocity and pressure errors are at least 3.1 and 3.3 times lower than any baseline's. On AirfRANS its errors are second only to those of a boundary-integral model (GLOBE) and at least 1.6 times lower than those of Transolver and GeoTransolver.

AI.tldr: 提出ISLA（Invariant Slice Attention），一种面向稳态、边界驱动PDE的切片注意力Transformer，通过对坐标、单位与网格的严格对称性设计，实现刚性运动/反射等变、单位不变与网格细分一致，并在AeroZoo与AirfRANS上显著优于现有神经代理模型。
AI.motivation: 物理基本原则要求PDE系统的行为不依赖坐标系原点、朝向、单位或网格，代理模型也应如此；但当前空气动力学基准上误差最低的神经代理模型缺乏这些不变性，在同一问题的简单变换下即失效：对单一姿态（平移旋转）与单一网格生成的汽车PDE模型，旋转整体PDE使表面压力误差从4%升至100%以上，重采样边界则升至约30%。
AI.method: ISLA为切片注意力Transformer：①任何可学习操作均不直接接收坐标；②边界上的所有求和均以数值求积实现；③位置仅以到可学习切片锚点的距离和相对角度形式进入；④长度以由边界计算出的单位度量；⑤内部点通过树加速的学习核查询边界，且内部点之间互不影响；⑥每个边界单元作为一个token，并进行精确边界读取。
AI.result: 在AeroZoo（2,816个在形状、尺寸、速度与边界条件上变化的流动）上，其参考缩放后的速度与压力平均误差至少比所有基线低3.1倍与3.3倍；在AirfRANS上误差仅次于边界积分模型GLOBE，且至少比Transolver与GeoTransolver低1.6倍。理论上具备刚性运动与反射等变、声明数据的单位不变、网格细分一致，且每个查询与其他查询独立。
AI.conclusion: 将物理对称性（等变、不变、网格一致性、查询独立性）内嵌于网络结构，可在保持精度的同时获得对变换的鲁棒泛化，为边界驱动稳态PDE的神经代理建模提供了可控、可扩展的范式。

title: A Convex-Analytic Reformulation for Poisoning Attacks on Logistic Regression
summary: We study data poisoning attacks on logistic regression with $\ell_2$-regularization, where an attacker chooses the features of a fixed number of injected observations with prescribed labels to maximize the logistic loss on the clean training data. Strong convexity of the defender's problem yields an exact reformulation through its first-order optimality conditions. Using convex conjugacy of the softplus function, we replace the sigmoid relations by a single convex optimality-gap inequality and express the attacker's objective as a concave function. A change of variables makes the stationarity condition affine, leaving bounded bilinear equalities as the only nonconvex constraints. We derive finite bounds on all variables involved in these equalities, including a global bound on the coefficient norm and tighter bounds obtained by preprocessing based on convex optimization. Experiments on eight binary classification datasets evaluate attack effectiveness and compare the two reformulations when solved with \textsf{SCIP}. Attacks obtained by local optimization degrade predictive performance on most datasets, while the convex-analytic formulation produces substantially stronger reported dual bounds within a fixed time limit.

AI.tldr: 该文研究ℓ2正则化逻辑回归上的数据投毒攻击，利用强凸性与凸共轭给出精确可行重构，使攻击问题变为仅含双线性等式约束的紧凑非凸模型。
AI.motivation: 现有数据投毒攻击研究多针对线性模型或采用启发式求解，缺乏对ℓ2正则逻辑回归攻击问题的精确刻画与可证明的求解质量保证，需要既可解又具界估计的建模框架。
AI.method: 以防御者问题强凸性下的KKT一阶最优性条件精确重构攻击问题；借助softplus的凸共轭将sigmoid关系替换为单一凸最优间隙不等式，使攻击者目标化为凹函数；通过变量变换使平稳性条件变为仿射，从而仅保留有界双线性等式为非凸约束；推导所有变量的有限界，包括系数范数全局界与基于凸优化预处理得到的更紧界；在8个二分类数据集上用SCIP比较两种重构。
AI.result: 局部优化得到的攻击在多数数据集上降低了预测性能；凸分析重构在固定时间限制内给出显著更强的对偶界（报告界）。
AI.conclusion: 该重构在保持精确性的同时改善了全局求解的界质量，为逻辑回归投毒攻击的可证明评估提供了实用框架。

title: Enhancing Preference Detection using Eye Movement Cascade and Multilayer Combinatorial Fusion
comment: Published in the Proceedings of the 26th Annual International Conference of the Global Business and Technology Association (GBATA), 2026, pp. 969-980
summary: Understanding how visual attention influences human preference formation is a fundamental problem in consumer behavior and cognitive science. In this work, we investigate how eye movement patterns can be used to predict preference decisions when subjects compare two alternatives. To address this problem, we analyze an eye-tracking dataset, where subjects view pairs of face images and their gaze behavior is recorded throughout the decision process. We model this problem using multiple machine learning classifiers and apply the Multi-layer Combinatorial Fusion (MCF) framework to iteratively combine diverse models. The MCF framework expands models to a large pool of model fusions and then reduces them based on cognitive diversity, repeating this process across layers until diversity diminishes. Experimental results show that MCF significantly improves performance over individual models. The best single model achieves a Pre@k of 0.90, which is improved to 0.9143 after the first layer of MCF, and further increased to 0.9286 in the second layer. This progression demonstrates that the second layer not only surpasses the performance of the first layer but also outperforms the best individual model, highlighting the effectiveness of leveraging diversity through multi-layer fusion.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用眼动数据预测二选一偏好决策，提出多层组合融合（MCF）框架迭代融合多样分类器，Pre@k由最佳单模型的0.90提升至0.9143（第一层）和0.9286（第二层）。
AI.motivation: 理解视觉注意如何影响人类偏好形成是消费者行为与认知科学的基础问题；作者希望探究眼动模式能否用于预测被试在两选项比较中的偏好决策。
AI.method: 分析眼动追踪数据集（被试观看成对人脸图像，全程记录注视行为）；采用多种机器学习分类器建模；应用多层组合融合（MCF）框架，先将模型扩展为大规模模型融合池，再依据认知多样性进行约简，逐层重复直至多样性减弱。
AI.result: MCF显著优于单一模型：最佳单模型Pre@k为0.90，第一层MCF提升至0.9143，第二层进一步提升至0.9286，第二层既超过第一层也超过最佳单模型。
AI.conclusion: 多层融合可通过利用模型间认知多样性有效提升基于眼动的偏好预测性能，验证了MCF框架在此类决策预测任务中的有效性。

title: AeroZoo: A Benchmark of Well-Posed Flow Problems for Foundation Models of Aerodynamics
comment: 35 pages, 13 figures, 23 tables. Lead authors: Peter Sharpe and Carmelo Gonzales. Companion paper to "ISLA: A Coordinate-Free, Measure-Weighted Transformer for Boundary-Driven PDEs" (Sharpe, 2026). Dataset to be published shortly at https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/AeroZoo
summary: Neural surrogates for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) are trained and ranked on datasets that each vary one design family in one flow domain. Such datasets cannot test the least that an aerodynamic foundation model must do: predict CFD-quality incompressible flow in seconds for new shapes in new enclosures. On DrivAerML, larger models and longer training barely lower Transolver's error; doubling the training cases cuts it by about 12% up to 400 cases, exhausting the dataset. We introduce AeroZoo, a benchmark and training corpus of 3,815 time-mean solutions to the unsteady Reynolds-averaged Navier--Stokes (RANS) equations with a transition model, across seven geometry families, eight enclosure configurations and Reynolds numbers from $10^3$ to $10^8$. Each sample poses a well-posed PDE problem in the form a solver receives it: the boundary meshes grouped by condition type, the prescribed values and the fluid properties. The 2,816 samples with a stable time mean form the canonical benchmark: two tasks, engineering metrics and 22 frozen splits, disjoint in geometry, that hold out geometry families, enclosures, boundary-condition layouts and Reynolds ranges. On the random split, boundary-condition tokens cut GeoTransolver's median velocity error from 76.9% to 8.4% of the inlet speed in single-seed runs (uniform inlet flow: 11.0%). ISLA, a transformer for boundary-driven PDEs, reaches 5.3% over four seeds, about 4 times the change from a finer mesh. On the same test samples, a held-out geometry family barely changes ISLA's error relative to uniform flow, and a held-out enclosure or boundary-condition layout raises it 2.4 to 9.2 times. The data and the scoring code will be released.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AeroZoo：包含 3,815 个带转捩模型 URANS 时均解的基准与训练语料，覆盖 7 个几何族、8 种外罩构型与 Re=10^3–10^8；其中 2,816 个稳定时均样本构成规范基准，含工程指标任务与 22 个几何/外罩/边界条件/雷诺数不交叠的冻结划分。实验显示边界条件 token 将 GeoTransolver 中位速度误差从 76.9% 降至 8.4%，ISLA 四种子达 5.3%；留出几何族影响很小，而留出外罩或边界条件布局使误差升高 2.4–9.2 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有 CFD 神经代理模型的训练与评测数据集通常只变化单一设计族、单一流场域，无法检验"气动基础模型"的最低要求——在数秒内对新外形、新外罩给出 CFD 级不可压流预测；且在 DrivAerML 上增大模型与延长训练收益甚微，加数据在 400 例后即饱和（误差仅降约 12%），说明需要更广、更难的基准来度量泛化。
AI.method: 构建 AeroZoo 基准与训练语料：3,815 个含转捩模型的非定常 RANS 时均解，跨 7 个几何族、8 种外罩构型、Re=10^3–10^8；每个样本以求解器输入形式给出适定 PDE 问题（按条件类型分组的边界网格、给定值与流体物性）。以 2,816 个具稳定时均的样本作为规范基准，设两个任务：工程指标预测与 22 个几何不交叠的冻结划分，分别留出几何族、外罩、边界条件布局与雷诺数区间。
AI.result: 随机划分下，引入边界条件 token 使 GeoTransolver 中位速度误差由入口速度的 76.9% 降至 8.4%（均匀入口流为 11.0%）；面向边界驱动 PDE 的 Transformer ISLA 在四个随机种子上达 5.3%，约为加密网格带来改善的 4 倍。相同测试样本上，留出几何族对 ISLA 误差影响甚微（接近均匀流水平），而留出外罩或边界条件布局使误差升高 2.4 至 9.2 倍。
